PVV MPs Fritsma and Kops asked how many social rental homes are occupied by status holders, whether the minister withheld this information, and whether that undermines MPs' right to ask questions. Minister Ollongren answered that the number is not centrally registered, offered only a theoretical estimate of about 38,000 homes for Syrian status holders, and said she has no exact figure.
I have no insight into how many social rental homes are currently occupied by status holders, not even after consultation with Aedes and COA.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel sociale huurwoningen momenteel worden bewoond door statushouders, ook niet na afstemming met Aedes en COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht 'Kerncijfers Asiel en Migratie'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Syrians cannot be returned to Turkey under the EU-Turkey deal yet still receive residence permits in the Netherlands, and urged halting permits and asylum for Syrians and immigrants from Islamic countries. The State Secretary answered that the EU-Turkey deal reduced crossings, that a country-of-origin report on Syria is due in summer 2018, that the Netherlands grants asylum only after careful procedure, and refused to halt asylum or admission of immigrants from Islamic countries, saying no such list is used.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, De Roon en Fritsma over de schamele korting op de financiële steun van de Europese Unie (EU) aan Turkije en het vooruitzicht op visumvrij reizen van miljoenen Turken

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether a reported 100 million euro cut in EU pre-accession aid to Turkey is real, whether Dutch money should still flow to Turkey, for a detailed overview of EU funds, and whether visa-free travel for Turks can be prevented. The minister confirmed about 50% cuts to annual and about 30% to multi-year pre-accession programmes in 2017, said the Netherlands favours suspension but lacks majority support, referred to existing documentation for fund details, and stated Turkey does not yet meet all visa liberalisation benchmarks so no Dutch position is needed yet.
The Netherlands is awaiting the Commission's proposals for limiting and reallocating the funds.
Nederland wacht de voorstellen van de Commissie voor inperking en herschikking van de middelen af.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Fritsma, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht dat Nederlanders langer op de wachtlijst voor een sociale huurwoning moeten staan doordat statushouders en buitenlandse arbeidskrachten

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch social-rent applicants face longer waiting lists because statushouders, foreign workers and students get priority, and whether social housing should go only to Dutch nationals. The Minister said housing supply drives waiting times, that the automatic urgency status for statushouders was removed, that she has no data on how many social rentals statushouders occupy, and that allocation by nationality is ruled out under equal treatment.
I have no insight into how many social rental homes are currently occupied by statushouders.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel sociale huurwoningen momenteel worden bewoond door statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, Fritsma, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Brede onrust na aanval op joods restaurant’

MPs of the PVV asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the suspect in an attack on a Jewish restaurant, who threw a burning liquid, was prosecuted only for vandalism and theft rather than a terrorist offence, and whether he could be deported. The Minister replied that prosecution and sentencing are for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts, that he would not comment on the individual case, and noted the court had adjourned the case for further investigation.
As you know, it is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide on prosecuting the suspect and to formulate a sentencing demand.
Zoals bij u bekend is het aan het OM om te besluiten over de vervolging van de verdachte en daarbij een strafeis te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over toegang van terroristen tot het Europees Parlement

PVV MPs asked whether the government knew that Leila Khaled had been received in the European Parliament, whether it finds this absurd, how a convicted hijacker obtained a Schengen visa, and what will prevent recurrence. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to judge the Parliament's invitation decision, explained the SIS refusal mechanism in general terms without discussing the individual case, and stated no action on the invitation policy.
I see no reason to intervene in the assessment made by the European Parliament when inviting Ms Khaled.
Ik zie geen aanleiding te treden in de afweging die door het Europees parlement is gemaakt bij de uitnodiging aan mevrouw Khaled.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over de berichtgeving dat de Syrische terrorist Yahyah Farroukh onlangs in Nederland was

PVV MPs asked whether suspect Yahyah Farroukh visited family in the Netherlands, how he passed screening, and whether Syrian asylum permits should be revoked given Syria's supposed safety. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated the person is no longer a suspect, defended asylum protection for those the IND finds in need, and refused to revoke Syrian asylum permits.
I generally do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik in de regel geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma en Maeijer over door NGO's gefaciliteerde asielinvasie naar Europese Unie

Two PVV MPs asked whether NGO sea rescue operations facilitate people smuggling and whether Dutch public money funds such NGOs, and urged closing the borders. The government answered that no Dutch subsidies go to Mediterranean rescue operations, that Italian criminal investigations must be awaited, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.

As also exchanged in previous answers and during various General Consultations, the Dutch government does not provide subsidies or other forms of financing to organisations for rescue operations in the Mediterranean Sea.

Zoals ook in eerdere beantwoording en tijdens verschillende Algemene Overleggen is gewisseld, verstrekt de Nederlandse overheid geen subsidies of andere vormen van financiering aan organisaties voor reddingsoperaties op de Middellandse Zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Italië weer wordt overspoeld met migranten

Opposition MPs from the PVV asked the government about reports of large migrant arrivals in Italy via Libya, the role of NGOs and Dutch-flagged ships, IOM funding, and calls to close borders. The government answered that arrivals were only slightly up on last year, described EU and Italian measures, said NGO funding and flag-state links require further investigation, and rejected a national border closure as discriminatory and unrealistic.
As far as the cabinet is aware, only in the case of the Iuventa is it currently established that this is an NGO ship sailing under the Dutch flag between Libya and Italy.
Voor zover het kabinet bekend, staat op dit moment alleen ten aanzien van de «Iuventa» vast
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat criminele vreemdelingen zelden worden uitgezet

PVV MPs asked why criminal foreigners often keep residence permits, how often this happens, and whether the state will close borders to asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries. The Secretary of State explained the graduated-scale test for revoking permits, said the IND cannot say how many cases involve insufficient sentences, and rejected a categorical border closure as unrealistic.
Based on the data available at the IND, it cannot be stated in how many cases an imposed sentence is insufficient to proceed to revocation of a residence permit.
Op basis van de bij de IND beschikbare gegevens is niet aan te geven in hoeveel gevallen een opgelegde straf onvoldoende is om over te gaan tot intrekking van een verblijfsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over een in Brunssum opgepakte Syrische terreurverdachte met een verblijfsvergunning

PVV MPs asked how a Syrian asylum seeker with a residence permit, suspected of terrorism, passed screening, how many asylum seekers are suspected of terrorist links, why migration continues, whether such suspects will be deported, and when borders will close to Muslim-country nationals. The state secretary replied that the suspect was wrongly linked to terrorism, that authorities stay alert but cannot guarantee abuse is impossible, that deportation or residence/nationality measures are considered when a conviction or intelligence report exists, and rejected closing borders.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register by residence status.
Het OM registreert niet op verblijfstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Helder en Wilders over een aanranding door een Somalische asielzoeker in Hoorn

PVV MPs asked why a Somali asylum seeker was arrested only months after a sexual assault in Hoorn despite the victim's early tip, why he kept a residence permit while already a suspect, and whether his permit will be revoked. The state secretary explained the DNA-based arrest timeline, said the permit will be reviewed for withdrawal now that the conviction is final, and rejected calls to close borders.
Now that the judgment in this case has become final, the IND will examine whether the residence permit of the person concerned can be withdrawn.
Nu in deze zaak het vonnis onherroepelijk is geworden, zal de IND onderzoeken of de verblijfsvergunning van de betrokkene kan worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Maeijer over de 22 miljard euro die door de EU uitgetrokken is voor de migratiecrisis

MPs Fritsma and Maeijer asked about the EU's 22 billion euro for the migration crisis, including whether the Turkey deal is included, which recipients receive funds and for what purpose, results achieved, and rescue and return numbers. The minister answered in detail on budget categories, funding instruments, Frontex and EASO, rescue figures, and IOM voluntary return numbers, while noting that the Commission does not break down the 22 billion figure and that return figures for the Netherlands will follow later.
However, the Commission does not give in detail how it arrived at these amounts in the factsheet.
De Commissie geeft in het factsheet echter niet in detail aan hoe men tot deze bedragen is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Fritsma en Wilders over 'Meer mensen in de bijstand'

PVV MPs asked whether rising welfare receipt among non-Western migrants, the welfare costs of immigration from Muslim countries, a ten-year residence requirement for social security, and closing borders to asylum seekers are justified. The government confirmed the trend, rejected the cost framing, said a welfare residence requirement would be disproportionate to its goals, and refused an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
The cabinet aims for a reasonable balance between preventing a pull effect on the one hand and income protection for those who have been in the Netherlands longer on the other.
Het kabinet streeft naar een redelijk evenwicht tussen het voorkomen van een aanzuigende werking enerzijds en inkomensbescherming voor degenen die al langer in Nederland zijn anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, De Graaf en Wilders over de berichtgeving dat er fouten zijn gemaakt bij de vrijstelling voor het inburgeringsvereiste

MPs Fritsma, De Graaf and Wilders asked why the IND failed to apply new rules, wrongly exempting thousands of migrants from the civic integration exam, and questioned the cost, grounds for not revoking permits, and the government's immigration policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said the IND took corrective steps, defended that permits cannot be revoked for legal certainty reasons, and rejected the claim that the errors add burdens on public resources.
I regret that the IND did not test applications for a stronger residence right against the stricter civic integration requirements.
Ik betreur dat de IND bij verblijfsaanvragen om een sterker verblijfsrecht niet aan de verzwaarde inburgeringseisen heeft getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over de handel in gestolen spullen door asielzoekers

Wilders and Fritsma asked the State Secretary why asylum seekers at the Delfzijl reception centre can trade stolen goods, why they are not arrested and deported, and whether the borders should be closed. The State Secretary answered that such trade is unacceptable, that COA has no concrete signals so far, that COA was asked to inform residents and enforce the visitor rules, and that he will not close the borders but will act against abuse of asylum law.
I have asked COA to remind residents of the opvanglocaties of the Dutch rules on selling stolen goods.
Ik heb het COA gevraagd om bewoners van de opvanglocaties te wijzen op de in Nederland geldende regels over de verkoop van gestolen goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie vele afgewezen asielzoekers toch trakteert op een verblijfsvergunning

An MP from the PVV asked whether the state secretary granted residence permits in 31% of discretionary cases involving rejected asylum seekers, and whether this amounts to a covert general pardon that rewards overstaying and attracts asylum migration. The state secretary denied any general pardon policy, said each case is judged on its merits and the 31% is a snapshot, and said he uses the discretionary power only in specific, distressing circumstances, while noting that MPs sometimes initiate or support such requests.
I assess each individual case on its own merits.
Elke individuele zaak beoordeel ik op de eigen merites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over het bericht dat al een miljoen Afrikanen onderweg zijn naar Europa

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked whether a reported million Africans en route to Europe, the projected growth of Africa's population, and calls to close Dutch borders to migrants from Islamic countries warranted action. State Secretary Dijkhoff answered that the cabinet lacks comparable figures, rejects closing borders as discriminatory and unrealistic, and describes EU and bilateral measures to address migration root causes and strengthen external borders.
The cabinet does not currently have comparable figures to those on which the former British ambassador based his claim.
Het kabinet beschikt op dit moment niet over vergelijkbare cijfers als die waarop de voormalige Britse ambassadeur zich baseert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het niet samengaan van massa-immigratie en onze verzorgingsstaat

The PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the State Secretary whether open borders are unsustainable given claims about welfare costs of immigration, and why the government does not publish the cost of migration by group, plus questions on Africa and closing borders to Islamic countries. The State Secretary declined to publish group-level cost accounts, pointed to earlier answers and existing policy, and refused to close the borders to asylum seekers from Islamic countries, citing international obligations.
The government does not evaluate citizens, but policy.
De overheid evalueert geen burgers, maar beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Fritsma en Wilders over EU watertaxi’s die 8500 migranten redden

PVV MPs asked about reports that 8,500 migrants were rescued off Libya over Easter weekend, including how many were picked up by Frontex, Italy, NGOs and merchant ships, where they were landed, whether they are held in closed centres, whether terrorists could be among them, whether EU policy creates a pull effect, and whether the Netherlands will close its borders. The government confirmed the figures, said it lacks detailed data on each rescue, described hotspot screening and Europol checks, rejected border closure as neither a complete solution nor clearly feasible, and pointed to a broader EU approach with Libya.
The cabinet does not have detailed information on all rescue operations carried out by various vessels over the Easter weekend.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over gedetailleerde informatie over alle reddingsoperaties die in het paasweekend door verschillende schepen zijn uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over de berichten 'Cijfers onder de pet' en 'Stempel nationale veiligheid excuus'

PVV MPs asked why police refused to share data on crimes by asylum seekers after a Telegraaf FOIA request, and whether this undermines police and mayors' information. The minister says the police initially interpreted the request narrowly, is re-assessing it with priority, and that information is shared with local authorities though no separate registration of asylum seekers' crimes exists.
In response to the Telegraaf's FOIA request, the police replied that they do not record the residence status of persons when arresting or stopping them.
Op het WOB-verzoek van de Telegraaf heeft de politie geantwoord dat zij bij aanhoudingen en staandehoudingen de verblijfstatus van betrokkenen niet registreert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over vakantievierende Eritreeërs

An MP from the PVV asked whether Eritrean refugees with asylum permits who travel back to Eritrea for holidays have had their permits revoked, what has been done to find them, and whether borders should be closed to all asylum seekers. The Secretary of State answered that checks since mid-2015 have revoked some tens of permits, none involving Eritreans among about 100 examined, that intensified checks will follow, and that the Netherlands will keep offering protection on moral and legal grounds.
In the coming period, checks will again be carried out more intensively on whether Eritreans are travelling back.
De komende tijd zal opnieuw intensiever worden gecontroleerd of er sprake is van terugreizende Eritreeërs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over een nieuwe lokatie voor illegalenopvang in Groningen

An MP asks the state secretary why municipalities may keep sheltering migrants without a right to stay, undermining return policy, and whether he will stop a new shelter in Groningen and cut the municipal fund. The state secretary declines to block the Groningen shelter or cut the municipal fund, since no legal norm prohibits such shelter, while he is exploring legal means and says the state no longer funds it since December 2016.
Neither the Aliens Act nor any other legislation or regulation currently prohibits municipalities from providing shelter to foreigners who no longer lawfully reside in the Netherlands.
De vreemdelingenwet, noch andere wet- en regelgeving kent op dit moment een verbod op opvang door gemeenten van vreemdelingen die niet langer rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht “Uitzettingen lopen spaak”

PVV MP Fritsma asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how he assesses the reported stalling of deportations of rejected asylum seekers through repeated applications and appeals, how many remain in the Netherlands as a result, and whether he will close the borders. The State Secretary Dijkhoff answered that appeals rose 66% in 2016 mainly due to higher rejection rates and IND output, that second and later applications fell 15%, pointed to targeted measures and a pilot, and rejected an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
I attach importance to a careful asylum procedure that offers protection to those who need it.
Ik hecht aan een zorgvuldige asielprocedure die bescherming biedt aan degenen die dat nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het bericht “Asielkraak kost goud”

PVV MPs Fritsma and Helder asked why a group of undocumented migrants squatting buildings in Amsterdam has not been deported or stopped, and whether squatting bans and bed-bath-and-bread provision will be enforced or ended. The State Secretary replied that deportation depends on cooperation from countries of origin, that evictions of such squats have been carried out and upheld in court, that the financial compensation to municipalities for bed-bath-and-bread will be stopped, but refused an asylum stop while announcing targeted measures.
I informed your House on 21 November that I am ending the financial compensation for the bed, bath and bread provisions offered by municipalities.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 21 november geïnformeerd dat ik de financiële vergoeding voor de door gemeenten geboden bed, bad en broodvoorzieningen stopzet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Beertema over het bericht dat Brussel haast heeft om visumvrij reizen voor Turken mogelijk te maken

PVV MPs asked why the EU is rushing visa-free travel for Turks despite unmet conditions, whether the government will oppose the Turkey deal, and whether it supports leaving the EU. The minister replied that visa liberalisation is conditional on all benchmarks being met, that the deal reduced irregular inflows, and that the government does not favour leaving the EU.
Only when it is established that all criteria have been met will there be full visa exemption, as repeatedly stated.
Pas wanneer geconstateerd wordt dat is voldaan aan alle criteria zal sprake zijn van volledige visumvrijstelling, zoals bij herhaling aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Helder, Fritsma en De Graaf over de Marokkaanse straatterreur in Maassluis

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about street disturbances by Moroccan-origin youths in Maassluis, including arrests, the mayor's conduct, camera use, police response times and denaturalisation. The minister answered that local authorities chose an emergency order that restored order, eight complaints were filed, five suspects arrested under OM direction, and that camera deployment was routine, while declining to discuss the ongoing investigation and noting the 15-minute police response target.
While the investigation is ongoing, I, as usual, make no further statements about it.
Lopende het onderzoek doe ik, zoals gebruikelijk, hierover geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over (Integratie) over de kosten van asiel en immigratie

MPs Wilders, Fritsma and De Graaf asked for year-by-year net costs of asylum and immigrant groups, and the costs of the 2014-2015 asylum cohort over 30 years including family migration. The State Secretary refused both, stating the government does not keep accounts of costs and benefits by group or origin and only evaluates policy, not citizens.
This cabinet also does not keep accounts of (groups of) citizens.
Ook dit kabinet houdt geen boekhouding van (groepen) burgers bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over het nieuwe Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland (DTN)

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked whether the government takes seriously reports that IS terrorists used the refugee flow to reach Europe, and whether borders and asylum centres should be closed. The minister rejected the claim that asylum intake alone threatens security, said all asylum seekers are identified and registered, acknowledged that misuse cannot be excluded, and said full border closure is neither possible nor the chosen approach.
The cabinet rejects the suggestion that merely admitting asylum seekers would pose a threat to national security.
Het kabinet verwerpt de suggestie dat enkel het binnenlaten van asielzoekers een bedreiging zou vormen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het tegen de wil van de bevolking in doordrukken van een Asielzoekerscentrum (AZC) in Witmarsum

An MP asks the State Secretary why an asylum reception centre for 200 asylum seekers is being imposed on Witmarsum despite a village survey showing residents oppose it, and whether he will halt it and close the borders. The State Secretary replies that municipalities decide on reception centres in consultation with COA and that he neither forces nor blocks the centre there, and that Dutch international obligations to protect asylum seekers remain.
The municipal government decides on the arrival of an asylum reception centre.
Het gemeentebestuur besluit over de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het door het Centraal orgaan Opvang Asielzoekers (COA) verzorgen van huur- en zorgtoeslag voor statushouders

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why status holders receive urgent rent and care allowance handling through COA while Dutch citizens do not, and whether this unequal treatment and priority housing for asylum seekers will end. The State Secretary answered that it is a pilot to reduce errors and speed exit from reception, that the identification step is simply done by COA staff, that all citizens can use Toeslagenservicepunten, and that a bill to remove housing priority for permit holders is being prepared.
There is no question of priority or acceleration for holders of a residence permit compared with Dutch nationals.
Er is geen sprake van voorrang of versnelling van houders van een verblijfsvergunning ten opzichte van Nederlanders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over groepen van vooral Arabische mannen die tientallen jonge vrouwen hebben aangerand, beroofd en verkracht in Duitsland

PVV MPs asked the government whether it shares the view that New Year's Eve sexual assaults by groups of mostly Arab men in German cities reflect imported violence from migrants, and whether it will close borders. The State Secretary answered that sexual violence against women must be combated, that the Cologne events were serious and the investigation ongoing, and declined to speculate on causes or to adopt the rhetoric, without committing to border changes.
For completeness, I note that the investigation into the events in Cologne is still ongoing; I therefore do not think it appropriate to speculate about possible underlying causes.
Volledigheidshalve merk ik op dat het onderzoek naar de gebeurtenissen in Keulen nog loopt; ik vind het daarom niet gepast om te speculeren over mogelijke onderliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over het bericht dat Belgisch Limburg bezorgd is om de waakzaamheid van Nederland

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why vigilance in Belgian Limburg is reportedly higher than on the Dutch side, whether the Netherlands should raise vigilance and close its borders, and how information exchange with mayors will be improved. Minister Van der Steur answered that Belgium raised its threat level, that the Netherlands has been at 'Substantieel' since 2013 with additional measures, that border closure is not justified now while mobile checks and ANPR were intensified, and that information exchange is being strengthened internationally and locally.
After the attacks in Paris, it was decided among other things to intensify measures at locations where travel movements to and from Belgium and France take place.
Na de aanslagen in Parijs is onder meer besloten tot intensivering van de maatregelen op locaties waar reisbewegingen van en naar België en Frankrijk plaatsvinden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen ingezet voor nijpend personeelstekort’

PVV MPs asked why a project placing refugees in jobs against a staff shortage does not consider unemployed Dutch workers, whether it should be ended, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers. The minister replied that the shortages are sector-specific and long-standing, that refugees with residence permits bring useful skills, that the project fits government policy, and that asylum claims are assessed individually.
I do not intend to end this project, because it fits government policy of having refugees contribute to society.
Ik ben niet van plan dit project te laten beëindigen, want het past binnen het kabinetsbeleid om vluchtelingen een bijdrage te laten leveren aan de samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de aanhouding van een Syrische asielzoeker in Den Haag op grond van deelname aan een terroristische organisatie

Fritsma (PVV) asks about the arrest of a Syrian asylum seeker in The Hague on suspicion of participation in a terrorist organisation and whether the government has sufficient insight into who enters the Netherlands without papers, and asks it to close asylum centres and borders. Staatssecretaris Dijkhoff replies that identification and screening procedures and a signal reporting structure are in place, that individual restrictions are possible when risks arise, and that border closure is not the government's approach, which instead focuses on European measures.
I note that despite all measures, a full guarantee of security cannot ultimately be given.
Ik merk hierbij op dat ondanks alle maatregelen een volledige veiligheidsgarantie uiteindelijk niet is te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Fritsma en Wilders over wijkagenten die bezoeken brengen aan leden en sympathisanten van de protestgroep Asielzoekerscentra (AZC)-alert

PVV MPs asked whether police home visits to members and sympathisers of the anti-AZC protest group AZC-alert, in uniform and by police car, are intimidating and whether they will stop. The minister replied that proactive contact with groups planning demonstrations is routine police work under local authority, aimed at reducing tension, and that there is no reason to change the practice.
This takes place under the responsibility of the local authority.
Dit gebeurt onder verantwoordelijkheid van het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Fritsma over het opschorten van de screening op TBC bij Syrische asielzoekers

MPs Klever and Fritsma asked why TB screening of Syrian asylum seekers was suspended, whether the minister considered passport fraud, how many unscreened asylum seekers remain, for how long, and whether no asylum seeker should be admitted. The minister answered that screening is risk-based, Syrian TB risk is low, about 3,000 unregistered people were present with roughly 900 non-Syrians unscreened, the backlog should be cleared in about two weeks, and asylum seekers able to find protection in the region should be returned there.
Parties involved in infectious disease control have indicated they will work to clear this backlog as soon as possible.
Partijen betrokken bij de infectieziektebestrijding hebben aangegeven zich in te zullen spannen om deze achterstand zo spoedig mogelijk weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over toenemende onveiligheid door gewelddadige gelukszoekers

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked why the government keeps admitting asylum seekers they describe as violent, endangering Dutch citizens, and asked whether reception centres will be closed and borders shut. The State Secretary rejected the generalisation, said incidents are assessed individually, noted efforts to limit inflow and support regional reception, and answered the questions together.
My services are of course always alert to possible contra-indications in every individual case and take this into account in their actions and decision-making.
Mijn diensten zijn uiteraard steeds alert op mogelijke contra-indicaties in elke individuele zaak en betrekken dit bij het handelen en de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over grootschalige identiteitsfraude bij pardonners

Fritsma (PVV) asked whether the 2007 pardon scheme, which allowed asylum seekers to correct identity data once without consequences, should be reversed, and how fraudsters can be prevented from naturalising or bringing family members. Staatssecretaris Dijkhoff rejected the premise of mass fraud, refused to scrap the child pardon, and described existing tools (permit revocation, naturalisation withdrawal within twelve years, IND fraud reporting) as adequate.
Under current laws and regulations, adequate action can be taken against fraudsters.
Op basis van de huidige wet- en regelgeving kan adequaat worden opgetreden tegen fraudeurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het snoepreisje van de gehele directie Koninkrijksrelaties naar Curaçao

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations why tens of officials from the Kingdom Relations directorate were allowed a trip to Curaçao, calling it a taxpayer-funded perk, and whether such trips will stop. The minister refers to his answers to earlier questions from MPs Van Raak and Van Laar, giving no substantive answer in this document.
For the answer I refer you to my answers to the questions from MPs Van Raak and Van Laar.
Voor het antwoord verwijs ik u naar mijn antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Laar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het vereiste inburgeringsexamen voor gezinsmigranten

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a European Court of Justice ruling requiring the Netherlands to exempt more family migrants from the civic integration exam, and whether restrictive family reunification policy would be further eroded and whether an EU opt-out on immigration and asylum could be pursued. The State Secretary replied that the cabinet remains committed to restrictive family migration policy within EU law, is still considering the consequences of the ruling, and that an opt-out is not a realistic option since it would require a treaty change.
At this moment the Cabinet is considering the consequences of the ruling.
Op dit moment beraadt het Kabinet zich op de consequenties van de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over intimidatie en bedreigingen door islamitische asielzoekers

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether asylum centres are dominated by Muslims who intimidate Christians and whether COA fails to act against it. The State Secretary denies that picture, acknowledges tensions between residents, describes COA house rules and sanctions, and says criminal conduct can affect asylum procedures.
COA has the possibility to impose a measure when a resident violates a house rule.
Het COA heeft de mogelijkheid om een maatregel op te leggen wanneer een bewoner een huisregel overtreedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Beertema over de kosten van asielzoekers

PVV MPs Fritsma and Beertema asked for the total 2014 cost of asylum seekers, including IND, COA, DT&V, legal aid, subsidies and education for asylum-seeker children. The government answered with itemised figures from the Justice and Education budgets, totalling roughly 0.9 billion euro, and noted that data on children without residence rights is not available.
Specific data on children without residence rights are not available and therefore cannot be provided.
Specifieke gegevens over kinderen zonder verblijfsrecht zijn niet beschikbaar en kunnen dan ook niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de wens van een woningcorporatie om illegalen te huisvesten

An MP asked the minister whether housing corporation Rochdale should be told that rejected asylum seekers have no right to social housing, and whether priority allocation of social rental homes to admitted asylum seekers should end. The minister answered that the Housing Act only allows Dutch nationals and lawfully resident aliens to obtain housing permits, that Rochdale has said it will only house people with residence permits, and that there are no plans to change the priority rules for permit holders.
There are no plans to amend the Housing Act on this point.
Er zijn geen voornemens de Huisvestingswet hierop aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht dat illegale Marokkanen niet kunnen worden uitgezet

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked whether Morocco stopped accepting the return of illegal Moroccan nationals, why this was not communicated to parliament, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary confirmed Morocco had refused cooperation on forced returns, said Morocco has now agreed to resume cooperation, and noted a Council of State ruling limited detention of Moroccan nationals, which should become possible again once cooperation resumes.
It is not customary to actively inform your House about which countries do or do not (fully) cooperate on forced return.
Het is niet gebruikelijk uw Kamer actief te informeren over welke landen wel of niet (volledig) meewerken aan gedwongen terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Fritsma over het bericht ‘Grote onrust in verzorgingshuis Zuidoost over opvang illegalen’

PVV MPs asked why a care home in Zuidoost houses rejected asylum seekers while elderly people with care indications ZZP 1-3 are no longer admitted, and whether such people should be removed. The state secretary replied that vacant care home rooms are being repurposed in the trend toward aging at home, that he sees no reason to change the Wet langdurige zorg for ZZP 1-3, and that deportation is unrelated to his policy.
I see no connection between my policy in the field of long-term care and the action you suggest.
Ik zie geen relatie tussen mijn beleid op het terrein van de langdurige zorg en de door u gesuggereerde actie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over illegalen die maandelijks ruim 200 euro leefgeld krijgen van de gemeente Eindhoven

An MP asked how undocumented migrants with a legal departure obligation can receive over 200 euro monthly subsistence money from Eindhoven, and whether such municipalities should be curbed. The state secretary replied that a Central Council of Appeal ruling requires minimal provision for such migrants, temporarily co-funded by the national government, but that unrestricted cash support falls outside that and will not be reimbursed.
Providing financial support for free use by the foreign national goes further than providing only a basic provision.
Het bieden van financiële ondersteuning, ter vrije besteding door de vreemdeling, gaat verder dan het bieden van enkel een sobere voorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘IS ziet immigrant als wapen’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that IS sees migrants as a weapon, and possible jihadist infiltration via the Libya-Italy route, mean a security emergency at the borders, and whether the government can guarantee no terrorists will arrive. The government answered that it is alert to signals of misuse of the refugee flow, describes existing reporting structures, awareness efforts and coordination bodies, but does not guarantee that no terrorists will arrive.
The Netherlands and the EU, including the implementing organisations, are alert to signals that ISIS or other jihadist organisations are misusing the refugee flow to reach the Netherlands or Europe.
Nederland en de EU, inclusief de uitvoeringsorganisaties, zijn alert op signalen van misbruik van de vluchtelingenstroom door ISIS of andere jihadistische organisaties naar Nederland of Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat illegalen in Amsterdam een gratis OV-kaart krijgen

An MP from the PVV asked whether it is acceptable that rejected asylum seekers in Amsterdam receive free public transport cards, and what the government will do to stop it and return them to their countries of origin. The State Secretary answered that Amsterdam offers only basic night shelter with two single transit tickets valid one hour, that the national government cannot enforce returns against those who refuse to cooperate, and that public order measures are for mayors.
It is not for me to intervene in public order measures taken by mayors.
Het is niet aan mij om in openbare orde maatregelen die door burgemeesters worden genomen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de problemen met het energielabel

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Housing about many problems with energy label issuance, whether the government would oppose the EU directive requiring them, whether the estimated energy use of homes was deliberately overstated amounting to misleading, and how homeowners could be freed from this burden. The Minister answered by referring to a separate letter on the implementation of the housing energy label, without addressing the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Fritsma (PVV), question number 2015Z01561, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to implementation of the energy label for homes'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV), vraagnummer 2015Z01561 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op uitvoering energielabel voor woningen»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat huurwoningen schaarser zijn door de komst van vluchtelingen

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister for Housing about reports that rental homes are scarcer due to refugees, whether priority allocation for asylum seekers is unfair, how many applicants are disadvantaged, and whether asylum inflow will be stopped. The government answers that refugees with residence permits get priority to support integration and reduce COA centre congestion, that a direct effect on waiting times cannot be given, and that it will not stop asylum intake because international obligations and individual assessment apply.
No, asylum seekers who have been granted a permit are housed with priority in order to promote outflow from COA centres and integration.
Nee, asielzoekers die een vergunning hebben gekregen worden met voorrang gehuisvest teneinde uitstroom vanuit de COA centra en de integratie te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de afspraak om in het dorp Oranje honderden asielzoekers te plaatsen in recreatiewoningen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether an agreement to house hundreds of asylum seekers at a holiday park in Oranje, owned by a VVD councillor, conflicts with the zoning plan and lacked council approval, and whether there were close personal ties with the owner. The State Secretary answers that the COA may use the park, that the municipality was informed and discussed numbers with the council, and denies personal or financial contacts beyond the stated ones, declining to give details of commercial transactions.
Given the commercial interests of the entrepreneur involved and the COA, I do not provide specific information about business transactions that the COA conducts with individual entrepreneurs.
Gelet op het bedrijfsbelang van de betrokken ondernemer en het COA geef ik geen specifieke informatie over zakelijke transacties die het COA met individuele ondernemers aangaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Of slapen er terroristen in Zwolle’

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of possible jihadist terrorists among asylum seekers, whether border closures and subsidy cuts were warranted. The minister answered that there are no concrete indications of planned abuse, that reintroducing internal border controls would be disproportionate, and that he will not close borders or cut subsidies, while pointing to a letter on measures and promising continued vigilance.
For operational reasons, I cannot make specific statements about any possible indications in this regard.
Vanwege operationele belangen kan ik geen specifieke mededelingen doen over eventuele aanwijzingen hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Fritsma over het bericht dat scholen de toestroom van asielkinderen nauwelijks aan kunnen

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Education how schools will cope with asylum-seeker children, including the extra costs for Den Helder and nationwide up to 2017, and whether the open-borders policy is disrupting education. The state secretary answered with cost estimates (about 630,000 euro for Den Helder; 22, 38 and 41 million euro nationally across three school years), said the schools are capable of providing education, and rejected closing the borders as a means to improve quality.
I do not share this view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat meer uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers een pardonvergunning krijgen

An MP asked why the government keeps granting residence permits to rejected asylum seekers, why this rewards ignoring departure orders, and whether it made deals with other parties to legalise such families. The Secretary of State said the long-term-resident children scheme is being implemented, that municipalities must house permit holders, and that return remains the starting point of policy, with the scheme not meant to change that.
The measures under the long-term resident children scheme are by no means intended as a change to this starting point.
De maatregelen in het kader van de regeling langdurig verblijvende kinderen zijn geenszins bedoeld als een wijziging van dit uitgangspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de benoeming van de Rijksvertegenwoordiger voor de BES- eilanden

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the minister why the Sint Eustatius island council distrusts the appointed Rijksvertegenwoordiger Isabella and whether his appointment is credible, and demanded assurances he stay off the islands. The minister regretted the council's doubts, stated the appointment followed a transparent procedure with an independent commission and consultation of island executives, and refused to restrict Isabella's future work.
Mr Isabella was appointed through a transparent procedure and on the nomination of an independent committee.
De heer Isabella is benoemd door middel van een transparante procedure en op voordracht van een onafhankelijke commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Klever over het bericht dat illegalen in Amsterdam de eigen bijdrage voor medicijnen terugkrijgen

Two PVV MPs asked why undocumented migrants in Amsterdam receive free medicines, whether the mayor breaches agreements, and how the government will ensure departure. The minister answered that undocumented migrants are responsible for care costs, that reimbursement via Zorginstituut is possible with a €5 correction, that the mayor's payment of that amount is a municipal matter, and that she was not consulted in advance.
To what extent municipalities bear these costs themselves and how they have organised this is not for me to assess.
In hoeverre gemeenten deze kosten voor eigen rekening nemen en hoe zij dit georganiseerd hebben, staat niet aan mij ter beoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over een tbs’er die 100 euro per dag vangt door getalm van de IND

PVV MPs Fritsma and Helder asked why the IND delayed declaring a Turkish tbs detainee undesirable, causing a daily penalty payment, and whether Turkey takes back such nationals. The state secretary replied that the objection was declared unfounded on 22 July 2014, removal preparations have started, the deadline overrun was due to case complexity, and the IND has issued work instructions to prevent recurrence.
Due to the complexity of this case, the IND regrettably exceeded the decision deadline for the objection, which led to a penalty payment as stated in the article.
Vanwege de complexiteit van deze zaak is tot mijn spijt de beslistermijn in bezwaar door de IND overschreden, wat heeft geleid tot een dwangsom zoals in het artikel staat vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Fritsma over de verwachte toename van medische kosten voor asielzoekers

PVV MPs Klever and Fritsma asked about rising costs of medical care for asylum seekers, including screening, costs per asylum seeker, the budget source, contraception coverage, co-payments and whether a deductible or medically-necessary-only limit should apply. The answers state that asylum seekers are screened for tuberculosis at arrival, that 2013 curative medical costs were 72.6 million euro (about 4,870 per person), that the extra costs are funded from the ODA budget, and that the government declines to introduce a deductible or limit care to medically necessary treatment.
Introducing a deductible would mean that the Dutch government reimburses this to itself for asylum seekers.
Het instellen van een eigen risico zou betekenen dat de Nederlandse overheid dit voor asielzoekers aan zichzelf vergoedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over vluchtelingen met een vals paspoort die vrijuit gaan

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why asylum seekers carrying forged passports escape prosecution, whether this conflicts with the Refugee Convention, and what measures would be taken. State Secretary Teeven answered that prosecution is only possible after a final rejection of the asylum claim, that the Supreme Court ruling is binding, and that no new measures or treaty withdrawal are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de benoeming van een omstreden PvdA-wethouder als Rijksvertegenwoordiger BES

MPs Fritsma and Wilders questioned the appointment of a controversial PvdA alderman as Rijksvertegenwoordiger BES, asking about selection criteria and whether the nomination would be withdrawn. The minister replied that a selection committee made a unanimous nomination which he adopted, that island councils were consulted, and that he considers the appointee fully qualified.
This committee made a unanimous nomination to me. I adopted this nomination.
Deze commissie heeft aan mij een unanieme voordracht gedaan. Deze voordracht heb ik overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat opvang van illegalen wordt verlengd

An MP asks why Amsterdam is extending shelter for rejected asylum seekers at the Vluchthaven and what the government will do to send them back. The Secretary of State says the initiative was closed on 1 June and replaced by six months of follow-up shelter for two defined groups, that two people have returned, and that return depends on the willingness of the person concerned.
The initiative was discontinued on 1 June.
Het initiatief is op 1 juni jl. stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de kosten van de vreemdelingenadvocatuur en subsidies voor aan vreemdelingenzaken gerelateerde organisaties

The MP asks about the cost of the immigration lawyers' legal aid (about 19.6 million euro paid in 2013 across 15,503 persons), how that compares with other countries like Denmark, and which migration-related organisations received subsidies in 2013 and how spending is accounted for. The Secretary of State gives figures, states that cross-country comparison data for subsidies are not available, reports subsidy recipients with accountability via the Auditdienst Rijk and the Court of Audit, and says measures against procedure-stacking are in place.
I do not have this data for other EU member states.
Ik beschik niet over deze gegevens van andere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Fritsma over het bericht met spoed gezocht: 100.000 seniorenwoningen

MPs Agema and Fritsma asked about reports of a shortage of 100,000 senior housing units and whether the government will postpone the ZZP 1-3 extramuralisation measure until enough suitable housing exists. The State Secretary replied that extramuralisation will keep 30,000-35,000 people at home longer, that existing stock is largely sufficient, and pointed to a regional transition agenda for living independently longer.
In our view, housing people who face an increase in limitations is therefore well feasible.
Naar onze mening is daarmee het huisvesten van mensen, die met een toename van beperkingen te maken krijgt, goed uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de asielaanvraag van Somalische piraten

An MP asked whether Somali pirates serving prison sentences in the Netherlands had applied for asylum, and demanded guarantees of refusal and deportation, an end to the Refugee Convention's application, and that no more pirates be prosecuted here. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual asylum applications, said they would be refused under Article 1F or the 24-month rule, reported deportations under agreements with Somalia, and reaffirmed the Convention framework and regional prosecution policy.
The Dutch government does not make statements about asylum applications submitted by individual foreigners.
De Nederlandse regering doet geen mededelingen over asielaanvragen die door individuele vreemdelingen zijn ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het ten onrechte vrij laten van Somalische piraten

Two PVV MPs asked why Somali pirates were released early despite earlier assurances that this only happens on proven departure, and whether they will serve their full sentences and be deported afterwards. The State Secretary replied that the law wrongly allows early release for foreigners who file asylum claims, that he will propose amending the Criminal Code, that the court found lawful residence so release applies, and that deportation of pirates is being pursued through agreements with Somalia.
I will therefore submit a proposal as soon as possible to amend the Criminal Code on this point so that only foreigners with a stable form of lawful residence can be eligible for conditional release.

Ik zal daarom zo spoedig mogelijk een voorstel indienen om het Wetboek van Strafrecht op dit punt te wijzigen zodat alleen vreemdelingen met een bestendige vorm van rechtmatig verblijf voor voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling in aanmerking kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de komst van het Eritrees voetbalelftal naar Nederland

An MP from the PVV asks whether former Eritrean national football team members, resettled from Romania to the Netherlands, should be rejected under the Dublin rules and why the Netherlands helped bring them, and asks what is being done about rising Eritrean asylum inflow. The State Secretary answers that the group was referred by UNHCR for resettlement, that Dublin rejection is not warranted because they came from the Emergency Transit Centre, and that measures on the inflow will be sent separately.
I will inform the House separately about the measures I have taken and am taking regarding the increased inflow.
Ik bericht uw Kamer separaat over de maatregelen die ik heb getroffen en tref met betrekking tot de verhoogde instroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het mogelijk verdwijnen van taaleisen bij gezinshereniging

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether EU rules undermine strict migrant admission, whether Dutch civic integration requirements abroad will remain, and whether the Netherlands can opt out of EU immigration and asylum rules. The State Secretary replied that a CJEU ruling on language requirements is expected within about eighteen months and the current policy stays unchanged until then, and that a Dutch opt-out is not realistic because it would require a treaty change.
Depending on the Court's ruling, the government will consider its position at that time.
Afhankelijk van de uitspraak van het Hof zal de regering zich op dat moment beraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over mogelijke contacten van Kamerleden met de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over individuele gevallen binnen het vreemdelingenbeleid

Fritsma (PVV) asked whether the State Secretary and officials hold informal contacts with individual MPs about individual immigration cases outside formal debates, how often this happens, and whether it is open to scrutiny. Teeven answered that such factual briefings have existed for years, are available to all MPs equally to verify facts, cannot themselves lead to intervention, and that no overview of frequency or outcomes is kept.
There is no overview on the basis of which it can be stated how often these contacts take place.
Er bestaat geen overzicht op basis waarvan kan worden aangegeven hoe vaak genoemde contacten plaats hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de forse stijging van Syrische asielzoekers in Nederland

An MP from the PVV asks the Secretary of State for Security and Justice why Syrian asylum arrivals rose sharply in early 2014, whether his earlier pledge to admit nearly all Syrians played a role, why regional protection is not used more, and what will ensure rejected Syrians leave. The Secretary answers that the rise reflects the situation in Syria, refers to earlier letters on regional reception, and states that most Syrians receive asylum with Dublin transfers as the main exception and no deportations to Syria.
It is not likely that Syrian asylum seekers flee their country because of Dutch asylum policy or my statements about it.
Het is niet waarschijnlijk dat Syrische asielzoekers hun land ontvluchten vanwege het Nederlandse asielbeleid of mijn uitspraken daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Klever over medische zorg voor vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked how many asylum seekers use medical care during their procedure, what it costs, whether they pay co-payments, and how many rejected applicants receive care. The government answered that care is provided under the Rva and RZA, costs were 72 million euro in 2012, asylum seekers pay no co-payments or deductibles, and it cannot track several requested figures due to medical confidentiality and lack of registration.
Which medical care an asylum seeker has received falls under medical professional confidentiality and is therefore not visible to the non-medical staff of the immigration chain.
Welke medische zorg een asielzoeker heeft ontvangen valt onder het medische beroepsgeheim en is daarom niet inzichtelijk voor het niet-medische personeel van de vreemdelingenketen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Amsterdam meer geld, opvang en hulp wil bieden aan  illegalen

The MP Fritsma (PVV) asked whether Amsterdam's plan to offer shelter, a 3,000 euro yearly housing allowance and other help to undocumented migrants breaches the 2007 bestuursakkoord and undermines return policy. The State Secretary replied that the plan was not discussed with the mayor beforehand, that the 2007 agreement still stands, that the shelter is short-term crisis accommodation linked to a return-oriented approach, and that he will evaluate the six-month pilot before judging its value.
After this six-month period the balance will be drawn up and it will be assessed whether this initiative by the municipality of Amsterdam has added value.
Na deze periode van zes maanden zal de balans worden opgemaakt en worden bezien of dit initiatief van de gemeente Amsterdam een meerwaarde heeft gehad.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de stand van zaken rond de noodzakelijke uitzetting van een Iraakse eermoordenaar (ingezonden 5 december 2012).

An MP asks the State Secretary for the status of the removal of an Iraqi man convicted of honour killing, why he runs a law office registered with the Chamber of Commerce, and why parliament was not kept informed despite a prior commitment. The State Secretary answers that the man has returned to Iraq, that an appeal procedure is still pending, and that parliament will be informed of new developments.
Currently an appeal procedure is still open in this case.
Momenteel staat er nog een beroepsprocedure open in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat België meer EU-burgers uitzet

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about Belgium expelling more EU citizens, requesting 2013 figures on residence revocations and departures and the reasons and nationalities involved, and asked whether the Netherlands would quadruple expulsions. The State Secretary reported 650 terminations of lawful residence in 2013 (360 for public order, 60 for unreasonable reliance on welfare, others for nuisance or failing conditions), explained differences in Belgian data practices, and said the existing tightened policy would be continued and a welfare pilot extended.
In 2013 the lawful residence of 650 EU citizens was terminated.
In 2013 is van 650 EU-burgers het rechtmatig verblijf beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Graaf over Oost-Europese overlast op vakantieparken

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about nuisance and overcrowding caused by Eastern European migrant workers housed on holiday parks, including whether a deterrence policy should replace the national housing declaration and whether work permits should be reintroduced. The government answered that municipalities enforce nuisance rules, that regional agreements have added 31,000 housing places, that free movement of workers cannot be reversed under the accession treaties, and that permanent occupation of recreational homes is a municipal matter.
Statistics Netherlands examined, in the municipalities of the 9 regions of the Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten programme, how many migrant workers are housed in which municipality.
Het CBS heeft onderzocht in de gemeenten uit de 9 regio’s van het programma Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten hoeveel arbeidsmigranten er in welke gemeente gehuisvest zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over Arabische informatiebrieven van woningcorporaties

PVV MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked whether housing corporations send information letters in Arabic, whether others do so, and what measures will stop it. The minister said one letter about waste collection in Leeuwarden was sent in Dutch, English and Arabic on behalf of the municipality, that no national overview exists, and that communication should be in Dutch with exceptions; he committed to no new measures.
No national overview exists of the information housing corporations provide, or in which language they do so.
Er bestaat geen landelijk overzicht van de informatie die door corporaties wordt verstrekt noch in welke taal zij dit doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over het extreme graaien door corporatiebobo's

Opposition MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked the minister whether he knew of reports that housing corporation directors would receive a 42% pay increase, requested a salary overview, and asked what measures would bring the salaries down. The minister confirmed the reports, referred to an earlier overview of 2012 pay, said the 2014 maximum-pay regulation allows higher maxima than before while at least 40% of current directors must be brought down over time, and stated that all corporations are bound by the regulation and will be enforced against.
All housing corporations are bound by the 2014 Regulation on maximum remuneration of senior officials of recognised housing associations, and enforcement will take place accordingly.
Alle woningcorporaties zijn aan de Regeling bezoldigingsmaxima topfunctionarissen toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting 2014 gebonden en daarop zal gehandhaafd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht ‘Waarom zitten Vestia-bestuurders niet zes jaar vast’

An MP asks the minister how a Vestia supervisory board chair who was involved in derivatives losses at another company can now oversee similar problems, and whether housing corporation supervisors will be required to be expert enough to defend tenants' interests. The minister replies that corporations appoint their own supervisors without accountability to him, that the chair's appointment followed the departure of the responsible supervisors, and that the revised Housing Act sets quality and independence requirements for supervisors, including disqualification for prior financial-economic offences.
Housing corporations are themselves responsible for appointing supervisory board members and are not required to account to me for this.
Woningcorporaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van commissarissen en zijn daarbij niet gehouden zich hierover aan mij te verantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de opvang van 600 asielzoekers in vakantiepark Duinrell

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why 600 asylum seekers were being housed in holiday park Duinrell, questioning the choice given Syrian refugees and the regional-aid policy. The State Secretary confirmed temporary housing there until end March 2014 due to rising asylum inflow, said the COA is seeking other sites, and defended regional refugee support and the efficiency of the asylum procedure.
It is correct that asylum seekers are being housed in cottages in Duinrell, where the first asylum seekers arrived from 15 November.
Het is correct dat er asielzoekers worden opgevangen in huisjes in Duinrell waar vanaf 15 november de eerste asielzoekers zijn ingestroomd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het onophoudelijke graaien van woningbobo's

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether he knew of reports that housing corporation directors' salaries were rising again, requested a 2012 salary overview, demanded that excess pay be repaid and apologies offered, and asked what measures he would take. The minister confirmed awareness, said no Wopt report for 2012 exists and offered confidential 2012 salary data later, stated that excess pay cannot yet be formally established under the WNT and that he finds high pay inappropriate, and said he will intervene for 2013 overruns where applicable.
For remuneration in 2013 I can and will intervene in case of breaches of the applicable norms, insofar as they do not fall under the transitional law of the WNT.
Voor de bezoldiging over 2013 kan en zal ik bij overschrijdingen van de geldende normen en voor zover niet vallend onder het overgangsrecht in de WNT ingrijpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat de subsidieboekhouding van de Nederlandse Antillen aan alle kanten rammelt

Fritsma (PVV) asks why subsidies to the former Netherlands Antilles continued despite warnings about accounting failures, and whether funds should be recovered and ties severed. Minister Plasterk replies that the final cooperation funds were transferred in 2012 to foundations running programmes until 2013-2015, that Saba, Sint Eustatius and Bonaire now form part of the Netherlands, and that independence decisions lie with Aruba, Curacao and Sint Maarten.
I refer you gladly to my letter to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, dated 27 August 2013.
Ik verwijs u graag naar mijn brief aan de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer, gedateerd 27 augustus 2013.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een 10-jarig meisje is aangerand door een illegaal in Nederland verblijvende Somalische bewoner v

PVV MPs asked the state secretary how a suspect with a record of sexual aggression, residing illegally in the Netherlands, could move freely and whether such persons should be detained, and asked for a guarantee he would not be released and how many criminal illegal residents exist. The state secretary replied that the suspect was arrested and detained pending trial, that his removal was blocked by lack of treatment options in his country of origin, that the court decides on the measure, and that the government is improving data on criminal illegal residents.
It is for the judge to decide which measure is appropriate, taking into account all circumstances of the case and the perpetrator's personal situation.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen welke maatregel passend is, alle omstandigheden van het geval en de persoon van de dader meewegend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de voortdurende wantoestanden rondom de “vluchtflat” in Amsterdam

An MP asks the State Secretary about recurring incidents (assault, fights, drug use) at the 'vluchtflat' in Amsterdam housing rejected asylum seekers, whether illegal residents commit crimes repeatedly, who facilitates the building, and whether detention and eviction should follow. The State Secretary denies evidence of repeated crimes, says the building is provided temporarily by a housing corporation with conduct rules, that detention is not a criminal-law tool, and that the mayor is responsible for public order and action against the building, while he continues consulting the municipality.
No. Immigration detention is an instrument the government can use as a last resort to actually realise the departure of a foreign national.
Nee. Vreemdelingenbewaring is een instrument dat de overheid als uiterst middel kan inzetten om daadwerkelijk vertrek van een vreemdeling te realiseren.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma over het bericht dat Irak nog altijd niet meewerkt aan het terugnemen van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

Fritsma (PVV) asked whether the state secretary had pressed Iraq over its refusal to take back rejected asylum seekers, whether a EUR 5.5 million aid commitment had been paid out, and what aid Iraq receives and whether it would be suspended. Teeven answered that he raised Iraq's obligations, that the money remains unpaid because no returns have occurred, and that aid is not being suspended since it supports minorities, demining and business diplomacy.
It was agreed to set up a working group with Iraq to develop concrete solutions to the return problem.
Afgesproken is samen met Irak een werkgroep in te stellen om concrete oplossingen voor de terugkeerproblematiek uit te werken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat de burgemeester van Amsterdam afspraken heeft gemaakt met de illegale vreemdelingen in de gekraakte kantorenflat in Amsterdam

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that the Amsterdam mayor made arrangements with rejected asylum seekers occupying a squatted office block, and whether detention and departure would be pursued. The state secretary answered that the mayor did not make agreements himself; the parties involved drew up house rules, the municipality is not a party, and detention is not appropriate for most residents who do not cooperate with return.
Regarding placing the persons concerned in immigration detention, I note that this is only relevant for the purpose of removal, when there is concrete prospect of removal.
Over het in vreemdelingendetentie plaatsen van de betrokken vreemdelingen merk ik op dat dit alleen aan de orde is ter fine van uitzetting, wanneer er concreet zicht is op uitzetting.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over uitspraken van de directeur van de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) inzake toepassing van de discretionaire bevoegdheid in de zaak van een dorststaker uit Kameroen

An MP asked the state secretary whether the IND director's statement that discretionary power was applied in a Cameroonian hunger striker's case, based on newly known facts, could be explained in a confidential letter to parliament. The state secretary declined, citing the principle of not discussing individual cases, while offering general information on policy implementation.
As I have already indicated in my earlier reply to your House, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.

Antwoord 2 Zoals ik reeds eerder heb aangegeven in mijn beantwoording aan uw Kamer ( 2013Z08916 ) vind ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat het aantal toegewezen asielaanvragen in Nederland veel hoger ligt dan in de rest van de EU

An MP asked why the Netherlands grants asylum at a higher rate than other EU states, whether this stems from differing rules, and whether the state should cap admissions at 1,000 people. The state secretary attributed the gap to differences in countries of origin, implementation and procedure design, and rejected a cap because Dutch obligations under international norms require protection for those entitled to it.
The difference in grant rates between member states cannot be unambiguously explained.
Het verschil in de inwilligingspercentages tussen de lidstaten kan niet eenduidig worden verklaard.
Antwoord vragen Helder en Fritsma over het bericht ‘België: bijna 20 criminele illegalen per dag’

MPs Helder and Fritsma asked whether the government tracks how many illegal migrants are arrested for crimes, their nationality, and how many lead to conviction and expulsion, following a report on Belgium. The state secretary answered that this data is not yet available, that linking criminal justice and migration databases is underway with expected data in 2014, and that in 2012 about 690 convicted or suspected foreigners were removed or left from the Dutch return caseload.
The requested information is not yet available.
De gevraagde informatie is nog niet voorhanden.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Van Vliet over mogelijk misbruik van de kennismigrantenregeling

Two PVV MPs asked whether foreigners often switch an existing residence permit to 'knowledge migrant' status and whether the 30% tax ruling for expats should be denied to those already living in the Netherlands. The government answered that 1,130 (2010) and 1,260 (2011) such changes occurred, and that people already resident on another basis are excluded from the 30% ruling unless they are students, interns or PhD candidates.
Employees who already reside in the Netherlands on another residence basis are not eligible for the 30% ruling, unless they reside in the Netherlands as a student, intern or PhD candidate.

Werknemers die reeds op grond van een ander verblijfsdoel in Nederland verblijven, komen niet in aanmerking voor de 30%-regeling, tenzij zij in Nederland als student, stagiair of promovendus verblijven.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma het bericht dat een dorststaker een verblijfsvergunning heeft gekregen

Fritsma (PVV) asks the state secretary whether a Cameroonian asylum seeker on hunger/thirst strike was granted a residence permit, on what basis, and whether this undermines admission criteria and signals to others that protest works. Teeven declines to discuss the individual case, states that a hunger or thirst strike is not a ground for residence, but that individual dossier indications must still be considered.
As the House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, vind ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Sint Maarten haar deel van de rekening voor de kustwacht weigert te betalen

An MP from the PVV asked the Interior Minister whether Sint Maarten refuses to pay most of its share of the coast guard costs, what the government will do about it, and whether Sint Maarten can be separated from the Kingdom. The minister answered that Sint Maarten has not refused to pay, the payment was late but has now been made, its 2012 share is about 680,000 euros, and any separation is for Sint Maarten to decide.
There is no question of Sint Maarten refusing to pay.
Er is geen sprake van een weigering tot betaling door Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet, Fritsma en Madlener over het bericht “Inwoners EU hebben recht op uitkering”

PVV MPs asked why EU residents may receive social assistance while doubts exist about their residence right and an income requirement applies, and whether all wrongly paid benefits to foreigners will be recovered. The minister answered that residence rights under the EU free movement directive depend on an individual assessment by the IND, that municipalities handle benefit decisions, and that municipalities are responsible for recovery policy.
The implementation of the WWB has been decentralised to the municipalities.
De uitvoering van de WWB is gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het bericht “Misdaad levert een huurwoning op”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that criminals receive priority for rental housing while ordinary citizens wait years, and whether such priority can be ruled out. The minister replied that the Amsterdam 'Pak je kans' project offers temporary housing only to former offenders who work or study, on a strict protocol, in former municipal service dwellings not part of the regular stock, and that there is no priority for regular rental housing.
There is no question of priority for the named group in obtaining a regular rental home.
Er is voor de genoemde groep geen sprake van voorrang voor het krijgen van een regulier huurhuis.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Agema over het rapport ‘Verloren tijd’

PVV MPs Fritsma and Agema asked whether the government agrees that asylum seekers should not receive day-care, education or recreation while cuts hit care for the elderly and disabled, and asked for the ACVZ report 'Verloren tijd' to be destroyed. State Secretary Teeven confirmed receipt of the advice and said a full government response will follow within three months, without taking a position on the substance yet.
As is customary, a government response to the report of the Advisory Committee on Migration Affairs (ACVZ) will be sent to the House of Representatives within three months of publication.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk wordt binnen drie maanden na verschijning van een rapport van de Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken (ACVZ) een kabinetsreactie aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Fritsma over het bericht “Veel Zuid-Europeanen naar Nederland”.

MPs Madlener and Fritsma asked the government about a news report on rising numbers of Southern European nationals in the Netherlands and what would be done to control this immigration. The government responded that EU free movement rights apply, that the numbers differ from CBS figures, and that it will keep enforcing income requirements and tackling exploitation while continuing existing initiatives.

As long as citizens from another member state meet the conditions for free movement of persons and thus do not place an unreasonable burden on social provisions in our country, we see no reason to oppose their arrival in the Netherlands and participation in Dutch society.

Zolang burgers uit een andere lidstaat voldoen aan de voorwaarden die gesteld worden aan het vrij verkeer van personen en daarmee dus geen onredelijke belasting vormen voor sociale voorzieningen in ons land, zien wij geen reden om afwijzend te staan tegen hun komst naar Nederland en deelname aan de Nederlandse samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het bericht dat «consumenten 1,3 procent teveel hypotheekrente betalen»

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked whether banks' mortgage margins are excessive, whether the Brussels price-leadership ban causes lack of competition, and what measures the government will take to lower mortgage rates. The minister says CPB and DNB find no systematic higher funding costs, that the ABN AMRO price-leadership ban remains and will be discussed with the Commission, and points to a forthcoming NMa margin study and new consumer-protection rules from 1 January 2013.
