The Central Planning Bureau (CPB) states that there are no indications that financing costs in the Netherlands are systematically higher than in the surrounding countries.
Het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) stelt dat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de financieringskosten in Nederland systematisch hoger zijn dan in de ons omringende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de komst van de winnaar van de verkiezingen op Curaçao die Nederlanders bodybags in het vooruitzicht heeft gesteld

An MP asked whether Curaçao election winner Wiels, who reportedly said body bags were ready for Dutch nationals, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The minister replied that the government values Wiels's constructive relations with the Netherlands and that the Kingdom has no power to bar Dutch nationals from entry.
In the Kingdom there is no possibility of 'denying access' to persons with Dutch nationality.
In het Koninkrijk bestaat geen mogelijkheid tot «ontzeggen van toegang» aan personen met een Nederlandse nationaliteit.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Van Vliet over het bericht dat België Europese bijstandsfraudeurs uitzet

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of Belgium expelling EU welfare fraudsters, how many EU nationals were removed from the Netherlands for benefit fraud or failing the income requirement, and how EU nationals can receive benefits despite the income requirement. The minister answered that 70 residence rights were ended in 2012 (10 forced returns), that benefit receipt does not automatically end residence, and that experiments with the municipalities of Vaals and Rotterdam aim to speed up information exchange, with results promised before summer.
The minister of Social Affairs and Employment promised in the General Consultation on Labour Migration of 17 January 2013 to inform the House before the summer about the results of the experiments.

De minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid heeft in het Algemeen Overleg Arbeidsmigratie van 17 januari 2013 toegezegd om de Kamer voor de zomer te informeren over de resultaten van de experimenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Marokko niet meewerkt aan de terugname van illegalen vanuit Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Morocco is refusing cooperation on returning Moroccan illegal migrants, including the scale of failed returns, whether Moroccan authorities still refuse charter flights, and what measures will be taken. The State Secretary acknowledged room for improvement in Moroccan cooperation, reported that many detention orders were lifted because identification took too long, said charter flights are not needed since scheduled flights work, and noted the EU holds the mandate for a readmission agreement and that the government will pursue the file bilaterally and within a broader country strategy.
As promised, I will inform the House further about the strategic country approach.
Zoals toegezegd zal ik uw Kamer over de strategische landenbenadering nader informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het bericht dat Eindhoven een miljoen verspilt bij verplaatsing woonwagenkamp

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked the Minister of Interior whether Eindhoven's municipal government could account for 2.2 million euros in relocation compensation paid for a caravan camp, and what would be done to limit the damage and prevent such excesses. The Minister replied that the money was paid on suspected forgery, that the municipality has filed a criminal complaint and commissioned an internal review, and that accountability rests locally, so no generic national measures are planned.
Accountability for this matter must take place at the local level, and I therefore see no reason for generic measures on my part.
De verantwoording over deze kwestie dient op lokaal niveau plaats te vinden, en ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor generieke maatregelen van mijn kant.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en van Klaveren over de verblijfsgrond van in Nederland verblijvende verdachten / criminelen die in verband met recente geruchtmakende zaken in het nieuws waren

Two PVV MPs asked why the government refused to answer questions about individual criminal foreigners tied to recent news cases, when earlier individual cases had been answered, and whether it is inconsistent to withhold information on criminals while disclosing information on people to be deported. State Secretary Teeven replied that he declines to discuss individual cases to protect the privacy of those involved, since the data are special personal data under the Dutch data protection law, and that privacy will generally weigh heavily.
I refrained from going into the individual cases because, for the protection of the privacy of those involved, I do not consider it desirable to go further into them.
Ik heb afgezien om in te gaan op de individuele zaken omdat ik het uit oogpunt van bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen niet gewenst acht hierop verder in te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over de uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers die tot voor kort in het tentenkamp in Amsterdam Osdorp verbleven

An MP from the PVV asked why rejected asylum seekers removed from a Amsterdam Osdorp tent camp were released rather than detained, and whether the government would act against the left-wing groups supporting them. The state secretary answered that detention requires individual grounds and prospect of removal, that eight were detained, and that organisations acting humanely within the law give no cause for action.
For the other foreigners there was insufficient basis, for example because there is no or insufficient prospect of removal, to justify a detention measure.
Bij de overige vreemdelingen was er onvoldoende grondslag, bijvoorbeeld omdat er geen of onvoldoende zicht is op uitzetting, om een maatregel van bewaring te rechtvaardigen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Agema over het bericht dat de gemeente Smallingerland opvang voor uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers wil betalen met geld dat bedoeld is voor mensen met een beperking

MPs Fritsma and Agema asked whether the government will stop the municipality of Smallingerland from providing shelter to rejected asylum seekers using funds meant for people with disabilities, and how it will ensure return policy is not undermined. The state secretary said the municipality's plans were not yet clear, that municipalities have discretion over their own funds, and that the government will keep pursuing active return policy, without committing to any new concrete step against the municipality.
It is not yet clear whether and how the municipality will actually provide (emergency) shelter to these people and how this will be financed.
Het is nog niet duidelijk of en hoe de gemeente daadwerkelijk (nood)opvang gaat bieden aan deze mensen en op welke wijze een en ander gefinancierd gaat worden.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma over de toelating tot Nederland van Somalische terreurverdachten

Fritsma (PVV) asked how Somali terrorism suspects living in the Netherlands, now also suspected of credit card fraud, obtained residence permits, whether they have criminal records, and why permits were not revoked despite AIVD concerns. State Secretary Teeven answered generally: he is restrictive about individual cases, explains the IND's Article 1F and national security checks, the 'glijdende schaal' for criminal convictions, and AIVD advisory reports, without giving case-specific details.
As your House is aware, I adopt the principle of being restrictive in providing information about individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, hanteer ik het uitgangspunt om terughoudend om te gaan met het verstrekken van informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Fritsma over het overbrengen van piraten naar Nederland

PVV MPs asked whether the foreign minister is involved in deciding to transfer captured Somali pirates to the Netherlands for prosecution, why transfer to the region or flag state was not chosen, whether pirates could be tried under Dutch law in the region and serve sentences there, and whether they could obtain asylum or stay in the Netherlands. The minister answered that prosecution is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service coordinated with the foreign and defence ministers, that a clear Dutch interest (attempted murder of Dutch marines) justified prosecution here, that trial under Dutch law in the region is not possible and sentence execution in Somalia is currently not possible though capacity-building is supported, and that asylum is expected to be refused under Article 1F and sentences of 24 months or more.
Instituting criminal prosecution in the Dutch criminal justice system is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het instellen van strafrechtelijke vervolging is in het Nederlandse strafrechtelijke stelsel voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over de verblijfsgrond van in Nederland verblijvende verdachten / criminelen die in verband met recente geruchtmakende zaken in het nieuws waren

MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked how various suspects and convicted criminals obtained residence rights in the Netherlands, and what measures would remove them after serving their sentences, and whether residence permits could require a criminal-record statement from origin countries. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, described the sliding-scale test for ending lawful residence after conviction and his plan to tighten it, and said he would inform parliament this year about using antecedent declarations.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Fritsma over het bericht dat de EU dreigt met herinvoering van de visumplicht voor de Westelijke Balkan

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the EU threatens to reinstate visa requirements for Western Balkan countries, asking about asylum figures, whether Roma asylum flows are undesirable, suspending Schengen expansion, and trends in Roma migration. The government answered that 2012 asylum data per country are unavailable due to the IND's system migration, that abuse of asylum is undesirable but protection must remain available, that Romania and Bulgaria's Schengen accession is not currently on the agenda, and that the registration system cannot generate figures by ethnicity.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en De Graaf over het bericht dat 60.000 euro aan subsidiegeld voor de Antilliaanse belangenvereniging MAAPP is “verdwenen”

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether 60,000 euro of subsidy to the Antillean association MAAPP was lost to fraud, how ministry oversight failed, and whether the money and future subsidies are secured. The minister answered that the former chair withdrew funds unseen by the board, that the ministry will recover the undisbursed amount via a bailiff and the police are investigating, but that more oversight could not have prevented it and no new subsidies are planned.
The Ministry will recover the improperly spent funds from MAAPP.
Het Ministerie zal de niet juist bestede middelen terugvorderen bij MAAPP.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat een groot netwerk achter vele schijnhuwelijken is blootgelegd

An MP asked about reports of a large network arranging sham marriages and whether the IND would tighten fraud checks and revoke residence rights. The minister answered that 60 residence permits were granted in cases involving the suspect, 22 are under review for revocation, and fraud controls were increased, but declined to bar the affected partners from future sponsorship.
In 22 of these the IND is currently examining whether there are sufficient grounds to revoke the residence permit.
In 22 daarvan beziet de IND op dit moment of er voldoende gronden zijn om het verblijfsrecht in te trekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland relatief veel asielaanvragen inwilligt

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands grants asylum at a relatively high rate compared with other European countries, and whether a cap of 1000 admissions or changes to the Refugee Convention should follow. The minister answered that the data needed for a comparison are not available, pointed to the Dutch fast-track procedure and the EU harmonisation agenda, and rejected a quota or withdrawal from the Convention.
The underlying data behind the admission rates are not available for the Netherlands, and for that reason alone it is not possible to carry out this analysis.
Deze onderliggende gegevens bij de inwillingingspercentages zijn voor Nederland niet beschikbaar en reeds daarom is het niet mogelijk deze analyse te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het niet terug kunnen sturen van Somaliërs

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked whether a NOS report showing Mogadishu calmer, with hundreds of Somalis returning weekly, contradicts the February 2012 country report and a Council of State ruling, and whether the government will speed up returns and leave the EU. Minister Spies replied that a media report alone does not justify changing policy, that the next Somalia country report (expected November 2012) will be reviewed and the minister asked to address the media reports, that asylum policy stays unchanged, and that the government does not accept that EU membership must end.
A media report alone is not grounds for the government to change policy.
Een verslag in de media alleen is voor de regering geen aanleiding om tot aanpassing van het beleid over te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het niet terug kunnen sturen van Somaliërs

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why a Council of State ruling prevents deporting Somalis and how to avoid a pull effect on migration. The minister answers that the ruling concerns travel through Mogadishu, that the government will comply, expects few additional arrivals, and keeps voluntary return as the policy starting point while pursuing forced return options.
The government will of course comply with the Division's ruling.
De regering zal zich uiteraard conformeren aan de uitspraak van de Afdeling.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Wilders over de zoveelste gekkigheden van Eurocommissaris Malmström inzake immigratie

Two PVV MPs asked the immigration minister whether he had noticed EU Commissioner Malmström's call for much more immigration to Europe, whether she should resign, and whether the Netherlands should leave the EU to regain control of its borders. The minister confirmed he had noticed the statement, noted that Commission members have independent responsibilities and the right to voice their views, and said the government considers continued engagement in the EU in the direct interest of Dutch citizens and businesses.
The cabinet considers continued involvement in the European process to be in the direct interest of Dutch citizens and businesses.
Het kabinet acht blijvende betrokkenheid bij het Europese proces in het directe belang van Nederlandse burgers en bedrijven.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma, Bontes en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU de deur open zet voor vele vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands joins EU mobility partnerships that ease visa access for Moroccans, Egyptians and Cape Verdeans, whether visa-free travel should be used as leverage, and whether the Netherlands should leave the EU. The government answered that mobility partnerships are tailored, conditional agreements covering irregular migration, legal migration, asylum and return, that visa facilitation is not visa liberalisation, and that it will not seek EU withdrawal.
Visa facilitation is not the same as visa-free travel. The Netherlands is very reluctant when it comes to visa liberalisation.
Visumfacilitatie is niet hetzelfde als visumvrij reizen. Nederland is zeer terughoudend als het gaat om visumliberalisatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van den Besselaar en Fritsma over het bericht dat Amsterdam illegale buitenlandse jeugd stages aanbiedt

PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam offering internships to students without residence permits is acceptable and whether fines should apply per case. The minister referred to a letter of 25 June 2012 announcing an appeal against a court ruling, and to earlier answers, without substantively answering the questions.
For answering your question I refer to the letter sent to your House on 25 June 2012, in which the cabinet announces it will appeal a ruling of the Hague District Court.

Voor de beantwoording van uw vraag verwijs ik naar de brief die wij uw Kamer op 25 juni 2012 (Kamerstukken II 2011/12, 32 144, nr. 16 ) hebben toegezonden, waarin het kabinet aankondigt in hoger beroep te zullen gaan tegen een uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over de beeldvorming in een uitzending van Eén Vandaag over vreemdelingen in het tentenkamp in Ter Apel

An MP from the PVV asked the immigration minister whether the Iraqi family interviewed in an EenVandaag broadcast about the Ter Apel tent camp was still in an appeal procedure and lawfully resident, and whether they were actually homeless or housed in an asylum centre. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, citing restraint on individual matters, and said the group at the tent camp was fluctuating and the family's connection to it could not be assessed.
I take as a starting point that I exercise restraint in providing information about individual cases.
Ik hanteer als uitgangspunt om terughoudend om te gaan met het verstrekken van informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma over de arbeidsdeelname van “pardonners”

An MP asked the immigration minister about the 40% labour participation of pardoned asylum seekers, whether the previous cabinet's 60% expectation was wrong, the cost implications for benefits, and whether a future pardon scheme should be ruled out. The minister acknowledged participation lagged expectations, said municipalities and employers bear responsibility for support, said cost data for this group is not available, and referred to a letter on whether future pardons are excluded.
A cost overview for the specific group of pardoned persons is however not available.
Een kostenoverzicht voor de specifieke groep pardonners is echter niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma over een door uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers opgeslagen tentenkamp in Ter Apel

An MP asked the minister whether a tent camp of rejected asylum seekers in Ter Apel, which he called blackmail, is permitted, how it will be ended, and whether they will be returned to Iraq. The minister answered that the action is tolerated while public order is maintained, that no asylum status or shelter will be granted because of it, that Iraqi authorities are not cooperating with forced return, and that talks are under way to resume cooperation and end the camp.
Actions of this kind can never be grounds for changing asylum policy in general or regarding a particular country.
Acties van deze aard kunnen nooit de aanleiding vormen om het asielbeleid in het algemeen of ten aanzien van een bepaald land in het bijzonder, te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Fritsma over het bericht dat Roemenen en Bulgaren vaker betrokken zijn bij mensenhandel

MPs Elissen and Fritsma asked whether the rising share of Romanians and Bulgarians in human trafficking cases warrants 100% border checks on their nationals and a firm stance on Schengen accession. The minister answered that border controls are already applied, that the KMar pilot has been scaled up nationally, and that the Netherlands will judge Schengen accession only after the July 2012 CVM report.
The cabinet's position on the Schengen accession of Bulgaria and Romania is known.
Het standpunt van het kabinet inzake de Schengentoetreding van Bulgarije en Roemenie is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over problemen in het terugkeerproces bij de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum about reported problems in the return process at the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek, including falling deportation numbers in 2011 and whether staff language skills and country specialisation would be improved. The Minister's reply refers the MP to a separate letter on the Laissez Passer department, indicating the questions were answered by reference rather than on substance.

The written questions from MP Fritsma (PVV), question number 2012Z08595, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to request from Van Dam regarding the Laissez Passer (LP) department of the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek (DT&V)'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV), vraagnummer 2012Z08595 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op verzoek Van Dam over de afdeling Laissez Passer (LP) van de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek (DT&V)» (Kamerstuk 29 344, nr.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma over het bericht dat in Dokkum een nieuw asielzoekerscentrum (AZC) wordt gebouwd terwijl andere AZC’s worden gesloten

Fritsma (PVV) asked why a new asylum reception centre in Dokkum is being planned while the COA closes other centres amid falling inflows, and how much it would cost. Minister Leers replied that no decision has been taken on Dokkum, that the COA is still exploring a feasibility study with the municipality, and that building sustainable locations is a long-term saving rather than an unnecessary investment.
No decision has yet been taken that an asylum centre will be established in Dokkum.
Er is nog niet besloten dat er een asielzoekerscentrum in Dokkum gevestigd zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Afghanen valse papieren kopen voor een asielverzoek

An MP asked the minister whether Afghan asylum seekers have been found with forged documents, whether recently granted Afghan asylum cases should be re-examined, and whether permits should be revoked and those concerned removed when forged documents are found. The minister confirmed over 300 forged documents were found in 2011 and a rising trend, but saw no reason to change document checks, re-examine cases, or add measures beyond existing revocation rules.
Er is sprake van een stijgende lijn.
Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie, Integratie en Asiel over het bericht «Vreemde daklozen in opvang» (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asks the Immigration minister about Utrecht providing shelter to rejected asylum seekers in breach of a 2007 agreement, whether other municipalities do the same, and whether the Gemeentefonds should be cut. The minister says structural municipal emergency shelter is undesirable, lists national measures, admits having no full overview of municipalities, and sees no reason for further measures beyond referral to DT&V.
I do not have a complete overview of the municipalities that still provide some form of emergency shelter to rejected asylum seekers.
Ik heb geen volledig overzicht van de gemeenten die nog een vorm van noodopvang bieden aan uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers.
Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie, Integratie en Asiel over het aanbod van de IND aan uitgeprocedeerde Somaliërs (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

An MP asks whether the IND advised protesting failed Somali asylum seekers to file new asylum applications so they regain reception rights, and whether this advice should stop. The minister answers that the IND only gave factual information on available procedures, that it would provide shelter until a new application is filed to address public order concerns, and that providing such information is part of the IND's regular work.
As set out above, there was no provision of legal advice, but of factual information.
Zoals hierboven uiteen is gezet is er geen sprake geweest van het verstrekken van juridisch advies, maar van het verstrekken van feitelijke informatie.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma over het bericht dat Nurten Albayrak weer aan de slag mag bij het Centraal Orgaan Opvang Asielzoekers (COA)

An MP asked the minister whether a COA employee, Nurten Albayrak, may return to work after a court ruling, and what options exist to prevent her return given an ongoing investigation into COA. The government answered that the questions were answered in a separate letter of 13 January 2012, so no substantive answer is given in this document.
These questions were answered in the letter of 13 January 2012 (Kamerstuk 33 042, no. 6).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 13 januari 2012 (Kamerstuk 33 042, nr. 6 ).

Vragen van de leden Driessen en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het door ontwikkelingsorganisatie Cordaid ondersteunen van illegale vreemde

PVV MPs asked whether Cordaid's support for a protest by illegal migrants is misleading and whether its state subsidy should be withdrawn because it undermines government policy. The government answered that the protest claims are inaccurate, that Cordaid's advocacy is legitimate civil-society dialogue separate from its subsidised programmes, and that it sees no reason to revise the partnership.
The cabinet sees no reason to revise cooperation with CORDAID.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden de samenwerking met CORDAID te herzien.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de mogelijkheid werkloze Turken te weren op basis van een EU-richtl

PVV MPs asked whether the 2004 EU directive could be used to exclude unemployed Turkish nationals, and whether the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling on Turkish civic integration was damaging. The minister replied that Turks are not EU citizens and cannot invoke the directive, so its restrictions do not apply to them, while the government is still reviewing how to secure integration.
Turks are not EU citizens and therefore cannot derive rights from the EU directive.
Turken geen EU-burgers zijn en dus geen rechten kunnen ontlenen aan de EU-richtlijn.
Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over misstanden rond het functioneren van de bestuursvoorzitter van het COA (ingezonden 19 september 2011).

An MP asks whether the COA chairman's pay exceeds the public-sector pay norm and whether a company car was over the guidelines, and what the minister will do, and asks about wasted public money and how the problems arose. The minister confirms pay exceeded the norm, states it must be lowered and the supervisory board suspended the chairman over inconsistent information, and says an external review of COA financing will be broadened.
I have asked the Supervisory Board to inform me as soon as possible, fully and correctly, about all outstanding questions.
Ik heb de Raad van Toezicht verzocht mij op de kortst mogelijke termijn volledig en correct over alle openstaande vragen te informeren.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het verlenen van een verblijfsvergunning aan een Marokkaan die betrokken is bij een gewelddadige beweging (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum how a residence permit could be granted to a Moroccan man linked to a violent Islamist organisation, on what grounds, and whether it would be revoked. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said the IND checks for criminal records and Article 1F exclusion, and said revocation would follow if an withdrawal ground arises, while also reporting a separate screening inquiry into the man's prior work as an Islamic chaplain at a prison.
The starting point for me is that information about individual cases is treated confidentially.
Uitgangspunt is voor mij dat informatie over individuele zaken vertrouwelijk wordt behandeld.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat de illegale vreemdeling die de moorden in het Groningse Baflo heeft gepleegd meerdere mislukte uitzetpogingen achter de rug h

The MP asks whether an undocumented foreigner suspected of a double murder in Baflo had failed deportation attempts, how often he was detained, and how many criminal foreigners remain free despite illegal status. The minister answers that the suspect's Beninese nationality was established but Benin and two other countries refused travel documents, he was detained only once briefly, and the government follows the 'deport or detain' principle, though the number of such cases is not tracked.
The number of criminal foreigners who can move freely in society, with or without (repeated) deportation attempts, is not tracked in figures.
Het aantal criminele vreemdelingen, dat vrij in de samenleving rond kan lopen, al of niet na (herhaalde) uitzetpogingen wordt niet cijfermatig bijgehouden.
Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het door Italië verlenen van visa aan Tunesiërs (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An MP asked whether Italy would grant tens of thousands of North African arrivals humanitarian visas valid in the Netherlands and whether the minister would object. The minister answered that Italy issued six-month residence permits to Tunisians arriving before 5 April 2011, that he regretted this unilateral decision, and that he had raised concerns with the Commission, co-signed letters with other states, and called for EU consultation.
I regret Italy's unilateral decision to provide residence permits to illegal Tunisian immigrants
Ik betreur de unilaterale beslissing van Italië om verblijfsvergunningen te verschaffen aan illegale Tunesische immigranten

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat aan illegale vreemdelingen geld wordt geboden om hen Nederland te doen verlaten (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about reports that departing illegal migrants are offered money to leave, and whether this rewards non-cooperation with return. The minister confirmed financial contributions are given in a limited number of cases (about 265 people since 2007, roughly 222,325 euro total), defended them as removing obstacles to voluntary departure, and said similar schemes exist in other European countries.
In a limited number of cases, the Return and Departure Service (DT&V) offers a financial contribution to rejected foreign nationals who must leave the Netherlands.
In een beperkt aantal gevallen wordt aan uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen die Nederland dienen te verlaten door de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek (DT&V) een financiële bijdrage geboden.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Jong (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat de werkloosheid onder niet-westerse alloch

PVV MPs asked the government about rising unemployment among non-Western immigrants in 2010, including whether immigrants should wait ten years before claiming welfare and whether continued immigration of low-skilled workers worsens the problem. The minister replied that stricter migration and welfare rules are being examined, attributed the unemployment rise to the cyclical and temporary-job structure of the labour market, and cited research indicating that the causes are cumulative factors rather than work ethic.
In line with the coalition agreement, it is being examined to what extent tightening migration policy is possible and what this means for access to our social provisions.
Overeenkomstig het regeerakkoord, wordt bezien in hoeverre aanscherping van het (arbeids)migratiebeleid mogelijk is en wat dit betekent voor de toegang tot onze sociale voorzieningen.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof van Justitie, dat in Europa geboren kinderen de illegaal verblijvende ouders verblijfsrecht geven (ingezond

An MP asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the 2011 CJEU ruling granting residence rights to illegally staying parents of EU-born children would undermine Dutch admission policy and what measures would be taken. The minister answered that the ruling's consequences for the Netherlands are very limited, since stateless children do not acquire Dutch nationality at birth, and saw no need for measures.
I therefore see no need to take any measures.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak tot het treffen van maatregelen.
Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het nieuwe immigratierecord (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the immigration minister about a record immigration figure and whether the coalition agreement measures should be implemented quickly, and whether emigration of native Dutch and skilled workers signals a brain drain. The minister said the measures are being pursued with timelines depending on EU processes and that the emigration data do not show mass departure of natives or braindrain among second-generation migrants.
My aim is explicitly to implement the measures in the coalition agreement in the shortest possible time.
Mijn inzet is er nadrukkelijk op gericht de in het regeerakkoord genoemde maatregelen op de kortst mogelijke termijn door te voeren.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat criminele vreemdelingen met valse paspoorten moeiteloos kunnen onderduiken in Nederlandse asielzoekerscentra (ingezonden 15 n

Fritsma (PVV) asked the immigration minister how the IND could be fooled by two foreigners using false Bulgarian passports to enter an asylum procedure, and whether fraud would be prevented and costs recovered. The minister replied that the asylum procedure was adequately handled, the applicants' claims were rejected, fingerprints are now registered including via Eurodac, and cost recovery was judged impractical and not pursued.
In my view, this case was dealt with adequately.
Naar mijn mening is in deze casus adequaat gereageerd.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Fritsma, Kortenoeven en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de

PVV MPs asked whether members of terrorist organisations should be denied or stripped of refugee status, citing a 2010 EU Court ruling and asking for screening and a revised EU directive. The government answered that the AIVD and IND can refuse or revoke status for national-security risks or serious non-political crimes after individual assessment, that mere membership is not enough, and that the current Qualification Directive already allows denying residence to those actually involved in terrorism.
The EU Court of Justice holds that a person who belonged to an organisation using terrorist methods can only be excluded from refugee status after an individual examination.

Het Hof van Justitie van de EU overweegt dat een persoon die heeft behoord tot een organisatie die terroristische methoden toepast, slechts van de vluchtelingenstatus kan worden uitgesloten na een individueel onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over een iftarmaaltijd in Slotervaart (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

PVV MPs asked the ministers about the cost, attendance and justification of a police-organised iftar meal in Slotervaart, questioning whether such events fit the police core tasks and whether the Amsterdam regional head discriminates against the native population. The minister answered that the meal cost over EUR 60,000 borne by the force, that about 250 staff attended, that the event serves community contact, and that the claims of discrimination are rejected; no registry of such meals across regions is kept.
We do not keep records of iftar meals organised by police regions.
Wij houden geen registratie bij van Iftar-maaltijden die door politieregio's worden georganiseerd.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat volgende maand de eerste allochtonenkliniek opent in A

PVV MPs asked whether the minister would act against a new clinic in Amsterdam aimed at Turkish-origin patients, which they called discrimination and Islamisation, and whether Agis and oversight bodies would investigate overtreatment. The minister rejected the discrimination framing, said the clinic is open to all, noted Agis's own finding of overtreatment in Turkish clinics, and stated that monitoring is the insurer's task rather than the Inspectorate's.
No, it is the task of the health insurers that conclude care contracts with the clinic to ensure that care is provided efficiently, in line with applicable professional standards.
Nee, het is de taak van de zorgverzekeraars die zorgcontracten afsluiten met de kliniek om er op toe te zien dat de zorg doelmatig – conform geldende professionele standaarden – wordt verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) de minister van Justitie over de mogelijke komst van twee grote asielzoekerscentra in Dokkum en Veenwouden (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether two large asylum centres for about 450 asylum seekers each were planned in Dokkum and Veenwouden, and raised concerns about local residents, crime and a murder case in the area. The minister answered that COA is only investigating possible locations with the two municipalities, that no decision has been taken, and that the size and siting of reception centres is a matter for COA's operations.
Decision-making on the size of reception centres and where they are realised falls under COA's operational management.
De besluitvorming inzake de omvang van de opvangcentra en de plaats waar deze gerealiseerd worden behoort tot de bedrijfsvoering van het COA.

Vragen van de leden Graus, Fritsma en Van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het artikel «Hondje doodgeschopt» (ingezonden 5 oktober 20

PVV MPs asked ministers about a newspaper report of a dog being kicked to death, asking how repression would reduce threats, robberies, and animal cruelty and what measures would be taken against street terror. The minister answered that this is a local matter for the municipality of Amsterdam and that no report or complaint was filed, so no action could be taken.
This concerns a local matter for which the municipality of Amsterdam is responsible.
Het gaat hier om een lokale aangelegenheid waarvoor de gemeente Amsterdam verantwoordelijk is.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitspraak van de Turkse regering dat Turken in Nederland niet hoeven in te burgeren (ingezond

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked the Minister of Interior whether the Turkish government's claim that Turks in the Netherlands need not take civic integration courses was acceptable, and what measures would be taken toward Turkey and to keep Turks subject to integration obligations. The minister replied that the Netherlands sets its own integration conditions, that the government has appealed court rulings holding the obligation contrary to the EU-Turkey Association Agreement, and that contacts between states and their nationals abroad are permitted within legal limits.
I have lodged an appeal with the Central Appeals Tribunal, because the Cabinet is of the view that the civic integration obligation falls outside the scope of the EU-Turkey Association Agreement.
Hoger beroep ingesteld bij de Centrale Raad van Beroep, omdat het Kabinet van mening is dat de inburgeringsplicht buiten de werkingssfeer van het Associatieakkoord EU-Turkije valt.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Helder, Kortenoeven en Fritsma (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vrijlating van Wesam al D., die in Amerika voor 25 jaar gevangenisstra

PVV MPs asked why Wesam al D., sentenced in the US to 25 years for plotting attacks on American soldiers, was released early after a Dutch court substantially reduced his sentence due to detention conditions, and whether they would prevent such reductions and revoke his Dutch nationality. The ministers answered that the court weighed additional information, that the case is exceptional and warrants no new measures, and that nationality revocation is not possible here because the relevant provision does not apply to offences committed before its entry into force.
As a rule, there is no reason for a judge converting a foreign sentence to moderate that foreign sentence on account of detention conditions.
In de regel is er voor de rechter bij de omzetting van een buitenlandse straf geen aanleiding voor matiging van de buitenlandse straf wegens detentieomstandigheden.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de warme banden van een Rotterdamse topambtenaar met een jihadistische organisatie

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about a Rotterdam senior official's close ties to a jihadist organisation, and whether he should be prosecuted or dismissed and whether other officials have similar ties. The minister answered that the municipality found no reason to doubt the official's integrity, referred all questions to that conclusion, and described general integrity screening, while not committing to a new investigation.
We have confidence in the judgement of the Rotterdam municipality and therefore endorse this conclusion.
Wij hebben vertrouwen in het oordeel van de gemeente Rotterdam en sluiten ons daarom aan bij deze conclusie.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Bosma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een doodsbedreiging op de website Marokko.nl (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

PVV MPs asked why threats against a former PVV candidate on the website Marokko.nl were not removed within an hour as promised, whether the operator should be sanctioned, and whether its subsidy had ended. The minister declined to classify the posts as threats (left to police and courts), said the operator promised to remove such posts within an hour and did so after being asked, and confirmed the subsidy was phased out in 2009.

However, it does not befit me as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to classify the statements in this specific case as threats; that is for the police and justice to assess and ultimately for the independent judge.

Het past mij echter als minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet om in dit concrete geval de uitingen als bedreiging te kwalificeren; dat is ter beoordeling aan politie en justitie en in laatste instantie aan de onafhankelijke rechter.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het aantal dodelijke slachtoffers als gevolg van eerwraak in Nederland (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the minister about the number of fatal honour-related killings in the Netherlands, the accuracy of reported figures, whether perpetrators should face heavier sentences, and whether honour violence is mainly linked to immigrants from Islamic countries. The minister answered that the figures (13 fatal cases in 2009 out of 445 reported possible honour cases) are police-recorded and not a full measure, that honour codes are cultural rather than religious, and that honour motive is not in itself an aggravating circumstance under Dutch law.
In 2009, the LEC EGG recorded 13 fatal victims.
In 2009 werd bij het LEC EGG melding gemaakt van 13 dodelijke slachtoffers.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over de stand van zaken rond de Irakese eermoordenaar die tot 19 oktober 2010 een tijdelijke verblijfsvergunning heeft gekregen (ingezonden 14 september 2010)

MP Fritsma asked the Justice Minister about the status of an Iraqi honour killer whose temporary residence permit ran until 19 October 2010, including whether an extension application exists, the bearing of his adult daughter on any Article 8 claim, preparations for return, abolition of the limitation period for such offences, and ongoing updates. The minister answered that no extension application has been filed, that the residence procedure is not yet concluded so he cannot comment on the daughter or on return preparations, that the policy on serious offences has already been changed, and that he will inform the House of new developments.
The immigration procedure concerning the individual to whom a temporary residence permit was granted has not yet been concluded.
De vreemdelingenrechtelijke procedure van betrokkene waarbij aan hem een tijdelijke verblijfsvergunning is verleend, is nog niet afgerond.

Vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Wonen Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat Turken en Marokkanen tijdens een gratis haarknipbeur

PVV MPs asked why Turkish and Moroccan pensioners receive free haircuts with explanations of the AIO supplement in their own language, and why they need not buy AOW buy-in like others. The minister answered that the SVB uses bilingual staff to reach a hard-to-reach group and reduce non-take-up, that the AOW buy-in is voluntary for all, and that autochthonous Dutch pensioners may also use the free haircut.
The haircut campaign was set up as part of further combating unwanted non-take-up.
De kappersactie is in het kader van het verder bestrijden van ongewenst niet-gebruik opgezet.
Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het door jongens voetballen met een 4 mei krans (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether youths who played football with a 4 May wreath in Zaltbommel are of Moroccan descent, how many suspects there are, and whether the government will take harsh action and impose an immigration stop for Muslim countries. The government answered that the criminal investigation is ongoing, five suspects aged 16 to 21 were arrested, all are believed to be lawfully resident, and it rejects an immigration stop on grounds of religion as contrary to the rule of law.
The criminal investigation into this incident is still ongoing.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar dit voorval loopt nog.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat homo’s en lesbiënnes verbaal of fysiek worden aangevallen in Amsterdam-West (inge

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Justice and of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration about reports that gay men and lesbians were being verbally and physically attacked in Amsterdam-West, and whether the perpetrators were Turkish or Moroccan youths and whether they should be expelled. The minister said the criminal investigation is ongoing, rejected claims of 'Islamisation', stated that the government acts against discrimination and intimidation, could not provide prosecution data on discriminatory threats since prosecutors do not register the discriminatory element separately, and pointed to new citizenship-revocation rules and local measures.
Since the criminal investigation is still ongoing, there are not yet any perpetrators.
Aangezien het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt, is er nog geen sprake van daders.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat de meeste «Marokkanengemeenten» geen prestatieafspraken over het terugdringen van criminaliteitscijfers, schooluitval

An MP from the PVV asked whether most 'Moroccan municipalities' refuse to set performance targets on crime, school dropout and unemployment among Moroccan-Dutch youth while still receiving extra national funds, and urged stopping such subsidies and tougher measures. The minister denied the claim, stating that 22 cooperating municipalities have concrete agreements with annual monitoring and that funding could be stopped for underperformers, and declined to change course.
The national government has made concrete performance agreements with the 22 cooperating municipalities.
Het Rijk heeft met de 22 samenwerkende gemeenten concrete prestatieafspraken gemaakt

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Jong (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor wonen, wijken en integratie over werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren (ingezonden 13 juli 2

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration about a report that one in four young people of foreign origin has no job, asking how this fits the Investing in Youth Act, whether mass immigration of unskilled migrants contributes, and whether work ethic differences play a role. The minister answered that the Act's effects will only be visible from Q3 2010, rejected the immigration premise, and cited surveys finding employers see no meaningful work-ethic gap.
Reducing unemployment among young people of foreign origin has the attention of this cabinet.
Het terugdringen van de werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren heeft de aandacht van dit kabinet.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat schilderijen met varkens zijn verwijderd uit een polikliniek om te voorkomen dat moslims er aanstoot aan nemen (ingez

An MP asked the minister for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration whether it is absurd to remove artworks depicting pigs from a polyclinic to avoid offending Muslims, and whether the minister would address the clinic and request reinstatement. The minister replied that the clinic is free to set its own art policy and that it is not for the minister to intervene, while stating that society is resilient enough to handle such debates and that the state would intervene only if constitutional freedoms were at stake.
A polyclinic is free to determine its own art policy and free to act on its own judgement in this.
Een polikliniek is vrij om haar eigen kunstbeleid te bepalen en vrij om hierin naar eigen inzicht te handelen.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat de helft van de Marokkaanse jeugd een misdrijf heeft gepleegd (ingezonden 29 juni

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked whether the government finds it unacceptable that half of Moroccan youth committed a crime before age 22, and whether it will crack down harder, create a street-terror unit, apply fast-track justice, raise penalties and enable denaturalisation and deportation. The minister answered that crimes must be tackled, pointed to existing person-focused policy and a new bill, referred to a separate motion for the street unit, and noted the underlying study only followed youths up to 2006.

Vragen van de leden Dille en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over het bericht dat er binnen «Amarant» (jeugd crisisopvang) asielzoekers worden opgevangen (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

PVV MPs asked the minister for Youth and Family whether young asylum seekers are being housed in regular crisis youth care at Amarant, and whether this should be stopped. The minister confirmed a single exceptional placement in 1996 at the request of the child protection board and sees no need for further action.
Since this is not a structural matter but an exception, I see no need to take further steps.
Aangezien het hier niet gaat om een structurele aangelegenheid maar om een uitzondering, zie ik niet de noodzaak om nadere stappen te ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en Sharpe (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over islamisering van het Haagse amateurvoetbal (ingezonden 9 jul

PVV MPs asked ministers whether a Hague amateur football club receives subsidy and whether reports of an 'Islamisation' coup there (no karbonaadjes, alcohol labels removed, women volunteers not invited) show a failure of Moroccan integration. The government answered that there is no current subsidy relation, that the club disputes the reports, and that the matter is a local responsibility with no integration problem found.
On the basis of the information obtained, I establish that there is no question of a coup or an integration problem here.
Op basis van de verkregen informatie stel ik vast dat hier geen sprake is van een coup dan wel een integratieprobleem.
Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht «Luxekantoor koopje voor moslimclub» (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An MP asks whether Amsterdam district Centrum rents the historic Montelbaan tower to the Secret Garden foundation for a symbolic amount and whether this is unacceptable. The minister answers that the rent is market-based at EUR 1,426.25 per month, that there is no unacceptable rental construction, and that no state aid is involved, relying on information from the municipality.
Inquiries with the Amsterdam district Centrum show that there is no question of a symbolic rent.
Navraag bij het Amsterdamse stadsdeel Centrum leert dat er geen sprake is van een symbolische huur.
Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Lucassen (beiden PVV) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat asielzoekers sneller een huis krijgen (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Fritsma and Lucassen asked the minister whether a 'Taskforce Thuisgeven' prioritising housing for about 2,200 backlogged asylum residence-permit holders would disadvantage ordinary social housing seekers, and whether measures would limit inflows. The minister replied that the backlog is not new, that the group is small relative to annual social housing turnover, that priority is anchored in the Huisvestingswet, and that the asylum procedure was improved on 1 July 2010.
Referring to the answer to question 3, I dispute that regular housing seekers are victims of the quota arising from the Housing Act, and I therefore see no reason to take measures.

Met verwijzing naar het antwoord op vraag 3, bestrijd ik dat reguliere woningzoekenden de dupe zijn van de uit de Huisvestingswet voortvloeiende taakstelling en ik zie derhalve geen redenen maatregelen te treffen.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door Nederland medefinancieren van een moskee op ground zero (ingezonden 21 juli 20

MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked whether Dutch taxpayer money supports ASMA, the organisation of imam Faisal Abdur Rauf planning a mosque at ground zero, and whether the subsidy should be withdrawn. The minister answered that ASMA is not involved in the ground zero mosque, that it receives MDG3 fund subsidy for a women's empowerment program in Afghanistan, Egypt and Pakistan, and that withdrawal is not being considered.
No, the American Society for Muslim Advancement (ASMA) is not involved in the construction of a mosque at ground zero in the United States.
Nee, de American Society for Muslim Advancement (ASMA) is niet betrokken bij de bouw van een moskee op ground zero in de Verenigde Staten.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat bejaarde biljarters hun clubhuis moeten verlaten om een Marokkaanse vereniging te huisvesten (inge

PVV MPs asked the minister whether elderly billiard players were being evicted from their clubhouse in Ede to make way for a Moroccan-Dutch association funded by a provincial subsidy, and whether the municipality's allocation reflected segregationist intent. The minister answered that the billiard players are not being evicted but must relocate within the building or elsewhere, that the municipality is pursuing shared housing for ethnic associations to promote integration, and that the matter is a local affair, so no federal intervention is planned.
I regard this as a local matter.
Ik beschouw dit als een lokale aangelegenheid.
Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over de stijging van de immigratiecijfers op het gebied van gezinsmigratie (ingezonden 14 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about rising family-migration residence applications, mainly from Somalis, fraud checks, EU-law family migration, and a ban on immigration from Muslim countries. The minister said the rise was modest and partly declining, reported roughly 400 fraud/address investigations in 2009, outlined EU harmonisation efforts, and rejected an immigration stop based on religion as contrary to the rule of law.
I am neither competent nor willing to impose an immigration stop in general, nor specifically for Muslim countries.
Ik ben niet bevoegd en niet bereid tot het afkondigen van een immigratiestop in het algemeen en ook niet specifiek voor moslimlanden.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma, Bosma en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat moslimleerlingen moeite hebben met de holocaust (in

PVV MPs asked ministers about a report that Muslim pupils have difficulty discussing the Holocaust, linking this to Islamisation, rising antisemitism and calling for an immigration stop from Muslim countries. The government answered that teachers can handle sensitive topics, that antisemitism reports do not show a sharp rise, that antisemitic slogans are prosecuted, and that a religion-based immigration stop is rejected as contrary to the rule of law.
The picture painted in the question that this form of antisemitism is not being tackled forcefully, I reject.
Het in de vraag geschetste beeld dat deze vorm van antisemitisme niet daadkrachtig wordt aangepakt, wijs ik van de hand.
Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Defensie over de islamisering van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

PVV MPs Fritsma and Brinkman asked the Ministers for Housing and Defence whether the appointment of two Islamic chaplains in the armed forces amounts to Islamisation and whether they would stop it, and whether Muslim soldiers could be exempted from duty during Ramadan. The government answered that the chaplains add expertise, that Islamisation means society organised along Islamic principles which does not apply to the military, that integration requires effort from newcomers, and that only Eid holidays may be swapped under an existing rule, not Ramadan as a whole.
Therefore, since 1981 there has been a scheme for Jewish, Muslim and Hindu feast and commemoration days.
Daarom bestaat er sinds 1981 een regeling voor joodse, moslim en hindoe feest- en gedenkdagen.

m: Amendement van het lid Bergkamp c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over toegang tot Wlz voor jeugdigen op nader te bepalen tijdstip
Amends the Wlz so that the government's decree bringing youth with psychiatric disorders under Wlz access is sent to both Houses, with a four-week wait before it is submitted.

the royal decree referred to in the first paragraph, if it concerns the entry into force of article IA, is not submitted earlier than four weeks after the draft has been laid before both Houses of the States General

De voordracht voor een koninklijk besluit als bedoeld in het eerste lid wordt, indien het de inwerkingtreding van artikel IA betreft, niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Bergkamp c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over toegang tot Wlz voor jeugdigen op nader te bepalen datum

Removes the age-based exception so young people with psychiatric disorders can gain Wlz access by royal decree on a later date, with the decree subject to a four-week waiting period after submission to both chambers.

The proposal for a royal decree referred to in the first paragraph, if it concerns the entry into force of article IA, is not submitted until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both Houses of the States General.

De voordracht voor een koninklijk besluit als bedoeld in het eerste lid wordt, indien het de inwerkingtreding van artikel IA betreft, niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Bergkamp c.s. over toegang tot Wlz voor jeugdigen op nader te bepalen datum
Amends the Wlz so that youth with psychiatric disorders can gain access on a later date set by royal decree, and requires that decree to be submitted to both chambers with a four-week waiting period.
in this special case it is provided that the royal decree bringing article IA into force must be submitted to both chambers of the States General
wordt in dit bijzondere geval geregeld dat het koninklijk besluit waarmee de inwerkingtreding van artikel IA wordt geregeld, aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal moet worden voorgelegd
Amendement van de leden Slootweg en De Lange over voorhang op de inwerkingtreding van het afschaffen van de driejaarstermijn
Requires that the royal decree bringing into force the abolition of the three-year criterion in the Long-term Care Act not be proposed until four weeks after the draft is submitted to both chambers.

The proposal for a royal decree referred to in the first paragraph, if it concerns the entry into force of article I, part C, is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een koninklijk besluit als bedoeld in het eerste lid wordt, indien het de inwerkingtreding van artikel I, onderdeel C, betreft, niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van de leden Hijink en De Lange over een met redenen omklede toelichting bij een opgelegde berisping of geldboete
Requires that a reasoned explanation of a reprimand or fine imposed on a BIG-registered professional be recorded in the register and published, so patients can understand it.
This amendment ensures that the BIG register and public publications explain more clearly why a BIG-registered professional was given a reprimand or fine.
Dit amendement regelt dat in het BIG-register en bij openbare publicaties duidelijker onderbouwd wordt waarom een BIG-geregistreerde een berisping of een geldboete opgelegd heeft gekregen
Motie van de leden Hijink en De Lange over het toelichten van maatregelen in het BIG-register
Asks the government to explore how publications of measures in the BIG register can include a short, understandable explanation of why the measure was imposed.
requests the government to map the options for including a short, understandable explanation of why a given measure was imposed when measures are published.
verzoekt de regering, in kaart te brengen welke mogelijkheden er zijn om bij de publicatie van maatregelen een korte, begrijpelijke toelichting op te nemen waarom een bepaalde maatregel is opgelegd
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Bergkamp en De Lange ter vervanging van nr. 13 over een reactie op toezichtgegevens
Amends the Dutch inspectorates' publication rules so that the concerned party's response to supervisory findings is published alongside the decision.
the person concerned is given the opportunity to make their response to the decision known
wordt de betrokkene in de gelegenheid gesteld zijn reactie op het besluit kenbaar te maken
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden De Lange en Bergkamp ter vervanging van nr. 16 over herinspectie
Requires inspectorates to adopt policy rules on re-inspections after negative findings, with conditions set by a general administrative order and publication of re-inspection results.
adopt policy rules on re-inspections after a negative outcome of inspection and investigation of a person concerned
beleidsregels vaststellen over herinspecties na een negatieve uitkomst van controle en onderzoek bij een betrokkene
Amendement van de leden De Lange en Bergkamp over herinspectie
Amends the health inspection provisions so that an AMvB sets when inspectorates re-inspect after a negative outcome, what counts as negative and the deadline, with results published.
By or pursuant to a general administrative order it is determined in which cases the State Supervision of Public Health and others charged with supervising compliance with the regulations re-inspect
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt bepaald in welke gevallen het Staatstoezicht op de volksgezondheid en anderen die zijn belast met het toezicht op de naleving van de regelgeving

Amendement van het lid De Lange c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 dat het mogelijk maakt om na een periode van twee jaar de effectiviteit van de interventies in het kader van anonieme e-mental health te e
Adds a clause requiring the Minister of Health to report to parliament within two years on the effectiveness of anonymous e-mental health interventions.
In agreement with the Minister for Housing and Public Sector Employment, sends the States General a report within two years on the effectiveness of this law
zendt in overeenstemming met Onze Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst binnen twee jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid
Amendement van het lid De Lange dat het mogelijk maakt om na een periode van twee jaar de effectiviteit van de interventies in het kader van anonieme e-mental health te evalueren
Requires the health minister to report to the States General within two years on the effectiveness and effects of the anonymous e-mental health law.
within two years of this act entering into force, sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this act in practice
zendt ... binnen twee jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden De Lange en Bouwmeester ter vervanging van nr. 29 over het initiatief Hartveilig wonen
Shifts funds within the health budget from Volksgezondheid to Curatieve Zorg to subsidise the Hartveilig wonen and HartslagNU citizen first-responder systems, conditional on merging them.
The funding for this amendment is found in the non-legal part of article 1.
De dekking van dit amendement wordt gevonden in het niet-juridische deel van artikel 1.
Motie van de leden de Lange en Bouwmeester over Samen Beslissen als standaard in de zorg
Asks that shared decision-making become the standard in care, via the NZa's DOT plan and clinical guidelines, with a report before summer 2016.
requests the government likewise to make Shared Decision-making the standard in care
verzoekt de regering eveneens, Samen Beslissen de standaard in de zorg te laten worden
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden De Lange en Tanamal ter vervanging van nr. 18 over familievertrouwenspersonen
Shifts 300 thousand euros in 2016 from the public health budget to curative care to fund the national family trust persons organisation in mental health care.
The funding for this amendment is found in the non-legally-obligatory part of article 1.
De dekking van dit amendement wordt gevonden in het niet-juridisch verplichte deel van artikel 1.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden De Lange en Bouwmeester ter vervanging van nr. 19 over het initiatief Hartveilig wonen
Shifts budget between health articles to fund a national expansion of the Hartveilig wonen volunteer resuscitation initiative.
The funding for this amendment is found in the non-legal part of article 1.
De dekking van dit amendement wordt gevonden in het niet-juridische deel van artikel 1.
Motie van de leden Bouwmeester en de Lange over patiëntgericht informeren
Asks the government to realise patient-centred health communication with a timeline and inform the House before summer 2016, and to have the Zorginstituut drive it.
asks the government to vigorously realise the patient-centred communication objective with a timeline
verzoekt de regering, met voortvarendheid de doelstelling over patiëntgericht communiceren met een tijdpad te realiseren
Amendement van de leden De Lange en Tanamal over familievertrouwenspersonen
Shifts 300 thousand euro within the health budget to fund the national family support foundation for 2016.
By this amendment a start is made by making funds available for budget year 2016.
Middels dit amendement wordt een begin gemaakt door voor het begrotingsjaar 2016 middelen beschikbaar te stellen.
Amendement van het lid De Lange over het initiatief Hartveilig wonen
Shifts budget within the health ministry's budget to fund a subsidy for the Hartveilig wonen volunteer defibrillation initiative.
The funding for this amendment is found in the non-legally mandatory part of article 1.
De dekking van dit amendement wordt gevonden in het niet-juridisch verplichte deel van artikel 1.

Amendement van het lid De Lange over het schrappen van het voorgestelde verbod op het aanprijzen van het aanbrengen van een tatoeage of piercing door tatoeëerders of piercers die zonder vergunning hun
Deletes the proposed ban on advertising tattoo or piercing services by unlicensed practitioners from the Warenwet bill, arguing enforcement of the licensing system should be improved instead.
This amendment aims to delete from the bill the proposed article 24(5) of the Warenwet, which contains a ban on advertising tattooing or piercing by unlicensed practitioners.

Dit amendement strekt ertoe het voorgestelde artikel 24, vijfde lid, van de Warenwet, waar een verbod is opgenomen op het aanprijzen van het aanbrengen van een tatoeage of piercing door tatoeëerders of piercers die zonder een benodigde vergunning hun werkzaamheden verrichten, uit het wetsvoorstel te schrappen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Van Gent en Peters over inning van alimentatie

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the collection of child maintenance owed by ex-partners who do not pay, including whether preferential collection priority should be studied and how other countries handle it. The minister agreed that non-payment is undesirable, promised a study of preference and collection by LBIO to be reported after the summer, and argued that existing enforcement adequately secures payment.
By letter of 27 February I informed you of the advantages and disadvantages of preference for child maintenance claims.
Antwoord 3 Bij Kamerbrief van 27 februari jongstleden heb ik u geïnformeerd over de voor en- nadelen van preferentie voor kinderalimentatievorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Ziengs en Arno Rutte over automatische externe defibrillators (AED’s) in treinen en op stations

MPs De Lange, Ziengs and Rutte asked whether AEDs should be installed in trains and at all stations, whether theft or vandalism justifies not placing them, and whether tender conditions could require them. The State Secretary answered that NS and ProRail are talking with the Hartstichting about 24/7 access at the 50 largest stations, that operators decide their own first-aid mix, and that a rail concession provision on AEDs in trains is under consideration.
I will have NS inform me about the considerations it makes for providing first aid on moving trains.
Ik zal mij door NS laten informeren over de afwegingen die zij maken voor het verlenen van eerste hulp op de rijdende treinen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Incidenten verwarde mensen heftiger’

MPs De Lange and Laan-Geselschap (VVD) asked the Justice and Health ministers about a report that incidents involving people with confused behaviour were becoming more severe and that police registrations had doubled. The minister answered that E33 registrations are not diagnoses, that the rise cannot yet be explained, and pointed to a person-centred approach, regional support teams, and planned information-sharing legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en De Lange over zorgfraude als verdienmodel voor criminelen

MPs Hermans and De Lange asked the Minister of Health about reports of care fraud as a criminal earning model, including recruitment of vulnerable people and misuse of personal budgets (PGB). The minister acknowledged the problem and outlined measures: more inspection capacity, automated checks in PGB 2.0, PGB-competence frameworks, a planned information-sharing bill delayed to early 2020, and municipal support programmes.
To tackle fraudsters as quickly and as firmly as possible, forces must be pooled even better.
Om fraudeurs zo snel en zo stevig mogelijk aan te pakken moeten de krachten nog beter gebundeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het nieuwsbericht ‘Herstel van gebroken been is te meten, maar geldt dat ook voor een depressie?’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a news report on measuring outcomes in mental health care, the drop in clinics supplying quality data (230 to 75), and how the Akwa quality alliance will restore data sharing. The State Secretary said quality data sharing is voluntary, that Akwa expects an indicator set in autumn, and that he will encourage providers to share data while the Dutch Data Protection Authority's position is pending.
I think it is important that the mental health sector works on making quality transparent.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de ggz-sector werkt aan het inzichtelijk maken van kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Wiersma over het bericht dat zzp’ers geen schuldhulp krijgen

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about reports that self-employed people (zzp'ers) with debts often do not get municipal debt assistance, and what is causing this. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said the Wgs does not exclude the self-employed but the 2012 explanatory memorandum causes confusion, and promised a Wgs amendment, a 2019 knowledge-sharing initiative, and further information.
I find it worrying that self-employed people with debts still have insufficient access to municipal debt assistance.
Ik vind het zorgwekkend dat zelfstandigen met schulden nog onvoldoende toegang krijgen tot de gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het rapport 'Financiële problemen 2018'

A VVD MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the NIBUD report on financial problems 2018, including why people with serious payment problems do not seek debt assistance, barriers to access, and early detection. The State Secretary answered that the report shows fewer households struggle but problems are more severe, attributed non-use to life events and lack of awareness, and pointed to the Broad Debt Approach, early signalling pilots and a planned amendment of the Municipal Debt Assistance Act.
As far as I am aware, no statistics are available to answer this question.
Voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen statistieken beschikbaar om deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Nederlandse wachtlijst geestelijke hulp telt in totaal 88.500 mensen’

MP De Lange asked the State Secretary for Health about a report that 88,500 people are on mental health waiting lists, the rising waiting times, and why many GGZ providers have not delivered waiting-time data to Vektis. The State Secretary answered that the figure is indicative, that waiting times remain a priority, that the NZa is pursuing enforcement and reminders, and that no provider names were published, while declining to set a new deadline for meeting the Treek norms.
I am not in favour of setting a new deadline, because it is difficult to set a deadline that is both motivating and sufficiently realistic.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het stellen van een nieuwe deadline, omdat het lastig is een deadline te bepalen die zowel stimulerend als voldoende realistisch is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘GGZ Nederland: nieuwe bekostiging acute ggz in 2020’

An MP asked why the new funding model for acute mental health care was postponed to 2020 and what interpretation differences caused this, and what the consequences would be. The State Secretary regretted the delay, explained that the generic module's ambiguities surfaced during contract negotiations, and said the parties agreed on extra capacity and on assessing personnel and budget impacts by 1 June 2019.
After all, it has been agreed that contracting will take place in the spirit of the generic module.
Afgesproken is immers dat in de geest van de generieke module zal worden gecontracteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Veel inzet onbevoegd personeel in zorg’

An MP asks the Minister of Health about a survey by V&VN showing staff shortages, unqualified staff being deployed, and patient safety concerns in care. The minister responds that unqualified staff may perform non-care tasks under conditions, that patient-stop measures signal shortages, that the Action Programme Working in Care and regional plans address the problem, and that safety concerns can be reported to the inspectorate.
It is not known what the precise deployment of unqualified or incompetent staff involved in the situations the respondents referred to, nor what exactly is experienced as a risk to patient safety.

Het is niet bekend wat de precieze inzet van onbevoegd of onbekwaam personeel inhield in de situaties waar de respondenten naar verwezen en wat precies als risico voor de patiëntveiligheid wordt ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het fors toenemend aantal ZZP’ers in de zorg

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about the rapid rise of self-employed (ZZP) workers in care and its effects on quality, continuity and staff workload. The minister answered that quality obligations and inspection apply equally to self-employed workers, and pointed to the workforce action programme and the regulatory-burden programme as responses.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) supervises the quality, safety and accessibility of care and does not distinguish by the type of employment relationship.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) houdt toezicht op de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toegankelijkheid van de zorg en maakt daarbij geen onderscheid naar de aard van het dienstverband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Bij ggz-patiënten klopt de diagnose vaak niet (meer)’

An MP asks the state secretary for health about reports that many psychiatric patients may have wrong diagnoses, following GGNet's re-diagnosis practice, and whether re-diagnosis should be standard and included in agreements. The state secretary welcomes GGNet's initiative, says no national figures exist, notes responsibility for diagnosis lies with providers, and promises the topic will be raised in a working group on triage and diagnostics.
I believe that re-diagnosing people with long-term psychological problems should be included in that, and I will also discuss this with the parties.
