Ik vind dat het opnieuw diagnosticeren van mensen met langdurige psychische problematiek daarin moet worden meegenomen, en zal dit ook met de partijen bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Lange over het bericht ‘het overmaken van de huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties’

Two MPs (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about whether moving debt-burdened tenants to the cheapest social rental housing could reduce housing costs and debt, and what other countries and corporations do. The minister gave rent-burden data, said debt cases require customised municipal solutions with no national data on relocations, and rejected extra consultation as unnecessary since corporations already work to prevent evictions.
The information you requested is not available because debt handling is customised work for which no national figures are kept.
De door u gevraagde informatie is niet beschikbaar omdat de aanpak van de schulden maatwerk is waarvan landelijk geen cijfers worden bijgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Tielen en De Lange over het bericht 'Húsdokter yn oplieding wol graach nei Fryslân, mar mei net'('Huisarts in opleiding wil graag naar Fryslân, maar mag niet')

Three VVD MPs asked why medical faculties restrict GP trainees to stages within their own university region, despite shortages in regions like Friesland, and asked about criteria, overviews and possible talks with HON. Minister Bruins replied that the uniform national allocation procedure already considers shortage regions, that HON is evaluating allowing transfers to shortage areas by Q3 2018, that no study delays were found, and that a LHV-linked study on GP location motives is being set up.
One of the recommendations from that evaluation is to allow transfers to shortage areas under conditions.
Een van de aanbevelingen uit die evaluatie is om overplaatsing naar krimpgebieden onder voorwaarden toe te staan.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden De Lange en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Ramp voor de patiëntjes'

MPs De Lange and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of a shortage of paediatric staff at VUmc, and whether shortages elsewhere and the Werken in de Zorg programme would address them. The minister replied that there is no national shortage of paediatricians, that the shortage concerns paediatric IC nurses, that patients are still treated and planned operations are rerouted to other hospitals, and that longer-term measures and a study on regional imbalances are underway.
To clarify to what extent there are national, regional and local imbalances in the need for and availability of medical specialist functions and their causes, I will commission a study.

Om inzichtelijk te maken in hoeverre er landelijk, regionaal en lokaal sprake is van onevenwichtigheden in de behoefte aan en de beschikbaarheid van medisch specialistische functies en wat daarvan oorzaken zijn, laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Zelfstandige ondernemers met schulden kunnen vaak niet bij hun gemeente terecht’

MPs De Lange and Wiersma asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about reports that self-employed people with debts are often turned away by municipalities, and why municipal practice differs. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance access and quality, that the Wgs does not exclude groups in principle, that the Bbz2004 is a suitable instrument, and that the government will support municipalities with knowledge development and funding.
Municipalities are responsible for access to and the quality of debt assistance for their residents.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de toegang en de kwaliteit van de schuldhulpverlening aan hun inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en De Lange over veiligheidshuizen en het delen van informatie tussen de ketenpartners

Two VVD MPs asked whether safety houses (veiligheidshuizen) lack a legal basis to share information needed for decisions on compulsory care, whether they will create one, and how medical confidentiality and the GDPR affect information sharing. The minister and state secretary answered that partners rely on their own legal bases, the Wvggz from 2020 provides sharing grounds, a bill on joint data processing is coming, and existing guidance and conflict-of-duties rules apply.
Soon the bill on data processing by cooperative partnerships will go into consultation.
Binnenkort gaat het wetsvoorstel gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden in consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en De Lange over het overmaken van de huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties

MPs Koerhuis and De Lange asked about the proposal to pay housing benefit (huurtoeslag) directly to housing corporations, its effect on debt-restructuring tenants, and the size and cost of social rental housing. The minister answered that talks with Aedes and the Tax Administration are ongoing, that direct payment is currently not used, and that outcomes cannot yet be anticipated.
I do not want to anticipate the outcome of those talks.
Op de uitkomst van die gesprekken wil ik niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Helft ggz-aanbieders biedt inzicht in wachttijden’

An MP asked the state secretary why 45% of mental health providers had not yet supplied waiting-time data despite the mandatory NZa requirement, and about the timing of a patient choice website and waiting-list mediation. The state secretary answered that about 70% now deliver data, attributed delays to technical and administrative problems, committed to stepped-up enforcement and an NZa progress report in April, and said the website is expected in Q4 2018.
The NZa has indicated to me that it expects most technical problems to be resolved by the end of March, and that from that point measures will become progressively more individual and more binding.
De NZa heeft mij aangegeven dat zij verwacht dat eind maart de (meeste) technische problemen zijn opgelost en dat vanaf dat moment maatregelen stapsgewijs individueler en dwingender zullen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en De Lange over het onderzoek van Reporter Radio op radio 1 zondag 18 februari 2018 jl.

Two MPs asked the state secretary for health about a radio investigation showing that many mental health providers exceed the waiting time norms, and about regional differences, autism and personality disorder waiting lists, and the 1 July 2018 target. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described the regional taskforce approach and the NZa monitoring, and committed to sending an updated NZa report to parliament in April.
I have no insight into what percentage of the total number of people on waiting lists these specific groups make up.
Ik heb geen inzicht in welk percentage de hierboven genoemde specifieke groepen vormen van het totaal aantal wachtenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Hermans en De Lange over het bericht 'Wachttijden onacceptabel'

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the causes of waiting times across healthcare sectors, whether insurers and providers have agreed to reduce them, and what the NZa can enforce. The minister answered that the NZa has an action plan, that insurers can be sanctioned under their duty of care, and that concrete follow-up such as reports to the House is planned.
Health insurers must make efforts to ensure that their insured persons receive good quality, accessible and timely care.
Zorgverzekeraars moeten zich inspannen om ervoor te zorgen dat hun verzekerden kwalitatief goede, bereikbare en tijdige zorg ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Lange over tekorten aan huisartsen in de regio

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Lange asked the minister about shortages of GPs in regions such as Friesland and Zeeland, monitoring of supply, and measures to address them. The minister replied that there is no national GP shortage, that regions must solve local problems with insurers' help, and that the government will send an action plan in spring 2018.
At present I am not holding consultations with the Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging (LHV) and health insurers specifically to solve the GP shortages in the regions.
Op dit moment voer ik geen overleg met de Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging (LHV) en zorgverzekeraars om specifiek het tekort aan huisartsen in de regio’s op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘UMC blundert met zaad’

MPs De Lange and Rutte asked the Minister of Health about a reported mix-up of sperm cells in ICSI fertility treatment at UMC Utrecht affecting 26 couples, including causes, consequences, resumption of treatment and support for affected parents. The Minister said the incident is being investigated via a SIRE review reported to the Inspectorate, that affected couples were informed and offered paid paternity testing and psychosocial support, and that a broader Inspectorate investigation into patient safety at the hospital is due in March.
I want this to be thoroughly investigated, to ensure it cannot happen again, and for those affected to receive clarity as soon as possible.
Ik wil dat het goed wordt uitgezocht, dat ervoor wordt gezorgd dat het niet meer kan gebeuren en dat mensen die het betreft zo spoedig mogelijk duidelijkheid krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over medische gevolgen van hulptelevisieprogramma’s

An MP asked the health minister about patient experiences in reality-TV dental makeover programmes, including misleading information, and about the duty of care of treating dentists. The minister called it a worrying signal, reaffirmed the duty to inform patients, said the IGZ inspectorate acts on complaints, and noted that its ongoing investigation of one clinic is not linked to the broadcast.
The inspectorate cannot make any statements about the nature of this ongoing investigation.
Over de aard van dit lopende onderzoek kan de inspectie geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en De Lange over het bericht “Amsterdam krijgt ‘Turks’ ziekenhuis”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports of a 'Turkish' hospital in Amsterdam, including its funding, whether it respects equal treatment, patient rights and gender norms, and when the inspectorate will visit. The minister answered that funding is for the hospital to disclose, that patient choice and anti-discrimination rules apply equally, that the hospital holds a WTZi licence and has been sent the inspectorate's questionnaire, and that a visit depends on the information received.
If there are signals that a hospital is not complying with the rules, action will be taken against it.
Indien er signalen zijn dat een ziekenhuis zich niet aan de regels houdt dan zal hier tegen worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over de rapportage ‘Onderzoek naar goed bestuur binnen de Zorggroep Alliade te Heerenveen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the IGZ/NZa report finding an appearance of conflict of interest at Zorggroep Alliade, including its board, supervisory board, the Freya/Support & Co structures, and whether market-conformity could be verified. The State Secretary answered that such conflicts are unacceptable, that the board and supervisory board should have acted earlier, that the directors resigned, and that the IGZ, NZa and Openbaar Ministerie continue monitoring, promising further inspection action.
If in the IGZ's judgement Alliade falls short in this, the IGZ will take further measures.
Indien naar oordeel van de IGZ Alliade hierin tekort schiet, dan zal de IGZ nadere maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over Het niet melden van een medische misser

MPs De Lange and Rutte asked the health minister about a hospital that again did not report a suspected medical error (calamity) in a baby's death, and whether the Inspectorate (IGZ) can adequately review such investigations and should be supported by external expertise or a task force. The minister answered that the hospital has now changed its procedure to report suspected calamities directly to the IGZ, that the IGZ supervises calamity investigations and their quality and parental involvement, and that a mandatory national task force is not considered necessary.

The IGZ assesses the report and asks the hospital itself to investigate calamities, unless the nature of the report or other information about the hospital gives reason for the IGZ to conduct the investigation itself.

De IGZ beoordeelt de melding en vraagt het ziekenhuis zelf calamiteiten te onderzoeken, tenzij de aard van de melding of andere informatie over het betrokken ziekenhuis aanleiding geven dat de IGZ zelf onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Gebrekkig ict-systeem apothekers vormt risico’

An MP asked the minister about reports that outdated ICT and fax-based communication between pharmacists, doctors and hospitals create medication-safety risks, and what is being done about electronic data exchange and patient access to medication records. The minister answered that electronic exchange is incomplete (mainly outside primary care), listed ongoing measures such as revising the medication transfer guideline, an information standard and the pending client-rights bill, and said patients' electronic access rights will be strengthened.
I am of the view that electronic data exchange contributes to the quality of care.
Ik ben van mening dat elektronische gegevensuitwisseling bijdraagt aan de kwaliteit van zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht Europese privacyregels zijn nekslag voor biomedisch onderzoek

An MP asked the Health Minister how the new EU data protection regulation affects Dutch biomedical research, including whether exemptions are possible and whether patients must consent repeatedly. The minister replied that the regulation allows broader consent and specific research derogations, that anonymised data fall outside it, and that a Dutch bill on control over body material is in preparation, without committing to new exemptions for Dutch research.
As I indicated above in answering questions 3 and 8, the regulation contains specific rules on scientific research that ensure researchers are not confronted with unnecessary legal obstacles.

Zoals ik hierboven bij de beantwoording van de vragen 3 en 8 heb aangegeven, bevat de verordening specifieke regels over wetenschappelijk onderzoek die ervoor zorgen dat onderzoekers niet met onnodige juridische belemmeringen worden geconfronteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en De Lange over de tweedeling somatische en psychische spoedzorg

MPs Rutte and De Lange asked the Minister of Health about a claimed divide between somatic and psychiatric emergency care that causes problems for patients with acute mental and physical needs. The Minister said the SiRM report and IGZ research did not identify this divide as a problem, that no registration exists of such cases, and pointed to ongoing sector-wide improvement work, including a coming quality framework.
This is not known; no separate registration is kept of this.
Dit is niet bekend, hiervan wordt geen aparte registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over medische thermografie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a TV report on commercial medical thermography marketed as an alternative to mammography, including whether misleading claims undermine the breast cancer screening programme and whether the Health Inspectorate will investigate. The Minister acknowledged the misleading marketing, stated no provider holds the required screening licence, and said the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation, expected to conclude after the summer, will address it.
The IGZ previously received a report about thermography and the investigation into it is currently ongoing.
De IGZ heeft eerder over thermografie een melding ontvangen en het onderzoek hiernaar loopt op dit moment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over de berichtgeving dat één op de drie artsen het falen van een collega niet meldt

An MP asked the health minister about reports that one in three doctors does not report a colleague's failure, and whether a culture of fear endangers patient safety, and what measures and supervision apply. The minister answered that primary responsibility for preventing and addressing underperformance lies with care institutions, professionals and professional bodies, that the IGZ will push them to act on the IQ Healthcare recommendations, and that a letter on safe reporting will follow.
The primary responsibility for preventing underperformance and responding adequately to signals lies primarily with care institutions, healthcare professionals and professional organisations.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid om disfunctioneren te voorkómen en adequaat te reageren op signalen ligt primair bij de zorginstellingen, de beroepsbeoefenaren en de beroepsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over de berichtgeving van het schending van privacy door Certe

An MP asked the Health Minister about press reports that the laboratory Certe breached patient privacy by sharing medical results with hospitals under an opt-out procedure, and asked about oversight and safeguards. The minister said the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is assessing the case and that oversight is its responsibility, while explaining the legal rules on sharing medical data and pointing to security standards.
I am awaiting the assessment of the AP.
Ik wacht de beoordeling van de AP af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het opvragen van de gegevens van een ggz-patiënt door een zorgverzekeraar

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a health insurer that requested referral letters and diagnoses of mental health patients who had objected to data sharing, and about whether other insurers and the insurer itself would face sanctions and how supervision would work. The minister said the Data Protection Authority found one insurer violated the rules in 2015, which has since stopped, that the DPA can now impose fines, and that the NZa and DPA cooperate on supervision with findings expected in spring 2016.
It is clear that one health insurer did not comply with the rules.
Het is duidelijk dat één zorgverzekeraar zich niet aan de regels heeft gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het slechte onderhoud van Automatische Externe Defibrillatoren (AED’s)

An MP asked the health minister about poor maintenance of AEDs and the IGZ's 2013 action with manufacturers, and about registration in volunteer alert networks. The minister said no national data exist on AED maintenance, described the IGZ's past steps, judged no new manufacturer letter necessary for now, and left registration largely to private parties while considering conditions on a subsidy.
I cannot draw a general conclusion about the state of maintenance of the AEDs present in the Netherlands.
Een algemene conclusie over de stand van het onderhoud van de in Nederland aanwezige AED's kan ik niet trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over Nederlandse patiëntgegevens in Belgische gevangenis

MP De Lange (VVD) asked the Minister of Health about Dutch patient records being handled by Belgian prisoners and records of several hospitals being exposed online. Minister Schippers answered that responsibility lies primarily with the hospitals and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg, that existing rules are sufficient, and that the inspectorate will alert hospitals via letters.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority to judge whether the Personal Data Protection Act was violated in these situations.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om te oordelen of in deze situaties de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) is overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het niet melden van een ernstig incident met een baby in het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC)

MP De Lange (VVD) asked the Minister of Health about a serious incident involving a baby at the AMC that was not promptly reported, and about the AMC's KNO department training climate and patient safety. The Minister answered that the IGZ is investigating the reporting and will send a follow-up letter, while describing the training accreditation decision, improvement measures, and the reporting obligations.

Once the investigation into this event is concluded (expected within a few weeks), I will resume answering the questions in the form of a letter with information on the outcomes of this investigation.

Zodra het onderzoek naar deze gebeurtenis is afgerond (naar verwachting binnen enkele weken), zal ik de beantwoording van de vragen hernemen in de vorm van een brief met informatie over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Rutte over de beperking van transplantaties in het Leids Universitair Medisch Centrum (LUMC) vanwege ruzie onder artsen

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about the temporary restriction of transplantation at LUMC due to a conflict among surgeons and whether patient safety was at risk. The minister answered that the hospital acted adequately, transplants were moved to Rotterdam where needed, no organs were lost, and the hospital's programme is fully running again.
The IGZ will continue to monitor the situation through its regular supervision.
De IGZ blijft de situatie met haar reguliere toezicht volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over de financiering van het kwaliteitsregister in de zorg

An MP asked the Minister of Health about uncertain 2016 funding for quality registries in healthcare and how patient quality information could be made more comparable. The Minister said partners should settle funding within existing DBC/DOT payment, that the Kwaliteitsinstituut could be asked to intervene, and that a transparency programme and a toetsingskader are underway.
I see a role here for the Kwaliteitsinstituut and will, if necessary, ask the Kwaliteitsinstituut to enter into discussions with the parties.
Ik zie hier een rol weggelegd voor het Kwaliteitsinstituut en zal het Kwaliteitsinstituut zo nodig verzoeken met partijen in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over mogelijk falen van GGZ crisisdienst in Gilze en Rijen

MP De Lange asked the Minister of Health whether the GGZ crisis service in Gilze en Rijen failed during an incident involving an asylum seeker, and whether the findings and measures to prevent recurrence would be shared with parliament. The minister said an internal review by GGZ Breburg identified information-exchange issues with the police, that local parties will agree improvements, and that the national task force on confused persons will only be involved if the problem proves broader.
It is up to local parties themselves to find solutions to the points of attention that have been identified.
Antwoord 3 Het is aan lokale partijen zelf om oplossingen te vinden voor de aandachtspunten die zijn gesignaleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over fatale gevolgen na het missen van diagnoses

An MP asks the Minister of Health about repeated missed diagnoses in IJsselland Hospital's cardiology department that led to young patients dying, and about the hospital's measures, patient information, and referral rules for under-16s. The Minister expresses regret, describes the measures taken and IGZ oversight, and says the cases are situational without signs of structural problems, leaving referral norms to professional societies.
What has happened is situational in nature and therefore tied to the IJsselland hospital.
Wat zich heeft voorgedaan is situationeel van aard en daarmee gebonden aan het IJsselland ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en De Lange over transparantie bij zorginstellingen

MPs Bouwmeester and De Lange asked why only 4 of 188 large healthcare institutions disclosed board expenses and declarations, whether the sector coordinated refusals to RTL Nieuws, and what role supervisory boards should play. Minister Schippers regretted the lack of openness, said good governance is the responsibility of private care providers, and pointed to a sector-led governance code revision on 25 November rather than government measures.
I am convinced, as indicated in the good governance agenda, that the necessary cultural change is best achieved through discussion within the sector itself.
Ik ben er van overtuigd, zoals in de agenda goed bestuur is aangegeven, dat de benodigde cultuurverandering het beste tot stand komt door discussie in de sector zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het informeren van familie bij erfelijke aanleg voor kanker

An MP asked the Minister of Health about whether relatives at risk from the BRCA1 gene mutation are being informed, and whether active cascade screening should replace the current passive approach that places responsibility on the index patient. The minister said the professional guideline puts primary responsibility on the patient, that the professional body will tighten and monitor compliance, but that there is no general legal duty to inform relatives and no plan for new legal change.
I have no insight into this.
Ik heb hier geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het ontstaan voor onveilige situatie voor een patiënt door het niet adequaat reageren van hulpdiensten op een vraag om acute hulp

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether emergency services' inadequate response to a request for urgent help, leaving a 75-year-old stroke patient without assistance, would be investigated and reported on, and how often such failures occur. The minister declined to investigate the individual case itself, said the Inspectorate might examine it, and described existing triage protocols and quality programmes.
It is not for me to investigate an individual case like this.
Het is niet aan mij om een individuele casus als deze te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over reanimatie en gebruik van AED’s (Automatische Externe Defibrillator)

An MP asked the health minister about public knowledge of resuscitation and the locations of AEDs in the Netherlands, citing a Red Cross survey. The minister answered that civil resuscitation is a societal responsibility supplementing professional care, referred to existing Red Cross and Heart Foundation initiatives and an app, and committed to action only where the government must step in.
If there are bottlenecks that the government must resolve, I am of course prepared to do so.
Mochten er knelpunten zijn die de overheid moet oplossen, dan ben ik daar natuurlijk toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over gezondheidsrisico’s die kunnen optreden als gevolg van aderlating of ‘wet cupping therapie’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about health risks of bloodletting and 'wet cupping' therapy, including infection and hepatitis transmission, and whether practitioners may legally make incisions. The minister agreed the practice falls under the BIG Act as a reserved medical act, said the IGZ supervises it with fines and criminal enforcement available, and committed to asking the IGZ and Education Inspectorate to visit a training institute, though she gave no figures on practitioners and did not commit to new rules.
I will ask the IGZ and the Education Inspectorate whether they are willing to visit this training institute.
Ik zal de IGZ en de Onderwijsinspectie vragen of zij dit opleidingsinstituut willen gaan bezoeken.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid De Lange over falende hartapparatuur bij de ambulancedienst Gelderland-Zuid

MP De Lange asked the health minister about reported failures of cardiac monitoring equipment at the Gelderland-Zuid ambulance service, including incident counts, similar cases elsewhere, and resolution timelines. The minister confirmed internal reports were made and the inspectorate is handling them, declined to discuss specifics while the inspectorate's review is ongoing, and said responsibility lies with the provider and manufacturer.
At this moment the IGZ is handling the report on this case. It is not possible to address this question substantively while the report is being handled.
Op dit moment behandelt de IGZ de melding over deze casuïstiek. Het is niet mogelijk inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze vraag gedurende de behandeling van de melding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over schadelijke stoffen in veel gekleurde tatoeage-inkten

MP De Lange (VVD) asked the Minister of Health about harmful substances found in many coloured tattoo inks, the NVWA's enforcement record and fines, and whether the industry and the 'Think before you ink' campaign will be engaged. The Minister answered that harmful substances should not be in inks, that fines are 525 euro with a 50% recidive surcharge, that she does not plan to raise fine levels, and that she will consult the NVWA and the tattoo industry on related points.
I do not intend to raise these fine amounts.
Ik ben niet voornemens deze boetebedragen te verhogen.

m: Motie-Van Bochove c.s. over de afspraken over de staatkundige toekomst van de Nederlandse Antillen
Motion asking the government not to depart from the agreements on the constitutional future of the Netherlands Antilles without first consulting the Chamber.
requests the government not to depart from the agreements on the constitutional future of the Netherlands Antilles unless it has first consulted the Chamber
verzoekt de regering om niet van de afspraken over de staatkundige toekomst van de Nederlandse Antillen af te wijken dan na vooraf de Kamer te hebben geconsulteerd
Amendement van het lid Schinkelshoek c.s. betreffende een voorhangbepaling i.v.m. modernisering instellingsovereenkomst Beneluxparlement
Would delay the royal decree bringing the Benelux treaty into force until four weeks after the draft is submitted to both chambers, giving parliament a waiting period.
The proposal for the royal decree is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.
De voordracht voor het koninklijk besluit bedoeld in het eerste lid wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overlegd.
Motie Anker c.s. over de parlementaire hoffelijkheidstroffee
Asks the Presidium to take charge of the parliamentary courtesy trophy and its regulations and oversee its annual award.
requests the Presidium to take charge of the parliamentary courtesy trophee and its regulations
verzoekt het Presidium zich te ontfermen over de parlementaire hoffelijkheidstrofee en het bijbehorend reglement
Motie Schinnkelshoek over rijksbrede maatregelen om externe inhuur door ministeries te verminderen
Motion asks the government to adopt cross-government measures forcing ministries to justify external hiring and to use budget ceilings for external staff.
requests the government to take government-wide measures enabling ministries to better reduce external hiring
verzoekt de regering rijksbreed maatregelen te treffen die ministeries beter in staat stellen externe inhuur te verminderen
Motie van het lid Schinkelshoek c.s. over experimenteerregio's in en om Limburg
Asks the government to work with German and Belgian authorities toward experimental cross-border regions in Limburg and to report progress to the Chamber.
requests the government: 1. in consultation with German and Belgian authorities, step by step working toward experimental regions in and around Limburg
verzoekt de regering: 1. in overleg met Duitse en Belgische overheden stap voor stap op weg naar het drielandenoverleg toe werken naar experimenteerregio’s in en om Limburg
Motie Schinkelshoek over de taken van het op te richten Nationaal Instituut voor de Rechten van de Mens
Asks the government to examine whether the tasks of a planned National Human Rights Institute can be placed in existing institutions instead of a new body.
explicitly to examine whether the named tasks, advice, oversight, international cooperation, research, education, information and training, can be placed with existing institutions

uitdrukkelijk te onderzoeken of de benoemde taken – advisering, toezicht, internationale samenwerking, onderzoek, onderwijs, voorlichting en training – ondergebracht kunnen worden bij bestaande instellingen
qa: Vragen van de leden Schinkelshoek en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over geluidsoverlast door het Kerkgen

MPs Schinkelshoek and Ferrier asked whether a noise dispute over Salvation Army gatherings in Zutphen, a site with religious use since 1856, should weigh in the assessment, and how the government would safeguard religious freedom and engage churches. The minister replied that the matter is for the courts given a pending interim ruling, that the Wet geluidhinder contains no church-specific requirements, and pointed to information on the Activiteitenbesluit, declining to go into the case further.
The cabinet therefore does not go further into the content of the interim ruling.
Het kabinet gaat derhalve niet nader in op de inhoud van de voorlopige uitspraak.

m: Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen c.s. over onderzoek naar "minder leiding en meer collega's" bij de politie
Asks the government to investigate how to reduce the number of management and policy positions in the police to free funds for frontline officers.
requests the government to investigate how the number of management positions and policymakers in the police can be reduced
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe het aantal managementposities en beleidsmakers bij de politie verkleind kan worden
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen c.s. over het behouden van oudere politieagenten
Asks the government to study how older police officers' experience can be kept for operational colleagues, for example through business offices within the national police.
requests the government to investigate how the experience and valuable knowledge of older police officers can be retained
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe de ervaring en waardevolle kennis van oudere politieagenten behouden kan blijven
Motie van het lid Hiddema over uitvoering van de motie over voorarrest voor criminele asielzoekers
Asks the government to ensure the Public Prosecution Service actually makes greater use of pretrial detention for asylum seekers who commit offences.
calls on the government to actually carry out the motion by urging the Public Prosecution Service to make more use of the said possibilities
roept de regering op de motie alsnog daadwerkelijk uit te voeren, door het Openbaar Ministerie aan te sporen meer gebruik te maken van de genoemde mogelijkheden
Motie van het lid Hiddema over staken van de verdere sluiting van politiebureaus in landelijke gebieden
Asks the government to halt further closures of police stations in rural areas and investigate reopening closed ones.
calls on the government to stop the further closure of police stations in rural areas
roept de regering op de verdere sluiting van politiebureaus in landelijke gebieden te staken
Motie van de leden Hiddema en Bisschop over geen honorarium voor advocaten die rechtens zinloze asielprocedures voeren
Asks the government to instruct the Legal Aid Board to stop paying lawyers for asylum procedures it judges legally hopeless.
no longer provide fees to lawyers for asylum procedures that, in the Board's view, are legally pointless
geen honorarium meer te verstrekken aan advocaten inzake door hen, naar het oordeel van Raad, rechtens zinloos gevoerde asielprocedures
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen c.s. over een onderzoek naar betaling voor politie-inzet
Motion asking the government to investigate making organisers of large sports events and commercial events pay for police deployment.
requests the government to investigate the possibility of having organisers of large-scale sports matches and events pay for police deployment
verzoekt de regering, de mogelijkheid te onderzoeken om organisatoren van grootschalige sportwedstrijden en evenementen te laten betalen voor politie-inzet
Motie van het lid Van Helvert c.s. over gebruikmaken van rijksbreed beschikbaar gestelde middelen voor klimaatdoelen
Motion asks the government to make Defence use nationally available funds for climate goals, such as the Operational Energy Strategy.
requests the government to have Defence explicitly connect to and use nationally available funds for realising climate goals
verzoekt de regering, Defensie nadrukkelijk aan te laten sluiten bij en gebruik te laten maken van rijksbreed beschikbaar gestelde middelen voor het realiseren van klimaatdoelen
Motie van het lid Van Wijngaarden c.s. over evidencebased programma's die recidive helpen verminderen
Asks the government to survey which evidence-based programmes reducing recidivism could be offered in prisons, with partners, and report to the House.
requests the government, in consultation with probation services, prison directors, prison staff, the Public Prosecution Service and other field partners, to survey which evidence-based programmes

verzoekt de regering, in overleg met Reclassering Nederland, gevangenisdirecteuren, gevangenispersoneel, het Openbaar Ministerie en andere veldpartijen te inventariseren welke evidencebased programma's
Motie van het lid Hiddema over bewerkstelligen dat de imam met toepassing van artikel 127 Wet RO strafrechtelijk zal worden vervolgd
Asks the minister to ensure the imam is prosecuted under article 127 of the Criminal Code despite the prosecutor's decision not to prosecute.
requests the Minister to ensure that imam Fawaz Jneid will be criminally prosecuted under article 127 of the Judicial Organisation Act
verzoekt de Minister, te bewerkstelligen dat imam Fawaz Jneid met toepassing van artikel 127 Wet RO strafrechtelijk zal worden vervolgd
Motie van het lid Hiddema over de invoering van het legaliteitsbeginsel
Asks for research, for example by the WODC, into whether introducing the legality principle would speed up justice, encourage victims to report crimes and relieve the appeal courts.
requests the government to have research done, for example by the WODC, into the extent to which introducing the legality principle can contribute to faster justice
verzoekt de regering, te doen onderzoeken, door bijvoorbeeld het WODC, in hoeverre de invoering van het legaliteitsbeginsel kan bijdragen aan een snellere rechtspleging
Motie van het lid Hiddema over verdubbelen van de strafmaat voor haatzaaien
Asks the government to drop its plan to double the maximum prison sentence for hate speech (art. 137d Sr) from one to two years.
requests the government to refrain from the proposed doubling of the penalty under 137d
verzoekt de regering, de voorgestelde verdubbeling van de strafmaat bij 137d achterwege te laten
Motie van het lid Van Oosten c.s. over geen verjaring van straffen
Asks the government to propose abolishing the statute of limitations for executing criminal sentences, so convicted persons cannot escape punishment through lapse of time.
to put an end to the statute of limitations on execution of sentences under article 76 of the Criminal Code
een einde te maken aan de executieverjaring uit artikel 76 Wetboek van Strafrecht
Motie van het lid Hiddema over ontzegging van de rijbevoegdheid aan criminele leden van motorcyclegangs
Asks the government to propose legislation letting judges impose driving bans as an additional sentence on gang members convicted of certain crimes.
requests the government, within six months, to come with a proposal enabling judges to impose a conviction-based sentence
verzoekt de regering, binnen zes maanden met een voorstel te komen dat rechters in staat stelt bij een veroordelend vonnis
Motie van het lid Bisschop c.s. over de wettelijk gegarandeerde wijkagenten
Asks the government to ensure municipalities actually receive the legally guaranteed number of neighbourhood police officers and to report to the Chamber on enforcement.
requests the government to ensure municipalities actually have the legally guaranteed neighbourhood officers and to inform the Chamber by 1 April 2018 how the legal norm is enforced.

verzoekt de regering, ervoor zorg te dragen dat gemeenten in de praktijk ook werkelijk in ieder geval de beschikking hebben over de wettelijk gegarandeerde wijkagenten en de Kamer voor 1 april 2018 te berichten op welke wijze de wettelijke norm wordt gehandhaafd
Motie van het lid Hiddema over het aanzetten tot gewelddadig optreden strafbaar stellen
Asks the government to propose narrowing article 137d of the Criminal Code so that only incitement to violence against persons or property on grounds such as race is punishable.
only incitement to violent action against persons or property on account of race, et cetera is made punishable
louter het aanzetten tot gewelddadig optreden tegen persoon of goed van mensen wegens hun ras, et cetera wordt strafbaar gesteld
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over de herijking van de relatie met Suriname

Two FvD MPs asked the foreign minister about the reset of relations with Suriname: current stance on the new government, conditions on aid, financial support and IMF/IDB debt talks, business opportunities, COVID aid and medical staff, diaspora role, and institution-building. The government answered in general terms, pointing to a prior letter, stating that aid carries risk-based conditionality and that Nederland may withhold aid, declining any precedent for a state guarantee, and committing to a business forum and a second aid package still being defined.
With every form of aid the Netherlands provides, risks are weighed, donor conditionalities are set and mitigating measures are taken where there is reason to do so.
Bij iedere vorm van hulp die Nederland levert worden risico’s meegewogen en donorconditionaliteiten gesteld alsook eventuele mitigerende maatregelen genomen indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over de subsidiering van zogenaamd ‘antiracisme’

The MP asked how many organisations receive subsidies from national, provincial and municipal government to combat (alleged) racism, the amounts, and detailed information per recipient. The minister answered that the requested per-organisation information is not available, pointing to the municipal anti-discrimination facilities funded at 6 million euro per year and the College voor de rechten van de mens budget of 7.01 million euro, and apologised for the late reply.
It is not possible to answer this question in its entirety, because the requested information is not available.
Het is niet mogelijk om deze vraag in zijn geheel te beantwoorden, omdat de gevraagde informatie niet voorhanden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het controleren van de Nederlandse grenzen inzake de coronacrisis

Two MPs from FvD asked the Health and Justice ministers how Dutch border controls operate during the COVID-19 crisis, including checks on arrivals, flight bans, and border checks with Germany and Belgium. The government answered that policy aims to control COVID-19 maximally, that travellers from high-risk countries must quarantine for 14 days, that border checks are sample-based and arrival numbers are not tracked, and that no land-border controls or travel bans are currently needed.
Insight into the number of persons travelling from abroad to the Netherlands cannot be provided.
Inzicht in het aantal personen dat vanuit het buitenland naar Nederland reist, is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over een terugkeerder uit Somalië

Two MPs from FvD asked the Justice Minister about a terror suspect returned from Oman to the Netherlands, including how he was brought back, what charges apply, and how the risk he poses will be managed. The minister refused to discuss case details because of the ongoing criminal case, but explained the general policy on controlled return, prosecution, and possible citizenship withdrawal.
Because of the ongoing criminal case against this person, I cannot go into the details of this specific case.
In verband met de lopend strafzaak naar deze persoon kan ik niet ingaan op de details van deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het gehanteerde beleid met betrekking tot het testen op COVID-19 (corona) besmettingen

Two FvD MPs asked the health minister about COVID-19 testing policy, including who is tested, testing capacity, lysis buffer supply, and imports. The minister answered that testing is restricted due to global shortages, that about 2000 tests run daily across 35 labs, and that a special COVID-19 envoy and taskforce will coordinate production and distribution.
At present, approximately 2000 COVID-19 tests are carried out daily in the Netherlands.
Op dit moment worden dagelijks ongeveer 2000 COVID-2019 tests uitgevoerd in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het diversiteitsbeleid bij de politie

MPs Baudet and Hiddema asked the Justice Minister about police diversity policy, including how diversity is defined and measured, recruitment targets, and a Muslim slaughter-offering meat sale. The Minister defends diversity as necessary for police legitimacy, explains the 25% recruitment target and CBS measurements, and largely answers on substance while declining to provide breakdowns by religion or ethnicity citing lack of legal basis.
There is no legal basis for linking personnel data to cultural background.
Er is geen wettelijke grondslag om personeelsgegevens te koppelen aan culturele achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over mogelijke betutteling in de rechtspraak na de verwijdering van het schilderij uit de rechtbank Almelo

An FvD MP asked whether the removal of the painting 'Regelrecht' from the Almelo court reception hall reflected puritanical overreaction that undermines public trust in judicial impartiality, and asked the minister to press for its return. The minister replied that building arrangements are the judiciary's responsibility, that the court board must decide on the complaints, and that the minister sees no threat to judicial independence in the decision.
The arrangement of a court building is a responsibility of the judiciary.
De inrichting van een gerechtsgebouw is een verantwoordelijkheid van de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over het aandeel van de asieladvocatuur binnen de gefinancierde rechtshulp

An FvD MP asked how much publicly funded legal aid goes to asylum and immigration procedures, what lawyers are paid in those cases, and whether lawyers in hopeless asylum cases could be denied legal-aid payment via court ruling. The minister answered that data for 2000-2001 are unavailable, pointed to a table for the budget figures, and declined to investigate court-based denial of lawyers' income, citing the ongoing asylum procedure review.
Figures for the years 2000 and 2001 are not available, because this was not separately registered in the Justice budget.
De cijfers voor de jaren 2000 en 2001 zijn niet beschikbaar, omdat dit niet apart geregistreerd werd in de Justitiebegroting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hiddema en Baudet over het bericht 'extreemlinkse activisten blijven meestal onbestraft'

Two MPs from FvD asked the Justice Minister whether left-wing extremist activists enjoy de facto impunity, as suggested by a WODC report, and what the government will do about it. The minister disagreed with that conclusion, citing difficulties of proof and that in three of seven cases the suspect was convicted, and said extremism of any kind is prosecuted case by case.
Where extremist conduct constitutes a criminal offence, the Public Prosecution Service will investigate as far as possible and assess whether to prosecute.

Wanneer er sprake is van extremistische gedragingen die een strafbaar feit opleveren, zal het OM voor zover mogelijk onderzoek instellen en beoordelen of tot strafrechtelijke vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over verwarde personen

An FvD MP asked the Justice Minister how police define 'confused persons', whether the May 2018 Hague stabbing was terrorism, and why police incident figures on confused persons rose sharply while GGZ figures did not. The minister answered that police cannot determine confusion, that the Schakelteam definition is used, that causes of the rise are unclear, and that the term 'verward' is increasingly inflated.
Whether someone is actually confused cannot be determined by the police.
Of iemand daadwerkelijk verward is kan niet door de politie worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het financiële fiasco rondom het Haagse Institute for Global Justice (IGJ)

MPs Baudet and Hiddema asked about the financial collapse of the Hague Institute for Global Justice (IGJ), its government subsidies, the oversight failures of its supervisory board chair Dick Benschop, and whether his nomination as Schiphol CEO should be suspended. The government answered that the subsidy was properly spent on the basis of accountability documents, that the Rijk is not liable for debts, that IGJ was declared bankrupt, and that it sees no reason for an investigation or to suspend Benschop's appointment.
Based on the accountability documents, there are no indications that the subsidy was not spent in accordance with its purpose and conditions.
Op basis van de verantwoordingsdocumenten zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de subsidie niet conform het doel waarvoor en de voorwaarden waaronder deze verleend is, is besteed.

m: Motie Klijnsma en Van der Werf over de cultuurkaart
Asks the government to contribute one-off six million euros to the cultuurkaart, conditional on CJP raising the rest of the costs.
to honour this cultural entrepreneurship by contributing a one-off six million euros
om dit culturele ondernemerschap te honoreren door eenmalig zes ton bij te dragen
Motie Van der Werf en Klijnsma over het borgen van belangwekkend cultuurgoed
Asks the government to safeguard cultural heritage of institutes closing due to budget cuts, using their own reserves if needed.
requests the government to carefully safeguard the cultural heritage of the named institutions
verzoekt de regering, het cultuurgoed van genoemde instellingen zorgvuldig te borgen
Motie Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink c.s. over mensen met een auditieve beperking
Asks the government to pay attention to people with hearing impairments when improving selection criteria for assistive devices and to inform the Chamber.
requests the government to pay attention to people with hearing impairments when improving the selection criteria and to inform the Chamber about this
verzoekt de regering aandacht te hebben voor mensen met een auditieve beperking bij het verbeteren van de selectiecriteria en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie Klijnsma en Voortman over coulanceregeling
Asks the government to create a hardship (coulance) scheme for chronically ill and disabled people hit by income-dependent care allowance rules.
requests the government to create a hardship scheme for chronically ill and disabled people
verzoekt de regering om een coulanceregeling in het leven te roepen voor chronisch zieke en gehandicapte mensen
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over overleg over beleidsvoornemens
Asks the government to consult the named patient and disability organisations on planned policy changes to the Wtcg and the TOG/Cer merger, and to inform the House of the outcomes.
requests the government to consult these organisations on the announced policy intentions and to inform the House of the outcomes of this consultation
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met deze organisaties over de aangekondigde beleidsvoornemens en de Kamer te informeren over de uitkomsten van dit overleg
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over het inkomensafhankelijk maken van de Wtcg
Asks the government to postpone by one year making the Wtcg income-dependent so that decisions on its future can be taken together.
requests the government to postpone by one year making the WTCG income-dependent
verzoekt de regering, het inkomensafhankelijk maken van de WTCG een jaar uit te stellen
Amendement van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Klijnsma over het naar boven bijstellen van de inkomensgrens
Raises the income ceiling for the WTCG allowance for chronically ill and disabled people so that more people with modest incomes qualify.
The original limit excludes too large a group from receiving an allowance.
De oorspronkelijke grens sluit een te grote groep uit van het krijgen van een tegemoetkoming.
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over collecties van bedreigde instellingen
Asks the government to inform the House promptly about what will happen to collections and archives of museums and cultural institutions threatened by budget cuts.
requests the government to promptly inform the House about what will happen to the collections and archives of institutions threatened with closure
verzoekt de regering om de Kamer spoedig te informeren over wat er met de verschillende collecties en archieven van met voortbestaan bedreigde instellingen zal gebeuren
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over kunsttijdschriften
Asks the government not to exclude art magazines in advance from applying for support from the cultural funds.
requests the government not to exclude art magazines in advance from the possibility of applying to the funds
verzoekt de regering kunsttijdschriften niet bij voorbaat uit te zonderen van de mogelijkheid een beroep te doen op de fondsen
Motie Klijnsma en Jasper van Dijk over het Jeugdcultuurfonds
Asks the government, with other funders, to ensure the Jeugdcultuurfonds can continue its activities with adequate financing in the coming years.
requests the government, in close consultation with other funders, to ensure that the Jeugdcultuurfonds
verzoekt de regering om er in nauwe samenspraak met andere kostendragers zorg voor te dragen dat het Jeugdcultuurfonds
Asks the government to ensure at least one dance and one theatre production house remain in existence.
requests the government to ensure that at least one production house for dance remains
verzoekt de regering om er zorg voor te dragen dat er op zijn minst één productiehuis voor de dans
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over postacademische kunstopleidingen
Asks the government to tell institutions before the new year how many funded places each post-academic art course will keep.
requests the government to make clear to the institutions before the turn of the year how many funded places
verzoekt de regering om nog voor de jaarwisseling aan de instellingen duidelijk te maken hoeveel gefinancierde plekken
Motie Peters c.s. over het budget voor frictiekosten
Asks the government to assess applications for the frictiekosten scheme on necessity and reasonableness rather than budget, and not to take extra funds from the culture budget.
requests the government to assess applications from institutions eligible for this scheme on the basis of necessity and reasonableness
verzoekt de regering aanvragen van instellingen die in aanmerking komen voor deze regeling op basis van noodzaak en redelijkheid te beoordelen
Motie Jasper van Dijk c.s. over de btw-verhoging
Asks the government to reverse the VAT increase on culture because the Geefwet has been hollowed out.
requests the government to reverse the VAT increase now that the Geefwet proves to be an empty shell
verzoekt de regering de btw-verhoging ongedaan te maken nu de Geefwet een lege huls blijkt te zijn
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over de Cultuurkaart
Asks the government to support the CJP plan for the Cultuurkaart culture card for young people, including a convenant and transition funding.
requests the government to support this action plan where possible
verzoekt de regering om waar mogelijk dit plan van aanpak te ondersteunen
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over jong publiek
Asks the government to study how to bring young people into contact with the arts and to consider youth reach when setting subsidy criteria.
requests the government to investigate how young people can be better brought into contact with the arts
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken op welke manier jongeren beter in contact kunnen worden gebracht met de kunsten
Motie Jasper van Dijk c.s. over livemuziek in kleinschalige horeca
Asks the government to consult the VNG about easing policy on live music in small-scale hospitality venues.
requests the government to consult with the VNG on easing policy regarding live music in small-scale hospitality venues
verzoekt de regering in overleg te gaan met de VNG over een versoepeling van het beleid ten aanzien van livemuziek in kleinschalige horecazaken
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over het museum Orientalis
Asks the government to consult the Orientalis museum about possible one-off support for its growing independence.
requests the government to consult with museum Orientalis about possible one-off support
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met museum Orientalis over een mogelijke eenmalige ondersteuning
Motie Klijnsma en Peters over een mobiliteitscentrum
Asks the government to help set up a mobility centre for potentially unemployed workers in the culture sector.
requests the government to help set up a mobility centre for potential unemployed in the culture sector
verzoekt de regering om een mobiliteitscentrum te helpen inrichten voor potentiële werklozen in de cultuursector
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over kunst en cultuur
Motion asking the government to exempt art and culture from any additional budget cuts.
requests the government to exclude art and culture from any additional budget cut plans
verzoekt de regering om kunst en cultuur bij eventuele aanvullende bezuinigingsplannen buiten schot te laten
Motie Van der Werf en Klijnsma over technische noodzaak als verdelingscriterium
Asks the government to make technical necessity a distribution criterion for Brim subsidy allocation.
requests the government to include technical necessity as a distribution criterion in the subsidy allocation
verzoekt de regering technische noodzaak als verdelingscriterium op te nemen bij de subsidieverdeling
Motie Klijnsma over hanteren van dezelfde maximumsubsidie voor de categorie "overige monumenten"
Motion asking the government to apply the same maximum subsidy to other monuments (windmills, castles, country estates) as to churches under the Brim 2012 scheme.
requests the government to apply the same maximum subsidy for the category other monuments as for churches
verzoekt de regering voor de categorie «overige monumenten» dezelfde maximumsubsidie te hanteren als voor de categorie «kerken»
Asks the government to create a coulance scheme for chronically ill and disabled people with extra costs who fail the WTCG allowance, to be run by the independent BAC commission.
also requests the government to assign the independent Objection and Advisory Committee (BAC) with implementing this coulance scheme

verzoekt de regering tevens om de onafhankelijke Bezwaar- en Adviescommissie (BAC) die in het leven is geroepen naar aanleiding van de motie-Klein Breteler met de uitvoering van deze coulanceregeling te belasten

Asks the government to use the Linschoten report insights this year to give a benefit (tegemoetkoming) to groups such as blind, hearing-impaired and rare-disease patients who are not reached by the WTCG scheme.
requests the government to use this year the insight gained from the Linschoten report and to provide the groups identified in the report with a compensation this year
verzoekt de regering om nog dit jaar het inzicht dat verkregen is op basis van het rapport-Linschoten te benutten en de in het rapport aangewezen groepen dit jaar van een tegemoetkoming te voorzien
Motie-Klijnsma c.s. over het besluit over de toekomst van de WTCG
Asks the government to keep at least the current budget for the WTCG allowance for chronically ill and disabled people when deciding its future.
to keep at least this budget available for compensation for chronically ill and disabled people
ten minste dit budget beschikbaar te houden voor tegemoetkoming aan chronisch zieke en gehandicapte mensen
Motie-Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink c.s. over een keuzemogelijkheid om het bedrag niet te ontvangen
Asks that the WTCG allowance decision include an option for recipients to decline the payment, with unclaimed sums invested in a fund for chronically ill and disabled people.
requests the government to include in the WTCG general allowance decision a paragraph giving the option not to receive the amount
verzoekt de regering in de beschikking algemene tegemoetkoming WTCG een alinea op te nemen met daarin een keuzemogelijkheid om het bedrag niet te ontvangen
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over het nieuwe stelsel in laten gaan in 2014
Asks the government to keep the original timetable and start the new cultural subsidy system in 2014 despite budget cuts.
requests the government to hold to the original planning.
verzoekt de regering vast te houden aan de oorspronkelijke planning
Asks the government to replace first-come-first-served subsidy allocation for monument renovation with assessment on content.
requests the government to arrive at a fair and adequate allocation system
verzoekt de regering om te komen tot een eerlijke en adequate verdelingssystematiek
Amendement van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Klijnsma over de mogelijkheid tot het ambshalve aanwijzen van woonschepenmonumenten als beschermd monument
Lets the minister designate houseboats as protected monuments ex officio, in addition to immovable monuments, widening ministerial discretion.
the Minister of OCW can, besides immovable monuments, also designate houseboat monuments ex officio as protected monuments
de Minister van OCenW naast onroerende monumenten ook woonschepenmonumenten ambtshalve als beschermd monument kan aanwijzen
Motie Klijnsma over verbouwen van monumenten tot woningen
Asks the government to ensure housing associations remain able to convert monuments into homes as services of general economic interest.
requests the government to ensure housing associations remain, for converting monuments into homes, among services of general economic interest
verzoekt de regering ervoor zorg te dragen dat corporaties voor het omvormen van monumenten tot woningen blijven behoren tot diensten van algemeen economisch belang
Motie Klijnsma en Jasper van Dijk over een meldingsplicht
Asks the government to require municipalities to set up a service point with a duty for owners of monuments to report their building or renovation plans.
requests the government to require municipalities to set up a service moment with a reporting duty
verzoekt de regering om gemeenten voor te schrijven een servicemoment met meldingsplicht in te richten
Motie Jasper van Dijk c.s. over voortbestaan bibliotheken
Asks the government to consult the VNG so that libraries are spared as much as possible from local budget cuts.
requests the government to consult the VNG with the aim that libraries are spared as much as possible from the cuts
verzoekt de regering in overleg te gaan met de VNG met als inzet dat bibliotheken zo veel mogelijk worden ontzien bij de bezuinigingen
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over afschaffen WWik
Asks the government to investigate the net revenue of abolishing the WWik and inform the House before 1 February 2011, while the motion is about the abolition of an arts-worker benefit scheme.
requests the government to investigate what the net yield is of the measure to abolish the WWik
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken wat de netto-opbrengst is van de maatregel tot afschaffen van de WWik
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over de btw-verhoging
Asks the government to abandon the planned VAT increase on art for the 2011 budget year.
requests the government to still refrain from the VAT increase for budget year 2011
verzoekt de regering alsnog af te zien van de btw-verhoging voor het begrotingsjaar 2011
Motie Sap c.s. over artistieke kwaliteit
Asks the government to keep artistic quality as the decisive criterion in designing the new basic cultural infrastructure.
Requests the government to keep artistic quality the decisive criterion.
verzoekt de regering artistieke kwaliteit het doorslaggevende criterium te laten blijven
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over bezuinigingen cultuur
Motion asks the government to involve all cultural sectors when making cultural budget cuts.
requests the government, when making its cultural cuts, to involve all cultural sectors
verzoekt de regering bij zijn bezuinigingen op cultuur alle cultuursectoren te betrekken
Asks the government to promote the Leerorkest music initiative so that other municipalities and neighbourhoods can follow it.
requests the government to promote the Leerorkest initiative so that it is followed in other municipalities and neighbourhoods in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering het initiatief van het Leerorkest uit te dragen zodat dit navolging krijgt in andere gemeenten en wijken in Nederland
Asks the government to give historic country estates the same 2011 subsidies as in 2010 and to study a new subsidy system.
requests the government to provide the same subsidies to historic country estates in 2011 as in 2010
verzoekt de regering in 2011 dezelfde subsidies te verstrekken aan historische buitenplaatsen als in 2010
Motie Klijnsma c.s. over afschaffen cultuurkaart
Asks the government to reconsider abolishing the youth culture card from 1 January 2012 and to propose an alternative.
requests the government to reconsider the abolition of the Cultuurkaart from 1 January 2012
verzoekt de regering de afschaffing van de Cultuurkaart per 1 januari 2012 te heroverwegen
qa: Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Hamer over de vermogenstoetsen bij de zorgtoeslag en het kindgebonden budget in geval van een letselschade-uitkering

MPs Klijnsma and Hamer asked whether the new asset tests for healthcare allowance and child-related budget would penalise people receiving personal injury compensation, and whether the rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that affected cases are mainly settlements paid as lump sums, that private-law solutions should be sought first, and that a limited, temporary compensation scheme will be considered for cases where the impact is disproportionate.
I am willing to introduce a compensatory scheme for cases where this turns out disproportionately hard.
Ik ben bereid voor gevallen waar dit onevenredig hard uitpakt een tegemoetkomende regeling te treffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Klijnsma over het kopen van cliënten door thuiszorgorganisaties

MPs Wolbert and Klijnsma asked the minister about home-care organisations paying hospitals for referrals, whether the NZa's investigation was broad enough, and the conflicts of interest of hospital-linked or payroll-linked transfer nurses. The minister answered that the NZa has issued directions to four hospitals, that the market works as intended, that the NZa is investigating further, and that the payroll arrangement is undesirable but no specific study is planned.
They invoiced home-care institutions for referring clients to them, although this was not permitted.
Zij hebben gedeclareerd aan thuiszorginstellingen voor het naar hen doorverwijzen van cliënten terwijl dit niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Wolbert over overbelasting van mantelzorgers

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for health about reports (Mezzo survey) that many family carers in nursing homes feel obliged to perform care tasks and are overburdened, and asked for action on communication between carers and professionals. The state secretary called family involvement voluntary and valuable, placed the survey's small sample in perspective, promised talks with stakeholders and reporting on the 2012 carers letter in spring 2013.
I intend to sit down together with Mezzo, the Expertise Centre Informal Care and the training institutions to consider how informal care can better come onto the professional's radar.
Ik ben van plan om samen met Mezzo, het Expertisecentrum Mantelzorg en «de opleidingen» om de tafel te gaan zitten om te bezien hoe mantelzorg beter op het netvlies van de professional kan komen.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Timmermans over naheffing door de Duitse fiscus aan Nederlandse oud-dwangarbeiders

Two PvdA MPs asked why elderly Dutch former forced labourers received back-tax demands from the German tax authority on their German state pensions despite a stated exemption, and asked for clear Dutch-language guidance and relief. The state secretary answered that an exemption exists but requires formal recognition as 'Verfolgte', that Germany agreed to a bilateral arrangement for those who can show their pension stems from forced labour, and that Dutch-language information is available and being sent with tax forms.
He then promised to resolve this problem efficiently and without bureaucracy by also granting exemption, within bilateral consultation, to forced labourers who formally fall outside the exemption.
Hij heeft mij toen toegezegd deze problematiek op efficiënte en onbureaucratische wijze te willen oplossen door in het kader van bilateraal overleg ook vrijstelling te verlenen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Wolbert over de extreem hoge inkomens van bestuurders in de zorg

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether it is acceptable that 41 elderly-care executives earn well above the Balkenende norm, and whether the government will enforce the Wolbert motion capping sector pay. The state secretary pointed to the forthcoming Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) and said the BBZ pay code has been actively promoted, with a stricter norm to apply when the WNT takes effect.
This proposal is now under consideration in the Senate.
Dit voorstel ligt inmiddels ter behandeling in de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klijnsma over cultuureducatie op basisscholen

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary about arts education in primary schools, including the Raad voor Cultuur advice, support for schools via the Cultuurkaart and Jeugdcultuurfonds, and keeping the Cultuurkaart going as requested by a motion. The state secretary promised a policy response this autumn and a letter before Prinsjesdag, while noting the existing programme Cultuureducatie met Kwaliteit.
I aim to send your House a policy response to the advice of the Education Council and the Council for Culture this autumn.
Ik streef ernaar om dit najaar een beleidsreactie op het advies van de Onderwijsraad en de Raad voor Cultuur naar uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma over het “Europees jaar voor Actief ouder worden en Solidariteit tussen de generatie 2012”

An MP asks about the Dutch response to the European Year for Active Ageing 2012, including whether an integrated older-people policy is needed, the aims, budget and coordination with other EU states. The state secretary answers that the SCP shows improving conditions for older people, that departments coordinate their own policy areas, that the year focuses on employment and participation with a EUR 4 million offensive and no dedicated national programme budget, and that experiences are shared with other member states.
Unlike previous European Years, no budget has been made available to member states for implementing a national programme for the 2012 European Year.
In tegenstelling tot eerdere Europese Jaren is er voor het Europees Jaar 2012 aan de lidstaten geen budget voor de uitvoering van een nationaal programma beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klijnsma over de aanpak van fraude met parkeerkaarten voor gehandicapten

An MP asked the Interior Minister about fraud with disabled parking permits, the low uptake of the national registration system by municipalities, and how to encourage wider use. The minister said national registration would help enforcement, reported 22 municipalities registering and 46 more organising the transition, and aimed for all municipalities to join by end 2013 without a binding deadline.
I have therefore financially supported the development of the national registration.
Ik heb daarom de ontwikkeling van de landelijke registratie financieel gesteund.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Klijnsma over het bericht dat toegankelijkheid van stations zeer te wensen overlaat

MPs Monasch and Klijnsma asked the minister about a TV report that station accessibility for people with disabilities is poor, including whether assistance is available at only about 110 of 386 stations and how far in advance it must be booked. The minister responded that the government aims for self-reliant accessibility by 2015 for visually and auditorily impaired people and faster for motor-impaired people, and committed to reducing the advance booking window in the 2015-2024 rail concession.
Within the concession for the main rail network 2015-2024, I will make agreements with NS on improving assistance provision.
In het kader van de concessie voor het hoofdrailnet 2015–2024 ga ik met NS afspraken maken over het verbeteren van assistentieverlening.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma over patiënten- en gehandicaptenorganisaties (pgo’s) die meerdere ziekten vertegenwoordigen

MP Klijnsma asks whether the new subsidy rules for patient and disability organisations representing several conditions penalise cooperation, since such organisations may see funding drop sharply, and proposes a per-condition voucher adjustment. Minister Schippers defends the one-subsidy-per-condition policy as encouraging cooperation, rejects the per-condition voucher change as undermining the cooperation it aims for, and promises to review the framework for organisations that have already merged this spring.
At the upcoming update of the policy framework this spring, I will examine whether I can accommodate these organisations within the system and principles of the scheme.
Ik zal bij de komende actualisering van het beleidskader dit voorjaar bezien of ik deze organisaties tegemoet kan komen binnen de systematiek en uitgangspunten van de regeling.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het schrappen van het gratis parkeren voor gehandicapten (ingezonden 22 de

An MP asks the government whether free parking for disabled permit holders on regular spaces should be kept, given fraud and inconsistent municipal policy, and whether a uniform national rule is needed. The minister says municipalities decide parking policy autonomously, points to a national registration database and a letter urging clear communication to permit holders, and does not commit to a uniform rule.
In Dutch municipalities, a municipal parking policy of their own applies.
In Nederlandse gemeenten geldt een eigen gemeentelijk parkeerbeleid.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat het aantal diefstallen bij ouderen schrikbarend is (ingezonde

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about a report that theft against elderly care-home residents is alarmingly high, asking whether the figures are representative, whether care homes have adequate policy, and what role police and neighbourhood officers play. The state secretary said the government strongly condemns such theft, expects care boards to protect residents, cannot verify the figures because the prosecution service does not record victim age or residence, and that police handle this case by case.
The Public Prosecution Service does not differentiate by age and residence of theft victims in its registration system.
Het Openbaar Ministerie differentieert in zijn registratiesysteem niet naar de leeftijd en de verblijfplaats van slachtoffers van diefstal.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volkgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over gelden voor pgo’s die meerdere ziekten vertegenwoordigen (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the government's plan to cut patient and disability organisation (pgo) funding from 43 to 25 million euro, and a new per-condition subsidy system, will hurt organisations covering multiple rare diseases and encourage splitting into smaller bodies. The minister acknowledges some organisations will be hit harder, defends the rule of at most one subsidised organisation per condition, and explains safeguards against splitting, while stating that organisations like VKS can still qualify for subsidy, especially if they cooperate.
I realise that some patient and disability organisations will be hit harder by this new system than they would have been by a generic cut.
Ik realiseer me dat sommige patiënten- en gehandicaptenorganisaties door deze nieuwe systematiek zwaarder getroffen worden, dan bij een generieke korting het geval zou zijn geweest.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Ministerie niet blij met donorapp» (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

Rep. Klijnsma asks whether the minister is developing a mobile-phone donor-registration app like the one described in a news report, and whether the initiators' expertise should be used. The minister says a government app linked to the Donor Register via DigiD is being developed, since separate apps or paper cards risk unfindable donor wishes, and that expertise lies mainly with the Donor Register itself.
In addition, the Donor Register is indeed working on a mobile application for those who wish to use it.
In aanvulling daarop wordt door het Donorregister inderdaad gewerkt aan een mobiele applicatie, voor diegenen die daar gebruik van willen maken.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over hulp bij zelfdoding aan huis (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP from the Labour party asked the health minister how she views ambulant teams and a clinic helping people with a death wish to die at home, including dementia and psychiatric patients, and whether she had consulted the initiators. The minister said the physician-patient relationship should remain the main channel, that complex cases need extra expertise, and that she met the NVVE in January without concrete outcomes.
In my view, it is most desirable that a request for end of life and the process of examining this request take place within the existing doctor-patient relationship.
Het is mijns inziens het meest wenselijk dat een verzoek om levensbeëindiging en het proces om dit verzoek te onderzoeken, plaatsvindt binnen de bestaande arts-patiëntrelatie.
Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de omzet en de rol van poppodia (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary about a report that pop venues had fewer visitors but higher revenue, and whether higher ticket prices hurt accessibility, quality and jobs. The secretary said he cannot judge accessibility from this information, that programming is the venues' own responsibility, and that job losses are not known because venues are mainly funded by municipalities.
