Because pop venues in the Netherlands are generally subsidised by municipalities and not by the central government, these figures are not known to my ministry.
Omdat poppodia in Nederland over het algemeen gesubsidieerd worden door gemeenten en niet door de rijksoverheid, zijn deze cijfers niet bekend bij mijn ministerie.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de effecten van de nieuwe criteria van het Fonds Podiumkunsten op muziekensembles (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the new Fonds Podiumkunsten criteria make the closure of music ensembles unavoidable and whether he agrees this is unacceptable. The secretary answers that closure is not unavoidable, that ensembles remain eligible for multi-year and project funding, and that 5.8 million euro is reserved for multi-year music activities.
There is no question that the new rules of the Fonds Podiumkunsten make the dissolution of the music ensembles unavoidable.
Er is geen sprake van dat door de nieuwe regels van het Fonds Podiumkunsten de opheffing van de muziekensembles onontkoombaar is.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de nieuwe systematiek voor subsidieverlening van het Fonds Podiumkunsten (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about the new subsidy system of the Performing Arts Fund, including expected cuts to cultural supply, the criteria, and effects on specific companies such as the Internationaal Danstheater and Orkater. The secretary answers that demand will exceed the budget, that the fund's criteria fit government policy, and that individual institutions must decide how to adapt, without predicting specific effects.
How much cultural supply will disappear depends on so many factors that it cannot be predicted.
Hoeveel cultureel aanbod er zal verdwijnen, hangt van zoveel factoren af, dat dit niet te voorspellen is.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de verdiencapaciteit van musea (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether museums such as Meermanno and Boerhaave, which have raised private funds, can continue given earlier doubts, and whether a letter should clarify if that income is structural or one-off before the committee meeting. The secretary confirmed awareness of the report, declined to prejudge the funding decision, and refused to send a letter before the formal subsidy application and advisory process are completed.
No, I do not want to disrupt the careful procedure of subsidy application and assessment.
Nee, ik wil de zorgvuldige procedure van subsidieaanvraag en beoordeling niet doorkruisen.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het te snel ter sprake brengen van orgaandonatie (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

MP Klijnsma asks the health minister about reports that doctors raise organ donation with families before brain death is confirmed, and how Dutch practice compares with Spain and other countries. Minister Schippers answers that families must be informed about the purpose of brain-death tests, that raising donation early sometimes loses donation chances, and that staff training and the organisation of donation in hospitals will be improved, with a letter promised later this year.
I will inform you later this year about how I intend to improve the organisation of organ donation in Dutch hospitals.
Ik informeer u later dit jaar over de manier waarop ik de organisatie van orgaandonatie in de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen wil verbeteren.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de voorgenomen verkoop van rijksmonumenten (ingezonden 31

An MP asks the state secretary whether the government plans to sell listed national monuments, which current users would be affected, and whether the monuments should stay in public ownership. The state secretary confirms a study into transferring museum buildings to the museums, says the study covers all museum housing, and argues other owners can also maintain monuments.
On the policy regarding monuments in state ownership more broadly, including the possibilities for disposal, you will receive a letter shortly.
Over het beleid ten aanzien van monumenten in rijksbezit in bredere zin, inclusief de mogelijkheden tot vervreemding ontvangt u binnenkort een brief.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de brief van de directeur-generaal Cultuur en Media gericht aan culturele instellingen van 16 september jl. (ingezonden

An MP asks the state secretary whether institutions in the basic cultural infrastructure may redirect their 2009-2012 subsidy to phased wind-down without parliamentary discussion, whether the four-week request window is correct, and whether subnational governments were consulted before the planned termination from 2013. The secretary confirms the letter and time window, says the wind-down option was already announced to parliament in June, and states that consultation with other governments took place and that a frictional costs policy rule will precede the decisions.
Before 1 November, your House will receive the policy rule on frictional costs.
Voor 1 november ontvangt uw Kamer de beleidsregel frictiekosten.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over tegenvallende kaartverkoop door de btw-verhoging in de cultuursector (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

Labour MP Klijnsma asked the State Secretaries of Education, Culture and Science and of Finance whether the VAT increase on performing arts tickets, which coincided with falling ticket sales, was counterproductive and should be reversed. The Finance State Secretary answered that a price rise can reduce demand, that it is too early to judge the full effect, that the government sees no reason to reverse the decision, and that developments will be monitored.
The cabinet sees no reason to reverse the decision, which was reached with the approval of a majority of your House.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de besluitvorming, die met instemming van een meerderheid van uw Kamer tot stand is gekomen, terug te draaien.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de verkoop van een Dumas door museumgoudA (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Gouda museum's sale of a Dumas painting was approved by the municipal council, who bought it, and whether museum budget cuts force such sales. The state secretary answered that the college of mayor and aldermen gave permission, the buyer is unknown, and he expects museums to develop creative plans rather than rely on subsidies.
The college has given MuseumgoudA permission to sell the Dumas painting, The Schoolboys.
Het college heeft MuseumgoudA toestemming gegeven het schilderij van Dumas, The Schoolboys, te verkopen.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het budget voor de uitvoering van de Wet tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken en gehandicapten (Wtcg) wordt gehalve

An MP asked the health minister whether the budget for the Wtcg compensation scheme for chronically ill and disabled people would be halved, what the purchasing-power effects would be, and whether the scheme would be kept after tax deduction limits were cut. The minister declined to answer the budget questions before Prinsjesdag and only acknowledged the background.
The Cabinet wants to keep to the agreement to announce the budget measures on Prinsjesdag.
Het Kabinet wil zich houden aan de afspraak om met Prinsjesdag de begrotingsmaatregelen bekend te maken.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over euthanasie (ingezonden 4 juli 2011).

MP Klijnsma asked the health minister about variation among doctors in handling euthanasia requests, including dementia cases, the refusal of a request by patient B., an estimated 40% of serious requests allegedly not taken seriously, and whether a legal referral duty should be introduced. The minister answered that doctors' knowledge of the Euthanasia Act is insufficient, that the KNMG is working on improvements and dialogue with the NVVE is planned, that no complaints desk will be set up, and that non-granted requests and referrals will be included in the ongoing evaluation of the Act, while arguing a statutory referral duty is not the real solution.
I do not intend to set up a complaints desk, but I will consult with the KNMG and the NVVE to discuss this issue.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een meldpunt in te stellen, wel zal ik in overleg gaan met de KNMG en de NVVE om deze problematiek te bespreken.
Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over levensloopbestendig bouwen (ingezonden 28 juli 2011).

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Delft 'Wel Thuis' project on age-appropriate housing, the expected demand for such homes, the digital step-by-step guide's continuity after 2011, and national stimulation of lifetime-suitable building. The Minister welcomed the local project, quantified demand at about 40,000 extra suitable homes per year, said continuity of the guide is a local responsibility, and pointed to an extended support programme until end 2011.
I regard the digital step-by-step plan and the model home as good examples.
Het digitale stappenplan en de modelwoning zie ik als goede voorbeelden.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de terugkeer van de Tienertoer (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

Labour MP Klijnsma asked the transport and education ministers about the return of the Tienertoer rail discount for youth and whether the trial could inform the future of the Cultuurkaart. The minister welcomed the CJP/NS trial, said the cabinet supports cultural participation through private initiative, and noted the government subsidy for the Cultuurkaart will be cut, with the cabinet open to private or civil-society continuation.
If there are societal and/or private initiatives to continue the Cultuurkaart and/or the Tienertoer in the future, the cabinet is positive about that.
Als er maatschappelijke en/of particuliere initiatieven zijn om de Cultuurkaart en/of de Tienertoer in de toekomst voort te zetten, dan staat het kabinet daar positief tegenover.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het succes van de pilot masterplan orgaandonatie Regio Noord-Nederland (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the results of the North Netherlands organ donation pilot, including the number of donation procedures in early 2011 and the rise in family consent rates, and whether the pilot should be rolled out nationally. The minister views the early signals as hopeful but will draw conclusions only after the evaluation, expected late 2011, and promises a plan of action by letter this summer.
I consider these hopeful signals, but I will only draw conclusions about the effect of this pilot once the evaluation has been completed.
Ik vind dat hoopgevende signalen, maar conclusies over het effect van deze pilot trek ik pas als de evaluatie daarvan is afgerond.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma (PvdA), Leijten (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Wiegman-van Meppelen Schepping (ChristenUnie) en Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van

MPs from several parties asked the health minister why a second cochlear implant for young deaf children is not reimbursed, and whether the evidence supports it, including costs and the CVZ's pending reassessment. The minister said the CVZ must judge the added benefit, that the research in Nijmegen is uncertain, and that she is open to temporary admission or conditional financing to generate evidence, as the motion requested.
It is for the College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) to answer that question within the context of its role as package manager.
Het is aan het College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) om die vraag te beantwoorden binnen de context van zijn rol als pakketbeheerder.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over int

MPs Klijnsma and Marcouch ask how intersex people can obtain legal recognition of their sex and whether a sex-change operation should be required. The government answers that sex can be corrected in the birth register via court order under article 1:24 BW without surgery, and that the sterilisation requirement for transgender people will be dropped in a forthcoming bill.
The requirement of a sex-change operation is not relevant in that regard.
Het vereiste van een geslachtsveranderende operatie is daarbij niet aan de orde.

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ratificatie van het VN-verdrag voor de rechten van mensen met een beperking (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

Labour MP Klijnsma asked the state secretary whether she was aware of a national manifestation in Utrecht on the UN disability rights convention and whether the Netherlands will ratify it and when. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the working conference and referred both questions to a forthcoming letter to the committee on the ratification process.
I will go into this further in my reply letter to the VWS Committee
Ik ga hier nader op in in mijn antwoordbrief aan de Commissie van VWS

Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over dreigende bezuinigingen op alle vormen van gesubsidieerde arbeid bi

An MP asked the ministers whether cuts to subsidised work (WIW and ID-banen) would threaten opening hours, security and possible closure of museums and cultural institutions, and how many people such jobs involve. The government said it has no figures by sector, that cuts to these jobs are a municipal responsibility, and that institutions must anticipate municipal measures.
The cabinet does not have information on how many people in subsidised work are employed in museums, theatres and other cultural institutions.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie hoeveel mensen op basis van gesubsidieerde arbeid werkzaam zijn binnen musea, theaters en andere culturele instellingen.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kwetsbare ouderen (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

MPs Recourt and Klijnsma asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about financial abuse of vulnerable elderly people, notaries' duty to check testamentary capacity, and whether the Dutch professional protocol on capacity should be made binding. The state secretary said no figures are available on the scale of abuse, considered the protocol sufficient while acknowledging that capacity defects are hard to detect, and saw no added guarantee in formalising it given existing disciplinary and civil consequences.
Formalising the protocol in itself offers no additional guarantee of careful treatment by the notary.
Het formaliseren van het protocol biedt op zich geen extra waarborg voor een zorgvuldige behandeling door de notaris.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het ontbreken van de Friese taal en cultuur in de adviesaanvraag voor cultuurbeleid (ingezonden 14 fe

MPs Klijnsma and Jacobi asked why the government's advisory request to the Council for Culture omitted Frisian language and culture, and whether it would add them. The state secretary replied that the request asks for an integral advice covering all sectors, that Frisian is protected through a new language law and a bestuursafspraak, and that he is willing to consult the province of Fryslân instead of adding it to the request.
However, I am willing to consult with the province of Fryslân, for example through the consultation with the northern region.
Ik ben echter bereid om met de provincie Fryslân overleg te voeren, bijvoorbeeld via het overleg met landsdeel Noord.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het dubbel raken van Nederlandse studentenorkesten in bezuinigingen (ingezonden 4 februari 2011

MPs Jadnanansing and Klijnsma asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science how student orchestras are hit twice by cultural cuts and the long-term student rule, and whether the government will scrutinise the cumulative effects. The state secretary acknowledged the signal but called it premature, said the long-study rule applies to all students and does not harm excellent students, and promised proposals in June that will consider knock-on effects.
I have committed to the House to come with further proposals in June as a follow-up to the principles for cultural policy I formulated on 6 December 2010.
Ik heb de Kamer toegezegd in juni met nadere voorstellen te komen als vervolg op de uitgangspunten voor het te voeren cultuurbeleid

Vragen van de leden Arib en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht over euthanasie bij baby's die niet gemeld wordt (ingezonden 7 februari 2011).

MPs Arib and Klijnsma ask the health minister whether euthanasia of babies is under-reported because doctors disagree on unbearable and hopeless suffering, and how many cases are reported, and whether a uniform guideline or palliative sedation priority is needed. The minister answers that the reporting commission cites several causes for under-reporting, that doctors must decide individually, and that the medical profession itself should build consensus and lead on guidelines.
Ultimately it remains up to the individual doctor to assess, within his professional framework, the unbearableness and hopelessness of a newborn's suffering.
Uiteindelijk blijft het aan de individuele arts om met zijn professionele beoordelingskader de ondraaglijkheid enuitzichtloosheid van het lijden van een pasgeborene te beoordelen.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gebrek aan orgaandonoren (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the shortage of organ donors, Belgian versus Dutch donor rates, improving donation conversations with relatives, the role of hospital donation officials under the Organ Donation Act, and physician training. The minister said donor rates are about 13 per million in the Netherlands, that hospital protocols and officials are largely in place but need better training, and that the government will review a successful NTS project and report in its progress letter.
As indicated in the progress letter, I will examine together with the NTS whether and how the successful approach from the project can be broadly implemented.
Zoals aangegeven in de stand van zakenbrief zal ik samen met de NTS bekijken of en hoe de succesvolle aanpak uit het project breed kan worden geïmplementeerd.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Bezuinigingen cultuur raken vooral kinderen» (ingezonden 1 november 2010 2010).

An MP asked the minister about press reports that cultural budget cuts would threaten small theatres, music schools and libraries, and about the effects on libraries. The state secretary answered that municipal budgets are the source of the cuts, that library funding is a municipal responsibility, and that a survey found 93% of public libraries face cuts, with a broader cultural policy letter promised for December.
The announced municipal cuts to local library work are the result of municipal policy.
De aangekondigde gemeentelijke bezuinigingen op het lokale bibliotheekwerk zijn het resultaat van gemeentelijk beleid.
Vragen van het lid Klijnsma (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het mogelijk uitstellen van de bouw van het nationaal historisch museum (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

MP Klijnsma asked whether the National Historical Museum's building project is delayed by budget cuts, whether its director's fear of too little money for activities is justified, and whether a temporary location could help. The state secretary confirmed that culture must contribute to cuts, stopped the building subsidy in favour of a 2011 project subsidy for activities, and declined to commit to a temporary location.
I have decided no longer to subsidise the NHM for realising a building, as I informed you by letter.
Ik heb besloten het NHM niet langer te subsidiëren voor het realiseren van een gebouw, zoals ik u per brief heb laten weten.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Justitie over het verstrekken van

MPs Heijnen and Klijnsma asked whether municipalities can issue an international marriage certificate to same-sex couples, why not, and whether national rules will be changed. The minister replied that the ICBS model extract cannot yet be used for same-sex marriages, that an amended model is expected in 2011, and that interim options exist, including a uniform model developed by the NVvB.
That no international extract can currently be issued for same-sex marriages based on the Vienna Convention does not mean that it would not be possible to accommodate the citizens concerned.

Dat er op dit moment nog geen internationaal uittreksel kan worden afgegeven voor huwelijken tussen personen van gelijk geslacht dat gebaseerd is op de Overeenkomst van Wenen, betekent niet dat het niet mogelijk zou zijn om burgers in kwestie tegemoet te komen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over werken zonder loon door het UWV en verdringing van reguliere arbeidsplaatsen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about UWV-linked unpaid work trajectories, including a case where night porters at Fletcher Hotels were replaced by people in training placements at Reco-Security, and whether this displaces regular jobs. The minister answered that UWV does not test displacement for trial placements and orientation days, that the Reco-Security case concerns training internships with no unpaid workers via UWV, and that UWV has been asked to investigate compliance with the WW training rules and handles complaints centrally.

Following these questions from your House, I have asked the UWV to conduct further research into whether the trajectories of the named training institute comply with the rules applying to training during unemployment benefit.

Ik heb naar aanleiding van deze vragen van uw Kamer aan het UWV gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen of bij trajecten van het genoemde opleidingsinstituut is voldaan aan de regels die gelden voor scholing tijdens de WW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Volp over de website www.werkenmetwajong.nl.

MPs Kerstens and Volp asked the State Secretary about the website werkenmetwajong.nl, which promotes side jobs, including in sex work, to Wajong beneficiaries and gives an impression of official government information, including links to UWV and the national government. The State Secretary said the site is not a government site, the national government's link was removed on request, UWV was asked to inform staff, and the operator was asked to stop targeting Wajongers but declined.
I have therefore asked UWV to actively inform its internal staff who deal with Wajongers about this.
Ik heb daarom UWV verzocht om intern UWV medewerkers die te maken hebben met Wajongers hierover actief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "het Manifest Schuldvrij! en incassobureaus die te snel naar de rechter stappen"

An SP MP asked the government about the Schuldvrij! manifesto, the overuse of court debt collection by collection agencies, government fines and surcharges, and the Zweeds-style single-collector model. The Staatssecretaris answered that the government shares the concern and will pursue a broad debt approach, committing to a debt collection register, a 2018 review and an information letter in spring 2018, but largely restated existing policy and deferred several points.
The cabinet will get to work on elaborating the debt collection register announced in the coalition agreement.
Het kabinet gaat aan de slag met de uitwerking van het in het regeerakkoord aangekondigde incassoregister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat een schuldeiser een rekening niet volledig mag plukken

The MP asks whether creditors may empty bank accounts leaving no living allowance, whether a statutory rule for bank seizure is coming, and what is done about creditor and bailiff practice. The state secretary agrees a legal rule is needed, says a broader revision of seizure law is planned for consultation in 2018, and promises talks with the bailiffs' body and a Ministry of Finance study on a proactive living allowance.
I agree with the National Ombudsman that a statutory rule must come to prevent bank seizure from circumventing the rules on the protected minimum for wages or benefits.

Ik ben het met de Nationale ombudsman eens dat er een wettelijke regeling moet komen om te voorkomen dat de regeling inzake beslagvrije voet bij loon of uitkering door een bankbeslag wordt doorkruist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Incassobureaus kopen schulden op om ze daarna met harde hand te innen’

An MP asked the government about reports that debt collectors buy debts and collect them aggressively, whether a debt-collection register and a ban on debt resale would help, and whether a Swedish-style royal collection agency is a solution. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the register will be developed with the sector in early 2018, saw no reason for a ban on resale, and said the Swedish model would not prevent debt resale but elements may be examined.
At this moment I see no reason for a ban on the resale of debts.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding voor een verbod op doorverkoop van schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het afsluiten van drinkwater

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether disconnecting a single mother and her three children from drinking water in Hoorn is acceptable, how often households were disconnected for water, gas and electricity, and what the government will do to prevent disconnections of vulnerable households and children. The minister acknowledged that disconnection is serious and must be avoided, announced a planned revision of the water disconnection regulation requiring a minimum water supply for four days, and otherwise defended the existing policy, declining to change the rules, to investigate the convenant, or to treat minors as vulnerable consumers.
I therefore see no reason to carry out the research you requested.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om het door u gevraagde onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdringing, werken zonder loon en de plaspas in Den Bosch

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about displacement of regular work, unpaid work and toilet-pass practices at Weener XL in Den Bosch, citing a Volkskrant article and a local party dossier. The government answered that the municipality is responsible, that no SW-indicated persons were dismissed, that the Inspectorate has no role in supervising individual municipalities, and that the municipality reports sanitary access is guaranteed.
It is not the task of the Inspectorate SZW to supervise individual municipalities regarding unfair competition.
Het is geen taak van de Inspectie SZW om toezicht te houden op individuele gemeenten inzake concurrentievervalsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over statushouders die klem komen te zitten tussen Participatiewet en de Wet inburgering 2013

An SP MP asked the minister about refugees (statushouders) being squeezed between the Participatiewet and the integration law, citing a KIS study, long workdays at a reintegration firm in Amstelveen, and whether municipalities are violating the spirit of the law. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible, that the matter is for the municipal council to supervise, that individual cases fall to municipalities, and committed to general cooperation agreements with VNG but no new national action.
First and foremost, it is for the municipal council to supervise the executive board.
Het is allereerst aan de gemeenteraad om het college te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het UWV gaat slecht om met 35-minners’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV gives poor support to people assessed as less than 35% disabled, including whether they should receive job-search guidance and access to the no-risk policy. The minister answered that such people can receive support via other benefits or municipalities, that UWV provides tailored guidance without extending it to all 35-minners, and that further policy changes are left to a new cabinet.
I will not ask UWV to offer guidance to all 35-minners.
Ik ga UWV niet vragen aan alle 35-minners begeleiding aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het uitsluiten van zelfstandigen van schuldhulp door gemeenten

MP Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether municipalities exclude self-employed people from debt assistance, and asked for figures on liquidated businesses, success rates, debts, benefit dependence and costs. The State Secretary denied the picture could be confirmed, noted that most data is not recorded, and said he expects municipalities to provide appropriate services and is willing to discuss the matter with them.
Data on this point are lacking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Jasper van Dijk over over het bericht dat zelfstandigen door gemeenten van schuldhulp worden uitgesloten

MPs Hijink and Van Dijk asked whether municipalities exclude self-employed people from debt relief and whether this forces them to stop their businesses. The State Secretary answered that such exclusion is not allowed, that individual assessment is required, that the Bbz scheme is an alternative for some, and that she will raise the issue with the VNG.
Municipalities may not apply exclusion grounds within debt relief.
Gemeenten mogen geen uitsluitinggronden in het kader van de schuldhulpverlening hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over 'Werken bij de Wajong loont niet'

An SP MP asked why working on a Wajong or WAO benefit often does not pay, why Wajong recipients can keep far less of extra earnings than social assistance recipients, and whether the allowance could be raised. The Secretary of State answered that earnings rules differ by regime, that changing the Wajong earnings allowance requires legislation left to a future cabinet, that the Participatiewet experiment raises the allowance to 50 percent up to 199 euros, and that WAO recipients are protected from losing rights after five years.
Changing the earnings-supplement system requires legislation. I am leaving the decision on this to a future cabinet.
Voor het aanpassen van de loonaanvullingsystematiek is wetgeving nodig. Ik laat de besluitvorming hierover aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over sociale minima die er op achteruit gaan en dat veel meer Nederlanders in armoede leven dan we denken

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs and the Finance Minister why social minimum recipients fall behind, why homeless and indebted people are missing from poverty statistics, and whether CBS/SCP poverty measures are up to date. The government replies that CBS and SCP methods cannot fully capture homeless and indebted groups, that data updates are planned, and that a koopkracht package of 450 million euro protects benefit recipients in 2018.
The Cabinet has therefore taken measures to restore purchasing power for these groups.
Het Kabinet heeft daarom maatregelen genomen om de koopkracht voor deze groepen te repareren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Een op de drie bijstandsgerechtigden ontvangt psychische zorg’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether municipalities and UWV have enough expertise to recognise and help people with psychological problems on benefits, and about the EUR 3.5 million for GGZ-UWV-municipality cooperation. The State Secretary answered that cooperation is being stimulated through regional plans and that a follow-up study on care use among benefit recipients may be repeated, but she gave no figures on post-2015 trends and no evidence on the link with strict enforcement.
I want to examine whether the same or comparable research can be repeated, so that developments in the years in which the Participation Act is in force also become visible.
Ik wil nagaan of eenzelfde of vergelijkbaar onderzoek kan worden herhaald, zodat ook de ontwikkelingen in de jaren waarin de Participatiewet van kracht is zichtbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘problemen met de Participatiewet’

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary about an Inspectorate report finding that many municipalities find parts of the Participatiewet unworkable, and about the severity of benefit sanctions, including full 100% benefit cuts. The State Secretary responded that municipalities should use their discretion and tailor sanctions, that about half of examined cases involved a full cut mostly for one month, and that the findings will be discussed with the VNG.
Implementation of the Participatiewet has been decentralised to the mayors and aldermen (colleges of B&W).
De uitvoering van de Participatiewet is gedecentraliseerd naar de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders.

MPs Kerstens and Volp asked the State Secretary whether the website werkenmetwajong.nl misleadingly suggests it is an official government site, claims activities are arranged with the benefits agency, and risks steering vulnerable Wajong beneficiaries toward sex work. The questions were declared lapsed (vervallen), so no substantive answer was given.
The questions below are to be regarded as lapsed.
Onderstaande vragen dienen als vervallen te worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het rapport 'Eerder stoppen met werken voor zware beroepen'

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the state secretary about an EIB report proposing early retirement for heavy occupations, including the definition of such jobs, a 15-year work requirement, a cost estimate of 120 million euro, comparison with other EU states, and whether it is fair that low-educated workers with shorter life expectancy may retire earlier. The state secretary responded that the report does not find a workable definition or financing solution, that the cost depends on design, that education is not a suitable criterion and the AOW is a universal scheme, and that other countries use diverse sectoral arrangements.
Unfortunately I must conclude that with this report the 'egg of Columbus' has also not yet been found for this file.
Helaas moet ik concluderen dat met dit rapport ook het «ei van Columbus» nog niet is gevonden op dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het artikel 'Helaas, geen nieuw huis dankzij BKR'

SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether small debts or payment arrears leading to a negative BKR credit registration, and the BKR's handling of proportionality requests, deletion, retention periods, fees and transparency, are fair and whether the state should intervene. The Minister answered that the BKR is a private foundation, that a negative registration does not itself bar credit, that deletions are possible under proportionality rules, and that he expects a more pragmatic BKR approach by year-end while promising free access to personal data from May 2018 and publication of dispute rulings.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Leijten over het bericht 'Elke maand honderden euro’s minder pensioen door Belastingdienst'

SP MPs asked why about 61,000 pensioners living in the Netherlands would lose hundreds of euros net per month under the new Dutch-German tax treaty, whether earlier assurances that seniors would not be affected were correct, and whether those affected were adequately informed. The state secretary answered that the 2013 income calculations, based on 2012 figures, may no longer reflect the situation given later tax changes, that the €15,000 threshold is intentional to reduce administrative burdens, that no change to the treaty is planned, and that affected residents were informed through the 2016 tax return and online channels.
It is therefore quite possible that the situation of these pensioners differs from what could be inferred from the income calculations made at the time.
Het is daarom goed mogelijk dat de situatie van deze gepensioneerden anders is dan uit de destijds gemaakte inkomensberekeningen kon worden opgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kooiman over ‘de toename van het aantal dakloze jongeren’

MPs Van Dijk and Kooiman asked why homeless young people rose from 8,000 to 12,000 in 2016, and whether the cost-sharing norm, psychiatric cuts, briefadres access and benefit rules contribute. The government acknowledges the rise, points to a pending Federatie Opvang report and a research project, defers responsibility to municipalities, and largely declines to commit to new legislative change.
Municipalities are responsible for tackling this target group and for making good policy to prevent people from becoming homeless.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de aanpak van deze doelgroep en het maken van goed beleid om te voorkomen dat mensen dakloos raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar inzake het bericht 'studenten weg vanwege collegegeldschuld'

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked about reports that students drop out over tuition debt, and about a proposal to pay benefits directly to institutions, and whether the government would collect national figures and change DUO's administration. The Minister rejected direct tuition payments to institutions for now, citing administrative costs, pointed to hogeschool coaching and municipal debt relief, and promised to await a research project before deciding.
Institutions are not obliged to report this information and I therefore do not have national total figures.
Instellingen zijn niet verplicht deze informatie te rapporteren en ik beschik derhalve niet over landelijke totaalcijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de groei van het aantal mensen met problematische schulden

MPs asked the government about the growth in households with problematic debts, including residents of holiday parks, why most are not reached by debt assistance, the difficulty of obtaining a postal address, and whether government creditors impose excessive costs. The government says it is taking steps such as funding debt assistance, reforming enforcement costs and the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet), and promises to improve access but commits to few concrete new measures.
Creditors, both government creditors and private creditors, must behave properly.
Schuldeisers, zowel overheidsschuldeisers als (private) schuldeisers dienen zich behoorlijk te gedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over incassobureaus en de dubieuze handel in schulden

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the government about debt-collection agencies, the resale of private debts, unlawful collection costs and whether banks remain responsible for sold debts. The minister answered that existing consumer-protection and financial-supervision rules already apply, that a ban on resale is not the right fix, that cumulative collection-cost rules are being kept under review, and that banks stay responsible for outsourced collection, without committing to new legislation.
Charging unjustified costs may constitute an unfair commercial practice, which can be enforced under the Unfair Commercial Practices Enforcement Act.
Het in rekening brengen van onterechte kosten kan een oneerlijke handelspraktijk opleveren en hiertegen kan worden opgetreden op grond van de Wet handhaving oneerlijke handelspraktijken.
Antwoord op van lid Peters over “financiële problemen van vrouwen in de vrouwenopvang”

An MP asked the State Secretary about financial problems and debts of women in women's shelters (blijf-van-mijn-lijfhuis) following an Ombudsman report, asking for debt percentages, costs, savings and whether independent client support will be promoted. The government answered that no data on debts in shelters exist, that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance with extra funding of 7.5 million euro, and that an integrated policy response including independent client support and debt problems will follow in the October 2017 progress report.
I am not aware of any figures on the number of women with debts specifically in women's shelters, nor on any increase or decrease in this number.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over het aantal vrouwen met schulden in specifiek de vrouwenopvang, noch over toe- of afname van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdringing en het schaden van werknemersrechten door Flextensie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about Flextensie, a BV that places benefit recipients with employers while they keep their benefit, and whether this displaces regular workers and undermines labour rights and collective agreements. The State Secretary replied that the instrument is not an employment relationship, that municipalities are responsible for preventing displacement under the Participatiewet, that an inspection study and a research project are ongoing, and that no new measures beyond guidance to municipalities were announced.
The research is ongoing. It is expected to be completed after the summer, after which I will inform the House of the outcomes as soon as possible.
Het onderzoek loopt. Naar verwachting wordt het onderzoek na de zomer afgerond, waarna ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ronnes over de problemen bij Anbang en de gevolgen daarvan voor de polishouders van VIVAT

MPs Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the ministers about problems at Anbang and the risks to Vivat policyholders, including the regulator's handling and possible capital extraction. The ministers answered that DNB's supervisory information is confidential, that the regulator monitors compliance and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection strengthened Vivat, while declining to comment on Anbang's internal affairs or future licence applications.
Information about the supervisor's assessment of the holder of a declaration of no objection is supervisory-confidential and therefore not public.
Informatie over de beoordeling door de toezichthouder van de houder van een verklaring van geen bezwaar is toezichtvertrouwelijk en daarmee niet publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong en Van Dijck over de berichten 'Pensioenfondsen oneerlijk' en 'DNB: Rendement pensioenfondsen te laag om te herstellen'

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary about press reports on pension funds' low returns and DNB's warning of possible pension cuts, questioning why cuts are possible given large fund assets and whether low discount rates distort funding pictures. The state secretary answered that coverage ratios remain below required buffers, the discount rate should not be raised, DNB's warning is part of its supervisory role, and cuts are a last resort under the 2015 framework.
It is the supervisor's task to point pension funds to their responsibilities and to point out the risks for the pension sector as a whole.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om pensioenfondsen te wijzen op hun verantwoordelijkheden en te wijzen op de risico's voor de pensioensector als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over de uitzending van Tros Radar Extra over oudere werklozen die nauwelijks kans op een baan hebben

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers about a Tros Radar report on older unemployed people with very little chance of work, including low re-employment odds, income loss from short jobs, home-ownership and benefit rules, the job-search obligation, and basic income. The government said it is acting through the 50-plus action plan, that the re-employment chance is well above 3%, that asset rules allow municipal loans against a home, and that it is not pursuing basic income, while pointing to municipal experimentation powers.
The cabinet also considers unemployment among people over fifty to still be too high.
Het kabinet is eveneens van mening dat de werkloosheid onder vijftigplussers nog steeds te hoog is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Fritsma en Wilders over 'Meer mensen in de bijstand'

PVV MPs asked whether rising welfare receipt among non-Western migrants, the welfare costs of immigration from Muslim countries, a ten-year residence requirement for social security, and closing borders to asylum seekers are justified. The government confirmed the trend, rejected the cost framing, said a welfare residence requirement would be disproportionate to its goals, and refused an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
The cabinet aims for a reasonable balance between preventing a pull effect on the one hand and income protection for those who have been in the Netherlands longer on the other.
Het kabinet streeft naar een redelijk evenwicht tussen het voorkomen van een aanzuigende werking enerzijds en inkomensbescherming voor degenen die al langer in Nederland zijn anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat artsen via hun pensioenfonds verplicht in tabak beleggen

An MP asked whether the government, as employer, can influence ABP's investment policy on tobacco and how participants can have more say over it. The state secretary replied that ABP's board and accountability body govern investments, that employer and employee representatives are involved, and that the government does not directly steer the policy.
The central government is one of the many public and education employers affiliated with ABP.
De rijksoverheid is één van de vele overheids- en onderwijswerkgevers die is aangesloten bij het ABP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het laten verwijderen van de registratie vanuit het Bureau Krediet Registratie (BKR) door bedrijven

MP Peters asked whether BKR credit registrations can only be removed when technical errors were made, whether courts have removed registrations, whether a BKR registration blocks mortgages, and what will be done about firms claiming they can delete registrations. The minister answered that removal is possible only for unlawful registrations, sometimes via settlement or courts, that a registration alone does not bar credit, that lenders must lend responsibly under AFM supervision, and that firms promising deletion without technical errors are misleading consumers.
It is not known how many mortgage applications are rejected or what part of them is (partly) rejected because of a BKR registration.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel hypotheekaanvragen worden afgewezen of welk deel daarvan (mede) vanwege een BKR-registratie is afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht “Tilburg woedend op Klijnsma om stoppen bijstandsproef: ‘We gaan gewoon door’”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether she rejected Tilburg's research design for a benefits experiment and why the process took so long after 1.5 years of consultation. The State Secretary denied rejecting it, said the plan had been returned for improvement under the regulations and now meets all requirements, and sent the letter to Tilburg to parliament.
No, this is not correct. The application will be approved.
Nee, dit klopt niet. De aanvraag zal worden gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het failliet van de banenafspraak

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the claimed failure of the disability jobs target (banenafspraak), including job counts, whether temporary placements and detachments count, and how to make these jobs permanent. The State Secretary reported that the 2016 private-sector target was exceeded while the public sector fell short, explained the counting rules, and said job durability will continue to be monitored, without committing to a specific new measure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uitstel van de beslistermijn Pensioen Eigen Beheer

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of directors-major shareholders not stopping PEB accrual by 1 July 2017, how they were informed, and why the deadline should not be extended. The State Secretary answered that accrual must stop by 1 July 2017 due to tax rules, that the Tax Administration informed affected parties extensively, and that further extension is undesirable.
Further postponement is undesirable from a policy perspective and illogical because pension would then continue to accrue for even longer, which would then have to be phased out again.
Verder uitstel is beleidsmatig onwenselijk en niet logisch omdat dan nóg langer pensioen wordt opgebouwd dat vervolgens weer moet worden uitgefaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over incassobureaus

An SP MP asked the government about debt-collection agencies using abusive practices (arbitrary fines, false threats of bailiffs), why the Nederlandse Incassocentrale had not been pursued by the OM or ACM, and whether payment arrangements should be offered before collection. The minister condemned these practices, said the ACM is enforcing in the sector and a criminal investigation is ongoing, but gave no details on specific companies and pointed to existing law and voluntary initiatives rather than new legislation.
The ACM cannot, under the law, make statements about whether it is investigating specifically named companies.
De ACM kan, op basis van de wet, geen mededelingen doen over of zij onderzoek doet naar specifiek genoemde bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie van 19 april 2016, Dansk Industri/Karsten Eigil Rasmussen

Two MPs asked the state secretaries whether the 2013 and 2016 European Court of Justice rulings (Experian, Dansk Industri/Rasmussen) show that the age exception in the Dutch equal treatment law and the Staffelbesluit age-based premium scales are incompatible with EU law, and what consequences this has for pension schemes. The government acknowledged the age exception in the Wgbl is likely not a correct implementation of the directive and promised to examine amendments, but maintained that the Staffelbesluit itself can be objectively justified and needs no withdrawal.

From both rulings of the European Court of Justice it can be inferred that the exception to the prohibition of age discrimination laid down in Article 8(3) of the Dutch Equal Treatment on Grounds of Age in Employment Act (Wgbl) is, on closer examination, not a correct implementation of the above Directive.

Uit de beide uitspraken van het Europese Hof van Justitie kan worden afgeleid dat de uitzondering op het verbod van leeftijdonderscheid, die is vastgelegd in artikel 8, derde lid, van de Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van leeftijd bij de arbeid (Wgbl), bij nader inzien geen juiste implementatie van de bovengenoemde Richtlijn is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uitstel beslistermijn Pensioen in Eigen Beheer

MP Van Weyenberg asked about the deadline for ending pension-in-own-business (PEB) accrual, a survey showing many directors unaware of the phase-out, and information provided by the government. The Secretary of State answered that the only requirement by 1 July 2017 is to stop accrual, that decisions can be made until end 2019, that outreach has been extensive, and that no extension of the grace period is needed.
In my view, the Tax Authority has therefore done everything to provide the necessary information, and affected parties or their service providers should therefore be informed.

Naar mijn mening is er dus vanuit de Belastingdienst alles aan gedaan om de noodzakelijke informatie te verstrekken en zouden belanghebbenden dan wel hun dienstverleners dan ook op de hoogte moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de dagvaarding van het sociaal werkbedrijf Alescon door FNV Overheid vanwege het inzetten van werknemers via een schijnconstructie

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary whether the social work company Alescon's use of an AwerC-Flex employment construction, which FNV Overheid has taken to court, breaches law and the collective agreement, and what the government will do. The State Secretary declined to judge the matter because it is before the court, gave factual clarifications on the corporate structure, employee numbers and contracts, and stated that the Participatiewet aims at a level playing field and that municipalities and social partners are responsible for oversight.
Since the case is before the court, it is not for me to pass judgment on it.
Aangezien de zaak onder de rechter is, is het niet aan mij hierover een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht Oost-Europese uitzendkrachten ingezet bij sociale werkbedrijven

An PVV MP asked the State Secretary whether sheltered-work companies hire Eastern European agency workers for jobs meant for people with disabilities, and whether this should stop. The State Secretary answered that the contractor uses foreign temporary workers without targeting that group, accepts their use only exceptionally to meet client deadlines, and said municipalities are responsible for agreements with the sheltered-work companies.
It is up to municipalities to make agreements about this with the sheltered-work companies.
Het is aan gemeenten om daarover afspraken te maken met de sw-bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de inzet van Oost-Europese uitzendkrachten bij sociale werkplaatsen

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the state secretary whether Eastern European temporary agency workers are being deployed at sheltered workplaces, displacing people with disabilities, and what action will be taken. The state secretary answered that use is only incidental, that it does not displace regular workers, that gemeenten are responsible, and that no measures are considered necessary, while pointing to existing programmes to help people reach the labour market.
As the answers above show, I see no need to take measures.
Zoals uit de beantwoording van bovenstaande vragen blijkt, zie ik geen noodzaak tot het treffen van maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Oost-Europese uitzendkrachten die worden ingezet bij sociale werkbedrijven

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about East European temporary agency workers deployed at sheltered workshops (sociale werkbedrijven), the Participatiewet, cao compliance, cost pressures and the funding demanded by municipalities. The State Secretary answers that the use of agency workers is incidental and exceptional, that she does not hold figures on it, that cao enforcement is primarily the responsibility of social partners, and that the extra 3 million euro is not new money but reallocated underspending.
I do not have these figures.
Over deze cijfers beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de gang van zaken bij sociale werkbedrijven

An MP from 50PLUS asks the State Secretary about reports that sheltered workshops use Eastern European temporary agency workers for work meant for people with disabilities, the closing of sheltered places, financial deficits, dumping prices, and government's own quota compliance. The State Secretary answers that use of agency workers is only incidental, that the Participation Act volume is lower than forecast, that the government is on track on quota commitments, and that placement decisions lie with municipalities.
Cedris states there is no structural use, but that agency workers (including Eastern European) are used incidentally when the client's demand cannot be met on time.

Cedris geeft aan dat geen sprake is van een structurele inzet, maar dat incidenteel gebruik wordt gemaakt van (Oost-Europese) uitzendkrachten als niet tijdig aan de vraag van de opdrachtgever kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het door bedrijven laten verwijderen van de registratie vanuit het Bureau Krediet Registratie (BKR)

An MP asked the government about a company advertising the removal of BKR credit registrations and whether such third-party intervention is widespread and leads to new debt problems. The Minister answered that creditors alone correct registrations, that no figures exist on third-party involvement or on resulting debt problems, and that a negative registration does not by itself prevent new credit.
There are no figures on the extent to which companies such as Dynamiet Nederland are involved in this.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over de mate waarin bedrijven zoals Dynamiet Nederland daarbij worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uiteenlopende eisen aan het recht op nabestaandenpensioen

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about differing partner definitions for survivors' pensions and what was done with the Stichting van de Arbeid recommendation on unmarried cohabitants. The State Secretary answered that most pension funds already include unmarried cohabitants, that most fund rules no longer require marriage or registered partnership, and that the situation may be reconsidered after the small pensions transfer bill takes effect.
If it becomes clear in time whether the small pensions value transfer bill has an effect on this point (as indicated in answer 2), it can be considered whether further measures are needed.
Als op termijn duidelijk is of het wetsvoorstel waardeoverdracht klein pensioen effect heeft op dit punt (zoals aangegeven in antwoord 2), kan worden bezien of nadere maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over klachten over betalingsachterstanden van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) aan schrijf- en gebarentolken

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about UWV payment delays to sign-language and written-language interpreters, including unpaid invoices, VAT burdens, and poor reachability. The state secretary answered that about 1,730 invoices were paid late due to capacity problems and internal miscommunication, that all arrears have now been cleared, and that UWV will discuss service improvements with interpreter organisations and report to parliament after the summer.
UWV will keep the Ministry of SZW informed of the outcomes. On that basis, your House will be informed after the summer about improvement measures that follow from them.
Het UWV zal het Ministerie van SZW op de hoogte houden van de uitkomsten. Op basis hiervan zal uw Kamer na de zomer worden geïnformeerd over verbetermaatregelen die hieruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over korting van het pensioenfonds Caribisch Nederland

MPs Diertens and Van Weyenberg asked why the new financial assessment framework (nFTK) was not applied to the Caribbean Netherlands pension fund PCN, what the effects of its introduction would be, and about pension cuts, the court case with the State, income effects and flanking policy. The government answered that the nFTK cannot be transplanted directly, that it would not improve PCN's financial position, that a 3.5% cut has been applied with income effects of up to 1.4%, that no compensation is planned, and that talks with employers and PCN are ongoing.
In short, adapting the supervisory framework for the Caribbean Netherlands requires a separate assessment and separate legislation.
Kortom, een aanpassing van het toetsingskader voor Caribisch Nederland vraagt om een eigenstandige afweging en aparte wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat mensen in de bijstand in Utrecht niet hoeven te solliciteren

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Utrecht may waive the job-search obligation for welfare recipients in an experiment without national approval, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have room to experiment within the Participatiewet, that Utrecht's experiment was postponed pending talks on its unapproved design, and that the government would first raise concerns with the municipality.
Pending a solution to be found, the municipality is postponing the planned start of its experiment on 1 May 2017.
In afwachting van een te vinden oplossing schort de gemeente de beoogde start van haar experiment per 1 mei 2017 op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over wanpraktijken inkomensbeheerders

An MP asked the state secretary about malpractice by income managers, including whether they are regulated and how many people have been harmed. The government answered that no data exist on harm, that the Wft ban on taking repayable funds from the public and DNB supervision apply, that voluntary income management is largely unregulated, and that it will ask municipalities to communicate on choosing a reliable income manager.
No data are known about this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over minima die bij de gemeentelijke kredietbank van Den Haag goedkoper kunnen lenen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Finance Minister about The Hague's municipal credit bank cutting interest for low-income borrowers from 11.5% to 2.3%, the resulting regional inequality, and whether the national maximum credit charge will be lowered. The government answered that municipal credit banks set rates within statutory limits, regional differences are inherent to decentralised powers, and the AFM will study consumer credit risks including the maximum charge, with results to be sent to parliament.
After this study is completed, the House will be informed of the outcomes.
Na afronding van dit onderzoek wordt uw Kamer over de uitkomsten geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Onrealistische AOW-leeftijd op pensioenoverzicht” van radar.avrotros.nl

An MP asked whether the Stichting Pensioenregister's pension overview site would show the expected AOW (state pension) age, and when. The Secretary of State replied that an impact analysis concluded showing amounts at the expected AOW age was too uncertain, so only the expected AOW age would be shown, with a link to an SVB calculator and a planned integration review.
The board has informed me that it will, in the short term, point more clearly where possible to the rise in the AOW age.
Het bestuur heeft mij laten weten op korte termijn waar mogelijk nog beter te wijzen op de stijging van de AOW-leeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Van Laar en Kerstens over korting van het pensioenfonds Caribisch Nederland

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about planned pension cuts at the Caribbean Netherlands pension fund PCN, including a 3.5% cut in April 2017 and possible further cuts in 2018 under DNB supervision rules, and the reduced recovery period. The government confirmed the 3.5% cut and that further cuts depend on funding levels, explained the different recovery rules for Caribbean Netherlands, said it will work on targeted support measures, and declined to answer the question on PCN's 2010 capitalisation because the matter is before the court.
The cabinet, as an employer, is one of the social partners and is involved in talks about PCN's financial situation in that role.
Het kabinet is als werkgever één van de sociale partners, en is vanuit die rol betrokken bij de gesprekken over de financiële situatie van PCN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Fokke over het bericht ‘Subsidie tram in gevaar’

MPs Hoogland and Fokke asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether she had threatened to withdraw the subsidy for the Hasselt-Maastricht tram after a newspaper report. The State Secretary denied threatening withdrawal, said she had called the province of Limburg to account for missed agreed deadlines on the BDU grant, and agreed to consult with the province on a solution.
I called the province of Limburg to account in my letter of 26 January 2017 for failing to meet agreements on the BDU grant
Ik heb de provincie Limburg met mijn brief van 26 januari 2017 aangesproken op het niet nakomen van afspraken over de BDU-uitkering
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over de wijziging van het zetelverdrag van het Joegoslaviëtribunaal

Two MPs asked whether amendments to the host-state agreement of the Yugoslavia Tribunal extend AOW pension coverage to family members of its staff retroactively to 2009 and why not to 1994 as the UN requested. The minister confirms the 2009 retroactive date, explains it was a goodwill choice rather than a legal obligation, and declines to extend it to 1994 because family members were explicitly excluded in the 1994 agreement.
The decision on retroactive effect is not based on an (international) legal obligation but was chosen as an accommodation for the MICT.
Het besluit met betrekking tot de terugwerkende kracht is niet gebaseerd op een (internationaal) juridische verplichting, maar is gekozen als tegemoetkoming voor het MICT
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel 'Pensioenfederatie: 'Nettopensioen is vaak loos product'

Lodders (VVD) asks whether the rules for buying net pension in pension funds, which may cause participants to lose a quarter or more of their savings, should be revised, and whether fiscal hygiene is adequately guaranteed. Klijnsma answers that the rules stem from a 2014 decree, that fiscal hygiene is guaranteed under current rules, and that she is consulting with the Stichting van de Arbeid and Finance on possible changes, with conclusions to be shared as soon as possible.
I aim to share my conclusions with your House as quickly as possible once the consultation with the Stichting van de Arbeid has concluded.
Ik streef ernaar om – na afloop van het overleg met de Stichting van de Arbeid – zo snel mogelijk mijn conclusies met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht ‘Koolmonoxidevergiftiging kinderen door barbecue in ijskoud huis’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a case where children were poisoned by carbon monoxide from a barbecue in a cold house, and asked whether utilities and evictions for debt should be restricted when children are present. The government answered that existing rules already protect vulnerable households, that no new ban on disconnections or evictions is needed, and that it will keep discussing gaps with local bodies without committing to a formal report.
On the basis of the current policy described above, the cabinet is of the view that the disconnection policy, in particular for vulnerable households, requires no amendment.
Op basis van bovenstaand omschreven huidig beleid is het kabinet van mening dat het afsluitbeleid, in het bijzonder het afsluitbeleid bij kwetsbare huishoudens, geen aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over tijdelijk werken vanuit de bijstand

MP Kerstens asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about making temporary work easier for people on welfare benefits (bijstand) and what the government would do to remove bureaucratic obstacles. The State Secretary answered that temporary and part-time work can be a stepping stone, that the earnings exemption was extended to six non-consecutive months from April 2016, and that gross-based benefit payment was not desirable for now, while promising continued monitoring and experiments from 2017.
I will continue to monitor and evaluate the implementation of the Participation Act to see where improvements are possible.
Ik blijf de uitvoering van de Participatiewet monitoren en evalueren om te bezien waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het bericht dat ‘verzekeraars WAO- en WIA-verzekeringen niet door laten lopen tot de AOW-leeftijd’

MP Vermeij asked whether insurers should extend WAO/WIA private supplementary policies to the new AOW age, so people are not cut on UWV benefits between 65 and that age, and what came of talks with the insurers' association and Achmea. The State Secretary answered that statutory benefits must be paid and no cuts are signalled, that private supplementary products are insurers' own responsibility, that insurers have adjusted statutory products and are working on the supplementary ones, and that UWV does not count these private benefits as income.
There can be no question of people being cut on a statutory benefit whose entitlement has been established by UWV.
Er kan geen sprake van zijn van dat mensen gekort worden op een wettelijke uitkering waarvan het recht (door UWV) is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de nieuwe kandidatenverkenner van het UWV op werk.nl

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the UWV candidate explorer on werk.nl, which only shows jobseekers with a disability counted under the Banenafspraak, is fair and discriminatory, and why it is used given quota sanctions. The State Secretary rejects the discrimination claim, explains the tool supports employers, and says UWV will further develop it in 2017.
I do not share the view that there is any discrimination or any degree of exclusion.
Ik deel niet de mening dat er sprake is van discriminatie of enige mate van uitsluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Gemeente Amsterdam betaalt godsdienstles moslimkinderen’

An MP asked the state secretary whether Amsterdam's use of poverty funds to pay for religious lessons for Muslim children is acceptable and how the government will ensure national child-poverty money goes to essentials. The state secretary replied that municipalities are autonomous in poverty policy, that the municipal council is primarily responsible, and that Amsterdam is investigating the lawfulness of the declarations; she also pointed to binding agreements with the VNG on reporting and evaluation.
For any signals about local poverty policy, the municipal council is therefore primarily responsible.
Bij eventuele signalen over lokaal armoedebeleid is derhalve primair de gemeenteraad aan zet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Groot over een regeling waarbij leenbijstand, die voor 1 januari 2017 omgezet is in een gift, niet langer leidt tot terugvordering van toeslagen en het (nog) niet uitvoeren van

Members Omtzigt and Groot asked why self-employed people whose loan assistance was converted into a grant, creating a phantom income that forced repayment of benefit allowances, still lack relief, and whether a scheme for existing cases could be proposed as the motion requested. The state secretary replies that retroactive or case-by-case compensation is unworkable, costly and unequal, that only a payment-plan route is offered, and that no problems with municipalities have been reported.
Although I understand the wish of your House, in view of the above I see no possibilities to arrive at a legally defensible and affordable tailor-made solution and to implement your motion.

Hoewel ik de wens van uw Kamer begrijp, zie ik gelet op het vorenstaande, dan ook geen mogelijkheden om tot een juridisch goed verdedigbare en tevens betaalbare maatwerkoplossing te komen en uw motie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van ‘t Wout over uitbreiding van de werkingssfeer van een cao en/of de uitbreiding van de verplichtstellingsbeschikking van een bedrijfstakpensioenfonds

MPs Lodders and Van 't Wout asked how often and why the scope of collective agreements and pension fund compulsory membership decisions is changed, who decides, and whether 'clarifications' or 'editorial changes' disguise expansions. The ministers answered that scope is set by social partners, that Minister decides on extensions with representativeness rules and objections procedures, and gave counts of 2015-2016 scope-change decisions, while declining to investigate misuse of editorial changes.
Defining and adapting the scope of collective agreements and compulsory schemes is a responsibility of the social partners.
Het definiëren en aanpassen van werkingssferen van cao's en verplichtstellingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat bijstandsgerechtigden moeten werken zonder loon, zonder arbeidsrechten, zonder cao of baangarantie voor hun uitkering

MP Karabulut asked whether welfare recipients working for Flextensie without wages, labour rights or a collective agreement, while keeping their benefit, was acceptable, and about displacement of regular work and exploitation. The State Secretary said municipalities have discretion within the Participation Act, that a market-rate fee is charged to clients, that the Flextensie arrangement was checked against legal frameworks, and that municipalities bear responsibility for lawful implementation; she promised to report back on how municipalities apply the instrument.
I am not aware of what kind of work is performed and at which companies.
Het is mij niet bekend wat voor werk wordt verricht en bij welke bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht 'Niet iedereen blij met baan plus bijstand'

An MP asked whether the Flextensie scheme, which lets welfare recipients work temporarily while keeping benefits at a low hourly rate, avoids displacing regular paid jobs, and about duration, voluntariness, sanctions and outcomes. The state secretary answered that municipalities have discretion and must prevent displacement under the Participation Act, that work is voluntary with a time limit of three to six months, and that an impact study is planned while no special agreements were made with Flextensie.
Municipalities themselves decide for which target group they wish to use Flextensie.
Gemeenten maken zelf de afweging voor welke doelgroep zij een beroep willen doen op Flextensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat slechts 3% van de bijstandsgerechtigden een tegenprestatie levert

A VVD MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities such as Amsterdam are failing to implement the legal tegenprestatie (counter-performance) requirement for welfare recipients, what has been done about it, and the basis for the claim that only 3% perform one. The state secretary confirmed Amsterdam's ordinance does not comply with the Participatiewet, says it asked the alderman to amend it, reports that 17 of 20 non-compliant municipalities are amending their ordinances, and attributes the 3% figure to the Divosa benchmark.
Amsterdam does not implement the tegenprestatie in line with the requirements the Participatiewet sets for it.
Amsterdam voert de tegenprestatie niet uit conform de eisen die de Participatiewet daaraan stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat gemeenten alleen mogen experimenteren in de bijstand als zij bijstandsgerechtigden verplichten tot een tegenprestatie

MP Voortman asks whether municipalities are only allowed to experiment with welfare benefits if they impose a tegenprestatie (counter-performance) obligation, and why this condition was not communicated earlier. The Secretary of State replies that the draft decree requires lawful implementation of the Participatiewet, that Amsterdam's tegenprestatie policy does not fit the law so it cannot yet apply, and that a maximum of 25 municipalities may experiment.
From municipalities that submit a request to experiment, I want in any case to be assured that all prescribed ordinances comply with the statutory provisions of the Pw.

Van gemeenten die een verzoek indienen om te mogen experimenten, wil ik in ieder geval verzekerd zijn dat alle voorgeschreven verordeningen in overeenstemming zijn met de wettelijke bepalingen van de Pw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht 'Geen 'tegenprestatie' in de bijstand? Dan géén vrijheid'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the imposition of a 'tegenprestatie' (counter-performance) in welfare is a municipal competence, whether the Participatiewet experiments are valid despite wording differences in municipal ordinances, and whether linking experiment eligibility to ordinance wording is improper. The State Secretary answered that municipalities regulate the tegenprestatie by ordinance under council oversight, that experiments require municipalities to comply with the law, and that the exact wording of ordinances is secondary as long as they conform to the Act.
The municipal council has a supervisory task over the implementation of the policy laid down in ordinances.
De gemeenteraad heeft een controlerende taak op de uitvoering van het in verordeningen vastgelegde beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de mogelijkheden voor ontwikkelingswerkers om zich vrijwillig te verzekeren voor AOW en Anw tegen een minimumpremie

MP Schouten asked whether development workers, aid workers and missionaries abroad who receive only expense reimbursements can insure voluntarily for AOW and Anw at the minimum premium, and whether current barriers exist. The State Secretary confirmed the situation, agreed that the minimum premium should not be a barrier, said individual questions can go to the SVB or a court, and announced no plans to change the voluntary insurance system.
I currently have no intention to make changes to the voluntary insurance system.
Ik heb op dit moment geen voornemen om verandering in het systeem voor vrijwillige verzekering aan te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep inzake ongehuwd samenwonenden, waarvan de één voor de ander zorgt, niet zonder meer mogen worden beschouwd als stel en de uitkeri

Karabulut (SP) asks how the government will respond to a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that unmarried cohabitants, where one cares for the other, should not automatically be treated as a couple and benefits cannot automatically be cut, and what legal changes will follow. The State Secretary replies that the Participatiewet must be amended, that municipalities must apply the ruling in individual cases meanwhile, and that the government will inform municipalities in the next letter.
