The CRvB ruling of 6 December 2016 means that the Participatiewet must be amended.
De uitspraak van de CRvB d.d. 6 december 2016 heeft tot gevolg dat de Participatiewet moet worden gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep van 6 december jongstleden over een zorgbehoevende bijstandsgerechtigde die samenwoont met haar zorgverlener

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Central Council of Appeal ruling that the Participatiewet's care-need exception, limited to second-degree blood relatives, discriminates against other unmarried cohabitants with a care-dependent partner. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling applies to all unmarried cohabitants pending a legal amendment, and said municipalities will be informed in the next letter.
The CRvB ruling of 6 December 2016 means that the Participatiewet must be amended.
De uitspraak van de CRvB d.d. 6 december 2016 heeft tot gevolg dat de Participatiewet moet worden gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Sittard-Geleen uitkeringsgerechtigden gaat inzetten voor het schoonhouden van de stad

An SP MP asked whether using welfare recipients to keep Sittard-Geleen clean displaces paid work and what the government would do about it. The State Secretary answered that the pilot's tasks are supposed to be additional, that municipalities themselves decide how to prevent displacement, and that the council and existing guidelines cover the issue, without committing to new action.
Municipalities are responsible, within the legal framework, for shaping their own implementation of policy to prevent displacement.
Gemeenten zijn ervoor verantwoordelijk om, gegeven de wettelijke kaders, zelf invulling te geven aan de uitvoering van het beleid om verdringing te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over “de Luxemburg-route”

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary about the Luxembourg pension route for cross-border pension schemes, the European pension vehicle there, and whether Dutch rules should be broadened to attract foreign schemes. The government answered that only a few Dutch schemes (under 50 participants) operate in Luxembourg, that participation is a social-partner choice protected by works council consent and dual supervisor approval, and that it does not consider changing Dutch prudential rules desirable, while it will study adjustments to the general pension fund for foreign schemes.
The cabinet indicated in its response to the study that it will further examine whether adjustments are needed to realise the potential of the general pension fund for foreign schemes.

Het kabinet heeft in haar kabinetsreactie bij het onderzoek aangegeven dat zij nader zal bestuderen of er aanpassingen nodig zijn om deze potentie van het algemeen pensioenfonds voor buitenlandse regelingen tot wasdom te laten komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het bericht "Verschil renterisico pensioenfondsen België en Nederland"

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report showing Dutch pension liabilities are more interest-rate sensitive than Belgian ones, and whether pension funds are moving to Belgium because of the supervisory framework. The government answered that the frameworks must be compared as a whole, explained why it chose not to include employer sponsor guarantees, and said cross-border pension activity is very limited, with no plan to change the framework beyond awaiting the IORP revision.
The different frameworks must therefore be viewed as a whole and cannot be compared on a single element in isolation.
De verschillende kaders moeten daarom in den brede worden bezien en kunnen niet op één element los vergeleken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over toezicht arbitrage en andere mogelijke schadelijke gevolgen voor pensioenfondsen en gepensioneerden van de IORP-2 richtlijn

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs for a precise article-by-article list of Pension Act provisions that the IORP-II directive requires changing, and questions whether cross-border pension fund transfers to Belgium for supervisory arbitrage should be allowed. The State Secretary replies that an article-by-article implementation plan will follow within three months of the directive entering into force, that DNB can block a transfer on defined criteria, and that the government considers large-scale arbitrage-driven transfers undesirable but not prohibited.
The cabinet is now working this out in an implementation plan of which an article-by-article overview will be part.
Het kabinet is nu bezig om dit uit te werken in een implementatieplan waar een artikelsgewijs overzicht onderdeel van uit maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Vermeij over het bericht ‘Aantal pensioenfondsen zakt onder driehonderd’

MPs Lodders and Vermeij asked the State Secretary about the reported drop of Dutch pension funds below 300, the causes of consolidation (especially among industry-wide funds) and what will be done to help industry funds merge. The State Secretary explained the long-term consolidation driven by social developments and efficiency concerns, and said a concept bill on merging mandatory industry funds with temporary segregated assets would be sent to parliament.
The cabinet endorses the importance of scale enlargement aimed at reducing administration costs for small and medium-sized pension funds
Het kabinet onderschrijft het belang van schaalvergroting met als doel het verlagen van de uitvoeringskosten voor kleine en middelgrote pensioenfondsen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over het bericht dat jaaropgaven van 1712 cliënten van enkele Groningse sociale diensten per ongeluk aan een andere cliënt zijn toegestuurd

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked about the misdirected sending of 1,712 income statements of clients of Groningen social services, the data leak risk, the number of municipal data leaks, security of municipal systems and readiness for the new GDPR. Minister Plasterk answered that the incident is a data leak reported to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, that municipalities remain responsible for their own information security, and that VNG and KING provide support, while the DPA does not comment on investigations.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority does not make statements about possible investigations.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doet geen mededelingen over eventuele onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het na toestemming toegankelijk maken van pensioenregistergegevens voor ontwikkelaars

Rep. Van Weyenberg asked whether pension fund and independent adviser access to personal pension register data, with participant consent, is blocked and whether the register foundation could enable it. The Secretary of State answered that only participants can access the register, that downloads to third parties are technically possible but unused, and that she will raise the issue with the register board without committing to a timeline.
Yes, insofar as it concerns the possibility outlined in answer 5, I am willing to do so.
Ja, voor zover het gaat over de mogelijkheid geschetst bij antwoord 5 ben ik hiertoe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en Straus over het bericht ‘Inzet budgetcoaches Vebego: sociaal en slim. Nu het onderwijs nog!’

MPs Moors and Straus asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about budget coaches for employees, prevention of debt, and financial education in schools (kerndoelen 35 and 42), and about measuring effectiveness and using Nibud rules of thumb. The State Secretary welcomed budget coaching and prevention, said curriculum responsibility lies with OCW, cited existing projects and the WiG platform, and said the effectiveness of financial education cannot yet be stated overall.
Including financial skills, learning to manage money and learning to budget in the school curriculum is the responsibility of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.
Het opnemen van financiële vaardigheden, het leren omgaan met geld en het leren budgetteren, in het curriculum voor scholen is de verantwoordelijkheid van het Ministerie van OCW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken- de Haan, Van ’t Wout en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht ‘Baan via gemeente of UWV? Vergeet het maar!’

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a Trouw report based on an Inspectorate SZW study showing weak cooperation between municipalities and UWV in placing jobseekers, and about knowledge management, the knowledge programme 'Vakkundig aan het werk', and how to raise employer uptake. The government acknowledged the cooperation problems, described existing and planned measures (knowledge programmes, Kandidatenverkenner, Programmaraad activities) and committed to a progress letter before 15 March 2017.
As promised during the Participation Act committee debate of 27 October, your House will be informed by letter before 15 March about progress.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het AO Participatiewet van 27 oktober jl., zal uw Kamer voor 15 maart per brief geïnformeerd worden over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘Zzp’er te karig voor pensioen’

Two Labour MPs asked the State Secretary about a report showing over a million self-employed people saving too little for retirement, and about policy options such as an opt-out pension scheme and debt reduction support. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing fiscal measures and a pending SER study, said an opt-out system is a possibility for a future cabinet to decide, and referred debt support to municipalities.
It is up to a future cabinet to make decisions on this.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om beslissingen hierover te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het door kerken uitgebrachte rapport ‘Armoede in Nederland 2016’

A Christian Union MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about a 2016 report by Dutch churches on poverty and church-based aid, including bureaucracy, waiting times and the need for coordinated support. The State Secretary welcomed the report, pointed to existing measures (beslagvrije voet simplification, debt-register expansion, legal moratorium, subsidies) and to municipalities' responsibility, and committed to forwarding the report to municipalities and answering before the budget debate.
I will bring the report to the attention of municipalities in the collective letter to municipalities.
Ik zal in de verzamelbrief aan gemeenten het rapport onder de aandacht brengen van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over “het bericht dat gemeenten mensen van 27 jaar en ouder, vier weken laten wachten bij aanvraag van een bijstandsuitkering”

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs how she responds to complaints to the National Ombudsman about a four-week waiting period before applicants aged 27 and over receive social assistance, and whether this breaches the Participatiewet. The state secretary replied that municipal councils are primarily responsible for oversight, that the ministry does not systematically supervise individual municipalities, that an instruction power exists but is not warranted here, and that applicants can appeal and the advance payment obligation protects them.
The ministry of SZW does not exercise systematic supervision over the lawful implementation of the Participatiewet by individual municipalities.
Door het minsterie van SZW wordt geen systematisch toezicht uitgeoefend op de rechtmatige uitvoering van de Participatiewet door individuele gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over dat de kostencijfers van DNB niet altijd goed vergelijkbaar zijn

An MP asked whether pension fund cost figures published by DNB are comparable and whether reporting guidelines cause confusion. The state secretary said reporting is largely comparable, DNB publishes unadjusted fund data, and the AFM supervises compliance, without committing to new action.
In my view, the reporting guidelines of the Pensioenfederatie need not lead to unclarity.
Naar mijn mening hoeven de rapportagerichtlijnen van de Pensioenfederatie niet tot onduidelijkheid te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de toetsing van pensioenfondsbestuurders door De Nederlandsche Bank

An MP asked the State Secretary about DNB suitability tests of pension fund board members, including the 24% of reappointed members who did not receive a positive verdict and the 30 members appointed before 2000 who were never tested. The government answered that the 22 members concerned had already passed earlier tests for board membership, that DNB can re-test on reasonable grounds, and that the test framework and figures for 2012-2016 were set out.
There is therefore no question of a pension fund having been governed by board members who turned out to be unsuitable afterwards.
Er is derhalve geen sprake van dat een pensioenfonds bestuurd werd door bestuurders die achteraf ongeschikt bleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Nieuwe regels voor aparte indexatiedepots voor Pensioenfondsen” van Rijksoverheid.nl.

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about new rules allowing separate indexation buffers for pension funds, including whether funding them reduces fund assets for other members and whether DNB advised on them. The State Secretary answered that these buffers are limited to three special situations, are financed under strict conditions without draining assets from other members, and that DNB gave informal input rather than formal advice.
It is not possible to finance an indexation depot by drawing off fund assets to the detriment of the other participants in the fund.
Het is niet mogelijk om een indexatiedepot te financieren door vermogen in het fonds af te romen ten nadele van de overige deelnemers in het fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over gemeenten die niet toetsen op verdringing van betaalde arbeid

An MP asked the State Secretary whether municipalities that do not check for displacement of regular paid work by welfare recipients doing tegenprestatie labour are acting unlawfully, and what action will be taken. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for preventing displacement under existing rules, that she will not impose stricter binding rules on municipalities, and that she has only encouraged them through letters, meetings and asking Divosa for support.
I do not consider it desirable to restrict the policy freedom of municipalities by imposing stricter binding rules.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk om de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten te beperken door dwingender regels op te leggen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid  Karabulut over het bericht dat de meeste gemeenten niet toetsen op het verdringen van betaalde banen door onbetaalde banen middels het laten werken zonder loon van uitkeringsgerechtigden

The SP's Karabulut asks the state secretary for Social Affairs how the government responds to FNV findings that most municipalities do not systematically check whether unpaid participation work displaces paid jobs, and about related municipal policy on the tegenprestatie and income supplements. The state secretary answers that municipalities bear responsibility for preventing displacement, points to existing rules and ongoing encouragement of municipalities, and says municipalities have wide discretion on income supplements.
Responsibility for adequately monitoring the prevention of displacement of paid work lies explicitly with the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het adequaat toezien op het voorkomen van verdringing van betaalde arbeid ligt uitdrukkelijk bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat werkzoekenden hondenpoepbakken moeten legen in ruil voor werkervaring

An SP MP asked whether unpaid work-experience placements in Putten, such as emptying dog-waste bins, displace paid work and breach minimum-wage norms, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answered that such placements are a local matter under the Participatiewet, that the municipality reports no displacement, and that the government relies on municipalities to prevent displacement without new national measures.
That is why responsibility lies with the local government to assess this.
Daarom ligt hier een verantwoordelijkheid voor het lokale bestuur om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat Pensioen 1-2-3 niet leidt tot meer duidelijkheid

Dutch MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a Netspar study finding that the new Pensioen 1-2-3 communication model does not yet make pension information easier to find, and about pension awareness, harmonisation of information channels and the key elements participants should see. The State Secretary acknowledged room for improvement, noted the obligation is new, pointed to existing tools and activities, reported awareness data without attributing effects to Pensioen 1-2-3, and said the sector will evaluate the instrument after two years.
I am willing to keep a close eye on progress and to engage in discussion with the pension providers.
Ik ben bereid om een vinger aan de pols te houden over de voortgang en in gesprek te gaan met de pensioenuitvoerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de toetsing van pensioenfondsbestuurders door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB)

An MP asked whether sitting pension fund board members escape DNB suitability checks, how often reappointed or re-tested board members are assessed, and whether performance is linked to suitability. The Secretary of State confirmed that sitting board members appointed before 30 December 2000 are not tested until reappointment, gave re-test and reappointment figures, and said no specific study links fund performance to board suitability.
I have not considered having sitting pension fund board members also undergo a one-time test.
Ik heb niet overwogen om ook zittende pensioenfondsbestuurders eenmalig een toets te laten afleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘Eiopa wil betere en meer vergelijkbare informatie voor deelnemers'

Conservative MP Lodders asked the State Secretary whether EU pensions supervisor EIOPA's plans to develop rules on participant information and governance for pension funds go too far, and what the government will do to stop them. The State Secretary answered that the government opposes detailed EU harmonisation, notes that EIOPA can only issue non-binding advice, and sees no need for concrete steps at present.
EIOPA can therefore issue advice, but cannot impose rules on member states.
EIOPA kan daarom wel advies uit brengen, maar geen regels opleggen aan lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Afgunst en bonje kost Oost-Groningen miljoenen’

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked whether the state will make the promised funds available so workers in East Groningen are not harmed by the dispute over the Akkoord van Westerlee. The Secretary of State replied that a maximum of 10 million euros is available for 2016-2018 and that the Akkoord will be implemented with the municipalities that remain willing, keeping the door open for the others.
I indicated that a maximum of 10 million euros is available for implementation in the years 2016, 2017 and 2018.
Ik heb aangegeven dat ten behoeve van de uitvoering in de jaren 2016, 2017 en 2018 maximaal 10 mln euro beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten dat gemeenten de weg naar schuldhulpverlening blokkeren en slechts 1 op de 5 gemeenten een juiste beschikking schuldhulp geeft

An MP asks whether municipalities have become stricter in admitting people to debt assistance, leaving problem debtors without help, and whether decisions lack proper motivation and remedy information. The State Secretary responds that the evaluation finds municipalities strive for broad access but results are hard to measure, promises an Inspectorate investigation and a possible tightening of the Wgs, and states that Awb requirements for motivation and remedy clauses are sufficiently guaranteed.
Anticipating this, I am preparing a possible tightening of the Wgs to remove the identified access blockages.
Daarop vooruitlopend bereid ik een mogelijke aanscherping van de Wgs voor om geconstateerde blokkades betreffende de toegang weg te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Bosman over het bericht "Ministerie overweegt kwijtschelding subsidiefraude bij Movimientu Antiano i Arubano pa Provomé Partisipashon MAAPP (beweging ter bevordering van

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Bosman (VVD) asked why a 2010 subsidy to MAAPP was not recovered or fined after a former chair misappropriated funds, and how the ministry controls subsidy spending. The minister answered that only EUR 47,934 of EUR 159,608 was accounted for, the ministry holds a claim of EUR 79,752, no legal basis exists for a fine, and the claim was written off under the 2014 remission rules.
The chair did not spend this amount on behalf of MAAPP, so the foundation could account for only EUR 47,934.
Dit bedrag heeft de voorzitter niet ten behoeve van MAAPP besteed waardoor de stichting slechts een bedrag van € 47.934 heeft kunnen verantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht “Taaleis bijstand genegeerd”?

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that welfare recipients with poor Dutch are not complying with the language requirement, asking how many are sanctioned and whether immigrants without Dutch should be denied benefits. The State Secretary answered that no national figures on sanctions are yet available (to be published for the 2020 evaluation), defended the language requirement as a tool for labour market participation, and said municipalities are responsible for enforcement, with the municipal council holding the supervisory role.
There are currently no national figures available on the number of people on welfare whose Dutch is insufficient.
Er zijn op dit moment geen landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal mensen in de bijstand dat het Nederlands onvoldoende beheerst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over verzekeraars die polissen niet verlengen tot aan de nieuwe AOW-gerechtigde leeftijd

An MP asked the State Secretary about insurers refusing to extend disability policies to the new AOW retirement age, a case of a 51-year-old fully disabled since 2014, and about a widow facing a months-long income gap before her AOW starts. The State Secretary said the case was not known to her, that insurers are not obliged to offer extensions after a 2015 KiFiD ruling, that she sees no plans for further action, and that the AOW bridging scheme is adequate.
I have no intention of taking additional action in this regard.
Ik heb in dit kader geen voornemen om hierin aanvullend actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat de financiën van toekomstige gepensioneerden zorgwekkend zijn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about Nibud/PwC findings that a quarter of future pensioners may have too little pension, and about related housing and care cost concerns. The State Secretary answered that the government wants all workers to build adequate pensions, points to existing financial-planning tools, and says care costs are cushioned by income-dependent contributions and compensation.

In the perspective note on the future of the pension system, the cabinet has indicated that it considers it important that all workers build up an adequate pension so that there is no major drop in spending power at retirement.

In de perspectiefnota over de toekomst van het pensioenstelsel heeft het kabinet aangegeven het van belang te vinden dat alle werkenden een toereikend pensioen opbouwen om bij pensionering geen grote terugval te hebben in bestedingsmogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Moderne slavernij bij IJmond Werkt’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports of intimidation and exploitation of workers at the social work provider IJmond Werkt, including whether benefit recipients were forced to pack sex toys and whether the Labour Inspectorate would investigate. The State Secretary replied that implementation of the Participatiewet lies with the municipality, that the Inspectorate works risk-based and sees no reason to investigate now, while noting that workers can file complaints with the Inspectorate.
I therefore cannot go into the specific case.
Ik kan derhalve niet ingaan op de concrete casus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Amsterdam gaat huurders financieel bijstaan

MPs Moors and Van der Linde asked the ministers about Amsterdam's plan to financially support tenants through rent reductions funded by the municipality and their view on using poverty funds against costly housing. The government answered that existing rent instruments suffice, that the Amsterdam approach is individual case-based and grounded in local agreements rather than the Participatiewet, and that municipalities and corporations each carry defined responsibilities.

Incidentally, it has come to my attention that Amsterdam does not base this policy on the Participatiewet, but is an elaboration of the cooperation agreements between the tenants' association, the federation of housing corporations and the municipality of Amsterdam.
Overigens is mij gebleken dat Amsterdam het onderhavige beleid niet baseert op de Participatiewet, maar betreft het een Uitwerking van de Samenwerkingsafspraken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de mantelzorgers financiële problemen heeft

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the government how it views reports that over half of informal carers face financial problems, why carers were not informed about changes in care, and what concrete measures will be taken. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for supporting carers under the Wmo 2015, that the cited Nibud study should be qualified, and that no concrete measures were announced beyond pointing to municipal responsibility.
It is up to municipalities to translate this responsibility into policy and implementation.
Het is aan gemeenten om deze verantwoordelijkheid door te vertalen in beleid en uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat ‘kanslozen’ niet hoeven te solliciteren

An MP asks whether municipalities may classify benefit recipients as 'hopeless' on general criteria such as age and benefit duration and exempt them from job-search duties, without individual assessment. The state secretary replies that the Participation Act gives municipalities discretion, requires individual assessment for exemptions, and promises no new concrete action beyond existing instruments and monitoring by municipal councils.
It is therefore expressly for the municipal executive, when imposing obligations and measures, to take account of the individual situation of the benefit recipient.
Het is dan ook uitdrukkelijk aan het college om bij het opleggen van de verplichtingen en maatregelen rekening te houden met de individuele situatie van de bijstandsgerechtigde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Yücel over de toename van het aantal zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp’ers) in de schuldhulpverlening

MPs asked the government about a rise in self-employed people without staff (zzp'ers) in debt assistance, its causes, access barriers and whether minimum rates should be set. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of the trend, said debt assistance is aimed at citizens and that self-employed people can use municipal business support, rejected minimum rates for zzp'ers, and pointed to information initiatives.
Yes. I am already doing so.
Ja. Ik ben daarmee ook reeds doende.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het oordeel van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens ‘VU-VUMC discrimineerde twaalf oudere medewerkers op grond van leeftijd bij de ontslagaanzegging in het kader van een reorg

MP Krol asked the ministers about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that VU-VUmc discriminated against twelve older employees by age in dismissal notices during a reorganisation, including a chairman's remark about cheaper younger researchers and the government's response to the ruling. The minister declined to give a substantive judgment, stressed that discrimination assessment is for the courts and the College, noted that College rulings are not binding and that the VU is a private law body where UWV preventive review applies since July 2015, and took no concrete action.
It is not for me to pass a substantive judgment on this.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover een inhoudelijk oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de plannen om mensen met zware schulden geen rekeningen te laten betalen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the proposed Breed Moratorium (blanket debt-collection pause) for heavily indebted people unfairly harms creditors and encourages payment laxity. The State Secretary replied that the moratorium only suspends collection, not repayment, is reserved for exceptional cases, and requires the debtor to make efforts to repay.
The moratorium does not suspend the repayment of debts, only the collection.
Het Moratorium schort niet het afbetalen van schulden op, maar enkel de incasso.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moors over het bericht "Gemeenten helpen jongeren met schulden"

MP Moors asks whether young people with problematic debts are excluded from municipal debt assistance, and about Leiden and The Hague taking over youth debts, possible interest charges, debt forgiveness and rewarding school or volunteer hours. The Secretary of State answers that the Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening gives broad access, that debt rescheduling is hard for youths, that the Hague and Leiden schemes are municipal pilots financed from local budgets, and that municipalities themselves must judge these projects against local frameworks.
I encourage municipalities, where a debt rescheduling is not possible, to make use of these other products.
Ik moedig gemeenten aan daar waar een schuldregeling niet tot de mogelijkheden behoort om van deze producten gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Yücel over de hoge kosten die een gerechtsdeurwaarder in rekening kan brengen

MPs Recourt and Yücel asked why bailiff enforcement costs can reach many times the debt, and whether government policy will limit debt build-up and stop commercial creditors from pressing payment during a moratorium. The minister replied that bailiff fees follow fixed tariffs not tied to the claim amount, that a breed moratorium will apply to all creditors including commercial ones, and that the government sees no need to change the tariff system.
The costs a bailiff may charge for official acts are set out in the Decree on tariffs for official acts of bailiffs.
De kosten die een gerechtsdeurwaarder voor ambtshandelingen in rekening mag brengen, zijn vastgelegd in het Besluit tarieven ambtshandelingen gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Krol en Van Klaveren over "het behandelvoorbehoud op het EU-voorstel inzake bedrijfspensioenfondsen"

MPs Omtzigt, Krol and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would present the negotiated text on the EU occupational pensions (IORP) directive in time for Parliament to instruct its voting position, and by when. The State Secretary replied that the consolidated negotiation text was sent to Parliament on 24 June and made available via the Council extranet, that COREPER would discuss it on 30 June, and that Parliament could still state its view before the Council decision.
The consolidated text of the negotiation result will be submitted to COREPER
De geconsolideerde tekst van het onderhandelingsresultaat zal worden voorgelegd aan COREPER
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Van Rijn gaat ingrijpen bij ‘foute’ gemeenten’

Kerstens (PvdA) asked whether the state should intervene in municipalities that fail to tailor Participatiewet reintegration support to individuals' circumstances, as the Wmo minister announced. Staatssecretaris Klijnsma answered that municipalities have discretion under the law, that the Rijk only intervenes in serious unlawful conduct, and that individuals can appeal decisions through bezwaar and beroep.
Only if there is serious unlawful action or inaction by the college regarding national rules can the Rijk interfere with choices made at local level.

Alleen indien sprake is van een ernstig onrechtmatig handelen of nalaten door het college ten aanzien van rijksvoorschriften, kan het Rijk zich bemoeien met de keuzen die op lokaal niveau worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de nieuwe Europese richtlijn pensioenen, IORP-2

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the status of the IORP-2 pension directive, whether a deal was reached in the trilogue, whether publication was delayed until after the Brexit referendum, and whether the government kept its 2014 commitments to inform parliament quarterly and send draft Council positions in time. The State Secretary answered that the trilogue reached a provisional compromise, that the stilte procedure passed without objection, that Coreper vote is planned for 30 June, that the text will be shared with parliament, and that prior briefings were sent, while publication timing is a normal procedure.
No minutes were drawn up of these trilogue meetings.
Van deze triloogbijeenkomsten zijn geen notulen opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat de extreem lage rente ook bij de specialisten hard aan komt

MP Ulenbelt asked the State Secretary whether the very low interest rate hurting pension specialists means DNB and the AFM are wholly responsible for problems at their pension funds, and what the causes are and how they will be solved. The State Secretary answered that social partners and fund boards choose their ambitions, premiums and investment risks, that low rates tighten the trade-off between premium, risk and ambition, and that the government will not discuss individual funds but will respond to the SER exploration of alternative pension contracts before summer.
I do not want to go into the situation of individual pension funds.
Ik wil niet ingaan op de situatie van individuele pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat pensioenen steeds vaker naar België gaan om de kosten te drukken

An SP MP asked the government about reports that Dutch company pensions are increasingly moved to Belgium to cut costs, asking about reasons, consequences, governance, taxation and whether this exposes weaknesses in the Dutch system. The State Secretary answered that Belgian arrangements allow cheaper sponsor-guarantee treatment, that Dutch labour law, works council consent, DNB and AFM oversight still apply, that tax effects are limited, and that the IORP review aims to protect members while indexation remains a Dutch policy goal.
First, Dutch social and labour law remains applicable to this arrangement, so safeguards such as the prohibition on buy-out and the right to transfer value remain in force.
Ten eerste blijft het Nederlandse sociaal en arbeidsrecht van toepassing op deze regeling, waardoor waarborgen als het verbod op afkoop en het recht op waardeoverdracht van toepassing blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht “Pensioenfondsen verhuizen naar België”

An MP (Lodders, VVD) asked the state secretary about Dutch employers moving pension schemes to Belgian or other EU funds to cut costs, including whether Belgium indexes more easily, how many firms have moved, and whether the Netherlands is lagging on cross-border pension rules. The government answered that Dutch labour law and supervisory checks (DNB, AFM) still apply, that several firms have moved about 550 million euro, and that it will reassess cross-border rules after an EIOPA advice.
First, Dutch social and labour law remains applicable to this scheme, so safeguards such as the ban on cash-out and the right to value transfer remain in force.
Ten eerste blijft het Nederlandse sociaal en arbeidsrecht van toepassing op deze regeling, waardoor waarborgen als het verbod op afkoop en het recht op waardeoverdracht van toepassing blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over strafrechtelijke boetes in de schuldhulpverlening

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked about a Rotterdam court ruling forcing the CJIB into a debt-settlement arrangement, the inability to include recent versus nearly-expired criminal fines in voluntary debt schemes, and whether this would lead to more forced settlements. The State Secretary defended the enforcement of criminal fines, citing installment options, clemency, and the statute of limitations extension, and said he finds widespread final debt relief undesirable.
For Wahv sanctions, as stated in the answer to question 2, since 1 January 2016 further collection of outstanding Wahv sanctions is ended after a successfully completed voluntary debt settlement.

Voor de Wahv-sancties geldt dat, zoals in antwoord op vraag 2 gemeld, sinds 1 januari 2016 de verdere inning van openstaande Wahv-sancties wordt beëindigd na een succesvol afgeronde minnelijke schuldregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zorgelijke financiële positie van veel gepensioneerden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Secretary of State whether the financial position of middle-income pensioners, who miss out on many allowances, has worsened, whether pensions should be compensated for non-indexation, and whether the mandatory pension system unduly restricts members' freedom to safeguard accrued pensions. The Secretary of State acknowledged pressure on older people's incomes, pointed to CBS and CPB figures showing improvement and a 2016 purchasing-power rise for most older people, and defended compulsory pension participation as a core feature of the system.
Any imbalances in the purchasing-power picture for next year will be considered in the August budget decision-making.
Eventuele onevenwichtigheden in het koopkrachtbeeld voor volgend jaar zullen in de augustusbesluitvorming worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat driekwart van de bijstandsgerechtigden in Amsterdam geen sollicitatieplicht heeft

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether Amsterdam's exemptions from the job-seeking obligation for about three-quarters of welfare recipients amount to prohibited categorical exemptions, and what would be done to address the large group left without support. The State Secretary replied that Amsterdam applies individual tailoring via a participation ladder, that about 30% of the long-distance group has temporary exemptions for individual reasons, that supervision of municipal implementation lies primarily with the municipality and the Inspectie SZW will not investigate, and that she will visit municipalities and rely on Divosa for knowledge development.
The primary responsibility for checking the lawful implementation of the Participatiewet lies with the municipality, and the municipal council has a supervisory role in this.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor de controle op de rechtmatige uitvoering van de Participatiewet ligt bij de gemeente en de gemeenteraad heeft daarbij een controlerende rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Vermeij over het bericht ‘Een op de zeven Hagenaars heeft schulden’

MPs Yücel and Vermeij asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that one in seven residents of The Hague has debts, and about debt relief, financial education and the role of various institutions. The State Secretary acknowledged the economic hardship, pointed to signs of recovery and existing support measures, said the Debt Relief Act is being evaluated with results due by 1 July, and described financial education initiatives and ongoing consultations.
I will send your House the results, including a government response, by 1 July this year.
Ik zal uw Kamer de resultaten inclusief een reactie van het kabinet, uiterlijk 1 juli dit jaar toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat schoonmakers uitgebuit worden in hotels

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that hotel cleaners are exploited and paid below the minimum wage, including at Bastion hotels, and what measures will be taken. The minister said fair pay is important, that the Inspectie SZW monitors compliance and inspectors are trained to spot signs of labour exploitation, while enforcement of the collective agreement is primarily the responsibility of the social partners.
When social partners suspect the collective agreement is not being complied with, they can, under article 10 of the AVV Act, submit a request to the Inspectorate SZW to investigate.
Wanneer sociale partners vermoeden dat de cao niet wordt nageleefd, kunnen zij op grond van artikel 10 van de wet AVV bij de Inspectie SZW een verzoek indienen om hier onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ‘de aantasting van de pensioenen’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether ECB policy threatens pensions, whether rate windfalls on state debt could fund AOW or pension compensation, and whether the mandatory supplementary pension should be replaced by an opt-out. The government said it is in talks with social partners, DNB and others and will send a DNB report in May, declined to make theoretical windfall calculations, would consider pensioners in the purchasing-power decisions, and kept mandatory pension participation while planning a differentiated approach to be sent to parliament before summer.
In May the cabinet will send the DNB report with an assessment of the figures to your House.
In mei stuurt het kabinet de rapportage van DNB met een appreciatie van het cijferbeeld naar uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Vaker betalingsachterstand na slechte financiële opvoeding’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about a Nibud report linking poor financial upbringing to payment arrears among young people, and what role government, schools, and businesses should play in financial education. The State Secretary endorsed the findings, described shared responsibility of parents and schools, listed existing support for financial education and Wijzer in Geldzaken, and noted that the new curriculum process and sector-led initiatives are underway.
I recognise and endorse the conclusions of the Nibud.
De conclusies van het Nibud herken en onderschrijf ik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jadnanansing over financiële ondersteuning voor volwassen scholieren

MPs Kerstens and Jadnanansing asked what financial support exists for adult pupils aged 18 and over who are not yet in a vocational or higher education programme, whether they face income loss, and what municipalities can do. The state secretary explained the DUO pupil allowance, the rules for the period before study finance and general assistance, and said municipalities hold individual discretion, while not holding data on municipal practice.
I do not have information on how municipalities deal with adult pupils who have not yet started an education programme.
Ik beschik niet over informatie hoe gemeenten omgaan met de volwassen scholieren die nog niet aan een opleiding zijn begonnen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat vijftig schoonmakers in Dordrecht worden ontslagen en dat hun werk wordt overgenomen door mensen met een uitkering en/of werkers van de sociale werkvoorzienin

An SP MP asked whether Dordrecht's outsourcing of cleaning work to people on benefits and sheltered-employment workers, replacing dismissed regular cleaners, amounts to displacement of paid work and what the government will do. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for preventing displacement, that the Inspectorate SZW supervises only aggregate municipal performance, and that municipalities may choose how to contract cleaning, without committing to new action.
Responsibility for adequately monitoring the prevention of displacement of paid work lies expressly with the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het adequaat toezien op het voorkomen van verdringing van betaalde arbeid ligt uitdrukkelijk bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat gemeenten in 2015 een half miljard euro tekort hebben op de bijzondere bijstand

Karabulut (SP) asks how the government reacts to reports that municipalities face a half-billion euro shortfall on special assistance in 2015, whether it will compensate municipalities for asylum-related costs and rising trusteeship costs, and whether it will compensate them for austerity-driven pressure. The state secretary rejects the premise of a earmarked budget, points to the reconstructed allocation in the municipal fund, and promises monitoring and a follow-up study without committing to new compensation.
The funds for special assistance form part of the general grant of the municipal fund and are therefore freely available for spending.
De middelen voor bijzondere bijstand maken onderdeel uit van de algemene uitkering van het gemeentefonds en zijn daarmee vrij besteedbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘gemeenten mensen met problematische schulden niet helpen’

MPs Karabulut (SP) asked the state secretary about a broadcast reporting that municipalities refuse debt help to people with problematic debts, asking about waiting times, incapable court-appointed administrators, and inequality. The government replied that the Wgs forbids categorical exclusion, pointed to guidance and an ongoing evaluation, cited new quality rules and centralised checks for administrators, and listed debt-reduction measures, mostly without new commitments or hard figures.
That is why the Wgs also sets a maximum waiting time of 4 weeks from request for help to first interview and an obligation to give the person seeking help insight into processing times.
Daarom kent de Wgs ook een maximumwachttijd van 4 weken van hulpvraag tot eerste gesprek en een verplichting om de hulpvrager inzicht te bieden in de doorlooptijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het bericht ‘Europese stresstest bevestigt kwetsbaarheden pensioenfondsen’

MP Vermeij asked the State Secretary about an EIOPA stress test showing Dutch pension funds are vulnerable: low buffers, high risk profiles, the rate sensitivity of the FTK, and options for relief in the low-rate environment. The State Secretary largely defended the FTK, promised a May update on funds' financial position and risk profile, and said DNB and AFM are scrutinising funds' communication to members.
Yes. In May I will send you an update on the financial position of pension funds, including an assessment by the cabinet.
Ja. In mei zal ik u een update sturen van de financiële positie van de pensioenfondsen, inclusief een appreciatie van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Nijkerken-De Haan over Suwinet

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Nijkerken-De Haan asked whether the government will act against municipalities whose protection of citizens' personal data on the SUWI-net system is inadequate, including fines and escalation. The Secretary of State says the Inspectorate has sent 198 municipalities non-compliance warnings with 6 to 12 week deadlines, that an instruction (aanwijzing) and, as a last resort, disconnection from SUWI-net are possible, and that 192 municipalities now meet all seven essential standards.

Following the Inspectorate SZW investigation started in September 2015 into the security of SUWInet, I have sent the 198 municipalities that do not meet all 7 essential standards a notice of intent to issue an instruction.

Ik heb naar aanleiding van het onderzoek dat de Inspectie SZW in september 2015 is gestart naar de beveiliging van SUWInet de 198 gemeenten die niet voldoen aan alle 7 essentiële normen een aankondiging tot een aanwijzing gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat het langer doorwerken voor veel zestigplussers niet mee valt

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asked the state secretary for Social Affairs and Employment how the government responds to reports that working longer is hard for many people aged 60 and over, including the anger this causes, its effects on sick leave, unemployment among young and older workers, and widening inequality. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, defended the pension age increase as necessary due to ageing and the crisis, and pointed to existing measures and a forthcoming action plan for older workers.
In the spring an action plan should be ready with measures to further improve the labour market position of older people.
In het voorjaar moet er een actieplan gereed zijn met maatregelen die de arbeidsmarktpositie van ouderen verder moet verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het oplossen van de problematiek rondom het zogenaamde ‘papieren inkomen’

MPs Voortman and Grashoff asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about the unresolved problem of 'papieren inkomen' arising from debt-forgiveness of Bbz start-up loans, which raises tax-credit (toeslag) income tests. The government confirms the problem persists, says a structural fix via taxation is under study with municipalities and other departments, promises to inform the Ombudsman and the House by year-end, and defers any retroactive arrangement.
Once a solution is in view, we will inform the Ombudsman and the House of Representatives.
Als een oplossing in beeld is, zullen wij de Ombudsman en de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over verdringing van vast personeel door vrijwilligers

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked the state secretary about volunteers replacing paid staff at the Dukenburg swimming pool, and what rules prevent such displacement of paid work. The state secretary said existing Participation Act rules and guidance already address displacement, that the local council must judge the risk case by case, and that no stronger national rules are needed for now.
It is not for me to interfere in the local discussion about how the swimming pool is operated.
Het is niet aan mij om me te mengen in de lokale discussie over de wijze van exploitatie van het zwembad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het manifest van de gezamenlijke ouderenorganisaties

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the government takes seriously the joint elderly organisations' manifesto on pension funds and will act on it. The State Secretary acknowledged broad concern about pension fund coverage ratios, promised a May update to parliament including the elderly organisations' concerns, and noted the government repaired purchasing power for elderly and benefit recipients for 2016.
In May I will send you an update on the financial position of the pension funds, including an assessment by the cabinet.
In mei zal ik u een update sturen van de financiële positie van de pensioenfondsen, inclusief een appreciatie van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Wajonger kan uitkering kwijtraken’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs whether Wajongers would be re-assessed after 2018 and lose their benefits, as reported by Trouw. The government answered that the reclassification only determines work capacity, that benefits drop from 75% to 70% of minimum wage for those with capacity, and that no benefit entitlement is revoked.
It is not correct that all Wajongers will be re-assessed from 2018.
Het klopt niet dat alle Wajongers vanaf 2018 opnieuw zullen worden gekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de brief ‘Uitvoering motie Export AOW-uitkeringen’

Schut-Welkzijn (VVD) asked the State Secretary how many AOW recipients would benefit from social security treaties with countries receiving over 100 AOW payments, whether such treaties cover only AOW, what the costs would be, and whether new treaties should pause until per-country assessments are done. The State Secretary answered that about 184 single AOW recipients in three countries could gain, that only AOW is covered, that costs cannot yet be estimated, and that per-country enforceability analyses will be used before any treaty is concluded.
I cannot yet give you a reliable indication of the (additional) implementation costs associated with the enforcement agreements still to be made with these countries.
Over de (extra) uitvoeringskosten die verband houden met de nog met deze landen te maken handhavingsafspraken kan ik u op dit moment nog geen betrouwbare indicatie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht  ‘We hebben helemaal geen pensioenprobleem’

An MP asked the state secretary whether pension funds receive more premiums than they pay out, whether using long-term returns instead of the risk-free rate would solve pension problems, and whether guaranteed pensions should be abolished as an illusion. The state secretary answered that funds take in more premiums than they pay out, rejected using expected long-term returns as the discount rate, defended buffers, and deferred the question of abolishing guaranteed pensions to a forthcoming debate.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of that, because we will be discussing them in your House soon.
Op de uitkomsten daarvan wil ik niet vooruitlopen, want we gaan daar binnenkort in uw Kamer over spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Gerard van Olphen nieuwe baas APG’

An MP asked whether the €566,000 salary of the new APG chief executive, the pension investor of ABP, is acceptable, whether any severance was agreed, and whether the minister will intervene to reverse the pay agreement. The Secretary of State said APG has reported a salary about 10% lower than its predecessor with no bonus, that she had earlier said a downward adjustment would be good, that she is unaware of any severance agreement, and that the government has no say over APG's pay and the director falls outside the pay-cap law.
At the same time, I am aware that the cabinet is not responsible for the level of remuneration of executives of market parties.
Tegelijkertijd ben ik mij er van bewust dat het kabinet niet gaat over de hoogte van de beloningen van bestuurders van marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper Van Dijk over studieschuld als nieuwe restschuld en zieke werknemers als gevolg van schuld

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked whether student debt reduces mortgage capacity, can be concealed when applying for a mortgage, causes problem debts among workers, and whether sickness absence linked to financial problems will be investigated and addressed. The government answered that student loans are weighted lower than consumer credit in mortgage assessments, that lenders' duty of care and applicants' disclosure duty suffice, that repayment is income-contingent with debt forgiveness after 35 years, and that it will await TNO research results and develop a website for employers on financial problems.
To verify the amount of the student debt, and thus as proof, the former student can simply print an overview from mijnDUO.
Ter verificatie van de hoogte van de studieschuld en dus als bewijsstuk, kan de oud-student eenvoudigweg een overzicht vanuit mijnDUO uitdraaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over problemen bij verrekening pensioen na echtscheiding

An SP MP asked about problems dividing pensions after divorce, including pre-1995 divorces, miscalculation by funds and insurers, and claims exceeding 100% of pension. The State Secretary answered that pre-1995 cases fall under case law (reasonableness and fairness), that no legal rules exist for calculation dates, that she knows of no such over-100% cases, and that she sees no need for new measures, pointing to the courts.
These divorces are governed by the case-law rule of reasonableness and fairness.
Deze scheidingen worden beheerst door de jurisprudentiële regeling van redelijkheid en billijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Recourt over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep over boetes voor bijstandsfraude

MPs Kerstens and Recourt asked the government how it responds to Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings requiring that social assistance fraud fines take account of the offender's financial capacity, and what this means for fine policy and legislation. Minister Asscher answered that fines must be proportionate to income and assets, that the ruling does not require changing the law or regulation now, and that a bill amending the social security acts on administrative fines was sent to parliament.
In its ruling, the CRvB holds that an administrative fine may not disproportionately affect a person's income and assets.
In zijn uitspraak oordeelt de CRvB dat een bestuurlijke boete een betrokkene niet onevenredig in zijn inkomen en vermogen mag treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het interview met de directeur van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank

An MP asked the state secretaries about SVB director Nicoly Vermeulen's remarks on 'framing' and problems with paying pgb carers, the delayed compensation scheme, monthly mutations and the SVB's organisational culture. The government answered that the problems span the whole chain, that the damage was estimated at 6 to 9 percent of payments, that a chain-wide improvement plan is being developed, and that the director's appointment was ended.
In accordance with the motion, the House will be informed in the first quarter of 2016 about the concretely elaborated plan.
Conform de motie zal de Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2016 over het concreet uitgewerkte plan worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘dat werkgevers veel minder banen voor mensen met een arbeidsbeperking hebben gerealiseerd’.

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that employers have created far fewer jobs for people with work disabilities than promised, including unfilled vacancies and temporary contracts. The state secretary replied that AWVN-supported employers have registered 7,653 workplace ambitions with 3,089 jobs realised among 120 employers, that most vacancies are adapted functions, and that the government will measure the banenafspraak results around summer 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Bouwmeester en Otwin van Dijk over het onderzoek ‘Geldzaken in de praktijk 2015’ van het Nibud

MPs Yücel, Bouwmeester and Otwin van Dijk asked about Nibud findings on debt arrears driven by health costs, low public awareness of financial aid, the role of municipalities and integrated financial desks, and how health-cost compensation is made known and used. The government answered that it monitors low incomes, that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance and receive extra funding, and that it is running information campaigns on the deductible and health-cost compensation.
In response to this motion I visited the Geldloket in Amersfoort.
In reactie op deze motie ben ik op bezoek geweest bij het Geldloket in Amersfoort.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Dordrecht schoonmakers wil ontslaan om hun werkzaamheden uit te laten voeren door mensen met een uitkering en/ of werkers van de sociale werkvoorz

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Dordrecht's plan to dismiss fifty cleaners and hand their work to welfare recipients and sheltered-work employees is permitted under the Participatiewet, and whether displacement of paid work is acceptable and warrants an Inspectorate investigation. The state secretary answered that the GR Drechtsteden chose not to renew its commercial cleaning contract and reorganised the work internally, that displacement risk is a municipal matter for the council to monitor, and that the Inspectorate does not supervise individual municipalities.
However, the risk of displacement can only be assessed case by case and at local level; this is a municipal task.
Het risico op verdringing kan echter alleen per geval en op lokaal niveau worden beoordeeld, dit betreft een gemeentelijke taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat buschauffeurs worden vervangen door medewerkers van de sociale werkplaats"

An MP asked whether Meppel replacing bus drivers with social workplace and benefit recipients, including unpaid 'tegenprestatie' riders, is desirable and whether it displaces paid work. The government answered that the choice lies with the municipality and its council, that the Inspectie SZW will not investigate individual municipalities, and that displacement means unfair competition causing job loss.
No, it is not the task of the Inspectie SZW to supervise individual municipalities. The municipal council has a supervisory task here.
Nee, het is geen taak van de Inspectie SZW om toezicht te houden op individuele gemeenten. De gemeenteraad heeft hier een controlerende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het CBS-rapport ‘Armoede en sociale uitsluiting 2015’

An MP asks the State Secretary about the CBS poverty report 2015, including whether the projected small fall in low-income households is a lasting trend and how the structural 100 million euro for poverty reduction reaches households with children. The State Secretary answers that the decline is welcome and hoped to be a lasting trend, describes the municipal use of funds and sports/culture participation measures, and outlines employment and integration measures for groups at higher risk.
I have asked municipalities to pay special attention to children in poverty when intensifying their poverty and debt policy.
Ik heb gemeenten gevraagd om bij de intensivering van hun armoede- en schuldenbeleid speciale aandacht te besteden aan kinderen in armoede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het oneigenlijk gebruik van de pensioenknip

An MP asked the State Secretary about pension insurers that only offer the pension lump-sum option (pensioenknip) to their own members, and whether insurers should be pressed to accept outsiders and present balanced information. The State Secretary said insurers are not obliged to issue offers to outside members due to contractual freedom, but committed to raise the matter with the Verbond van Verzekeraars and to keep monitoring information provision.
I will raise this point again with the Verbond van Verzekeraars to encourage insurers to treat requests for the pension lump-sum option in a benevolent manner.
Ik zal dit punt nogmaals bespreken met het Verbond van Verzekeraars om te bevorderen dat verzekeraars welwillend omgaan met verzoeken voor de pensioenknip.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over onterechte kortingen op toeslagen en uitkeringen vanwege een afgekocht pensioen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about unlawful reductions in benefits and allowances (rent allowance, AOW partner allowance, Anw and bridging benefit) after small pensions were bought out, and about SVB advice discouraging objections and the failure to fix the problem for two years. The State Secretary answered that the rules were changed from 1 December 2014, that an internal SVB investigation found no proof people were deterred from objecting though some may have felt objections were pointless, and that the SVB was asked to fully revise 2013–2014 decisions as a goodwill gesture.
Given the combination of circumstances, I have decided to ask the SVB to fully revise decisions on buy-outs of small pensions reduced between 1 January 2013 and 1 December 2014.

Ik heb besloten om, gezien de samenloop van omstandigheden, de SVB te verzoeken besluiten ten aanzien van de afkoop van klein pensioenen die gekort zijn in de periode van 1 januari 2013 tot 1 december 2014 volledig te herzien
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut inzake de sluiting van leerwerkbedrijven

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked why the Werkartaal social-firm training provider for vulnerable youth and others is closing, whether the Participatiewet cuts are harming vulnerable groups, and what the government will do to preserve such pathways. The minister answers that the closure stems from lack of participants and falling employer demand, that the government cannot support individual private work-learning companies, and that gemeenten and other providers can take over.
The Ministry of OCW therefore cannot take measures to support an individual work-learning company that is in financial distress.
Het Ministerie van OCW kan dan ook geen maatregelen nemen om een individueel leerwerkbedrijf dat in financiële nood verkeert te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Albert de Vries over de wijze waarop hypotheekverstrekkers omgaan met herbeoordelingen van het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Kerstens and De Vries asked whether mortgage lenders are excluding the full Wajong benefit from income calculations because of possible 5% reductions under the Participatiewet, and whether the minister would negotiate with lenders. The state secretary replied that a reduction would not justify excluding the whole benefit, that the NHG website was corrected, that 53 NHG loans with Wajong income were granted in 2015, and that banks generally count benefits that are permanent or guaranteed for their duration.
I share your view that the possible reduction of the Wajong benefit from 2018 should not lead to the entire benefit no longer being counted in a mortgage granting.
Ik deel uw mening dat de mogelijke verlaging van de Wajong uitkering vanaf 2018 er niet toe zou moeten leiden dat de gehele uitkering niet meer wordt meegenomen bij een hypotheekverstrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht dat Amsterdam nee zegt tegen de taaleis in het kader van de bijstand

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether she knows Amsterdam refuses to apply the language requirement for social assistance and offers free vet visits to low-income residents, and asked what action she will take to enforce the statutory language requirement in all municipalities. The State Secretary answered that the Participatiewet is decentralised, that municipal councils and officials are primarily responsible for implementation and supervision, and that she trusts municipalities to apply the law properly, without committing to new measures.
The Participatiewet, of which the language requirement is part, has been decentralised to the municipalities.
De Participatiewet, waarvan de taaleis onderdeel uitmaakt, is gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kerstens over het bericht dat steeds meer kinderen opgroeien in de bijstand

MPs Yücel and Kerstens asked the state secretary about reports that more children are growing up on social assistance, and what is being done to prevent child poverty and support children's participation. The state secretary answered that the rise is mainly due to the economic crisis and divorce, pointed to work as the main route out of poverty, described municipal child packages and extra funding, and promised to alert municipalities and fund projects.

I will actively draw municipalities' attention in the next collective letter to the findings of the research on experiences with the child package, and call on them to pay special attention to involving children in child-oriented poverty policy and reaching children.

Ik zal gemeenten in de volgende verzamelbrief actief attenderen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de ervaringen met het kindpakket en hen daarbij oproepen om speciale aandacht te besteden aan het betrekken van kinderen bij het kindgericht armoedebeleid en aan het bereiken van kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over de handelspraktijken van incassobureaus

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked about debt collection agencies' practices, including excessive pressure, threats of measures they cannot legally take, excessive collection costs and time-barred claims, and whether fines or consumer protection would follow the ACM report. The minister answers that no fines have yet been imposed, that the ACM and AFM will act jointly, that consumers can reclaim undue costs and seek legal advice, and that she rejects making excessive collection costs a tort, citing existing remedies.
At this moment, no fines have yet been imposed for the problems identified in the report.
Op dit moment zijn voor de in het rapport gesignaleerde problemen nog geen boetes opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermuë over een werkbezoek aan sw-bedrijf Dethon

MPs Kerstens and Vermue asked whether the ban on wage deductions in the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies would unintentionally hinder sheltered-employment firms from deducting rent from workers' pay, and whether action would be taken. Minister Asscher answered that the ban is not meant to harm sheltered workers, that he will seriously consider an exception, and that deductions remain permitted until 1 July 2016, with a letter to parliament promised in early 2016.
Therefore I will also seriously consider an exception for this group.
Daarom zal ik een uitzondering voor deze groep ook serieus overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over het bericht dat huurverhogingen leiden tot armoede

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked whether rent increases cause poverty and whether the government will curb rents and help affected tenants. The minister answered that income drops drive payment problems, that the rent-cap agreement and bill are in progress, refused a rent freeze, and pointed the tenant to rent reduction and housing-allocation options.
No, I am not willing to oblige landlords to freeze rents.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid verhuurders te verplichten de huren te bevriezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de representativiteit van beroepspensioenfondsen

MP Vermeij asked the State Secretary whether the 55% self-employed threshold for mandatory occupational pension schemes should be waived to protect employees in sectors like veterinarians and physiotherapists, and for a lasting solution. The State Secretary answered that employees will not be excluded from the mandatory scheme solely for failing the threshold, that representativeness will still be assessed separately for each group, and that she will seek a durable solution in consultation with the sector and social partners.

I find it undesirable that, as a result of changed labour market circumstances, employees could be placed outside the occupational pension scheme solely because the scheme fails the requirement of at least 55% self-employed members.

Ik vind het ongewenst dat als gevolg van veranderde omstandigheden op de arbeidsmarkt beroepsgenoten in loondienst alleen wegens het niet voldoen aan het verhoudingsvereiste van minimaal 55% zelfstandige beroepsgenoten, buiten de werking van de beroepspensioenregeling geplaatst zouden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de procedure herindeling Wajong

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about the UWV procedure for reassessing young disabled people (Wajong), including people with a day-care indication and those who no longer meet Wsw minimum criteria, and whether they could go straight to Wajong without a new procedure. The government answered that people with an AWBZ day-care indication are presumed to have no work capacity and are not invited, that no data exist on those unknown to UWV because no legal basis for data exchange with CIZ exists, and that no one had been invited in the first two quarters of 2015.
On your question whether I have insight into the size of the group of Wajong recipients with a day-care indication of whom UWV is unaware, I must answer that no data on this are known.
Op uw vraag of ik inzicht heb in de omvang van de groep Wajongers met een indicatie dagbesteding zonder dat UWV hiervan op de hoogte is, moet ik u antwoorden dat hierover geen gegevens bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘In 2020 veel meer mensen gekort dan ufr-rapport veronderstelt’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about press reports that pension funds may need to cut benefits by 2020, questioning the assumed funding ratios, premium coverage and the revised ultimate forward rate (ufr) method. The State Secretary answered that about 700,000 participants could face an average cut of around 3% in 2020 under fund recovery plans, that the outcome depends on economic developments, and that the ufr is set by the independent supervisor DNB on the advice of an independent committee.
The cabinet considers it important that the interest rate pension funds must use is shaped as realistically as possible.
Het kabinet vindt het van belang dat de rente waar pensioenfondsen mee moeten rekenen zo realistisch mogelijk wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Rotterdamse bijstandsgerechtigden verplicht papier moeten prikken als tegenprestatie

Karabulut (SP) asked the State Secretary about reports that Rotterdam welfare recipients must do unpaid work such as paper-picking as a counter-performance, including SDW's costs, displacement risk, and the Rotterdam ombudsman's findings. Secretary Klijnsma answered that WerkLoont is a reintegration programme rather than a counter-performance, that implementation and oversight lie with Rotterdam's municipal council and mayor and alderman, and that the minister has no role to judge the local practice.
Given the decentralised character of the Participation Act, municipalities have considerable policy and implementation freedom to shape participation and reintegration policy.
Gemeenten hebben gezien het decentrale karakter van de Participatiewet een grote beleids- en uitvoeringsvrijheid om het participatie- en re-integratiebeleid vorm en inhoud te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht dat bedrijven uit het Europees Sociaal Fonds (ESF) yogalessen voor personeel gesubsidieerd kunnen krijgen

An MP asked whether yoga and mindfulness subsidies from the European Social Fund are appropriate after a company reported being told such lessons qualify. The State Secretary replied that yoga does not fall under ESF criteria, the agency told the provider to remove the incorrect information, and such applications will be rejected.
The Agency SZW will reject such subsidy applications in accordance with my answer to question 2.
Het Agentschap SZW zal dergelijke subsidie-aanvragen afkeuren conform mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Oosenbrug over stopgezette uitkeringen als gevolg van onderzoeken van externe bureaus ingehuurd door gemeenten

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary whether municipal outsourcing of benefit fraud investigations to commercial bureaus led to wrongly stopped benefits, clawbacks and fines, and whether those decisions should be reconsidered. The State Secretary said Article 7(4) of the Participatiewet bars outsourcing the establishment of rights and duties, that Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings confirm outsourcing of investigation is not allowed, that colleges may revise earlier decisions, and that she will ask municipalities with signals of unlawful outsourcing for information and may issue a binding instruction if needed.
It is up to the colleges of mayor and aldermen to consider, in appropriate cases, how they deal with 'old' cases.
Het is aan de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders om in voorkomende gevallen te bezien hoe zij omgaan met «oude» gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘de gemeente Almere mensen in de bijstand dwingt om onderbetaald werk uit te voeren’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Almere forces welfare recipients into underpaid work, whether this displaces regular workers, whether the Participatiewet should be changed, and about JS Consultancy's earnings and EU subsidies. The government denies compulsion, describes the arrangement as a werkervaringstraject for higher-educated welfare recipients with a training and coaching phase, rejects displacement and any need to amend the law, and says it has no information on JS Consultancy's earnings.
Based on the information provided to me by the municipality of Almere, I cannot endorse your claim that the municipality obliges welfare recipients to perform underpaid work.
Op basis van de mij beschikbaar gestelde informatie van de gemeente Almere kan ik uw stelling dat de gemeente bijstandsgerechtigden verplicht om onderbetaald werk uit te voeren niet onderschrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken - De Haan over "het bericht dat Amsterdam de bijstandswet ontduikt"

An MP asks whether Amsterdam circumvents the cost-sharing norm in the new Participatiewet by granting extra special assistance, and whether other municipalities do the same. The State Secretary replies that implementation is a municipal responsibility, that Amsterdam grants special assistance after individual case review, that no national data exist on similar practices, and that she has asked the VNG for implementation signals.
Implementation of the Participatiewet is a competence and responsibility of the municipal executive (college van burgemeester en wethouders).
De uitvoering van de Participatiewet is een bevoegd- en verantwoordelijkheid van het college van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitvoering van de aanpassing van het Schattingsbesluit arbeidsongeschiktheidswetten

An SP MP asked the minister about the first experiences with the amended Schattingsbesluit, the income losses for disability benefit recipients, possible compensation, and notification timing. The minister answered that few people are affected so far, that UWV notifies recipients individually with a transition period to 1 July 2016, and that no additional compensation will be provided because the change saves UWV administration costs.
This means that only after 1 July 2016 could it be examined what the actual income loss has been.
Dit betekent dat pas na 1 juli 2016 onderzocht zou kunnen worden wat de feitelijke inkomensachteruitgang is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aantasting van de financiële positie van grote pensioenfondsen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about the financial position of large pension funds, asking whether an opt-out from mandatory supplementary pension and conversion of contributions into gross salary is possible. The State Secretary answered that the cabinet wants to keep a form of mandatory participation, while pursuing a differentiated approach such as opt-out defaults, a fund for flexworkers and more customisation.
The cabinet believes that some form of mandatory participation for employees must be maintained.
