Het kabinet vindt dat een vorm van verplichtstelling voor werknemers daarbij moet worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over knelpunten in de inkomensvoorziening voor jongeren met opgeschorte Wajong-2015

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked whether severely multiply disabled young people over 18 can continue learning and what support exists after the Wajong-2015 study allowance ended. The government replied that vso attendance is possible until age 20 with exemptions, that gemeenten may grant studietoeslag or bijzondere bijstand, and that it has no insight into how many municipalities provide bijzondere bijstand to this group.
I have no insight into the extent to which municipalities provide individual special assistance to severely multiply disabled young people aged 18 and over without labour market prospects.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de mate waarin gemeenten individuele bijzondere bijstand verstrekken aan meervoudig gehandicapte jongeren van 18 jaar en ouder zonder arbeidsmarktperspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Koser-Kaya, Karabulut en Schouten over de brief ‘Eerste tussenmeting banenafspraak’

MPs asked about Wsw sheltered-employment placements, waiting-list trends, hours worked and job counts under the banenafspraak (jobs agreement) for disabled workers in 2013-2014. The state secretary answered with Panteia and UWV figures, showing a shift from sheltered workshops to external placements and an increase of 7,304 unique extra jobs, and said the 2015 results would follow around summer 2016.
You will receive the answers in advance of the General Consultation on the Participation Act of 29 October.
U ontvangt de antwoorden voorafgaand aan het Algemeen overleg Participatiewet van 29 oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een verlamde Haagse jongen gewoon moet solliciteren

An SP MP asked the state secretary how a paralysed, ventilator-dependent young man on a Wajong benefit could receive a preliminary notice that he has working capacity and must apply for jobs, and whether similar cases exist. The state secretary answered that the UWV's reassessment procedure relies on existing records, that the recipient can object and obtain a full assessment, that no comparable cases are known, and that the UWV has since started a reassessment of this case.
The UWV has since received a response form in which the person concerned states that he does not agree with the proposed classification.
Het UWV heeft inmiddels een reactieformulier ontvangen waarin betrokkene aangeeft niet akkoord te gaan met de voorgenomen indeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht 'Gemeente Enschede frustreert aanvragen bijstand'

Karabulut (SP) asked the state secretary to respond to the Ombudsman's finding that Enschede imposes a four-week search period on benefit applicants aged 27 and over, and whether this breaches the Participatiewet and whether other municipalities do the same. The state secretary said the Ombudsman found Enschede's information about direct applications unclear, that the municipal council and ultimately the courts are responsible for oversight, that no signals exist of Rotterdam or other municipalities imposing the same term, and that no directive (aanwijzing) is warranted since the letter of the law is not breached.
It is up to the municipal council to monitor the implementation of Enschede's policy and, if there is reason to do so, to raise it at the council meeting.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om de uitvoering van het beleid van de gemeente Enschede te controleren en, indien daar aanleiding toe is, in de Raadsvergadering aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat éénvijfde van de oud-studenten wanbetaler is

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers whether one in five former students being in arrears on student loan repayment is worrying, what measures will prevent further debt, and whether enforcement and the draagkracht scheme work as intended. The minister answered that arrears are varied (many small), that the share has stayed around 20 percent, that new measures and stricter enforcement are being used, and that the government does not expect the new loan system to produce more defaulters, but no new concrete commitments beyond existing monitoring were given.
It is correct that 20.6 percent of former students with a repayment obligation have a payment arrear (as of 1 June 2015).
Het klopt dat 20,6 procent van de oud-studenten met een terugbetaalverplichting een betalingsachterstand heeft (stand per 1 juni 2015).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over het afschaffen van de kwijtschelding van de heffing voor de zuivering van afvalwater door het waterschap Delfland

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked about Delfland water board's plan to phase out remission of its wastewater treatment levy, its consistency with the Unie van Waterschappen advice and interbestuurlijke cooperation, and effects on low incomes and municipal debt and poverty policy. Minister Plasterk answered that water boards decide on remission democratically, that the Waterwet cooperation is unaffected by levy remission, and that the Staatssecretaris will invite the Unie van Waterschappen for a discussion.
The starting point is the freedom of each water board to shape and determine its remission policy in a democratic deliberative process.
Voorop staat de vrijheid van elk waterschap om zijn kwijtscheldingsbeleid in een democratisch afwegingsproces vorm en inhoud te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht “Bankieren duurder voor kwetsbaren”

Karabulut (SP) asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about ABN AMRO raising bank tariffs for professional debt administrators (bewindvoerders) managing accounts of vulnerable people, and whether the government would intervene. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that tariffs are a matter for banks themselves, that the government sees no reason for measures despite state shareholding, and that dialogue between banks and administrators is advisable.
That said, setting tariffs is a matter for which banks themselves are responsible.
Vooropgesteld moet echter worden dat de tariefstelling bij banken een aangelegenheid is waarvoor de banken zelf verantwoordelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over onbereikbaar zijn van duur MBO voor kinderen van minima

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about reports that expensive MBO vocational education is out of reach for children of low-income families, with some schools redirecting pupils who cannot pay to other options or to Leergeld foundations. The minister says the situation is unwelcome, that schools may require only tuition and not other fees, that the inspectorate monitors school-cost policy, and that she will ask the MBO Raad to promote instalment payment schemes and report back to parliament.
I will inform your House of this in writing.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover schriftelijke informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Yücel over minimagezinnen waarvoor de kosten van mbo-opleidingen voor hun kinderen onbetaalbaar zouden worden

MPs Jadnanansing and Yücel asked whether low-income families can afford mbo school costs now that the WTOS allowance for under-18s was abolished, and whether this forces students to drop out. The minister acknowledges the change makes payment harder, says about 27,000 students previously received WTOS and that the kindgebonden budget increase compensates most, points to school payment plans and local funds, and says municipalities are responsible for local support.
It is true that the income-dependent allowance for education contributions and school costs (WTOS) for parents of children under 18 ceased to exist from school year 2015/2016.
Het klopt dat de inkomensafhankelijke tegemoetkoming in de onderwijsbijdrage en schoolkosten (WTOS) voor ouders met kinderen jonger dan 18 jaar vanaf schooljaar 2015/2016 is opgehouden te bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat het Hoogheemraadschap Delfland stopt met het kwijtschelden van waterschapsbelasting aan minima

MPs asked the government whether it supports municipalities' calls for Hoogheemraadschap Delfland to keep waiving water board charges for low-income residents, and about waterschap waiver policy generally. The state secretary answered that waiver decisions belong to each water board's democratically elected general board, that all water boards currently grant waivers, and that he plans to invite the Unie van Waterschappen to discuss poverty and debt.
Setting the level of water board charges and whether to waive them in whole or in part is decided in a democratic process.
Het vaststellen van de hoogte van de waterschapsbelastingen en het al dan niet (gedeeltelijk) kwijtschelden van waterschapsbelastingen wordt in een democratisch proces bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over pensioenopbouw van medisch specialisten

An MP asked whether the pension cap in the Witteveen Act treats full-time doctors working over 40 hours unfairly compared with those working 36 or 38 hours, and why no exception was made. The State Secretary answered that there is no statutory full-time threshold, that the cap is pro-rated for part-time work to prevent splitting contracts, and that changing the law is not desirable.
I therefore do not consider an amendment of the law desirable.
Een aanpassing van de wet acht ik daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Agema en Wilders over het artikel 'Ouderen op zwart zaad'

PVV MPs asked the government to respond to an article on elderly people's poor finances, calling the situation a disgrace and accusing the government of undermining elderly care, the state pension and pensions. The minister replied that elderly purchasing power has declined due to pension fund problems and budget measures, that low incomes were protected, that long-term care was reformed, and that purchasing power will be reviewed annually with measures in the budget if needed.
Each year the integrated purchasing power picture, including that of the elderly, is weighed for the coming year and the cabinet takes measures where necessary, within the available budgetary room.
Jaarlijks wordt het integrale koopkrachtbeeld, waaronder die van ouderen, voor het komende jaar gewogen en treft het kabinet zo nodig, binnen de beschikbare budgettaire ruimte, maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Anne Mulder over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan gratis geld uitdelen’

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Mulder asked whether municipal plans to hand out unconditional money, reported in the press, fit the experiment clause (art. 83) of the Participation Act and whether gemeenten know the rules on part-time and temporary work. The state secretary said no concrete proposals had been received, that details must be assessed first, and that an experiment would need an AMvB with parliamentary pre-consultation, while promising to inform municipalities again after a bill passes.
An experiment deviating from the statutory framework of the Participation Act can take place only if it is regulated by an AMvB under article 83(2).
Een eventueel experiment waarin wordt afgeweken van de wettelijke kaders van de Participatiewet kan plaatsvinden indien dit bij AMvB op grond van artikel 83 2 wordt geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de mogelijkheid van leerlingenvervoer naar de buitenschoolse opvang

An SP MP asked whether municipalities should be made to provide adapted transport from special schools to after-school care for children with disabilities, since parents may be forced to stop working. The State Secretary answered that the arrangement covers home-school transport only, that after-school transport is the parents' responsibility, and that existing hardship clauses already allow flexibility without new legislation.
I am of the view that not every situation should be resolved through regulation.
Ik ben van mening dat niet elke situatie via regelgeving moet worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ulenbelt en Krol over de aanpassing in de Ultimate Forward Rate (UFR) voor pensioenfondsen

MPs Omtzigt, Ulenbelt and Krol asked the state secretary about the change to the Ultimate Forward Rate for pension funds, including its effects on contributions, wages, recovery plans and transfers of value. The state secretary answered that the UFR was set by DNB following the advice of an independent committee, and gave estimates of effects while stating that many outcomes remain uncertain.
I expect that I can inform you at the end of September about the outcomes of this study.
Ik verwacht dat ik u eind september over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek kan informeren.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de Minister van Financiën over de vraag of fiduciair beheer door pensioenfondsen is toegestaan en over de openheid in beleg

An MP asks the State Secretary and Finance Minister about whether pension funds may outsource investments to fiduciary managers, the duty of care of such managers, participants' access to contracts, investment and derivatives information, and accountability for misleading cost reporting. The government answers that participants have no individual right to inspect management contracts, that the supervisor's information rights cannot be limited by confidentiality clauses, that the current law has no communication norm, and that internal and external supervision is relied upon, while declining to report current investment positions for strategic reasons.

However, the Pension Funds Code stipulates that the pension fund board annually and critically evaluates the quality of execution and costs of contracted service providers, including fiduciary managers.

Wel is in de Code Pensioenfondsen bepaald dat het pensioenfondsbestuur jaarlijks en op kritische wijze, de kwaliteit van de uitvoering en de gemaakte kosten van de gecontracteerde dienstverleners, inclusief de fiduciair beheerders, evalueert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over het artikel «Pension Funds Can Only Guess at Private Equity’s Cost»

MPs Nijboer and Vermeij asked the Finance Minister and the Social Affairs State Secretary about pension fund private equity costs, including whether fees and profit-sharing are lawful and whether pension funds can see their costs. The government answered that fee levels are negotiated contractually, that it cannot assess whether the costs are lawful, that existing reporting rules are sufficient for now, and that it will push for more cost transparency internationally through the AIFMD evaluation.

It is not clear to the cabinet what the pension funds named in the article agreed with the private equity funds concerning the allocation, level and reporting of the various costs, and how this relates to the costs actually charged.

Het is voor het kabinet niet inzichtelijk wat de onderzochte pensioenfondsen die in het artikel worden genoemd met de betreffende private equityfondsen hebben afgesproken over de allocatie, hoogte en rapportage van de verschillende kosten en hoe dit zich verhoudt tot de daadwerkelijk in rekening gebrachte kosten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over ‘onduidelijkheden over de hoogte van de mobiliteitsbonus en het doelgroepenregister voor schoolverlaters van het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs, praktijkonderwijs

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether schools hesitate to register school-leavers for the target-group register because the mobility bonus is cut from 2016, and whether a school-leaver who has earned the minimum wage can still be on the register. The state secretary answered that UWV has received registrations, that a planned amendment will equalise the bonus at 2,000 euro for the whole target group, and that the register rule cannot be applied retroactively in the described case.
Partly in response to the question from these SP members, I intend to actively inform parties in the field in the short term.
Mede naar aanleiding van de vraag die deze leden van de SP hebben gesteld, ben ik van plan om partijen in het veld op korte termijn actief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het wegvallen van inkomsten als gevolg van een uitspraak van KiFiD over een WAO-gat verzekering

Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether insurers must close the AOW gap for already-sick WAO-gap policyholders after a KiFiD ruling, and about the resulting income losses of up to EUR 10,000. The state secretary said the OBR bridging scheme covers those who were already receiving private disability benefits on 1 January 2013 and refused further compensation or investigation.
No. These people can, provided they meet the conditions, apply for the temporary AOW bridging benefit scheme (OBR).
Nee. Deze mensen kunnen mits zij aan de voorwaarden voldoen een beroep doen op de tijdelijke regeling overbruggingsuitkering AOW (OBR).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over dat gehandicapten en mensen met een uitkering ingezet worden voor thuiszorg

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked whether the municipality of Kaag en Braassem replacing thuiszorg staff with disabled people and benefit recipients, and whether this displaces regular work and breaches Participatiewet rules. The state secretary answered that the programme pairs experienced home helps with trainees for activation purposes, denies that dismissals or displacement occur, and sees no reason for further inquiry or intervention.
From the available information it can be concluded that there is no question of job displacement.
Uit de beschikbare informatie kan worden geconcludeerd dat er geen sprake is van werkverdringing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een medewerker van de sociale werkvoorziening Hameland na ontslag met behoud van uitkering hetzelfde werk moet doen

An MP asked whether a sheltered-workshop employee who had to keep doing the same work after a fixed-term contract ended, while on benefit without cao wages or pension accrual, is acceptable. The State Secretary confirmed the case, said it is not desirable to convert paid work into benefit-based placements but that municipalities are responsible and the matter can be raised in appeal or the council, and said she has no data on such workers.
The municipality is responsible for the correct implementation of the reintegration policy and the use of the instruments, and can be held accountable for that responsibility.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor de juiste uitvoering van het re-integratiebeleid en de inzet van de instrumenten en is op die verantwoordelijkheid aanspreekbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over een uitzending van Brandpunt waaruit blijkt dat miljoenen aan EU-subsidies voor kwetsbare groepen niet goed terecht komen

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked, following a Brandpunt broadcast, why EU subsidies meant for Roma and Sinti were spent improperly, who checks such projects, and whether the EU should prevent this rather than create a European Public Prosecutor. The government answered that the Roemenian authorities and the Commission are responsible for spending and control, that a full audit chain exists, that new 2014-2020 rules stress performance, and that withdrawing subsidies and a European Prosecutor are distinct tools, while declining to judge specific projects before audits conclude.

Before the cabinet can make statements about a specific case or individual project, it is important to await further investigation by the responsible bodies (in this case the European Commission and European Court of Auditors).

Voordat het kabinet uitspraken kan doen over een specifieke casus of een individueel project, is het van belang om nader onderzoek door de verantwoordelijke instanties (in dit geval de Europese Commissie en Europese Rekenkamer) af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat de vereiste dekkingsgraad van pensioenfondsen tot één procentpunt te hoog is door een weeffout Financieel Toetsingskader'

An MP asked whether the Financial Assessment Framework (nFTK) contains a design flaw inflating pension funds' required coverage ratios, citing Aon Hewitt's claim that the UFR introduction led to excessive buffers. The State Secretary rejected the claim, arguing the buffer treatment is consistent and that changing it would cause coverage ratios to fall sharply.
This approach is consistent, so it is certainly not a "design flaw".
Deze handelwijze is consequent, dus beslist geen «weeffout».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichtgeving ‘Pensioen verdampt door lage rente’

Krol (50PLUS) asks the state secretary about pension annuity losses from low interest rates, insurer communication, and the delayed premium-scheme bill, and asks for interim relief. The secretary acknowledges the problem, points to a temporary Pensioenknip reopening and an AFM investigation, and says the bill is delayed to late 2015 with consultation planned for July.
I intend to open the draft bill for internet consultation in July.
Ik ben voornemens om het concept wetsvoorstel in juli open te stellen voor een internetconsultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de directeur van de sociale werkplaats in Delft een hoge salaris krijgt dan de minister-president

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the director of the Delft sheltered workplace earning more than the Prime Minister, and the poor pay of its staff, was acceptable and what measures would be taken. The State Secretary answered that the director's pay was below the WNT norm, that pay terms are for employers and employees, and that municipalities and their councils are responsible for implementation, declining to act or investigate.
I am not a party to that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht 'Ex-bestuurder pensioenreus APG krijgt miljoen afkoopsom'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported ~1.1 million euro severance and continued-pay package for an ex-APG board member, and whether the rules on pension-sector pay were followed. The State Secretary confirmed the court-ordered payments, pointed to the Wet beloningsbeleid financiële ondernemingen as governing severance, and said it was for APG to decide on further steps.
It is up to APG to decide on any further steps.
Het is aan APG te beslissen over eventuele vervolgstappen.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en PieterHeerma (beiden CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over mensen die massaal afgezien hebben van een beroep tegen de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) over de

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked why many people who received SVB reductions of their partner allowance after lump-sum pension payouts did not appeal, allegedly because the SVB discouraged them, and asked for investigation and redress. The State Secretary denied the SVB discouraged appeals, refused to reopen final decisions and to provide call recordings, but committed to amending the Inkomensbesluit to stop reductions of lump-sum small pensions and referred complaints to the Nationale ombudsman.
Beneficiaries may, if they wish, request inspection of the telephone report.
Belanghebbenden kunnen desgewenst om inzage vragen in het telefoonrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat het Bedrijfstakpensioenfonds voor de Zeevisserij haar nieuwe regeling onderbrengt bij het Pensioenfonds Grafisch Bedrijf

Parliamentarian Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary whether the Bedrijfstakpensioenfonds voor de Zeevisserij could move its new scheme into the Pensioenfonds Grafisch Bedrijf without expanding that fund's statutory scope, and whether this conflicts with the earlier call for restraint in such expansions. The State Secretary answered that extending the compulsory scheme to another sector is permitted under current law, that the issue of limiting such moves raises principled questions to be addressed within the future pension system, and that PGB plans to offer premium schemes from 2016.
That is permitted under current legislation.
Dat is toegestaan binnen de huidige wetgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Weyenberg over welke mensen verplicht moeten deelnemen aan het pensioenfonds voor de uitzendbranche, StiPP, nu de ontslagregeling een andere definitie heeft van uitzendwerkg

MPs Omtzigt and Van Weyenberg asked whether payroll and secondment workers must remain covered by the StiPP pension fund, given that the 2015 dismissal rules define employment agencies differently by requiring an allocation function. The State Secretary answered that the dismissal definitions apply only to that regulation, that the StiPP scope is set by its parties (with a pending Supreme Court case), and promised a bill on equal pension treatment for payroll workers after the summer.
The relevant bill will be submitted to your House after the summer.
Het betreffende wetsvoorstel zal na de zomer bij uw Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uiteenlopende eisen aan het recht op nabestaandenpensioen

An MP asked why pension funds differ in whether survivor's pension requires marriage or registered partnership, and whether this is fair. The government said most funds cover cohabitants, the legal definition of partner imposes no extra conditions on the relationship, and it will raise the issue with social partners rather than act directly.
Contacts with the Pensioenfederatie and the Stichting van de Arbeid have shown willingness to bring this matter to the attention of decentralised parties involved in collective bargaining.
Uit contacten met de Pensioenfederatie en de Stichting van de Arbeid is gebleken dat er bereidheid bestaat om deze zaak onder de aandacht te brengen van decentrale partijen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het korten van pensioenen van personen op de West bank

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the government will cut AOW pensions to the single-rate (50% minimum wage) for new recipients living in Israeli-occupied West Bank territory from 1 January 2016, whether Israel can lawfully bind itself to treaty obligations there, and how this squares with the 1967 borders and the Oslo framework. The government answered that Israel as occupying power cannot conclude treaties applying to the occupied territory, that existing recipients keep the 70% rate, and that the Netherlands does not recognise the territories as Israeli.

This decision will be announced and communicated as soon as possible, so that it should be clear enough what the consequences of living in Israeli-occupied territory are for the AOW benefit of single AOW recipients.

Dit besluit zal zo spoedig mogelijk worden bekendgemaakt en gecommuniceerd, waardoor het voldoende helder moet zijn welke gevolgen wonen in door Israël bezet gebied heeft voor de AOW-uitkering van alleenstaande AOW-gerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over sw-bedrijf Hameland

MP Kerstens asked the state secretary about the sheltered workplace Hameland, covering whether workers with a sw-indication keep their rights, whether the municipalities' care duty remains, financial effects of not renewing fixed-term contracts, and access to sectoral plans and ESF funding. The state secretary confirmed workers keep their legal rights, stated the care duty lapsed with the Participatiewet, explained the budget and cost consequences for municipalities, and listed ESF subsidy arrangements without committing to new action.
I can confirm that employees with a sw-indication who are employed indefinitely by a sw-company retain their statutory rights.
Ik kan bevestigen dat medewerkers met een sw-indicatie, die voor onbepaalde tijd in dienst zijn van een sw-bedrijf, hun wettelijke rechten behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘vraagtekens bij sluiting sociale werkplaats’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the planned dissolution of the Hameland sheltered workshop, job security and contract renewals for temporary staff, whether sheltered workshops should be preserved under the Participation Act, suicidal signals among staff, monitoring of the Act's effects, and collective labour agreements for workshop employees. The State Secretary answers that municipalities decide and staff keep their legal rights, that workshops can keep a valuable role, that the Act's effects will be evaluated under the existing monitoring plan, and that collective agreements are not her responsibility.
I do not have the data for each individual sheltered workshop.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens van elk afzonderlijk sw-bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over de aanpak van huiselijk geweld in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether the government would adopt preventive, family-centred approaches to domestic violence in Caribbean Netherlands instead of a mainly justice-based response, and whether they would fund and roll out a pilot run by the Bonaire youth and family centre. The government answered that an integrated approach covering prevention, care and justice is needed, pointed to existing measures and funding, and said it would support a Bonaire Eigen Kracht pilot and share results if successful, without committing to a rollout.
If the conference proves successful, the results will be shared with the other islands.
Mocht de conferentie een succes blijken te zijn, dan zullen de resultaten gedeeld worden met de andere eilanden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat sinds 2013 nog maar 2.000 garantiebanen zijn gerealiseerd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that only about 2,000 quota jobs for people with work disabilities had been created since 2013, and about vacancy-search and job-placement figures. The State Secretary said the first interim measurement was still underway, pointed to employer-led facilitators, instruments and regional Werkbedrijven, and gave vacancy statistics without committing to new measures.
It is not yet known how many jobs have been added for people in the target group of the jobs agreement since 1 January 2013.
Het is nog niet bekend hoeveel banen erbij zijn gekomen voor mensen uit de doelgroep van de banenafspraak sinds 1 januari 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Enschede betaalt werklozenbegeleider in korte tijd kwart miljoen’

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether the municipality of Enschede should have paid a large sum, partly from the participation budget, to an external project manager for unemployment reintegration, and what the value was. The state secretary answered that reintegration policy is a municipal responsibility best debated in the municipal council, that the project manager's costs were paid from other municipal funds, and that the project reported 45 participants moving to regular employers.
The responsibility to reach adequate choices lies explicitly at the local level.
De verantwoordelijkheid om tot adequate keuzes te komen, ligt uitdrukkelijk op het lokale niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘gemeenten een half miljoen verdienen aan dwangarbeid’

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary whether municipalities profiting from unpaid work by welfare recipients (plastic flower folding) is acceptable, whether it constitutes unfair competition, and what tools exist to stop such practices. The state secretary replied that re-integration policy is a municipal responsibility, that the national government will not intervene in an individual municipality's policy, that the municipal council is the proper forum, and that recipients can object or complaints can be raised via the client council.
Given municipal policy discretion, it is not appropriate for the national government to pronounce on the policy of an individual municipality.
Gelet op de gemeentelijke beleidsvrijheid ligt het niet in de rede dat de rijksoverheid zich uitspreekt over het beleid van een individuele gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over re-integratie-projecten van gemeenten

MP Kerstens (PvdA) asks whether municipalities such as Aalten displace regular paid work by placing welfare recipients in unpaid or low-paid positions while keeping benefits, and what the state will do about it. The Secretary of State answers that re-integration is a local matter under municipal discretion, that the risk of displacement can only be judged locally, and that she relies on municipalities and existing guidance without committing to new rules.
I do not have information on the nature of the contracts and changes in them. This is a local matter.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de aard van de contracten en de wijzigingen hierin. Dit is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ‘spelregels tegen verdringing’

MP Kerstens asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about rules against displacement of paid work by municipal reintegration activities, and whether a Rotterdam advisory council should be made mandatory. The State Secretary agreed displacement must be guarded against and that it is a municipal task, said the Programme Council drafted voluntary guidelines, and declined to require municipalities to set up advisory councils.
Reintegration policy is a task whose implementation has been left to the municipality.
Het re-integratiebeleid is een taak waarbij de invulling is overgelaten aan de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over re-integratie in Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about reports that re-integration practice in Rotterdam amounted to intimidation of benefit recipients, and whether the state would act on the ombudsman's recommendations. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that under the Participatiewet implementation is a municipal responsibility, the municipal council is the proper overseer, no contact with the Rotterdam ombudsman is planned, and the issue is being handled locally.

Given the decentralisation of responsibilities under the Participatiewet, it is for the municipality to decide how it shapes its policy on the Participatiewet, labour market reintegration and the counter-performance.

Gezien de decentralisatie van verantwoordelijkheden in de Participatiewet is het aan de gemeente om te bepalen op welke wijze zij hun beleid met betrekking tot de Participatiewet en daarmee de arbeidstoeleiding van werkzoekenden en de tegenprestatie willen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat gemeenten aandringen op meer beleidsvrijheid bij fraudebestrijding

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports that municipalities want more discretion in fraud enforcement and benefit sanctions, including whether national rules leave enough room for local judgement and whether sanction costs exceed benefits. The minister answered that the Participation Act and Fraud Act leave municipalities room for tailored decisions, that the Fraud Act is being amended to allow lower fines and warnings, and that individual cases are a municipal responsibility he will not intervene in.
The decentralised implementation of the Participation Act also means that I do not intervene in individual cases between a municipality and benefit recipients.
De decentrale uitvoering van de Participatiewet betekent ook dat ik niet treed in individuele gevallen die spelen tussen een gemeente en bijstandgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de beleidsvrijheid van gemeentes bij fraudebestrijding

Kerstens (PvdA) asked whether current rules leave municipalities too little room for tailored sanctions and for distinguishing real fraudsters from people making honest mistakes, and whether the minister will accommodate their objections. Minister Asscher replied that uniform sanctioning is needed for legal certainty, that planned Fraudewet changes give municipalities more discretion (warnings, lower fines, waiving sanctions in individual cases), and that existing maatregel rules already allow weighing personal circumstances, without committing to new measures.
In view of legal certainty and equal treatment, a certain uniformity in sanctioning policy is desirable.
Met het oog op rechtszekerheid en rechtsgelijkheid is een zekere uniformiteit in het sanctiebeleid gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aankondiging van de stresstest voor pensioenfondsen door EIOPA op 11 mei jongstleden

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the State Secretary about the EIOPA pension fund stress test, its legal basis, its consistency with the IORP-II revision, DNB's role, the consequences of non-participation, and whether it adds regulation. Klijnsma answered that EIOPA has a mandate under its founding regulation, that participation is voluntary, that results will be published only in aggregate by country, and that the government remains critical and will coordinate with like-minded member states.
It is up to EIOPA to decide when a stress test will be carried out.
Het is aan EIOPA om te bepalen wanneer er een stresstest uitgevoerd zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber naar aanleiding van het bericht dat regionale voedselbanken in het nauw komen

An MP asked the state secretaries whether regional food banks in the Rijnmond area are receiving too little food and what the government is doing about it, including progress on the Alliance and Voedselbanken cooperation and support for donation projects. The government attributes the shortfall mainly to a seasonal pattern, describes ongoing cooperation and some supportive measures, and says it is unaware of other obstacles.
It is regrettable that a number of food banks in the Rijnmond region are temporarily receiving too little food.
Het is te betreuren dat een aantal voedselbanken in de regio Rijnmond – tijdelijk – te weinig voedsel aangeleverd krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Oosenbrug over de inhuur door gemeenten van externe bureaus op no cure no pay basis voor onderzoek naar uitkeringsfraude

MPs Kerstens and Oosenbrug asked about municipalities hiring external firms on a no-cure-no-pay basis to investigate benefit fraud, including the 'unpaid civil servant' arrangement and the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling. The State Secretary said she lacks data on how widely the practice is used, rejects it, holds that core benefit-investigation tasks cannot be outsourced, and promises a letter to municipalities and possible instructions under article 76 of the Participatiewet.
The implementation practice as addressed in the broadcast is something I reject.
De uitvoeringspraktijk zoals die in de betreffende uitzending aan de orde is gekomen wijs ik af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma, Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de nadelige gevolgen voor kloosterlingen, indien de kostendelersnorm ook voor AOW wordt ingevoerd

MPs Heerma, Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked whether the household-sharing norm for the AOW pension would harm monastic residents and when the study on its effects on informal care would be ready. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, noted the exemption for commercial arrangements, said implementation was postponed to 1 July 2016 and promised the decision-making would be sent to Parliament before summer 2015.
My aim is to send the decision-making on the household-sharing norm in the AOW, in relation to effects on informal care, to both Chambers of the States General before summer 2015.
Mijn inzet is om de besluitvorming over de kostendelersnorm in de AOW in relatie tot de effecten op mantelzorg voor de zomer van 2015 naar beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over "screening door de SVB van ouderen met een Turkse achtergrond op buitenlandse bezittingen"

MP Öztürk asked whether the SVB's assets-abroad checks on AIO recipients, which since 2013 include people with Turkish background, amount to discriminatory screening, and asked about costs, cross-border investigation methods, and privacy safeguards. The State Secretary answered that all AIO recipients are checked in rotating annual batches by country of origin, that the checks are lawful and cost-effective, that no commercial parties are used, and that no discrimination is involved.
I see no conflict with Article 1 of the Constitution.
Ik zie geen strijd met artikel 1 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ypma over de positie van leerlingen in het praktijkonderwijs in de Participatiewet

Two MPs asked whether pupils in practical secondary education (praktijkonderwijs) risk falling through the cracks under the Participatiewet, and whether they can be automatically listed in the target-group register for guaranteed jobs. The government answered that pupils will stay in view through handover of Wajong networks to municipalities, information campaigns, and a UWV procedure allowing direct applications for target-group assessment, with financing centralized at UWV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de problemen van het plaatsen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking op een extra baan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about reports that very few people with work disabilities are being registered for the target-group register, so few are eligible for guaranteed jobs, and about assessment costs, praktijkonderwijs pupils, and the flow from special education into benefits. The State Secretary answered that the register is already well filled, that the slow registrations are being monitored and processes changed, and that assessments will be reviewed in autumn, while giving no firm figures on placements.
It is not possible to state how many people registered between 1 January 2015 and 1 May 2015 have since been placed in an extra job.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven hoeveel mensen die tussen 1 januari 2015 en 1 mei 2015 zijn aangemeld, inmiddels geplaatst zijn op een extra baan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over de (tussen)uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep, waarin zij oordeelt dat een afgekocht pensioen niet in mindering gebracht wordt op de partnertoeslag AOW

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked the State Secretary about a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that a lump-sum pension buyout should not be fully offset against the AOW partner allowance, and about the SVB's notice and the costs of appeal. The State Secretary answered that the ruling leaves room for other ways of offsetting, that the Inkomensbesluit will be amended so buyout amounts are fully exempt from 1 December 2014, and that retroactive relief for final decisions is not granted because of legal certainty.
Requests to reconsider our decision will be rejected because you did not lodge an objection or appeal.
Verzoeken om alsnog terug te komen op onze beslissing wijzen wij af, omdat u niet in bezwaar of (hoger) beroep bent gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over de kille wijze waarop een Nederlandse Holocaust overlevende is gekort op haar AOW-uitkering

PVV MPs asked why a Dutch Holocaust survivor living in the West Bank had her AOW pension cut by about 35 percent, whether all residents of Israeli settlements in occupied territories face such cuts, how many are affected, and whether the government will act against it. The government regretted the handling, said the affected survivor's situation was corrected, and decided that current single AOW recipients in occupied territory keep their benefit while new single recipients from 2016 get the 50 percent married-couple norm; it declined to change the treaty or contact Israeli counterparts.
The cabinet regrets how matters unfolded; for the person concerned the situation has now been adjusted and she has been informed of this.
Het kabinet betreurt de gang van zaken Voor betrokkene is de situatie nu aangepast en zij is daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over "het korten van AOW’ers in Israël".

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would reverse the reduction of AOW pensions for Dutch residents of the occupied West Bank and how many are affected. The government regrets the situation, will keep the current AOW level for those already receiving the single-person benefit up to 70% of the minimum wage, and cap it at the married norm (50%) for new recipients from 1 January 2016.
Everyone who currently lives in Israeli-occupied territory and receives a single-person AOW of up to 70% of the statutory minimum wage may keep it.
Iedereen die nu woont in door Israël bezet gebied en een AOW voor alleenstaanden ontvangt ter hoogte van maximaal 70% van het wettelijk minimumloon, mag die houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over de toekomst van leerlingen die het praktijkonderwijs succesvol hebben doorlopen

MPs Siderius and Karabulut (SP) asked about the prospects of praktijkonderwijs (practical education) leavers, including barriers from language and maths requirements, the Participatiewet, sheltered work and dagbesteding, and whether the government will monitor and support school-leavers. The State Secretary answers that most leavers find work or continue training, that municipalities are now responsible for support, and that additional measures and monitoring are planned, without accepting parliamentary demands for extended follow-up or compensation for reduced ESF funds.
The cabinet does not expect a negative effect of the Participatiewet on the successful outflow of praktijkonderwijs pupils.
Het kabinet verwacht geen negatief effect van de Participatiewet op de succesvolle uitstroom van leerlingen uit het pro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht "Geen compensatie voor korting op AOW-toeslag"

An MP asked why AOW pensioners who objected late or were unaware of the option were not compensated for AOW partner allowance cuts on small pension lump sums, despite the top administrative court ruling against the SVB, and what the government would do. The State Secretary replied that the Central Appeals Tribunal only found the outcome unreasonable in specific cases, that the government is amending the general income decree to fully exempt such lump sums from 1 December 2014, and that already final decisions will not be reopened to avoid precedent.
This concerns a new regulation, so there is no legal inequality with citizens whose decision was taken under different applicable law and which has become legally unassailable.

Het betreft een nieuwe regeling en daarmee is er geen sprake van rechtsongelijkheid ten opzichte van burgers waarvan het besluit onder een ander geldend recht is vastgesteld en waarbij er inmiddels sprake is van een rechtens onaantastbaar besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht “Fraude loont”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that welfare fraud goes unpunished, including inconsistent enforcement by municipalities, the criminal reporting threshold, the recovery rate of fraud fines, and a Rotterdam court ruling on information duties for suspects. The minister acknowledged the concern, said municipalities must apply the law and that he will keep raising enforcement with the VNG and municipalities, and gave partial answers, noting that national data on recovery and benefit termination are not available.
The cabinet does not have a national picture.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een landelijk beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Pensioenfonds moet uit olie en gas”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about press reports that APG/ABP's exposure to fossil fuels differs from DNB's earlier estimate, and whether DNB would reassess its conclusions and monitor carbon bubble and climate-policy risks. The minister answered that the figures differ because APG/ABP used a broader definition of energy investments, that DNB sees no reason to revise its conclusion, and that DNB addresses ESG risks through supervision and dialogue.
The full APG report is not publicly available because it serves internal risk purposes and contains confidential information.
Het volledige rapport van APG is niet publiek beschikbaar, omdat het voor interne risicodoeleinden dient en vertrouwelijke informatie bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat het beheer en de uitvoering van pensioenvermogens steeds vaker in het buitenland plaatsvinden

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that pension management and administration increasingly takes place abroad, including questions on salary rules, companies moving pension administration to Belgium, and cross-border PPI activity. The State Secretary answered that existing pension remuneration rules apply regardless of location, that Dutch supervisors (DNB, AFM) and employee councils retain oversight of cross-border transfers, and that the PPI's cross-border scope will be evaluated again in three years.
In the aforementioned answer to parliamentary questions from MP Vermeij I addressed the safeguards in place for this.
Bij de hiervoor genoemde beantwoording van Kamervragen van het lid Vermeij ben ik ingegaan op de waarborgen die hiervoor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voorkeursbehandeling van jongeren, vrouwen en allochtonen in pensioenfondsbesturen

An MP asked the state secretary whether solidarity and union representativeness justify preferential treatment of young people, women and ethnic minorities on pension fund boards. The state secretary answered that diversity should reflect the membership base while expertise comes first, and that union involvement follows from collective bargaining rather than representativeness.
Not all forms of solidarity need to be reflected in pension scheme board composition.
Niet alle vormen van solidariteit hoeven bij pensioenregelingen tot uiting te komen in de bestuurssamenstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ambtenaren worden verdacht van machtsmisbruik bij re-integratietrajecten en bijstandscliënten in de rol van slaaf worden geduwd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs how she views reports that Amsterdam civil servants were suspected of abuse of power in re-integration trajectories, whether she will act against such treatment, and whether she will order an independent inquiry. The State Secretary replied that she does not intervene in individual cases, that the municipality has investigated and taken measures, that complaints routes exist at municipal level, and that a national inquiry is not appropriate because the municipal council is responsible for oversight.
An investigation by the national government is not appropriate.
Een onderzoek door de rijksoverheid is niet opportuun.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de beslissing van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) om een uitkeringsgerechtigde vrijwilligerswerk als chauffeur op de buurtbus te verbieden, terwijl een

An MP asked the minister why UWV barred an unemployment-benefit recipient from volunteering as a bus driver while a social-assistance recipient may do similar volunteer work, and whether this inconsistency is undesirable. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained the criteria for volunteering with retained WW benefit (non-commercial organisation, allowance below the tax-office cap of 150 euro per month), and said that municipalities and UWV are responsible for supervising these rules.
It is not for me to go into individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over rentegevoeligheid als molensteen om nek pensioenen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether low interest rates and the ECB bond-buying programme are a burden on pension funds, and what this means for indexation and for protective measures, and whether social partners will be consulted. The State Secretary acknowledged the pressure on pensions, said the ECB effect cannot be separately quantified, that the new funding framework cushions the impact in the short term, and that she is willing to discuss a new perspective with social partners.
The separate effect of the ECB programme on fund-specific coverage ratios therefore cannot be quantified.
Het afzonderlijke effect van het ECB-programma op fondsspecifieke dekkingsgraden kan daarom niet worden gekwantificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Pensioenfondsen gaan investeren in windpark’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether pension funds should be investing in a wind farm and in climate policy, and whether the regulator should be asked to intervene. The State Secretary answered that pension funds are primarily responsible for their own investment policy, saw no reason to intervene, and said DNB supervises compliance with the law without reporting on individual funds.
Pension funds are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy and for whether or not to take risk.
Pensioenfondsen zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid en het wel of niet nemen van risico daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over regeldrift

MPs asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurers demand extensive documents from employers before advising on pension schemes, given the aim to cut administrative burden. The minister says the Wft uses open norms, the AFM guidelines are not a checklist, the burden is hard to estimate and is not tracked, and the Actal study on financial-sector regulation will examine similar cases.
Because there are various ways to gather information from the client, the administrative burden arising from this cannot be reliably estimated.
Vanwege de verschillende mogelijkheden om informatie bij de klant in te winnen zijn de administratieve lasten die hieruit voortkomen niet goed in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Alle werklozen naar de sociale werkplaats’

MP Karabulut asked the State Secretary about Apeldoorn's policy of requiring welfare recipients to do simple production work, whether this is paid work, displacement risks, and how it fits with individual-only support rules under the Wwb. The State Secretary replied that the Direct Actief approach is a municipal reintegration method with individual assessment, that municipalities bear responsibility for oversight, and that no displacement is evident, while withholding financial and commercial details of the Werkplein Activerium arrangement.
This concerns a decentralised responsibility in which the municipal council and the college of mayor and aldermen make the decisions.
Het betreft een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid waarbij de gemeenteraad en het college van burgemeester en wethouders besluitvormend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘de vrijwilliger van het jaar niet genoeg doet voor haar uitkering’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a municipality declaring a volunteer-of-the-year's welfare-related voluntary work insufficient as a counter-performance, and whether only local volunteering should count and whether the municipality may stop volunteering. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said municipalities decide the content and scope of counter-performance under their own by-laws, and noted that volunteering requires municipal permission with paid work prioritised.
I do not intervene in individual cases between a municipality and a welfare recipient.
Ik treed niet in individuele gevallen die spelen tussen een gemeente en een bijstandsgerechtigde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over het stopzetten van het uitbetalen van een aanvulling op het pensioen door het Algemeen Burgerlijk Pensioenfonds (ABP)

An MP asks why ABP stopped paying a pension supplement linked to AOW partner allowance, how it worked, how members were informed, and whether ABP communicated too late. The State Secretary explains the supplement's rules and communication, says the late notice is regrettable, and reports ABP has reversed the decision and will inform affected members personally.

As I indicated on 24 February in answering oral questions from MP Krol (50PLUS) on this subject, I find it very regrettable for those involved that they were informed at a late stage about the discontinuation of the supplementary scheme.

Zoals ik op 24 februari jl. in de beantwoording van de mondelinge vragen van het lid Krol (50PLUS) over dit onderwerp heb aangegeven, vind ik het erg vervelend voor de betrokkenen dat zij op een laat moment zijn geïnformeerd over het stopzetten van de aanvullende regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een grootmoeder is beboet omdat ze op haar kleinkinderen paste

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that a welfare recipient was fined for babysitting her grandchildren, and whether this counts as paid work and fits the participation policy. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, which is subject to appeal and delegated to the municipality, said babysitting is only relevant to benefits if it amounts to paid work judged on nature, duration and structure, and promised to revise sanctions legislation after a court ruling.
I therefore cannot interfere in individual cases.
Ik kan mij dan ook niet mengen in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat er enorme ongelijkheid is ontstaan in de studietoeslag voor arbeidsgehandicapten"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about large municipal differences in the individual study allowance for disabled students, and whether a nationally enforceable individual study right should replace this. The State Secretary answered that municipalities set the allowance by ordinance within the legal framework, so variation reflects local democratic choice, and that no central rule or renegotiation with municipalities is planned.
Central prescription does not fit here.
Het centraal voorschrijven past hier niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de Wet schuldsanering natuurlijke personen

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the government about falling admissions to the debt rescheduling scheme (WSNP), rising use of guardianship (beschermingsbewind), and whether debt-assistance attempts should remain a precondition for admission. The state secretary answered that the decline reflects several factors, that a precondition of prior out-of-court effort will be kept, and that admission via guardianship is legally possible but subject to judicial assessment.
It is currently not known to what extent guardianship is imposed on people who do not qualify for debt assistance or are insufficiently helped by it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend in hoeverre beschermingsbewind wordt ingesteld voor mensen die niet in aanmerking komen voor schuldhulpverlening of er niet voldoende door geholpen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het gebruik van CO2 voor het vergassen van veldmuizen in Friesland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the use of CO2 under a drag sheet to gas field voles in Friesland complies with the EU biocides directive and whether enforcement is planned. The government agreed the method should not be used under the directive, but said it will examine whether it could be applied in future and what legal steps would be needed.
With that in mind, I will have it examined whether this method can be applied in the future and, if so, what legal steps would need to be taken.
Ik zal met het oog daarop laten nagaan of deze methode in de toekomst toegepast kan gaan worden en zo ja, welke juridische stappen hiertoe gezet moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de naleving van de beslagvrije voet door schuldeisers

MP Schouten (ChristenUnie) asked whether creditors are routinely breaching the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) and what the government will do, including faster government connection to the attachment register and Tax Authority repayment with retroactive effect. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem is substantial, announced simplification of the calculation rules, a phased connection of bailiffs to the register with government connection still requiring preparation, and said the Tax Authority generally does not repay retroactively unless the debtor is not at fault.
I do not have data showing how many people must live on an income below the applicable protected minimum.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens waaruit blijkt hoeveel mensen moeten rondkomen van een inkomen onder de voor hen van toepassing zijnde beslagvrije voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voorkeursbehandeling van jongeren, vrouwen en allochtonen in pensioenfondsbesturen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the FNV's plan to give priority to young people, women and immigrants in appointments to pension fund boards is acceptable, and questions the representativeness of unions on such boards. The State Secretary answers that preferential treatment by reserved seats is not allowed under equal treatment rules, that expertise and diversity can coexist, and that union board seats follow statutory arrangements for balancing the interests of all participants.
That means no board seats may be reserved for young people, women or immigrants.
Dat betekent dat er geen bestuurszetels gereserveerd mogen worden voor jongeren, vrouwen of allochtonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat Samsom op vrijdag ouderen wast

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary whether it is acceptable that a non-professional (Samsom, a volunteer) washes and dresses elderly people and assists with wound care, and whether this is consistent with the view that intimate care should be done by professionals. The state secretary answers that these tasks are not reserved under the BIG act, that Samsom is accompanied by a district nurse who performs reserved acts, and that the volunteer work is a welcome form of openness, not a political experiment.
Actions such as washing, dressing and assisting with wound care are not designated as reserved acts.
Handelingen zoals wassen, aankleden en het assisteren bij het verzorgen van wonden, zijn niet aangemerkt als voorbehouden handelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “Geëiste premiedaling komt niet van de grond”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister of Finance about reports that a promised fall in pension premiums was not materialising, and about the premium forecasts underlying the coalition agreement and the expected revenue from cutting pension accrual. The government answered that premiums fell between 2014 and 2015, that current CPB forecasts are below earlier projections, and that the expected revenue of 2.1 billion euro in 2017 is not at risk.

The CEP 2015 forecast shows that the realised premium development in 2014 and the expected development for 2015 and 2016 are so far more favourable than expected at the time of the pension agreements.
Uit de CEP-raming 2015 blijkt dat de gerealiseerde premieontwikkeling in 2014 en de verwachte ontwikkeling voor 2015 en 2016 vooralsnog gunstiger is dan verwacht ten tijde van de pensioenafspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over de uitzending van het programma “Dit is de dag” over de gemeente Oude Pekela

MP Potters (VVD) asked the State Secretary about a broadcast on the municipality of Oude Pekela's high benefit dependency, whether more should be done to activate welfare recipients, and whether a cross-border job pilot with Germany should be supported. The government said the Participatiewet gives municipalities the instruments and that they are responsible for implementation, and pointed to cross-border labour market programmes and regional funding while declining to commit to a specific pilot.
As stated, the goal of the Participatiewet is to get people to participate and preferably move them into regular work.
Zoals gezegd is het doel van de Participatiewet om mensen te laten participeren en bij voorkeur naar regulier werk toe te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het niet aanleveren door gemeenten van arbeidsgehandicapten voor het doelgroepenregister

An MP asked why municipalities had referred so few people for the disability employment target register, and whether this created inequality with Wajong and WSW applicants. The state secretary answered that the low number was not alarming since January was early, that priority is given to Wajongers and WSW waiting-list members, and that referral costs are reimbursed, while not committing to new measures.
The number of requests for a target group assessment for the jobs agreement in January is low, but no reason for panic.
Het aantal aanvragen voor een doelgroepbeoordeling banenafspraak in januari is laag, maar geen reden voor paniek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Wajongers dupe laksheid’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that only 29 municipal registrations were made in January to the UWV register of people eligible for the jobs agreement, and whether the register works adequately. The state secretary confirmed the figures, said the register reliably shows eligibility and will be filled further during 2015, and noted that the number of requests says nothing about the register's functioning.
The number of requests for a target-group assessment under the jobs agreement says nothing about the functioning of the register itself.
Het aantal aanvragen voor een doelgroepbeoordeling banenafspraak zegt niks over het functioneren van het register zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het sluiten van sociale werkplaatsen

An MP asked the state secretary about five municipalities planning to close sheltered workshops (sociale werkplaatsen) without clear alternatives, and about the position of current Wsw employees. The state secretary answered that this is a decentralised municipal responsibility, that current Wsw employees keep their rights, and that municipalities have a broad instrumentarium under the Participatiewet.
It concerns a decentralised responsibility in which the municipal council and the college of mayor and aldermen make the decisions.
Het betreft een decentrale verantwoordelijkheid waarbij de gemeenteraad en het college van burgemeester en wethouders besluitvormend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het pleidooi van de AFM voor een opt-out op de verplichte aanvullende pensioenregeling

MP Van Klaveren asks the Minister about the AFM's call for an opt-out from mandatory supplementary pension premiums and whether the government will move toward individual choice over pension contributions. The Minister says flexibility and individual needs will be considered in a forthcoming policy note on pensions, but rejects the view that mandatory pension is outdated and says mandatory participation is a strength of the system.
In May I will send the House a policy outline on the future of the pension system, in which I sketch several possible policy variants.
In mei stuur ik de Kamer een Hoofdlijnennotitie over de toekomst van het pensioenstelsel, waarin ik enkele mogelijke beleidsvarianten schets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over werken over de grens

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about provinces and municipalities planning pilots to place unemployed Dutch workers in jobs across the German border, and whether obligations to take such work should be enforced before obstacles are removed. The minister confirmed the initiatives, said cross-border work is possible and that the Participatiewet allows sollicitatieplicht across the border, promised to work with border regions via the GROS network under a motion, and said no one can be forced to accept work abroad though benefits can be sanctioned for refusing to apply.
No one in the Netherlands can be forced to accept work.
Niemand in Nederland kan gedwongen worden werk te aanvaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over uitblijven besluit beschutte werkplekken

An MP asked the State Secretary how she views Cedris figures showing many municipalities have not yet decided on sheltered work and whether they can exclude instruments in advance, and whether municipalities can be forced to create sheltered jobs at wage. The State Secretary answered that municipalities have policy freedom under the Participatiewet, that the monitoring is ongoing and she will talk with municipalities if results lag, but she will not impose a minimum number of sheltered jobs.
If the monitor shows that results lag behind what the Participatiewet intends, I will enter into discussions with municipalities and other relevant organisations.
Als uit de monitor blijkt dat de resultaten achterblijven bij wat de Participatiewet beoogt, ga ik in gesprek met gemeenten en andere betrokken organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de ICT-problemen bij de SVB met betrekking tot het niet uitbetalen van pgb’s

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Health about ICT problems at the SVB that prevented PGB payments, covering agreements, system design, cost, fraud control and oversight. The State Secretary answered at length, largely describing agreements, the Nestor/Treks systems, the fallback scenario and planned reviews, and committed to an independent problem analysis.
At the request of the House, an independent problem analysis will be carried out.
Op verzoek van de Kamer zal een onafhankelijke probleemanalyse worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de premiepercentages bij een pensioenrichtleeftijd lager dan 67 jaar

An MP asks whether pension schemes with an entry date on the first of the month the member turns 67 must be recalculated under the Witteveen framework and at what cost. The state secretaries confirm recalculation is required where the full fiscal room is used, but grant a temporary two-year exemption from actuarial recalculation for these schemes to ease administrative burden.
It is not known how many pension schemes this issue affects.
Het is niet bekend bij hoeveel pensioenregelingen deze problematiek speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over pensioenopbouw door IB-ondernemers bij een beroepspensioenregeling

Two MPs asked why self-employed income-tax payers in mandatory occupational pension schemes are assessed on profit from three years earlier, and what relief exists for someone who became partly disabled, so that their pension premium more than doubled. The government answered that a reference year (t-3) gives time to fix the maximum pensionable income, that special rules apply for illness, disability and starters, that it is always allowed to use a lower amount, and that pension funds and social partners decide on premium-free continuation and discretion.
It is always fiscally permitted to assume a lower amount than the maximum that may be taken into account as pensionable income.
Het is fiscaal altijd toegestaan om van een lager bedrag uit te gaan dan het bedrag dat ten hoogste als pensioengevend loon in aanmerking mag worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ‘de noodzaak van een wijziging van het pensioenstelsel’

MP Van Klaveren asks whether the minister is aware of a press report on the need to change the pension system, and challenges claims that 40% of Dutch people want to abolish the collective, compulsory supplementary pension, that young generations bear an unfair burden, and that returning pension premiums to workers would boost growth. The Staatssecretaris answers that the 40% figure is not recognised, that the Pension Dialogue supports mandatory pensions for employees, that intergenerational views differ, and that reduced premiums raise short-term spending but lower long-term pensions, and says a policy note will be written with SER and SCP input.
In doing so I will also draw on the SER advice on the future of the pension system.
Ik zal daarbij ook gebruik maken van het advies van de SER over de toekomst van het pensioenstelsel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over een AOW-korting voor niet-werkende gezinsleden van Nederlandse werknemers bij diverse internationale organisaties in Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked whether Dutch family members without their own income of staff at various international organisations in the Netherlands build no AOW pension rights because of host-state agreements, and whether this is fair. The Secretary of State answered that these exclusions follow from the seat agreements, that the organisation's wishes are decisive, that recent agreements no longer exclude resident family members, that fewer than 20 persons are affected, and that courts found the exclusion justified.

As indicated above, the exclusion from the Dutch social security system follows from the correct application of applicable seat agreements that the Netherlands has concluded with international organisations established in our country.

Zoals hierboven aangegeven vloeit de uitsluiting van het stelsel van Nederlandse sociale zekerheid voort uit de correcte toepassing van geldende zetelverdragen die Nederland heeft gesloten met in ons land gevestigde volkenrechtelijke organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de uitspraak van de AFM dat zzp’ers verplicht aan pensioensparen moeten doen

MP Klein asked the State Secretary whether it is premature for the AFM to call for mandatory pension saving for self-employed workers before their voluntary scheme has started, and whether it is appropriate for a supervisor to advise on this. The State Secretary answered that the AFM raised a legitimate question within the National Pension Dialogue, that it only considers mandatory participation if voluntary saving proves insufficient, and that a supervisor's broad view makes its contribution valuable.
I consider this an open and constructive contribution to the National Pension Dialogue.
Ik acht dit een open en constructieve bijdrage aan de Nationale Pensioendialoog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “Oudere werklozen geen prioriteit voor gemeenten”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a Trouw report, based on a Divosa survey, that municipalities give low priority to older long-term welfare recipients for wage-subsidised jobs. The State Secretary said municipalities hold the responsibility and discretion under the Participatiewet, that the survey covered only about a quarter of municipalities, and that she did not recognise claims about budget-driven prioritisation.
It is up to the municipal council to set the policy and to oversee its implementation.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om het beleid vast te stellen en op de uitvoering er van toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat de gemeente Tilburg het alternatief voor beschut werk doorzet”

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether Tilburg's decision not to realise sheltered work (beschut werk) and to offer alternatives such as volunteering and day care is acceptable, and whether the Participatiewet should be amended to require a minimum of sheltered jobs. The State Secretary answers that municipalities have policy discretion and that the 30,000 places will be realised, while declining to impose a statutory minimum and promising monitoring and evaluation.
I value this policy freedom and do not intend to restrict it in advance.
Ik hecht aan deze beleidsvrijheid en ben niet voornemens deze op voorhand in te perken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van het College van de Rechten van de Mens dat er sprake is van leeftijdsdiscriminatie als een uitkering van functioneel leeftijdsontslag stopt op

MPs Ulenbelt asked how the government responds to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that ending the UGM military disability benefit at 65 while the AOW age has risen amounts to age discrimination, and what it will do about the resulting income gap. The minister says the ruling concerns UGM benefits, that Defence is negotiating a fix with unions and a temporary ABP bridging scheme runs to 2016, and that the AOW gap is a deliberate sustainability measure with a temporary OBR bridging benefit; no structural change is promised.
Until then, the Minister of Defence is obliged to apply the existing terms of employment and no individual deviating arrangements will be made.
Tot die tijd is de Minister van Defensie gehouden de bestaande rechtspositieregeling toe te passen en worden geen individuele afwijkende regelingen getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over "het artikel ‘de volksvertegenwoordiging gepiepeld"

An MP asks the state secretary whether a Follow the Money column was right that parliament was misinformed about the death-benefit exclusion clause in net pension insurance, and what will be done about disabled workers losing pension accrual. The secretary rejects the claim of misinformation, maintains the net pension is a continuation of the earlier survivors' provision, and says the specific disability group's coverage depends on social partners' agreements and a promised study is underway.
I therefore believe there is no question of 'the parliament being taken for a ride' as stated in the article.
Ik meen derhalve dat geen sprake is van «het piepelen van de volksvertegenwoordiging»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Karabulut en Yücel over de invordering van belasting- en toeslagschulden door de Belastingdienst

MPs Schouten, Karabulut and Yücel asked whether the Tax Authority's recovery of tax and benefit debts ignores personal circumstances and the subsistence allowance (beslagvrije voet), pushing people deeper into debt, and how the motion on respecting the subsistence allowance will be implemented. The State Secretary acknowledged the Tax Authority cannot always account for personal circumstances, pointed to payment arrangements and the duty of debtors to act, exempted single parents from set-off against the child budget, and promised to discuss the report's recommendations with the LOSR and inform parliament.
The Tax Authority makes every effort to respect the subsistence allowance in line with the Schouten et al. motion.
De Belastingdienst spant zich maximaal in om conform de motie Schouten c.s. de beslagvrije voet te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Steeds meer mensen onvindbaar voor schuldeisers’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that debtors increasingly disappear to avoid creditors, including ex-partners left liable for their debts. The government answered that it does not want debtors to evade responsibility, pointed to debt assistance, and described existing public-summons procedures and the new EU EEX Regulation enabling cross-border enforcement from January 2015.
Whether this occurs frequently is not known.
Of dit veel voorkomt is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Schouten over schulden voorkomen
