Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether he knew of CNV union debt-prevention courses for employees, whether he would engage employers and unions on debt prevention and wage garnishment, and whether he would research the effect of financial problems on sickness absence. The State Secretary answered yes to all three, citing sector initiatives such as aviation, subsidies to Hogeschool Utrecht, ongoing talks with Nibud and Divosa, and a 2012 study on sickness absence.
Yes, I am certainly willing to do so.
Ja, daar ben ik zeker toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welzijn over "het privacy lek van het UWV"

An MP asked the minister and state secretary about reported weak privacy protection at UWV and the municipality of 's-Hertogenbosch regarding access to the Suwinet data system, including missing security plans and incomplete logging. The government admits the security requirements are not fully met, says UWV and the municipality are remedying the shortcomings, and promises formal adoption of plans and procedures in early 2015 and an inspection follow-up reported in April 2015.
We find that not all of the required security standards are being complied with and that the risks are therefore too great.
Wij stellen vast dat niet alle gestelde beveiligingseisen worden nageleefd en dat daarmee de risico's te groot zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de pensioenmaximering op € 100.000 en de verlaging van de opbouw, die bij heel veel werkgevers niet tijdig wordt doorgevoerd en de fiscale gevolgen die dat kan hebben

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about the EUR 100,000 pension accrual cap, the risk that employers fail to adapt schemes in time, and the tax and legal consequences including dual or part-time employment cases. The State Secretary answered each question, explaining the glijclausule option, the per-employment application of the cap, the limited legal risk for employers, and that no treaty changes are needed.
As far as can be seen, the risk of a claim is therefore very small.
Naar het zich laat aanzien is het risico op een claim daarom zeer gering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Schouten over onoplosbare schulden

MPs Yücel and Schouten asked about the Jungmann report on unsolvable debt situations, including eligibility criteria for debt rescheduling, municipal barriers, behavioural factors and alternative help. The state secretary answered that the report's exclusion practices conflict with the Wgs, that municipal help should be client-oriented, and that a broader range of support exists beyond debt rescheduling, with a letter on the debt policy and the land debt register promised for December.
Excluding debtors does not solve the underlying problem.
Het uitsluiten van schuldenaren lost de eigenlijke problematiek niet op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het snel willen instemmen met de nieuwe richtlijn voor pensioenen in de EU zonder de Kamer daarover tijdig en adequaat te informeren

Omtzigt (CDA) asked why the government sent a 79-page compromis on the EU IORP pensions directive only days before the Coreper vote, without prior briefing as promised, and asked it to postpone agreement until January 2015. The Staatssecretaris replied that the government kept its promised information, sent a progress letter in October and an appreciation on 4 December, and that a deal needed to be reached before the Italian presidency ended, so postponement was not desirable.
We attach great importance to these agreements and are of the view that we have informed the House of Representatives as well as possible.
Wij hechten zeer aan deze afspraken en zijn van mening dat we de Tweede Kamer zo goed mogelijk geïnformeerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over “de afkoop van kleine pensioenen"

An MP asked whether the government had agreed with pension bodies to postpone payment of small pension buy-outs and whether the fiscal timing and the continued-work requirement could be relaxed. The government said the discussed solution proved unworkable under tax rules, but an adopted amendment now allows postponing the buy-out to the first day of the month after reaching the AOW age without the continued-work requirement.
This was also reported in the letter of 2 July about the buy-out of a small pension.
Dit is ook gemeld in de brief van 2 juli jl. over de afkoop van een klein pensioen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over “de pensioenuitkering en afkoop klein pensioen op verjaardag”

MP Vermeij asked whether the tax authority requires pensions to start only on the pensioner's birthday from 1 January 2015, and how this squares with the government's July 2014 letter on buying out small pensions. The state secretary replied that tax rules have not changed on pension start dates, that the timing of payouts is for pension providers, and that an amendment Vermeij co-sponsored now lets small-pension buyouts be deferred to the first day of the month after the AOW age.
This is not new as of 1 January 2015; the changes to the Witteveen scheme on that date change nothing about the pension start date or the pension target age.
Dit is niet nieuw per 1 januari 2015; de wijzigingen van het Witteveenkader per die datum veranderen niets aan de pensioeningangsdatum of de pensioenrichtleeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters, Van der Linde en Visser over het bericht ‘Social return kost taxichauffeurs baan’

MPs Potters, Van der Linde and Visser asked the State Secretary about reports that social return requirements displaced taxi drivers, including KNV's claim that 5,000 drivers lost jobs, and about the expertise and monitoring of such placements. The State Secretary acknowledged displacement concerns, said she cannot calculate social costs or judge individual firms, stated that re-integration is a municipal responsibility, and that no central data exist on sustainability of placements, while noting that the central government drops social return where displacement risk is real.
With the introduction of the WWB in 2004, implementation of the law became the responsibility of municipalities.
Met de introductie van de WWB in 2004 behoort de uitvoering van de wet tot de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over "de berichten dat huishoudens met financiële problemen de samenleving jaarlijks elf miljard euro kosten"

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about Nibud findings that over-indebted households cost society eleven billion euros a year, and whether debt prevention should be strengthened in policy and law. The State Secretary answered that the figures rest on existing research, that prevention is already anchored in law and municipal policy, and that she will support municipalities through platform meetings and further monitoring.
I endorse the importance Nibud attaches to a broad approach to debt prevention, with specific attention to making people self-reliant and to insight into behaviour.
Ik onderschrijf het belang dat Nibud hecht aan een brede aanpak van preventie van schulden met daarin specifieke aandacht voor het zelfredzaam maken van mensen en inzicht in het gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat 2,5 miljoen mensen in Nederland onder de armoedegrens leven

Yücel (PvdA) asked the state secretary about a report claiming 2.5 million people in the Netherlands live below the poverty line, and how this squares with CBS and CPB figures of 1.2 million. Klijnsma answered that the higher figure uses the EU AROPE indicator, that the government's standard low-income measure gives about 1.3 million people, and that she supports an integrated anti-poverty approach with municipalities.
The concept of poverty is not a fixed notion that can best be measured by a single key figure; there are several angles and definitions to gain insight into the different aspects of the problem.

Het begrip armoede is geen vastomlijnd concept dat het beste door middel van één kerncijfer gemeten zou kunnen worden, er zijn meerdere invalshoeken en definities om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende aspecten van de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitzending ‘Altijd wat monitor’ over verdringing van betaald werk door werklozen

An MP (Karabulut, SP) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about displacement of paid work by welfare recipients, including a benefit-linked taxi project in Twente, social return numbers and dismissals, and how municipalities will be held to preventing displacement. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Work and Assistance Act and monitor such instruments, that she will not comment on specific cases, that national social return figures are not held centrally, and that the minister will discuss displacement with the VNG.
I do not have national figures on the use of social return by municipalities.
Ik beschik niet over landelijke cijfers ten aanzien van de inzet van social return door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Enschede aanvragers van een uitkering vier weken laat wachten alvorens de aanvraag in behandeling te nemen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the municipality of Enschede may delay processing benefit applications from people over 27 by a month, and whether the government will stop this practice and what sanctions apply. The State Secretary answered that the WWB requires an advance within four weeks, that municipalities are responsible under decentralised implementation with council oversight and only exceptional intervention by the national government, that the Inspectorate does not judge individual municipalities, and that complaints can go to the municipal complaints committee, ombudsman, objection or appeal.
Implementation of the WWB has been decentralised to the college of mayor and aldermen of a municipality.
De uitvoering van de WWB is gedecentraliseerd aan het college van burgemeester en wethouders van een gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn, Moors en Van Oosten over het bericht “Tweetal steelt AOW via DigiD-fraude”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about a report that two people stole old-age pensions via DigiD phishing fraud, and how victims were compensated and future fraud prevented. The state secretary answered that a criminal investigation found about 5,000 possibly misused DigiD accounts and total losses of about 50,000 euro, that victims were fully compensated, and that the government will try to recover the money and promote safer DigiD use, with a promised overview of further measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van Dekken en Nijboer over het sluiten van de metaalafdeling van Synergon

MPs Kerstens, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked the State Secretary about the closure of Synergon's metal department, the failed takeover talks, the long uncertainty for staff and possible support for an external investigation. The State Secretary said responsibility for the Wsw lies with the municipalities, so she cannot comment on the company's operations, but pointed to a sector-wide Cedris programme, a provincial independent inquiry and regional funding.
Responsibility for implementing the Wsw is assigned to the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van de Wsw is belegd bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over tijdelijke contracten in de sociale werkvoorziening

MP Kerstens asks the state secretary whether temporary contracts for sheltered-work employees are being left unrenewed in some municipalities, whether an income drop for WIA recipients is accurate, and what concrete steps will secure the priority placement and sheltered-work budget. The state secretary says renewal is possible but municipalities decide themselves, cites the budget effects and placement efforts, and says work on WAO/WIA measures is ongoing.
They therefore decide for themselves, as has always been the case over recent decades, on matters including whether to renew temporary contracts or convert them into permanent ones.
Zij beslissen dus zelf, zoals de afgelopen decennia ook steeds het geval is geweest, over onder meer het wel of niet verlengen van tijdelijke contracten c.q. het omzetten daarvan in vaste contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de hoogte van de AOW-uitkering in het buitenland

An MP asked how many Dutch AOW pensioners live abroad, with which countries treaties exist for checking the cohabitation criterion, how the SVB verifies survival in non-treaty countries, and whether treaties should be pursued more widely. The State Secretary answered that treaty-based enforcement is the policy basis, that few new treaties are feasible, that 21 countries are under negotiation, and that the provisional application of the Costa Rica treaty was ended in 2012.
It has been the aim of the Dutch government, after adoption of the Export Restriction of Benefits bill, to conclude such enforcement treaties with as many countries as possible.
Het is de inzet geweest van de Nederlandse regering om na aanvaarding van het wetsvoorstel Beperking Export Uitkeringen (BEU) met zoveel mogelijk landen een dergelijk handhavingsverdrag te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Rekenfout kost 1,3 miljoen’

An MP asks why six municipalities must repay Wsw sheltered-employment budget for 2011, and whether they can be exempted if they show the money went to jobs. The state secretary answers that the repayments follow from documented under-realisation under the Sisa system, that the municipalities' audited accounts were accepted by their councils, and that she cannot deviate from the statutory rules, though two municipalities have appealed to the court.
Municipalities have an explicit responsibility of their own in this regard.
Gemeenten hebben hierin uitdrukkelijk een eigen verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over het kwijtraken van pensioen bij bijstand in Enschede

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the state secretary about Enschede's plan to require early cashing-in of occupational pension before claiming social assistance, and whether the Wet werk en bijstand permits this. The secretary called the plan undesirable, noted Enschede has withdrawn it, and promised a proposal to prevent municipalities forcing early pension withdrawal, plus a call to municipalities in the next letter.
Social assistance recipients should not be forced by municipalities to take their second-pillar pension early within the framework of assistance.
Bijstandsgerechtigden zouden – in het kader van de bijstand – niet door gemeenten verplicht moeten worden om hun 2 e pijler pensioen vervroegd in te laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Enschede werklozen wil verplichten hun aanvullend pensioen op te eten alvorens zij recht krijgen op bijstand

An SP MP asked whether Enschede's plan to require welfare applicants to first draw down their supplementary pension was lawful and how it fits government policy protecting pension savings. The Secretary of State called the plan undesirable, said she will propose a legal change so municipalities cannot force early pension drawdown, and explained the Inspectorate's review of Enschede's financial recovery plan and regional job prospects.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de gemeente Enschede een zoekperiode van vier weken voor de bijstand hanteert

An SP MP asked the Minister whether Enschede should stop its four-week job-search period before assessing welfare applications, which he argued causes debt and wrongful rejections, and whether the municipality's advance-payment practice and budget pressures should be addressed. The Minister answered that municipalities may impose a four-week search obligation but must process applications within it for people aged 27 and over, that he had informed the alderman, that he had no known cases of missed advance-payment deadlines, and that municipal budget shortfalls are a structural part of budget financing with mitigation measures available.
I have since informed the alderman for Social Affairs of the municipality of Enschede about this.
Ik heb de wethouder van Sociale Zaken van de gemeente Enschede hierover inmiddels geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de toepassing van de uitzondering op de maximale periode van 10 jaar voor de vrijwillige verzekering van de AOW

MP Schouten asked whether the SVB wrongly excludes volunteers sent abroad by designated development organisations from the exception to the 10-year limit on voluntary AOW insurance, how many are affected, and what group the exception targets. The State Secretary replied that the SVB applies the exception to all qualifying development workers, including volunteers and interns, provided the placement is under a designated Dutch organisation, and agreed that longer voluntary insurance for such volunteers is desirable.
All development workers who meet the conditions set out in the regulations are eligible for the exception to the maximum duration of voluntary AOW insurance.
Alle ontwikkelingswerkers die aan de in de regelgeving genoemde voorwaarden voldoen komen in aanmerking voor toepassing van de uitzondering op de maximale duur van de vrijwillige AOW-verzekering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Woede om gouden handdruk manager'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers about a reported €294,476 severance payment to a unit manager of the Amersfoort sheltered-work body, whether municipal aldermen knew, and whether it breaches the WNT pay-cap law. The minister answered that the manager was not a top official under the WNT so the cap did not apply, the payment was reported and explained, the board was only informed afterwards and is discussing it with management, and no action to reclaim the payment was announced.
Strictly speaking, this question should not be directed at the ministers of BZK and SZW.
Deze vraag hoort strikt genomen niet te worden gericht aan de bewindspersonen van BZK en SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat er gigantische onrust heerst onder alleenstaande ouders met een bijstandsuitkering vanwege fors inkomensverlies in 2015

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the government would reverse the income losses for single parents on social assistance caused by the 2015 child benefit reform and how many would be affected. Minister Asscher answered that the reform removes the single-parent supplement, that about 78,500 single parents on benefits are affected, that the income effects will be shown in the 2015 budget, and that the reform is expected to have only small effects on poverty and to be monitored.
No figures are available on the realised purchasing power development of single parents on social assistance.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de gerealiseerde koopkrachtontwikkeling van alleenstaande ouders in de bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een stijgend aantal stagiairs fulltime werkt zonder enige vergoeding

MP Karabulut asked the minister whether unpaid full-time internships are increasing, what criteria define a stage, how many internships and pay levels exist, and whether rules or Inspectorate checks should follow. The minister said he lacks data to confirm the trend, set out criteria distinguishing a stage from work, declined to add new rules, and said the Inspectorate will act only on concrete complaints.
Performing an internship without any financial reward is as such not an offence.
Het verrichten van een stage zonder dat daar een financiële beloning tegenover staat is als zodanig geen overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat een manager van een sociale werkplaats een ontslagvergoeding van 300.000 euro heeft gekregen".

An SP MP asks whether a manager of the Amersfoort sheltered workplace RWA received a 300,000 euro severance payment from public funds, whether the payment is defensible, whether it will be reversed, and whether SW manager salaries should be capped. The State Secretary confirms a severance of about 294,476 euro under a social plan, says employment terms are not her responsibility, and refuses to reverse it, noting the WNT cap does not apply to this unit manager but the payment was publicly disclosed.
I am not a party to agreements on terms of employment.
Ik ben geen partij bij afspraken over arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het artikel "Bijkomen van de bijstand”

Potters (VVD) asked about reports that many welfare recipients are exempt from job-search obligations, including informal exemptions, and about the effects on work prospects. Staatssecretaris Klijnsma answered that 22% of welfare households had an exemption in December 2012, that exact reasons are not yet recorded, that exemptions fell from 35% in 2008, and that the 2015 WWB amendments will harmonise rules and add enforcement tools.
At this moment no data are available on the exact reasons for exemption from the work obligation.
Op dit moment zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over de exacte redenen van de ontheffing van de arbeidsverplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het herkeuren van Wajongers

MP Karabulut asked why Wajong beneficiaries are not told when they will be reassessed, on what criteria, and how they can prepare, given uncertainty among beneficiaries. The State Secretary answered that UWV has informed beneficiaries, that timing per quarter is not yet known and will be communicated, that criteria are set in the Schattingsbesluit, and that UWV will inform beneficiaries later this year.
At this moment it cannot yet be said which Wajong beneficiary will be assessed in which quarter.
Op dit moment is nog niet te zeggen welke Wajonger in welk kwartaal beoordeeld zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘de zwakste gemeenten minder re-integratiegeld krijgen’

An SP MP asked whether the weakest municipalities lose more re-integration funding under the new Participation Budget allocation model, and whether the government would change the model. The state secretary acknowledged an 8 percent cut affecting all municipalities, argued the model is balanced and that weak-region municipalities' share rises slightly, and declined to amend the model.
In view of the above, in my judgment an amendment of the Participation Budget allocation model is not warranted.
Gelet op het voorgaande ligt een aanpassing van het verdeelmodel Participatiebudget naar mijn oordeel niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het herkeuren van Wajongers met een indicatie voor AWBZ dagbesteding"

Member Karabulut asked whether Wajongers with an AWBZ day-care indication were wrongly sent notices for reassessment, though such people are supposedly exempt, and how many are affected. The Secretary of State answered that all Wajongers received a letter, that about 10,000 Wajongers attend day care, and that those with AWBZ day-care from 2008 onward can be deemed to have no work capacity without further assessment, though incomplete files may require the person to provide proof.
All Wajongers have received a letter from UWV stating the possible consequences of the Participation Act.
Alle Wajongers hebben van UWV een brief ontvangen waarin is aangegeven wat de mogelijke gevolgen van de Participatiewet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat er geen banen zijn voor jongeren met een laag IQ

MPs Karabulut and Siderius asked the State Secretaries about warnings that closing sheltered workplaces and the Participatiewet will leave practical-education pupils without jobs, and about the cost-effectiveness of job coaches. The government answered that practical-education pupils are being steered to work through regional school-municipality networks and ESF funding, that the Participatiewet creates new instruments such as sheltered work, and that the job coach pilot was found to be expensive with limited effect on transitions to regular work.
The central government does not close sheltered workplaces (sw-bedrijven).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Voortman over het bericht dat overheden ervoor zorgen dat langdurige werklozen en arbeidsgehandicapten een hevige concurrentiestrijd leveren aan de onderkant van de arbeidsmark

MPs Schouten and Voortman asked whether social return in public tenders disadvantages social enterprises employing people far from the labour market, and whether government will support social entrepreneurship. The government answered that social return targets only extra placements, that social and regular firms face similar obstacles, that municipalities are responsible for their own tenders, and that it has asked the SER for advice due in early 2015.
Regarding the case in the article, the municipality concerned is responsible for the tenders it issues and the social conditions it sets. I have no insight into that.

Ten aanzien van de casus in het artikel geldt dat de betreffende gemeente verantwoordelijk is voor de aanbestedingen die zij doet en de sociale voorwaarden die zij daarbij stelt. Ik heb daar geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over Marokkanen en uitkeringsfraude

An MP asks how many AIO recipients there are by country of birth, how often SVB checks foreign assets, in how many cases foreign authorities refuse cooperation, how verification of foreign data works, when sanctions are applied, and whether the approach is discriminatory. The State Secretary gives tables and counts of checks and hidden assets, states SVB relies on foreign institutions being reliable, describes penalties and suspension rules, and denies any discrimination.
The SVB has no indications that information is deliberately or knowingly provided incorrectly to the SVB.
De SVB beschikt niet over aanwijzingen dat opzettelijk of bewust niet juiste informatie wordt verstrekt aan de SVB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over misstanden bij de sociale dienst Midden-Drenthe

An MP asked the State Secretary about reported misconduct at the Midden-Drenthe social services, whether municipalities should pause placing benefit recipients with firms under inspection, for individual plans and for rules preventing displacement. The State Secretary said the municipality remains responsible, has commissioned a review of its re-integration policy, and that the matter of pausing placements is for municipalities to decide.
It is not for me to judge whether municipalities should, as a precaution, refrain from placing benefit recipients with a company under investigation under the Working Conditions Act.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen of gemeenten uit voorzorg geen bijstandsgerechtigden moeten plaatsen bij een bedrijf dat onderzocht wordt op grond van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Kuzu over de berichten dat het rijk schulden erger maakt door het inhouden van toeslagen en de stijging van het aantal mensen dat onder beschermingsbewind is geplaatst

MPs Schouten and Kuzu asked whether the state worsens household debts by clawing back excess childcare and other benefit advances, and about the rise in people placed under protective administration (beschermingsbewind). The state secretary acknowledged the repayment problem, described repayment arrangements and the protection of the subsistence allowance, said the Rijksincassovisie would address it, and referred to a separate letter for the protective administration questions.
If the benefit applicant cannot pay the amount under the standard payment arrangement, he can ask for a tailored payment arrangement.
Wanneer de toeslagaanvrager het bedrag van de standaard betalingsregeling niet kan opbrengen, kan hij om een betalingsregeling op maat vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de afkoop van kleine pensioenen

An MP asked whether the pension start date for small pensions, and their buy-out, could be shifted to the prevailing AOW age, and whether the government would discuss pension rule changes with social partners. The government answered that no legal obstacles exist, that the working-on requirement was waived by a 2012 policy decision, and that social partners are already adjusting pension rules.
There are no legal obstacles to setting this pension start date in the collective pension scheme at or after the prevailing AOW age.
Er zijn geen wettelijke belemmeringen om deze in de collectieve pensioenregeling te bepalen pensioeningangsdatum te stellen op of na de geldende AOW-leeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het faillissement van de private schuldbemiddelaar Bureau Integraal in Groningen

MP Karabulut asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of private debt mediator Bureau Integraal in Groningen, including whether it may invest client funds, whether current rules prevent such abuse, and whether private debt mediators should face quality standards and be allowed to charge fees. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said current rules are sufficient apart from better information, noted that a general measure allowing paid private debt mediation is in preparation and will be sent to parliament before the summer recess, and gave statistics on enforcement.
As is customary, I do not make specific statements about individual cases.
Zoals gebruikelijk doe ik over individuele gevallen geen specifieke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Gemeenten in Oost-Groningen failliet door werkvoorziening’

An MP asks the State Secretary about reports that municipalities in East Groningen face bankruptcy from growing deficits at sheltered-employment bodies, and whether national policy is to blame. The government replies that responsibility for the Wsw lies with municipalities, that the budget is sufficient, that efficiency gains are achievable, and that it has held and will continue consultations with the Groningen municipalities.
Responsibility for implementing the Wsw has been assigned to the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van de Wsw is belegd bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over de dreiging van een artikel 12-status voor de gemeenten Oldambt, Pekela en Bellingwedde

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked whether Oldambt, Pekela and Bellingwedde risk an article 12 financial-supervision status, what causes it, and what the new municipal fund and participation budget models mean for them. The minister answered that the province sees no current basis for the concern, pointed to efficiency cuts and the new participation budget, and listed existing support measures for weak labour-market regions.
Once there is insight into the effects of the objective models in the social domain, the need for a possible transitional arrangement will be considered.
Als er zicht is op de effecten van de objectieve modellen binnen het sociaal domein, wordt de noodzaak van een eventuele overgangsregeling bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de sluiting van Synergon Metaal te Winschoten

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of the Synergon Metaal sheltered-work metalworking unit in Winschoten, including whether workers keep their jobs and what options exist for regional employment in East Groningen. The state secretary said municipalities are responsible for sheltered employment and transfers are possible, and listed existing regional employment measures without committing to new ones.
The municipalities are responsible for the efficient implementation of the Wsw and can determine how sheltered-work employees are deployed.
De gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de efficiënte uitvoering van de Wsw en kunnen bepalen hoe de sw-medewerkers worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het eten van voedselbanken vaak onvoldoende is

An MP asked the State Secretaries about a report that food bank recipients often lack enough healthy food, the food insecurity comparison with the UK, and how to get surplus food from companies to food banks. The government answered that municipalities hold primary responsibility for poverty policy, that cooperation with the food alliance is progressing, and that a tax-clarification meeting is planned.

As indicated in the answers to the questions of MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten of 25 March 2014, it is important that people who rely on food banks are helped and that the underlying problems are addressed.

Zoals in de antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten (ChristenUnie) van 25 maart 2014 (TK Aanhangsel van de Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2013–2014, nr. 1852 ) is aangegeven, is het van belang dat mensen die een beroep doen op de voedselbank geholpen worden en dat de achterliggende problematiek wordt aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de omstreden methoden van re-integratiebedrijf WorkFast

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about contested methods used by re-integration firm WorkFast, including pressure on benefit claimants with health conditions, demands for many job applications, and childcare and volunteering demands. The State Secretary declined to judge the firm, said municipalities are responsible for outsourcing and oversight, pointed to council control and complaint and appeal routes, and refused an Inspectorate investigation.
Investigation by the Inspectorate SZW is not at issue here.
Onderzoek door de Inspectie SZW is hier niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de Belgiëroute voor pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the state secretary about the risks of moving Dutch occupational pensions to Belgian cross-border pension funds (OFPs), covering supervision, member influence, solidarity rules, funding and taxation. The government answered that Dutch law and DNB/AFM supervision still apply, that Dutch members have limited direct influence over Belgian OFP documents, and that employer guarantees and funding rules remain unclear and depend on the Belgian supervisor.
It is of great importance that they pay close attention to the consequences thereof.
Het is van groot belang dat zij goed letten op de gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat slechts vijftien procent van de mensen die aankloppen bij de schuldhulpverlening daadwerkelijk wordt geholpen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a report claiming only 15% of people seeking debt help are actually helped, and about whether municipalities manipulate debt-assistance statistics and should be monitored. The State Secretary disputed the report's definition of success, said she lacks the requested figures, stated that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance and reporting, and declined to create a national complaints point, pointing to existing complaint and objection routes.
Within that division of responsibilities, it is not for me to oblige implementing parties to supply specific information.
Het is binnen die verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling niet aan mij om uitvoerende partijen te verplichten tot aanlevering van specifieke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over misstanden bij de Sociale dienst Midden-Drenthe

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about alleged abuses at the Midden-Drenthe social services, including a claimant's benefit cut, forced unpaid work, intimidation, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should investigate. The State Secretary replied that municipal implementation is a local responsibility, the municipal council has already ordered its own inquiry, and the Inspectorate has no competence over individual municipalities, while promising to send the answers before the WWB debate.
It concerns a local municipal responsibility and the factual situation is now being investigated by the municipal council.
Het betreft een lokale gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid en de feitelijke situatie wordt nu door de gemeenteraad onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over "de medische bezwaren tegen de voorgenomen herkeuring van Wajong-ers"

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary whether the planned reassessment of Wajong beneficiaries should be abandoned given its costs, psychological burden and expected waste, and whether results will be reported to parliament. The State Secretary rejects the claim of waste, says the reassessment is needed to identify who can work, and promises to inform parliament of the results after the operation is completed.
I intend to inform your House of the results after the completion of the reassessment operation.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer na afronding van de herbeoordelingsoperatie te informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat onverantwoorde leningen worden verstrekt aan huishoudens

Karabulut (SP) asked whether reports of rising problematic household debt and 210,000 households with risky loans are accurate, their causes, and how households are protected from unnecessary loans. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that over one in six households is at risk of or has problematic debt, that the figure rose between 2009 and 2012, and that credit rules have been tightened and the AFM enforces them.
That is why the rules for responsible lending have been tightened and this cabinet is focusing on strengthening people's financial self-reliance.
Daarom zijn de regels voor verantwoorde kredietverlening aangescherpt en zet dit kabinet in op het versterken van de financiële zelfredzaamheid van mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de vrijstelling van de pensioenpremie voor gelegenheidswerkers onder druk staat

MPs Lodders and Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asked whether the pension premium exemption for short-term agricultural casual workers conflicts with equal treatment law, and what it costs employers if the exemption ends. The Secretary of State says the courts will decide, that social partners have reached a principle agreement subject to legal review, and that the ministry's role is limited to amending the compulsory affiliation scheme.
Whether the pension premium exemption for casual workers is or is not contrary to the law is ultimately a matter for the courts.
Of de vrijstelling van pensioenpremie bij gelegenheidswerkers al dan niet in strijd met de wet is, is uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat ambtenaren gegevens van bekende Nederlanders bekijken

MPs Ulenbelt and Van Weyenberg asked about reports that municipal staff looked up records of well-known Dutch people in the Suwinet system without need, and what measures had been taken since November 2013. The state secretary called such access unacceptable, outlined VNG and CBP measures, a planned escalation protocol to cut off access from early 2015, and further technical measures, but gave few new firm commitments.
I find it unacceptable that employees of municipalities and social services consult data of well-known Dutch people without any necessity.
Ik vind het niet acceptabel dat medewerkers van gemeenten en sociale diensten zonder enige noodzaak gegevens van bekende Nederlanders raadplegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de informatievoorziening van pensioenfondsen, met name over gebruikmaking aanvullingsregelingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether pension funds deliberately omitted from their communication that contributions to early-retirement supplementary schemes could also be used to top up the final pension, and whether funds should be required to disclose all interests of participants. The State Secretary said the case was ruled on by a court with the appeal declared unfounded, that information must be complete on relevant parts but need not address every individual interest, and that a planned Wet pensioencommunicatie will require balanced communication.
I intend to forward the pension communication bill to the Council of Ministers and the Council of State soon.
Ik ben voornemens het wetsvoorstel pensioencommunicatie binnenkort door te geleiden naar de ministerraad en de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het afkopen van een klein pensioen

Mr Omtzigt asked the ministers about problems with buying out small pensions before retirement, including effects on rent allowance, AOW partner allowance and benefits, and whether the government would reverse or prevent buy-outs. The government answered that it sees no feasible way to reverse past buy-outs or compensate those affected, but will work with pension providers on better information and will inform parliament before the summer recess.
I deeply regret that people have suffered adverse financial consequences from the buy-out of a small pension.
Ik betreur het ten zeerste dat mensen nadelige financiële gevolgen hebben ondervonden van de afkoop van een klein pensioen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Potters over de gevolgen van het hebben van schulden voor zzp’ers

Two VVD MPs asked whether self-employed people (zzp'ers) with debts are effectively excluded from debt relief, since minnelijke trajecten are often unavailable and the Wsnp generally requires ending the business. The State Secretary answered that the Bbz scheme is the first route for viable businesses, that continuation under the Wsnp is possible with judicial permission but judges are cautious, and that municipalities decide how debt assistance is organised.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing the Bbz.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het Bbz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over Marokkanen en uitkeringsfraude

MP De Graaf (PVV) asked whether the SVB's request for Moroccan identity numbers from benefit recipients is a sound fraud-detection tool, whether those refusing to cooperate should lose benefits, and what the government does to trace property abroad. Secretary Klijnsma answered that the number is needed only when investigation in Morocco is required, that non-cooperation can lead to benefit suspension decided case by case, and that cross-border asset checks run through existing SVB and UWV teams.
Because the SVB does not use the CIN number at this stage of its investigation, it does not need to be supplied now.
Omdat de SVB in dit stadium van haar onderzoek geen gebruik maakt van het CIN-nummer, hoeft dit nu niet te worden aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over het bericht dat de Voedselbank EU-geld voor armoedebestrijding opeist

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked why the government is using EU food-aid fund FEAD for 2014-2020, whether consultation occurred, and how food surpluses could better reach food banks. The state secretary answered that the funds are reallocated from ESF/EFRO rather than additional, that the fund targets social inclusion, and that gemeenten and the AVV-Voedselbanken cooperation are being engaged, with promises of further talks and support.
It is correct that for the 2014-2020 programme period the Netherlands will deploy 3.5 million euros for the EU Fund for European Aid to the Most Deprived (FEAD).
Het klopt dat Nederland voor de programmaperiode 2014–2020 3,5 miljoen euro zal inzetten voor het Fonds voor Europese hulp aan de meestbehoeftigen (FEAD).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "een forse toename in het aantal klachten over de Rotterdamse Sociale Dienst"

An MP asked about a sharp rise in complaints about the Rotterdam social services department, its inability to process growing benefit applications, and whether this is a national problem. The State Secretary said responsibility lies primarily with the municipal executive and council, saw no signals of similar problems elsewhere, pointed to statutory deadlines and advance payments, and declined to take additional measures or order an inspection.

In this context I point out that the proper and lawful implementation of the WWB is primarily a matter between the executive college of mayor and aldermen and the policy-setting and supervising municipal council.
In dit kader wijs ik erop dat een juiste en rechtmatige uitvoering van de WWB primair een aangelegenheid is tussen het uitvoerende college van B&W en de kaderstellende en controlerende gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de Werkkamer zegt dat een grote groep jonggehandicapten, straks onzichtbaar, verdwijnt achter de voordeur

MP Karabulut asked whether the Werkkamer chair's warning that many young disabled people will disappear behind the front door under the Participation Act is shared, and how the government will prevent it, including questions on job chances, the rules for municipalities and the 125,000 guaranteed jobs. The State Secretary rejects the picture of a large group disappearing, points to municipal instruments, the distribution model and the job agreement, but does not guarantee equal chances and refers largely to ongoing regional initiatives.
I cannot guarantee that, just as I cannot for every job seeker with full work capacity.
Dat kan ik niet garanderen, net zo min als ik dat kan voor iedere werkzoekende met volledig werkvermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over wedstrijden dieren doodschieten

An MP asks whether hunting contests to shoot as many crows and jackdaws as possible, including during breeding season, are acceptable and whether the exemption list should be reconsidered. The Secretary of State calls framing pest control as a contest inappropriate but says the species may legally be hunted year-round and defers responsibility for conduct to hunters.
I find it inappropriate that pest control and damage control are announced as a contest.
Ik vind het ongepast dat beheer en schadebestrijding als wedstrijd wordt aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ontslag van schoonmakers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether hundreds of cleaners risk losing jobs because municipalities give cleaning work to sheltered workshops, and whether existing staff should be taken over and whether the 125,000 extra jobs pledge is being honoured. The State Secretary said municipal procurement is the municipality's own matter, that no evidence of hundreds of job losses was found, and that whether extra jobs materialise will be shown in future labour-participation data.
The choice in tendering by the municipality for suppliers and service providers is a matter for the municipality itself. I have no involvement in that.
De keuze bij aanbesteding van de gemeente voor leveranciers en dienstverleners is een zaak van de gemeente zelf. Ik heb daar geen bemoeienis mee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht ‘Nibud bevestigt dat Bonaire ver onder de armoedegrens leeft’

MPs Kuzu and Van Laar asked about a report by the Nibud finding that Bonaire lives well below the poverty line, and whether the government has the report and how it compares to the CBS study and the social minimum in the European Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that Bonaire commissioned the report for its own poverty policy, that the Nibud figures are reference amounts not norms, that the CBS study is a separate economic study, and that the government will engage with the island's executive but will not base national minimum wage or benefit levels on the Nibud report.
The Nibud study cannot be the basis for national policy on the levels of the statutory minimum wage and benefits.
Het Nibud-onderzoek kan niet de basis zijn voor het rijksbeleid ten aanzien van de niveaus van het wettelijk minimumloon en de uitkeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over waardeoverdracht

An MP from the VVD asks the state secretary for Social Affairs about the situations in which pension value transfer is possible, its size and main problems, and the pros and cons of different systems. The state secretary lists the legal situations, cites about 115,000 transfers a year worth EUR 1.7 billion, and says she is still studying options without committing to a specific outcome.
I will answer the questions for the General Consultation on Pension Matters, which has been moved to 20 March.
Ik beantwoord de vragen voor het Algemeen Overleg Pensioenonderwerpen, dat is verplaatst naar 20 maart a.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens en van het lid Pieter Heerma over de inschakeling van bijstandsgerechtigden tijdens de kerstdrukte bij PostNL

MPs Kerstens and Pieter Heerma asked whether jobseekers on welfare were placed at PostNL during the Christmas peak through a temporary agency, whether this was a stepping stone or a benefit obligation, and whether municipalities should agree rules to prevent displacement of regular workers. The State Secretary answered that these were regular temporary jobs paid at the normal wage with benefit offset, not a tegenprestatie, that no displacement occurred, and that rules to prevent displacement are expected by spring.
There is no displacement but regular temporary paid work by welfare recipients.
Er is geen sprake van verdringing maar van regulier tijdelijk betaald werk door bijstandsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over ontslagen bij sociale werkplaats Novatec

An MP asks the State Secretary whether plans by sheltered workplace Novatec to cut 50 to 100 jobs, and the implied loss of Wsw rights and placement prospects, are acceptable, and how placement at regular employers can be guaranteed. The State Secretary replies that Novatec denies cutting jobs, that the workers stay employed and will be placed at regular employers under the Participatiewet, that Wsw rights are unchanged, and that municipalities decide how places are realised.
The statutory provisions under the Wsw remain applicable to the group of people who work under the Wsw with a Wsw referral when the Participation Act takes effect.
De wettelijke bepalingen op grond van de Wsw blijven van toepassing op de groep mensen die met de inwerkingtreding van de Participatiewet met een Wsw-indicatie in de Wsw werkzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Gerven over het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) dat jonge werkloze medische specialisten met behoud van uitkering aan het werk zet

SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that young unemployed medical specialists work unpaid at the AMC while keeping their benefits, and how many are underpaid, whether this is minimum-wage evasion or fraud, and how underpayment will be ended. The State Secretary answered that pay must meet legal and CAO obligations, that the number of unpaid specialists is unknown, that no complaints have reached the inspectorates so no investigation is under way, and that the government sees no underpayment under the specialists' terms of employment.
It is unknown how many medical specialists work unpaid. This is not registered.
Het is onbekend hoeveel medisch specialisten onbetaald werken. Dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'PGGM haalt beleggingen uit Israëlische banken'

MPs Madlener, De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government considers PGGM's divestment from Israeli banks a boycott, how much PGGM invests in Israel and the Palestinian territories, and what the government will do against investor withdrawal and anti-Israel sentiment. The minister answered that PGGM's decision is its own, that PGGM still invests in Israeli companies (over EUR 60 million in several dozen firms), that the government does not track investments and does not intervene in company decisions, and that it is working to deepen economic ties with Israel.
The government does not keep track of PGGM's investments.
Het kabinet houdt de investeringen van PGGM niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over de verhoging van het wettelijk minimumuurloon op Saba

Conservative MP Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asks why the minimum wage on Saba is raised before the CBS study is complete, why the decision was not debated in advance, and how it affects benefits, pensions and competitiveness. State Secretary Klijnsma answers that the increase follows agreed policy and ministerial authority without prior parliamentary procedure, that benefits and pensions are adjusted in line with it, and that local employers and the island government were consulted and already pay more than the new minimum.
Setting the amounts under the Wet minimumlonen BES is a ministerial power, without a prior-consultation (voorhang) procedure.
Het vaststellen van de bedragen op grond van de Wet minimumlonen BES is een ministeriële bevoegdheid, zonder voorhangprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over "het veel te laat gepubliceerde en lang achtergehouden rapport over de doorsneepremie"

An MP from the CDA asked why the Ministry of Social Affairs delayed publishing the CPB study on the average-premium system for pensions until 20 December 2013, despite repeated promises of earlier delivery, and asked for drafts, comments and advisory group input. The State Secretary acknowledged the delays, explained the Landsadvocaat legal review and the contractual publication control, but declined to release drafts and advisory group comments.
Releasing the advisory committee's comments would breach the reasonable and customary agreement with them that their input would be used only for the study.
Het vrijgeven van opmerkingen van de begeleidingscommissie zou de zeer redelijke en gebruikelijke afspraak met hen schenden dat hun inbreng alleen ten behoeve van het onderzoek gebruikt zou worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Karabulut over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Spoorwegen vast personeel van de fietsenstallingen wil vervangen door werklozen

MPs Smaling and Karabulut asked whether NS was replacing permanent bicycle-parking staff with unemployed re-integration workers and whether it was negotiating with Halfords; the state secretary replied that the reports were largely inaccurate, NS had terminated nine parking contracts with a planned uniform national formula, and expects new operators to take over existing staff. The answers rely on NS's account and refuse to exercise any power over private operators' personnel policy.
I have no relationship with these operators and no authority to enforce that one operator rehires the staff of another operator in such cases.

Ik heb geen enkele relatie met deze exploitanten en ik heb geen bevoegdheid om af te dwingen dat de ene exploitant in voorkomende gevallen het personeel van de andere exploitant opnieuw in dienst neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de toekenning van MAU- en IAU-uitkeringen

An MP asked the State Secretary about the handling of MAU and IAU supplementary welfare payments for municipalities, including the rejection of Enschede's application based on an exploratory econometric study and the number of applications and rejections. The State Secretary answered that 96 IAU and 45 MAU applications were filed, explained the Toetsingscommissie WWB assessment process, defended the Enschede review as careful and noted that objections and appeals remain available.
The Toetsingscommissie WWB has not yet been able to give me advice on Enschede's MAU application.
Over het MAU-verzoek van Enschede heeft de Toetsingscommissie WWB mij nog geen advies kunnen uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Potters over de stelselmatige fraude met Veiligheid, Gezondheid en Milieuchecklist Aannemers (VCA) examens

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Potters asked whether more arrests will follow in the VCA safety-certificate exam fraud case in Zwijndrecht, how it was discovered, its safety implications, and how future risks will be prevented. The minister said the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, that Inspectie SZW acted on a report from the Stichting Examenkamer, and that the private exam providers are responsible for preventing fraud while revoked certificates and enforcement by Inspectie SZW and the Openbaar Ministerie are the response.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot currently make any statements about this case.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik op dit moment geen mededelingen doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en De Wit over het bericht dat incassobureaus zich nog steeds niet aan de regels houden

MPs Siderius and De Wit asked whether collection agencies still charge excessive collection costs and whether the Wet normering buitengerechtelijke incassokosten should carry a sanction for non-compliance. The State Secretary said it is too early to judge the law's effect, that civil-law remedies exist for consumers, and that he will send a letter on enforcement before the Christmas recess.
As promised during the General Consultation of 3 July 2013 on civil law matters, I will send your House a letter before the Christmas recess on enforcement of the debt collection costs act.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 3 juli 2013 inzake civielrechtelijke onderwerpen zal ik uw Kamer – voor het Kerstreces – een brief sturen over de handhaving van de wet incassokosten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over Nederlandse financiële instellingen die investeren in kernwapens

An MP asks whether the government will restrict Dutch financial institutions, including the ABP pension fund and ABN AMRO, from investing in nuclear weapons producers, and whether it will pressure them to stop. The government answers that the NPT does not ban such investment, that institutions bear their own responsibility under national law, that no ban is being considered, and that it sees no added value in raising the issue again with ABP.
With reference to the answer to question 1, no ban on investing in companies that manufacture nuclear weapon components is being considered.
Onder verwijzing naar het antwoord bij vraag 1 wordt er geen verbod inzake het investeren in bedrijven die onderdelen voor kernwapens maken overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de forse verlaging van de vermogensgrenzen in de Wet Werk en Bijstand

An SP MP asked why the state secretary did not inform the House about a sharp cut in the asset limits of the Work and Assistance Act (WWB) effective 1 January 2014, and about the reasons, numbers and savings. The state secretary replied that the limits were not cut: the statute text shows original 2003 amounts with indexed amounts in brackets, the 2014 limits are not yet known and will be indexed by the consumer price index and published in the Staatscourant, and gemeenten will be informed via the Gemeenteloket.
The asset limits in the Work and Assistance Act (WWB) are not and will not be lowered as of 1 January 2014.
De vermogensgrenzen in de Wet werk en bijstand (WWB) zijn en worden niet verlaagd per 1 januari 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het afwijzen van een maximale uitkeringsduur in de bijstand

MP Siderius asked why the government accepts Amsterdam's plan to investigate a maximum benefit duration in social assistance, whether this conflicts with the constitutional right to assistance, and how people would support themselves after the maximum expired. The State Secretary answered that the WWB prohibits a fixed maximum duration, that Amsterdam itself concluded the plan conflicts with the law, and that the scenario of an expired maximum therefore does not arise.
Under the Work and Assistance Act (WWB) it is not permitted to attach a maximum benefit duration to the right to assistance in advance.
Op grond van de Wet werk en bijstand (WWB) is het niet toegestaan vooraf een maximale uitkeringsduur aan het recht op bijstand te verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen inzake het lid Siderius over het bericht dat sociale diensten en de vakbond de regels voor de tegenprestatie in de bijstand te onduidelijk vinden

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs how the government will respond to reports that municipal social services and the union find the rules on the bijstand tegenprestatie unclear, to the poor reintegration offered, to the share of recipients getting no support, to the SP study of recipients' views, and to delays in processing benefit applications. The State Secretary answers that municipalities have wide discretion, that the tegenprestatie will become mandatory from 1 July 2014 via a bill, that Divosa will get a support guide, and that the other points are municipal responsibilities or are defended on policy grounds.
I lack information about municipalities that exceed the statutory term for applications for a benefit under the bijstand.
Het ontbreekt mij aan informatie over gemeenten die de wettelijke termijn voor de aanvraag van een bijstandsuitkering overschrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over werknemers die door werklozen worden verdrongen en bijstandsgerechtigden die gedwongen onder het minimumloon werken

An SP MP asked the state secretary about Schagen's practice of replacing school-transport drivers with benefit recipients working under the minimum wage, and about similar schemes such as PostNL in Sittard. The state secretary said municipalities bear responsibility for implementing the WWB and she does not judge their policy, described the arrangements as social-return placements with six-month contracts, and said she lacks data on how many PostNL placements led to regular jobs.
With the introduction of the WWB in 2004, implementation of the law became the responsibility of the municipalities.
Met de introductie van de WWB in 2004 behoort de uitvoering van de wet tot de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat werklozen in Rotterdam verplicht moeten sporten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether it is acceptable that Rotterdam requires welfare recipients to exercise twice a week under threat of benefit cuts, and whether this is based on law and serves job placement. The State Secretary replied that implementing the WWB is a municipal responsibility, that the exercise programme is a labour-integration measure under article 9-1b WWB, and that sanctions are handled by the municipality with appeal rights available.
I have no reason to assume that this allocation of responsibility is not functioning.
Ik heb geen reden aan te nemen dat deze verantwoordelijkheidtoedeling niet functioneert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over “stratenmakers die verdrongen worden door werklozen”

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether municipal work-with-benefit schemes that have unemployed people paving streets displace regular paving workers and undermine skilled jobs. The state secretary declined to judge municipal policy, said the municipality reports no displacement and that the activities are small repair jobs, and noted that work with retained benefit is a legitimate reintegration tool.
It follows that I do not, in general terms, pass judgement on the policy pursued by municipalities.
Daaruit volgt dat ik in algemene zin geen oordeel uitspreek over het door gemeenten gevoerde beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "de problemen van het pensioenfonds van de sociale werkplaatsen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the government will compensate the pension fund PWRI for the deficit caused by closing the sheltered workplaces, and whether the closure will affect pension accrual and premiums. The State Secretary replied that social partners are responsible for Wsw pension financing, that talks with the VNG on the pension cost effects are ongoing, and that the government cannot yet say more.
The starting point is that social partners are themselves responsible for agreements on and financing of the Wsw pensions.
Uitgangspunt is dat sociale partners zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor afspraken over en de financiering van de Wsw-pensioenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Kosten pensioenbeheer fors gestegen’

Madlener (PVV) asks the State Secretary why pension funds' asset management costs rose by 1.5 billion euros in 2012, whether such cost increases can be justified to members, when full cost transparency will be mandated, and what will be done to curb cost growth. The State Secretary answers that the rise is mainly due to higher performance fees linked to higher returns, that voluntary disclosure has improved and Pension 1-2-3 will include costs, that higher costs are justifiable only if matched by returns, and that cost control is primarily the funds' own responsibility, with no new mandatory measures yet.
I do not have information with which I can explain the increased costs of asset management.
Ik beschik niet over informatie waarmee ik de toegenomen kosten van het vermogensbeheer kan verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Pensioenbeheer veel duurder’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that ABP paid €650m in performance fees to external asset managers while cutting pensions, and about the cost development at pension funds. The government answered that the fees reflect higher-than-benchmark returns that did not avert the cut, declined to provide a list of funds under recovery plans citing the Pensioenwet's confidentiality ban, and explained the collective structure of fund choice.
The Pensioenwet prohibits anyone from disclosing supervisory data traceable to individual pension funds.
De Pensioenwet verbiedt een ieder om bekendheid te geven aan toezichtgegevens die herleidbaar zijn naar individuele pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Pensioenbeheer veel duurder”

Rep. Klaver asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that pension fund management costs rose mainly due to higher performance fees to asset managers, and about whether bonuses should be linked to multi-year returns, cost control, and mandatory cost reporting. The State Secretary answers that higher costs are justified only if matched by higher returns, that pension funds are collectively responsible for costs, that the sector already largely bases fees on multi-year returns, that governance and transparency are the main cost-control tools, and that no additional binding measures are currently needed.
I am following these developments with interest, but for the time being I see no reason for additional measures.
Ik volg deze ontwikkelingen met belangstelling, maar zie vooralsnog geen aanleiding voor aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de definitie van samenwonen in de AOW

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about the criteria for cohabitation in the AOW state pension after a newspaper case of a married woman facing a pension reduction, and asked for the guidelines used. The state secretary explained that married and registered partners receive 50% of the minimum wage each, while unmarried cohabitants are treated as married only if they share a household (shared housing plus mutual financial or other care), judged case by case under case law, and sent an exploration of alternatives to the current cohabitation criterion.
The implementing agency determines, based on objective factual circumstances in the individual case, whether there is a shared household.
De uitvoeringsinstantie stelt op basis van objectieve feitelijke omstandigheden in het individuele geval vast of er sprake is van een gezamenlijke huishouding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over pensioenen

An MP asked how many Dutch residents are entitled to and receive Greek state pensions, how many have sought SVB help, and whether the government has contacted other countries or Greece. The State Secretary answered that the government lacks data on entitlements and payments, has received only a few signals, and sees no need for further action, while noting that collecting the pension is the pensioner's own responsibility.
I do not know how many people residing in the Netherlands are entitled to a pension from the Greek state.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel personen die woonachtig zijn in Nederland recht hebben op een pensioen van de Griekse staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de herkeuringen van jonggehandicapten

An MP asked the state secretary about re-assessments of young disabled people (Wajongers), including projections, criteria, employment figures and income support for working Wajongers. The secretary said the projections were sent to parliament earlier, that assessment is only on whether a person has work capacity, and that details of the criteria and transfer to municipalities are still being worked out with UWV and VNG.
Once this has been further worked out, Wajongers will be informed further.
Zodra dit nader is uitgewerkt zullen Wajongers nader geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer Nederlanders twee banen hebben

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that more Dutch people hold two jobs, the reasons behind it, the working poor, and long-term trends. The state secretary said about 8.5% of workers hold multiple jobs, mostly for investment or extra income, that minimum wage is relatively high, and that the CBS will publish further analysis on working poor in early 2014.
I have already asked the CBS to carry out additional analyses of the composition and, where possible, the background of the group of long-term working poor.
Ik heb het CBS reeds gevraagd om aanvullende analyses uit te voeren op de samenstelling en zo mogelijk achtergronden van de groep langdurig werkende armen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Weyenberg over het achterhalen van vaders van niet-erkende kinderen

D66 MPs asked whether municipalities may pursue biological fathers of non-recognised children for benefit recovery, how paternity is established, how this relates to privacy, and whether mothers can lose benefits for refusing cooperation. The state secretary explained the municipal procedure, the court route under the Civil Code, the mother's duty to cooperate with possible suspension of benefits, and that sperm donors are generally not liable for maintenance.
Those who carry out work under the WWB are subject to a duty of confidentiality (article 65 WWB), which adequately safeguards the privacy of those involved in municipal benefit recovery.

Voor degenen die werkzaamheden verrichten in het kader van de uitvoering van de WWB geldt een geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 65 WWB) waarmee de privacy van de betrokkenen bij gemeentelijk bijstandsverhaal afdoende is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "het sluiten van sociale werkplaatsen "

An SP MP asked the state secretary about closing sheltered workplaces (sociale werkplaatsen), their effects on unemployment, the lack of regional data on jobs and waiting lists, and why intake fell. The state secretary said the Participatiewet closes new intake from 2015 without closing existing sw-bedrijven, that regional data is unavailable or only available at macro level, and that many begeleid-werken jobs ended for mixed reasons.
I have no insight into the regional distribution of committed jobs.
Ik heb geen zicht op de regionale spreiding van toegezegde arbeidsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over armoede onder huurders

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about rising poverty among tenants, the effect of the landlord levy and rent increases, and whether the government would improve rent allowance or moderate rent policy. The State Secretary said the government takes the signal seriously, is strengthening poverty and debt policy with extra funds for municipalities, and that the landlord levy has no direct link to low-income households' spending, citing rent allowance.
I do not have that data at my disposal.
Die gegevens heb ik niet tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over armoede en de toenemende vraag naar schuldhulpverlening

Member Ulenbelt (SP) asked the state secretary about poverty, rising demand for debt assistance, the adequacy of the debt-relief budget, and the impact of cuts on low incomes. The state secretary answered that municipalities are primarily responsible, announced extra funds and a prevention focus, and described the purchasing power decline as caused by recession and austerity.
Municipalities are primarily responsible for this policy and the cabinet helps them with it.
Gemeenten zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor dit beleid en het kabinet helpt hen hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over Polen die in de sociale werkplaatsen werken

MP Ulenbelt asks whether the Rotterdam sheltered workshop Robedrijf Groen employs Polish agency workers while over 15,000 people wait for sheltered jobs, and about their pay, the numbers nationally, and whether such workshops should be for indicated persons. The state secretary answers that no Polish employees with a Wsw indication work there, only temporarily hired regular workers placed by a client, paid under the horticulture CAO, that national figures are not held, and that municipalities decide how to organise sheltered employment.
Municipalities are responsible for sheltered employment.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de sociale werkvoorziening.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Weduwe buitenland houdt pensioen’

MPs Madlener and De Graaf asked whether the government will appeal a court ruling that the lowering of survivors' benefits for widows moving abroad under the country-of-residence principle is unlawful, and whether it will introduce repair legislation. The minister confirmed an appeal will be lodged, reaffirmed the policy with an estimated €8 million budget impact, and declined to propose repair legislation.
Yes, the Social Insurance Bank will appeal the ruling of the Amsterdam District Court of 22 August.
Ja, de Sociale Verzekeringsbank zal hoger beroep instellen tegen de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam van 22 augustus jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de ramenwas-service in Arnhem

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Arnhem's window-cleaning project places welfare recipients on minimum-wage contracts below the glazier CAO, and whether it displaces regular work. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible, that the work is not comparable to the CAO, that 3 of 13 participants moved to regular jobs, and that the project will be evaluated in autumn 2013.
The municipality is responsible for monitoring the legal conditions of the various re-integration instruments.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken van de wettelijke voorwaarden van de verschillende re-integratie-instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over het stimuleren van «reshoring» en de mogelijkheden daarbij in het kader van de Participatiewet

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether reshoring of production to the Netherlands creates jobs for people with a distance to the labour market under the Participatiewet and what measures could stimulate it. The ministers replied that reshoring complements the Participatiewet, pointed to wage-cost subsidies and sector plans, and said the government will promote reshoring's job potential during implementation.

In implementing the Participatiewet, the State Secretary for Social Affairs will explicitly promote the opportunities reshoring offers for creating employment, particularly for people with a distance to the labour market.

Bij de implementatie van de participatiewet gaat de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken expliciet uitdragen welke kansen «reshoring» biedt voor het creëren van werkgelegenheid, met name voor mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het keurmerk eerlijke teelt champignons

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Fair Produce certification for mushroom farms, the difference with the Grasp assessment, and whether labour inspection would expand scrutiny of the sector. The minister stood by Fair Produce, said Grasp is only a first administrative check, committed to continued cooperation with the sector, and reported that the inspectorate had visited 54 non-certified farms and was already intensifying enforcement in the sector.
The intervention team carried out various types of inspections at the growing companies that are not certified according to the Fair Produce list.
Het interventieteam heeft verschillende soorten inspecties uitgevoerd bij de teeltbedrijven die volgens de lijst van Fair Produce niet zijn gecertificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de storing op de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

An MP from the VVD asked the minister about outages on the UWV website Werk.nl, ICT spending of about 3 billion euro since 2002, the cost and handling of telephone help, sanctions on benefit recipients who could not report on time, and how future outages will be prevented. The minister answered that the outage problems were resolved, that claimants face no penalties for missed obligations, that ICT spending is needed for efficiency with a modernisation and savings programme, and that a new platform is planned for 2015 without a guarantee of no future disruption.
Customers will suffer no financial disadvantage if, as a result of the instability, they cannot meet their obligations on time.
Klanten ondervinden er geen financieel nadeel van als zij als gevolg van de instabiliteit hun verplichtingen niet tijdig kunnen nakomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over de uitzending Zwarte Zwanen, gokken met uw pensioenpremie’

MP Krol asked the state secretary about pension fund oversight of outsourced investment, cost transparency, executive pay at outsourcing partners and fund risk-taking, after a broadcast on pension investment. The state secretary answered that fund boards, supervisory boards, DNB and AFM oversee outsourcing, that transparency measures are being considered including a possible bill, and that the government leaves pay policy largely to funds while noting regulations on remuneration.
At present I am considering whether this should be legally established.
Op dit moment wordt door mij bezien of dit juridisch vastgelegd moet worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Leijten over braille leesregels voor blinden en slechtzienden

MPs Ulenbelt and Leijten asked why blind and partially sighted people with a job must often buy two braille displays, one funded by the health insurer and one by UWV, when one could serve both settings. The government answered that the insurer-funded display may be used at work and at home, and that UWV only funds a second device when the first is unsuitable for the job, so no change or consultation is planned.
A braille display provided by the health insurer may be used both privately and in the work situation.
Een braille leesregel die is verstrekt door de zorgverzekeraar mag zowel in de privé als de werksituatie worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over berichten dat vrijwilligerswerk ouderen aan een nieuwe baan kan helpen
