MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked whether volunteering helps older people find paid work, whether government policy should change, and whether the Inspectorate's review of reintegration and tegenprestatie should consider it. State Secretary Klijnsma acknowledged volunteering can help job seekers but said existing reintegration tools are sufficient, and promised to inform the House after the Inspectorate's findings expected in October.
I am of the view that the current range of reintegration instruments is sufficient to guide people to work.
Ik ben van oordeel dat het huidige palet aan re-integratie-instrumenten voldoende is om mensen naar werk te begeleiden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de tegemoetkoming in de kosten van adoptie

An SGP MP asked why the Agentschap SZW changed the wording of the adoption-cost allowance criteria, which led to rejections of some applications, and whether the old criteria would be applied. The minister says the change was a clarification, that 35 wrongly rejected cases were reassessed and the website amended, and that the earlier criteria will be applied to the affected applications.
It was then decided to reassess these 35 cases and to amend the website, so that the lack of clarity has been removed.
Daarop is besloten deze 35 gevallen opnieuw te beoordelen en de website aan te passen, zodat de onduidelijkheid is weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de dreigende sluiting van de sociale werkplaats in Groningen

MPs Kerstens, Van Dekken and Nijboer asked whether the Secretary of State was aware of reports on the threatened closure of the Groningen sheltered workshop, whether she agreed with the term 'sterfhuisconstructie', and whether a regional-differences motion would be implemented. The Secretary answered yes to awareness, explained that the Participatiewet closes Wsw inflow from 2015 without the state closing workshops, and confirmed regional factors will be weighed in the new budget distribution.
The central government is not closing any sw-bedrijven.
Het Rijk sluit daarbij geen sw-bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een werkloze straatveger voor 400 euro minder salaris moet straatvegen

An SP MP asks whether it is acceptable that an unemployed street sweeper must sweep streets for €400 less per month under a municipal work-with-benefit arrangement, and whether this constitutes exploitation and displacement, and asks for legislative action. The state secretary replies that instruments are a municipal responsibility, that the council should supervise, that the specific case is for the alderman and council to judge, and that the inspectorate will study tegenprestatie implementation with results expected in autumn 2013.
The decision on the use of instruments to help people into work is for the municipalities.
De beslissing over de inzet van de instrumenten om mensen aan het werk te helpen is aan gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "de mededeling op de site van de Sociale verzekeringsbank dat na 2015 een eenmalige uitkering zoals een afkoopsom kan leiden tot intrekking van de partnertoeslag AOW"

Ulenbelt (SP) asked why the SVB website stated that a one-off payment such as a lump sum to the partner after 2015 could end the AOW partner allowance permanently, and whether this was premature given the pending bill. Secretary of State Klijnsma answered that the notice was separate from the pending bill, was premature because incidental income was not explicitly addressed, and that the SVB has since amended the notice.
The notice on the SVB website was in that sense premature.
Het bericht op de SVB-site was in die zin voorbarig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over “de schoolverlaterskorting in de bijstand”

An SP MP asks whether the six-month 20% reduction for school leavers claiming social assistance is fair, and whether single parents with minor children should be exempt. The state secretary defends the reduction as matching the lower living costs of students, says municipalities can account for family circumstances, and declines to create an exception under article 28 WWB.
The college can take the applicant's family situation into account.
Het college kan rekening houden met de gezinssituatie van de aanvrager.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over herkeuring van jonggehandicapten

An MP asks the state secretary why she publicly claimed Wajong beneficiaries would not be mass re-assessed, then announced re-assessments, and why figures on beneficiaries moving to welfare were given in the media but not in the letter to parliament. The secretary answers that re-assessment will follow the social accord, the detailed design is still being worked out, the figures are UWV projections, and the figures were disclosed later to avoid unrest.
Why did you omit to report this in the letter to the House of Representatives?
Heeft u verzuimd dit in de brief aan de Tweede Kamer te melden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over armoedebestrijding door Cordaid in Nederland

MP Karabulut asked the State Secretary about Cordaid's poverty projects in Dutch municipalities, whether poverty in the Netherlands should be compared with aid in developing countries, whether poverty reduction is a government task, and how the Participatiewet would avoid creating poverty. The State Secretary answered that Cordaid's projects are privately funded, that municipalities are primarily responsible for local poverty policy, that the government allocated an extra 20 million euro, and that work remains the best way out of poverty.
As I indicated in my letter of 3 July 2013 on intensifying poverty and debt policy, municipalities are primarily responsible for local poverty policy.
3 Antwoord 3 Zoals ik heb aangegeven in mijn brief van 3 juli 2013 over de intensivering van het armoede- en schuldenbeleid 4 zijn gemeenten primair verantwoordelijk voor het lokale armoedebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over werknemers van PostNL die tijdens de staking het werk van de zelfstandige pakketbezorgers overnemen

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether PostNL was right to call on its staff to deliver parcels with private cars during the strike by self-employed couriers, whether this breaches the right to strike, and how staff were insured. The minister said the parties reached an agreement, that the right to strike is for courts to weigh case by case, and that PostNL insures its staff and would be held liable as client in case of third-party damage.
It is therefore not for me but, where applicable, for the court to judge any possible conflict with the right to strike.
Het is dus niet aan mij maar in voorkomend geval aan de rechter om een oordeel te vellen over eventuele strijdigheid met het stakingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over de vergoeding van hoortoestellen aan mensen met een structurele functionele hoorbeperking

MPs Karabulut and Leijten asked why people with a structural functional hearing impairment can no longer claim hearing aids from UWV for keeping their job, whether referral to health insurers is adequate, and whether the 25% co-payment and deductible burden is acceptable. The minister answered that since 2013 all necessary hearing aids fall under the Zvw, that the 25% co-payment applies to hearing devices, and that he is not willing to reverse the change, while providing UWV and insurer expenditure figures.
No, I am not willing to reverse the removal of hearing aid reimbursements from the UWV or to expand reimbursement of hearing aids in the basic package.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om het schrappen van de vergoedingen voor hoorhulpmiddelen vanuit het UWV ongedaan te maken of om de vergoeding van hoorhulpmiddelen in het basispakket te verruimen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over onrust in de sociale werkplaats

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary about unrest at sheltered workplace Delta in Zutphen, including the phase-out of sw-employment, a director's salary, mediation costs, inspection and detachment of workers. The state secretary answered that instruction will stop after 2014 while sheltered work stays in place, that the conflict was not caused by the director's salary, that mediation cost about 56,000 euro, and that the inspectorate has investigated working conditions.
I have made inquiries about this with the municipality of Zutphen.
Ik heb hierover navraag gedaan bij de gemeente Zutphen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over de onbekendheid van verlofregelingen bij mantelzorgers

An MP asked the state secretaries about caregivers' unawareness of leave schemes, employer information duties, and how the AOW cohabitation rule affects elderly carers. The government acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing leave schemes and planned an information project and a labour-and-care summit, and referred the AOW question to a later response.
That is why we intend to carry out a project aimed at informing working caregivers and employers.
Daarom zijn wij voornemens om een project gericht op voorlichting van werkende mantelzorgers en werkgevers uit te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol ver het artikel “Verzekeraars zetten ouderen op straat”

MP Krol asked the state secretary whether health insurers' letters ending funding for residents of care homes after three years would force elderly people out of institutions, and whether that is acceptable. The state secretary replied that existing clients keep their right to institutional care, that no one will be forced to live independently, and that he is talking with care offices and provider associations about the purchasing of care.
There is no question of existing clients being forced to live independently.
Er is geen sprake van dat bestaande cliënten gedwongen worden om zelfstandig te gaan wonen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de misstanden bij sociale werkplaats Berckenrode Groep Schiedam (BGS)

An SP MP asked the state secretary about misconduct, intimidation and structural integrity failures at the sheltered workplace BGS Schiedam, including whether gemeenten and the Inspectie SZW oversee such workplaces adequately and whether a national complaints body is needed. The government accepts the commission's serious conclusions, says the responsible gemeente must act and has asked the Inspectie to re-inspect BGS, but declines to publish lists or inspection reports and rejects new national rules and a national complaints point.
It is the responsibility of the municipality of Schiedam to respond adequately and implement improvements.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Schiedam om hier adequaat op te reageren en verbeteringen door te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de berichtgeving dat alleenstaande AOW-ers minder vakantiegeld krijgen dan andere jaren

An MP asked the State Secretary why single AOW pensioners receive less holiday allowance this year, and whether the SVB would clearly communicate the cause and effect. The State Secretary explained the tax-table effect, pointed to the SVB's website and staff information, and said the communication was adequate, without committing to further action.
In my view, the SVB has acted adequately in its communication.
De SVB heeft naar mijn oordeel in de communicatie adequaat gehandeld.
Antwoord vragen Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Bijzondere bijstand op aan onkosten’

An MP asked the state secretary about rising numbers of people placed under protective administration (beschermingsbewind), whether it is granted beyond physical or mental incapacity, the quality and oversight of administrators, and the relation to debt rescheduling and municipal responsibility. The government answered that cases have tripled since 2004, that debt problems are a common ground, that a pending bill would formalise debt-related grounds and require quality standards, and that municipalities should use integrated debt assistance and can request such measures.
In the collective letter to municipalities, municipalities will be pointed to this ruling of the Central Appeals Tribunal and to the options outlined above, in line with my commitment to your House.

In de Verzamelbrief aan de gemeenten zullen gemeenten worden gewezen op deze uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep en op de hierboven geschetste mogelijkheden, conform mijn toezegging aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens en Kuzu over stijgende bewindvoerderskosten ten laste van de bijzondere bijstand

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary about rising court-appointed administrator costs (beschermingsbewind) consuming municipal special assistance budgets. The government confirmed the rise is mostly driven by more people placed under administration, said it is analysing the signals with VNG, Divosa and NVVK, and pointed to a pending bill giving municipalities power to request administration orders.
We are currently analysing the various signals received. On that basis it will be examined whether and what actions or research are needed.
Momenteel analyseren we de verschillende ontvangen signalen. Aan de hand daarvan zal bekeken worden of en zo ja welke acties of onderzoek nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het toepassen van een te lage beslagvrije voet voor mensen die wel willen maar niet kunnen betalen

MP Karabulut asks whether a reduced 81% attachment-free allowance (beslagvrije voet) applied to people who are willing but unable to pay, and whether the notorious-defaulter definition should be tightened. The government says the 90% allowance must be upheld for those unable to pay, that the 81% rate applies only to notorious defaulters, and that it will contact municipalities and water boards and clarify the interpretation of the term.
The ministries of BZK and I&M will contact municipalities and water boards to examine to what extent the situations described by the LOSR occur in practice and how they can be prevented.

De ministeries van BZK en I&M zullen met gemeenten en waterschappen in contact treden om te bezien in hoeverre de door de LOSR geschetste situaties in de praktijk optreden en hoe deze voorkomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het arrest van het Europees Hof van Justitie in zaak C-398/11

An MP asks the state secretary and foreign minister about the CJEU ruling in case C-398/11 (Hogan), which held that member states may be liable if insolvency wipes out half or more of occupational pension rights, and about its consequences for the Netherlands, European liability schemes and the government's position. The government confirms awareness, says the ruling is still being analysed with results promised before the summer recess, states no European guarantee proposal exists, and describes the Dutch position in the hearing.
The CJEU judgment in the Hogan case (C-398/11) is currently being analysed.
Het arrest van het Hof van Justitie in de zaak Hogan (C-398/11) wordt op dit moment geanalyseerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over “de combinatie van bijstand en studiefinanciering”

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary whether municipalities treat the loan component of a student partner's studiefinanciering as a preceding provision that must be drawn before welfare benefits, and whether the six-month school-leaver reduction in the Wet Werk en Bijstand should be scrapped. The state secretary answered that municipalities' practice is not recorded, that case law treats studiefinanciering as a preceding provision regardless of loan debt, that only the living-cost component counts for the joint means test, and that she will not remove the loan from the preceding-provision rule or the school-leaver article.
How exactly municipalities deal with the loan portion of studiefinanciering of the partners of benefit recipients I cannot tell you.
Hoe gemeenten precies omgaan met het leendeel van de studiefinanciering van de partners van bijstandsgerechtigden kan ik u niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ondanks een gerechtelijke uitspraak bijstandsgerechtigden nog steeds 32 uur per week moeten werken als tegenprestatie voor een uitkering

An SP MP asked the state secretary about Orionis Walcheren continuing to require welfare recipients to work 32 hours a week as a return obligation despite a court ruling, and how this fits with earlier promises to adjust the rules. The state secretary answered that the municipality-level body will revise its rules and stop imposing sanctions for non-compliance, that enforcement is a decentralised matter for local authorities or the courts, and that the court ruling is to be followed.
This is a decentralised task. Oversight of it lies with the local authority or, as has already happened, the court.
Het betreft een gedecentraliseerde taak. Controle hierop is aan het lokale bestuur of, zoals reeds is geschied, de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over “de onkostenvergoeding voor gemeenteraadsleden en de gevolgen hiervan voor mensen met een wajong-uitkering "

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether council members' expense allowances count as taxable income, which can reduce income-linked benefits such as Wajong-related supplements, making council membership difficult for people with disabilities. The State Secretary answered that under the work-cost scheme (werkkostenregeling) the allowance can be kept outside taxable income, removing the financial obstacle, while noting the transition is not yet complete in all municipalities.
With the introduction of the work-cost scheme, the expense allowance of council members classed as fictitious employees can be kept outside the individual taxable wage of a council member.

Met de invoering van de werkkostenregeling kan de onkostenvergoeding van raadsleden die als fictief werknemer worden aangemerkt buiten het individuele belastbaar loon van een raadslid worden gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inzet van fotoherkenningsapparatuur om op internet bijstandsgerechtigden op te sporen

An SP MP asked whether municipalities use photo-recognition equipment to trace welfare recipients' holiday photos online without suspicion of fraud, and on what legal basis, including proportionality and privacy (ECHR art. 8). The state secretary replied that this has not been found to happen, that municipalities only use public sources such as Suwinet, Hyves and Facebook, that no prosecutor's permission is needed for administrative checks, and that guidance for municipalities is being prepared.
The finding that municipalities hire or use photo-recognition equipment to trace welfare recipients' holiday photos on the internet is, as far as is now known, incorrect.
De constatering dat gemeenten fotoherkenningsapparatuur inhuren of inzetten om op het internet vakantiefoto's van bijstandsgerechtigden op te sporen, is voor zover nu bekend, onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitbetaling van langdurigheidstoeslag in Spijkenisse

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether Spijkenisse's payment of long-duration allowance and related benefits in four instalments contradicts the original legislative intent of a single lump-sum payment, and whether the minister would press the municipality to pay in one instalment. The state secretary confirmed the instalment practice, explained that since 2009 municipalities set the amount and number of instalments themselves, and declined to intervene.
Since then it is up to the municipalities to set, locally and for a period of 12 months, the amount of the long-duration allowance as well as the number of instalments in which it is paid.

Sindsdien is het aan de gemeenten om op lokaal niveau voor een periode van 12 maanden de hoogte van de langdurigheidstoeslag vast te stellen, alsmede het aantal termijnen waarin deze toeslag wordt uitbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat PostNL mensen met een arbeidshandicap aan een baan gaat helpen als postbezorger

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked why PostNL, after reducing jobs for employees with disabilities, now plans to employ people with work disabilities as postal deliverers, and whether this replaces costlier staff. The government answered that PostNL denies disadvantaging disabled staff, that the job cuts stem from market changes, and that it sees no evidence of replacing employees with cheaper workers.
I have no indications that PostNL found its own employees with disabilities too expensive and is now replacing them with cheaper workers with disabilities.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat PostNL de eigen medewerkers met een beperking te duur vond en deze nu vervangt door goedkopere werknemers met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over mogelijke fouten in loonstrookjes als gevolg van de samenloop WUL en AOW leeftijdsverhoging

Two MPs asked whether the 2013 AOW age increase combined with the new wage definition (WUL) caused errors in pensioners' payslips, whether the SVB communicated adequately, and whether taxpayers need to file returns. The government denied a systematic error, explained how tax credits are split between AOW and pension income, pointed to Belastingdienst information, and declined to extend the early WUL evaluation to pension-fund and SVB implementation.
At present, given the answers above, I see no reason to also include the implementation and communication by pension funds and the SVB in that evaluation.
Ik zie op dit moment – gezien de hierboven gegeven antwoorden – geen reden ook de uitvoering en communicatie door pensioenfondsen en SVB in die evaluatie te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat ‘Tata Steel geen extra gehandicapten wil’

SP MP Karabulut asks the state secretary why Tata Steel offers only 10 work placements for young disabled people, whether this conflicts with the social accord's 125,000-job target, and whether the government will engage the company. The state secretary replies that the accord's targets are monitored with a quota backstop from 2016, that the cao negotiations are separate and Tata Steel has agreed to continue 10 Wajong placements, and points to a 2011 cao survey.
The social accord dates from 11 April. The elaboration of the agreements takes time and is not yet part of ongoing collective wage negotiations.
Het sociaal akkoord dateert van 11 april jongstleden. De uitwerking van de gemaakte afspraken vraagt tijd en maakt nog geen onderdeel uit van lopende cao-onderhandelingen.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over het onderzoek van FNV naar het functioneren van Werk.nl

An SP MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about FNV research finding that users rate the Werk.nl job-matching website poorly, and about UWV's shift to digital services, automatic sanctions, job-vacancy coverage, staff cuts and closure of regional offices. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said UWV is improving digital services and that sanctions are preceded by a warning, a werkcoach assessment and a right to respond, and said the office reduction is needed for budget cuts and aligns with the Werkbedrijven.
Before a sanction is imposed, the client always first receives a pre-notification with an opportunity to respond.
Voordat een sanctie wordt opgelegd krijgt de klant altijd eerst een vooraankondiging met mogelijkheid tot verweer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over aan het werk gaan vanuit de bijstand

MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether bureaucratic obstacles deter benefit recipients from accepting temporary agency work and whether temporary work is a good stepping stone to a permanent job. The state secretary acknowledged knowledge bottlenecks in rules and municipal practice, said the government is working with municipalities and agencies to reduce them, and said measures on flexible work and payrolling will be pursued.
We are currently working with municipalities, as announced in the cover letter to this study, to examine the bottlenecks they experience in this area, with temp agencies also involved.

Momenteel zijn wij, zoals aangekondigd in de aanbiedingsbrief bij dit onderzoek, samen met gemeenten bezig de door hen ervaren knelpunten op dit terrein te bezien, waarbij ook uitzendorganisaties zijn betrokken.
Antwoord vragen Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de helft van de Nederlanders zijn eigen pensioen met zorgen tegemoet ziet

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked why the government spends billions on eurozone rescue funds while Dutch pension entitlements are cut, and whether pension funds should be allowed a fixed 4% discount rate. The State Secretary replied that euro-fund loans are conditional, that pension cuts are needed because funds fall short of legal funding requirements, and that a risk-free rate is required, so 4% is not acceptable.
In my letter of 1 March to your House I explained why pension funds must calculate their obligations using a risk-free interest rate.
In mijn brief van 1 maart jl. aan uw Kamer heb ik toegelicht waarom pensioenfondsen hun verplichtingen met een risicovrije rente moeten berekenen.
Antwoord vragen De Wit en Karabulut over de toetredingsvoorwaarden van de Wet Schuldsanering Natuurlijke Personen

MPs De Wit and Karabulut asked why the ten-year bar on re-entering the Wsnp debt-restructuring scheme exists, how often the exceptions are used, and whether the government will introduce a shorter term or a general hardship clause after a Supreme Court ruling and Advocate-General conclusion criticising the rule. The state secretary answered that the rule was deliberately made mandatory in 2008, that at least 237 people were re-admitted within ten years, and that he sees no reason to shorten the term or generalise the hardship clause.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat Post NL mensen met een arbeidshandicap aan een baan gaat helpen als postbezorger

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked whether PostNL's plan to employ about 500 people with work disabilities as part-time postal deliverers, via secondment from sheltered workshops or social assistance, risks displacing regular workers and serving as cheap labour. The state secretary called the initiative positive, said PostNL reports no displacement, and said no indications of exploitation exist, while declining to cancel planned cuts to sheltered workshops.
I currently have no indications that there is any displacement or exploitation.
Ik heb thans geen aanwijzingen dat er sprake is van verdringing en uitbuiting.

Vragen van de leden Hamer, Kerstens en Mei Li Vos (allen PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken over het inzetten van bijstandsgerechtigden doo

MPs Hamer, Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked whether municipalities placing welfare recipients at PostNL as postal deliverers while the company dismisses staff amounts to displacement, whether the arrangement serves real labour-market reintegration, and what will be done to make the postal market decent. The state secretary answered that roughly 10 percent of the 500 placements are with unchanged benefits, that PostNL denies displacement, that placements are temporary reintegration places, and that a 2011 temporary decree requires postal firms to reach 80 percent employment contracts, with no signals of non-compliance.
According to PostNL there is no question of displacement here.
Volgens PostNL is hierbij geen sprake van verdringing.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Kerstens over "beëindiging uitkering van kankerpatiënte omdat vriend te vaak langskwam"

MPs Van Weyenberg and Kerstens asked the state secretary whether it is undesirable that a cancer patient's benefit was stopped because her partner visited too often, and how far law or case law requires this. The state secretary declined to judge the individual case, explained that the WWB is decentralised to municipalities and that cohabitation is assessed case by case, and said she has confidence in municipalities, councils and the courts.
The WWB is decentralised and implemented by the municipalities.
De WWB is gedecentraliseerd en wordt uitgevoerd door de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over beleggingen van het ABP in Hospira

An MP asked whether the government, as employer and sector representative, could influence ABP pension fund investments in Hospira, a supplier of drugs used in US executions, and what it would do about human-rights concerns. The government replied that the fund's board is responsible for investment policy, that the state has no direct influence over the privatised fund, and that ABP is engaging Hospira, which has imposed distributor restrictions.
ABP is a privatised pension fund. This means the government/cabinet exercises no direct influence over it.
Het ABP is een geprivatiseerd pensioenfonds. Dat betekent dat de overheid/het kabinet daar geen directe invloed op uitoefent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet, Fritsma en Madlener over het bericht “Inwoners EU hebben recht op uitkering”

PVV MPs asked why EU residents may receive social assistance while doubts exist about their residence right and an income requirement applies, and whether all wrongly paid benefits to foreigners will be recovered. The minister answered that residence rights under the EU free movement directive depend on an individual assessment by the IND, that municipalities handle benefit decisions, and that municipalities are responsible for recovery policy.
The implementation of the WWB has been decentralised to the municipalities.
De uitvoering van de WWB is gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over het bericht dat de curatoren van het failliete Sociale Werkvoorziening (SW) bedrijf Licom een onderzoek gaan starten naar de handelwijze van de gemeenten inzake het failliet laten

MP Heerma (CDA) asked about the bankruptcy of SW company Licom, its job and order-book effects, the municipalities' role as shareholders, liability for damages, and whether the government would investigate. The state secretary said the bankruptcy did not threaten Wsw workers' jobs, that the curators are investigating municipal conduct, and that she would not commission her own inquiry because responsibility lies with the municipalities.
In view of the answers to questions 4 through 7, I am not willing to do so.
Gelet op de antwoorden op de vragen 4 tot en met 7 ben ik daartoe niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Dekken over stijgend aantal kinderen dat in armoede opgroeit

Two MPs (PvdA) asked the state secretary about the rising number of children growing up in poverty and what measures the government takes, including ring-fencing poverty funds, regional differences and the municipal participation ordinance. The state secretary answered that poverty policy is mainly a municipal task, listed existing measures, declined to earmark funds, and said the ordinance will be evaluated after two years.
Poverty reduction is primarily a task for municipalities.
Armoedebestrijding is primair een taak voor gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het protocol bij sociale werkplaats Breed in Nijmegen als er geen werk is"

MP Karabulut asked the state secretary about a protocol at sheltered workplace Breed in Nijmegen for when there is insufficient work, including whether sending workers home and docking leave or pay is lawful. The state secretary replied that the document is not an adopted protocol, but that a formally adopted measure lets workers be sent home when work is lacking, with no docking of leave or pay.
Breed states that it concerns a protocol that has not been adopted.
Breed geeft aan dat het een niet vastgesteld protocol betreft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over werkloze Friezen die direct bij de sociale werkplaats aan het werk worden gezet

An MP asked the state secretary whether Frisian municipalities place welfare recipients directly into sheltered work with benefits maintained under threat of cuts, and about displacement, pay and outcomes. The government answered that the project is a voluntary municipal activation pilot, that no displacement occurs, that work with benefits is limited to a short trial, and that success is for municipalities to judge.
Municipalities have policy freedom in organising the implementation of the Wsw.
Gemeenten hebben beleidsvrijheid in het organiseren van de uitvoering van de Wsw.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de re-integratie bij sociale werkplaats IW4 voor bijstandsgerechtigden

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that Veenendaal requires benefit recipients to do monotonous work at sheltered workplace IW4 under threat of benefit cuts, and whether such work should instead match their skills. The state secretary replied that municipalities may activate recipients through work with benefit retention or require a counter-performance, that diagnosis and activation are often needed, and that sheltered workplaces may be used for these tasks without displacing Wsw-indicated persons.
Municipalities are free to engage companies for this, such as those that also carry out Wsw tasks for municipalities.
Het staat gemeenten vrij daarbij bedrijven in te schakelen die bijvoorbeeld ook de Wsw taken voor gemeenten uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut  over "een jonggehandicapte die - ondanks goed functioneren - na 3 tijdelijke contracten wordt ontslagen door een supermarkt "

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a disabled young worker dismissed by a supermarket after three temporary contracts despite good performance, and whether this fits the coalition goal of raising disabled participation and whether quota and job-coach rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that employers may freely decline to renew contracts, committed to a quota scheme and a policy note in spring, and rejected changing the three-year job-coach limit.
I am fully engaged in working out the quota scheme.
Ik ben volop aan de slag met de uitwerking van de quotumregeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over berichten dat ABP 50 miljard euro meer vermogen zou hebben gehad als het haar renterisico had afgedekt

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether ABP pension fund could have had about 50 billion euros more capital had it hedged its interest rate risk, and asked about sector-wide hedging, DNB supervision, and communication to members. The state secretary declined to judge individual funds, explained that hedging is a board responsibility under prudent-person rules with DNB supervision, gave sector hedging figures of about 45%, and said the government will talk with stakeholders about wider questions.
The confidentiality provisions of the Pensions Act do not allow information that individual pension funds have provided to the supervisor to be made public.
De geheimhoudingsbepalingen uit de Pensioenwet staan niet toe dat informatie die individuele pensioenfondsen aan de toezichthouder hebben verstrekt, openbaar wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over hoogopgeleide arbeidsgehandicapten, die noodgedwongen in de Wajong terecht komen

An MP asked the state secretary about highly educated disabled people who end up on the Wajong benefit because employers do not hire them, including a blind lawyer's case, and asked about government targets, UWV re-integration practice and benefit levels. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to planned quota rules from 2015, ongoing government initiatives, individual tailoring by UWV, and rejected any cut to the Wajong benefit.
The policy aims to increase the labour market participation opportunities of people with a disability.
Het beleid is gericht op het vergroten van de mogelijkheden tot arbeidsdeelname van mensen met een handicap.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over angst onder AOW’ers dat zij onbewust uitkeringsfraude plegen

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked the state secretary about widespread fear among AOW pensioners that they unknowingly commit benefit fraud through cohabitation rules, and asked for clearer criteria, suspension of sanctions, and an end to random checks. The state secretary replied that the SVB's objective criteria and case-by-case assessment are sufficient, that existing rules and sanctions will not change, and that the SVB will verify through administrative checks and home visits, which residents may refuse without consequence.
It is up to the person concerned to demonstrate how his actual situation is put together.
Het is aan de belanghebbende om aan te tonen hoe zijn feitelijke situatie in elkaar steekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de premieovereenkomst voor pensioenen (DC-regeling)

An MP asks the state secretary whether employers switch from DB to DC pensions for cost reasons, whether DC members can build an adequate pension given fiscal staffels based on 4% (or 3%) assumed returns versus lower market rates and a 2.4% illustrative rate, and why annuity purchase and mortality tables are outdated. The government answers that adequacy is possible within the legal framework, that the 4% assumption is reasonable, that a new premium staffel with updated mortality tables was issued end 2012, and that DC and DB fiscal room are equal overall.
Yes, that is possible within the legal framework.
Ja, dat is mogelijk binnen het wettelijke kader.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Van Vliet over het bericht dat België Europese bijstandsfraudeurs uitzet

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of Belgium expelling EU welfare fraudsters, how many EU nationals were removed from the Netherlands for benefit fraud or failing the income requirement, and how EU nationals can receive benefits despite the income requirement. The minister answered that 70 residence rights were ended in 2012 (10 forced returns), that benefit receipt does not automatically end residence, and that experiments with the municipalities of Vaals and Rotterdam aim to speed up information exchange, with results promised before summer.
The minister of Social Affairs and Employment promised in the General Consultation on Labour Migration of 17 January 2013 to inform the House before the summer about the results of the experiments.

De minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid heeft in het Algemeen Overleg Arbeidsmigratie van 17 januari 2013 toegezegd om de Kamer voor de zomer te informeren over de resultaten van de experimenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “PvdA niet tevreden met regeling AOW-gat"

The MP Omtzigt asked the state secretary about press reports that most early-retirement and pre-pension recipients would not qualify for the new AOW bridging allowance, and about the feasibility, legal form, EU coordination and cross-border health cover of the scheme. The government answered that roughly 80-90% of early-retirees fall outside the means test, that the scheme is a ministerial regulation under the Kaderwet SZW-subsidies with a commitment to brief parliament, and that a legal fix to Zvw article 69 will close the health-cover gap retroactively.
Given the importance of the subject, however, I attach great value to closely involving the House of Representatives in the drafting of the scheme.
Gelet echter op het belang van het onderwerp hecht ik er zeer aan om de Tweede Kamer nauw bij het tot stand komen van de regeling te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen Potters en Schut-Welkzijn over de nieuwe Wajong

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about the new Wajong disability benefit, including UWV's handling of transitions from the old scheme, the 14-week decision period, and criteria for transferring. The state secretary answered that transition is voluntary, UWV published information in advance, the 14-week period is a statutory maximum, and she will evaluate the first three months before informing the House.
I want to form a picture based on the experiences of the first three months and consultation with UWV, and then inform the House.
Ik wil mij op basis van de ervaringen van de eerste drie maanden en overleg met het UWV hierover een beeld vormen en de Kamer aansluitend informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Van Vliet over het bericht ‘Oudere mannen vaker werkloos’

Two PVV MPs asked the minister about a report that older men are increasingly unemployed and how this fits with raising the AOW age, the planned easing of dismissal law, the job-continuation bonus, and the bridging scheme for those unable to prepare for the higher AOW age. The minister replied that unemployment among men aged 45-65 remains the lowest of age groups, that dismissal criteria and the selection principle are retained, that the bonus supports working longer, and that bridging scheme contours were sent to parliament with implementation planned for 2013.
On 23 January a letter was sent to the House of Representatives outlining the contours of the bridging scheme.
Op 23 januari jl. is een brief verstuurd aan de Tweede Kamer waarin de contouren van de overbruggingsregeling zijn geschetst.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hilkens en Kerstens over discriminatie van vrouwen bij schadevergoeding na letselschade

MPs Hilkens and Kerstens asked whether insurers may factor a hypothetical childbearing wish or work-care combination into injury compensation, which disadvantages women, and what the government will do about it. The minister says such differential treatment is already prohibited under equal-treatment law, that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens has raised this with the insurance sector, and that affected persons can petition the College or go to court, without committing to new measures.
Discrimination on grounds of sex is already prohibited in this area under the General Equal Treatment Act and the Equal Treatment Decree.
Discriminatie op grond van geslacht is voor dit terrein reeds verboden op grond van de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling en het Besluit gelijke behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn en Potters over de storing op de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Potters (VVD) asked the minister about the prolonged outage of the UWV website (mijnUWV), the resulting call centre surge and waiting times, compensation for affected clients, and structural fixes. The minister acknowledged the outage lasted 7 to 17 January, reported call volumes and waiting times, described alternative service channels, and rejected compensation because no sanctions would be imposed on affected clients.
Nevertheless, it remains unpleasant that the outage has lasted so long.
Desondanks blijft het vervelend dat de storing lang heeft voortgeduurd.
Antwoord vragen Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de AFM meer pensioenrechten voor jongeren wil

An MP asked the state secretary how the government views AFM board member Korte's call for more open pension communication, the example of a fund's mismatched brochures, and the status of the study on the cross-subsidy premium. The state secretary answered that the communication rules are being revised, the AFM lacks powers over non-mandatory communication, the study concludes in early May, and the Witteveen scheme bill will be submitted this spring.
There are no statutory powers for the AFM to intervene in non-mandatory forms of communication.
Er zijn geen wettelijke bevoegdheden voor AFM om in te grijpen in niet verplichte vormen van communicatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over "ontslagen bij sociale werkplaatsen Emco en Wedeka"

An SP MP asks the state secretary about dismissals of sheltered-workshop staff at Emco and Wedeka after reduced government funding, whether temporary-contract practices and cuts are acceptable, and whether dismissed workers can be placed in jobs. The state secretary answers that non-renewal of temporary contracts is a municipal policy choice, that courts handle individual disputes, that the government will set a quota and the Participatiewet changes apply, and that municipalities hold responsibility for placement.
The non-renewal of temporary contracts at Emco and Wedeka is a policy choice of the municipalities.
Het niet verlengen van tijdelijke contracten bij Emco en Wedeka betreft een beleidskeuze van de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Kuzu over het geen doorgang vinden van het Landelijk Informatiesysteem Schulden (LIS)

Kuzu (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the withdrawal of the Dutch Banking Association from the national debt registration project (LIS/ViP) means the initiative is dead, and what steps were taken since the July 2012 letter, including a pilot said to be approved by the Data Protection Authority. The State Secretary regretted the banks' decision, described the pilot intentions and the January 2013 meeting where the LIS partners ended their initiative, and said she intends to explore other options for early warning of problem debts.
I intend to talk with the parties involved to explore whether there are other options for arriving at a system of early warning.
Ik ben voornemens om met betrokken partijen in gesprek te gaan om te verkennen of er andere mogelijkheden zijn om tot een systeem van vroegsignalering te komen.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens over het spreekverbod bij SW-bedrijf Pantar

MP Kerstens asked the state secretary whether a gag order on all Pantar employees speaking to municipal councillors was justified, and whether it restricted workers' and councillors' rights during a planned reorganisation. The state secretary answered that no blanket ban exists: employees may speak in a personal capacity, while speaking on behalf of Pantar or by the works council is not allowed, and the matter is for Pantar to handle.
Pantar has indicated that the rights of the works council members are not in question and that every employee has the right to speak in a personal capacity.
Pantar heeft laten weten dat de rechten van de leden van de COR niet ter discussie staan en dat iedere medewerker het recht heeft om op persoonlijke titel te spreken.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het spreekverbod met politici voor werknemers van Pantar

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether a directive by the director of sociale werkplaats Pantar telling staff not to share information with council faction representatives amounts to a gag order, and what measures would be taken. The state secretary answered that there is no gag order, only a request to exercise care when speaking on behalf of Pantar and regarding unadopted documents, and that no further measures are needed.
Pantar has indicated that the rights of the members of the works council are not in question and that every employee has the right to speak in a personal capacity.
Pantar heeft laten weten dat de rechten van de leden van de COR niet ter discussie staan en dat iedere medewerker het recht heeft om op persoonlijke titel te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Heerma over het niet stopzetten van bijstandsuitkering bij voortvluchtige criminelen

MPs Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga and Heerma asked the state secretary why benefits to fugitive convicted criminals are not stopped and whether municipalities should be obliged to join the signal system. The state secretary agreed benefits should be stopped, reported rising signal counts, said joining is not mandatory but all municipalities participate, and noted that since 2013 municipalities must recover wrongly paid benefits.
Municipalities are not obliged to use the monthly report of the Inlichtingenbureau.
Gemeenten zijn niet verplicht om gebruik te maken van de maandelijkse rapportage van het Inlichtingenbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht dat veroordeelde criminelen een bijstandsuitkering ontvangen

An MP asked the state secretary of Social Affairs about reports that convicted criminals were receiving welfare benefits, including amounts, the municipalities not connected to the information service, enforcement, and recovery. The state secretary answered that since 2011 benefits lapse for fugitive convicts, that municipalities are not obliged to use the monthly signal report but most now do, that municipalities are responsible for recovery and fines from 2013, and that she urged them to act.
Municipalities are not obliged to use the monthly report of the Inlichtingenbureau.
Gemeenten zijn niet verplicht om gebruik te maken van de maandelijkse rapportage van het Inlichtingenbureau.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuzu en Jadnanansing over de aandacht van scholen voor het omgaan met geld door jongeren

MPs Kuzu and Jadnanansing asked whether young people lack financial self-reliance and how schools and government address responsible money management. The State Secretary answered that core objectives in primary and secondary education cover consumer self-reliance and budgeting, leaving school-level implementation to schools and declining to direct schools to use specific Nibud lesson packages.
It is not for the government to encourage schools to use certain lesson packages.
Het is niet aan de overheid scholen te stimuleren bepaalde lespakketten te gebruiken.
Antwoord vragen Klein over het bericht “Pensioen onzekerder voor werknemers in de zorg”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary about press reports that pensions for care workers are becoming less secure under a planned switch by PFZW to a new pension contract, and how accrued rights would be protected. The state secretary answered that the new contract resembles the Pensioenakkoord model, that a trial on transferring accrued rights (invaren) will start in 2013 with safeguards to be included in a Pensioenwet amendment, and that he was unaware of the fund's proposal put to social partners, while suggesting the reporting was one-sided.
The experiment will yield information on how careful decision-making on transferring accrued rights and a careful transfer procedure can be ensured.
Het experiment levert informatie op over de wijze waarop een zorgvuldige besluitvorming over invaren en een zorgvuldige invaarprocedure kan worden geborgd.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en van Klaveren over de verblijfsgrond van in Nederland verblijvende verdachten / criminelen die in verband met recente geruchtmakende zaken in het nieuws waren

Two PVV MPs asked why the government refused to answer questions about individual criminal foreigners tied to recent news cases, when earlier individual cases had been answered, and whether it is inconsistent to withhold information on criminals while disclosing information on people to be deported. State Secretary Teeven replied that he declines to discuss individual cases to protect the privacy of those involved, since the data are special personal data under the Dutch data protection law, and that privacy will generally weigh heavily.
I refrained from going into the individual cases because, for the protection of the privacy of those involved, I do not consider it desirable to go further into them.
Ik heb afgezien om in te gaan op de individuele zaken omdat ik het uit oogpunt van bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen niet gewenst acht hierop verder in te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouten over het te laag vaststellen van de beslagvrije voet door deurwaarders en overheidsinstanties

An MP asked the state secretary whether the beslagvrije voet (protected minimum income from wage/benefit garnishment) is set too low by bailiffs and agencies such as UWV and SVB, and what will be done about it. The government replied that the protected amount must be respected by all creditors, that there is no registration of garnishments so the scale cannot be estimated, and that information, communication and the Paritas Passé study will be addressed in a forthcoming cabinet response.
There is no register recording garnishments imposed on a debtor and/or comparable collection measures.
Er is geen registratie waarin ten laste van een schuldenaar gelegde beslagen en/of daarmee vergelijkbare invorderingsmaatregelen worden geadministreerd.
Antwoord vragen Kuzu en Bouwmeester over het vooraf betalen van het eigen risico in de bijstand

MPs Kuzu and Bouwmeester asked whether it is acceptable that Agis collects the compulsory deductible monthly in advance from welfare recipients in Amersfoort, whether the minister will intervene, and whether the refund timing is fair. Minister Schippers replied that the collective scheme is voluntary, that municipalities and insurers may agree such arrangements, that refunds come by end 2014 because care billing lags, and that she sees no reason to intervene.
I see no reason for further consultation with ZN and the VNG, because the arrangement is voluntary.
Ik zie geen reden tot nader overleg met ZN en de VNG, omdat de regeling op vrijwillige basis is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kerstens over het feit dat mannelijke Wajongeren vaker een baan vinden dan vrouwelijke

An MP asked the state secretary about research showing male Wajongeren find jobs more often than female ones, and about the role of diagnosis, motivation, parents, schools and the UWV. The state secretary said support should be equal for men and women, that UWV applies no gender distinction, and that the research findings have caveats, without committing to new action.
Furthermore, I have no indications that the support of female and male Wajongers by the UWV differs.
Ik heb voorts geen aanwijzingen dat de begeleiding van vrouwelijke en mannelijke Wajongers door het UWV verschilt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over de verblijfsgrond van in Nederland verblijvende verdachten / criminelen die in verband met recente geruchtmakende zaken in het nieuws waren

MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked how various suspects and convicted criminals obtained residence rights in the Netherlands, and what measures would remove them after serving their sentences, and whether residence permits could require a criminal-record statement from origin countries. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, described the sliding-scale test for ending lawful residence after conviction and his plan to tighten it, and said he would inform parliament this year about using antecedent declarations.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht over misstanden bij de sociale werkplaats in Schiedam

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary about a report of bullying and belittling of vulnerable workers at a sheltered workplace in Schiedam, and whether this is a structural problem. The state secretary called such conduct unacceptable, said Inspectie SZW can investigate complaints, noted no complaint had been filed and that the municipality had started its own investigation, and said the cao is not for him to decide.
I am not a party to the agreements around the collective labour agreement.
In de afspraken rond de cao ben ik geen partij.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht over misstanden bij de sociale werkplaats in Schiedam en antwoord vragen Karabulut over werknemers met een arbeidsbeperking die worden getreiterd in Schiedam

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about reported intimidation and mistreatment of disabled workers at a sheltered workplace in Schiedam, including when complaints arrived, what complaint channels workers have, whether similar abuses exist elsewhere, and whether budget cuts are linked. The state secretary answered that the municipality suspended the director and four staff, set up a complaint point and an investigation committee, and that workers can complain to the Labour Inspectorate, while declining to speculate on other workplaces and denying a link to budget cuts.
In appropriate cases, employees can file a complaint with the Labour Inspectorate, which will then conduct an investigation.
In voorkomende gevallen kunnen werknemers een klacht indienen bij de Inspectie SZW die daarop een onderzoek zal doen.

MPs De Krom and Blok asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs and the Minister of Justice about a couple in Spijkenisse who allegedly defrauded the state of about EUR 250,000 by concealing Turkish property while receiving welfare benefits since 1983, including whether benefits were stopped, whether assets were seized, whether recovery is limited to 1997, and whether criminal prosecution follows. The government answered that the municipality found the non-disclosure, stopped the benefit in October 2009, levied seizure in July 2009, planned to file a criminal complaint, and that the SIOD is not involved because enforcement is municipal responsibility; it said it would consider legislative options to recover full benefits.
I will consider the options for recovering the full amount of unduly paid welfare in cases of this kind and will inform you further.
Ik zal mij beraden op de mogelijkheden om in dit soort zaken de gehele onverschuldigd betaalde bijstand terug te vorderen en u daarover nader berichten.

m: Motie van het lid Rooderkerk c.s. over de bezuiniging op de onderwijskansen van de allerkwetsbaarste kinderen bij de augustusbesluitvorming heroverwegen
Asks the government to reconsider the education budget cut affecting the most vulnerable pupils, including vmbo and practical schools, in the August budget decisions.
requests the government to reconsider this cut to the educational opportunities of the most vulnerable children in the August budget decisions
verzoekt de regering deze bezuiniging op de onderwijskansen van de allerkwetsbaarste kinderen bij de augustusbesluitvorming te heroverwegen
Motie van het lid Soepboer over geld in onderwijsregio's teruggeven aan de scholen
Asks the government to return money from education regions that comes from schools to the schools, and to use the rest for a non-binding incentive scheme without extra governance.
return the money held in the education regions that comes directly from schools (for professionalisation and strategic HRM, for example) to the schools
het geld dat in de onderwijsregio's zit en direct afkomstig is van scholen (voor professionalisering en strategisch hrm bijvoorbeeld) terug te geven aan de scholen
Amendement van het lid Soepboer over dat het bevoegd gezag in het tweede jaar opnieuw een aanbod doet als in het eerste jaar geen contact tot stand is gekomen

the competent authority makes a new offer of career guidance in the second year
doet het bevoegd gezag in het tweede jaar opnieuw een aanbod tot loopbaanbegeleiding
Motie van het lid Soepboer over een praktische handreiking om overdocumentatie en disproportionele administratieve lasten bij uitvoering van de nazorgplicht te voorkomen
Asks the government, with schools and the inspectorate, to publish a practical guide preventing excessive documentation and administrative burden when implementing the aftercare duty.
to draw up a practical guide that helps prevent excessive documentation and disproportionate administrative burdens when implementing the aftercare duty
een praktische handreiking op te stellen die helpt overdocumentatie en disproportionele administratieve lasten te voorkomen bij de uitvoering van de nazorgplicht
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Ceder en Soepboer ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een evaluatie binnen drie jaar, waarbij ook de administratieve lasten en uitvoeringslasten in kaart worden gebracht

In article VII 'five years' is replaced by 'three years'
In artikel VII wordt «vijf jaar» vervangen door «drie jaar»
Motie van het lid Soepboer over zo optreden dat de NPO een reclameluw bestel blijft en dat de online advertentieruimte niet wordt opengesteld voor commerciële adverteerders
Asks the government to ensure the NPO stays advertising-free and its online advertising space is not opened to commercial advertisers, to protect media pluriformity.
requests the government to act so that the public broadcaster remains advertising-light and its online advertising space is not opened to commercial advertisers
verzoekt de regering zo op te treden dat de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep een reclameluw bestel blijft en dat de online advertentieruimte ervan niet open wordt gesteld voor commerciële adverteerders
Motie van de leden Soepboer en Van Vroonhoven over de Mediawet zo aanpassen dat de regering niet langer kan ingrijpen in besluiten van het Commissariaat voor de Media
Asks the government to amend the Mediawet so it can no longer suspend or annul decisions of the Commissariaat voor de Media, to secure its independence.
requests the government to amend the Mediawet so that the government can no longer intervene in decisions of the Commissariat
verzoekt de regering de Mediawet zo aan te passen dat de regering niet langer kan ingrijpen in besluiten van het Commissariaat
Motie van de leden Soepboer en Ceder over de huidige regeling onderwijsregio's terugbrengen tot een structurele stimuleringsregeling voor regionale samenwerking
Asks the government to scale back the education regions scheme to a structural incentive for regional cooperation without new governance layers, redirecting freed funds to primary education quality.
without setting up additional governance layers and governance structures
zonder extra bestuurslagen en governancestructuren op te tuigen
Motie van het lid Soepboer over een stimuleringsregeling voor educatieve initiatieven voor onder deel II van het Handvest erkende talen
Asks the government to present a concrete subsidy scheme for educational initiatives on Part II Charter languages such as Twents and Limburgs before the Spring Memorandum.
requests the government to come up before the Spring Memorandum with a concrete subsidy scheme for educational initiatives
verzoekt de regering om vóór de Voorjaarsnota te komen met een concrete stimuleringsregeling voor educatieve initiatieven
Motie van het lid Soepboer over een investeringsagenda om door middel van onderwijs en onderzoek tot een maximaal innovatieve krijgsmacht en industrie te komen
Asks the government to develop an interdepartmental investment agenda linking education and research to an innovative armed forces and defence industry.
requests the government to arrive, through interdepartmental cooperation, at an investment agenda
verzoekt de regering om via interdepartementale samenwerking tot een investeringsagenda te komen
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over binnen de vrije investeringsruimte van het Deltafonds prioriteit geven aan waterveiligheid
Asks the government to prioritise water safety within the Delta Fund's free investment room so that dike reinforcement under HWBP is not delayed.
requests the government to give priority to water safety within the free investment room of the Delta Fund
verzoekt de regering om binnen de vrije investeringsruimte van het Deltafonds prioriteit te geven aan waterveiligheid
Motie van de leden Soepboer en Grinwis over bij de Duitse regering aandringen op het invoeren van grenswaarden voor pfas-lozingen
Asks the government to press the German government to introduce limit values for PFAS discharges into the Rhine.
requests the government to urge the German government to introduce limit values for PFAS discharges
verzoekt de regering om er bij de Duitse regering op aan te dringen dat zij grenswaarden voor pfas-lozingen in gaat voeren
Motie van het lid Soepboer over voor de Voorjaarsnota in kaart brengen hoeveel geld wordt besteed aan klimaatadaptieve en klimaatmitigerende maatregelen
Asks the government to map spending on climate adaptation and climate mitigation measures before the Spring Memorandum.
requests the government to map by the Spring Memorandum how much money it spends on climate adaptation and mitigation measures
verzoekt de regering om voor de Voorjaarsnota in kaart te brengen hoeveel geld zij besteedt aan klimaatadaptieve en klimaatmitigerende maatregelen
Motie van het lid Soepboer over het bedrag van 332 miljoen euro uit het Groeifonds investeren in het direct versterken van de basisvaardigheden
Asks the government to use the 332 million euro from the Groeifonds to directly strengthen basic skills instead of converting the Ontwikkelkracht pilot into a subsidy scheme.

requests the government to invest the 332 million euro that the Minister wants to use from the Groeifonds to convert the Ontwikkelkracht pilot into a subsidy scheme in directly strengthening basic skills

verzoekt de regering het bedrag van 332 miljoen euro dat de Minister vanuit het Groeifonds wil gebruiken voor het omzetten van de pilot Ontwikkelkracht in een subsidieregeling, te investeren in het direct versterken van de basisvaardigheden
Amendement van de leden Soepboer en Tseggai over het beperken van de reikwijdte van het wetsvoorstel tot formele opleidingen
Restricts the proposed NLQF qualification framework to formal education, removing the option for non-formal courses to be placed on the framework.
In the definition of 'formal education' the word 'formal' is removed.
In de begripsomschrijving van «formele opleiding» vervalt in het begrip «formele».
Motie van het lid Tuinman c.s. over bijdragen aan het aanstellen van een meertaligheidscoördinator in iedere gemeente in het Friese taalgebied
Asks the government to contribute to appointing a multilingualism coordinator in every municipality in the Frisian language area.
requests the government to contribute to appointing a multilingualism coordinator in every municipality in the Frisian language area
verzoekt de regering om eraan bij te dragen dat in iedere gemeente in het Friese taalgebied een meertaligheidscoördinator wordt aangesteld
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over een wettelijke borging van Friestalig media-aanbod
Asks the government to legally secure Frisian-language media provision and ensure Frisian productions can effectively access Filmfonds and NPO fund subsidies.
to arrive at a statutory guarantee of Frisian-language media provision
te komen tot een wettelijke borging van Friestalig media-aanbod
Motie van het lid De Hoop c.s. over in de nieuwe bestuursafspraak Friese taal en cultuur concrete maatregelen opnemen voor een gelijkwaardige positie van het Fries in de openbare ruimte
Asks the government to include concrete measures in the new Frisian language administrative agreement for an equal position of Frisian in public space.
requests the government to include concrete measures in the new administrative agreement on Frisian language and culture
verzoekt de regering in de nieuwe bestuursafspraak Friese taal en cultuur concrete maatregelen op te nemen
Motie van het lid Tuinman c.s. over borgen dat identiteitskaarten dan wel delen daarvan in het Frysk kunnen worden uitgegeven
Asks the cabinet to ensure the new identification act allows identity cards, or parts of them, to be issued in Frisian.
requests the cabinet to ensure, in the proposal for a new Identification Act, that identity cards or parts thereof can at least be issued in Frisian
verzoekt het kabinet om bij het voorstel voor een nieuwe Wet op de identificatieplicht te borgen dat in ieder geval identiteitskaarten dan wel delen daarvan in het Frysk kunnen worden uitgegeven
Motie van het lid De Hoop c.s. over de instandhouding van Afûk
Asks the government to treat maintaining the Afûk Frisian language institute as part of its statutory duty toward the Frisian language and culture.
requests the government to treat maintaining Afûk as part of the statutory duty toward Frisian language and culture
verzoekt de regering instandhouding van de Afûk als onderdeel van de wettelijke zorgplicht ten aanzien van de Friese taal en cultuur te behandelen
Motie van het lid Soepboer c.s. over in beeld brengen wat nodig is voor een gelijkwaardige positie voor de Friese taal en cultuur in Fryslân
Asks the government to map what is needed to give the Frisian language and culture an equal position in Fryslân, and to speed up signing the European Charter for regional languages.
requests the government to map out what is needed to meet the points mentioned in the considerations
verzoekt de regering om in beeld te brengen wat er nodig is om aan de in de overweging genoemde punten tegemoet te komen
Motie van het lid Meulenkamp c.s. over rekening houden met de vraag naar voldoende Friestalige kinderopvang
Asks the government to take into account demand for sufficient Frisian-language childcare when changing the language requirement for childcare.
requests the government to take into account the demand for sufficient Frisian-language childcare
verzoekt de regering rekening te houden met de vraag naar voldoende Friestalige kinderopvang
Amendement van het lid Westerveld c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 55 over een overbruggingsregeling voor de tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten
Shifts 1 million euro per year in 2024 and 2025 within the subsidy budget for the civic service to fund a bridging transport-cost scheme for practical-education pupils.
The coverage for 2024 (1 million) and 2025 (1 million) is found within the subsidies instrument under the civic service rule.
De dekking voor 2024 (1 miljoen) en 2025 (1 miljoen) wordt gevonden binnen het instrument subsidies op de regel maatschappelijke diensttijd.
Amendement van het lid Soepboer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 50 over een practoraat Fries
Shifts 500 thousand euro per year from university research policy to vocational education to fund a Frisian-language practoraat in secondary vocational education.
In article 04 Vocational education and adult education the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 500 thousand euro
In artikel 04 Beroepsonderwijs en volwasseneneducatie worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 500
Amendement van het lid Soepboer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 52 over een practoraat Fries
Budget amendment shifting 500 thousand euro from research policy to vocational education for a Frisian-language practoraat over five years.
for the duration of the Frisian Language and Culture Administrative Agreement (five years) an annual amount is made available
wordt voor de looptijd van het Bestuursakkoord Friese Taal en Cultuur (vijf jaren) een jaarlijks bedrag ter beschikking gesteld
Amendement van het lid Westerveld c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 40 over een overbruggingsregeling voor de tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten
Moves budget within education to fund a bridging scheme for reimbursing travel costs of practical-education pupils in 2024 and 2025.
This bridging scheme costs 1 million euro for 2024 and 1 million euro for 2025.
Deze overbruggingsregeling kost 1 miljoen euro voor 2024 en 1 miljoen euro voor 2025.
Motie van het lid Soepboer over onderzoek naar een normeringspercentage onderwijsgeld in de lumpsum voor het primaire proces
Asks the government to study a minimum percentage of education money in the lump sum that must go to the primary teaching process.
requests the government, in the recalibration of funding steering for primary and secondary education, to conduct concrete research into a norm percentage for education money in the lump sum
verzoekt de regering in de herijking sturing funderend onderwijs een concreet onderzoek naar een normeringspercentage onderwijsgeld in de lumpsum
Amendement van het lid Soepboer c.s. over een practoraat Fries
Earmarks a yearly amount for a Frisian-language professorship at Frisian vocational education, funded by shifting money from the research budget.
made available for setting up and running a lectorate on Frisian language and literacy in a multilingual context
ter beschikking gesteld voor de inrichting en uitvoering van een practoraat «Friese taal en Geletterdheid in de meertalige context.»
Amendement van het lid De Hoop c.s. 36410-VIII nr. 44 over duurzaam investeren in een bachelor Fries
Proposes shifting 340,000 euros within the university education budget to fund a Frisian bachelor programme.
by earmarking 340,000 euros annually from the general lump sum specifically for a Frisian bachelor programme
door jaarlijks € 340.000,– van de algemene lumpsum specifiek te oormerken voor een bachelor fries
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Soepboer en De Hoop over het onterecht moeten inleveren van pompeblêdspeldjes door een Friese delegatie bij de Tweede Kamer

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether a Frisian delegation was wrongly required to surrender their pompeblêd pins at the Tweede Kamer entrance, and whether such symbols are political expressions. The minister acknowledged the situation as unpleasant for those involved, said the interpretation of symbols and enforcement of house rules rest with the Speaker and the presidium, and declined to commit to changing the rules.

The interpretation of such symbols falls under the responsibility of the presidium and the Speaker of the House of Representatives, who decide within the framework of the House rules whether expressions are appropriate in parliamentary decorum.

De interpretatie van dergelijke symbolen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het presidium en de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer, die binnen de kaders van de Kamerorde beslissen of uitingen passend zijn in het parlementaire decorum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Aukje de Vries, Soepboer en Pierik over de gesloten brug bij Uitwellingerga

Four MPs asked the minister why temporary solutions for the closed Uitwellingerga bridge are not feasible, what the impact is on residents and businesses, and whether bridge inspections were adequate. The minister explains that only a temporary fixed bridge deck option is being pursued for August 2025, that the bridge cannot be repaired, that about 1,500 people in surrounding villages are affected, and that inspection procedures are being evaluated.
Rijkswaterstaat regularly evaluates the inspection procedures; the experiences at Uitwellingerga are also being taken into account.
Rijkswaterstaat evalueert de inspectieprocedures regelmatig; ook de ervaringen van Uitwellingerga worden hierin meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de berichten ‘Kleine scholen kunnen ‘zomaar’ worden opgeheven’ en ‘Zorgen over toekomst van Amelander basisschool: “Dan vergrijst het dorp”

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about reports that small primary schools can be closed easily, including a case on Ameland, and about the effect on village life and quality. The government answers that closures are mostly mergers, that closure norms are differentiated by municipality, that small schools matter for liveability, and that it will inform parliament before year end on a differentiated rural supplement and a review of the closure system.
I intend to inform your House further on this before the end of the year.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer hier nog voor het einde van het jaar nader over te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over het onderzoek van Nieuwsuur naar de basisschoolbezoeken van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs, waaruit blijkt dat de inspectie ernstig verzuimd heeft om scholen te inspecteren

An MP asked the Education Minister how the Inspectorate could fail to visit all primary schools every four years, whether the policy choice was justified and communicated to Parliament, and what improvements are planned. The Minister acknowledged the shortfall and the incomplete reporting, announced an external audit by the Auditdienst Rijk and a registration improvement plan, and said the Inspectorate had dropped the four-year cycle in 2021, while several questions about historical data were deferred until the audit is complete.
We intend to commission an independent external investigation into the reports on the Inspectorate's visits to schools in primary and secondary education.
Wij zijn voornemens om een onafhankelijk en extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de rapportages over de bezoeken van de inspectie aan scholen in het funderend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de veerverbinding met Ameland

An MP asks whether the government will start the MIRT exploration for the Ameland ferry link, which has a 250 million euro risk reserve in the budget and a startdocument with partner names. The minister confirms the start decision was taken on 14 November 2024, after consulting regional administrators, and that the reserve was used for it.

Yes, I am aware of this. On 14 November the House was informed about the start decision and the use of the 250 million euro reserve (incl. VAT) under article 11.04 for the MIRT exploration of Ameland accessibility.

Ja, hier ben ik van op de hoogte. Op 14 november jl. is de Kamer geïnformeerd over de startbeslissing en het aanwenden van de reservering van € 250 mln. incl. btw op artikel 11.04 voor de MIRT verkenning Bereikbaarheid Ameland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Soepboer en Wingelaar naar aanleiding van het bericht “Grote gevolgen gezonken vrachtschip: fabrieken op Chemelot dreigen stil te vallen en directeur Sappi in Maastricht vreest productiest

Two MPs asked the minister about the Julianakanaal closure after a sunken ship, the compensation committee, works progress, bypass route reliability, and business damage. The minister answered that works are on schedule for reopening by end April 2025, that a compensation committee exists but damage from the ship collision falls under the shipowner's liability rather than Rijkswaterstaat compensation.
Basically there is therefore no ground for damages or compensation by Rijkswaterstaat solely as a result of this calamity.
In de basis is er dan ook geen grond voor schadevergoeding of nadeelcompensatie door Rijkswaterstaat enkel als gevolg van deze calamiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over “Tientallen schoolbestuurders privé actief bij onderwijsadviesbureaus”

An MP asked the state secretary about school board members holding paid roles at education advisory firms, conflicts of interest, and the privatised education support market. The state secretary called conflicts of interest unacceptable, pointed to existing legal duties and planned legislation, and promised to inform parliament this autumn about regulating the advisory market.
If there is a conflict of interest, I consider this undesirable and unacceptable.
Als er sprake is van belangenverstrengeling vind ik dit onwenselijk en ontoelaatbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de startdatum van de werkzaamheden aan het Julianakanaal

An MP asked the minister why a second opinion on the Julianakanaal works was commissioned, whether its interim results would be shared, why work starts before final results, and why the extra budget was not communicated earlier. The minister answered that the second opinion covered the chosen method and costs, that final results are now attached with an implementation plan, that the start is justified by interim findings, and that the cost increase arose from failed foil tests in late May and was communicated promptly.
The final results are now available. These results are included as an annex to this letter.
De eindresultaten zijn inmiddels beschikbaar. Deze resultaten zijn als bijlage bij deze brief opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de startdatum van de werkzaamheden aan het Julianakanaal

An MP asked the minister whether the planned start of works closing the Julianakanaal on 12 August 2024 complies with a parliamentary motion requiring the Borgharen weir to be fully functional first, and what the status of those works and the protection of canal users is.
