The minister answers that the weir is restored enough for works to start on 12 August, that alternative routes remain available, and describes the status of works and stakeholder communication.
The Borgharen weir has been restored to such an extent that works on the Julianakanaal can start on 12 August.
De stuw Borgharen is dusdanig hersteld dat op 12 augustus gestart kan worden met de werkzaamheden op het Julianakanaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de niet nagekomen afspraken aan de organisatie Digibende

An MP asks why promised funding for Digibende, a non-state-funded truancy initiative, has not materialised and what will be done. The State Secretary says direct funding is not possible, promises a subsidy scheme for school partnerships expected to open in spring 2025, and says the original commitment has been explored but not met.
Digibende will be able to use the planned subsidy scheme for partnerships in the same way as other unfunded truancy initiatives.
Digibende kan straks wel op dezelfde wijze gebruik maken van de beoogde subsidieregeling voor samenwerkingsverbanden zoals andere niet-bekostigde thuiszittersinitiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de discriminerende vooringenomenheid door het gehele controleproces van fraude bij DUO

An MP asked the Minister of Education about indirect discrimination in DUO's fraud-control process, including a new study finding bias across the whole selection process. The Minister acknowledges the bias is worse than thought, apologises, promises a changed control system, a review of signal handling, and a letter to parliament in the autumn.
That the situation is worse than we already suspected is extremely disappointing.
Dat de situatie slechter is dan we al vermoedden is buitengewoon teleurstellend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de berichten ‘Op welk nijpend probleem zijn deze nieuwe kerndoelen een antwoord’ en ‘Curriculumherziening stevent af op mislukking’

An MP asks whether added civics and digital-skills content will overload teachers or hollow out existing subjects, and whether the Chamber should get earlier say over the curriculum revision. The Minister replies that clearer, more concrete core goals will reduce overload, that the Chamber has been informed at several points and will get a technical briefing and a nahang procedure before the goals take effect.
The Chamber has and will have every opportunity to express its views on the curriculum and the current revision, even before the pilot phase.
De Kamer heeft en krijgt dus alle gelegenheid om zich – nog voor de pilotfase – uit te spreken over het curriculum en de huidige herziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot, De Hoop en Soepboer over het bericht 'Hoe komt het met het Frysk in de Kamer, nu zoveel voorvechters van het toneel verdwijnen?' van 13 december 2023

MPs asked whether the duty of care for the Frisian language and culture is maintained during a change of minister, and how to finalise the delayed new Frisian language and culture administrative agreement (BFTK). The minister answered that the duty remains in force, that the existing agreement and visibility accord continue until a new one is signed (expected spring 2024), and that the successor will be briefed on the file.
A change of guard may not lead to reduced commitment to the duty of care for Frisian language and culture.
Wisseling van de wacht mag niet leiden tot een verminderde inzet voor de zorgplicht voor de Friese taal en cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van Soepboer over de slechte PISA-scores in verhouding tot de genomen maatregelen om achterstanden weg te werken en te voorkomen en de Kamerbrief van 5 december jl.

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education why Dutch 15-year-olds' PISA results fell faster than elsewhere, how NPO education funds and the Masterplan basisvaardigheden are working, and how school pressure relates to results. The minister attributes the decline to multiple structural causes plus COVID, says the effects of NPO funds cannot yet be fully assessed, and commits to evaluation and further reports without changing oversight of the executive.
The cabinet aims to structurally fund all schools from 2026 for improving basic skills.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar alle scholen vanaf 2026 structureel te financieren voor het verbeteren van de basisvaardigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over burgers die tegen de overheid moeten procederen

MP Arib asks whether citizens who miss short appeal deadlines against government decisions should be able to correct such errors, and whether the human touch should prevail in legal disputes with the state. The minister answers that a bill amending the General Administrative Law Act is in preparation, which will examine a 'civil loop' and more room for discretion on late objections, while stating that the existing administrative loop cannot cure time-limit breaches and that the government will consult on the bill in spring.
This question will be considered in the process of the bill in preparation amending the General Administrative Law Act following the childcare benefits affair.
Deze vraag wordt betrokken in het traject van het in voorbereiding zijnde wetsvoorstel tot aanpassing van de Awb naar aanleiding van de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de resultaten van de pilot vergoeding eigen risico zorgverzekering voor slachtoffers van seksueel geweld

An MP asked whether the government would scrap the health insurance deductible for sexual violence victims seeking help, after a pilot study found victims experience compensation as recognition and the seven-day cutoff is questioned. The minister answered that a policy response will follow in spring 2022 after consultation with stakeholders, explained the seven-day rationale (acute care and evidence collection), and pointed to a campaign and a new study on barriers to help-seeking.
A substantive policy response on the follow-up will be sent to the House of Representatives in spring 2022.
Een inhoudelijke beleidsreactie ten aanzien van het vervolg wordt in het voorjaar van 2022 naar de Tweede Kamer gestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over het vernietigende advies van de Raad voor de rechtspraak over de wetsvoorstellen 2G en 3G op de werkvloer, dat vlak voor kerst, met vijf weken vertraging, aan

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked why the Council for the Judiciary's critical advice on the 2G/3G workplace bills was sent to parliament late, why its criticisms (necessity, proportionality, dismissal risk, privacy) were not summarised in the explanatory memorandum, and why ministers may not have seen it. The minister answers that the advice was omitted by error and sent later, that the bills were substantially amended in response, and that the government considered the advice fully.
The advice was mistakenly not sent to the House of Representatives together with the other advice issued on the two bills.
Het advies is abusievelijk niet tezamen met de andere over de twee genoemde wetsvoorstellen uitgebrachte adviezen naar de Tweede Kamer gezonden.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht ‘Sociale media niet geschikt voor kinderen, concludeert Consumentenbond’

An MP asked the government about a Consumentenbond finding that social media platforms are unsuitable for children, including personalised advertising to minors and data privacy concerns. The state secretary responded that the AVG already protects children, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is responsible for enforcement, and that the government supports EU-level restrictions on profiling minors while proposing to promote the Dutch Code voor Kinderrechten Online and adjust national rules.
The cabinet wants to protect children more against inappropriate online advertising and child-directed marketing and give children the right not to be tracked and not to receive data profiles.
Het kabinet wil kinderen extra beschermen tegen niet-passende online reclame en kindermarketing en kinderen het recht geven om niet gevolgd te worden en geen dataprofielen te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gescheiden plaatsen van broers en zussen na een uithuisplaatsing

MP Kuiken asked the minister how many siblings are placed apart after out-of-home placement, whether ECHR and CRC obligations require keeping siblings together, and what is being done to legally anchor joint placement. The minister reports that 28 percent of sampled files showed split placements, that the government accepts a positive duty to keep siblings together where possible, and promises an answer on follow-up measures and a possible legal provision by 1 April 2022.
By 1 April 2022 at the latest I will inform the House of how I, together with the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport, will follow up on the recommendations.
Uiterlijk 1 april 2022 zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de wijze waarop ik, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS), opvolging zal geven aan de aanbevelingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over het bericht 'Ombudsman waarschuwt: Als het OM zelf straft, komen slachtofferrechten in het geding' en de brief over positie slachtoffers bij strafbeschikking O

MPs Van der Werf and Sneller asked about reports that the Public Prosecution Service imposes penal orders (strafbeschikking) even in serious cases where victims want to speak, and about the Ombudsman's warning on victims' rights. The Minister acknowledges that in 4 cases, including one sexual offence, penal orders were used despite the victim wishing to speak, says the OM will re-emphasise the contra-indication and that an evaluation of the new legal aid scheme and a fifth PG study are pending.
In 4 cases it turned out to be so. This involved 1 sexual offence case.
In 4 zaken bleek dat het geval. Het betrof daarbij 1 zedenzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en El Yassini over het bericht dat het Albeda als eerste mbo in Nederland een studentenrechtbank krijgt

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers about the Albeda college's new student court, questioning its legal basis, fair-trial safeguards, victims' reporting to police, and whether it clashes with criminal justice. The ministers answered that it is a voluntary, extrajudicial, preventive restorative process not subject to the Experimentenwet, that police are consulted on suspected crimes, and that the court is complementary and does not change reporting policy.
Parties are entirely free to choose this extrajudicial track.
Het staat partijen volledig vrij om te kiezen voor dit buitengerechtelijk traject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over vergoeding van schade naar aanleiding van een uitspraak van de civiele rechter

An MP asked whether private parties holding civil-court damages claims against childcare benefit victims should receive government advances during the moratorium, as crime victims with criminal damages awards do. The minister confirmed awareness, explained that advances apply only to criminal-court damages awards, and said civil claimants must enforce judgments themselves.
A citizen can claim damages in civil proceedings on the basis of tort.
Een burger kan in civiele procedures schadevergoeding eisen op grond van onrechtmatige daad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het artikel 'Jeugdzorgkenner: Kans op terugplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders 'vrijwel nihil''

An MP asked why the government did not order an independent investigation into returning children taken from childcare-benefit parents, and how the independence of the inspectorates is guaranteed. The minister answered that the inspectorates are independent under the Aanwijzingen inzake de rijksinspecties, will report by mid-February, and that support for parents and children is being arranged without waiting for the inquiry.
The Aanwijzingen provide that the minister responsible for policy may not influence the content of the inspectorates' work.
In de Aanwijzingen is bepaald dat de beleidsverantwoordelijk Minister de inhoud van de taakuitoefening van de inspecties niet mag beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over signalen van slechte zorg, fraude en hoge salarissen bij een instelling die zorg zou moeten leveren aan ex-gedetineerden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about poor care, fraud signals and high salaries at a provider of care to ex-prisoners in Enschede, including what supervision was in place and whether the director was screened. The minister answered that DJI knew of the signals since March 2020, launched a material audit in July 2021 and did not renew the contract, while defending its supervision, the tender exclusion grounds and the planned recovery of funds.
At present the investigation into the lawfulness of the care services declared by Zorg en Research is ongoing.
Op dit moment loopt het onderzoek naar de rechtmatigheid van de door Zorg en Research gedeclareerde zorgprestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over contact van gedetineerden met journalisten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why prisoners need prior permission from the prison director to speak to journalists, whether this should be reversed to a Belgian-style after-the-fact sanction system, and how often such requests are granted or refused. The minister replied that the current permission system with a balancing test and appeal routes is adequate, that no data on requests are registered, and that no change is planned.
I see no reason at this time to change the procedure.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de werkwijze te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de dubbelrol van een Amsterdamse rechter

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about an Amsterdam judge who also works as director of the Criminal Justice Chain at the ministry, questioning impartiality and conflicts of interest. The minister replied that such side functions are permitted under the WRRA and the judiciary's guidelines, that the court president as functional authority assessed and registered it, and that a bill to ban judges from parliament is in consultation while possible wider restrictions on side functions may be discussed in parliament.
This means judges may hold side functions as long as these do not impede the proper performance of the office and do not give rise to (the appearance of) partiality.
Dit betekent dat rechters nevenfuncties kunnen bekleden zolang deze niet in de weg staan aan een goede vervulling van het ambt en niet (de schijn van) partijdigheid met zich brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over rechtsbijstand bij verhoor van minderjarigen

MP Van Nispen asks why the government has not complied with a Amsterdam district court ruling extending legal aid to unarrested minors questioned by police, and whether the state will appeal and provide a temporary arrangement to safeguard the lawfulness of interrogations. Minister Dekker replies that the ruling was implemented for the individual case, that the government disagrees with the court's reading of the directive and has asked for an appeal to the Council of State, and that a temporary arrangement for summoned minors is being prepared.

At present I am in discussion with the legal profession and the most involved chain partners to arrange a temporary provision, examining how legal aid during police interrogation is to be arranged for summoned juvenile suspects.

Momenteel ben ik met de advocatuur en de meest betrokken ketenpartners in gesprek om een tijdelijke voorziening te treffen, waarbij wordt bezien op welke wijze rechtsbijstand bij politieverhoor wordt geregeld voor ontboden jeugdige verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van Nispen over de Kamerbrief 'Financiële compensatie voor het tekortschieten in de informatievoorziening bij wijziging van de SBF-regeling'

MPs Palland (CDA) and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the SBF-scheme compensation, arguing that SBF-ers suffered pension damage from the 2010 and 2013 changes and that DJI's poor information provision was wrongful. The Minister answered that no pension damage has been established, accepted the Boot/Lubbers finding of inadequate information only for the 2013 change (compensated), and declined further talks with the affected group.
I have not planned any consultation or follow-up steps with the SBF employees who used the SBF leave scheme or with the interest group 'SBF moet eerlijk'.
Ik heb geen overleg of vervolgstappen gepland met de SBF-medewerkers die gebruik hebben gemaakt van de SBF-verlofregeling of van de belangengroep «SBF moet eerlijk» gepland staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over gerechtsdeurwaarders die discutabele incasso’s proberen te incasseren

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether bailiffs earn more from debt collection than from official duties, whether they properly vet client companies with dubious reputations, and how consumers are protected from confusion and unfair pressure. The Minister answered that collection is a permitted side activity subject to independent BFT oversight, that bailiffs must communicate carefully and face disciplinary liability for undue pressure, and that a Wki quality bill and further consultations on the roles of bailiffs are underway, while leaving the burden of disputing invoices largely with the debtor and the creditor.
It is certainly not good if the bailiff is seen as an extension of companies with a dubious reputation.
Het is zeker niet goed als de gerechtsdeurwaarder als verlengstuk wordt gezien van bedrijven met een dubieuze reputatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over de recorduitgaven aan de landsadvocaat

SP MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked why government spending on the state's lawyer (landsadvocaat) reached a record in 2020, how it is itemised, and how this squares with the aim of curbing juridification and with refusing legal aid to Groningen gas-damage victims. The minister explained the rise as incident-driven (COVID and Groningen litigation), itemised costs per ministry, and said legal aid for Groningen residents is being arranged through a novella while the state's own lawyer use is necessary and kept under scrutiny.
The cabinet is preparing for that with the state's lawyer.
Het kabinet bereidt zich daar met de landsadvocaat op voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de nasleep van de storing in het Centraal register uitsluiting kansspelen

An MP asked when the Kansspelautoriteit's evaluation of Cruks start-up problems would be ready, whether all consequences had been mapped, how pre-20 October records were corrected, and how many players were wrongly admitted. The minister replied that the evaluation results are expected by 1 April, that all Cruks records were checked and corrected by 16 November, and that 67 reported players were admitted despite registration, with broader checks of operators' records ordered.
The Kansspelautoriteit expects to have the results available by 1 April at the latest.
De Kansspelautoriteit verwacht uiterlijk 1 april de resultaten beschikbaar te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over gokreclames op www.vi.nl

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Minister for Legal Protection about gambling advertisements, including live sports betting odds, on the website of Voetbal International, and whether they comply with advertising and youth-protection rules and the Kansspelautoriteit's oversight. The minister answers that the advertising rules apply to affiliates, that the regulator is responsible for supervision and enforcement, and that the website was adjusted, without judging the specific case.
It is not for me, but for the Kansspelautoriteit, to make statements on compliance with laws and regulations in a specific case.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de Kansspelautoriteit om uitspraken te doen over naleving van wet- en regelgeving in een concreet geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over illegale casino’s op Curaçao

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the scale of illegal online gambling from Curaçao, the Dutch Gambling Authority's (Ksa) ability to collect fines, and the status of a motion on the Team Bestrijding Ondermijning. The government answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and enforcement, that it is working with the Netherlands on reform under the Curaçao package, that Ksa fines against Curaçao-based firms are hard to collect, and that the motion is considered fulfilled.
Imposing an order subject to a penalty or a fine is, however, only one of the means that can be used to stop illegal providers.
Het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom of boete is echter maar één van de middelen die kunnen worden ingezet om illegale aanbieders te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de praktijk van het uitsluiten door Jehova’s Getuigen van afvallige leden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about shunning of former Jehovah's Witnesses, including what help the state offers victims, whether the law is adequate, and the status of a reporting point for cult victims requested by motion. The minister answered that shunning per se is not a criminal offence, victims can use regular mental health care and general victim support, no signals justify new criminalisation, and the reporting point will be set up carefully, with results of a commission expected in spring 2022.
Excluding former members by the Jehovah's Witness community is, however, not a criminal offence in itself.
Het uitsluiten van ex-leden door de gemeenschap der Jehova's Getuigen is echter op zichzelf geen strafbaar feit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over het artikel 'Hoe een verkrachter opnieuw kon toeslaan alle alarmsignalen ten spijt'

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether the Inspectorate of Justice and Security will investigate a case in which a rapist under intensified supervision struck again despite warning signs, and why no further inquiry is planned. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found no reason for further investigation after questioning police and probation, that the information it received is confidential supervisory information and cannot be shared, and that no reason for a new inquiry has come to light.
That information cannot be shared. The Inspectorate of Justice and Security received this information from the police and probation service in the context of its supervisory duties.
Die informatie kan niet worden gedeeld. Deze informatie heeft de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid van de politie en de reclassering gekregen in het kader van haar taakuitoefening als toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom aan over de inzet van gezichtsherkenningstechnologie

MP Kerseboom asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a company could use facial recognition at events under the GDPR without a qualifying public interest, whether citizens are sufficiently aware to consent, and how non-consenting bystanders are protected. The Minister answered that consent is the basis relied on, that it must be freely and informed given and is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority or courts to assess, that data minimisation applies, and that measures must prevent processing data of those who did not consent.

Ultimately, it is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) to determine in the specific case, taking into account the EDPB guidelines 05/2020 on consent, whether this consent was actually given freely.

Uiteindelijk is het aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) om in het specifieke geval – met in acht name van de richtsnoeren 05/2020 inzake toestemming van de European Data Protection Board (EDPB) – te bepalen of deze toestemming daadwerkelijk vrijelijk is gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over het ambtshalve toevoegen van een advocaat door een rechter aan een moeder die niet zelfredzaam is

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court that appointed a lawyer ex officio for a mother who could not look after her own interests, despite no statutory basis, and how such cases should be handled. The minister welcomed the outcome, pointed to early-signalling efforts, said costs fall on the legal aid budget, and declined to create a statutory basis for now, awaiting a WODC study due spring 2022.
I do not consider a statutory amendment to create an ex officio legal aid assignment for interested parties who are not self-reliant to be appropriate at this time.
Ik acht een wetswijziging om een ambtshalve last tot toevoeging te creëren aan belanghebbenden die niet zelfredzaam zijn, nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over incidenten in het Justitieel Complex Zaanstad

MP Kathmann asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether recent incidents at the Zaanstad prison complex are exceptional, whether the situation is worrying and safe, and whether scale matters. The minister answered that incidents are inherent to prisons, that Zaanstad has a relatively high number of misconduct reports largely due to its special regimes, that the situation is comparable to other institutions, and that additional safety measures were announced.
I see no link between incidents and the size of the penal institution.
Ik constateer geen verband tussen voorvallen en de grootte van de penitentiaire inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paternotte over een corona-uitbraak in een gevangenis en de vaccinatie van gevangenen

MPs Sneller and Paternotte asked about a COVID-19 outbreak in Zaanstad prison, the vaccination rate among prisoners, and current measures in detention facilities. The minister answered that outbreak protocols were followed, the exact vaccination rate is unknown because prisoners need not disclose status, and DJI follows RIVM advice on measures.
The exact vaccination rate among prisoners is not known, because prisoners are not obliged to disclose their vaccination status.
De exacte vaccinatiegraad onder gedetineerden is niet bekend, omdat gedetineerden niet verplicht zijn om de vaccinatiestatus door te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de bescherming van de privacy en het gebruik van een front-facing camera op de zelfscanner van de Albert Heijn

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Albert Heijn's handheld self-scanners with a front-facing camera enable facial recognition of customers, and what the government will do to prevent supermarkets from using it. The minister replied that the camera is switched off, that the manufacturer lists facial recognition as a possible use, that GDPR allows biometric processing only with explicit consent or for overriding public interest, that a bill clarifying this in the UAVG is planned, and that the AP's guidance is considered sufficient.
The statutory text will explicitly state that the exception in Article 29 may only be applied where necessary for an overriding public interest.
In de wettekst wordt expliciet opgenomen dat de uitzonderingsgrond van artikel 29 alleen kan worden toegepast wanneer dat nodig is voor een zwaarwegend algemeen belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mogelijk onterecht in rekening gebrachte kosten door de deurwaarder

Two SP MPs asked whether bailiffs may charge debtors €84.64-€85.36 for bank-account information requests under art. 475aa Rv even without subsequently seizing funds, and whether this is justified. The Minister defended the separate tariff as comparable to EAPO work, rejected evidence of abuse, promised to raise transparency and tariff concerns with the bailiffs' association, but refused to drop the tariff.
I will continue to raise the practical operation of this bank-inquiry arrangement in my regular discussions with the KBvG.
Ik zal in mijn reguliere gesprekken met de KBvG aandacht blijven vragen voor de praktijkwerking van onderhavige regeling omtrent bankbevragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Jeugdzorg faalt: jong kind soms niet meer terug naar ouders door onthechting'

An MP asked whether young children placed out of home are sometimes not returned to their biological parents because of attachment to foster families, and how often this happens. The minister answered that no figures exist on this specific issue, pointed to existing guidelines and the 'acceptable timeframe' criterion, acknowledged that gaps in help and fact-finding can delay returns, and referred to the reform agenda and a planned Inspectorate review of fact-finding quality.
There are currently no figures available on how often children cannot be returned to their parents due to attachment problems.
Er zijn op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar over hoe vaak het voorkomt dat kinderen (niet) kunnen worden teruggeplaatst bij hun ouders vanwege hechtingsproblemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het strafmaximum voor het onttrekken van een lijk aan nasporing

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the two-year maximum penalty for unlawfully removing a corpse from investigation (art. 151 Sr), which a court called too low, will be raised, and whether the Criminal Code gives enough room for intent and manner. The minister replied that WODC research on broader criminalisation of corpse desecration, including art. 151, is underway and he will report to the House after its results, without committing to a change.
I am awaiting the results of this research and will respond in due course, and will inform your House of that.
Ik wacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek af en zal te zijner tijd met een reactie daarop komen, waarover ik uw Kamer zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Belastingdienst gaf advies over omgaan met klagers in Jeugdzorg'

An MP asked whether youth care sought advice from the Tax Authority on handling parental complaints, and about the complaint routes for parents and the SKJ. The minister confirmed the Tax Authority was consulted in a 2019 round table following the Tielen/Peters motion, denied that the advice led to stricter complaint rules, and said parents' complaints must be taken seriously while noting the need to streamline complaint and disciplinary procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over GSM-detectie in gevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether serious criminals have too much freedom in prison and how mobile phone use by detainees can be restricted, including the status of a GSM jammer. The minister agreed phone possession should not be allowed, listed existing controls, and said the GSM jammer tender was stopped due to complexity, limited effectiveness and high cost, with DJI now researching GSM detection instead.
Strengthening the prevention of phone use remains an important part of the approach to tackling criminal conduct in detention.
Het versterken van het tegengaan van telefoongebruik is en blijft een belangrijk onderdeel van de aanpak om crimineel handelen in detentie tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Markuszower over het bericht 'Alarm jeugdrechters om crisis jeugdzorg: gebrekkige dossiers en niet passende beslissingen'

MPs Maeijer and Markuszower asked the government about reports that juvenile judges warn of a youth care crisis, with poor case files and inappropriate decisions, and about waiting times, closed placements and the quality of factual investigation in child protection. The minister acknowledges pressure on child protection, reports regional gaps and an action programme, but gives no national figures on children waiting or unnecessarily detained, and points to other bodies and ongoing reviews.
No national figures are available on how many children are currently waiting for the child protection measure imposed by the juvenile judge.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen cijfers beschikbaar hoeveel kinderen op dit moment wachten op de door de kinderrechter opgelegde jeugdbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat door de huidige vorm van geboorteaangifte bij de burgerlijke stand de risico’s op fraude of illegale adoptie groot zijn

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the current birth registration procedure allows fraud and illegal adoption, whether the government has data on the scale of the problem, and whether it will consult FIOM, Defence for Children and the Dutch association for civil registry officers. Minister Dekker replies that safeguards in Dutch birth registration are sufficient, that cases of fraud in the Netherlands are very rare and no current indications exist, that false foreign birth certificates are a residual risk beyond Dutch control, and that the government will keep watching signals and is willing to discuss with the organisations concerned.
Regarding possible signals of recent cases of illegal taking-in of children, I am willing to discuss with the organisations involved.
Over mogelijke signalen van recente gevallen van illegale opneming ga ik graag in overleg met de betrokken organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen  over het bericht over veroordeelde criminelen die vrij rondlopen in Turkije

An SP MP asked why a man convicted in absentia for strangling his niece in 2004 has evaded justice for 17 years in Turkey, and what is being done about impunity for offenders abroad. The minister agreed the situation is unacceptable, explained that Turkey does not extradite nationals but may take over enforcement of sentences under the Wots framework, reported 16 open cases and reminders sent, and said the case remains a topic with Turkish authorities while declining to give case-specific details.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and how a foreign authority acts on them, I make no statements.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over slachtoffers van oplichting en het verhaal van de schade na civiele vonnissen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about victims of fraud who win civil judgments but cannot recover damages from fraudsters, and whether the state should help collect or advance compensation. The Minister answered that enforcement via bailiffs is adequate, that the state has no role in collecting civil awards, and that the Donner committee's advice is under discussion with chain partners.
At this moment I see no reason for the government to play a role in this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor de overheid om hierin een rol te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichten ‘Daar sta je dan: mishandeld, vergeten en met lege handen’ en ‘Driekwart slachtoffers gelooft niet meer in aangifte doen’

A CDA MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that most victims no longer report crimes and about victims' rights when the Public Prosecution Service settles serious assault and sexual cases by penalty order without a judge. The ministers answered that reporting willingness depends on offence type, that the OM considers victims' interests but acknowledges delays in sending victim letters and is working to fix them, and that victims can claim damages and complain to the OM.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated it is working with priority on resolving these problems.
Het OM heeft aangegeven met prioriteit te werken aan het oplossen van deze problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Van Nispen en Westerveld over het sterker, gerichter en efficiënter fixen van matchfixing

Three MPs (Van der Laan, Van Nispen, Westerveld) asked the ministers about matchfixing, including its prevalence, prosecutability under Dutch criminal law, information sharing between betting operators, investigators and sports bodies, and funding for prevention. The minister answered that the government is reviewing the anti-matchfixing structure, that existing offences like fraud and bribery only partly cover matchfixing, and that monitoring and the Kansspelwet evaluation will follow, with no clear commitment to new legislation yet.
The nature and extent of matchfixing in the Netherlands is not known.
De aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Inge van Dijk over wederom een bericht over matchfixing

MPs Van der Laan and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government will act on KNVB calls for further investigation into possible matchfixing in youth football, whether betting operators monitor these competitions, and whether an OM study on criminalising matchfixing will be shared with parliament. The minister says the Signalenoverleg Sportfraude will discuss the signals, that betting on the Onder 21 competition is prohibited, and that the OM study is still being advised on, with parliament to be informed later.
Your House will be informed about the advice afterwards.
Uw Kamer wordt daarna geïnformeerd over het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de voortgang op interlandelijke adoptie

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about progress on a new intercountry adoption system, the impact of the adoption suspension on licence holders, the reopening of adoption routes, and the expert centre. The minister replied that findings on the future of intercountry adoption will be sent to parliament by end 2021, that 40 children were approved for admission, that talks with licence holders on continuity are ongoing, and that the expert centre is not yet operational, targeted for the first half of 2022.
I will inform the House before the end of 2021 about the outcomes of the exploration into the future of intercountry adoption.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor het einde van 2021 over de uitkomsten van de verkenning naar de toekomst van interlandelijke adoptie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over "de langdurige digitale storing bij Dienst Justis”

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a multi-day digital outage at Dienst Justis that blocked VOG applications, why it was not resolved sooner and communicated late, and about reporting and prevention. The minister answered that a technical fault at the shared ICT service affected several government systems, that about 70,000 VOG applications could not be filed, that information was given via the website and letters, and that causes and preventive measures would be evaluated later.
After evaluation of the outage by SSC-ICT and by JenV, it will be considered which measures will be taken
Na evaluatie van de storing door SSC-ICT en door JenV zal bezien worden welke maatregelen worden getroffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de werkdruk van gevangenispersoneel bij de Rijks Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about staff shortages, workload and safety at the Rijks Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen, including the Hunnerberg warning and the failure to meet the 77-hour daily programme norm. The minister acknowledged the pressure, listed short- and medium-term measures (Horsterveen opening, temporary agency staff, mbo group leaders, staff survey) and admitted the statutory 77-hour norm is sometimes not met, while declining to provide private-institution staffing data.
Unlike the RJJI, which falls under my management, I have no insight into staff turnover at private institutions.
In tegenstelling tot de RJJI, die onder mijn beheer valt, heb ik geen inzicht in het personeelsverloop van particuliere inrichtingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de complexe schadevergoeding van benadeelden in strafzaken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a court ruling showing that Dutch criminal procedure does not allow a split verdict (deciding guilt first, then victim compensation) should be addressed by allowing an interim judgment, citing cases with remorseful offenders and the Donner commission's advice. The minister answered that the law was deliberately designed this way, declined to propose an interim-judgment option now, and pointed instead to a planned separate compensation procedure in the new Code of Criminal Procedure, which is still under Council of State advice.
I do not consider it appropriate at this time to anticipate this with a proposal for a possibility, by means of an interim judgment, to handle the injured party's claim only after a finding of guilt.

Ik vind het nu niet aan de orde om daarop vooruit te lopen met een voorstel voor een mogelijkheid om door middel van een tussenvonnis de vordering van de benadeelde partij pas na een schuldigverklaring te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Ellian en Kathmann over internationale kinderontvoeringen

MPs Van Nispen, Ellian and Kathmann asked how countries that are party to the Hague Child Abduction Convention but fail to comply can be held to account, whether the agreements are adequately enforced, and whether the Dutch Central Authority has sufficient capacity. The Minister answered that return is the starting point but courts decide, that cooperation and the revised Brussels II-bis regulation from August 2022 aim to improve enforcement, and that the Central Authority responds on average within five working days.
It is not for me to pass judgment on the ruling of an independent judicial body (in another country).
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te vellen over de uitspraak van een onafhankelijke gerechtelijke instantie (in een ander land).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de voorschotregeling voor slachtoffers van misdrijven

An MP asked whether victims of violent and other crimes can receive an advance from the state when a perpetrator's payment of compensation is suspended under a moratorium, and whether the 5,000 euro cap applies. The minister answered that the state will pay victims an advance equal to the amount normally collected from the offender during the moratorium, without the 5,000 euro cap, and that the advance rule protects victims from a perpetrator's temporary inability to pay.

Since I consider this an undesirable situation, on 14 June I decided to pay victims of violent and other crimes an advance during the moratorium so that they are not disadvantaged by the temporary suspension.

Aangezien ik dit een ongewenste situatie vind, heb ik op 14 juni jl. besloten om gedurende het moratorium een voorschot aan de slachtoffers van gewelds- en andere misdrijven uit te keren zodat zij niet worden benadeeld door de tijdelijke opschorting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rechtsbijstand

An MP from the SP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why funding for the social legal profession (sociaal advocaten) was only raised now, how the reform affects lawyers' income and access to justice, and how a voluntary levy on commercial law firms would work. The Minister replies that the tariffs are being raised structurally from 2022 under scenario 1 of the Van der Meer committee, that the levy is still under discussion, and that the reform aims to reduce demand for legal aid.
I see no reason at this time to expand the scope of subsidised legal aid.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de scope van de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de uitvoering van de motie Van Berge c.s. over de uitzondering op een vergoeding voor video on demand wegnemen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how far implementation of the motion on removing the video-on-demand exception to the film makers' remuneration right has progressed, and sought faster action given the weak position of makers. The minister replied that a draft bill is being prepared to extend the collectively managed remuneration right to all filmmakers and actors and to paid VOD services, with a preliminary draft targeted for this year.
I aim to present a draft bill to the sector this year.
Ik streef ernaar een voorontwerp van wet nog dit jaar aan het veld voor te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand

An SP MP asked about the readiness of the CRUKS gambling exclusion register, privacy safeguards, the Verslavingspreventiefonds and care access before the 1 October 2021 launch of online gambling. The minister acknowledged that CRUKS failed on 1 October despite stress tests, explained privacy rules and oversight by the Kansspelautoriteit and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, described the prevention fund and helpline, and said care capacity was sufficient, while promising monitoring letters.
Unfortunately, the testing could not prevent the system from not working on 1 October.
Het testen heeft helaas niet kunnen voorkomen dat het systeem op 1 oktober jl. niet werkte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over de valse start van het online gokken en de storing in het Centraal register uitsluiting kansspelen

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked why the Cruks gambling self-exclusion register malfunctioned at the launch of legal online gambling on 1 October 2021 and why the Kansspelautoriteit allowed licensed operators to accept players before registration worked. The minister acknowledged the start was flawed, explained the technical causes and the decision to allow play from 2 October as the safer alternative to illegal sites, and said Cruks now functions stably and the regulator will evaluate the start-up problems.
The Kansspelautoriteit has informed me that consumer privacy was not at risk at any point in the entire process.
De Kansspelautoriteit heeft mij bericht dat de privacy van consumenten in het gehele proces niet in gevaar is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Staaij over de opstelling van de staat in zaken rondom afstandsmoeders en verjaring bij adoptie

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Staaij asked why the state is now being sued over non-voluntary domestic adoptions and whether it should waive limitation defences as it did for intercountry adoption. The Minister said the Commission report is still under review with stakeholders, that the state assesses limitation defences case by case, and that the court must now decide.
It is now up to the court to rule on this defence.
Het is nu aan de rechtbank om over dit verweer te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de implementatie van het nieuwe gevangenisregime onder de Wet Straffen en Beschermen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the early implementation of the Wet Straffen en Beschermen in prisons, including whether all facilities were ready on 1 July, delays in leave applications, the 6-week leave decision period, BBA and PP occupancy and choice, reduced sport and shopping hours, and whether the regime reduces recidivism. The Minister replied that preparations were thorough, that old leave forms remained usable and new ones are coming, that no fixed 6-week decision term exists, that BBA hours are nationally set and reasonably meet the Pbw, and that the reform is expected to reduce recidivism.
If bottlenecks emerge in that process, they will be assessed on the facts and resolved where necessary.
Als daarbij knelpunten aan het licht komen zullen deze naar bevind van zaken worden beoordeeld en indien nodig worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht dat Tilburgse kappers op blauwe plekken gaan letten in de aanpak tegen huiselijk geweld

An MP from the CDA asked whether Tilburg's plan to train hairdressers to report suspected domestic violence, and the wider idea of organised reporting points, is consistent with government policy on youth care and trust between citizens and professionals. The State Secretary answered that Veilig Thuis is the only reporting point, that reporting must follow the mandatory meldcode with care for trust, and that the government supports Tilburg's initiative to raise awareness without changing the meldcode.
Apart from Veilig Thuis there are no other organised reporting points for reporting domestic violence.
Naast Veilig Thuis zijn er geen andere georganiseerde meldpunten voor het melden van huiselijk geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over uithuisplaatsing van kinderen van gedupeerden van de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many children of childcare-benefit scandal victims have been placed outside the home, for how long, and what help parents received. The minister answered that the number is not yet known, that placements are a last resort with safeguards, and that municipalities and the Herstel Toeslagen programme will offer support and reassess cases.
It is currently not known how many families of affected parents have had (or have) to deal with an out-of-home placement or return.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen van gedupeerde ouders te maken hebben (gehad) met een uithuisplaatsing of terugplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Ellian over het bericht ‘Duizend inhuurkrachten WhatsApp lezen mee in chats’

Two MPs asked the government about reports that WhatsApp moderators can read the last five messages of a reported user, questioning whether this undermines end-to-end encryption and transparency under GDPR Article 12. The minister answered that the ProPublica article was corrected, that reporting only shares the messages the reporter chooses to send so encryption is not broken, and that no indications of an Article 12 breach were found.
When a WhatsApp user reports another WhatsApp user, the reporting user sends WhatsApp the most recent messages received from the other user.
Wanneer een WhatsApp-gebruiker een andere WhatsApp-gebruiker rapporteert, dan stuurt de rapporterende gebruiker aan WhatsApp
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Gezondheidslobby casht jackpot in gokbranche'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about reports that health-sector organisations such as MIND promoted state-run lotteries, the role of the Nederlandse Loterij, gambling reclame rules, and monitoring of gambling addiction. The government answered most questions substantively, committing to talks with MIND and asking the Kansspelautoriteit to act, while noting data gaps (LADIS not operational) and that some questions fall under other ministries or are commercially confidential.
Regarding the budgeted financial returns of any participation, we do not share information because it may concern commercially sensitive and competition-sensitive business information.
Over begrote financiële opbrengsten van welke deelneming dan ook, delen wij geen informatie omdat dit mogelijk bedrijfs-commerciële en concurrentiegevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kathmann over het bericht dat verdachtenverhoor bij de politie tekortschiet

MP Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about a report that police interrogations of suspects fall short, and why the OM replaced its recording directive with a non-public instruction. Minister Grapperhaus rejected the claim of insufficient interrogator skill, explained that the directive was converted into an instruction under a broader OM policy cleanup, and defended not publishing instructions since they have no external effect.
Instructions as such have no external effect; third parties cannot derive rights from them.
Instructies hebben als zodanig geen externe werking; derden kunnen er geen rechten aan ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de kwaliteit en het opnemen van politieverhoren

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security minister about the quality of police suspect interviews, recording of interviews, withdrawal of the OM instruction on recording, and treatment of people with mild intellectual disabilities. The minister denies the quality problems, says recording is not feasible for all interviews, and defends the withdrawal of the OM directive as not weakening suspects' rights.
The importance of audiovisual recording lies mainly in the right to a fair trial, as laid down in Article 6 ECHR.
Het belang van audiovisuele registratie is met name gelegen in het recht op een eerlijk proces, zoals neergelegd in artikel 6 EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Bikker over het bericht 'Geen Friese tolken meer beschikbaar vanwege 'magere vergoeding''

MPs Romke de Jong and Bikker asked about reports that Frisian interpreters are no longer available due to low fees, and how the right to use Frisian in court (Wet gebruik Friese taal art. 11) is guaranteed. The minister answered that Frisian-speaking judges and prosecutors exist, interpreters can be used, new tariff and procurement arrangements are being introduced, and a baseline survey and future bestuursafspraken are planned.
It is for my successor to give these arrangements concrete form and record them.
Het is aan mijn ambtsopvolger deze afspraken concreet vorm te geven en vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er geen gerechtstolk Fries meer beschikbaar is om financiële redenen

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the government was aware that Frisian court interpreters had stopped working over low pay and why it allowed this, and what it would do to restore access to justice in Frisian. Minister Dekker answered that the new tariff and contracting system will let interpreters negotiate rates with intermediaries, that Frisian-speaking judges and prosecutors provide access, and that a website and monitoring will follow, without committing to raise pay now.
I regret that the sworn interpreters and translators registered in the Register of Sworn Interpreters and Translators have decided to stop providing interpreting services for the judicial system.
Ik betreur het dat de in het Register beëdigde tolken en vertalers ingeschreven tolken Fries op dit moment hebben besloten geen tolkdiensten meer te verrichten ten behoeve van de rechtspleging.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over de berichten ‘Beruchte topgangster deelt lakens uit in bajes Zaanstad’: ‘De R. bepaalt wat er gebeurt’ en ‘Motorbendekopstuk Lysander de R. (39) in allerijl uit cel gehaald en

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that a gang leader inside Zaanstad prison runs a rival motorclub, influences prison affairs, and was moved after media attention. The minister confirmed the reports in part, explained the rules for inmate committees and complaint procedures, declined to discuss the individual transfer or the keylogger case due to an ongoing police investigation, and listed measures against criminal activity from detention.
In the interest of this investigation, I am not making any further statements about the keylogger at this time.
In het belang van dit onderzoek doe ik op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen over de key-logger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht 'Beruchte topgangster deelt lakens uit in bajes Zaanstad'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a press report that a prominent gang member inside Zaanstad prison was intimidating staff and steering criminal activity from her cell, and about prison safety and related measures. The minister acknowledged the report as unacceptable, described anti-contraband, monitoring and integrity measures, and answered most questions, while declining to share some investigation results pending the police and prosecution inquiry.

If the investigation is completed in time and publishing its results does not harm order and safety in the prisons or an ongoing criminal investigation by the prosecution and police, I will inform the House of the outcomes.

Indien het onderzoek tijdig is afgerond en het bekend maken van de onderzoeksresultaten geen negatieve invloed heeft op de orde en veiligheid in de penitentiaire inrichtingen of een lopend opsporingsonderzoek van OM en politie zal ik uw Kamer berichten over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bestaan van een dodenlijst in de Penitentiaire Inrichting Zaandam

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a list containing names of staff at PI Zaandam found during a cell inspection, including how it arose, who had access, staff risks and aftercare, and whether the suspect was transferred. The minister confirmed the list, said police and prosecutors are investigating, withheld details pending that inquiry, described aftercare meetings with staff, and declined to discuss individual transfers.
As long as the results of that are not yet known, I cannot make further statements about the list or about what may have been done with the list.
Zolang de resultaten daarvan nog niet bekend zijn, kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen over de lijst of over wat er mogelijk met de lijst kan zijn gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht 'Beruchte topcrimineel deelt lakens uit in Bajes Zaanstad'

Van Haga asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a prominent criminal runs a prison ward, smuggles phones, intimidates staff and inmates, and gets access to staff data at JC Zaanstad, and asks what is being done. The Minister answers that smuggling and criminal conduct are being addressed through searches, detection measures and disciplinary action, but withholds details of individual cases because investigations are ongoing and for privacy reasons.
Since an criminal investigation is currently underway, I cannot make any statements about this individual case.
Aangezien er momenteel een opsporingsonderzoek loopt, kan ik over deze individuele casus geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Personeel gevangenis Zaandam op dodenlijst´

An MP asked whether the government is aware of reports that staff of Zaandam prison appeared on a death list and what it will do to protect them and their families. The minister confirmed awareness, described a staff meeting, the ongoing police and prosecution investigation, individual talks and existing security measures, without announcing new concrete steps.
On Monday 23 August, all staff of the department where the list was found gathered with the prison management.
Op maandag 23 augustus jl. zijn alle medewerkers van de afdeling waar de lijst werd aangetroffen bij elkaar gekomen met de directie van de inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Nispen over rammelende feitenonderzoeken in de jeugdbescherming

MPs Kwint and Van Nispen asked about unreliable fact-finding reports in youth protection, including a reported case of a wrongly placed child and complaints procedures. The Minister of Justice replied that the case did not rest on a wrong file, that a Dutch action plan on fact-finding runs to end 2021, that the existing checks are adequate in his view, and that a future youth protection scenario is under consultation.
Imposing a youth protection measure may under no circumstances be based on faulty fact-finding.
Het opleggen van een jeugdbeschermingsmaatregel mag overigens nooit gebaseerd zijn op foutief feitenonderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en Bouchallikh over het bericht dat de Nederlandse politie toch gebruik heeft gemaakt van gezichtsherkenningssoftware van het omstreden bedrijf Clearview AI

MPs Van Ginneken and Bouchallikh asked whether Dutch police used Clearview AI facial recognition software despite earlier denials, and how this fits with privacy law. The minister answered that logs predate February 2020, police deny operational use and have no contract, the authorities cannot verify the claims, and no further legislative steps are planned because no legal gap was found.
Upon inquiry, it has not emerged that Dutch police employees used a test account on or following this event.
Op navraag is niet gebleken dat door medewerkers van de Nederlandse politie op of naar aanleiding hiervan gebruik is gemaakt van een testaccount.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het reinigen van de woning van een dierbare na een geweldsincident of zelfmoord

MP Van Nispen asks whether next of kin should be responsible for and bear the cost of cleaning a home after a violent incident or suicide, and whether a national policy or fund is needed. The ministers agree the situation is distressing and not reasonably expected of relatives, estimate about fifty cases a year, and commit to talks with Slachtofferhulp Nederland, police, the prosecution service and the Schadefonds to map practice before deciding on any extra measure.
Cleaning the home after such an incident can in principle not reasonably be expected of next of kin.
Het reinigen van de woning na een dergelijk incident kan in beginsel redelijkerwijs niet van nabestaanden verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Ginneken over het bericht dat het ROC Mondriaan in Den Haag is gehackt

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about the hack of ROC Mondriaan in The Hague, its effects on students and staff, timing of recovery and data breach, and whether other ROCs and the sector are protected. The minister answered that systems were shut down as a precaution, teaching largely continued, recovery will take weeks, data including class lists and financial details has been published, and sector-wide security initiatives and a dialogue with the MBO Raad are underway.
That cannot be said at this moment.
Dat is op dit moment niet te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het stilgehouden rapport Woittiez over structurele en ernstige juridische fouten in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked why a 2018 exploratory document ('Incident of Patroon?') on structural legal failures in youth care was not shared with parliament, and how the government chooses the reform agenda and involves experiential experts. The minister answered that the document was a short exploration rather than a full report, judged not to need sharing because the problem was already known and being addressed, and outlined the reform agenda and consultation processes while leaving final decisions to a new cabinet.

Given the nature of the exploration and the fact that it showed the problem was already known and being addressed, there was then no reason seen to inform me about the exploration and therefore not to share it with your House.

Gezien de aard van de verkenning en gelet op het feit dat uit de verkenning bleek dat de problematiek reeds bekend was en werd opgepakt, is destijds geen aanleiding gezien om mij te informeren over de verkenning en daardoor ook niet om de verkenning met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het toezicht op en van advocatenkantoor Houthoff op haar cliënten

The MP asked the ministers whether a major Dutch law firm, Houthoff, was adequately supervised for client due diligence and anti-money-laundering compliance after press reports of weak checks and profit over compliance. The government answered that the firm was inspected in 2019 with no irregularities found beyond administrative recommendations, that supervision lies with the local bar dean and the BFT, and that it is not for the minister to order further investigation.
Houthoff was inspected by the supervisor in 2019 as part of a thematic investigation into law firms' compliance with the Wwft.
Houthoff is in het kader van een thematisch onderzoek naar de naleving van de Wwft door advocatenkantoren in 2019 doorgelicht door de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Meldingen eergerelateerd geweld stijgen, opvang vol’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that honour-related violence notifications are rising while shelter places are full, including shelter capacity, perpetrator removal, early recognition and a multi-year action programme. The government answered that notifications rose only slightly in 2020, that shelter demand peaked and was temporarily solved, that criminal law tools exist, and that work on prevention and a follow-up exploration is ongoing.
Talks are now taking place between the VNG, municipalities and care providers on the availability, occupancy and financing of this specialised shelter, with the aim of reaching a structural solution.

Er vinden nu gesprekken plaats tussen VNG, gemeenten en betrokken zorgaanbieders over de beschikbaarheid, bezetting en financiering van deze specialistische vorm van opvang, met als doel om tot een structurele oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over wettelijk tuchtrecht voor verzekeraars

An SP MP asks the government about the disciplinary regime for insurers, including the 2008/2009 limits on consumer complaints, whether consumers can still complain directly, individual liability, sanctions and the independence of the Tuchtraad. The minister answers that consumers were never stripped of the right to complain, that a statutory duty for insurers to submit to discipline is planned, and that DNB will supervise compliance while the sector retains operational control.
I also call on insurers to make the possibility of filing disciplinary complaints sufficiently known in their internal complaints procedure and on their website.
Ik roep verzekeraars ook op om de mogelijkheid tot het indienen van tuchtklachten voldoende kenbaar te maken in hun interne klachtenprocedure en op hun website.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Gevangenis Limburg laat vrouw per ongeluk te vroeg vrij door rekenfout'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a prisoner released early due to a calculation error at a Limburg prison, including the offences, why she was not yet arrested, whether a description was sent to investigators, how often such early releases occur, and what measures will prevent them. The minister acknowledged the error as human, said the offender has been re-arrested and serves the remaining sentence, a description was sent, five early-release alerts occurred in 2021, and cited existing safeguards such as a four-eyes check and software support.
I will not go into individual cases any further.
Ik ga verder niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat Amsterdam een tekort aan rechters en officieren van justitie heeft

MP Van Nispen asked the ministers about reports that Amsterdam's courts and prosecution service face shortages of judges, prosecutors and funds, and about budget compensation for case complexity, experiments and digitalisation. The ministers answer that staffing shortages are tied to a tight labour market and turnover, that the problem affects all districts, that funding is set via price and volume agreements with the judiciary and prosecution, and that no new short-term funding is committed while the cabinet is caretaker.
The starting point is that the current caretaker cabinet does not anticipate decision-making on possible investments by a next cabinet.
Uitgangspunt hierbij is dat het huidige demissionaire kabinet niet vooruit loopt op besluitvorming over mogelijke investeringen door een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de documentaire 'Goede Moeders'

MP Westerveld asks the Ministers about the documentary 'Goede Moeders' on repeated child removals, including reporting of new pregnancies, Veilig Thuis and youth-care investigation procedures, inaccurate case files, and the status of a motion and action plan to reduce out-of-home placements. The government answers that reporting is governed by the Meldcode and sector frameworks without a legal reporting duty, describes fact-finding safeguards and complaint routes, and says the motion's plan is under study with a roundtable planned, though it provides no firm commitment on the plan.

I am aware that in practice parents and children sometimes believe that the organisations concerned, such as Veilig Thuis, the certified institutions or the Child Protection Board, have not conducted proper fact-finding and that incorrect information remains in files and petitions.

Het is mij bekend dat het in de praktijk voorkomt dat ouders en kinderen menen dat door de betreffende organisaties, zoals VT, de GI's of de RvdK, geen goed feitenonderzoek is gedaan en dat onjuiste informatie in dossiers en verzoekschriften blijft staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Laan en Sneller over het artikel ‘Ik zag mijn lichaam en mijn maatschappelijke rol als een gevangenis’

MPs Van der Laan and Sneller asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a newspaper article describing a woman's dismissal from the judicial training programme linked to her gender transition, and whether transition-related leave should exist. The minister answered that the dismissal was for substantive reasons unrelated to the transition, that the Council of State-style oversight via the courts and the College voor de Rechten van de Mens upheld this, and that a study on transition leave will be answered by the next cabinet.
It is not for me to go into the further substance of this case.
Het is niet aan mij om op de verdere inhoud van deze casus in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een familie die vermalen wordt in de molens van de overheid

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Nispen (SP) asked why a family was harmed by government action over a small cannabis plantation, including Tax Authority estimates, closure of their home under article 13b Opiumwet, and denial of subsidised legal aid. The ministers declined to discuss the specific case, citing tax secrecy and the judge's role, defended the legal framework and noted ongoing evaluations and a planned legal-aid review.
A specific case cannot be discussed.
Er kan niet worden ingegaan op een specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er vragen leven rondom de privacy van Burgernet

An MP asked the Minister about privacy concerns over the Burgernet alert system, including unclear responsibility, location tracking, collection of postcode and house number, and whether a risk analysis was done. The minister answered that police own Burgernet, the app does not track citizens, a 2019 privacy scan found privacy safeguarded with most recommendations adopted, and that the child-abduction alert feature is ready pending launch.
As requested, I have attached the report for you, with an accompanying memo, in consultation with the police and the external advisory firm.
Zoals verzocht heb ik het rapport voor u, met een begeleidende memo 4 , bijgevoegd, dit in afstemming met politie en het externe adviesbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Van der Laan, Ellemeet, Kathmann en Simons over het bericht 'Kabinet biedt excuses aan voor oude transgenderwet'

MPs asked why the compensation scheme for the former transgender sterilisation requirement was not published by 1 July, how the Transgender and Intersex Collective was involved, and why the amount is EUR 5,000. The minister said publication was delayed, the Collective was consulted and its input shaped the scheme, the amount follows an earlier scheme for youth care abuse victims, and the scheme will be published in the Staatscourant with applications from 18 October 2021.
It has become apparent that drafting the scheme and preparing its implementation required more time than originally estimated.
Het is gebleken dat de totstandkoming van de regeling en het voorbereiden van de uitvoering meer tijd vereisten dan op voorhand was ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het ondoorzichtige keuringsysteem van de jeugdbescherming

MP Peters asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the certification system for youth protection, including the Keurmerkinstituut's handling of weak client participation at Jeugdbescherming Limburg, access to audit reports, and oversight of the certifier. The Minister answers that the certifier judged client participation sufficient after measures were taken, that audit reports are shared at the discretion of the certified institution, and that the certifier is supervised by the RvA and the inspectorates, so no new measures are planned.
The KMI supervises the certified institutions and is itself checked by the RvA and the Inspectorates.
Het KMI houdt toezicht op de gecertificeerde instellingen en wordt door de RvA en de Inspecties gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Justitie wil doodrijder van Fleur niet op verlof in Loosdrecht in belang van nabestaanden’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the public prosecution service should prevent a driver who killed a 19-year-old while drunk from returning to his home village on leave, and how often location and contact bans are imposed and how the new Wet straffen en beschermen will better protect victims. The minister answered that such conditions are assessed case by case, gave rough figures on bans, said the new law explicitly weighs victims' interests, and noted that protection after full release falls under other laws, with no firm targets given.
In that weighing, the victim's or next of kin's need for protection is set against the offender's fundamental rights.
In die afweging wordt de beschermingsbehoefte van het slachtoffer of de nabestaande afgezet tegen de grondrechten van de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de marktwerking in het notariaat

An MP from the SP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about market competition in the notarial profession, including whether the Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) oversight is adequate, staffing, the high-risk notary offices, cooperation with accountants and tax advisers, affordability, the link between market liberalisation and incidents, and whether a new evaluation should be carried out. The Minister replies that the BFT's oversight is adequate and risk-based, that the KNB's peer reviews complement it, that affordability is not in question, and that no new evaluation is needed at present, though a KNB future-oriented exercise is awaited.
The BFT has various enforcement instruments ranging from a norm-transmitting conversation, through a written warning, to filing a complaint with the Chambers for the notariat.

Het BFT beschikt over verschillende handhavingsinstrumenten oplopend van een normoverdragend gesprek, via een schriftelijke waarschuwing tot het indienen van een klacht bij de Kamers voor het notariaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het feit dat geadopteerden op dit moment 835 euro moeten betalen voor het wijzigen van hun achternaam naar hun oorspronkelijke achternaam

An SP MP asked why adoptees must pay 835 euro to revert to their original surname, arguing they had no say in the original name change and asking whether fees could be waived or reduced and whether adoptive parents are consulted. The minister confirmed the fee, said government services must be cost-covering and that fees are reviewed periodically, but committed to no change and said adoptive parents are not consulted.
As soon as I see opportunities to do so from the perspective of cost-covering, I will adjust the fees.
Zodra ik daartoe vanuit het perspectief van kostendekkendheid mogelijkheden zie, zal ik de leges aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het naleven van de Europese privacyregels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) bij (uitvoerings)instanties

An MP asks multiple ministers whether a long list of public bodies (DUO, CBR, SVB, IND, DJI, UWV, OM, FIOD and others) collect and process personal data in line with GDPR, and whether any are not yet compliant. The government replies per organisation, generally stating compliance, while noting ongoing work and specific gaps such as UWV's SONAR system, SVB processes still in development, and CAK access management.
UWV is working hard to comply with the GDPR.
Het UWV werkt hard om aan de AVG te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet inzake de weigering om meer geld te reserveren voor echtscheidingszaken

The Member Ellemeet asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the government refuses to reserve more money for divorce cases, after the Bar Association suspended cooperation on legal aid packages, and whether divorce lawyers' fees will fall by thirty percent. The Minister acknowledges that fees in family law lag most, earmarks EUR 28 million through 2024, rejects the thirty percent claim, and promises a meeting with the Bar Association.
I will enter into discussion with the NOvA in the short term to see how we can continue the cooperation.
Ik zal op korte termijn in gesprek met de NOvA treden om te bezien hoe we de samenwerking kunnen voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake Rechtshulppakketten

An SP member asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the NOvA suspending cooperation on legal aid packages, the adequacy of the proposed hourly rate of about 86 euros for divorce work, and whether scenario 1 of the Van der Meer committee will be implemented by 1 January 2022. The Minister says the NOvA's decision is regrettable, that the experiment's fees are a step up within budget limits, that no new trajectories will stop, and that options for implementing the motion are being examined with the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand.
