As soon as the cooperation allows, we will resume the development of legal aid packages, including the divorce experiment.
Zodra de samenwerking dit toestaat zullen we de ontwikkeling van rechtshulppakketten, waaronder het experiment scheiden, hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de mogelijke uitbreiding van het aantal jeugdgevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about rising prognoses for youth detention capacity, the closure of youth institutions under the VOM programme, staffing and safety, and whether the prognosis model should be recalibrated. The minister answered that capacity needs are rising, explained the rationale for closures and buffer capacity, announced a temporary Rijks JJI location at PI Zuid-Oost Ter Peel with Inspectorate review, and said the prognosis model will be further studied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Drie kinderen aangerand door tbs’er op onbegeleid verlof’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a 42-year-old TBS patient on unaccompanied leave sexually assaulted three children in Venray, and whether unaccompanied leave should be stopped for sex offenders. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said the clinic is investigating and the outcome awaited, and rejected stopping unaccompanied leave, citing the established risk-assessment procedure.
It does not befit me to go into an individual case.
Het past mij niet om op een individuele casus in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de berichten ‘Kritisch rapport over fouten in jeugdzorg stilgehouden’ en ‘De gescheiden vader, de top van Justitie en het verdwenen rapport’

An SGP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether parents' legal position in child protection should be strengthened, whether the fact-finding improvement plan should be reconsidered, what happens to families harmed by flawed reports, whether a complaints point should be opened, and whether more funds are needed for child judges. The minister replied that civil child-protection law offers adequate protection, the improvement plan continues with evaluation next year, existing complaint routes suffice, and extra funds for judges are not planned for now.
In my response to this research I indicated that further legal protection, for example through stricter evidentiary rules, is not opportune.
In mijn reactie op dit onderzoek heb ik aangegeven dat verdergaande rechtsbescherming, bijvoorbeeld door middel van strengere bewijsregels, niet opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over fouten in de jeugdzorg stilgehouden’

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Rechtsbescherming about a 2018 internal exploration 'Incident of patroon?' that allegedly showed systematic errors in youth-care files and was withheld from the ministers and the father in a case. The minister answered that it was an exploration rather than a report, that the claim of hundreds of cases per year is not substantiated, that the ministers were not informed, and that the actionplan on fact-finding is in progress with evaluation in 2022.
I am of the view that the method chosen for this exploration is not the right way to answer a broader systemic question.
Ik ben van mening dat de methode, zoals die in deze verkenning is gekozen, niet de juiste manier is om tot beantwoording van een bredere stelselvraag te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, De Hoop en Westerveld over het artikel ''Raadsdames' in actie: de titel raadsheer is seksistisch'

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the Ministers whether the judicial title 'raadsheer' is still appropriate given that women hold the office, and whether gender-neutral titles should be adopted. The minister agrees gender-neutral titles fit better, but says a law change is a large operation and defers the decision to the next cabinet, with only a possible WODC study being explored.
It is therefore up to the new cabinet to decide on a legislative change to one or more gender-neutral job titles for raadsheren.
Het is daarom aan het nieuwe kabinet om een beslissing te nemen omtrent een wetswijziging naar een of meer sekseneutrale functietitels voor raadsheren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de delicten die Bredanaar J. B. onder toezicht van de Reclassering pleegde

An MP asks the minister whether the government knew, when answering questions in October 2017, that a supervised offender had committed a rape a week before a stabbing, and whether Reclassering supervision failed, and asks about sentencing and minimum sentences. The minister denies failed supervision, says the earlier offence was unknown at the time, declines to detail the individual case, and rejects minimum sentences.
It is not appropriate for me to go into detail on an individual case.
Het past mij niet om in detail in te gaan op een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over het artikel ‘Hoe een verkrachter opnieuw kon toeslaan alle alarmsignalen ten spijt’

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about a newspaper report on a rapist who reoffended despite warning signs while under reclassering supervision, including whether reports to the reclassering were timely, why he was allowed to live with his mother despite breached conditions, and whether an independent investigation should be ordered. Minister Dekker answered that the reclassering was informed in time, that living with his mother was a justified temporary arrangement, that the reclassering's housing problem is broader and addressed via detention-reintegration plans, and that no independent investigation is warranted since the Inspectie saw no reason to investigate.

Given the information I have about the conduct of the reclassering and the other agencies involved in this case, I see no reason to characterise it as careless and to investigate the matter further (or have it investigated).

Gelet op de mij bekende informatie over het handelen van de reclassering en de andere betrokken instanties in deze casus zie ik geen aanleiding om dit als onzorgvuldig te bestempelen en de zaak nader te (laten) onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Van Nispen en Kathmann over het terughalen van ontvoerde kinderen

MPs Ellian, Van Nispen and Kathmann asked the Minister for Legal Protection about slow cooperation between central authorities in international child abduction cases, including a case of a child taken to Thailand, and what could be done to speed up return. The minister said cooperation is generally adequate, that deadlines vary by country, that the Hague Convention sets a six-week guideline, and that the Thailand case has full attention without discussing the individual case.
Without going into the individual case, I can assure you that the matter of Mr De K. has the full attention of the Central Authority.
Zonder in te gaan op de individuele casus kan ik u verzekeren dat de zaak van de heer De K. de volle aandacht van de Centrale autoriteit heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Palland over de kleinschalige detentievoorziening De Compagnie in Krimpen a/d IJssel

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the small-scale detention unit De Compagnie in Krimpen a/d IJssel, including its outcomes, funding, possible nationwide rollout and reported closure. The minister answered that it is a pilot with promising recidivism and financial indications but no full cost-benefit analysis, that its elements will be built into the BBA concept, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before informing the House after the summer recess.
I will inform your House about this after the summer recess.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover na het zomerreces informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de kritiek op de inloopkamers in de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about criticism of the new 'inloopkamers' (walk-in chambers) in the judiciary, including concerns over tunnel vision, digital-only hearings, delegation of judgment drafting to juridical staff, and reduced motivation of verdicts. The Minister defended the chambers as part of the 'Tijdige rechtspraak' programme to cut backlogs, stressing voluntary participation, experienced judges, judge responsibility for verdicts, and no need for further talks with the NVvR.
The establishment of the walk-in chamber is temporary, until 31 December 2023 at the latest.
Het instellen van de inloopkamer is tijdelijk tot uiterlijk 31 december 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de casus van een deurwaarder die loonbeslag legt in relatie tot de geest en strekking van een door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen motie

An MP asked the ministers whether a bailiff's wage garnishment over a 13-year-old 83-euro debt, despite over 800 euro already paid, conflicts with a parliamentary motion calling for improvements to responsible debt collection, and whether concrete measures would follow. The government called the case distressing, explained that interest and costs under the Civil Code can make small debts grow, said themes sessions with stakeholders are underway with papers to be sent to parliament after the summer recess, and referred to existing legislation without committing to new measures now.
Answer 3, 4: The aim of the broad debt approach is to prevent people with (problematic) debts from getting further into trouble when facing collection by public and private creditors.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 3, 4 Inzet van de brede schuldenaanpak is het voorkomen dat mensen met (problematische) schulden verder in de problemen komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vrijheid van advocaatkeuze bij rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars

An MP asked the minister whether a CJEU ruling extending free choice of lawyer under rechtsbijstand insurance, and the wide variation in insurers' maximum budgets, requires government action. The government says existing law already reflects the ruling, the AFM supervises compliance, insurers must decide how to implement it, and it will consider further research and possibly a WODC study before deciding whether minimum tariffs or other measures are needed.

After consulting the Verbond van Verzekeraars and the Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten, we will assess whether additional research is needed and, if so, ask the WODC to consider whether it fits next year's research agenda.

Wij zullen na overleg met het Verbond van Verzekeraars en de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten beoordelen of er aanvullend onderzoek nodig is en zo nodig het WODC vragen om te bezien of dit past binnen de onderzoeksagenda van volgend jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de schaderegeling voor slachtoffers in de jeugdzorg

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the minister about the compensation scheme for youth-care victims, covering rejected applications, aftercare, the asset test, debt-rescheduling claw-back and ZMOK-school placements. The minister answered in detail, explaining rejection grounds, referral to support lines, the Belastingdienst form process, Wsnp rules and why voluntary placements are excluded, while committing to no new action.
Placement via a ZMOK school does not fall under forced placement within the meaning of the scheme.
Plaatsing via een ZMOK-school valt niet onder gedwongen plaatsing in de zin van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Hijink en Leijten over het afschuiven van uitbetalingen bij letselschade door verzekeraars aan gemeenten

MPs Van Nispen, Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked about insurers redirecting injury-claim victims to municipalities for costs insurers should bear, and about slow payouts and municipal recovery of costs. The minister answered that insurers may not require victims to first go to the municipality, that victims may choose, that no fixed settlement term exists, and that municipalities are responsible for recovering costs, with no direct national role beyond pointing to a convenant option.
An insurer of the liable party may not require a victim to first approach the municipality to claim support under the Social Support Act 2015.

Een verzekeraar van de aansprakelijke partij mag niet van een slachtoffer verlangen dat hij zich eerst tot de gemeente wendt voor een beroep op ondersteuning via de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de inwerkingtreding van de Wet straffen en beschermen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the entry into force of the Wet straffen en beschermen affects leave eligibility for prisoners already detained, and whether transitional rules should protect those whose detention was postponed due to COVID. The minister confirmed the new leave rules apply immediately from 1 July 2021, with applications assessed under the regime in force at filing, and declined a transitional arrangement, citing the immediate-effect principle and administrative complexity.
Within the execution of sentences, immediate effect is the starting point, which I consider permissible for (among other things) the new re-integration leave.
Binnen de tenuitvoerlegging geldt onmiddellijke werking als uitgangspunt, hetgeen ik geoorloofd acht voor (onder meer) het nieuwe re-integratieverlof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het overgangsrecht bij de Wet straffen en beschermen

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked the Minister for Legal Protection about transitional law for the new Wet Straffen en Beschermen, including suspended inmate transfers to restricted facilities, reduced leave under the new regime, and whether prisoners who self-reported during Covid face stricter rules. The Minister defends immediate application and the 1 July 2021 start date, says DJI will clarify leave-request handling and communicate the rules, but rejects postponing or phasing in the reform.
I am aware that critical questions have been raised, for example by advocates, regarding the immediate effect and the transitional law adopted under the Wet SenB.

Ik ben bekend met het feit dat er kritische vragen zijn gesteld – door bijvoorbeeld belangenbehartigers zoals advocaten – met betrekking tot de onmiddellijke werking en het in het kader van de Wet SenB getroffen overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat duizenden medewerkers de jeugdbescherming de rug hebben toegekeerd

An MP asked the minister whether thousands of youth protection staff are leaving, with figures on departures, sick leave, workload and remedies. The minister said these figures are not centrally recorded, promised to ask providers for data and monitoring, pointed to extra funding and an upcoming exploration of the labour market problem, and noted that a future scenario for child protection is in consultation.
These figures are not centrally recorded or registered.
Deze cijfers worden niet centraal bijgehouden of geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Markuszower over kinderrechters die de noodklok luiden over de situatie van de jeugdzorg in Zeeland

PVV MPs asked whether judges' warnings that no youth care provider in Zeeland can take on court-ordered child protection cases, causing long waits, mean children are left without help, and what the government will do. The minister answers that new measures can still be assigned, but some children wait for a fixed case manager, with interim safety arrangements; a taskforce and a takeover of Intervence are underway, and the government says it will not take over regie.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for implementing youth protection and youth probation.
Gemeenten zijn conform de Jeugdwet verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van jeugdbescherming en -reclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het jaarverslag van de rechtspraak 2020 en het belang van de dialoog tussen wetgever en rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the judiciary's 2020 annual report, covering the lack of room for tailored решения in corona support laws, youth-care problems, open norms in legislation, longer court processing times, and dialogue between legislature and judiciary. The Minister acknowledged limits on tailoring in Tozo/NOW, outlined youth-care reform bills and open-norm delegation reasoning, described backlog-reduction programmes, and committed to arranging a round-table with the state powers on a standing consultation.
Together with my colleague at BZK I am currently preparing a round-table meeting between representatives of the state powers.
Met mijn ambtsgenoot van BZK bereid ik momenteel een rondetafelgesprek tussen vertegenwoordigers van de staatsmachten voor.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over het bericht dat Jehova’s Getuigen proberen gespreksverslagen te bemachtigen die zijn opgemaakt in het onderzoek naar misbruik bij de Jehova’s Getuigen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked whether the Jehovah's Witnesses' attempts to obtain interview records from a university abuse study endanger victims' anonymity and why the organisation is pursuing them. Minister Dekker answered that participants were promised confidentiality, that a privacy impact assessment was made, that he is disappointed in the organisation's legal action, and that he sees no point in discussing the requests' motives with its leadership.

The people who reported there were informed that their information is treated confidentially and that their personal data will not be shared with the Jehovah's Witnesses community or other third parties.

De personen die zich daar hebben gemeld, zijn geïnformeerd over het feit dat hun informatie vertrouwelijk wordt behandeld en dat hun persoonsgegevens niet met de gemeenschap van Jehova’s Getuigen of andere derden worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de strenge criteria voor de herziening van strafzaken

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why the Arnhem villa murder convictions, based on coerced confessions now viewed as potentially unsafe, cannot be reopened since the Supreme Court found no novum, and whether the revision criteria should be widened to cover unsafe convictions, ECJ rulings and ECHR breaches. The Minister rejects widening the novum concept, defends the Supreme Court's decision as a matter for the judiciary, and announces a bill to allow revision after an ECHR strike-out following a unilateral state declaration of violation.
I intend shortly to submit to the Advisory Division of the Council of State a legislative amendment ensuring that a final Dutch criminal conviction can also be revised

Ik ben voornemens op korte termijn aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State een wetswijziging voor te leggen die ertoe strekt te verzekeren dat een onherroepelijke Nederlandse rechterlijke veroordeling eveneens kan worden herzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de openbaarheid van de uurtarieven van de door de overheid ingehuurde advocaten

SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the hourly rates paid to lawyers hired for police officers were withheld, and asked for disclosure in line with an adopted motion. The minister refused disclosure of the rates in this case, citing harm to the law firm's competitive position and a Council of State ruling, while disclosing total costs, the number of officers and the period.
Disclosing the hourly rates could unfairly disadvantage the law firm that handled this case.
Met de openbaarmaking van de uurtarieven zou het advocatenkantoor die deze zaak heeft behandeld, onevenredig kunnen worden benadeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat het CBS toegang kreeg tot privacygevoelige locatiedata van klanten van T-Mobile

MP Buitenweg asked about reports that Statistics Netherlands (CBS) had access to sensitive location data of T-Mobile customers, raising privacy, legal basis, oversight and contracting concerns. Minister Blok answered that the Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are investigating, that CBS says it only received anonymised or aggregated data, and that CBS is an independent body the minister cannot instruct on individual contracts.
The Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are currently jointly investigating the matter as supervisors following the NRC article.
Het Agentschap Telecom en de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doen op dit moment als toezichthouders samen onderzoek naar aanleiding van het NRC-artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een uitspraak van het Gerechtshof Amsterdam over de onafhankelijkheid van advocaten bij “zelfonderzoeken” en het verschoningsrecht

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a Amsterdam Court of Appeal ruling, allowing a lawyer to invoke legal privilege while conducting an 'independent' internal fraud investigation for a client, undermines the independence of such self-investigations and whether they should be stopped. The minister replied that existing professional rules and disciplinary law sufficiently address the tension, the Bar revised its guidance, and a WODC study on self-investigations will start after summer 2021 and finish in March 2022.
As I have indicated before, the applicable professional and conduct rules and disciplinary law in my view provide sufficient means to address a possible tension between partiality and independence.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven bieden de geldende beroeps- en gedragsregels en het tuchtrecht naar mijn mening voldoende mogelijkheden om een mogelijke spanning tussen partijdigheid en onafhankelijkheid het hoofd te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over de problemen met het halen van je recht na een medische misser

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink asked about long claim-settlement times and high rejection rates for victims of medical errors, and about measures such as GOMA, a no-fault fund and a faster complaints route. The Minister of Medical Care answered that long durations are largely due to complex causation questions, that existing measures and a Chamber for long-running injury cases are being pursued, and that a no-fault fund is not supported because the Belgian experience showed little gain.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over de NOS-berichten inzake matchfixing

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked the government about rising gambling addiction during the COVID crisis, the expected effects of opening the online gambling market, and matchfixing risks. The Minister answered that addiction trends cannot be verified because the LADIS database is not operational, that the market opening on 1 October 2021 will proceed with stricter prevention rules, and outlined existing matchfixing cooperation and reporting arrangements.
Unfortunately it is not possible to determine whether the number of people with a gambling addiction seeking help has increased.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om in beeld te brengen of het aantal mensen met een gokverslaving dat zich heeft gemeld bij hulpverlening is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van der Staaij over bericht 'Fout in nieuwe gokwet zorgt voor ‘meer risico op matchfixing’, sportbonden boos'

MPs Kuik and Van der Staaij asked whether a flaw in the new online gambling law stops sports federations receiving timely matchfixing signals, and how that squares with their advisory right. The minister answered that a fast lane via FIU-Nederland and notification rules will get signals to sports bodies quickly, that no law change is needed, and that the sector's advisory role on black and white lists is maintained.
It has been agreed that a fast lane will be created at FIU-Nederland for matchfixing signals.
Afgesproken is dat voor signalen van matchfixing bij de FIU-Nederland een fast lane zal worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat een fout in de nieuwe gokwet zorgt voor meer risico op matchfixing

An MP asked whether the Wwft reporting regime (unusual transactions go to the FIU-Nederland, not directly to sports bodies) weakens sports bodies' information position on matchfixing, and what the government will do. The minister replies that event-level signals still reach the SBIU and sports bodies, that the sport's position has not worsened, and that a 'fast lane' for FIU information sharing will be set up, but rejects amending the Wwft.
All in all, I conclude that the information position of the sport has not worsened.
Ik concludeer al met al dat de informatiepositie van de sport niet slechter is geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van Kathmann over de aanpak van matchfixing

Kathmann (PvdA) asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether sports federations are right that the government lacks urgency on matchfixing, and whether a Sports Betting Intelligence Unit and better handling of Wwft reports are needed. The minister rejects the urgency criticism, points to an information coordinator pilot evaluated this summer, says the Kansspelautoriteit's role is limited to supervising licensees' detection duties, and agrees that suspicious Wwft reports must be recognisable as matchfixing signals, citing FIU powers and a planned fast lane to sports bodies.
The results of the evaluation will be shared with your House.
De resultaten van de evaluatie zullen met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Smeets over het fixen van matchfixing

MPs Van der Laan and Smeets asked about match-fixing, including how bookmakers, the FIU, the Wwft and privacy rules affect timely reporting to sports bodies, and who is responsible for what. The minister answered at length, setting out each actor's role, explaining that Wwft confidentiality can delay signals reaching sports bodies, and describing a planned 'fast lane' at the FIU to be evaluated after a year.
To prevent possible delay, it has been agreed with the sports federations that a so-called fast lane will be set up at the FIU-Netherlands for signals of possible match-fixing.
Om mogelijke vertraging te voorkomen is speciaal voor signalen van mogelijke matchfixing met de sportbonden afgesproken dat bij de FIU-Nederland een zogeheten fast lane zal worden vorm gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Groothuizen en Verhoeven over de intimidatie van historicus Nadia Bouras

MPs from D66 asked the Justice and Security minister how the government views intimidation of historian Nadia Bouras by the anonymous group Vizier op Links, whether doxing should be tackled specifically, whether the Trade Register should better protect addresses of entrepreneurs, and whether platforms should bear more responsibility. The minister condemned the intimidation, said police and the Public Prosecution Service have tools, that a criminal-law option for doxing is being explored, that a proposal to shield sole-trader home addresses is in preparation, and that he intends further agreements with platforms.
I will examine this together with the internet bullying policy framework that has been developed and whose various steps are currently being implemented.
Ik ga dit onderzoeken in samenhang met het beleidskader internetpesten dat is ontwikkeld en waarvan de verschillende stappen momenteel worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian inzake de limiet aan de lengte van processtukken

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the new caps on the length of court briefs set by the appeals courts and about the lawyers' summary proceedings challenging them, including whether the profession was consulted and whether the rule must be set by statute. The Minister said the courts set procedural rules themselves, that the dispute is for the judge and the parties, and that he sees no active role for himself in resolving it.
Setting procedural rules is a power of the court administrations.
Het vaststellen van procesreglementen is een bevoegdheid van gerechtsbesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Ellian over het bericht 'Universiteiten delen zonder toestemming persoonsgegevens met CBS'

MPs Van der Woude and Ellian asked whether universities sharing staff personal data with Statistics Netherlands (CBS) for the Barometer Culturele Diversiteit, which infers migration background from data, complies with the motion on not recording ethnic background and with GDPR rules. The minister answered that universities do not record ethnic or migration background, rely on legitimate interest rather than consent, did no DPIA or prior consultation, and sees no reason to ask universities not to participate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de screening van justitiële zorginstellingen

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the procurement of forensic care, including the use of an open house procedure, providers rejected elsewhere still being contracted, and whether market competition is desirable. The minister says DJI contracts 180 providers, admits some providers raise quality concerns requiring intensive contract management, promises a new procurement system and quality framework, and defers the motion reply to a forthcoming letter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een daling van het aantal sociaal advocaten en de kerncijfers van de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand 2020

The MP asks whether 2020 saw the largest ever drop in social lawyers, why the number of legal aid grants and Wsnp admissions fell, and what the Juridisch Loket's 19% drop in contacts means. The minister answers that active social lawyers fell 5.1% in 2020, attributes limited significance to the macro figures, promises a monitoring programme and a fuller progress report in July, and sees no need for acute measures.
Based on the current picture of the figures, I see no need for acute measures at this time.
Op grond van het huidige beeld van de cijfers zie ik thans geen noodzaak voor acute maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het artikel 'Afgewezen zorgaanbieders glippen weer binnen via de achterdeur'

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers why DJI contracted and extended Stichting OnderDak after an inspectorate found insufficient oversight, and how information-sharing between care purchasers is restricted. The minister answered that DJI knew of the inspection findings, intensified contract management, and pointed to a pending bill and the inspectorate's oversight limits.
The Public Prosecution Service, in the interest of a possible criminal investigation, does not comment on whether a criminal investigation is being conducted in a specific case.

Het Openbaar Ministerie doet in het belang van een eventueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek geen uitspraak over de vraag of in een specifiek geval al dan niet een strafrechtelijk onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de uitvoering van toezeggingen en moties van het notaoverleg 'In Nederland beslis je over je eigen leven'

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers about implementation of motions and commitments on honour-related violence, forced marriage protection, female genital mutilation registration and the possible criminalisation of hymen restoration. The State Secretary replied that the government is following up on these motions through action programmes, investigations and working groups, with most results promised in later progress letters.
I informed your House on 18 March 2021 about the progress of the action agenda on harmful practices.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 18 maart 2021 geïnformeerd over de voortgang van de actieagenda schadelijke praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Lagere straffen slijterij-moord'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that appellate courts reduced sentences for a murder-related case because the prosecution and courts exceeded the reasonable time limit, and asked about sentencing norms, data on sentence reductions and whether murderers are being 'rewarded' for delays. The minister confirmed the overrun, explained the Supreme Court's sentence-reduction framework, said the judiciary does not register such reductions so no quarterly data will be shared, and stated the judiciary is working to clear backlogs.
The Judiciary and the Public Prosecution Service do not keep records of exceedances of the reasonable time limit and of the consequences attached to them in a specific criminal case.
De Rechtspraak en het Openbaar Ministerie houden geen registratie bij van overschrijdingen van de redelijke termijn en de gevolgen die daaraan in een specifieke strafzaak zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de kritiek op peperdure advocaten van politieagenten en de onderbetaling van sociaal advocaten

Van Nispen (SP) asks why the police paid about 1.3 million euros in lawyers' fees to defend officers in one case, whether those rates are justified, and why legal aid lawyers are underpaid. The ministers say the fees cover 26 officers over about three years, reflect market rates, and that the state is a paying client; they also outline a plan to increase legal aid fees and a structural reform programme.

Disclosure of information may be withheld to the extent that the interest does not outweigh the interest in avoiding undue advantage or disadvantage to natural or legal persons involved or third parties.

Openbaarmaking van gegevens mag achterwege blijven voor zover het belang niet opweegt tegen het belang van onevenredige bevoordeling of benadeling van bij de aangelegenheid betrokken natuurlijke personen of rechtspersonen danwel derden

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over grootschalige en onrechtmatige verzameling van data van burgers door de krijgsmacht, de politie, de Belastingdienst, de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten en andere overhei

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about large-scale and unlawful data collection on citizens by the armed forces (LIMC), police systems, UWV (SONAR), the Tax Service, and COA-police data sharing, including whether these comply with GDPR and oversight rules. The ministers acknowledged shortcomings, described remediation steps such as stopping LIMC collection pending an internal review, phasing out SONAR, and ending COA data sharing, while deferring some matters to ongoing investigations and to a future cabinet on AP funding.
If it turns out that government organisations are not or insufficiently able to do so, the cabinet will discuss this with the relevant body.
Indien blijkt dat overheidsorganisaties hier niet of onvoldoende toe in staat zijn, dan gaat het kabinet hierover met het desbetreffende onderdeel in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over recente ontwikkelingen in Polen

An MP asks the ministers about recent concerns over judicial independence and media freedom in Poland, the effectiveness of Article 7 procedures, the Rule of Law report, infringement actions, Article 259 TFEU, and the Rule of Law budget conditionality regulation. The government answers that it shares the concerns, will keep monitoring, supports the infringement actions and civil society, and that Article 259 is not yet relevant while the Commission is acting.
The government is concerned about the erosion of the rule of law in Poland and continuously follows developments regarding the judiciary and media freedom.
Het kabinet is bezorgd is over de erosie van de rechtsstaat in Polen en volgt in dat kader voortdurend de ontwikkelingen rondom de rechterlijke macht en vrijheid van media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de detentiefasering onder de Wet straffen en beschermen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about replacing (Z)BBI prisons with Beperkt Beveiligde Afdelingen (BBA) under the Wet straffen en beschermen, its effects, timing and admission criteria. The minister confirmed the BBA replacement, said BBAs will be introduced on entry into force with the date subject to a second gateway review, and set out criteria tied to extramural work, with alternative re-integration routes for those who cannot work.
On entry into force, the BBAs will be introduced immediately.
Bij inwerkingtreding worden de BBA's onmiddellijk ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een explosieve toename hacks en datadiefstal

MP Kuiken asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the sharp rise in hacking and data theft, whether it leads to fraud, whether organisations handle personal data carefully, and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) lacks capacity to act on breaches. The minister confirmed the rise, said the link to specific fraud cannot be traced, attributed carelessness partly to awareness, and stated that AP capacity is a matter of reprioritisation and that budget increases must wait for a new cabinet.
It is not possible to state whether the failure to act on reported data breaches is due to a lack of capacity.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven of het niet oppakken van gemelde datalekken te wijten is aan capaciteitsgebrek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens de noodklok luidt om de stijging van het aantal hacks bij datalekken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the reported rise in hacks, phishing and malware breaches, the government's rising misdirected-data incidents, whether the AP and police have enough capacity to investigate, how many reports led to prosecution, and whether multi-factor authentication should become the norm. The minister acknowledged the trends, said the AP's role is supervision not cybercrime investigation and that capacity is still being assessed, gave police staffing figures, could not link breach reports to prosecutions, and said multi-factor authentication is advised but not mandated.
It is therefore not possible to establish which reports to the AP led to investigation and/or prosecution.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om vast te stellen welke meldingen bij de AP hebben geleid tot opsporing en/of vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Asielzoekers (14, 15 en 16) aangehouden na gewelddadige inbraak Oisterwijk’

PVV MPs asked whether juveniles aged 14-16 who commit serious crimes should always be tried under adult criminal law, for statistics on asylum-seeking minors suspected of crimes, for expulsion of convicted asylum seekers and their families, and for closing borders and asylum centres. The State Secretary replied that the juvenile justice system is sufficiently equipped, promised a conference on maximum penalties, said data for 2015-2017 would require detailed research and 2020 figures will appear in the Staat van Migratie, stated that return will be pursued where grounds exist (without discussing individual files), and rejected closing borders as unrealistic.
Of course, due to the Personal Data Protection Act I cannot go into the individual files.
Natuurlijk kan ik vanwege de wet bescherming persoonsgegevens niet in gaan op de individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Jong over de boete die is opgelegd aan Stichting SIGNI Zoekhonden

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers why a EUR 4,800 fine was imposed on the volunteer search foundation SIGNI Zoekhonden under working conditions rules and whether it would be withdrawn or the rules changed. Minister Koolmees answered that the fine concerns diver safety rules, that the objection procedure is ongoing and proportionality will be reassessed, that the fine has been paid, and that he is willing to discuss the rules with the foundation but will not change them now.
In the Inspectorate SZW's judgment the foundation initially provided insufficient evidence, so there was no reason to reduce the fine.
Naar het oordeel van de Inspectie SZW heeft de stichting initieel onvoldoende bewijs aangeleverd, waardoor geen reden bestond om de boete te matigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Dam over wachttijden bij het opvolgen van aangiftes over verkrachtingen

MPs Buitenweg and Van Dam asked about long waiting times before police act on rape reports, including delays in questioning suspects, whether this weakens prosecution, and whether victims are advised to stay silent during investigations. The Minister acknowledged high workloads and 798 open cases over six months, outlined extra capacity funding and a six-month target, and said victims are heard quickly to limit influence and support referral.
The police are working hard to improve the performance of the vice squad's duties.
De politie werkt hard aan verbetering in de taakuitvoering van de zedenpolitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de wenselijkheid van de legitieme portie in het hedendaagse erfrecht

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the desirability of the forced heirship portion (legitieme portie) in modern inheritance law, citing a CNR/Netwerk Notarissen report and related surveys, including its effect on estranged parents, elder financial abuse, and abolition elsewhere in the Kingdom. The minister acknowledged the report as a contribution to ongoing debate, defended testamentary freedom as a principle balanced against family ties, stated that the portion is not a suitable anti-abuse tool but has preventive value, and declined to commit to revising the law given the caretaker cabinet, leaving any decision to a future cabinet.

Given the various partly principled legal convictions underlying the forced heirship portion, and the further weighing this requires, it is not obvious, partly in view of the caretaker status of the current cabinet, to decide now on revising the current legislation on the forced heirship portion.

Gelet op de verschillende deels principiële rechtsovertuigingen die aan de legitieme portie ten grondslag liggen, en de nadere afweging die een en ander vergt, ligt het – mede gezien de demissionaire status van het huidige kabinet – niet voor de hand om op dit moment te beslissen over herziening van de huidige wetgeving inzake de legitieme portie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over toezicht op grondspeculanten

An MP asked ministers about oversight of land speculators, notaries' duties, AFM supervision and fragmentation of land ownership after reports of disputes over dubious land deals. The government answered that existing consumer law, notarial duties and AFM rules apply, that no new oversight is needed, and that the Wet beleggingsobjecten decision is left to the next cabinet.

From the statutory framework and the professional body's regulations in general, and from the disciplinary procedure in particular, it cannot be inferred that the role of notaries (in general) in pointing out risks in land transactions needs improvement.

Uit de wettelijke regeling en de verordeningen van de beroepsorganisatie in het algemeen en uit de tuchtprocedure in het bijzonder valt dan ook niet te herleiden dat de rol van notarissen (in het algemeen) bij het wijzen op risico's bij grondtransacties verbetering behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sneller en Schonis over het bericht 'Particuliere beleggers slepen notarissen voor de rechter vanwege rol in dubieuze grondhandel'

MPs asked whether land speculation rules changed since 2019, whether notaries adequately protect private investors, and how buyers are protected against speculators. The minister replied that no relevant legislative changes occurred, that fragmentation is limited (about 0.13% of farmland), that notaries' independence rules and disciplinary oversight apply, and that consumer protection and AFM oversight exist, promising a further answer.
Since May 2019 there have been no legislative amendments aimed at bringing land positions under AFM supervision or at countering land speculation.
Sinds mei 2019 zijn geen wetswijzigingen geweest die erop gericht waren grondposities onder het AFM-toezicht te brengen of gericht waren op het tegengaan van grondspeculatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over illegale aanbieders van kansspelen op afstand

MPs Van Nispen asked about the start of the Dutch online gambling law, abuse of legal operators' trademarks by illegal advertisers, a Kindred director's comments on using player databases, and Ksa enforcement capacity. The minister answered that the law takes effect 1 April with licences from 1 October, that the Ksa tackles illegal offers via platform agreements and new powers, that operators must wait about two years nine months before licensing and may not use player data for marketing, and that enforcement capacity will be expanded from summer.
From the summer, enforcement capacity will also be expanded so these powers can be used effectively.
Vanaf de zomer zal ook de handhavingscapaciteit worden uitgebreid om deze bevoegdheden effectief te kunnen inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over illegale aanbieders van online kansspelen die mogelijk in aanmerking willen komen voor een vergunning

MP Kuiken asks whether illegal online gambling operators who have operated since 2019 may obtain a licence, citing the Kansspelautoriteit report estimating a 400 million euro market mostly illegal, and invokes earlier motions. The Minister says applicants' past illegal conduct is weighed on reliability, a two-year good-conduct period applies per the Postema motion, and the Ksa applies a policy rule with criteria assessed over two years and nine months before application.
An operator that has in the past actively offered illegally can remove doubt about its reliability by showing good conduct over a continuous period before the licence application.

Een aanbieder die in het verleden actief illegaal heeft aangeboden kan de twijfel over zijn betrouwbaarheid wegnemen door gedurende een aaneengesloten periode voorafgaand aan de vergunningaanvraag goed gedrag te laten zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Van Nispen over onderwijs in het gevangeniswezen

MPs Van den Berge and Van Nispen asked whether education in detention has been cut, whether only basic education and arbeid-focused programmes remain, and whether 2 hours weekly of education meets international norms. The Minister replied that education has not been cut since 2015, that 4 hours weekly are available for education, re-integration and meaning-making, that no data is kept on hours per activity, and that Dutch practice complies with the European Prison Rules and Mandela Rules.
No data is kept on how many hours are spent on education within the 4 hours available for education, re-integration and meaning-making.
Er worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over hoeveel uur wordt besteed aan onderwijs, als onderdeel van de beschikbare 4 uur voor ORZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Tbs met dwangverpleging geëist tegen moordenaar van Rik van de Rakt

MP Markuszower asks why the Public Prosecution Service demanded a treatment order rather than prison for the killer of 18-year-old Rik van de Rakt, whether officials who failed should be dismissed, and whether minimum sentences should be introduced. The minister replies that the prosecution is independent, that TBS aims at treatment and safe reintegration, that the municipality's inquiry found information was shared within legal limits, that various reforms have been implemented, and that minimum sentences are rejected to protect judicial discretion.
The Public Prosecution Service is independent in determining the sentencing demand in criminal cases.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (hierna: OM) is onafhankelijk in het bepalen van de strafeis in strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Nederlandse spermadonor verwekt 200 kinderen en adverteert ermee op social media’

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about a Dutch sperm donor reportedly fathering around 200 children and advertising on social media, and about regulating multi-donor practices domestically and abroad. The Minister of Health answered that private donation falls outside government control, pointed to clinic rules and the planned Wdkb amendment capping donations at 12 families, and said no registration or international agreement is feasible for private arrangements.
Outside the clinics and the Sdkb, there is no visibility into the number of so-called multi-sperm donors active in the Netherlands or abroad.
Buiten de klinieken en de Sdkb om is er geen zicht op het aantal zogenaamde multi-spermadonoren dat actief is in Nederland of in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een gratis consult bij een OM-strafbeschikking

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a free lawyer consultation for people facing OM penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen) in corona cases has not yet been introduced, and why it took months when cases were quickly shifted to penalty orders. The minister replied that the free consult will start on 1 April 2021 for cases with an OM hearing, with the rest following once the CJIB adjusts its systems, and that the delay reflects the time needed to adapt ICT and work processes.
On 1 April the standard consultation will start being offered to suspects who are heard by the OM before the penalty order.
Op 1 april zal worden gestart met het aanbieden van het standaard consult aan de verdachten die voorafgaand aan de strafbeschikking door het OM worden gehoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma and Van Nispen asked whether the government would make a humanitarian request for transfer of Mr Singh's sentence to the Netherlands, given his health and the failure of earlier clemency requests, and why it rejects the WOTS transfer procedure and continuing enforcement. The minister replied that transfer is not a humanitarian instrument, that the government is diplomatically supporting a clemency request instead, and that it sees no room for a WOTS request because of the lack of remaining sentence and binding to the Netherlands.

In my letter to the House of 21 September 2020, responding to the motion by Van Nispen et al., I indicated why I see no room for a request to the American authorities to transfer enforcement of his sentence to the Netherlands.

In mijn brief aan uw Kamer d.d. 21 september 2020, in reactie op de motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s., heb ik aangegeven waarom ik geen ruimte zie voor een verzoek aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten tot overdracht van de tenuitvoerlegging van zijn straf aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van de leden Groothuizen, Van Dam en Buitenweg over de rechtsstaat in Polen en de gevolgen voor Nederland

MPs Groothuizen, Van Dam and Buitenweg asked the government about media pluralism and press freedom in Poland, press lawsuits, EU tools, Polish asylum claims under the Aznar protocol, free movement, and detained Polish suspects after extradition suspensions. The government answered at length, largely describing EU monitoring frameworks, noting the limits of EU instruments, declining to provide asylum-motive statistics, and reporting that no one is held in Dutch detention solely due to the suspension.
The cabinet is not aware that Polish citizens are currently experiencing problems exercising their right to free movement in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet is er niet mee bekend dat Poolse burgers momenteel problemen ondervinden bij het uitoefenen van hun recht op vrij verkeer in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de dwang op commerciële advocatuur om gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand te gaan verlenen

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why commercial lawyers should be compelled to provide subsidised legal aid, questioning the plan's planning, its effect on legal aid quality, and whom it benefits. The Minister says he will seek a less voluntary contribution from commercial firms, citing existing initiatives and possible forms such as shared infrastructure, expertise, internships or a fund, and rejects withdrawing the plan.
With a less voluntary approach I want to ensure that commercial lawyers contribute more than they do now to legal aid for less well-off and often vulnerable legal seekers.

Met een minder vrijblijvende aanpak wil ik bewerkstelligen dat commerciële advocaten meer dan nu het geval is hun steentje gaan bijdragen ten behoeve van de rechtshulp aan minder draagkrachtige en vaak ook kwetsbare rechtzoekenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de wenselijkheid van vermenging van accountancy en advocatuur

MP Van Nispen asked the Finance and Justice ministers whether accountancy firms offering legal services and combining audit with advisory work is desirable, and whether the law permits it. The ministers answered that the two professions serve different interests, that the audit-advisory separation rules and professional codes constrain such combinations, and that they will monitor developments and examine the Cta and Kwartiermakers' structural alternatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ''Zorgen om gokkende jeugd: 'Toto zoekt rand op''

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Toto (Nederlandse Loterij) gambling advertising reaching young people, the age restriction in the draft decree, and the societal costs of gambling addiction. The minister mostly defers to the Kansspelautoriteit and Lotto B.V., states that advertising rules already bar targeting under-25s, notes data on addiction costs is currently unavailable, and says the State Secretary will discuss the Toto ads with Nederlandse Loterij.
It is up to Lotto B.V. whether it wishes to make the research results public.
Het is aan Lotto B.V. of ze de onderzoeksresultaten openbaar wil maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over beslaglegging op compensatie door de Belastingdienst

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked whether debt-relief trustees can seize compensation paid to childcare-benefit scandal victims after a WSNP debt-rescheduling period ends, and whether a seizure ban will be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledged the undesirable effect, said talks with public and private creditors are ongoing, committed to public creditors waiving claims, and promised certificates clearing victims of past fraud or intent labels.
That is why I am in talks with creditors and other parties to reach a solution that does justice to the various interests.
Daarom ben ik in gesprek met schuldeisers en betrokken partijen om te komen tot een oplossing die recht doet aan de verschillende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de coronabesmettingen in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the rise in COVID-19 infections in Dutch prisons, including the outbreak at PI Ter Apel, and about measures on staff working from home, masks, shared cells, testing, Skype access and vaccination priority. The minister answered that DJI follows RIVM guidelines plus extra measures, admitted that Ter Apel did not fully keep to the internal group-size rule, and committed to sending the OMT advice to parliament.
From the start, the priority of PI Ter Apel has been to keep the virus outside the walls.
Vanaf het begin is het de prioriteit van de PI Ter Apel geweest om het virus buiten de muren te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van den Hul en Van der Graaf over emotionele verwaarlozing en huiselijk geweld als gevolg van de lockdown

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the government about a Leiden study showing more emotional neglect and domestic violence during the lockdown, why official reporting figures did not show the same rise, how professionals and schools can support vulnerable families, and how the findings should inform policy. The state secretary answered that the government is aware of the study, monitors reporting trends through CBS and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, points to helplines and support tools, and agrees the school closures' effects on vulnerable families must be weighed, while stating that secondary schools cannot reopen yet.
We therefore, together with these organisations, closely monitor the (numerical) developments currently and also in the coming period.
Wij houden daarom samen met deze organisaties de (cijfermatige) ontwikkelingen momenteel en ook de komende tijd nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de schaderegeling voor slachtoffers in de jeugdzorg

Westerveld asked why the Schadefonds website still said it was unknown whether the compensation affects benefits, why it should be listed in tax returns, how many claims were filed, how elderly victims can apply, how victims are informed, and for an update on funding a memorial. The minister answered that the compensation does not count as income or assets for benefits and allowances, claims stood at about 1,900, the fund supports applications by proxy and by post, victims are actively informed, and up to 160,000 euros will be subsidised for the memorial.
Victims can ask the Tax Administration/Allowances to disregard this compensation of 5,000 euros for the assets test.
Slachtoffers kunnen bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen verzoeken deze tegemoetkoming van € 5.000,- buiten beschouwing te laten voor de vermogenstoets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Gevangenis Vught verdacht van financiering terrorisme'

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked how the Vught prison could transfer money to convicted terrorist Mohammed D., whether staff should be disciplined, and whether terrorist prisoners should be denied purchases and any money. The Minister says a 2019 exemption from the terrorism sanctions regime allows limited payments for prisoners, that the Public Prosecution Service investigates possible violations, and that he sees no need for a full structural restriction; he declines to comment on Mohammed D.'s individual case.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de dwangsom van de ACM aan commerciële bemiddelingswebsites

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the minister why the government did not act earlier against commercial websites charging extra for VOG certificates, and whether rules should be tightened or other ministries asked to act. The minister answered that Justis and the ACM have taken action, that intermediaries cannot be obliged to inform consumers of the free route, and that the ACM enforces unfair trading practices.
I will continue to follow developments surrounding the intermediary websites for VOG applications.
Ik blijf de ontwikkelingen rondom de bemiddelingswebsites voor VOG aanvragen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over misstanden bij adoptie en verjaringsproblematiek

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Zembla revelations of irregularities in intercountry adoptions, whether ministries knew, how the adoption-limitation motion will be implemented, how many cases are pending against the state, and whether the state will stop invoking limitation. The minister replied that a commission (COIA) is investigating, its report is expected in February 2021, and a full reaction including the motion will follow; three civil cases are pending and the limitation question will be addressed later.
I will send you a response after receiving the report.
Ik zal na ontvangst van het rapport een reactie aan u doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de second opinion voor nabestaanden

MP Van Nispen asked about the second opinion pilot for bereaved relatives at the Openbaar Ministerie, whether treatment of relatives has improved, and whether relatives and their experts can get a second inspection of the police file. The minister said the pilot ended in December 2020 and will be reported in the spring 2021 letter, that the OM is open to a second file inspection in principle, but experts' access is decided case by case.
The Public Prosecution Service in principle deals generously with requests for inspection from relatives.
Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat in beginsel ruimhartig om met verzoeken tot inzage van nabestaanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Toorenburg over kinderen die onterecht uit huis worden geplaatst door slecht feitenonderzoek

MPs Peters and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether children are wrongly removed from their homes due to poor fact-finding by youth care workers and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and what measures will prevent this. The minister replied that the statutory duty to report facts fully and truthfully applies, that an Action Plan to improve fact-finding is under way through 2021, and that existing checks (RvdK independence, judicial review, appeal) are sufficient, so no new measures are needed.
Based on the above, I am of the view that the current system already contains sufficient safeguards to address the problem you describe.
Op basis van het bovenstaande ben ik van mening dat het huidige systeem reeds voldoende waarborgen bevat om het door u geschetste probleem te ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Meer dan 160 enkelbanden uit de lucht door netwerkstoring’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a network outage that took over 160 ankle monitors offline, including whether wearers knew, whether offenders were among them, whether sabotage or crimes occurred, and whether the ankle monitor should be abolished. The minister explained that wearers are not alerted, that location data is stored during outages, that no sabotage or violations were recorded, and that new dual-SIM bands are being rolled out by May 2021.
Answering this question precisely would require case-file research for each ankle monitor wearer, involving several organisations, to retrieve this data.
Het precies beantwoorden van deze vraag zou per enkelbanddrager dossieronderzoek vergen, waarbij meerdere organisaties betrokken zijn, om deze gegevens te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Wijngaarden over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad inzake het inreisverbod

MPs Becker and Van Wijngaarden asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Supreme Court ruling on entry bans, the use of criminal prosecution under article 197 Sr for illegal residents, detention and reception of those with bans, and the relation to unwanted-person declarations. The State Secretary answered that prosecutions have sharply declined pending a Court of Justice ruling, gave approximate figures (about 10 people detained), explained the return procedure and reception policy, and referred to earlier letters for further detail.
It is not possible to give a precise picture of how many foreigners reside unlawfully in the Netherlands and therefore also not how many of them have an entry ban.
Het is niet mogelijk een precies beeld te geven van hoeveel vreemdelingen onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus ook niet hoeveel van hen een inreisverbod hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Peters over het nodeloos procederen van overheidsinstanties

MPs Van Dam and Peters asked the Minister for Legal Protection about unnecessary litigation by government agencies, notably UWV's pattern of filing provisional appeals and withdrawing them, leaving citizens unable to recover legal costs in administrative law. The minister acknowledged the problem, said UWV will discuss compensation with the affected party and that the ministry will examine whether legislative change is needed, but did not commit to creating a statutory basis for cost compensation now.
It is my intention to examine how this problem can be addressed and whether changes to laws and regulations are necessary for this.
Het is mijn voornemen te onderzoeken hoe deze problematiek kan worden ondervangen en of wijziging van wet- en regelgeving hiervoor noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake de wettelijk verankering van de Code zaakstoedeling

Van Nispen (SP) asked why the case-allocation code (Code zaakstoedeling) for courts was not anchored in statute following the ECtHR Miracle Europe judgment, and whether allocation must be random and transparent. Minister Dekker replied that the judgment does not require statutory codification, that the code's criteria for non-random allocation are objective enough, and that no further legal anchoring is needed.
A further statutory anchoring is not necessary in my view, as I explained in the answer to questions 2 and 3.
Een nadere wettelijke verankering acht ik niet noodzakelijk, zoals ik heb toegelicht in het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over de berichtgeving m.b.t. coronabesmettingen binnen het gevangeniswezen: 'Corona in gevangenis: 84 gedetineerden in quarantaine'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about COVID-19 infections in prisons, including 84 detainees quarantined at PI Roermond, prisoners not being allowed to wear masks, a Complaints Commission ruling against the PI Heerhugowaard directorate, and video-call problems. The minister confirmed the infections and said masks are generally not worn by detainees for order and security reasons, while noting that other measures apply and that the matter is under advisory review and pending appeals.
Information on infections among staff cannot be shared with you, as it may not be recorded.
Informatie over besmettingen onder personeel kan ik niet met u delen aangezien dit niet vastgelegd mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over kinderalimentatie

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about child maintenance: whether income changes can only be adjusted with mutual consent or a court, whether LBIO should review incomes periodically, whether recipients should account for spending, and how child benefit and the child-related budget create inequality. The minister answered that ex-partners should first agree between themselves, that courts remain available, that LBIO should not gain a review power, that periodic accounting is undesirable, and that the Belastingdienst is raising awareness, while rejecting a binding dispute committee.
I therefore see little added value in establishing a dispute committee for maintenance cases, certainly not given the downward trend in the number of court cases.
Ik zie dan ook weinig toegevoegde waarde in het instellen van een geschillencommissie voor alimentatiezaken, zeker niet gezien de dalende trend van het aantal rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de tegemoetkomingsregeling voor sociale advocatuur

MP Van Nispen asks why a COVID-19 compensation scheme for social lawyers is expected to be barely used and whether its budget, drawn from legal aid underspending, will benefit social lawyers; he also asks about repayment terms for advance payments and monitoring of lawyers' income. The Minister answers that the scheme was a safety net, the April 2020 drop in legal aid grants has largely recovered, unused funds go to the legal aid system, and the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand can extend repayment terms case by case.
The Raad voor Rechtsbijstand will therefore decide in individual cases on spreading the repayment of the advance over a longer period if the lawyer or mediator invokes this.

De Raad voor Rechtsbijstand zal daarom in individuele gevallen op grond van eerder genoemd artikel een beslissing nemen omtrent de verrekening van het voorschot over een langere periode indien daar door de advocaat of mediator een beroep op wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verrekenen van proceskosten met schulden van schuldenaars ten koste van rechtsbijstandsverleners

MP Van Nispen asked whether courts' rulings and municipal practice allow winning parties' costs awards to be set off against their debts, harming legal aid lawyers and access to justice. The Minister answered that such set-off is a widespread legal tool aimed at reducing citizens' debts, that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand applies a hardship clause protecting lawyers' fees, and that the amount involved cannot be determined.
It is therefore not possible to determine how much money that would involve.
Het is dus niet te achterhalen om hoeveel geld dat zou gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Meerdere OMT-leden bedreigd en thuis opgezocht'

MPs Groothuizen and Van Toorenburg asked the government about reports that several OMT members were threatened and visited at home, and about protection, public address data and doxing. Minister Grapperhaus said threats are unacceptable, police are investigating, protective measures are available where needed, and the address-shielding and doxing policy work is ongoing.
As your House knows, I cannot go into further detail on ongoing matters.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan ik over lopende zaken niet verder in detail treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over sluiten van jeugdzorginstelling Intervence

An MP asks the State Secretary and Minister whether they accept the closure of youth care provider Intervence in Zeeland, whether the timeline is feasible, what happens to children and staff, and what the government will do about financial mismanagement and its own role. The government answers that municipalities chose to split Intervence's youth protection work among three other providers, that care continues until transfers are complete, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and inspectorates must approve a transition plan before any irreversible steps, with the government promising interbestuurlijk toezicht if continuity is not assured.

If, according to the JA and the inspectorates, the continuity and quality of care are not secured, we will hold the municipalities to account and, where necessary, take measures within the framework of interadministrative supervision.

Als de continuïteit en kwaliteit van zorg volgens de JA en de inspecties niet geborgd is, zullen wij de gemeenten daarop aanspreken en zo nodig maatregelen treffen in het kader van het interbestuurlijk toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Verhoeven over het gebruik van discriminerende algoritmes en massasurveillance door de politie

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about predictive policing, the Roermond Sensing trial against mobile banditry, privacy and discrimination safeguards, and Amnesty's criticism. The minister replied that the trial is not predictive policing, that profiles and human officer decisions limit discrimination risks, and rejected stopping the project while noting it is now largely inactive.
The Roermond Operational Testing Ground (OPTR) does not use predictive policing.
De Operationele Proeftuin Roermond (OPTR) maakt geen gebruik van «predictive policing».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over het bericht 'Ernstige zorgen over het verdwijnen van ‘de Zeeuwse IC op het gebied van jeugdzorg’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the Zeeland child-protection provider Intervence is being closed by 1 January 2021, whether children and families can be safely transferred, and whether the government is responsible. The government answers that municipalities chose the scenario, that no irreversible steps will be taken until an inspectorate-approved transition plan exists, and that tariff and personnel issues are being addressed.
The proposed decision by the municipalities has a far-reaching impact on the children and their relatives, the Intervence staff and all parties involved in Zeeland.
Het voorgenomen besluit van gemeenten is ingrijpend voor de kinderen en hun naasten, de medewerkers van Intervence en alle betrokken partijen in Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de inwerkingtreding van de Wet straffen en beschermen en de uitvoering van de Wet USB

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the planned 1 May 2021 start of the Wet straffen en beschermen, the preparations and a Gateway review, and the division of execution tasks between the OM and AICE under the Wet USB, including local supervision of conditional sentences. The minister answered that the start date is still targeted, that a review found steps still needed, that the OM retains several execution tasks with a transfer planned later, and that local contacts are adequately secured.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een forensische zorginstelling moet stoppen met Tbs-behandelingen, omdat zij de financiën niet meer rond krijgt

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether he would act after reports that a forensic care clinic must stop TBS treatment due to financial problems, and whether tariffs should differentiate by actual costs such as housing, and how to curb self-employment in forensic care. The minister said he does not recognise the claim that TBS treatment is generally loss-making, that NZa tariffs (with up to 10% above the maximum) remain leading, and that the Taskforce Forensische Zorg is addressing labour market issues.
I do not recognise this picture. I have no signals that the treatment of these patients is in many cases loss-making.
Ik herken dit beeld niet. Ik heb namelijk geen signalen dat de behandeling van deze patiënten in veel gevallen verlieslatend zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de financiële problemen bij de Geschillencommissie

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the Geschillencommissie's subsidy request of 7 July 2020 had not been answered, whether its closure would harm consumers and courts, and how its survival would be secured. The Minister said he would decide shortly after hearing the SGC, reaffirmed that the SGC's survival must not be endangered, and that he remains in contact with it.
A decision on the SGC's subsidy request will be taken in the short term.
Op korte termijn zal een besluit op het subsidieverzoek van de SGC worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Dam en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Poland’s National Public Prosecutor is going to war with the Netherlands’

MPs Van Dam and Omtzigt asked the government about a Polish National Prosecutor instruction to find grounds to refuse Dutch European arrest warrants, its link to the Amsterdam court's suspension of Polish surrenders, and possible responses. The minister said the instruction is worrying and conflicts with mutual trust, that the Netherlands is not violating EU law, that the Dutch judiciary's independence is not in doubt, and that the government will raise the matter with the Commission and in bilateral and EU channels.
It is a worrying signal that the Polish National Prosecutor instructs Polish prosecutors to search for grounds to refuse Dutch surrender requests.

Het is een verontrustend signaal dat de Poolse nationale aanklager aan Poolse officieren van justitie een opdracht geeft om op zoek te gaan naar gronden om Nederlandse overleveringsverzoeken te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over waarom de zorgbonus niet wordt uitgekeerd aan zorgverleners die werkzaam zijn in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asked the Ministers for Medical Care and Legal Protection why prison and forensic (TBS) healthcare staff are excluded from the COVID-19 care bonus, whether 1.5 metre distancing can be guaranteed there, and whether the exclusion should be lifted. The government answered that DJI follows RIVM guidance with extra measures where distancing is impossible, and that the bonus scheme does not cover DJI, which instead must apply the CAO Rijk extra-reward framework at managers' discretion.
DJI falls outside the scope of the bonus scheme, so no subsidy application for a bonus can be submitted for DJI staff.
DJI valt niet onder de werkingssfeer van de bonusregeling, zodat voor personeel werkzaam bij DJI geen subsidieaanvraag voor een bonus kan worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de documentaire ‘De laatste sociaal advocaten’

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection, after a documentary on the last social lawyers, about low legal-aid fees, shrinking lawyer numbers, risks to access to justice, and why the Van der Meer report's fee problem was not fixed. The minister answers that the legal-aid system is being renewed within existing budget limits, a temporary fee supplement applies in 2020–2021, and the new system should be fully in force by 2025.
With the combined measures of the system renewal we are aiming for better remuneration for lawyers and mediators working in the system.
Met de gecombineerde maatregelen van de stelselvernieuwing zetten we in op een betere vergoeding voor advocaten en mediators die in het stelsel werkzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Woedeaanval terrorismeverdachte leidt tot 30.000 euro schade in gevangenis’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about a terror suspect's rampage causing about 30,000 euro damage at PI Vught, whether he should pay for it, incident counts, disciplinary sanctions, and whether complaints were filed against him and Mohammed Bouyeri. The minister confirmed the facts, said the suspect should bear the damage, gave incident and sanction figures, and said a complaint was filed against the suspect but not against Bouyeri given his limited role.
In the first eight months of 2020, 318 incidents took place within PI Vught that led to disciplinary sanctions.
In de eerste acht maanden van 2020 hebben binnen de PI Vught 318 incidenten plaatsgevonden die hebben geleid tot disciplinaire straffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en het lid Van den Berge over het gebrek aan hulp bij zoektochten van geadopteerden naar hun verleden

MPs Van Nispen and Van den Berge asked why the new subsidy for adoptees searching for their origins funds a central information point and organisations rather than individual searches, and whether it would be reviewed after the COIA report. Minister Dekker answered that the funding strengthens organisations to serve as many adoptees as possible, that the costs of individual searches are hard to estimate (tens of millions), and that he is willing to keep talking with adoptees.
I am willing to remain in dialogue with adoptees and to listen to their wishes.
Ik ben bereid met geadopteerden in gesprek te blijven en te luisteren naar hun wensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Mohammed B. opnieuw door het lint in de gevangenis’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a 2019 prison incident in which two terrorism detainees damaged a gym, causing about 34,000 euro in damage, and why the news came out a year later, and whether terrorist detainees should be fully isolated, moved to the EBI, and deported. The minister said the incident was published in the October 2019 monthly incident overview, that one detainee was punished and reported while the other was punished without a report, and rejected full isolation and a higher security regime as unnecessary and contrary to human rights law, saying deportation of a non-resident is pursued via the return service with a long entry ban.
The newspaper report concerns an incident that took place on 20 September 2019.
Het krantenbericht gaat over een incident dat plaatsvond op 20 september 2019.
