Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het artikel 'In adoptiezaken is verjaring ongewenst'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether he knows the European Court of Human Rights case law on limitation periods in parentage matters and how that case law will be considered in the COIA report on intercountry adoption. The minister said he knows the case law, that the Butink court ruling distinguished it, that he will not comment on the substance while appeal is possible, and that the COIA is independent and will not rule on fault or liability, though its findings still matter.
Since the Butink case is still open to appeal, it is not appropriate for me to make substantive statements about it.
Nu de zaak Butink nog vatbaar is voor hoger beroep, past het mij niet hierover inhoudelijke uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het artikel 'Helft minder slachtoffers moord en doodslag in 20 jaar'

Three MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about a CBS report showing that over half of women killed in 2015-2019 were killed by a partner or ex-partner, and whether prior police contact existed and how police respond. The government confirmed the figures, said police and prosecution systems cannot provide case-level data on prior contact, and described existing protective measures and COVID-related steps without committing to new concrete action.

No, unfortunately I cannot. The police and the Public Prosecution Service cannot, based on the records in their systems, provide insight into the cases involving (ex-)partner violence with fatal outcomes in the period 2015 through 2019.

Nee, dat kan ik helaas niet. De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kunnen op basis van de registraties in hun systemen geen inzicht geven in de gevallen waarbij sprake was van (ex-)partnergeweld met dodelijke afloop in de periode 2015 tot en met 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over diverse recente berichten over de (strafrecht)advocatuur

An MP asked about recent reports on criminal-law advocates, including conflicts of interest when representing several co-suspects, cash payments, and police shadowing of lawyers. The minister said existing conduct rules are adequate, that the Bar's dean supervises compliance, that cash payments are limited to 5,000 euro, and that surveillance of lawyers is subject to special care, while promising to raise the conflict-of-interest dilemma with those involved.
I undertake to address this dilemma with those involved.
Ik zeg u toe om dit dilemma bij betrokkenen te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de kosten van WOZ-bezwaren voor gemeenten

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether no-cure-no-pay agencies profit from WOZ property-valuation objections while citizens gain little, and about the costs to municipalities. The minister says a WODC study is expected by end 2020, cites over EUR 12 million in cost reimbursements paid by municipalities in 2019, and states that objection procedures are already easy for citizens, with no further access measures planned for now.
The WODC study is expected to be delivered by the end of 2020.
Het onderzoek van het WODC wordt naar verwachting voor het eind van 2020 opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de beslissing om Holland Casino en de automatenhallen open te houden gedurende de fase van zwaardere coronamaatregelen

Van Nispen (SP) asked why Holland Casino and amusement halls were allowed to stay open during the stricter COVID measures when hospitality had to close, and questioned their duty of care on gambling addiction and distancing. Minister Dekker replied that the OMT did not advise closing these venues, the package applied equally to them, the sector's protocol and regulators' oversight cover the duty of care and distancing, and the government closed such buildings for two weeks in its 3 November measures.
The OMT did not advise closing sectors such as casinos and amusement halls in this case.
Het OMT heeft in dit geval niet geadviseerd sectoren zoals casino’s en speelautomatenhallen te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van der Graaf en Van Nispen over het blog van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van de Kansspelautoriteit Imago en ‘backlash’

MPs Van Toorenburg, Van der Graaf and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a blog by the Kansspelautoriteit chair warning of a public 'backlash' after opening the online gambling market, and whether the government would protect vulnerable people and the lottery revenue. The minister answered that the Dutch market is regulated rather than liberalised, that strict advertising and care-duty rules apply, that the regulator will monitor and enforce, that the law will be evaluated after three years, and that the sector will revise its advertising code.
Three years after the law takes effect it will be evaluated, with explicit attention to the effects on consumer protection and addiction problems.
Drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de wet zal deze worden geëvalueerd, waarbij nadrukkelijk zal worden gekeken naar de effecten op consumentenbescherming en verslavingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht 'Duizenden kinderen worden uit huis geplaatst en dat kan zeer traumatisch zijn'

A VVD MP asked the ministers about reports that thousands of children are placed out of home in high-conflict (complex) divorces, covering terminology, triage, costs, registration, court procedures, and reporting quality. The state secretary answered largely by describing existing procedures, stating that cost and registration data on divorce-related cases are not available due to privacy rules, and committing to a policy response on equal parental care rights later in the year.
Due to privacy legislation, such data may not be used for another purpose, such as policy information.
Vanwege privacywetgeving mogen dergelijke gegevens niet worden gebruikt voor een ander doel, zoals beleidsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over rechtsbijstand aan verdachten bij strafbeschikkingen door het OM tijdens de coronapandemie

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether no agreement was reached on legal aid for suspects receiving OM penal orders during the pandemic, and why suspects summoned but not detained lack assistance. The minister replied that talks with the NOvA and chain partners are ongoing, that summoned suspects are informed of their right to subsidised legal aid, and that the quality of OM penal orders has improved according to oversight reports.

I am currently in talks with the legal profession and the relevant chain partners to provide some form of legal assistance in cases that were not submitted to the police judge during the coronavirus crisis but are settled by the OM with a penal order.

Ik ben momenteel in gesprek met de advocatuur en de betrokken ketenpartners om in de zaken die door de coronacrisis niet aan de politierechter zijn voorgelegd, maar door het OM met een OM-strafbeschikking worden afgedaan, in een vorm van rechtsbijstand te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over vervalsingen en het aanvraagproces van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG)

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked about forged Verklaringen Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and commercial websites charging extra for VOG applications. The minister answered that forgeries are fraud, that Justis reports them, that employers must check authenticity, and that unauthorised use of government logos has been stopped with further steps under study.
Justis has informed municipalities of the existence of commercial parties.
Justis heeft gemeenten op de hoogte gesteld van het bestaan van commerciële partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek van de RSJ naar het naleven van de coronamaatregelen in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the RSJ's conclusion that shared cells (MPC) are irresponsible during COVID-19 is correct, and how quarantine and testing of cellmates and new prisoners are handled. The minister rejects the RSJ's conclusion, keeps MPC use in place, and describes new quarantine rules for cellmates of symptomatic prisoners while referring to RIVM testing guidelines.
I do not share the RSJ's conclusion.
Ik deel de conclusie van de RSJ niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over de trage afhandeling van letselschadezaken door verzekeraars

MPs asked the minister for Legal Protection whether self-regulation by insurers in personal injury claims has failed and whether the government will tighten rules, sanctions and a disciplinary tribunal. The minister acknowledged the problem and attributed delays largely to necessary case complexity, but rejected legislation, sanctions and a disciplinary tribunal, pointing instead to the Letselschade Raad's keurmerk and other industry measures.
Legally anchoring and tightening the Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade, as well as imposing sanctions for non-compliance with that code, do not fit well with this approach.
Het wettelijk verankeren en aanscherpen van de Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade, alsmede het stellen van sancties op het niet-naleven van die gedragscode, verhouden zich daarmee niet goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over bedrijven die handelen in kredietgegevens van personen zonder hen daarover te informeren

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether private credit-scoring firms may trade personal creditworthiness data without informing the individuals concerned, and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority should be urged to investigate. The minister said the GDPR requires transparency toward data subjects, that firms are primarily responsible for compliance, and that the Authority is independent and is already investigating several credit bureaus, so it would not intervene in its priorities.
I wish to emphasise that these companies are primarily responsible for safeguarding personal data.
Ik hecht eraan te benadrukken dat deze bedrijven in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het waarborgen van persoonsgegevens
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht “Klokkenluider Huig Plug: ‘De bezem moet door het hele Ministerie Justitie en Veiligheid!’’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that DJI incident lists are incomplete, a prison cell fire not being listed, a complaint by medical staff against the Inspectorate J&V, and whether a judge may also serve as a prison director. The minister answered that piketmeldingen are only made for serious or media-sensitive incidents, that the full incident data 2016-2019 and periodic reports are published, and that the complaint and IGJ investigation are being handled.
I am of the view that together this provides a sufficient overview of the seriousness, numbers and development of incidents within DJI institutions, and I will therefore suffice with this.
Ik ben van mening dat dit samen voldoende overzicht geeft in de ernst, de aantallen en de ontwikkeling van incidenten binnen de inrichtingen van DJI en volsta daar dan ook mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'U staat op een zwarte lijst'

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that credit bureaus (EDR, Lindorff, Focum) hold personal data and score people without their knowledge, and whether this breaches the GDPR, plus questions on deposits, bailiffs and collection agencies. The minister answers that the Data Protection Authority is investigating, explains GDPR rights and grounds, and says he will talk to bodies if the investigation finds the practices unlawful.
Since the investigation by the Data Protection Authority has not yet been concluded, it is not possible to go into the matters substantively.
Gelet op dat het onderzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens nog niet is afgerond, is het niet mogelijk om inhoudelijk op zaken in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het ontlopen van strafvervolging na genitale verminking

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether parents can evade prosecution for female genital mutilation by moving to the United Kingdom, and what measures and EU action are possible. The minister answered that no loophole exists in UK law, that the government sees no need for further UK contact or EU action, and that the police and prosecutors can act, including prosecution of mutilation abroad.
I am not aware that Somali status holders move with the aim of avoiding prosecution for cutting their daughters.
Het is mij niet bekend dat Somalische statushouders verhuizen met als doel om strafvervolging voor het besnijden van hun dochters te ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Wiersma over het voorstel van een aantal hoogleraren voor een wijziging van de Auteurswet ten behoeve van online clasroom use

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a proposal by 24 professors to extend the copyright classroom-use exemption (art. 12(5) Auteurswet) to online teaching. The minister agreed to clarify the law, including via an amendment to the implementing bill, and said a private-education point is constrained by EU Directive limits on commercial use.

I will therefore clarify this in the law, even though I have (fortunately) not yet received word that rights holders have raised obstacles to providing distance education, with or without presentations.

Ik zal dit daarom in de wet verduidelijken, ook al heeft mij (gelukkig) nog niet het bericht bereikt dat rechthebbenden tegen het verzorgen van onderwijs op afstand al dan niet ondersteund door presentaties drempels zouden hebben opgeworpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Criminelen tarten justitie: weer meer enkelbanden doorgeknipt'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising ankle monitor sabotage, how many monitored people committed offences, the status of seven fugitives who cut their bands, and whether serious offenders should be barred from monitors or monitors abolished as a substitute for prison. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, gave aggregate figures, said sabotage statistics will be published in early 2021, and defended the monitor as a control tool while promising a sturdier band and a file analysis.
It does not befit me to go into individual cases.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het invoeren van een directe WA-verzekering

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers of Finance and Legal Protection about the insurers' plan for direct motor liability insurance, the ACM's role, and foreign examples. Minister Hoekstra answered that no prior ACM approval is needed, that direct insurance has pros and cons, that Europe requires compulsory liability insurance but permits this arrangement, and that he will leave the initiative to the insurance sector for now.

I see a possible role for myself and my colleague for Legal Protection only if the desirability of direct insurance is firmly established and insurers are unable to offer this product without changes to laws or regulations.

Ik zie pas een mogelijke rol voor mijzelf en mijn ambtsgenoot voor Rechtsbescherming weggelegd als de wenselijkheid van een directe verzekering zonder meer vaststaat en verzekeraars niet in staat zijn dit product aan te bieden zonder aanpassingen in wet- of regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Staaij over de verjaringstermijn bij adoptie en het bewaren van adoptiedossiers

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Staaij asked whether the limitation period in intercountry adoption cases should start only when the adoptee comes of age, and how adoption files will be kept after Stichting Kind en Toekomst stops mediating. The minister defended absolute limitation periods for legal certainty, pointed to the COIA inquiry, said the files stay with the foundation and the Ca takes over if it is dissolved, and said a bill extending the retention period to 100 years will go to consultation by end 2020.
I can imagine that the court's ruling on limitation is disappointing, not only for the person seeking justice but possibly also for other adoptees.
Ik kan mij kan voorstellen dat de betreffende uitspraak van de rechter inzake de verjaring teleurstellend is, niet alleen voor de rechtszoekende, maar mogelijk ook voor andere geadopteerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en de Jong over het bericht; ‘Shannon ziet de beelden nog voor zich: “Mijn dochter werd mishandeld op de crèche”

MPs Markuszower and De Jong asked about a report of a child abused at a daycare centre, the status of a motion for a lifetime ban on working with children for offenders, and whether people who settled civilly with victims should lose their VOG. The minister said the motion is sufficiently implemented via criminal-law occupational bans and VOG screening, and that civil settlements are not registered and cannot be used in VOG screening.
For this reason, I consider the motion concerning the protection of minors through an occupational ban to be sufficiently implemented.
Om deze reden acht ik de motie die ziet op het beschermen van minderjarigen via een beroepsverbod, voldoende uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over de ontvoering van Insiya naar India

Two PvdA MPs asked the Ministers of Legal Protection and Foreign Affairs why Insiya, abducted to India, has not been returned to her mother despite court rulings, what steps the Netherlands has taken, and whether the minister has raised the case with India. The minister agreed the situation is unsatisfactory, said Dutch court rulings cannot be enforced in India and the case is raised diplomatically, and declined to detail pending Indian proceedings without parties' consent.
I can and may only inform you about proceedings pending between parties in India with the consent of the parties involved.
Over in India aanhangige procedures tussen partijen kan en mag ik u alleen met toestemming van betrokken partijen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over wijziging achternaam uit een oogpunt van veiligheid in geval van een traumatisch oorlogsverleden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether refugees and new Dutch citizens with a traumatic war past may feel unsafe because of their surname, and whether a name change on health grounds is available under the Besluit geslachtsnaamwijziging. The minister confirmed the concern, said safety is a general goal supported by municipalities and mental health organisations, and explained that Article 7 allows a name change if a expert statement shows non-change would seriously harm health.

Article 7 of the Besluit geslachtsnaamwijziging provides that a request for a surname change may be granted if the applicant shows, by submitting a statement from an expert, that not changing the surname would seriously harm his physical or mental health.

Artikel 7 van het Besluit geslachtsnaamwijziging luidt dat een verzoek tot geslachtsnaamswijziging kan worden ingewilligd, indien de verzoeker door overlegging van een verklaring van een deskundige aannemelijk maakt dat het achterwege blijven van een geslachtsnaamswijziging zijn lichamelijke of geestelijke gezondheid in ernstige mate zou schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over de rol, taken en verantwoordelijkheden van de Landelijke Expertisegroep Bijzondere Zedenzaken

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about the role, tasks and responsibilities of the LEBZ expert group on sexual offence cases, the removal of a website sentence about it, and calls for an independent investigation into ritual abuse networks. The minister explained that the LEBZ advises the public prosecutor non-bindingly, that the website change did not alter its role, and that he sees no reason for a new investigation while offering to contact German counterparts.
The advice of the LEBZ is not binding.
De adviezen van de LEBZ zijn niet bindend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Politie en COA 'overtreden privacywet' met delen persoonlijke data asielzoekers'

MPs Verhoeven and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked whether police use COA asylum-seeker data for proactive checks, predictive policing and incident enforcement, and about the legal basis and DPIA for the COA-police data sharing. The minister answered that the data are not used for proactive checks or CAS, that the sharing rests on article 107 Vreemdelingenwet, that COA suspended sharing pending an external review, and that the DPIA is being refreshed, while stating that DPIAs and AVG compliance by municipalities and agencies are primarily their own responsibility.
Pending the outcome of the external review, the COA board decided on 16 July to suspend immediately the sharing of personal data with the police.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van de externe toetsing heeft het bestuur van het COA op 16 juli jl. besloten het delen van persoonsgegevens met de politie per direct op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de adoptie van een ernstig ziek meisje uit Malawi

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers why a seriously ill Malawian girl adopted by a Dutch mother could not be insured in the Netherlands, why the passport decision took so long, and whether the adoption could be recognised quickly. The minister answered that insurance is tied to residence in the Netherlands, that the adoption was a local one under Malawian law, that a visa for medical treatment was issued, and that a reconsideration of the objection will take place as soon as possible.
Within the objection procedure, a reconsideration of the rejection will take place as soon as possible.
In het kader van de bezwaarschriftprocedure zal zo spoedig mogelijk een heroverweging van de afwijzing plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet voldoen aan de zorgplicht jegens gedetineerden in verband met bescherming tegen het COVID-19 virus

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Penitentiary Supervisory Commission ruling that the PI Heerhugowaard (Zuyder Bos) failed its duty of care to protect detainees against COVID-19, and whether this applies to all prisons. The minister said the ruling is under appeal, that DJI's measures (visit and leave suspension, quarantine, medical intake) apply in all prisons, and that he is convinced the duty of care is met everywhere.
Against this ruling, the facility director lodged an appeal with the Council for Criminal Justice and Youth Protection on 13 August 2020.
Tegen deze uitspraak heeft de vestigingsdirecteur bij de Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing en Jeugdbescherming op 13 augustus 2020 beroep ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de aanvraag erkenning Orthodoxe Zendende Instantie als zendende instantie

An MP asked why the government has not yet decided on the Orthodox Sending Agency's application, filed in November 2019, to be recognised as a sending body and a separate eighth denomination within the prison chaplaincy service. The Minister answered that the question is unprecedented, that independent advice has been commissioned and is expected in early 2021, and that no assessment framework yet exists, which will also be drafted.

Given the importance of the separation of church and state and the procedure followed in earlier applications for recognition as a sending body, I have decided, in consultation with my colleague the Minister of Justice and Security, to seek independent advice on this matter.

Gezien het belang van scheiding tussen kerk en staat en de gevolgde procedure bij eerdere aanvragen tot erkenning als zendende instantie heb ik, in overleg met mijn collega de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, besloten onafhankelijk advies in te winnen inzake dit vraagstuk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake de onlinedienst Lusha

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the online service Lusha, which publishes phone numbers of people who may not consent, and whether this breaches the GDPR and whether Lusha has a legitimate interest. The minister answered that the assessment of individual cases and of GDPR compliance is for the independent Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and explained the legal framework for legitimate interest without applying it to Lusha.
Assessment of individual cases is for the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, as is the question of whether Lusha's practices breach the GDPR.
De beoordeling van individuele zaken is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, zo ook de vraag of de werkwijze van Lusha in strijd is met de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma inzake het bericht over de zaak van de heer Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen and Sjoerdsma asked the Minister of Legal Protection what steps had been taken after a motion to bring Jaitsen Singh, detained in a US prison for 36 years, to the Netherlands, including whether a transfer request existed, whether the discretionary power should be used to start a transfer procedure, and whether diplomatic pressure for clemency would be pursued. The minister replied that no formal transfer request exists, that the US review is ongoing, that no transfer procedure will be initiated by the Netherlands, and that diplomatic support for a clemency request by Singh himself will be provided if no societal risks are involved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Kolossale fouten gemaakt bij terugkeer tbs’er Michel B.’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of serious failures in the Oostvaarderskliniek's supervision of tbs patient Michel B. and whether other tbs patients are adequately monitored, and asked for the draft inspectorate report and a suspension of all tbs leave. The minister declined to share the draft report pending the final version, expected in autumn, said leave is a safe, essential part of tbs treatment, and refused to suspend leave.
The Inspectorate JenV report is still in draft form and is currently under embargo for hearing of the parties involved.
Het rapport van de Inspectie JenV bevindt zich nog in de conceptfase, en ligt nu onder embargo voor wederhoor voor bij betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een resocialisatietraject in de Oostvaarderskliniek

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that the Inspectorate found serious failures in the Oostvaarderskliniek's resocialisation trajectory for a tbs patient, and what the government will do. The Minister says the draft inspection report is still in hearing, the clinic has already taken improvement measures, the definitive reports are expected later this year, and he will respond only after reviewing them.
The report of the Inspectorate Justice and Security is still in the hearing phase.
Het rapport van de Inspectie JenV (hierna: de inspectie) bevindt zich nog in de wederhoorfase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht over levenslanggestraften

An MP from D66 asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a court ruling ordering a decision on a life-sentence pardon request, the Hague Court of Appeal's view that the detention may be inhumane, the reasonableness of pardon deadlines, costs of litigation, and whether judges rather than politicians should decide. The Minister confirms the decision was issued on time, defends discretionary pardon power and refuses a statutory deadline or a bill transferring the decision to courts.
That means the judicial advice in a pardon procedure is not comparable to a judge's ruling imposing a sentence.
Dat maakt dat het advies van de rechter in een gratieprocedure niet vergelijkbaar is met de uitspraak van een rechter waarin een straf wordt opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Voetbaltv daagt privacywaakhond AP voor de rechter om uitblijven besluit’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the Dutch privacy regulator AP taking VoetbalTV to court over its failure to issue a decision, and about inconsistent GDPR enforcement across EU states. The minister answered that the AP acts independently, that consistency is pursued via the EDPB, that a decision is now before the court so the AP cannot comment on its content, and that the matter will be raised with the AP after the summer recess.
Under Article 52 of the GDPR, each supervisory authority acts with complete independence in performing its tasks and exercising its powers under the regulation.

Op grond van artikel 52 van de AVG treedt elke toezichthoudende autoriteit volledig onafhankelijk op bij de uitvoering van de taken en de uitoefening van de bevoegdheden die haar overeenkomstig deze verordening zijn toegewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘dat een problematische gokker veel te lang zijn gang kon gaan in het casino’

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Finance about reports that a problem gambler lost a quarter million euros at Holland Casino, including whether the casino tracks and informs customers of their losses, whether it has adequate tools and oversight for addiction prevention, and whether there are daily limits on casino card payments. The Minister answered that Holland Casino does not systematically record wins and losses, that the Gambling Authority supervises its addiction-prevention duty and is finishing a review in 2020, that compulsory referral of a relative or to addiction care is not imposed, and that the Wet Koa will tighten rules.
The Gambling Authority supervises Holland Casino and checks whether it takes sufficient measures and provisions to prevent gambling addiction as far as possible.
De Kansspelautoriteit houdt toezicht op Holland Casino en controleert daarbij of het voldoende maatregelen en voorzieningen treft om kansspelverslaving zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hengelose onderneemster maakt megawinsten met zorg voor ex-gedetineerden’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a care bureau for ex-prisoners that reportedly made large profits from publicly funded care, and whether oversight of such providers is adequate. The minister said the provider is a small residential facility outside the profit ban, that annual DJI checks found no irregularities so far, that a further DJI investigation is due in October, and that no general changes to oversight or the care model are currently planned beyond improving the procurement system.
Following media reports, DJI is currently conducting further investigation at the care provider.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving in de media vindt op dit moment nader onderzoek door DJI bij de zorgaanbieder plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat een agent vervolging wil afdwingen van man die hem bedreigde met fysiek geweld

Members Van Wijngaarden and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked whether the Public Prosecution Service was right to drop a case where a police officer sought prosecution of a man who threatened him with violence, and about protection and reporting of violence against police. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the OM judged the threat did not qualify under the relevant offences, that agents are encouraged to report incidents, and that the bill extending the community-service prohibition is on track.
On this individual case, which is now before the judge, I cannot go into further detail.
Op deze individuele casus, die thans aan de rechter is voorgelegd, kan ik verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Politie dringend op zoek naar ontsnapte tbs’er’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a tbs (forensic psychiatric) patient who absconded from a resocialisation unit while on unsupervised leave was granted leave, when his full name was only released after weeks, how dangerous he is, how many tbs patients absconded or reoffended in 2020, and whether public safety should outweigh his liberty. The minister answered that leave is granted only when treatment and safety allow, with binding advice from the independent AVT, that police and prosecutors release names only after other search methods fail, that he was arrested on 26 August, that 15 absconsions and 2 escapes occurred in 2020 (all found), and that no reoffending data for 2020 exists.
Leave is only granted if the treatment permits it.
Verlof wordt alleen toegekend als de behandeling dit toelaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Geadopteerden ontevreden over onderzoek’

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister for Legal Protection about criticism of the independent commission investigating illegal intercountry adoptions, including doubts about members with former state ties, the reliability of interview reports, the small number of adoptees heard, and promised document disclosure. The Minister rejects the criticism, defends the commission's independence and expertise, says the commission decides whom to hear and how reports are verified, and declines to disclose documents beyond what the Wob permits.
It is up to the commission to determine whom it must hear in order to carry out this assignment.
Het is aan de commissie om te bepalen wie zij moet horen ten behoeve van de uitvoering van deze opdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over mogelijke fouten bij het dodelijk drama met Rik van de Rakt als slachtoffer

SP MPs asked whether information-sharing failures between COA, the municipality and care providers contributed to a fatal incident involving an asylum status holder, and whether the system should be investigated. The State Secretary said the criminal investigation is ongoing, that COA shared what legally could be shared, that medical data sharing is governed by consent rules, and that she is willing to review information sharing with partners and noted recent inspection reviews.
The criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vergoeden van affectieschade voor broers en zussen van het slachtoffer

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why siblings of a victim are not by default entitled to compensation for affection damage under the Dutch law, unlike parents, and whether the law should be changed. The minister answered that the law uses a fixed group of parents, partners and children, that siblings can only claim via the hardship clause on a case-by-case basis, and that no amendment is planned, though the group of claimants will be considered in the forthcoming evaluation.
No, at present I see no reason to amend the law.
Nee, ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de wet te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over psychische mishandeling

Three MPs (Bergkamp, Van den Hul, Özütok) asked the ministers about how the government addresses psychological abuse, its criminal-law treatment, registration, and compliance with the Istanbul Convention and children's rights treaty. Minister De Jonge replied that existing law and the GHNT programme already allow action, that police and courts do not register psychological abuse separately, and that no specific problems are reported in prosecution.
It therefore cannot be determined from police registration how often a report of psychological abuse has been filed, whether or not combined with other forms of abuse.
Het is daarom niet uit de politieregistratie te halen hoe vaak aangifte is gedaan van psychische mishandeling, al dan niet in combinatie met andere vormen van mishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over onderzoek naar de legitieme portie in het erfrecht

Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the legitimate portion (legitieme portie) in inheritance law should be abolished or revised, given family conflicts and changing family structures. The Minister defended testamentary freedom as the starting point but kept the legitimate portion, citing limited public demand for change, and declined to commission new research while a Radboud University study on public support is pending.
No broadly shared, urgent need has been shown to amend the legislation on this point.
Niet is gebleken van een breed gedragen, dringende noodzaak om op dit punt tot aanpassing van wetgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het kansspelkarakter van loot boxes in videogames

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the gambling character of loot boxes in video games, including whether an international approach is pursued, the reach of prevention websites and helplines, the independence of the PEGI rating system, and why FIFA 20 receives a PEGI 3 rating. The minister answered that loot boxes are an international phenomenon but international legal harmonisation is not straightforward, that a WODC study and PEGI consultation are underway, and that the Kansspelautoriteit assesses individual cases, with further steps to be considered depending on outcomes.
I expect to inform your House together with the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the outcomes of this study in early 2021.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in begin 2021, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Dam over aanleiding van de column ‘Er is een klimaat dat het voor agressieve horken eenvoudig maakt om anderen het leven zuur te maken’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Dam asked whether light community sentences for serious threats are appropriate, and whether digital threats are treated more leniently than physical ones, prompted by a column on online abuse. The Minister answered that threats are unacceptable, that sentencing is for prosecutors and judges, that written threats generally carry higher sanctions than spoken ones, and that threats against journalists can raise the sentence demanded.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Verdachte zaak-Maddie verbleef in Nederland’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a German convicted offender suspected in the Madeleine McCann case stayed in the Netherlands, what Dutch authorities knew, and whether convicted sex and violent offenders can travel or live abroad. The minister declined to give case details due to an ongoing foreign criminal investigation, but explained the legal options to restrict travel of Dutch sex offenders and noted that EU free movement limits restrictions on foreign convicts.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation abroad.
Er is sprake van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over twijfels bij het gebruik van een bepaald risicotaxatie-instrument bij de reclassering vanwege het gevaar op etnisch profileren

An MP asks whether the risk-assessment algorithm OxRec used by the probation service may lead to ethnic profiling, including whether it uses neighbourhood data and how large its error margins are. The Minister answers that ethnicity is excluded, that the neighbourhood score is based on socioeconomic status validated against recidivism, that the probation worker keeps the final judgement, and that the instrument's accuracy is within the range expected of such tools.
It is designed as a tool so that the probation worker overlooks nothing and critically reviews their own assessment.
Het is ontworpen als hulpmiddel hierbij zodat de reclasseringswerker niets over het hoofd ziet en zijn eigen beoordeling kritisch bekijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een mogelijke aanbesteding van het Centraal Administratie Kantoor

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the CAK's collection tenders overlap with the CJIB, why small bailiff offices are excluded by the lot structure, and whether price is effectively the selection criterion. The minister explains the CAK is transferring most enforcement to the CJIB, the remaining tender is a separate gradual transition, and lots are limited for efficiency and single-contact reasons, with 70% weight on quality.
Within the tender the CAK applies the following price and quality ratio: price 30% and quality 70%.
Het CAK hanteert binnen de aanbesteding de volgende verhouding voor prijs en kwaliteit: prijs = 30% en kwaliteit = 70%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Willekeur van coronaregels ondermijnt het vertrouwen’ en ‘Advocaten roepen mensen op: kom in verzet tegen coronaboete’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether corona fines can be challenged in court, given that kanton court hearings are largely suspended until 1 September 2020. The minister replied that objections (verzet) are possible and reviewed by the kantonrechter, but such cases were not yet heard, and the OM and Rechtspraak will bring a representative selection of objection cases to court before 1 September.
In principle this does not yet apply to criminal law kanton hearings (until 1 September 2020), which also include objection cases.
In beginsel geldt dit nog niet voor strafrecht kantonzittingen (tot 1 september 2020), waar ook de verzetszaken onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de schuldsanering en een effectieve schuldenrechter

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister about debt relief, the accessibility of the Wsnp debt-discharge procedure, and a more effective debt judge. The Minister answered that the government is working with the State Secretary on better linking the voluntary and statutory debt tracks, and will inform Parliament in summer 2020 on concrete steps, while rejecting an external supervisory body and a maximum duration for voluntary debt assistance.
I am not in favour of a maximum term, but I am in favour of progress and transparency.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een maximumtermijn, maar wel van voortgang en transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Gevangene Sittard overleden aan overdosis drugs’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a prisoner in Sittard could die of a drug overdose, how drugs entered the prison, and whether the anti-smuggling measures had failed and staff should be dismissed. The minister confirmed the death, said the investigation could not establish how drugs entered, declined to discuss the individual case, saw no reason for dismissals, and pointed to additional measures and a forthcoming policy letter.
Because this is an individual case, I will not go into the specific circumstances of the detention and the death.
Omdat het een individuele zaak betreft, ga ik niet nader in op de specifieke omstandigheden van de detentie en het overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de versoepeling van de corona-maatregelen in het gevangeniswezen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a Ramadan gathering of 50 detainees per group at PI Krimpen aan den IJssel breached the 30-person RIVM limit, why staff gatherings and the easing of visits and leave were so slow and limited to a few prisons. The minister admitted the 30-person limit was breached and regretted it, explained the visit easing was phased to manage infection risk, and said visits were opened in all suitable prisons from 16 June 2020.
It is correct that in this situation the RIVM guideline prescribing a maximum of 30 people gathering together was breached.
Het is correct dat in deze situatie de RIVM-richtlijn die voorschrijft dat er maximaal 30 mensen bijeen mogen komen is overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over Jehova’s getuigen

Kuiken (PvdA) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a report on manipulation within the Jehovah's Witnesses, whether the closed culture undermines trust that abuse is taken seriously, and whether members who criticise, marry civilly or are shut out can be protected. The Minister said abuse handling is covered by a separate forthcoming letter, that the government has no view on how the community handles other misconduct, and that existing criminal law (coercion, threats, child abduction) already offers sufficient means to intervene.
There are therefore sufficient legal possibilities to intervene.
Er zijn daarmee voldoende wettelijke mogelijkheden om te kunnen ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Een zaal vol Oekraïense draagmoederbaby’s wacht op ouders’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the government about a report of surrogacy babies waiting in Ukraine for their parents during the lockdown and about measures against malpractice in surrogacy abroad. The Minister said a legal framework with safeguards is being prepared, that legal recognition of foreign-born parenthood cannot be prevented or guaranteed free of malpractice, and pointed to Hague Conference work on an international instrument.
Making international surrogacy legally impossible is therefore not desirable in my view, and I will not do so.
Het juridisch onmogelijk maken van internationaal draagmoederschap vind ik dan ook niet wenselijk en zal ik niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de situatie in gevangenissen in coronatijd

An MP from the SP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about conditions in prisons during the COVID-19 period, including reports that detainees were silenced, visits and leave suspended, Skype access, lawyer visits, hygiene and quarantine, a detainee death, and a court ruling on multi-person cells. The Minister answered that DJI information is reliable, that sanctions for speaking to media are case-by-case, that visits and leave were suspended to prevent spread and are gradually being restored, and that quarantine and hygiene measures follow RIVM guidance.
A detainee must ask the director for permission to speak with the media.
Een gedetineerde moet de directeur om toestemming vragen voor een gesprek met de media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de opstand in jeugdgevangenis Den Hey-Acker

The MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a riot at the Den Hey-Acker youth detention centre, whether staff shortages caused it, and whether incidents are under-reported. The Minister said the incident is being investigated internally with results to the inspectorates in September, denied a one-staff-per-youth rule and staff shortages as cause, stated that only incidents causing serious injury trigger a special incident report, and described aftercare for staff.
The inspectorates asked DJI to carry out an internal investigation into the incident and report back to them.
De inspecties hebben DJI verzocht intern onderzoek naar het incident uit te voeren en hen daarover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Gewelddadige tbs’er Hendrik M. neemt wederom de benen, zoekactie gestart’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a violent TBS patient who absconded during unsupervised leave was not yet found, why no police bulletin was issued, and whether all leave for violent TBS patients should be withdrawn. The minister explained that the patient was arrested on 9 June, that a photo was published instead of a bulletin, and rejected withdrawing all leave, arguing leave is essential to treatment.
During a TBS measure, every leave request is thoroughly assessed by an internal committee of a TBS clinic.
Gedurende een tbs-maatregel wordt elke verlofaanvraag grondig getoetst door een interne commissie van een tbs-kliniek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Grote verschillen tussen rechters bij beoordelen van fiscale zaken’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Legal Protection about a report that tax courts differ widely in outcomes, and whether taxpayers' rights are adequately protected, including calls for a taxpayers' charter and further research. The government answered that the Deloitte analysis rests on a very small share of published rulings and does not establish inconsistency, that case-win data are unavailable, that no charter is planned, and that an advisory committee on practical legal protection in tax matters is examining the issue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van den Berge over de strafrechtspleging in Coronatijd

MPs Buitenweg and Van den Berge asked about the state of criminal justice during the COVID-19 period, including police capacity, legal aid, backlogs, courtroom access, detainee participation and tbs (forensic psychiatric) leave. The minister replied that physical hearings were gradually resumed from 11 May with priority for criminal, youth and family law, backlogs are being addressed through an integrated approach, and various measures on legal aid, video hearings and probation were described, mostly without concrete new commitments beyond promised letters.
Your House will be informed in writing about the approach once it is ready.
Uw Kamer wordt schriftelijk geïnformeerd over de aanpak zodra deze gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over rechterlijke uitspraken over de PAS

An MP asked the ministers about court rulings on the PAS nitrogen programme after 29 May 2019, including how many concern farm housing, grazing, manure and enforcement, and why some rulings were not published. The minister answered that the courts themselves decide on publication under the Rechtspraak criteria, that no integrated system counts PAS rulings, that the Council of State published all its PAS rulings, and that the Noord-Nederland court has now published some rulings after media attention.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Otterloo over het artikel ‘Burgemeesters: doorgeslagen privacywet heeft extra doden gekost’

An MP asked the Minister whether privacy law prevented officials from reporting deaths of nursing home residents from COVID-19 and whether this cost lives, and asked about contact tracing and planned action. The Minister answered that GDPR does not cover deceased persons, that health data sharing runs through the Public Health Act channels with aggregated figures to mayors, that no legal change is needed, and that the Ministry will address information sharing with mayors; the answer was late.
As the above shows, privacy legislation was no obstacle to communicating the necessary information about these infections and deaths.
Zoals uit het bovenstaande blijkt, vormde de privacywetgeving geen belemmering voor het communiceren van de nodige informatie over deze besmettingen en sterfgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Kansspelautoriteit machteloos staat tegen gokelementen in videogames

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the Gambling Authority is powerless against gambling elements such as loot boxes in video games like FIFA, including the status of enforcement against providers and why enforcement takes so long. The minister answered that the Authority cannot comment on individual cases, outlined its sanction options, said enforcement is generally possible quickly though legal challenges can delay it, and maintained that the rules are sufficiently clear.
I note that the Gambling Authority (Ksa) cannot make statements about individual cases, whether ongoing or not.
Ik merk op dat de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) over al dan niet lopende, individuele zaken geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de toename van agressie tegen agenten

An MP asks the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers why assaults on police officers rose, whether the taakstraf ban bill and mental-health plan are delayed, and whether courts are too lenient. The ministers answer that no clear cause is visible in the data, the taakstraf bill is with the Raad van State and expected before summer recess, the mental-health approach is led by municipalities, and courts generally follow prosecutors' demands.
The taakstraf ban bill is currently pending advice from the Council of State's advisory division.
Het wetsvoorstel Taakstrafverbod is op dit moment voor advies aanhangig bij de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over versoepeling van Corona-maatregelen in gevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why Corona measures in prisons had not been eased like elsewhere, leaving visits and movement suspended since mid-March and detention phasing stalled. The minister replied that visits and leave were expanded from 2 June following RIVM guidelines, that suspension of detention for a small group of end-of-sentence prisoners continues for safety reasons, and that he will inform parliament shortly on resuming placement in restricted facilities.
I am considering when it is responsible to make placement in a ZBBI part of detention phasing again.
Ik bezie op welk moment het verantwoord is om de plaatsing in een ZBBI weer onderdeel te maken van de detentiefasering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Hof moet na hardhandige arrestatie Michael P. weer kijken naar straf’

An MP asked the Justice Minister to act against an advocate-general who advised a reduced sentence for Michael P. after his violent arrest, and asked whether police officers should be prosecuted or honoured. The minister answered that the advocate-general acts independently, that the prosecution service decides on prosecution and sentencing demands, and that dismissal is outside his role.
Given the separation of powers, it is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to judge the independent advice of an advocate-general at the Supreme Court.
Gelet op de scheiding der machten is het niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om te oordelen over onafhankelijke adviezen van een advocaat-generaal bij de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over partners van slachtoffers in de rechtszaal

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether partners or relatives of crime victims may attend court hearings during the COVID-19 measures, and whether the government will consult the judiciary about allowing them. The minister answered that victims may bring one companion, that a further close relative is admitted when the building's health rules allow, and that no further consultation with the judiciary is needed.
Should I find that the approach nonetheless causes problems in practice, I will not fail to raise this point in my weekly consultation with the Council for the Judiciary.

Mocht ik constateren dat de werkwijze in de praktijk toch tot problemen leidt, dan zal ik niet nalaten dit punt ter sprake te brengen in het wekelijks overleg dat ik heb met de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Te koop: openbare orde en veiligheid; Onderzoek Beveiligingsmultinational G4S en de VVD-lobby’

MPs Van Dam (CDA) and Verhoeven (D66) asked about a 2016 intention statement on sharing sensor data between G4S-type security firms, police and prosecutors, the legal basis for camera footage sharing, camera rules for municipalities, facial recognition, and the conduct of a former OVV chair holding a G4S advisory role. The minister answered that the document is a non-binding intention statement with no follow-up, that legal frameworks (Wpg, Wjsg, AVG) govern data sharing, and that the former chair complied with reporting rules as far as known.
There is no question of a covenant.
Er is geen sprake van een convenant.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Van den Berge over de berichtgeving dat de politie en het OM steken laten vallen bij het afdwingen van het nakomen van door de rechter vastgestelde omgangsregelinge

MPs asked whether police and prosecutors neglect enforcement of court-ordered child contact arrangements, including reluctance to take complaints and the scope of criminal versus civil remedies. The Minister acknowledges the concern, says current reports are insufficient for firm conclusions, and points to an expert team reporting in October, with no concrete enforcement change committed yet.
I am awaiting their report before drawing further conclusions.
Ik wacht hun rapport af alvorens verdere conclusies te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het onderzoek Afstand en adoptie in Nederland, 1956 - 1984

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the registration process, data handling, verification of statements, retention and budgets for the study on forced adoption and separation in the Netherlands 1956-1984. The minister admitted that reports were not verified properly and some data handling did not meet GDPR requirements, and committed to extending registration to 31 July, having interviews run only by VJI, offering verification to all registrants, destroying retained reports and publishing clearer information.
I have had to conclude that registrants were not sufficiently actively asked whether they wanted to view and correct the report.
Ik heb moeten constateren dat aan aanmelders onvoldoende actief gevraagd is of zij het verslag willen inzien en corrigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over vrouwenonderdrukking

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about oppression of women in marriages with migrants, including a case where a woman was killed shortly after arriving, and about isolation of partners of knowledge migrants. The government says such practices are unacceptable, points to the action agenda on harmful practices and the Rotterdam pilot, but declines a national study and says it cannot bar sponsors from bringing partners under EU family reunification rules.
Because every case of forced isolation is one too many, it has not been chosen to set up a national study into the extent of forced isolation of marriage migrants.
Omdat elk geval van gedwongen isolement er één te veel is, wordt er niet voor gekozen om een landelijk onderzoek in te stellen naar de omvang van gedwongen isolement van huwelijksmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het artikel 3:305a BW

MP Van Haga asks the Minister for Legal Protection about article 3:305a of the Dutch Civil Code (collective actions by foundations and associations), including representativeness, democratic legitimacy of judges, and the Urgenda case. The Minister replies that representativeness has been an explicit admissibility requirement since 1 January 2020, that judges applying law do not assess what is 'in the interest of' the population, and that the Urgenda implications will be reported to the House later.
The collective action right as anchored in article 3:305a BW I consider a useful and meaningful element of our legal system.
Het collectief actierecht zoals dat is verankerd in artikel 3:305a BW acht ik een nuttig en zinvol element van ons rechtssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Ronnes en Palland over de website coronaverlies

MPs Van Dam, Ronnes and Palland (CDA) asked the government about the website coronaverlies.nl, which offered claim-recovery services to businesses hit by COVID-19, and whether it was a scam exploiting entrepreneurs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the site is now offline, that it is not for the cabinet to judge whether such services are legitimate, and that victims can file a police report for the Public Prosecution Service to assess.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether services offered on websites such as coronaverlies.nl are legitimate.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of diensten die worden aangeboden op websites als coronaverlies.nl legitiem zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het bericht ‘Amsterdams homokoppel uitgescholden en bespuugd’

MPs Bergkamp, Van den Hul and Özütok asked the Justice Minister about a reported homophobic attack in Amsterdam, underreporting of hate crime, the use of specialised discrimination detectives, and the training of police officers on discrimination. Minister Grapperhaus said such discrimination is unacceptable, announced a publicity campaign and a national police coordination function, but rejected creating specialised hate crime units and left the police training curriculum largely unchanged.
I intend to conclude this process with a public campaign aimed at the willingness of LHBTI people to report and file complaints.
Ik ben voornemens dit traject af te ronden met een publiekscampagne gericht op de meldings- en aangiftebereidheid van LHBTI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de definitieve sluiting van Het Poortje

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the government about the definitive closure of Het Poortje youth institution in Groningen, including a claimed EUR 3.5 million deficit, dismissals, and whether youth care in Groningen and Drenthe remains adequate. Minister De Jonge answered that Elker will close its Groningen Jeugdzorg Plus location but continue closed youth care in smaller settings without forced dismissals, that regions are satisfied with places, and that no emergency plan is needed.
Elker Jeugdhulp & onderwijs has informed me that it will organise closed youth care differently.
Elker Jeugdhulp & onderwijs heeft mij gemeld dat zij de gesloten jeugdhulp anders gaan organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de juridische basis van de beperkende maatregelen tegen verspreiding van het Coronavirus en de gevolgen van de opgelegde boetes

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about the legal basis of COVID-19 emergency ordinances, whether fines for breaching distancing rules and the resulting criminal record could affect VOG certificates, and related enforcement concerns. The government answered that a temporary statute will replace the ordinances to strengthen democratic legitimacy, that a single COVID fine would generally not block a VOG, and that enforcement follows a set framework with warnings first.
With legislation in the formal sense, democratic legitimacy is strengthened.
Met wetgeving in formele zin wordt de democratische legitimatie versterkt.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de registratie van kinderen die kort na geboorte zijn overleden maar waarvan geen akte van overlijden is opgemaakt

Two Christian Union MPs asked how parents whose infant died shortly after birth, without any death certificate having been issued, can have this registered, and whether they must hire a lawyer to go to court. The minister confirmed a court procedure exists, that a lawyer is generally needed, and promised to map the problem with civil registrars and report in the second half of the year, and a bill is being prepared to allow registration of such children in the BRP.

I will, in consultation with the professional association of civil registrars, map the scale of the problem and on that basis examine whether there is reason to further assist parents, in addition to the existing options.

Ik zal in overleg met de beroepsvereniging van ambtenaren van de burgerlijke stand, de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Burgerzaken (NVVB), in kaart brengen wat de omvang van de problematiek is en op basis daarvan nagaan of er aanleiding is om -aanvullend op de bestaande mogelijkheden- ouders nader tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Bergkamp en Van Nispen over duivelsuitdrijving bij kinderen en andere misstanden binnen religieuze gemeenschappen

MPs asked whether exorcism practices against children in religious communities, including alleged sexual abuse and threats, are harmful and criminal, and how oversight, reporting and independent research could be strengthened. The minister agreed such practices can harm children and may be criminal, pointed to Veilig Thuis and the police for oversight, declined a separate national study, and said he would consider a constitutional-law angle on restricting religious freedom by statute.

Given the extensive research agenda of the WODC and the number of studies still in the queue, I do not consider it desirable to start a separate study into the nature and extent of exorcisms in the Netherlands.

Antwoord 7 Ik acht het – mede gezien de omvangrijke onderzoeksagenda van het WODC en de hoeveelheid onderzoeken die nog in de wachtrij staan – niet wenselijk om een separaat onderzoek naar de aard en omvang van duivelsuitdrijvingen in Nederland op te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over wrakingscijfers

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the 2019 figures on recusal (wraking) requests in criminal cases, including whether withdrawn requests were counted and whether the figures justify the planned fast-track rules. The Minister confirmed the 692 requests with 17 upheld (later corrected to 4), explained 14 withdrawn requests, and said the planned legislation is motivated by procedural flexibility and the small share of granted requests.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Groothuizen over rechtspraak in tijden van coronacrisis

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked how the judiciary during the COVID-19 crisis can resume physical hearings, reduce case backlogs, adjust financing and protect indebted citizens. The ministers answer that hearings resume from 11 May with priority for criminal, youth and family law, that backlogs will be addressed without yet presenting a plan, and that they will examine the proposed changes to police-judge powers and evaluate emergency measures later.
In our letter of 23 April we indicated that courthouses can also be opened outside office hours and hold hearings.
In onze brief van 23 april jl. hebben we aangegeven dat er de mogelijkheid is om gerechtsgebouwen ook buiten kantoortijden te openen en zittingen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen inzake fundamentele rechten in het strafrecht

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about fundamental procedural rights in criminal law during COVID-19 measures, including phone-only lawyer consultation, video hearings, detainee access to hearings, public access to trials, and cell placement. The ministers largely answered that rights are safeguarded, that measures are proportionate and temporary, and that they are monitoring and adjusting practice, while committing to some reviews and expansions.
In taking all measures, the principles of the rule of law, democracy and fundamental rights are safeguarded, subject to the restrictions arising from the necessary public health measures.

Bij het treffen van alle maatregelen worden de beginselen van rechtsstaat, democratie en grondrechten geborgd met in achtneming van de beperkingen die voortvloeien uit de noodzakelijke maatregelen ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de toegang tot en het gebruik van archieven van het Rode Kruis voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek

An MP asked the minister whether strict conditions on access to Red Cross war archives transferred to the National Archives, citing GDPR, are justified for researchers and memorial institutions. The minister answered that the conditions follow the minimal GDPR-based requirements of the Dutch implementing act, that existing access arrangements will be continued after the transfer, and that adequate access remains possible.
Other conditions than the minimum conditions mentioned in Article 24 UAVG are therefore not imposed.
Andere voorwaarden dan de minimale voorwaarden, genoemd in artikel 24 UAVG, worden dan ook niet gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de beveiliging van tbs-klinieken

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the security of tbs clinics, following a report that Kijvelanden would now always check staff after an escape, and whether the rules on staff screening are followed in practice. The minister confirmed the 1-in-25 field norm for staff checks, pointed to inspection and DJI audits showing compliance, and declined to tighten security at other clinics for now, citing ongoing sector improvement efforts and a new addendum with the sector.
Yes, this is shown by investigations periodically carried out by the IJenV and DJI into security in FPCs.
Ja, dit blijkt uit onderzoeken die periodiek door de IJenV en DJI naar de veiligheid in FPC's zijn gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Toorenburg over de excuses en schadevergoeding voor slachtoffers van Zusters van de Goede Herder

MPs Van Nispen and Van Toorenburg asked whether the proposed EUR 5,000 flat-rate compensation and apology for victims of forced child labour at the Zusters van de Goede Herder is adequate, and why it is aligned with victims of youth-care abuse. The minister defends the single amount as recognition of the government's inadequate supervision, says a separate Goede Herder case would be disproportionate to treat differently, and promises a Ministerial Regulation in autumn with the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven administering it.
In my letter of 19 December to the House I indicated that the government has a responsibility to take for having failed to supervise adequately, allowing the unlawful forced labour to continue.
In mijn brief van 19 december aan uw Kamer heb ik aangegeven dat de overheid een verantwoordelijkheid heeft te nemen voor het feit dat zij onvoldoende toezicht heeft gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake de stakingsoproep van de Vereniging van Advocatenbelangen

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a strike call by the Vereniging Advocatenbelangen among social lawyers, the lack of a way to record strikers, the reform of legal aid and whether it will cause a shortage of social lawyers. The Minister answers that the July strike was withdrawn, that extra funding and monitoring are in place, that strike absence is not registered for privacy reasons, and that the reform is being developed in a learning manner with measures to attract young lawyers.
Question 4: Will you talk with the Legal Aid Board to set up a system as soon as possible that makes it possible to map how many social lawyers are striking? Answer 4: No.

Vraag 4 Gaat u met de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand in gesprek om zo snel mogelijk een systeem op te richten waarbij het wel mogelijk is om in kaart te kunnen brengen hoeveel sociaal advocaten staken? Antwoord 4 Nee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake het bericht ‘ruziënde Russen kosten Nederlandse rechtspraak miljoenen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about an Argos report that Dutch courts are used by shell companies with little link to the Netherlands, costing millions, and about the NCC English-language commercial court. The minister denied any policy of luring shell companies, said no cost or company-type data exists, defended court access and the NCC, and declined to commission new research.
There is no policy or deployment of the judiciary to attract so-called letterbox companies to the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake van beleid of inzet van de rechterlijke macht om zogeheten brievenbusfirma’s naar Nederland te lokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake omgangsregelingen gedurende de corona-maatregelen

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection how court cases and contact arrangements (omgangsregelingen) were handled during the corona measures, including whether delayed family cases and possible abductions were being prioritised. The Minister acknowledged the frustration, explained that urgent child-safety cases are always heard and that contact arrangements should continue unless there are health complaints, and said the expert team on parental alienation will report interim findings before the summer.
Cases in which the safety of the child is at stake, such as possible abductions, have already been classed as urgent and are always handled.
Zaken waarin de veiligheid van het kind in het geding is, zoals bij mogelijke ontvoeringen, zijn al direct als urgente zaken aangemerkt en worden altijd behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de gevolgen van het Corona-virus voor de (sociale) advocatuur

An MP asks the Justice ministers how the Covid-19 crisis affects the legal aid sector, including advance payment schemes, arrests and piket calls, lawyers' income, and whether court scheduling takes lawyers' agendas into account. The minister answers that an extra advance payment scheme and related measures are in place, that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand monitors case numbers per field, and that further targeted measures may follow.
Your House will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Uw Kamer zal hierover zo spoedig mogelijk nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over "het doorprocederen door de overheid"

Two SP MPs asked whether Enschede's municipality acted improperly by pursuing a benefit recovery to cover social investigation costs and monitoring bank spending to the euro, and whether this reflects a wider practice of prolonged litigation by government. The state secretary answered that it is a municipal case for the council to supervise, that no signals suggest a systemic practice, and that the government will share an interdepartmental plan to reduce unnecessary procedures with parliament before summer.
This concerns a case within an individual municipality. It is not for me or the Minister for Legal Protection to pass judgment on individual descriptions such as those in the article you cite.

Het betreft hier een casus binnen een individuele gemeente. Het is niet aan mij of de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming om een oordeel te vellen over individuele beschrijvingen zoals in het door u aangehaalde artikel.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Buitenweg, Van Dam en Groothuizen over de brief van the European Network of Councils for the Judiciary (ENCJ) aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie over recente anti-Europese wetgeving

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about the ENCJ letter on Polish rule-of-law reforms, the Polish 'muzzle law' and the Commission's infringement actions, and whether the Netherlands should start an Article 259 TFEU procedure against Poland. The ministers expressed serious concern, noted the Court of Justice's rulings and the Commission's role, supported rule-of-law conditionality in the EU budget, but argued that a Member State-initiated Article 259 procedure is not the appropriate instrument.
The separation of powers and the independence of the judiciary are essential principles of the democratic rule of law and form the core values of the European Union.
De scheiding der machten en onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht zijn essentiële beginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat en vormen de kernwaarden van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van den Berge over het bericht 'Transgender eist excuses overheid: ‘Om vrouw te worden, moest ik me laten steriliseren’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government acknowledges the harm caused by the pre-2014 sterilisation requirement for legal gender change, whether it will apologise, how other countries handled redress, and whether it will meet the complainants. The minister acknowledged the harm and the requirement's damage, said a response to the Transgender Collective's letter requesting apology and compensation talks is still under consideration, described Sweden's compensation and noted no other countries have apologised, and declined to commit to a meeting for now.
I am aware that this condition for sterilisation caused suffering and I also acknowledge this suffering.
Ik ben er mee bekend dat deze voorwaarde tot sterilisatie leed heeft veroorzaakt en erken dit leed ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over uithuisgeplaatste kinderen die niet meer terug kunnen naar de eigen ouders

MP Peters (CDA) asked the ministers whether children placed out of home after parents were evicted for debt or lack of housing could be returned, and what the government does to prevent evictions and support housing. The government answered that no general six-month housing requirement exists, that it is working on early warning and debt-support measures, and that it does not accept a housing guarantee for parents whose children are placed under court order.
There are no figures available on how often this occurs.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vastlopen van de rechtspraak

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers why the courts were stalling, whether the government knew the figures before the debate, what it would do to shorten case durations and how it would better inform victims. The ministers answered that the capacity shortfall was foreseen, that an internal analysis showed a backlog and that a joint OM-judiciary analysis and extra measures were underway, while acknowledging victims suffer from delays and agreeing to explore proactive victim updates.
We consider this a good suggestion and will consult with the OM on how this can be shaped.
Wij vinden dit een goede suggestie en gaan met het OM in overleg hoe dit vormgegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over stelende bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Peters asked the government about trustees (bewindvoerders) who embezzled clients' money in Limburg, including why intervention was slow, prosecution capacity, complaint handling, and whether a blacklist or regional lists should be created. The minister answered that courts dismissed the trustees, criminal proceedings are pending with the OM, quality requirements since 2014 are monitored by the judiciary, and that no blacklist is planned, while complaint routes and a white list are described.
The OM does not have this data because it is not registered by occupational group or profession of the suspect.
Het OM beschikt niet over deze gegevens omdat niet wordt geregistreerd op beroepsgroep of beroep van de verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over falende bewindvoerders
