MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about rogue court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) who allegedly defraud clients, and what the government will do about supervision and complaints. The minister answered that dismissal, liability and court supervision exist, that quality requirements and the Landelijk Kwaliteitsbureau are in place, and that stakeholders will explore mandatory training and the government will look into the motion on improving the system.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over de Beleidsregels exploitatievergunning speelautomatenhallen Heerlen 2020

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked why Heerlen allocates speelautomatenhal licences by lottery rather than by merit on player protection and crime prevention. The minister replied that municipalities may choose any allocation method that respects formal equality, that Heerlen's lottery is followed by a substantive assessment of each drawn application, and that it is for the municipality to decide.
Within the limits of laws and regulations, municipalities are free to determine how they shape the granting of licences.
Binnen de grenzen van de wet- en regelgeving zijn gemeenten vrij om te bepalen hoe zij de verlening van vergunningen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de coronamaatregelen door een tbs-kliniek niet nageleefd (kunnen) worden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether COVID-19 rules are being followed at the Oostvaarderskliniek forensic psychiatric centre, whether staff and patients are tested and protected, and why handovers were shortened. The minister answered that clinics follow RIVM guidelines, that protective equipment and testing are available under those guidelines, and that a staff member died, with patients and staff isolated when symptoms appear.
Yes, of course the clinics work in accordance with the applicable guidelines and measures.
Ja, vanzelfsprekend werken de klinieken conform de geldende richtlijnen en maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het bericht ‘KNLTB in beroep tegen uitspraak AP’ en ‘Boete voor tennisbond vanwege verkoop van persoonsgegevens’

MPs Heerema and Van Gent asked the ministers about the Dutch data protection authority's fine on the KNLTB tennis federation for selling personal data and its interpretation of 'legitimate interest' under the GDPR, including whether the fine was proportionate and why no alternative intervention was used. The minister answered that the GDPR is binding EU law, that the AP acts independently and cannot be instructed, that the KNLTB's appeal is pending so details cannot be given, and that the sports sector will draft new guidelines by mid-2020.
It is for the AP to impose a proportionate sanction; it makes its own independent assessment in this.
Het is aan de AP om een proportionele sanctie op te leggen, zij maakt hierin onafhankelijk haar eigen afweging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'Corona-app dreigt te mislukken door enorme haast van kabinet'

An MP from D66 asked the health and justice ministers about the rushed timeline and tender for the Corona contact-tracing app, including deadlines, cybersecurity, open source, and expert concerns. The government answered by referring to its COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Verhoeven (D66) to the ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Legal Protection have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update status'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Rechtsbescherming zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Sneller en Groothuizen over de implementatie van noodverordeningen ten behoeve van de ‘intelligente lockdown’

MPs Den Boer, Sneller and Groothuizen asked why the legal basis for new COVID-19 'intelligent lockdown' measures was not communicated, why emergency ordinances took days to draft, whether enforcement before legal force was lawful, and when the ordinances will be withdrawn. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the legal bases were in the Minister of Health's directive to safety regions, acknowledged the omission for future letters, defended announcing measures before the ordinances existed, explained the drafting complexity, and said the measures stay in force until the health minister's directive is withdrawn, with review before 28 April.
In future, care will be taken that these legal bases are also stated when informing the House.
In het vervolg zal erop worden gelet dat deze grondslagen ook worden vermeld bij het informeren van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een-tweetjes tussen ministers en Kamerleden en onenigheid daarover tussen ministers

An SP MP asked whether a TV-and-press plan by a VVD justice spokesperson, offered to the minister of his own party, was an appropriate one-to-one arrangement, and whether the minister represents the government or his party. The minister answered that MPs may appear in the media, that the ministry only gave a general reply to a press inquiry, and that ministers must respect collective government policy and not announce plans outside agreed policy.
Ministers, as members of the government, observe the unity of government policy (Article 45, paragraph 3, of the Constitution).
Ministers nemen als lid van de regering de eenheid van het regeringsbeleid in acht (artikel 45, derde lid, Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Toorenburg over het artikel ‘Verdachte in ‘tattookillers’-zaak knipt enkelband door en vlucht’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a suspect who cut his ankle monitor and fled during a case, and whether conditional release is withheld in such cases. The minister said the prosecution does not hold data on the specific cases, that about 60 requests to revoke conditional release were filed in 2019 with 45 partly granted, and that the specific case is pending appeal and cannot be discussed in substance.
At the time of the assessment, the prosecution saw no serious objections on the basis of which it could be requested to refrain from conditional release.
Ten tijde van de beoordeling zag het OM geen ernstige bezwaren op grond waarvan verzocht kan worden om van een v.i. af te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het voorkomen van vechtscheidingen met mogelijke ouderverstoting tot gevolg

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about keeping the family home after divorce, a pilot involving children in parenting plans, the scale of parental alienation, the expert team's mandate, enforcement of custody arrangements and prosecutions under Article 279 of the Criminal Code. The minister answers that mortgage matters are a lender responsibility, the pilot results are due in May 2020, the expert team's report is delayed to autumn, and a national enforcement bureau is for the expert team to advise on.
The police have no data on the number of reports of unlawful removal from parental authority because such reports cannot be detected in police systems.

Er zijn bij de politie geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal aangiften/meldingen betreffende onttrekking aan het ouderlijk gezag omdat deze in de systemen van de politie niet kunnen worden gedetecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Van der Graaf en Van Nispen over de totstandkoming van de Wet homologatie onderhands akkoord

MPs Nijboer, Van der Graaf and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the WHOA bill was prepared, including which documents, consultation inputs and outside-party texts can be shared, and whether ministry contacts with third parties over amendments were improper. The minister answered that the bill's history and consultation reactions are largely available, that outside texts were used through a standard process, and that premature communication about draft amendments with the coalition and Finance occurred due to miscommunication.
This happened as a result of a miscommunication.
Dit gebeurde als gevolg van een miscommunicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Slachtoffers misdrijven willen meer privacy, angst voor wraak daders’

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that crime victims lack privacy protection and fear reprisals, including why victims are not always told about postal-address or anonymous-filing options. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained the limits of anonymous filing, said a generic anonymisation measure and process fixes are under review, and promised a progress letter in spring 2020.
I committed in that letter to inform the House in spring 2020 about the state of affairs of these actions.
Ik heb in deze brief toegezegd uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2020 te informeren over de stand van zaken van deze acties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de maatregelen die worden getroffen in het gevangeniswezen in verband met het COVID-19 virus

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how COVID-19 measures in prisons are coordinated, how staff protection, testing, work, cell placement and electronic monitoring for ZBBI prisoners are handled. The minister answered that a central DJI crisis team coordinates measures, legal review was done, existing complaint rights remain, staff have protective equipment, and measures reduced multi-person cell use, though some questions were answered only by restating existing protocols.
The system of legal protection has not been changed. Detainees can, if they wish, file a complaint against the measures with the supervisory committee.
Het stelsel van rechtsbescherming is niet aangepast. Gedetineerden kunnen als zij dat wensen tegen de maatregelen in beklag bij de commissie van toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over berichten dat sociaal advocaten stoppen vanwege te lage vergoedingen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that social lawyers are quitting over low fees and what the government will do to keep them. The minister acknowledged the departures, pointed to temporary extra funding and reform pilots, and said access to a social lawyer remains guaranteed while declining to predict further departures.
I am closely monitoring whether there is still sufficient supply of lawyers.
Ik laat nauwlettend monitoren of er nog voldoende aanbod is van advocaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over algoritmische analyse van vonnissen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about algorithmic profiling of judges and the publication of court rulings, including France's ban on analysing judges' identities. The Minister said the analysis of judgments is longstanding but that technology allows it at larger scale, that only 2-3% of Dutch rulings are published online (rising to 5% under the agreement), and that a review of how large-scale analysis could be allowed is worth considering.
In addition, the potential negative consequences of publishing all rulings must be examined.
Daarnaast dienen potentiële negatieve consequenties van het publiceren van alle uitspraken te worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over de gevolgen van het Corona-virus voor de rechtspleging en de rechtsbescherming

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked how the Corona crisis affects criminal justice and legal protection, including the Public Prosecution Service's restricted approach, the Emergency Justice Act (Noodwet rechtspleging) and suspended community service sentences. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police, prosecutors, probation and courts have scaled back work to priority tasks, that remote legal aid is being organised and extra fees given, that the emergency act is not yet needed but would be decided via the Ministerial Crisis Committee, and that community service terms cannot currently be extended by law.
Applying the Emergency Justice Act is, given the exceptional measures it provides, not an instrument to be used lightly.
Het toepassen van de Noodwet rechtspleging is, mede gelet op de bijzondere voorzieningen die deze wet biedt, geen lichtzinnig in te zetten instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Beckerman en Van Nispen over huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis

SP MPs asked why eviction summary proceedings are treated as urgent or postponed during the coronavirus crisis, whether evictions should be halted, and whether a law banning evictions is needed. The minister answers that eviction cases are postponed except in exceptional superspoed cases, that landlord associations agreed to avoid evictions during the crisis, and that the government will use emergency legislation to extend temporary leases.
Eviction cases have not been classified as urgent by the judiciary, so for now no oral hearings take place unless the judge in summary proceedings decides a hearing must go ahead.

Huisuitzettingen zijn door de rechtspraak niet aangemerkt als urgente zaken en voorlopig vinden er daarom geen mondelinge behandelingen plaats, tenzij de rechter in kort geding oordeelt dat een zitting moet doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens de drukte niet aan kan

MPs Van Nispen and Verhoeven asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) lacks the capacity to handle its workload, including waiting times of at least six months, and about whether it must drop complaints. The minister acknowledges the shortage, notes €3.4 million added structurally in the 2019 spring memorandum and an external budget study, but declines to commit to an immediate budget increase before the study's results.
The aim of the study is to reach a shared picture of a sound financial basis for the AP to carry out all of its statutory tasks, both in the short and long term.
Doel van het onderzoek is te komen tot een gedeeld beeld van een gezonde financiële basis voor de uitoefening door de AP van al haar wettelijke taken, zowel op korte als lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen van uw Kamer over medische zorg in penitentiaire inrichtingen, detentiecentra en forensisch psychiatrische centra

An SP MP asked about medical care in prisons, detention centres and forensic psychiatric centres, including staffing shortages, waiting times for psychiatric prison places, use of isolation cells and medication safety. The Minister acknowledges recruitment difficulties and waiting lists of a few days, describes recruitment and capacity measures, and promises to review capacity in 2021 without committing to specific deadlines for resolving the problems.
The number of prisoners waiting for a place in a PPC fluctuates.
Het aantal gedetineerden dat op een plaatsing in een PPC wacht fluctueert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht dat ‘Jeugdzorginstelling eist dat ouders video van uit huis halen dochtertje van internet verwijderen’

An MP asked about a youth care institution demanding that parents remove a video of their daughter from the internet, and about complaint routes, data on complaints, grounds for ending parental authority, mediation, and parents' right to criticise providers. The minister answered that complaints can go to the institution, its complaints committee, the National Ombudsman and professional tribunals, that the courts decide on ending parental authority and the privacy conflict, and that talks with certified institutions on a framework will be considered.
Such an overview is not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de Eritreeër die tot 6 jaar cel en TBS veroordeeld is voor doodslag, verkrachting en mishandeling van een oudere dame in Amsterdam, welli

MPs Markuszower and Emiel van Dijk asked whether an Eritrean sentenced to six years and TBS for manslaughter, rape and assault could be guaranteed deportation and loss of residence after serving his sentence, and whether that matches earlier statements by the state secretary. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, said the IND will decide on revoking the residence permit once the conviction is final, and said public safety is a primary consideration.
I will not go into the substance of individual cases and cannot anticipate the IND's decision or the course of the TBS treatment.
Ik ga niet in op de inhoud van individuele zaken en kan ook niet vooruitlopen op de beslissing van de IND of het verloop van de behandeling in het TBS-traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Verhoeven over de privacyrisico’s van onveilige beveiligingscamera’s

MPs Buitenweg and Verhoeven asked the Minister for Legal Protection about privacy and security risks of insecure internet-connected security cameras, including minimum security standards, data on hacks, enforcement, and privacy by design. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to EU-level work on minimum security requirements for IoT devices, said no data on hacks is recorded, and declined to take on a coordinating role with producers, leaving that to the Dutch DPA and manufacturers.
The total number of cases per year involving hacked security cameras is not known to me.
Het totaal aantal gevallen per jaar waarbij sprake is van gehackte beveiligingscamera’s is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Tientallen camera’s houden klanten van filiaal Jumbo in de gaten: “Willen we dit”?’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why he would not provide information on legal frameworks for facial recognition, whether the AP is investigating Jumbo's cameras, what citizens can do, whether Dutch agencies work with Clearview, and related privacy questions. The minister replied that the AP has the advisory role, that the AP has contacted Jumbo which has switched off the cameras pending advice, that affected people can complain to the AP or claim damages in civil court, and that he will send a letter on the legal framework for facial recognition, including the directive covering investigative use.
As a follow-up to a motion by MPs Verhoeven and Van Dam, I am preparing a letter on the legal framework applicable to facial recognition.
Ik bereid, als uitvloeisel van een motie van de leden Verhoeven en Van Dam 4 , een brief voor over het juridisch kader dat van toepassing is op gezichtsherkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over ontvangen signalen van het afsluiten van een zwijgcontract

An MP asked whether the government still supports banning gag contracts in healthcare and youth care, how many reports the inspectorate received, what action was taken, and when the bill goes to consultation. The minister confirmed the ban policy, reported few reports (8 confirmed of 55 in 2016-2017, 11 since, none confirmed), described a warning-based response, and said the bill will go to consultation shortly and to parliament after summer 2020.
The draft bill is nearly finished. The bill will very soon be put out for consultation.
Het ontwerp van het wetsvoorstel is bijna afgerond. Het wetsvoorstel wordt zeer binnenkort in consultatie gebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van der Graaf over levenslanggestraften

MPs Groothuizen and Van der Graaf asked about the National Ombudsman's findings on the prosecution service's advice in a 2017 life-sentence pardon request, the duration of the procedure, the review framework for life sentences and the government's response to NGO submissions to the Council of Europe. The minister maintains the advice was sufficiently substantiated, the review framework complies with the ECHR, no statutory deadlines are needed, and the pardon decision remains a discretionary balancing by the Crown.
I therefore see no need to take measures on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak om op dit punt maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat juridische hulp aan lage inkomens in gevaar is door problemen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of internal conflict and dissatisfaction at the Juridisch Loket threatening legal aid for low-income people, and whether the minister would intervene or order an independent investigation. The minister answered that the matter is an internal one for the Raad van Toezicht, which has already investigated, that service continuity is assured, and that a separate ministerial investigation is not needed.
This is an internal matter. The Supervisory Board is the designated party to act on the findings and has informed me that it is doing so.
Dit is een interne kwestie. De Raad van Toezicht is de aangewezen partij om naar bevind van zaken te handelen en zij heeft mij laten weten dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Nispen, Kuiken en Van der Graaf over het onderzoekverloop naar de dood van Dascha Graafsma

MPs asked how the second opinion on the cause of Dascha Graafsma's death was set up, how bias was prevented, whether lessons would lead to rule changes, and what the government would do about the family's complaints. The minister answered that a separate police unit runs the forensic second opinion, reviewed by uninvolved prosecutors, that no rule changes are planned, and that the OM apologised and will keep communicating openly.
The OM and police have apologised for earlier communication that too firmly concluded this case was a suicide.
Het OM en politie hebben excuses gemaakt voor eerdere communicatie waarin te stellig werd geconcludeerd dat in deze zaak sprake was van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Peters over de kritiek van de toezichthouder op de marktwerking voor deurwaarders

MPs Van Nispen and Peters asked the minister whether the regulator's criticism of market competition among bailiffs (deurwaarders) should change policy and whether a new study is needed. The minister acknowledged the regulator's concerns, kept the market model, and promised a one-off tariff adjustment and a ban on price agreements that endanger bailiff independence, while rejecting a new study.
I also want to, following the Regulation on limits to tariff models for bailiffs, prohibit price agreements between the bailiff and the client that endanger the bailiff's independent position.

Ook wil ik – in navolging van de Verordening Grenzen tariefmodellen gerechtsdeurwaarders 3 – prijsafspraken tussen de gerechtsdeurwaarder en opdrachtgever verbieden die de onafhankelijke positie van de gerechtsdeurwaarder in gevaar brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg inzake het bericht dat de Consumentenbond de noodklok luidt om illegale datahandel

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a Consumer Association report on illegal data trading in Europe, including whether GDPR and UAVG are violated, why apps exclude behavioural data from personal data, and what enforcement has followed. The Minister says the GDPR and UAVG give sufficient tools, the AP has not yet imposed any sanctions for illegal sharing, and he welcomes the AP's focus on data trade and will press for stronger ePrivacy rules.
Given the effective exercise of the AP's supervisory tasks, I cannot give you more concrete information on the number of investigations or enforcement trajectories.
Gelet op een effectieve uitoefening van de toezichtstaken van de AP kan ik u geen concretere informatie geven over de hoeveelheid onderzoeken of handhavingstrajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verbeteringen voorgesteld door de Vereniging Advocatenbelangen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether he would respond to the Vereniging Advocatenbelangen's proposals to raise legal aid fees for social-law lawyers, and whether he agrees that the point rate is still insufficient. The Minister said he received the letter, referred to a separate reply to the association, agrees the fee system has fallen behind practice and needs restructuring rather than extra money, and noted the association was informed on 28 February 2020.
I share the view that the fee system of the Legal Aid Fees Decree has not kept pace with societal developments and changes in court practice.
Ik deel de mening dat het vergoedingensysteem van het Besluit vergoedingen rechtsbijstand niet mee ontwikkeld is met de maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen en veranderingen in de procespraktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Inspectie: Veilig Thuis sloot zwijgcontract met ouders’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Veilig Thuis Utrecht imposed a confidentiality contract on a family and kept an unfounded Pediatric Condition Falsification suspicion on file, and about monitoring the family. Minister De Jonge answered that the IGJ found the amended settlement no longer contained confidentiality-contract features, that the disputed clause was dropped, that correction and deletion procedures exist, and that no further steps against Veilig Thuis Utrecht are needed.
It is not for me to judge the conduct of professionals in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over het handelen van professionals in individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Tekort aan psychiaters vertraagt rechtszaken’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about shortages of psychiatrists and psychologists at the NIFP causing delayed pro Justitia reports and court cases. The minister acknowledged the shortage as worrying, described temporary measures such as triage, a shorter report variant, an accelerated training route and a pilot increasing hours per report, but did not present a fundamental structural fix.
The NIFP is struggling with a shortage of available pro Justitia (pJ) reporters.
Het NIFP kampt met een tekort aan beschikbare pro Justitia (pJ)-rapporteurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Raad voor de Rechtspraak een schadevergoeding van een oud-rechter moet betalen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the Judiciary Council should bear and recover the damages a former judge owes a lawyer after being found to have lied, given the indemnity the Council granted him. The Minister answered that the indemnity is legally valid and no realistic recovery is possible, so the Council bears all costs, and that the Council has said the indemnity was a one-off.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onvrede en een staking onder tolken en vertalers

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about dissatisfaction and a strike among interpreters and translators, citing unchanged fees since 1981 and budget cuts threatening legal quality. The minister said the impact of the strike is limited, and announced tendering of all interpreting services with statutory minimum rates, while acknowledging the sector's concerns and promising monitoring and further consultation.
We are therefore moving to tender all interpreting and translation services and introduce minimum rates.
We gaan dan ook over tot het aanbesteden van alle tolk- en vertaaldiensten en de invoering van minimumtarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Afwijzing vordering TUL in 2 strafzaken’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Gelderland court ruling that refused to enforce suspended sentences despite convicting the defendants of new offences, because under the new Wet USB no appeal lies against such enforcement decisions. The minister agreed that enforcing a suspended sentence before the new conviction is final would conflict with the presumption of innocence, said CJIB measures now prevent such enforcement, and committed to amending the law soon.
I will bring this legislative amendment into procedure at very short notice.
Ik zal deze wetswijziging op zeer korte termijn in procedure brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over een ‘Decision on interim measure’ van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

An MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about a European Court of Human Rights interim measure concerning a suspect held beyond 10 days in the Philipsburg police cells, and about detention conditions on Sint Maarten. The minister answered that the detainee was transferred to Point Blanche prison, that Sint Maarten lacks prison capacity and has adjusted its procedure, and that the Netherlands is concerned but Sint Maarten must act, with container cells offered as support.
It is up to Sint Maarten to take measures to improve the situation.
Het is aan Sint Maarten om maatregelen te nemen om de situatie te verbeteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over het bericht dat zorginstellingen misbruik lijken te maken van de regeling waarmee zij aanstelling of ontslag van een bewindvoerder, mentor of curator mogen vragen

Two MPs (Van Nispen and Hijink, SP) asked about reports that care institutions are misusing their power to request appointment or dismissal of guardians and administrators, and whether judges adequately check such requests and whether guardians are dependent on care institutions. Minister Dekker answered that the figures were misread (about 20 institutional requests per year since 2017), that safeguards against conflicts of interest exist, and that the evaluation did not show clear misuse, while promising to ask care umbrella organisations to raise the issue with members.
When a care institution files a dismissal or appointment request, the judge assesses the merits of the request and weighs all interests involved.
Als een zorginstelling een ontslag- en benoemingsverzoek indient, beoordeelt de rechter de gegrondheid van het verzoek en weegt hij alle betrokken belangen af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht “Die man kent onze zoon helemaal niet”

An MP asked whether care institutions use court proceedings to remove family members as guardians or administrators, whether guardians are financially dependent on institutions, and whether mediation should be mandatory before removal. The minister says such petitions are about 20 per year, sees no reason to restrict access to court, notes conflict-of-interest safeguards exist, and declines to mandate mediation.
I agree that conflicts between care institutions and administrators/mentors should preferably be resolved outside the court.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat conflicten tussen zorginstellingen en bewindvoerders/mentoren bij voorkeur buiten de rechter om worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over gebrek aan zittingscapaciteit bij extra beveiligde rechtbanken

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the shortage of hearing capacity in the existing extra-secure courtrooms (the Bunker in Amsterdam and Justitieel Complex Schiphol), which are almost fully booked for 2020 largely due to the MH17 trial, and about the consequences and planned measures. The minister confirmed the capacity problem, said delays are likely, and said talks with the Council for the Judiciary are ongoing without committing to specific measures or costs yet.
I am holding talks with the Council about the expected need for additional courtrooms and the possibilities for extra capacity on this point.
Ik voer gesprekken met de Raad over de verwachte behoefte aan extra zittingszalen en de mogelijkheden voor eventuele extra capaciteit op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Groothuizen en Van den Berge over de werkwijze van de meervoudige kamers van de Hoge Raad

MPs Van Nispen, Groothuizen and Van den Berge asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the Supreme Court's practice of 'reservists' taking part in deliberations conflicts with articles 75 and 5 of the Wet RO. The Minister answered that reservists only give legal input in deliberations, do not decide cases or join the final vote, so no conflict with the law arises and no amendment is needed.
In my view there is therefore no reason to amend the law.
Mijns inziens bestaat er dan ook geen aanleiding om de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over het bericht dat de veiligheid in de gevangenis van Lelystad in gevaar is

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reported rises in prison incidents, staffing shortages, mega-prisons, and whether multi-person cells and isolation cells remain workable. The minister replied that total incidents have fallen, that serious violence against staff prompted a further DJI review due before summer 2020, that staffing is being addressed through recruitment, and that multi-person cell use and isolation placements remain appropriate.
I have asked DJI to conduct further research into this.
Ik heb DJI gevraagd hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de financiële tarieven in de forensische zorgsector

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about inadequate tariffs in forensic care, noting that providers representing about 30 percent of capacity have started a summary proceeding over the tariffs, and questioned whether the tariffs safeguard security. The Minister replied that the NZa-set maximum tariffs are considered cost-covering, that the court found DJI insufficiently motivated its discounts, and that he is in talks with providers and willing to ensure adequate tariffs, while the NZa tariff questions are part of a pending objection procedure.
The court has now ruled that DJI, in applying discounts, did not sufficiently justify that a realistic tariff exists for those products to which a discount was applied.
De rechter heeft nu geoordeeld dat DJI, bij het toepassen van kortingen, onvoldoende gemotiveerd heeft dat dan sprake is van een reëel tarief voor die producten waar een korting op is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het id Van Nispen over de pilot met rechtsbijstandverlening door Achmea

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the legal aid pilot run by Achmea/LegalGuard, including its commercial interests, the filmed work visit, the legal basis under the Legal Aid Act, funding, and low uptake. The Minister answers that the pilot is a lawful provision under the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, denies any commercial promotion, and says the pilot will run to March 2020 with lessons drawn despite low participation.
That is why the pilot will not be stopped prematurely by the Raad.
Daarom wordt de pilot door de Raad niet voortijdig stopgezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Hogere straffen voor geweld, lagere straffen voor drugs’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether it is undesirable that serious drug offences and threats receive lower sentences, and whether maximum penalties should be raised. The minister declined to take a position on sentences imposed by judges, said the research does not show a clear trend, and saw no need to raise maximum penalties.
However, I do not consider it appropriate to express a view on the level of sentences imposed by judges.
Ik acht het echter niet opportuun om mij uit te spreken over de hoogte van door rechters opgelegde straffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over de uitzending van Pauw op 16 december 2019 en de tweet van Peter R. de Vries op 17 december 2019

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Pauw broadcast on the non-appearance of detained suspect Gökmen T. at his hearing, the handling of victim communication, the choice of courtroom, and Peter R. de Vries's tweet disputing the broadcast's account. The minister explained the existing legal framework, the planned mandatory-appearance bill, the prison intervention team deployment, and the court's courtroom and video arrangements, and committed to improved victim information for the next hearing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Verdachte steekpartij Den Haag gevaar voor zichzelf en omgeving, maar werd niet opgepakt’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a stabbing suspect, already ordered into forced psychiatric care, was not picked up after failing to appear, and about the chronology of care and police contacts. The government declined to give the detailed chronology, citing ongoing criminal investigation and a parallel IGJ inspection, and only committed to informing the House of relevant findings later.
Since a criminal investigation is ongoing in the case and the trial against the suspect has yet to take place, no statement can be made about the precise sequence of events.
Nu in de zaak strafrechtelijk onderzoek wordt gedaan en het proces tegen de verdachte nog moet worden gevoerd, kan over de precieze gang van zaken geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de veiligheidssituatie in het Justitieel Centrum voor Somatische Zorg te Scheveningen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a cell fire at the JCvSZ prison in Scheveningen, fire-safety arrangements, hygiene shortcomings flagged by the health inspectorate, reports of a climate of fear, and protection of whistleblowers. The minister answered that fire safety is adequate, that the incident was caused by a prisoner burning papers and was handled quickly, that hygiene improvements are underway with a report due in spring 2020, that whistleblowers are protected by law, and that an inspection orientation on the fear-culture signals was completed and sent to parliament on 20 January 2020.
DJI is always open to signals from the work floor, and reporters of possible misconduct are taken seriously in accordance with the laws and regulations on whistleblowers.
DJI staat altijd open voor signalen vanaf de werkvloer en melders van eventuele misstanden worden, conform de wet- en regelgeving inzake klokkenluiders, serieus genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het personeelstekort in jeugdgevangenissen

MPs Van den Berge, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about staff shortages in youth detention centres, including juveniles being temporarily placed in a women's prison, closures, turnover, sick leave and the Juvaid incident. The Minister answered that the problem is staff shortage rather than a lack of beds, detailed staffing and absence figures, and described the Ter Peel arrangement and measures taken at Juvaid.
I am aware of that. Should there be cause to inform you, I will do so.
Ik ben daarvan op de hoogte. Mocht er aanleiding zijn u te informeren, dan zal ik dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat experts en slachtoffers zorgen hebben over het stoppen van Sektesignaal

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether experts and former cult members are right to worry that closing the Sektesignaal information centre leaves victims without support, and how sharing of information and reporting would work afterwards. The minister disagreed with the concerns, pointed to a 2013 WODC study and the low incidence of cult abuses, and said reporting and information sharing would run through police, inspectorates and the RIEC network.
Abuses within cults occur only to a limited extent in the Netherlands.
Misstanden binnen sekten komen in Nederland beperkt voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de overname van jeugdzorginstelling Juzt is afgeketst

An SP MP asked why the takeover of the near-bankrupt youth care provider Juzt failed, who guarantees the funding, and how clients and staff are affected. The minister explains that bankruptcy was averted through municipal loans and a €3 million liquidity loan from VWS, that care is being transferred in phases to other providers, and that regional and national cooperation on youth care will be strengthened.
Before 1 March 2020 we will inform the House further about our policy intentions in this regard.
Voor 1 maart 2020 zullen wij uw Kamer nader informeren over onze beleidsvoornemens daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over kinderen die seksueel zijn misbruikt en onvoldoende hulp krijgen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health and justice ministers about child sexual abuse victims who receive insufficient care, including misdiagnosis, referrals between services, use of isolation, and funding problems at Centres for Sexual Violence. The minister acknowledged difficulties in recognising trauma and referral delays, outlined programmes and pilots, and said the exact numbers are not known while committing to further research and a study with the Dutch Rapporteur.
The requested figures are not known.
De gevraagde cijfers zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake het bericht ‘Tientallen camera's houden klanten van filiaal Jumbo in de gaten: 'Willen we dit?'’

An MP (Verhoeven, D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a Jumbo store uses facial recognition cameras on customers, and about the legal framework under the GDPR, whether the practice is compliant, and whether businesses will be informed. The minister replied that GDPR supervision lies with the Dutch Data Protection Authority, outlined the biometric data rules (Art. 9 GDPR, Art. 29 UAVG) and a planned amendment, and promised a letter to parliament on facial recognition law and a notice to a national crime-prevention platform.
Supervision of compliance with the GDPR is assigned to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP).
Toezicht op de naleving van de AVG is belegd bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een wettelijke regeling voor zaakstoedeling

The SP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the delayed publication of the judiciary's Code of case allocation, its transparency, the implications of the ECHR Miracle Europe judgment, and how the flex pool of judges fits in. The Minister answered that the Code is expected to be published in February 2020 with implementation by mid-2020, that he is considering whether statutory anchoring is needed, and that the Code's principles also apply to the flex pool.
The Code of case allocation is expected to be published on rechtspraak.nl in February 2020.
De Code zaakstoedeling zal naar verwachting in februari 2020 op rechtspraak.nl bekend worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Markuszower over het bericht dat KLM weigerde mee te werken aan het vertrek van Lili en Howick

MPs Van Dijk and Markuszower asked whether KLM's refusal to fly two Armenian children deported by the Netherlands undermined court rulings, how often airlines have refused deportations, and what the costs are. The State Secretary referred to the Inspectorate's report and its announced measures, said airlines generally cooperate but the captain may refuse passengers for safety reasons, and said the state cannot assess the costs or KLM's reasoning.
I cannot speculate on the considerations KLM made before deciding not to transport the two children.
Ik kan niet speculeren over de afwegingen die de KLM heeft gemaakt voorafgaand aan het besluit de twee kinderen niet te vervoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de actie #ikpiketnietmeer van 1 t/m 14 januari 2020 en het breken van deze staking

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many criminal-defence and youth lawyers withdrew from legal-aid duty rosters during the January 2020 strike, whether the reported 39% non-availability was accurate, and why emergency fees were paid for stand-in duty while structural fee increases were refused. The minister said the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand cannot determine how many lawyers withdrew specifically because of the strike, confirmed the 39% figure only as non-availability without reasons, and explained the emergency per-diem arrangement as a temporary measure funded within the Raad's budget.
The Raad voor Rechtsbijstand has informed me that this information cannot be traced.
De raad voor rechtsbijstand heeft mij laten weten dat deze informatie niet te achterhalen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het onderbrengen van IS-kinderen bij IS-aanhangers

MP Baudet asked whether placing IS-returnee children with grandparents flagged as IS sympathisers risks transmitting extremist ideology, how the child protection council and the national extremism support point missed the warning, and whether the council neglected its statutory duty. The minister answered that no radicalisation indicators were found at placement, that procedures were followed, and referred to a separate evaluation letter for the details and improvement points.
The Child Protection Council followed the agreed procedure.
De RvdK heeft de afgesproken procedure doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Brenk over het plenaire debat inzake het bericht dat het UWV ten onrechte uitkeringen verstrekt aan gevangenen (d.d. 4 september 2019)

MPs Krol and Van Brenk asked why fully non-accountable tbs patients in forensic care can keep their social security benefits, how many receive them, and whether the government will fix this. The minister says current law and Centrale Raad van Beroep case law require continuation in such cases, the number is not recorded, and the absence of a co-payment will be included in the evaluation of the Wfz, with a possible solution if unjust situations are found.
This is not known / cannot be determined.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van Dam en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Overheid sponsort eigen verzet’

MPs asked whether government-subsidised legal aid for environmental and other organisations suing the state, including squatter-type groups, is appropriate and whether the practice is being evaluated. The minister answered that subsidised legal aid can cover administrative cases, that stacking of procedures is possible but no business model is evident, that eligibility rules apply, and that the long-overdue evaluation of the reduced environmental-organisation contribution will be shared with parliament in the first half of 2020.
This evaluation, however, never took place and is now being carried out after all.
Deze evaluatie heeft evenwel nooit plaatsgevonden en wordt nu alsnog uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Verdachte moord Bouwlust ontsnapte aan toezicht enkelband’

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the suspect in a Den Haag murder, who had escaped electronic monitoring, had a record of absconding, whether assessment errors were made, and how often lethal offences by electronically monitored offenders occur. The minister answered that the criminal investigation is ongoing, gave only general detention history (a 2013 Turkish sentence transferred to the Netherlands, a penitentiary programme approved in 2019 on positive advice from the OM, reclassering and police, and a first escape on 29 September 2019), and said such cases are not centrally registered.
The criminal investigation led by the public prosecution service is still ongoing.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek onder leiding van het OM is nog bezig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de verstoring van de dodenherdenking door gedetineerden vanuit de P.I. Vught

MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether financial compensation to a prisoner for a minor procedural error is appropriate, and whether the minister would discuss this with the Vught prison supervisory committee and the RSJ. The minister said the compensation decision lies with the independent complaints committee under Pbw article 68 and declined to judge that case, but agreed to consult the RSJ, and will ask DJI to appeal such decisions where it disagrees, possibly amending the Pbw if that fails.
This case gives me reason to ask DJI to appeal in cases where DJI believes a financial compensation should not be awarded.
Deze casus is voor mij aanleiding om DJI te vragen om in gevallen waarin DJI meent dat een financiële tegemoetkoming niet behoort te worden vastgesteld in beroep te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het blog van de voorzitter van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Jonge Strafrechtadvocaten (NVJSA)

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a blog by the NVJSA chair criticising the design sessions for legal aid, including a €25,200 external consultancy and claims of closed discussions and irreversible steps. The Minister answered that the consultancy followed procurement rules, that the design sessions were open, and that urgency justified quick steps on family law.
The costs for the external consultancy ultimately amounted to €25,200 (excluding VAT).
De kosten voor het externe adviesbureau bedroegen uiteindelijk € 25.200 (exclusief BTW).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Tbs’ers uit frustratie ontsnapt’?

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of staff shortages and turnover in forensic care and their effect on safety and treatment of tbs patients. The minister acknowledged shortages, cited a 28.5 million euro package and a taskforce with a recruitment campaign, and gave no precise vacancy figures because most providers are private.
I have no insight into the precise extent of the staff shortages.
Ik heb geen zicht op de precieze omvang van de personeelstekorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat Ikea een proef doet met sollicitatiegesprekken thuis op de bank

An MP asked whether the Minister for Legal Protection would consider reinstating home visits to candidates for prison service posts, as a service and to gain insight into applicants' personal circumstances. The minister answered that home visits are not standard practice since the VOG requirement, that they would burden candidates, and that DJI continuously seeks to improve its recruitment process.

Visiting candidates for a post in a penitentiary institution at home burdens the candidate more, because they would still have to come in later to complete additional selection steps that cannot be organised in a home setting.

Het thuis bezoeken van kandidaten voor een functie in een penitentiaire inrichting belast de kandidaat meer, omdat deze op een later moment alsnog langs zal moeten komen om aanvullende selectiestappen te doorlopen die niet binnen een thuissituatie te organiseren zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het werkdrukonderzoek Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) 2020 van FNV onder gevangenispersoneel

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection how the FNV workload survey of prison staff can show rising workload, whether the minister will reconsider multi-person cell use, and whether the EUR 100 million personnel fund will be made structural. The minister acknowledges the workload signals, points to recruitment and retention efforts and the convenant with unions, defends multi-person cells as a legitimate detention facility, and says the funds are reserved for 2019-2021 with further investment to be weighed afterwards.
I am still awaiting publication of the FNV report.
Ik ben nog in afwachting van de publicatie van het rapport van de FNV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vele klachten van een buurt na de komst van een forensisch centrum

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about many neighbourhood complaints after a private forensic youth centre opened in Amsterdam-Noord, including unclear responsibilities, lack of prior consultation, and whether the ministry funds places there. The minister replied that the centre is private, not run by the ministry, that the ministry buys no places, and that responsibility for neighbourhood issues, complaints, and oversight of local impacts lies with the municipality, with the Inspectorate for Healthcare and Youth able to act on care quality.
I therefore cannot answer your specific questions about the incidents and contact with the neighbourhood.
Uw specifieke vragen over de incidenten en contact met de buurt kan ik daarom niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over een voormalige vruchtbaarheidskliniek in Oosterbeek

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked about a former fertility clinic in Oosterbeek where a doctor may have fathered around 150 children, asking about the legal framework of the 1970s-80s, whether affected children can find their donor, and what the ministers will do to help. The Minister replied that no specific donor-registration law existed before 2004 and no evidence shows the clinic was illegal then, and that missing clinic records mean donors cannot be traced, so the only option left is free registration in the Fiom KID-DNA databank.
The administration of this fertility clinic is missing, so it is not possible to determine from it which donors donated at this clinic.
De administratie van deze vruchtbaarheidskliniek ontbreekt, zodat het niet mogelijk is op basis daarvan te achterhalen welke donoren in deze kliniek hebben gedoneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het handhaven van de stakingsacties door sociaal advocaten in januari 2020

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many social lawyers had signed up for January 2020 duty rosters after the deadline and how many still maintained their strike, and what the consequences were. The minister answered that about 1850 lawyers are now available, that the raad voor rechtsbijstand does not record how many strike, and that the few local gaps are being addressed by the council.
The raad voor rechtsbijstand does not record how many lawyers are on strike.
De raad voor rechtsbijstand registreert niet hoeveel advocaten staken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat forensische zorginstellingen onvoldoende gefinancierd worden

MP Van Nispen asked whether forensic care institutions are underfunded, whether three tbs clinics went to court over tariffs, and whether the ministry's tariffs fall below NZa maximums. Minister Dekker replied that DJI follows NZa maximum tariffs with some discounts, that no price negotiations took place, that the financing increase is adequate, and that a blanket 10% increase is rejected.
The tariffs applied nationally by DJI are based on the maximum tariffs set by the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa).
De tarieven die landelijk worden gehanteerd door DJI zijn gebaseerd op de maximale tarieven zoals vastgesteld door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (Nza).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over kredietwaardigheidsonderzoeken

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about creditworthiness checks by credit bureaus, including use of postcode and age data, transparency, and redress. The minister answered that existing GDPR rules and the AP and NVH complaint routes apply, that the government will seek EU-level safeguards for algorithmic decisions, and that no new national rules are announced.
These third parties may only provide this data if a valid legal basis exists, with the necessity of the processing motivated and demonstrated.
Deze derden mogen deze gegevens alleen verstrekken indien hiertoe een geldige grondslag bestaat waarbij de noodzaak van de verwerking wordt gemotiveerd en aangetoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het functioneren van het tbs-stelsel

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether tbs clinic Hoeve Boschoord downplays incidents to avoid capacity and funding limits, whether the Inspectorate's ongoing thematic study covers tbs treatment duration, the financial norms and related incentives, and whether a separate study should follow. The minister said the Inspectorate has started an orientation on Boschoord, that there is no reason yet to assume a national problem, that the Inspectorate's resocialisation study will examine treatment duration, financial norms and leave phasing, and that it will inform parliament on the wider inquiry as soon as possible.
The Inspectorate immediately started an orientation and will soon assess to what extent further investigation is needed.
De IJenV is direct een oriëntatie gestart en beoordeelt spoedig in hoeverre nader onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over evenwichtigere griffierechttarieven

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about proposals to rebalance court filing fees (griffierechten): lowering fees for small claims while raising fees for large claims, whether past fee changes raised revenue, whether high fees deter large cases, why the state keeps surplus on default cases, and how to improve SME access to justice. The Minister rejects the large-claim surcharge as a budget risk, declines to quantify past revenue gains, argues fees should not track real costs, and points to a planned budget-neutral bill lowering small-claim fees.
I cannot give an amount of additional revenue resulting from the changes to the court fee rates in 2010 and 2011.
Ik kan geen bedrag noemen aan extra inkomsten als gevolg van de wijzigingen in de griffierechttarieven uit 2010 en 2011.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Gevangenis Pointe Blanche: The Devil’s Rock van Sint Maarten'

An MP asked about reports on the Pointe Blanche prison in Sint Maarten, progress on improvement measures, the status of Council of Europe supervision after the Corallo judgment, and whether TBS (ter beschikking stelling) can be imposed and executed in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The Minister reported slow progress on prison improvements, marine assistance in late October and November, periodic monitoring with Sint Maarten, that Council of Europe assessment is awaited in early 2020, and that TBS is executed by the countries themselves with no facilities in the Netherlands.
With Sint Maarten, progress on the agreed improvement measures is reviewed every 2 weeks.
Met Sint Maarten wordt elke 2 weken gekeken naar de voortgang van de afgesproken verbetermaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Toorenburg over misstanden bij adopties en de betrokkenheid en wetenschap van de Nederlandse overheid

MPs Van Nispen and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about irregularities in intercountry adoptions, government knowledge of them, and whether the inquiry should be broadened and whether China adoptions remain responsible. The minister mostly pointed to the ongoing COIA inquiry, announced stricter oversight of sending countries, and said adoptions from China remain justified, while declining to give an interim report yet.
I attach importance to awaiting the findings of the COIA before being able to make statements about what is indicated in the question.
Ik hecht eraan de bevindingen van de COIA af te wachten alvorens uitspraken te kunnen doen over hetgeen in de vraagstelling wordt aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het zinloze karakter van de vervangende hechtenis bij betalingsonmacht

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about imprisoning people who cannot pay a compensation measure, and whether this breaches Article 5 ECHR. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to the upcoming gijzeling regime under the Wet USB that will exempt proven inability to pay, and rejects the ECHR argument while promising to review CJIB payment arrangements.
The starting point when applying gijzeling is that no one is detained if inability to pay is demonstrably present.
Uitgangspunt bij toepassing van de gijzeling is dat niet wordt gegijzeld als aantoonbaar sprake is van betalingsonmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over een mogelijk cookiewall-verbod

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a possible ban on cookiewalls, how freely given consent works under the GDPR and Telecommunications Act, the roles of the Dutch data protection authority (AP) and competition authority (ACM), and the state of EU negotiations. The minister answered that consent must be genuinely free, that the Netherlands supports a cookiewall ban in the EU ePrivacy regulation, and that the Council is unlikely to adopt it, while the enforcement and EU details are largely left to the AP and to the negotiations.
It is for the supervisory authority, in this case the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), and ultimately for the court, to interpret what this means in a specific case.
Het is aan de toezichthouder, in casu de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (hierna: AP), en uiteindelijk aan de rechter, om duiden wat dit in een concreet geval betekent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Wekelijks tbs-geweld’

An MP asked whether incidents of violence in TBS clinics are reported and prosecuted, and whether TBS should be replaced by prison. The minister answered that clinics must report offences and DJI requires complaints for violence against staff, but the OM does not track prosecutions centrally, and defended TBS as more effective than prison for preventing reoffending.
The Public Prosecution Service does not centrally keep track of whether criminal offences have been committed against staff of TBS institutions.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt niet centraal bij of strafbare feiten zijn gepleegd tegen medewerkers van tbs-instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een leerling-zweminstructeur die wordt verdacht van ontucht met minderjarigen

An MP asked the ministers whether a swim instructor suspected of sexual misconduct with minors should have had a VOG, whether mandatory VOGs should apply to swim instructors, and whether clubs should be checked and inform parents. The minister condemned the conduct, declined to discuss the individual case during the criminal investigation and for privacy, and rejected a statutory VOG obligation for the sector while promoting voluntary VOG use within integrity policy.
Due to the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot answer these questions. Moreover, the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
In verband met de privacy van de betrokkene kan ik deze vragen niet beantwoorden. Bovendien loopt het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de reclameactiviteiten van Toto

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether Toto's gambling advertising via KNVB partner mailings and the Voetbal.nl app, which reached some minors, is acceptable and whether enforcement is needed. The minister answered that the rules permit such mailings, that minors were reached by a human error and apologised for, and declined to ask the Gambling Authority to enforce or convene parties.
It is very unfortunate that in this case, as I understood from the KNVB, due to a human error, this single mailing was sent to minors.
Het is zeer onfortuinlijk dat in dit geval, naar ik van de KNVB begreep door een menselijke fout, deze enkele mailing wel aan minderjarigen is gericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Middendorp over de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens

MPs Van Gent and Middendorp asked whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) gives unclear guidance, particularly on cookies, and whether an external review should address its advisory role. The minister replied that the AP offers general and specific guidance, that cookiewalls are not permitted under the GDPR consent rules, and that the planned external review focuses mainly on the AP's financing, with guidance being one of its statutory tasks.
That is why it is possible for organisations and their data protection officers to submit specific questions to the AP in addition to general guidance.
Daarom is het voor organisaties en hun functionarissen gegevensbescherming (FG's) mogelijk, om naast algemene voorlichting, ook specifieke vragen aan de AP voor te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onrust bij de rechtbank Noord-Nederland

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reported unrest and a culture of fear at the Noord-Nederland district court, and whether he will back an independent investigation proposed by unions. The Minister acknowledges the situation, notes the court president has stepped down, and says the Council for the Judiciary will discuss the situation with the court, including the union's proposal, without committing to an investigation himself.
The Council for the Judiciary has stated in a press release that it will discuss with the court what is needed for the organisation and its employees.
De Raad voor de rechtspraak heeft in een persbericht laten weten met de rechtbank in gesprek te gaan over wat nodig is voor de organisatie en haar medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht ‘deurwaarders die onterecht kosten in rekening brengen’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a disciplinary ruling that a bailiff firm (GGN) wrongly charged costs to around 34,000 debtors and whether the firm must repay them, and about the suitability of digital arbitration (e-Court) for such cases. The minister said that the civil court must decide on repayment and the ruling does not itself require active repayment, that parties should resolve whether debtors were harmed, and that e-Court can contribute if legal requirements are met.
That is for the civil judge to determine.
Dat is aan de burgerlijke rechter om vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over verslavende games voor minderjarigen

An MP asked the Minister whether addictive game elements, loot boxes and rising youth gaming addiction should be banned for minors, and whether that conflicts with the ban on minors in gambling. The Minister shares concern about gambling elements in games, notes that only loot boxes that are gambling under the Wok are prohibited and enforced by the Ksa, points to PEGI self-regulation, and promises to discuss strengthening PEGI with NICAM.
I share the view that it is undesirable for minors to be exposed in games to elements that can carry a risk of addiction.
Ik deel de mening dat het ongewenst is dat minderjarigen in games kunnen worden blootgesteld aan elementen die een verslavingsrisico met zich mee kunnen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over "de landsadvocaat die ruim 2,1 miljoen euro verdiende aan de Groninger gaswinning"

SP MPs asked for a total overview of legal costs in Groningen gas-damage lawsuits, costs per case, and how the State Attorney's costs relate to the damage claims and the 200,000 euro legal-aid amendment. The minister provided yearly fees for the State Attorney in civil suits against the State, the number and cost of the six Northern Netherlands cases, declined to discuss the individual Nijhof case, and said the costs are not charged to compensation budgets while cost-minimisation remains the aim.
I cannot go into individual procedures that have been or are being conducted.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele procedures die zijn of worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Toorenburg en Van der Graaf over de impact van gokelementen in games op jongeren

MPs from the CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries about rising problematic gaming among young people, the spread of gambling-like loot boxes, the slow enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit against game developers, and age classification. The government answered that the rise may not be confirmed by current data pending a legal basis for LADIS, rejected a national ban as ineffective, said enforcement is complex and partly confidential, and pointed to prevention, industry dialogue and PEGI self-regulation.
Not everything happens in public. It is a careful process that must also be able to withstand scrutiny in court.
Niet alles gebeurt in de openbaarheid. Het is een zorgvuldig proces dat ook bij de rechter moet kunnen standhouden.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld en Wörstendörfer over ‘jeugdzorg wil actie tegen agressie’: ‘je bent gewaarschuwd ik maak je kapot’

MPs Wörstendörfer and Westerveld asked the government about rising aggression against youth care workers, sentencing, complaints handling, and privacy of professionals' data in the registry. The minister answered that aggression is widespread and measures are underway, that the OM applies a 200% aggravation for such offences, that complaints procedures are being evaluated, and that the registry data leak has been corrected.
I will talk with the sector, the police and the Public Prosecution Service to find out whether additional steps are needed.
Ik ga in gesprek met de branche, de politie en het OM te achterhalen of extra stappen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het bericht over het bericht dat er een onveilige situatie is binnen een TBS-kliniek

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of an unsafe situation at TBS clinic Hoeve Boschoord, staffing shortages and funding cuts in forensic care, and an incident of physical aggression. Minister Dekker answered that management heard staff concerns, DJI will monitor the situation, the Inspectie was asked to investigate, and a Taskforce and workforce measures address staffing and administrative burden.
That is why DJI will closely follow the situation at Hoeve Bosschoord in the coming period.
Daarom zal DJI de situatie in Hoeve Bosschoord de komende tijd aandachtig volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘het verslavend karakter van onderdelen van videospellen’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about loot boxes in EA's Fifa games, including whether they amount to illegal gambling and why the Kansspelautoriteit has not acted. The minister answered that only loot boxes meeting the legal definition of a game of chance fall under the Wok, that the Ksa has sufficient capacity but does not comment on ongoing investigations, that the Belgian removal of Fifa coins does not automatically satisfy Dutch law, and that the government will talk with NICAM and commissioned WODC research.
It makes no statements about whether investigations are ongoing or not.
Over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken doet zij geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar oorzaken van langlopende letselschadezaken

MPs Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen and Kuiken asked why the University of Utrecht study into causes of long-running personal injury claims is delayed, and whether its independence is compromised given the involvement of the Letselschade Raad, insurers and QCPP. The minister attributes the delay to the broad design, privacy preparation, and insurer response rates, and defends the study's independence and balanced steering committee.
There are no reasons for me to doubt the independence and objectivity of the commissioning party.
Er zijn voor mij geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid en objectiviteit van de opdrachtgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het rapport van de Commissie-Oskam over tarieven en marktwerking voor deurwaarders

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Commissie-Oskam report on bailiff tariffs and market competition, including doubts about the reliability of the underlying Pro Facto and Cebeon studies, performance contracts, and whether market competition should be curbed. The Minister declined to pre-judge the report, said a full policy response would follow this year, and rejected the claim that market competition has gone too far while calling performance contracts undesirable where they only serve to let clients profit from official acts.
I do not want to anticipate the substantive response to the report. I am currently preparing it and expect to send it to your House this year.
Ik wil niet vooruit lopen op de inhoudelijke reactie op het rapport. Deze bereid ik thans voor en verwacht ik dit jaar nog naar uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over de artikelen ‘Rechtsbijstandverlener tart advocatenregels’ en ‘Kleine bedrijven vinden de rechter te duur’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a rule by the Dutch Bar Association that bars advocates in employment from serving clients without legal expenses insurance, and about whether small businesses find legal costs too high. The Minister says access to justice must be affordable, that the Bar Association is responsible for reviewing its rules, and that she will inform parliament after the bar's review.
I expect the NOvA to critically review its rules when new forms of service delivery emerge.
Ik verwacht van de NOvA dat zij regels kritisch tegen het licht houdt op het moment dat nieuwe vormen van dienstverlening ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Volgens minister helpt privacy bedrijven om klanten binnen te houden’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the ban on cookie walls will be brought to the attention of companies and whether privacy-by-design requires default settings that prevent tracking. The minister replied that the Dutch Data Protection Authority has issued guidance, is intensifying enforcement, and that consent for tracking cookies must be opt-in and cannot be pre-ticked.
The AP has further informed me that it sent a letter with the interpretation of the norm to the organisations about which it received the most complaints.
De AP heeft mij voorts laten weten de organisaties waar zij de meeste klachten over heeft ontvangen een brief te hebben gestuurd met de normuitleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van den Berge en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Minister Dekker kan teloorgang sociale advocatuur niets schelen; NOvA blijft weg uit topberaad’

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how to react to the Dutch Bar Association (NOvA) withdrawing from the top-level consultation on legal aid reform, which it called pointless, and why trust had collapsed. The minister regrets the NOvA's decision, says the door stays open, explains that no extra budget was provided in line with the coalition agreement, and points to a governance review by Bureau Gateway, inviting the NOvA back to talks.
I have invited the NOvA to resume talks in the short term.
Ik heb de NOvA uitgenodigd om op korte termijn weer in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het budget voor mediation in strafzaken bijna op is

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the budget for criminal mediation was nearly exhausted and how future shortfalls would be prevented. The minister said extra underspending on youth funds would cover most of the 2019 gap, leaving about 40 mediations unfunded, and committed to resolving that with the judiciary while noting the 2020 budget is fixed.

Now that it appears the funds for 2019 are likely insufficient, I have informed the National Coordinator for Mediation in Criminal Cases at the Judiciary Council that the expected underspending on youth funds can be used for non-youth criminal cases.

Nu het er naar uit ziet dat de middelen voor 2019 waarschijnlijk niet toereikend zijn, heb ik de Landelijk Coördinator Mediation in Strafzaken bij de Raad voor de rechtspraak laten weten dat de verwachte onderuitputting bij de middelen voor jeugdzaken ingezet kan worden voor andere dan jeugdstrafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het  blog  ‘Andere tijden voor de rechtsbescherming’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a blog criticising legal aid pay, an advocates' piket strike in early 2020, and the cost comparisons used in government arguments. The Minister acknowledges the strike and the pay gap for social lawyers, cites cuts and reforms over two decades, and says a reform within the existing budget is planned.
I am currently mapping out how I will implement this motion.
Ik breng op dit moment in kaart hoe ik uitvoering ga geven aan deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de vrijlating van een gevaarlijk persoon uit de Woenselse Poort

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the release of a dangerous man from the Woenselse Poort TBS clinic, the Reclassering's recidivism assessment, and whether minimum sentences will be introduced. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, denied that anyone was released for non-cooperation, cited existing and pending measures (the straffen en beschermen bill, Wet Langdurig Toezicht, forensic care rules) and rejected minimum sentences as incompatible with judicial sentencing discretion.
It is not appropriate for me to go into this individual case in more detail.
Het past mij niet om op deze individuele casus nader in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Toetsingscommissies euthanasie gaan meer naar de context kijken’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Tellegen asked about reports that euthanasia review committees will look more at context, and about a proposal to let the Supreme Court rule on euthanasia law questions directly. The government said it is examining allowing cassation in the interest of the law against RTE rulings, is studying ways to protect doctors from lengthy criminal proceedings, and that talks with stakeholders have already taken place, with a substantive letter promised this autumn.
Your House has been promised that this proposal will be examined.
Aan uw Kamer is toegezegd dat dit voorstel wordt onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gevangeniswezen, het tegengaan van het binnensmokkelen van verboden spullen en de inhuur van externen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about contraband smuggling into the Zaanstad prison, staffing and overtime pressure, multi-person cell use, vacancies, and external hiring of security staff. The minister said the smuggler was a visitor caught by police, that staffing and cell-use measures are being managed, and that external staff undergo the same VOG screening, while the government will consider further measures on centralised registration of dismissed contract staff.
I have asked DJI to further investigate whether DJI runs a risk as a result and which measures could be taken.
Ik heb DJI gevraagd nader te onderzoeken of DJI hierdoor risico loopt en welke maatregelen getroffen kunnen worden.
