Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ‘de app Nextdoor’

An MP asked the ministers whether the neighbourhood app Nextdoor leaks data, whether the Data Protection Authority has started an investigation, whether police complaints were filed, and whether government should refrain from promoting such apps. The ministers acknowledged leak risks, declined to comment on the AP investigation and individual complaints, said government should be restrained in recommending privately developed apps, and declined to commission research into safer alternatives.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority has informed me that in principle it does not make statements about possible and ongoing investigations.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) heeft mij bericht in beginsel geen uitspraken over mogelijke en lopende onderzoeken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kosten van Nederlanders met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the costs of (non-Western) immigrant-background residents across justice and security spending, and to say how it compares with revenues from fees. The minister answered that police, terrorism, prison, and immigration services do not record costs or outcomes by migration background, so the requested breakdowns and estimates cannot be provided.
Data on the costs of police deployment with regard to citizens with a (non-Western) migration background are not available.
Gegevens over de kosten van de inzet van politie ten aanzien van burgers met een (niet westerse) migratieachtergrond, zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht “Fraudehelpdesk in Apeldoorn moet miljoenen gegevens van fraudeurs vernietigen”

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens refusing a data-processing permit to the Fraudehelpdesk, forcing destruction of fraud data, and whether a statutory basis for cross-sector fraud data sharing is needed. The minister answered that the permit was refused as insufficiently substantiated, that the existing GDPR/UAVG framework already permits such sharing with a permit, that no new legislation is yet warranted, and that the AP is responsible for the permit decision.

I have heard that the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) did not grant the permit requested by foundation Safecin for the Fraudehelpdesk because the application did not yet meet requirements and must be further completed and substantiated in parts.

Ik heb vernomen dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (hierna: AP) de door de stichting Safecin ten behoeve van de Fraudehelpdesk aangevraagde vergunning niet heeft verleend omdat die aanvraag nog niet voldeed en op onderdelen nader ingevuld en onderbouwd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de fiscale aftrek van partneralimentatie de komende jaren wordt verlaagd

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the phased reduction of the tax deduction for partner alimony would push payers into hardship and cause a flood of court cases for lower alimony, and what the costs and revenues are. The State Secretary answered that only about 28% of payers are affected, that reviews are case-by-case and mostly handled without a judge, that the Raad voor de rechtspraak expects no major rise in workload, and that the structural revenue is estimated at 41 million euros, without behavioural effects.
Paid partner alimony remains fully deductible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het Europees aanbesteden van medische diensten in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether European tendering of medical services in prisons, and the replacement of security contractor G4S by Trigion, reflect cost-cutting or quality concerns. The Minister answers that EU procurement rules legally require the tendering, that cost savings are not the aim, that quality requirements apply, and that the number of externally hired guards (230) will be reduced only once permanent staff are recruited and trained.
Cost savings are not an aim of tenders in this area.
Bezuinigingen zijn geen oogmerk van aanbestedingen op dit gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Tielen over het bericht 'Salafistische jongerenwerkers actief in Den Haag'

MPs Peters and Tielen asked the ministers about reports that Salafist youth workers operate in The Hague, including one worker who stopped after police warnings, and whether radical influence on youth is widespread. The government confirmed the case was handled locally with the employer ending the worker's contract, said no grounds exist for a wider inventory or new measures on leaked information, and pointed to existing prevention and partnership efforts.
We are not aware of any signals that would require such an inventory.
Er zijn ons geen signalen bekend die een dergelijke inventarisatie nodig zouden maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuwe record: ministeries geven 25 miljoen euro uit aan inhuur van de landsadvocaat

Van Nispen (SP) asks why ministries spent a record 25 million euro on the state's external counsel (landsadvocaat) in 2018, whether this conflicts with the government's aim to reduce juridification and procedures, and why this contrasts with underfunded legal aid for citizens. The minister answers that the costs are being critically reviewed, mainly reflect mandatory civil representation where the state is defendant, and that legal aid and state counsel spending are distinct; he also details Defence and Justice spending, the Groningen claims procedures, and aims to reduce unnecessary government litigation.
It is difficult to say why the costs of hiring the state counsel were higher in 2018 than in previous years.
Het is moeilijk aan te geven waarom de kosten van inhuur van de landsadvocaat in 2018 hoger zijn uitgevallen dan in voorgaande jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Apple deelde herleidbare, persoonlijke gegevens bij opnames Siri-gebruikers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether Apple's sharing of identifiable Siri recordings violated privacy, what the Dutch privacy regulator AP had done, which law applies and where citizens should complain, and what the government would do about privacy risks in tech. The ministers answered that the AP is a concerned authority while the Irish regulator leads, that AVG complaint routes exist, that current law is largely adequate with the AVG evaluation to address data volume and profiling, and that a public campaign on privacy will start in spring 2020.
It is up to the competent privacy supervisors in the EU to start an investigation into Apple's conduct.
Het is aan de bevoegde privacytoezichthouders in de EU om een onderzoek te starten naar het handelen van Apple.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over procedeergedrag van de Rijksoverheid

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about rising spending on the state's external lawyer (landsadvocaat) and government procedural behaviour, and whether the government will reduce it. The minister answered with a multi-year table of spending by ministry, attributed the rise to complex and incident-driven cases, explained that the state uses external lawyers mainly in mandatory civil proceedings, and said the government will curb unnecessary litigation without committing to specific new steps.
It is difficult to say why the costs of hiring the state's lawyer were higher in 2018 than in previous years.
Het is moeilijk aan te geven waarom de kosten van inhuur van de landsadvocaat in 2018 hoger zijn uitgevallen dan in voorgaande jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de (on)mogelijkheid voor volwassenen om geadopteerd te worden

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection why adults can only be adopted in exceptional circumstances, whether data on demand exist, which countries allow adult adoption, what objections exist, and when the WODC study on simple adoption will be ready. The Minister saw no reason to change the law, citing that adoption is a child-protection measure and that adult adoption could enable circumvention of rules on inheritance, nationality and migration, while noting courts have occasionally allowed it on individual grounds and the WODC study is expected by year-end.
I see no reason for a change in the law.
Ik zie geen reden tot een wetswijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat rechters nog steeds hun bijbanen niet melden

Mr Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether judges' non-reporting of side jobs, reported in the press, undermines transparency and risks conflicts of interest, and whether the minister will consult the judiciary. The minister answered that a complete, up-to-date register of side positions is important for public trust, that the duty to disclose is meant for transparency rather than discouraging side jobs, and that he will talk with the Council for the Judiciary about instruments to safeguard transparency and impartiality and report back.
I consider it, together with the Council for the Judiciary and the Dutch Association for the Judiciary, of great importance that the register of side positions is up to date and complete.
Ik vind het – met de Raad voor de rechtspraak en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak – van groot belang dat het register nevenbetrekkingen actueel en volledig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ' Flaws in Cellphone Evidence Prompt Review of 10,000 Verdicts in Denmark '

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch use of telecom data as evidence could suffer from errors like those found in Denmark, and whether verdicts could be affected. The government answered that Dutch conversion tools are not used as evidence, that no concrete reason exists to assume inaccurate data is used, and that it will ask police to check the Danish findings against the Dutch situation after the Danish inquiry concludes.

However, after the Danish investigation is concluded I will ask the police to project all the 'uncertainties and sources of error' identified by the Danes onto the Dutch situation and report their findings to me.

Wel zal ik na de afronding van het Deense onderzoek de politie vragen om alle door de Denen aangegeven «onzekerheden en bronnen van fouten» op de Nederlandse situatie te projecteren en mij over de bevindingen te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het beïnvloeden van persberichten van de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand door het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

MP Van Nispen asked whether the Ministry of Justice and Security influenced the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand's press release on its Monitor Gesubsidieerde Rechtsbijstand 2017, and why it commented on the draft. The minister answered that the ministry only sat on the monitor's supervisory committee, that it commented on the draft headline as not covering the report's content, that the Raad decided the final text, and that the correspondence is internal and not published.
It is the responsibility of the Raad to establish a definitive text of its press releases, whether or not based on comments made.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad om, al dan niet op basis van gemaakte opmerkingen, een definitieve tekst van zijn persberichten vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gratis moeten leveren van rechtsbijstand door advocaten

SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection why criminal lawyers receive no separate fees for frequent hearings and activities, and why they are expected to work largely unpaid under the fixed-fee system. The minister replied that work is covered by flat fees and surcharges, acknowledged imbalance in criminal-law fees, announced an investigation into extra-hours arrangements, and pointed to pilots and a EUR 10 million innovation reserve as steps toward better fees.
Under the current system, it is therefore not the case that lawyers perform their work for free.
In het huidige stelsel is het dus niet zo dat advocaten gratis hun werkzaamheden verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat advocaten stoppen met het verlenen van gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand vanwege te lage tarieven

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that criminal lawyers are quitting subsidised legal aid because fees are too low, and whether the government will act on falling lawyer numbers. The minister said the decline in registered criminal lawyers is mainly due to lawyers failing registration requirements and fewer legal-aid assignments, but acknowledged the signals and committed to a reform of the legal aid system within budget limits.
Access to justice will remain the starting point under a revised legal aid system as well.
Toegang tot het recht zal ook onder een herzien stelsel van rechtsbijstand het uitgangspunt blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Dam over advocaten die stoppen met rechtsbijstand

MPs Groothuizen and Van Dam asked the Minister for Legal Protection about lawyers quitting legal aid, especially youth criminal duty (piket) work, due to low fees and the new juvenile suspect rules. The Minister acknowledged the signals, reported declining registered lawyers and piket participation, and pointed to a fee measure, a €10 million innovation fund and the ongoing system reform as responses.
As Minister for Legal Protection I bear responsibility for a sufficient supply of lawyers, including by providing reasonable remuneration for the work to be performed.

Als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming draag ik een verantwoordelijkheid voor een voldoende aanbod van advocaten, onder meer door het bieden van een redelijke vergoeding voor te verrichten werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Laan-Geselschap over het artikel ‘Speciale opvang voor jihad-kinderen bij terugkeer in Nederland’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a Parool report on special reception for children returning from IS territory, and whether such children pose a security threat. The government answered that the children are primarily victims, that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming did not set up locations, that children are placed in specialised trauma care and observed, and that the youth court decides on protective measures based on multidisciplinary advice.
The RvdK has not set up any locations.
De RvdK heeft geen locaties opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de wettelijke grondslag van de pilot van de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand met LegalGuard/Achmea

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand's pilot with LegalGuard/Achmea has a legal basis, given that no rules were set for contracting third parties to provide legal aid. The minister replied that the pilot rests on articles 7, 8 and 13 Wrb, that LegalGuard may use staff of a voorziening regardless of employment arrangements, and that no further policy rules are required.
No policy rules need to be set by the board of the Raad for this under article 13, third paragraph, Wrb.
Hiervoor hoeven op grond van artikel 13, derde lid, Wrb door het bestuur van de Raad geen beleidsregels te worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Medewerker PI Krimpen bewusteloos na aanval van gedetineerde'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a report that a prison officer at PI Krimpen was knocked unconscious by an inmate, asking how it happened, whether the inmate is still in isolation, and what will be done to restore staff control. The minister confirmed the incident, described the sequence, said the inmate was punished, transferred to a stricter regime and reported for attempted manslaughter, and pointed to a recent letter to parliament on strengthening staff's position.
Violence against staff is unacceptable to me.
Geweld tegen personeel vind ik onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdenking van omkoping en corruptie bij Shell en het verschoningsrecht van bedrijfsjuristen

The MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how the legal professional privilege of in-house lawyers, raised in the Shell corruption case, should be understood and whether its scope should be reconsidered. The Minister answers that in-house lawyers admitted as advocates may claim privilege only for advocate-type work, that the scope is under court review in the ongoing Shell case, and that a WODC study and a procedure in the new Code of Criminal Procedure are planned, but sees no reason to change the current scope.
Given that this concerns an ongoing criminal case that is before the judge on this legal question, I will not go into it further here.
Gelet op het feit dat het hier een lopende strafzaak betreft die ten aanzien van deze rechtsvraag onder de rechter is, zal ik daar hier verder niet op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Minder rechtszaken in Overijssel door tekort aan rechters’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the Overijssel court cannot hold the agreed number of criminal hearing days due to a judge shortage, and that 500 appeal cases are being moved from the Arnhem-Leeuwarden appeals court to The Hague. The Minister confirms the shortfall (about 3.5% of hearing days), says already-scheduled cases are not delayed, leaves prioritisation to the prosecution service, describes recruitment and training measures and a temporary transfer regulation, and states that the regulation excludes Overijssel cases to limit travel burdens.
The court is working hard to reduce the shortage of judges as quickly as possible.
De rechtbank werkt er hard aan om het tekort aan rechters zo snel mogelijk terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het moeilijke wijzigen van een achternaam, zelfs voor slachtoffers van misbruik

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the difficulty and cost of changing a surname, especially for victims of incest, and about procedures, waiting times, fees and the C1 hardship route. The minister answered in detail, explained the legal criteria and fee structure, and announced a simplification of the procedure for incest victims and a possible single counter for first and surname changes.
I intend to adjust the procedure in these cases so that the victim can themselves submit medical documents showing mental or physical harm.
Ik ben voornemens de werkwijze in deze gevallen aan te passen, zodat het slachtoffer zelf medische stukken kan overleggen waaruit blijkt dat er sprake is van geestelijke of lichamelijke hinder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Dagelijks rechten geschonden’ inzake het gevangeniswezen op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the government about reports of daily rights violations in Sint Maarten's prison, including cell confinement, lack of rehabilitation and psychiatric care, and suspects being sent home instead of held in pre-trial detention. The State Secretary answered that prisons are a country matter, cited the minimum two hours outdoor time and limited reclassering capacity, referred the release policy to Sint Maarten authorities, and said the Corallo supervision and 11 transferred containers cells are being monitored.
It is not for me to assess the factual findings presented in the article.
Het is niet aan mij om de in het artikel weergegeven constateringen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het wijzigen van de achternaam na incest

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why changing a surname after incest requires a costly, lengthy psychological procedure and fees, and whether exemptions or easier criteria could apply. The minister answered that the procedure will be simplified with medical evidence from the victim's own treating professional, that fees are waived after a final conviction and, following alignment with the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven criteria, also when that fund has granted compensation.
I will change the procedure in these cases so that the victim can submit medical documents themselves showing physical or mental harm.
Ik ga de werkwijze in deze gevallen aanpassen, zodat het slachtoffer zelf medische stukken kan overleggen waaruit blijkt dat er sprake is van lichamelijke of geestelijke hinder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de pilot van Legal Guard, de overeenkomst met de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand en eerdere vragen hierover

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Legal Guard pilot run by Achmea for the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, covering funding, fee structure, lawyer qualifications, client choice and evaluation. The minister answered that the pilot is the Raad's own initiative paid from its own funds, that fees are volume-based and not comparable to lawyers' flat fees, that the audit is by independent academics, and that the final report is expected in May 2020.
The total costs of the pilot are not yet known, as the pilot is still running.
De totale kosten van de pilot zijn nog niet bekend, aangezien de pilot nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over het bericht 'Websites overtreden massaal cookiewallverbod'

VVD MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that websites widely violate the cookiewall ban, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's view that cookiewalls are not allowed, practice in other EU countries, competitive effects on Dutch media, how consent for tracking cookies can be obtained, and how the Telecommunications Act, ePrivacy Directive and GDPR relate. The minister answered that cookiewalls do not give freely given consent under GDPR, that consent cannot be obtained via general terms, that Dutch rules apply to foreign firms targeting Dutch users, and that Dutch government supports an explicit cookiewall ban in the forthcoming ePrivacy Regulation.
That is why the Netherlands, in line with the Verhoeven motion, advocates a ban on these so-called cookiewalls.
Daarom pleit Nederland in lijn met de motie Verhoeven voor een verbod op deze zogenoemde cookiewalls.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Westerveld over geweld in de jeugdzorg

MPs Buitenweg and Westerveld asked whether psychological child abuse is punishable under Dutch criminal law and how prosecutors handle it, and what measures the government will take. The minister answered that Article 300 Sr can cover psychological abuse, that the Public Prosecution Service examines such cases case by case, that no Criminal Code revision is currently considered opportune, and listed ongoing programmes and a pending bill strengthening child abuse liability.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuiken over het illegaal aanbieden van op Nederlanders gerichte online kansspelen

An MP asks whether illegal online gambling operators targeting the Dutch market should be excluded from licences, and how the two-year cooling-off period for licence applicants works. The minister confirms the government will refuse illegal operators actively targeting the Dutch market, explains the two-year good-conduct period, and says the Kansspelautoriteit has published a draft policy rule with indicators and a Bibob check.
I indeed maintain the position that I want to exclude illegal providers that continue to actively target the Dutch market.
Ik blijf inderdaad bij het standpunt dat ik illegale aanbieders die zich actief op de Nederlandse markt blijven richten wil weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Den Boer over berichten op Twitter dat mensen een sms kregen van Forum voor Democratie zonder dat zij zich hebben ingeschreven bij de partij

MPs Verhoeven and Den Boer asked how Forum voor Democratie could text people who had not joined the party, whether the Data Protection Authority would investigate, how people can check and delete their data, what sanctions apply, and whether party membership is verified for state funding. The ministers answered that the phone numbers may have been obtained lawfully with consent or were a processing error, that complaints were already with the AP and ACM, that data access and erasure requests are available, and that membership is checked through a declaration of intent and audit.
Inquiries with the AP show that complaints about this situation have indeed been filed.
Navraag bij de AP leert dat er inderdaad klachten over deze situatie zijn ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een ernstig geweldsincident in de  gevangenis

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a serious assault on a prison officer at JC Zaanstad, the incident figures, staffing levels, safety measures, and whether the perpetrator was wrongly housed in a regular ward for lack of psychiatric capacity. The minister described the incident, said staff can work safely, noted rising demand for PPC places and capacity expansion, and rejected claims of structural unsafety.
The staff at JC Zaanstad can perform their work safely and responsibly.
Het personeel in JC Zaanstad kan veilig en verantwoord het werk doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het vreemde onderscheid tussen de burgerlijke staten ‘ongehuwd’, ‘gescheiden’ en ‘gehuwd’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why civil status categories 'unmarried', 'divorced' and 'married' are kept, and whether 'unmarried' should become 'single'. The minister answered that the distinction is needed for civil registry accuracy and legal consequences of divorce, and does not agree to change the categories.
The distinction matters because it must be possible to establish that a marriage existed from which the spouses derived rights and obligations.
Het onderscheid is van belang omdat vastgesteld moet kunnen worden dat er een huwelijk heeft bestaan waaraan de echtgenoten rechten en plichten ontleenden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een wetsvoorstel inzake het toezicht op vermogensbeheer van minderjarigen

MP Van Nispen asked why a promised legislative change on supervision of guardianship assets of minors, announced after a 2017 study, had not yet been sent to parliament, and when it would be. The minister admitted delay, citing other personal-law projects, and said consultation is planned for 2020 with a bill possibly submitted in the second half of 2020.
I intend to put the bill on supervision of guardianship of minors' assets out for consultation during 2020.
Ik ben voornemens om het wetsvoorstel inzake toezicht op bewind bij minderjarigen in de loop van 2020 in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over tbs voor verkrachters

The MP Kuiken asks whether a psychiatric disorder should be presumed for the most serious rapists so that TBS can be imposed without a forensic PJ report, and whether this would resolve the problem of suspects refusing observation. The minister answers that not every rapist has a disorder, that the EUR report advises against presumption as disproportionate, and that the government is pursuing other measures to reduce refusals and their effect.
I have committed to mapping, together with the Public Prosecution Service, the practice of carrying out PJ reports in serious sexual offence cases.
Ik heb daarbij toegezegd dat ik met het Openbaar Ministerie de praktijk van het uitvoeren van PJ-rapportages bij ernstige zedenzaken in kaart zal brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over hoe de sterke zekerheidsrechtelijke positie van banken alternatieve financiers belemmert

MPs Sneller, Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether banks' strong security positions in bankruptcy and the ban on pledging assets hinder alternative lenders, and whether the government will investigate, legislate or address this in the bankruptcy law revision. The minister answered that a study of Dutch financing practice will be commissioned, that the bankruptcy law revision is examining secured creditors' position, and that the bill to lift pledging bans will go to the Council of State shortly after the summer recess.
We are willing to commission a study into this, which will also address collateral provision in SME financing, in view of the motion adopted by your House on 18 June.

Wij zijn bereid om een opdracht tot een onderzoek daarnaar te geven, waarbij tevens, mede gelet op de op 18 juni door Uw Kamer aangenomen motie, 2 de zekerheidsstelling bij MKB-financiering aan de orde zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over tbs voor verkrachters

An MP asks whether a legal rule should require a rape court to consider TBS (compulsory psychiatric treatment) for the most serious rape cases, unless the suspect proves no psychiatric disorder, and asks for a study of this with results before year-end. The minister refers to the answer to earlier Kamervragen rather than addressing the proposal directly.
For the answer to this question I refer you to the answer to questions 3 and 4 of the parliamentary questions submitted on 28 May 2019.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar het antwoord op vraag 3 en 4 van de Kamervragen ingezonden op 28 mei 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het lekken en illegaal verhandelen van persoonsgegevens uit het kentekenregister

An MP asked whether the government knows of illegal trade in confidential license-plate register data, how it could happen despite stricter privacy rules, who has access, and what will be done. The minister confirms awareness, says a police investigation with the RDW and LIV is underway, describes the legal framework and list of access categories, and says an external review of extra safeguards has been commissioned.
The investigation must establish where the data came from and whether there has been misuse.
Het onderzoek moet uitwijzen waar de gegevens vandaan komen en of er sprake is van misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrief van jeugdrechtadvocaten

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the youth lawyers' open letter complaining that the EU child-procedural-rights directive, now implemented, guarantees minors mandatory legal aid at police interrogation without an adequate fee, and that police and prosecutors shift responsibility onto the bar. The minister acknowledged the extra workload, said fees follow the existing point system (raised 50% in 2016), disputed that police and prosecutors shift responsibility, and promised to consult the bar and report before the budget debate.

In response to this letter, I will shortly consult further with the (youth law) bar, together with the police and the public prosecution service, within the existing functional contacts on implementing the directive and the practical application of the implementing law, and discuss the bottlenecks identified.

Mede naar aanleiding van deze brief zal ik op korte termijn, in het kader van de reeds bestaande functionele contacten over de implementatie van de richtlijn en de praktische uitvoering van de wet ter uitvoering van deze richtlijn, samen met politie en openbaar ministerie nader in overleg treden met de (jeugdrecht)advocatuur en daarbij ook de gesignaleerde knelpunten bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat jeugdrechtadvocaten massaal overwegen piketdienst terug te schroeven

Rep. Raemakers (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that youth-law advocates were considering scaling back their police-interview duty service, including the inadequate per-client fee and the risk of breaching the EU juvenile directive. The minister confirmed that legal assistance at police interviews of minors is now mandatory since 1 June 2019, said the fee would be discussed with stakeholders, and expressed confidence that a shortage would not occur.

I will discuss the fee in the consultations that will take place shortly with the youth-law advocates, the Legal Aid Board, the police and the Public Prosecution Service on the practical implementation of the law.
Ik zal de vergoeding bespreken in de overleggen die op korte termijn zullen plaatsvinden met jeugdrechtadvocatuur, Raad voor rechtsbijstand, politie en OM over de praktische uitvoering van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over recente berichtgeving rondom SAVE Midden-Nederland en Veilig Thuis

MP Tielen asked about reports that parents involved with SAVE Midden-Nederland and Veilig Thuis feel opposed rather than supported, whether combining the referring body and a certifying institution creates conflicts of interest, and how inspectorates supervise these bodies. The minister acknowledged complaints, said the organisational structure is legally permitted, pointed to shared supervision by the IGJ and Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid, and noted that much of the relevant information is not available centrally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de oprichting van een nieuwe motorclub vanuit de gevangenis

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a detained man could found a new motorcycle club from prison, what formalities and communication means he had, and whether the number of motorclubs has risen. The minister answered that founding an association is permitted within legal limits, that no registration exists in the trade register, that the inmate was disciplined for unauthorised media contact, and that the 2018 gang progress report will be sent to parliament once received.
Inquiry at the trade register on 26 June 2019 shows that no registration under the name "Hardliners" has in any case been made in the trade register.
Uit navraag op 26 juni 2019 bij het handelsregister blijkt dat in het handelsregister in ieder geval geen inschrijving is gedaan onder de naam «Hardliners».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vergelijking van rechtsstelsels en de methode van het World Justice Project

An SP MP asks the Ministers of Justice and Security and for Legal Protection why the government relies on the World Justice Project rule of law ranking, questioning its survey method, the expert sample, the unclear identity of the fieldwork company and whether firm conclusions about Dutch courts can be drawn. The Minister for Legal Protection defends the index as one of several indicators, says the 21 experts and the fieldwork contractors are as disclosed by the WJP, and maintains that the Dutch rule of law functions well.
As previously indicated, the World Justice Project has informed me that it contracted YouGov to carry out the population survey.
Zoals ook al eerder aangeven heeft het World Justice Project mij laten weten dat zij YouGov gecontracteerd hebben om het bevolkingsonderzoek uit te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Gent over de berichten ‘De schrikbarende stijging die niemand kan verklaren’ en ‘Verkeersanalyse provincie nutteloos door Privacywet’

MPs Dijkstra and Van Gent asked whether the GDPR (AVG) prevents provinces from analysing traffic accidents, after reports that the increase in road deaths in Brabant could not be explained. The minister acknowledged that special personal data cannot currently be supplied due to a missing legal basis, that a bill is expected early next year, and pointed to aggregated data, in-depth studies and data sharing as alternatives.
However, special personal data cannot currently be supplied.
Bijzondere persoonsgegevens kunnen op dit moment echter niet worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over de teveel betaalde belasting en ZVW-premie door oud-gevangenispersoneel dat met SBF-verlof is gegaan

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked whether former prison staff on SBF leave were wrongly charged income tax and health premiums after a 2013 law change, and why some were not compensated. The State Secretary answered that the 104-week limit runs from the start of SBF leave, that the Tax Authority and DJI reached a settlement in late 2018, and that 151 people were not refunded because no excess tax was paid for them.
This establishes that the white table applies to the remaining part of the 104-week period as of 1 January 2013.
Daarmee is vastgelegd dat op het per 1 januari 2013 resterende deel van het tijdvak van 104 weken de witte tabel wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over nieuwe bezuinigingen en dreigende sluitingen van justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked whether savings on youth detention institutions, possibly including closures, were being considered, and questioned the timing, capacity forecasts and consultation of the regions. The Minister replied that a reorganisation towards smaller and specialist facilities is set out in a letter of 28 June 2019, that the reforms fit the coalition agreement, that current occupancy forecasts show no short-term capacity shortage, and that a debate with the House is welcome.
The decision-making has been sent to you with my letter of 28 June 2019. I am happy to debate this with your House.
De besluitvorming heb ik u met mijn brief van 28 juni 2019 toegezonden. Ik ga hierover graag met uw Kamer in debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het  verlagen van drempels voor de herziening van afgesloten strafzaken

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether the threshold for asking the ACAS to review closed criminal cases should be lowered to cases with less than twelve years' maximum sentence, and whether the novum criterion for revision should be broadened. The minister answers no to both, arguing that the twelve-year threshold is justified, the 2018 evaluation found no reason to change it, and broadening the novum criterion would turn revision into a fourth instance and weaken its exceptional character.
On the other hand, I do see clear objections to other formulations.
Ik zie daarentegen wel duidelijk bezwaren tegen andere formuleringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de VOG als verdienmodel

Groothuizen (D66) asked whether private firms charging more than the official VOG fee, and the fact that only applicants can request a VOG, should prompt tighter rules. The minister said the services are acceptable, that direct digital application is cheaper, and that Justis is studying ways to reduce administrative burden, without announcing new rules.
I will examine whether the communication on this is sufficiently clear.
Ik zal bekijken of de communicatie hieromtrent voldoende duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over een Europees beroepsverbod

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked whether foreign occupational bans can be used in Bibob integrity screening, whether stakeholders can force a Bibob check and challenge refusals in court, and whether improper animal treatment can factor into environmental permit decisions. The minister answered that foreign criminal and administrative sanctions can be considered in Bibob screening, that initiating a Bibob check is discretionary and not appealable, and that animal welfare falls outside environmental protection but criminal animal offences can ground a permit refusal.
Whether or not to apply the Bibob Act is a discretionary power of the administrative body concerned.
Het al dan niet toepassen van de Wet Bibob is een discretionaire bevoegdheid van het betreffende bestuursorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Omstreden kliniek opnieuw in de fout met verlof patiënten’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a news report that a clinic in Den Dolder again released patients on leave wrongly, and about how forensic patients' freedoms are restored after the Michael P. case. The minister said the incident involved two civil GGZ patients outside the justice ministry's responsibility, gave the number of forensic patients on leave, and stated that the clinic has learned lessons and that inspectorates are monitoring improvements.
At my request, the inspectorates are keeping a close eye on whether the improvements introduced also take hold.
De inspecties houden op mijn verzoek goed vinger aan de pols om erop toe te zien dat de ingezette verbeteringen ook beklijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de enquête waaruit blijkt dat bijna 70% van de sociaal advocaten overwegen te stoppen

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how she responds to a survey showing that nearly 70% of social lawyers are considering quitting, and whether this threatens subsidised legal aid, and asks about the state of the planned overhaul of subsidised legal aid. The minister says she is aware of the concerns, notes the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand figures show a decline in participating lawyers mainly due to lawyers failing minimum registration requirements, and promises a progress report and implementation plan before the summer recess.
I will therefore give this concern a place in the further elaboration of the outlines.
Ik geef deze zorg dan ook een plek in de nadere uitwerking van de contouren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Levenslang gestrafte wil vaker verlof en na 27 jaar vrijkomen’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether life sentences really mean life, whether relief leave and eventual release of a life-sentenced prisoner would harm victims and relatives, and whether the government would prevent this offender from getting leave or release. The minister answered that life means life in principle, that reviewed policy gives life prisoners a prospect of release, that victims and relatives can be heard in the process, and that he cannot comment on a court ruling while advisory bodies still have to advise.
It does not befit me to comment on a court ruling.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over preventieve handhaving in het bestuursrecht

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the relationship between preventive enforcement tools under the General Administrative Law Act, including the herstelsanctie to prevent repetition and the preventive herstelsanctie, and their legal basis. The minister answered that both are distinct competences recognised in case law, explained the criteria for repetition and the one-year lifting request, and stated that the reparatory sanctions are not punitive for Article 6 ECHR purposes.
According to case law, these are two coexisting competences.
Blijkens de jurisprudentie betreft het twee naast elkaar bestaande bevoegdheden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de plaatsing van ex-gedetineerden in een woonwijk in Arnhem

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about placing ex-prisoners and forensic clients in an Arnhem residential flat without prior consultation with the municipality and residents. The minister confirmed five forensic clients were placed by DJI, acknowledged poor contact with the municipality, and committed to making municipal contact a contractual obligation and to ongoing engagement with the municipality and residents.
To ensure that care providers actively and regularly engage with municipalities, this will henceforth be included as an obligation in the contracts between DJI and forensic institutions.

Om ervoor te zorgen dat zorgaanbieders actief en regelmatig in contact treden met gemeenten zal dit voortaan als verplichting opgenomen worden in de contracten tussen DJI en de forensische instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het recht tot zelfbeschikking van intersekse baby’s en kinderen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about UN Committee against Torture recommendations on intersex children's bodily autonomy, prevalence, unnecessary surgery, and parental consent. Minister Bruins answered that medical decisions rest with professionals, that no IGJ reports of non-consensual procedures are known, that research is insufficient, and that a quality standard for intersex/DSD care is being developed.
I therefore cannot confirm that there are intersex babies and children in the Netherlands who have undergone a non-medically necessary procedure without informed consent.
Ik kan dan ook niet bevestigen dat er intersekse baby's en kinderen zijn in Nederland die zonder dat er sprake is van informed consent een niet-medisch noodzakelijke ingreep hebben ondergaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat door personeelstekorten er niet voldoende celinspecties plaats kunnen vinden in gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether staff shortages in prisons prevent adequate cell inspections, whether sanctions are effective, and how working pressure and personnel will be addressed. The minister acknowledged the signals, said DJI prioritises inspections and recruitment, defended group-cell use, and announced a tightened sanctions card and a 2018–2021 convenant on workload.
I consider cell inspections of essential importance for safety in the institution, and therefore we must not compromise on them.
Celinspecties vind ik van wezenlijk belang voor de veiligheid in de inrichting, en daarom mogen we daar niet op inleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de benoeming van een bestuurder bij FPA Roosenburg

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why he was not actively informed about the appointment of a former prison care director as board member of a forensic care provider, how this fits with the needed culture change in forensic care, and what influence he has over such appointments. The minister answered that the board appointment was public after the provider announced it, that he steers private providers on quality and performance rather than personnel policy, and that a multi-year culture-change programme is being pursued with the sector.
Your House is generally not actively informed about appointments of board members at forensic institutions.
Uw Kamer wordt in zijn algemeenheid niet actief geïnformeerd over benoemingen van bestuurders bij forensische instellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘De behandeldirecteur van de PI Vught die zwaar blunderde bij de overplaatsing van Michael P. is nu bestuurder van Fivoor’

Two CDA MPs asked whether it is acceptable that the prison treatment director criticised for errors in the transfer of Michael P. now leads the clinic Fivoor, and whether the government will act given local residents' distrust of the clinic in Den Dolder. The minister replied that the government does not steer individual appointments at private institutions but on quality and performance, that a broader culture change is being pursued, and that interim measures were agreed with residents, with the inspectorate monitoring the clinic.
Where these performances fall below standard, intervention is possible.
Daar waar deze prestaties onder de maat zijn kan worden ingegrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht ‘Gratis wonen. Als je mee laat kijken in je bed’

An MP asked the ministers whether a Helmond smart-district initiative offering rent reductions in exchange for personal data, and sensor-based monitoring, is acceptable, and how it fits with privacy and oversight. The minister answered that the project is a citizen-involved experiment bound by the GDPR, that no concrete data agreements exist yet, that the rent-for-data plan is still in feasibility, and that the Ethics Commission and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens remain relevant, with no commitment to halt the initiative.
Nothing has been decided yet. Should the experiment go ahead, I will closely monitor its design and implementation.
Er staat op dit moment nog niets vast. Mocht het experiment wel worden uitgevoerd, dan ga ik de uitwerking en de uitvoering daarvan nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Tien jaar cel en tbs voor doodsteken therapeut tbs-kliniek Kijvelanden’

The MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a case where a therapist was killed in a tbs clinic by a man already in treatment, questioning the sentence, his leave eligibility, placement in a regular clinic, and why tbs was reimposed. The Minister states that judges independently set sentences, that leave decisions are binding-advised by the independent AVT, declines to discuss the individual case, and gives recidivism statistics and figures on dangerous tbs patients.
I will not go into this individual case.
Ik ga niet in op dit individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jongeren die grensoverschrijdend gedrag vertonen niet worden behandeld

MP Kuiken asked whether a national overview exists of young people with risky behaviour who go untreated, despite court orders, and whether the government will act on municipalities' funding requests. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that waiting lists are being tackled regionally, and that extra funds for youth care were allocated, with a progress report promised.
To ensure that rulings on this component are actually carried out, the Youth Act obliges municipalities to deploy the youth assistance that a judge deems necessary.
Om te verzekeren dat vonnissen op dit onderdeel daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd, verplicht de Jeugdwet gemeenten de jeugdhulp die een rechter nodig acht, in te zetten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Van Wijngaarden en Laan-Geselschap over de berichten ‘Tientallen jongeren met grensoverschrijdend gedrag worden niet behandeld’ en ‘Aanhoudingen in Rotterdam voor groepsverkrachtin

Three VVD MPs asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and Health about press reports on untreated youths with sexual boundary-crossing behaviour and group rape by minors in Rotterdam. The government answered that trends in juvenile sex offending are falling, that municipalities are responsible for youth care ordered by courts, and that financial shortfall does not exempt municipalities from their duty.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for the provision of youth care. Financial shortage does not release municipalities from their youth care obligation.
Op grond van de Jeugdwet zijn gemeenten verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de jeugdhulp. Financiële krapte ontslaat gemeenten niet van hun jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat marktwerking voor gerechtsdeurwaarders te ver is doorgeslagen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked whether market competition among bailiffs has gone too far, creating perverse incentives that undermine bailiffs' independence and whether government should encourage debt assistance and alternative procurement. The minister disagreed that competition has gone too far, said a commission is reviewing the tariff system, pointed to existing responsible-collection commitments, and said price will not be part of the CJIB tender competition.
I am awaiting the results of that investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de motivering van automatisch genomen besluiten

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether automatically taken decisions should disclose their decision rules, given that a rule analyst's structuring choices shape outcomes. The minister answered that publication adds little where algorithms are a one-to-one translation of law, but that disclosure is warranted where additional choices are made beyond statute and policy rules.
Disclosure is appropriate where further choices are made in addition to choices already contained in legislation and policy rules.
Openbaarmaking is wel op haar plaats, als nadere keuzes worden gemaakt in aanvulling op keuzes die al in wetgeving en beleidsregels zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat een Nederlandse strafrechtadvocaat de toegang tot de Verenigde Staten geweigerd wordt

SP MPs asked the government whether it would act after reports that a Dutch criminal lawyer representing terrorism suspects was denied entry to the United States, and how US authorities obtained that information. The minister said advocates must be free to practise, that the US decides its own entry criteria and gave no individual explanation, that the government raised the matter with US authorities and will monitor it, and that the Dutch government shares no information about such lawyers with the US.
Enquiries with the American authorities show that an application for an ESTA or visa is assessed against many different criteria.
Navraag bij de Amerikaanse autoriteiten leert dat een aanvraag voor een ESTA of visum wordt getoetst aan de hand van vele verschillende criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over advocaten die de toegang tot de Verenigde Staten wordt geweigerd

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether US entry bans against lawyers defending terrorism suspects could deter Dutch lawyers, and whether the minister would consult the US ambassador. The minister agreed lawyers must practise freely, said US entry decisions are sovereign and based on many criteria, and reported that US authorities referred to general policy and would not address individual cases; the government will keep monitoring the situation.
Lawyers must be free in the exercise of their profession, given the important role they play in realising the right of suspects to a fair trial.
Advocaten moeten vrij zijn in de uitoefening van hun beroep, gelet op de belangrijke rol die zij spelen in de verwezenlijking van het recht van verdachten op een eerlijk proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laan-Geselschap en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Opgesloten terrorist moet kunnen verdienen’

MPs Van Laan-Geselschap and Van Wijngaarden asked why prison authorities would let frozen-asset terrorist detainees earn and receive money, and whether this undermines the sanctions regime. The minister replied that only a capped internal prison account (500 euro, one contact person) is exempt, other frozen accounts stay blocked, the sanctions rationale still holds, and sanctions beyond asset freezing (travel and contact bans, supervision, nationality deprivation) exist.

By making the exemption possible only for limited amounts on the internal prison current account intended for activities within the penal institution, the exemption does not detract from the risk reduction intended by the sanction measure.

Door de ontheffing alleen mogelijk te maken voor beperkte geldbedragen op de interne rekening courant die bestemd zijn voor activiteiten binnen de penitentiaire inrichting, doet de ontheffing geen afbreuk aan de risicoverkleining zoals bedoeld in de sanctiemaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Buitenweg, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht Boek over politieonderzoek Nicole van den Hurk moet worden aangepast

MPs asked about a court ruling that a book on the police investigation into Nicole van den Hurk must be amended to protect relatives' privacy, and about how the police and prosecution service handle media contracts and embedded journalists. The minister admits errors were made, says the relatives were informed late, outlines a revised media guideline and standard contract, and says a Slachtofferhulp study will report by end 2019.
Errors were made. In weighing the public interest in openness against the protection of the relatives' privacy, insufficient attention was paid to the latter.

Er zijn fouten gemaakt. Bij de afweging tussen het maatschappelijk belang van openheid aan de ene kant en de bescherming van de privacy van de nabestaanden aan de andere kant is onvoldoende oog geweest voor het laatste.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de pilot van Legal Guard en de overeenkomst met de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Legal Guard pilot with Achmea and its agreement with the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, covering costs, the choice of a 750-case cap, fee and eigen bijdrage differences versus social lawyers, quality requirements and confidentiality. The minister answered each question, defending the pilot as a learning experiment run by the Raad, while conceding that Legal Guard jurists are not subject to disciplinary rules like lawyers and that fee and cost-retention terms differ from those for social lawyers.
Confidentiality has been agreed regarding the fixed project costs and data traceable to persons working at the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand and Legal Guard, or involved in the pilot.
Er is geheimhouding afgesproken over de vaste projectkosten en gegevens die herleidbaar zijn tot personen werkzaam bij de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand en Legal Guard, of betrokken bij de pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Haatlectuur voor het grijpen in bajes Vught’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why radical jihadist and anti-Jewish/Christian literature is available to detainees in PI Vught, including those on the Terrorist Wing, and what criteria exist for refusing books. The Minister answered that the TA screening has removed several titles, that criteria for the director's decision are not yet formulated but will be drafted with experts, and that removal of extreme titles will be checked further.
I am of the view that such criteria are indeed desirable.
Ik ben van oordeel dat dergelijke criteria wel wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Moordende rapper scoort gouden plaat in de bajes’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a convicted murderer could record a gold-selling album and give a radio interview from prison, and pressed for sanctions, asset seizure, isolation and withdrawal of station funding. The Minister said the prisoner was disciplined with a cell placement for unauthorised media contact, that the prison law allows seizing income only for outstanding fines, and that there is no legal basis to cut FunX's subsidy.
The prisoner in question did not ask for permission for the radio interview about his gold album.
De betreffende gedetineerde heeft voor het radiointerview over zijn gouden plaat geen toestemming gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de dodenherdenking in Vught is verstoord door gejoel en geroep van de PI Vught

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a Dutch national remembrance ceremony in Vught was disrupted by shouting and noise from the PI Vught prison's terrorism wing, and how this could happen. The Minister confirmed that five detainees deliberately made noise, that they received disciplinary punishment of about a week in isolation, and that the prison is reviewing how to prevent such disruptions.
Internal investigation showed that five detainees placed on the TA at PI Vught deliberately made noise in their cells during the two-minute silence.
Uit intern onderzoek is gebleken dat vijf gedetineerden, die op de TA van de PI Vught zijn geplaatst, tijdens de twee minuten stilte opzettelijk lawaai in hun cel zijn gaan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de noodkreet van een strafrechtsadvocaat over de zin van het strafrechtelijk aanpakken van psychisch gestoorden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a criminal lawyer's complaint that mentally ill suspects and convicts are wrongly handled by criminal justice instead of psychiatric care, including the high share of suspects with limited intellectual ability, sexual intimidation in care, detention while seeking shelter, and how to secure appropriate care. The minister answered that criminal law applies to all, that courts and prosecutors consider such circumstances, that holding people in pre-trial detention to find shelter is undesirable, and pointed to existing mechanisms such as forensic observation, BOPZ and future Wvggz measures.
Criminal law applies to everyone, including when psychological problems or limited intellectual ability are involved.
Het strafrecht geldt voor iedereen, ook wanneer er psychische problemen of LVB aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Van Gent en Peters over inning van alimentatie

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the collection of child maintenance owed by ex-partners who do not pay, including whether preferential collection priority should be studied and how other countries handle it. The minister agreed that non-payment is undesirable, promised a study of preference and collection by LBIO to be reported after the summer, and argued that existing enforcement adequately secures payment.
By letter of 27 February I informed you of the advantages and disadvantages of preference for child maintenance claims.
Antwoord 3 Bij Kamerbrief van 27 februari jongstleden heb ik u geïnformeerd over de voor en- nadelen van preferentie voor kinderalimentatievorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Ongelooflijk dat tbs’ers in dorp rondlopen’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether tbs (hospital order) patients from De Kijvelanden are allowed to roam freely in Albrandswaard, whether leave for tbs patients should be ended, and for an overview of incidents. The minister replied that leave is carefully staged, assessed by the clinic and the independent AVT advisory committee, that incidents are evaluated, that recidivism figures are low, and that no leave will be ended, while providing incident figures for 2015 to 2018.
Leave is granted carefully and step by step, and is only allowed if it is considered safe.
Verlofverlening vindt zorgvuldig en stapsgewijs plaats en wordt alleen toegestaan indien dat veilig wordt geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over ontvoeren en uithuwelijken van meisjes naar het buitenland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked the government about abduction and forced marriage of girls abroad, including whether children aged twelve and under are affected, the role of teachers, legal options to block travel, and possible exit bans. The government answered that child marriages are hard to detect, pointed to the meldcode and existing child-protection measures, noted that preparing a forced marriage abroad is already punishable under article 285c Sr, and said further measures are being explored within the 'Geweld hoort nergens thuis' programme.
Child marriages are an invisible and complex problem.
Kindhuwelijken zijn een onzichtbaar en complex probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het gevangeniswezen Sint Maarten

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister about a Voortgangscommissie letter proposing that the Kingdom take full responsibility for Sint Maarten's prison system, the poor detention conditions, and whether detainees should be returned. The government declined to send the internal letter, rejected the claim it was insufficiently cooperative, said it monitors agreed improvement measures and intends to return detainees as agreed.

It is therefore established cabinet policy not to make documents drawn up for internal deliberation a subject of political debate, so that thoughts can be exchanged in confidence to ensure careful decision-making.

Het is dan ook staand beleid van het kabinet om documenten die zijn opgesteld voor intern beraad, geen onderwerp te maken van het politieke debat om ervoor te zorgen dat in vertrouwelijkheid van gedachten kan worden gewisseld ten behoeve van zorgvuldige besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gent over apps waarmee je de telefoon van anderen kan spioneren

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about spy apps that let someone secretly monitor a partner, child or employee's phone, and whether their use is criminal or unlawful. The minister said the Criminal Code already penalises installing, selling and advertising such software and secret recording, and commissioned TILT research, due early 2020, on licensing to better regulate their use.

That is why I asked the Tilburg Institute for Law, Technology, and Society (TILT) of Tilburg University to examine how the use of spying products by citizens can be better regulated so that citizens' privacy can be better protected.

Daarom heb ik het Tilburg Institute for Law, Technology, and Society (TILT), van de Universiteit Tilburg verzocht te onderzoeken hoe het gebruik van spionageproducten door burgers beter kan worden gereguleerd zodat de privacy van burgers nog beter kan worden beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over intimidatie door een incassobureau

MPs Van Dijk asked the government about intimidation by debt collection agency Hendriks Incasso, including threats of powers it lacks, and whether the ACM's warning-only response and the planned debt collection register would stop such firms. Minister Dekker answered that incasso practices must stay within the law, declined to judge the individual case, and said the register with sanctions is planned for mid-2021.
It is not for me as Minister to judge individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om te oordelen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Laan-Geselschap, Groothuizen en Van Dam over de procedure en de capaciteit bij het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

MPs asked about budget problems at the Council of Europe and the European Court of Human Rights, the reopening of Dutch criminal cases after a unilateral state acknowledgement of a Convention breach, and extra staff for Dutch cases at the Court. The minister said the Netherlands must meet its payment obligations and wants the Court spared from cuts, that the government will examine whether the reopening rules need amending, and that talks are underway on extra support for the Court's registry.

In view of this, I will examine whether amending the statutory provisions is necessary and desirable to ensure that revision is possible on the basis of a decision by the ECtHR following a unilateral government declaration that the Convention has been breached.

Gelet hierop zal ik bezien of aanpassing van de wettelijke regeling nodig en gewenst is om te verzekeren dat herziening mogelijk is op grond van de beslissing door het EHRM na een eenzijdige verklaring van de regering dat het verdrag is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over hoe de Pauselijke Geheimhoudingsplicht seksueel misbruik in de Rooms Katholieke Kerk mogelijk in de hand werkt

MP Bergkamp asked whether the papal confidentiality obligation in the Normae de gravioribus delictis could enable a cover-up of child sexual abuse by clergy in the Catholic Church, and whether the Crimen sollicitationis still applies. Minister Dekker answered that Crimen sollicitationis was replaced in 2001, that the Normae remain in force, that canon law cannot override Dutch criminal law and requires reporting to the authorities, and that the Dutch Church applies a reporting duty and zero-tolerance policy.
The papal confidentiality obligation applies to the handling of complaints of sexual abuse of a minor under canon criminal law and procedure by the Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith.

De pauselijke geheimhoudingsplicht geldt voor de behandeling van aanklachten wegens seksueel misbruik van een minderjarige volgens het canonieke strafrecht en strafprocesrecht door de Congregatie voor de Geloofsleer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het functioneren van het gezagsregister

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for the Interior about how the Central Gezagsregister (guardianship/parental authority register) functions, including its scope, access by the Royal Marechaussee, and its use by professionals. The government answered that the register only records authority arising from court decisions, that the Rvdr is responsible for it, and that additional documents are sometimes needed, while promising to look into better information provision.
I will investigate how the information provision can be improved.
Ik zal onderzoeken hoe de informatievoorziening verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het rapport ‘Behoorlijk invorderen vanuit het burgerperspectief’ van de Nationale ombudsman

An MP asked the Minister about the National Ombudsman's report on fair debt collection and about the government's approach to stacking and escalation of administrative fines and premiums, including whether authorities should send free payment reminders. The Minister answered that the government is taking steps such as relaxed payment arrangements and a planned emergency-stop procedure, but that free reminders may not reach the indebted group and that the policy reply to the Ombudsman will follow.
In the coming months a plan for an emergency-stop procedure will be developed.
De komende maanden zal worden gewerkt aan een plan voor een noodstopprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de diensten van rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about secret contracts between legal expenses insurers and subcontracted firms, and whether insured persons receive adequate legal aid given low fixed fees and outsourcing. The minister described existing supervision by AFM and DNB, self-regulation and complaint routes, said quality of legal aid is essential in the new system, and noted case law on free choice of lawyer without addressing specifics of the reports.
Administrative supervision of legal expenses insurers is carried out by the Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het bestuursrechtelijk toezicht op rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars vindt plaats door de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de werkwijze en prijsafspraken van rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars en de gevolgen voor de kwaliteit

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about legal expenses insurers reselling cases to third parties at fixed low fees without client knowledge, the secrecy of such contracts, and who guarantees quality. The minister answered that insurers say outsourcing is exceptional and disclosed to clients, that quality remains the insurer's responsibility under existing rules and complaint channels, and that the new subsidised legal aid system will use quality criteria, procurement steering and supervision, with a promise to reconsider outsourcing policy.
The Dutch Association of Insurers states it does not have figures on the number of cases that legal expenses insurers outsource for a fixed amount.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars geeft aan niet te beschikken over cijfers van het aantal zaken dat door rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars wordt uitbesteed voor een vast bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over wifitracking

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Dutch Data Protection Authority reviewing an industry opt-out register for wifi tracking, which municipalities are using wifi tracking, whether citizens' legal safeguards are adequate, and whether citizens can complain. The Minister said the AP has not yet received a formal request, municipalities have no visibility over private tracking, the legal framework is clear and sufficient, and the AP can act ex officio as well as on complaints.
The AP is an independent supervisory authority that as a rule does not make statements about ongoing or possible investigations or other activities.
De AP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die als regel geen mededelingen doet over lopende of mogelijke onderzoeken of andere werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het belemmeren van de vrije advocatenkeuze door rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about legal expenses insurers restricting clients' free choice of lawyer, citing a Kassa broadcast and criticism that in-house lawyers serve two masters and that cost caps for external lawyers are much lower than for in-house lawyers. The minister answers that quality is monitored by the AFM, insurers must inform clients of their choice rights under binding self-regulation, EU case law allows cost limits unless they make free choice illusory (a matter for courts), and the Verbond van Verzekeraars reports no signals that caps are insufficient.
This yields a varied picture, but in general it can be said that in other European countries too, insurers' salaried lawyers provide legal aid in kind.

Hieruit komt een divers beeld naar voren, maar in zijn algemeenheid kan gezegd worden dat ook in andere landen in Europa juristen in loondienst van rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars in natura rechtshulp geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Medische gegevens duizenden Nederlanders verplaatst naar Google: 'Riskant'’

MPs Verhoeven and Raemakers asked whether patient medical data moved to Google Cloud by Medical Research Data Management was safe, whether patients and the Dutch Data Protection Authority were informed, and whether privacy-friendlier alternatives exist. The minister said hospitals bear responsibility for informing patients, that data stays in Dutch datacentres under double encryption with Google barred from access, and that he will commission independent research on non-European cloud platforms.
I will have independent research carried out into the desirability of using non-European cloud platforms to store healthcare data.
Ik zal onafhankelijk onderzoek laten doen naar de wenselijkheid van het gebruik van niet-Europese Cloud platforms voor het opslaan van zorgdata.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook weigert geld terug te betalen bij aankopen die op haar platform zijn gedaan door minderjarigen

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked the minister whether Facebook refuses refunds for in-game purchases made by minors without parental knowledge and what rules apply in the Netherlands. The minister answered that such refunds can be claimed under Dutch civil law, that Facebook has a refund tool and reportedly grants valid claims, and that parents can secure accounts, while the minister raised the issue with Facebook.
If something unexpectedly goes wrong and a child makes payments without permission, I am assured that Facebook is accommodating in refunding them.
Als er onverhoopt toch iets mis gaat en een kind zonder toestemming betalingen verricht, is mij verzekerd dat Facebook coulant omgaat met terugbetalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat kinderen in Nederland nog steeds kunnen gokken in videogames

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why children can still gamble through loot boxes in video games despite the Kansspelautoriteit finding breaches in 2018, why the offending games were not named, why FIFA changed in Belgium but not in the Netherlands, and whether the regulator has enough legal capacity to enforce. The minister answered that not all loot boxes breach the law, two games were fixed, two cases are ongoing, the regulator names firms only after an established breach, and the regulator is adequately equipped.
Because of possible unjustified reputational damage, the Ksa always chooses to name companies only after it has established that a breach has occurred and an enforcement measure has been imposed.
Vanwege mogelijk onterechte imagoschade kiest de Ksa er steeds voor om bedrijven pas bij naam te noemen nadat is vastgesteld dat er een overtreding is begaan en een handhavende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over illegale gokzuilen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about illegal slot machines (gokzuilen) and bookmakers, including enforcement capacity of the Kansspelautoriteit, municipal approaches and BIBOB screening. The minister answered most questions, noting enforcement actions, cooperation with municipalities and the planned new enforcement powers, while declining to confirm some figures and stating no need to expand the regulator's instruments further.
I see no reason for now to further expand its instruments.
Ik zie vooralsnog geen reden voor een verdere uitbreiding van haar instrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de terugkeer van gedetineerden naar de Pointe Blanchegevangenis op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether detainees were returned from the Netherlands to the Pointe Blanche prison on Sint Maarten despite inhumane conditions, and whether officials had warned the return was legally contested. The minister confirmed eight returns in 2018 (three after October for imminent release, five earlier at Sint Maarten's request), said the return of the rest was suspended pending improvement measures, and committed to monitoring progress.
Five detainees returned between April and July 2018 at Sint Maarten's request in the context of their legal proceedings.
Vijf gedetineerden zijn tussen april en juli 2018 teruggekeerd op verzoek van Sint Maarten in het kader van hun rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het succes van mediation in het strafrecht en de toereikendheid van het budget

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the success of mediation in criminal cases and whether the budget is sufficient, warning it may run out by October 2019. The minister responded that mediation is valuable for victims under conditions, that 774 mediation agreements were reached in 2018, and that the 2019 budget of 1.3 million euro, including 300,000 for youth cases, is expected to be sufficient.
For 2019 and subsequent years 1.3 million euro is available, of which 300,000 euro is exclusively for youth cases.
Voor 2019 en volgende jaren is 1,3 miljoen euro beschikbaar waarvan 300.000 euro exclusief voor jeugdzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de start van de pilot consumentenzaken met Legal Guard

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the consumer-cases pilot with LegalGuard: how its goals are evaluated, whether it was tendered, how fees and quality standards compare to subsidised lawyers, and the rule-making and marketing study behind the legal aid reform. The minister answered that an independent evaluation and audit will be carried out by the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that the pilot falls below tender thresholds and was initiated by the Raad, and that the reform design is still being refined through pilots and market research.
Evaluation is carried out independently of LegalGuard through a customer satisfaction survey by researchers at the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand.
Evaluatie gebeurt onafhankelijk van LegalGuard door middel van een klanttevredenheidsonderzoek door de onderzoekers bij de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over een zwartboek waaruit blijkt dat verzekeraars letselschadezaken niet altijd goed afhandelen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked about a Radar black book showing insurers do not always handle personal injury claims properly under the GBL code, and proposed statutory deadlines, sanctions, an independent tribunal and easier court access. The minister said a University of Utrecht study is under way, that the Tuchtraad already exists, that deelgeschillen procedures are available, and that responsibility is shared between two ministries, promising to decide on measures after the study results.
