Based on the outcomes of the University of Utrecht study, I will engage with the various stakeholders involved.
Aan de hand van de uitkomsten van voornoemd onderzoek van de Universiteit Utrecht zal ik in gesprek gaan met de verschillende betrokken stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het werkbezoek van de minister in België bij vrederechters

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection to report on findings from his working visit to a Belgian justice of the peace and what lessons he would apply in the Netherlands, and on what timeline. The minister described the visit and its discussions, said the Belgian model's features (low-threshold access, solution-oriented approach, referral) are being tested in Dutch district court pilots, and promised to send a WODC/Utrecht study on applicability to the Chamber before summer and to take stock with the judiciary after evaluating pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over onveiligheid in woonzorginstellingen

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about safety problems and weak oversight in supported-housing institutions housing ex-offenders and former TBS patients, following local media reports. The minister answered that municipalities supervise Wmo-funded supported housing, the IGJ and Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid have limited roles, no national picture is planned, and the government will send a forensic-expertise study and publish municipal oversight reports.
I do not have a national registration of the actual use by municipalities of the enforcement instruments available to them.
Ik beschik niet over een landelijke registratie van het feitelijke gebruik door gemeenten van het hun ter beschikking staande handhavingsinstrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Buitenweg en Van der Staaij over de gesloten jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld, Buitenweg and Van der Staaij asked the ministers about youths being placed in closed youth care because no alternatives exist, the acceptability of deprivation of liberty, waiting lists, and compliance with children's rights. Minister De Jonge answered that closed care should be minimised, pointed to a best-fit care plan and expert teams, acknowledged the lack of alternatives and the need for a new legal framework, and said several points are under study.
That young people have experienced stays in a closed institution as a prison, I consider an important signal.
Dat jongeren het verblijf in een gesloten instelling als een gevangenis hebben ervaren, vind ik een belangrijk signaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de blog ‘Een minister voor Rechtsbescherming is meer dan ooit nodig’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection to respond to a blog arguing that legal aid costs in four criminal cases are high because the government prolongs proceedings, and to comment on the author's claims about lawyers and perverse incentives. The minister says he will not discuss the individual cases, stresses that prosecutors and courts weigh efficiency against rights, and states that the legal aid system contains an incentive to litigate that a renewed system is being designed to fix.
I will not go into the individual examples.
Op de individuele voorbeelden zal ik niet in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie de mogelijkheid zou willen om vaker met criminelen deals en afspraken te maken in grote strafzaken

An SP MP asked whether the government supports the Public Prosecution Service's idea of more plea and sentence agreements with suspects in serious cases, and objected to lower sentences for serious criminals, risks of wrongful confessions, reduced public visibility and victims' rights. The Minister says he is in principle positive about exploring such agreements under a clear statutory framework, while guarding sentence severity, victims' position and a full public trial for serious cases.
I therefore in principle welcome further exploring the possibility of process and sentence agreements, based on further input from the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik sta dan ook in beginsel positief tegenover het verder verkennen van de mogelijkheid van proces- en vonnisafspraken, aan de hand van nadere inbreng van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van het faillissement van Intertoys

MPs Moorlag, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that the owner of bankrupt Intertoys, as a pledge-holding creditor, would be paid ahead of other creditors, whether this shifts business risk onto the tax authority, UWV and staff, and how workers would be helped. The minister said the specific case is for the curator and courts, explained generally how pledges give priority, said the matter is being examined in the bankruptcy law review, and described UWV information sessions and support for workers.
It is not for me to comment on a specific practical situation.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op een specifieke praktijksituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het plaatsen van (bewerkte) foto’s en filmpjes van leerkrachten in klaslokalen op internet

Two VVD MPs asked whether pupils posting edited photos and videos of teachers online is a growing problem, whether this breaches GDPR, and what sanctions apply. The minister said schools should set their own rules on phone use, that Kennisnet and the School and Safety foundation will be supported, that lawfulness under GDPR is for the Dutch data protection authority or courts to judge, and that the government does not hold figures on sanctions imposed.
The data on the number of sanctions is not known to me.
De gegevens over het aantal sancties zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Eijs over het bericht dat bedrijven websites als MijnBelastingdienst hebben ontdekt als jachtgrond voor persoonlijke gegevens

MPs Verhoeven and Van Eijs asked about reports that companies harvest personal data from government portals such as MijnBelastingdienst, and about data requirements for rental applicants. The State Secretary answered that the GDPR applies and that he is concerned about tenants' dependence on landlords, is exploring further legal frameworks for citizen control over personal data, and sees a government portal as not necessarily required.
I am currently examining whether further (legal) frameworks are needed for this.
Ik onderzoek momenteel of hiervoor nadere (juridische) kaders nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebrek aan onderzoekscapaciteit naar mogelijke politiefraude

An MP asked whether a complaint against police over a major tender has lain idle with the Rijksrecherche for six months, whether understaffing leaves police misconduct unexamined, and whether threats against mayors are blocking corruption investigations. The minister confirms the complaint was filed earlier, with later filings and a Article 12 complaint causing delay, and now sits with the Public Prosecution Service; he acknowledges capacity limits forcing scaled-back or dropped investigations, and denies that threats against mayors are the cause.
The file is now under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service.
Inmiddels ligt het dossier ter beoordeling voor aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over 'het verhaal van Lisa’ en het bericht dat de afhandeling van een artikel 12-zaak niet juist zou zijn geweest

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a radio/investigative report on a child sexual abuse case handled via an article 12 complaint procedure, including a judge's alleged personal acquaintance with an involved party and whether the victim was heard. The Minister declined to judge individual cases, stated the prosecution's decisions were based on evidence, and said the system has adequate safeguards and that any new facts should be pursued through criminal law routes.
It does not befit me as Minister to judge in concrete cases the handling of the case, the course of the procedure, the judge's ruling, or the judges who handled the case.

Het past mij als Minister niet om in concrete gevallen te oordelen over de behandeling van de zaak, het verloop van de procedure, de uitspraak van de rechter, of over de rechters die de zaak hebben behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de eindeloze strijd voor een schadevergoeding via de rechtsbijstandsverzekering

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a 60-year-old woman still awaiting damages via her legal expenses insurer after five and a half years, and about insurer conduct and the role of insurers in the new legal aid system. The minister declined to judge individual disputes, pointed to the complaints routes (Kifid, Tuchtraad), said the Letselschade Raad is studying causes of long-running injury claims, and said insurers' role in the new legal aid system is still being explored.
As Minister, I do not assess individual disputes between insured persons and insurers.
Als Minister treed ik niet in de beoordeling van individuele geschillen tussen verzekerden en verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Mijn grootste fout is dat ik hulp heb gezocht voor mijn kind'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a newspaper story on a father's experience with youth protection, including whether parents and children understand the roles of youth protection bodies and whether the Scheiden zonder Schade programme will be effective. The minister acknowledged the stories, said roles are clearly delimited but parents are not always adequately informed, and announced information materials and an update on the programme in spring 2019.
In practice it appears that in some cases parents and children do not feel sufficiently informed.
In de praktijk blijkt dat in sommige gevallen ouders en kinderen zich niet of onvoldoende geïnformeerd voelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over vrouwenbesnijdenis

Rep. Van Dijk asked the government about a request to the Hague mayor to act against the As-Soennah mosque over alleged endorsement of female genital mutilation, whether reconstructive surgery after FGM should be covered by basic insurance, and the practice of hymen checks and hymen restoration. The minister replied that the enforcement decision lies with the mayor, that FGM is illegal and the government pursues an integrated chain approach, that reconstructive surgery cannot yet be added to basic insurance pending a Zorginstituut opinion, and that the government opposes hymen restoration done out of fear and will consult doctors and the NVOG.
The request to enforce is addressed to the mayor of The Hague.
Het verzoek tot handhaven is gericht aan de burgemeester van Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Notarissen staken jarenlang kadastergeld in eigen zak’

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked about reports that notaries charged clients for cadastral fees and levies never actually incurred, and whether this is widespread, unlawful, and whether clients should be refunded. The Minister replied that the disciplinary judge has ruled on the conduct without imposing a sanction, that no structural problem is known so no estimate can be made, that the matter is for the civil court on undue payment, and that the bar association has urged notaries to compensate clients, which the Minister supports.
It is for the disciplinary judge to assess the conduct of a (candidate) notary and to impose measures where appropriate.
Het is aan de tuchtrechter om te oordelen over het handelen van een (kandidaat-)notaris en eventueel maatregelen op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over levenslang gestraften

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court order to submit a pardon request of a life-sentenced prisoner to the Crown, delays in pardon procedures, information gathering, victim involvement and the minister's remarks on life sentences. The minister answered that pardon procedures have no fixed deadlines, that information is adequately secured, and that the policy on life sentences complies with European human rights case law.
In the context of protecting the privacy of those involved, I can only inform the House that I take the handling of every pardon request, including the one concerned, seriously
In het kader van de bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen, kan ik uw Kamer slechts melden dat ik de behandeling van elk gratieverzoek, zo ook het betreffende gratieverzoek, serieus neem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rol van verzekeraars, Achmea in het bijzonder, bij het proces tot stelselherziening rechtsbijstand en de invloed op het ministerie

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about insurers, especially Achmea, and their growing role in the legal aid system reform and their influence on the ministry, including a pilot with LegalGuard and the minister's earlier promotional video for Achmea. The minister replies that the pilot was initiated by the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that ministry officials had no involvement in choosing LegalGuard, that insurers are consulted as one of many parties, and that no decision on the new system has been taken yet.
In choosing LegalGuard (an Achmea initiative) as service provider for this pilot, neither I nor my officials had any involvement.
Bij de keuze voor LegalGuard (initiatief van Achmea) als dienstverlener in het kader van deze pilot hebben noch ikzelf noch mijn ambtenaren enige betrokkenheid gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over de positie van de civiele rechter bij de mijnbouwschade in Groningen en de toegang tot het recht

MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked whether the draft bill moving earthquake damage claims from civil courts to administrative law (Instituut Mijnbouwschade) weakens Groningen residents' access to justice, and what is being done to make civil justice more accessible. Minister Wiebes replied that the bill is still with the Raad van State for advice, that administrative appeal is low-threshold, that the TCMG and a 200,000 euro fund for test cases are in place, and that the civil justice reform programme and an experiment law are planned.

The bill establishing the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen is currently with the Council of State's Advisory Division for advice. For this reason I cannot anticipate discussions touching on the content of the bill.

Het wetsvoorstel Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen ligt op dit moment voor advies voor aan de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State. Om die reden kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen op discussies die aan de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Buitenweg over collectief beheer bij Video on Demand

MPs Kwint and Buitenweg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about collective management of remuneration for Video on Demand, including whether American rightsholders are paid and whether similar international arrangements could apply. The Minister answered that a convenant between Dutch PAM collecting societies and Rodap covers VOD remuneration until 1 January 2020, that no data exist on cross-border flows, that some non-Rodap VOD providers such as Netflix have not paid so far, and that an evaluation of the Wet auteurscontractenrecht will be started.

Inquiries with the CBOs show that no overviews exist of the total remuneration collected through mandatory and voluntary collective management and its distribution to foreign authors and neighbouring rightsholders.

Navraag bij CBO's levert op dat er geen overzichten bestaan van het totaal via verplicht en vrijwillig collectief beheer geïnde vergoedingen en de repartitie daarvan aan buitenlandse auteurs- en naburig rechthebbenden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over nieuwe misstanden in het Gevangenisziekenhuis te Scheveningen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about new reports of misconduct and mould at the Scheveningen prison hospital (JCvSZ), including inspection frequency, complaint handling and whether enhanced oversight is needed. The minister replied that the inspectorate (IGJ) found no shortcomings requiring immediate intervention, that inspections are announced for security reasons but include unannounced elements, that the situation is not acceptable where mould exists but is being addressed, and that intensified oversight is not currently warranted, with continued routine monitoring.
The IGJ itself determines, on the basis of its findings, what the right steps are from the supervisory perspective.
De IGJ bepaalt zelf aan de hand van haar bevindingen wat de juiste stappen zijn vanuit het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de toestand in Justitieel Medisch Centrum Scheveningen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of poor hygiene, medication and treatment failures, and dilapidated buildings at the Scheveningen prison hospital JCvSZ, and whether the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) should re-inspect it. The minister said the IGJ found improvement points but no shortcomings requiring immediate intervention, pointed to a hygiene action plan and periodic audits, and saw no reason to request a new inspection.
I therefore see no reason to doubt the quality of care at the JCvSZ.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om te twijfelen aan de kwaliteit van zorg in het JCvSZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Feest in de bajes'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how detainees could film and party with mobile phones in PI Heerhugowaard, whether sanctions were imposed, whether staffing and camera coverage were adequate, and whether prison staff remain in control. The minister answered that the phones were contraband, sanctions were applied, staffing norms and inspections are in place, an investigation is ongoing, and staff remain in control though a stronger security awareness is needed.
An investigation is currently being carried out into how the contraband was brought into PI Heerhugowaard and how this can be prevented in future.
Er wordt op dit moment onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de manier waarop de contrabande in de PI Heerhugowaard is ingevoerd en hoe dit in de toekomst kan worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de harde kritiek vanuit de rechtspraak op het beleid waardoor het vertrouwen in en het gezag van de rechtspraak ondermijnd wordt

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection how she responds to sharp criticism from the Hague district court president that government policy undermines judicial trust and authority, and whether she is troubled by it. The minister acknowledges judiciary financial and workload problems, rejects the claim that policy deliberately pushes citizens away from courts, denies the criticism's examples (criminal penalty orders, e-court, court fees) are valid, and points to strong judicial independence in the Netherlands.
I am committed to, and will continue to work toward, preserving the prominent and independent position that the judiciary holds in our constitutional state.
Ik maak me sterk en blijf dat doen voor het behoud van de prominente en onafhankelijke positie die de rechtspraak in onze rechtsstaat inneemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Geen kinderen meer in de isoleercel? Niet haalbaar, zeggen instellingen’

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked about reports that youth care institutions say the goal of ending solitary confinement of children by 2021 is unrealistic, and about the current frequency of isolation, enforcement, and staffing. The minister says no such letter has been received, a uniform definition and registration of forced isolation is being developed with results due May 2019, the Inspectorate will supervise the rules, and staffing shortages are being addressed through a recruitment campaign.
It is not clear whether young people in Jeugdzorgplus are now forcibly isolated more or less often than in previous years.
Het is niet duidelijk of jongeren in de Jeugdzorgplus nu vaker of minder vaak dan in voorgaande jaren gedwongen worden afgezonderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook tieners betaalde om hen te kunnen bespioneren

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether Dutch youths used Facebook Research's paid data app, whether it is desirable and lawful under the GDPR for minors to be paid to share all their data, and whether the Dutch DPA knew of it and has enough capacity to supervise. The minister answers that the app targeted only the US and India, so the GDPR likely did not apply, that consent from minors under 16 requires parental authorisation, and that complaints about Facebook fall to the Irish lead supervisor while Dutch citizens can complain to the AP.

I do not consider it desirable that Facebook asks people for all their data in return for payment, because it is impossible to foresee what possibilities this data provision offers or which combinations of data can be made.

Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat Facebook mensen tegen betaling om al hun gegevens vraagt, omdat niet is te overzien wat de mogelijkheden zijn die deze dataverstrekking biedt of welke combinaties van data er kunnen worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over de teveel betaalde belasting over de SBF-verlofuitkering door oud-gevangenispersoneel

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked about excess payroll tax and health insurance premiums withheld from former prison staff receiving SBF leave benefits, and why refunds were limited to 104 weeks and to post-2013 cases. The state secretary answered that the 2013 statutory change has no retroactive effect, refunds were paid in December 2018 for the 104-week period, and the Tax Administration cannot deviate from this.
The statutory amendment has no retroactive effect for the first cohorts.
De wetswijziging kent geen terugwerkende kracht voor de eerste lichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat ex-gedetineerden nog steeds niet tot nauwelijks verzekeringen kunnen afsluiten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether ex-prisoners are still refused insurance even for unrelated products, whether the promised talks with insurers improved matters, and whether the criminal-record disclosure rule in the Civil Code should be narrowed. The minister answered that insurers assess individual risk, that the Association of Insurers reports few complaints, that the statutory framework should not be changed, and that the Vereende insurer serves high-risk applicants at higher premiums.
Amending the law is not something I consider opportune.
Aanpassing van de wet acht ik niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Deskundigen adviseren jeugd-tbs voor verdachte (19) geruchtmakende verkrachtingszaak De Esch’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a 19-year-old suspect in a violent rape case should be tried under adult criminal law rather than youth law and kept in pre-trial detention, and asked about his prior violent offence. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained that judges decide on adolescent criminal law case by case, and said the Public Prosecution Service is independent in these decisions.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het pas na een artikel-12 procedure verstrekken van een kopie van het onderzoeksdossier aan nabestaanden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why next-of-kin can only obtain a copy of a criminal investigation file after starting an article 12 complaint procedure, and whether this fits the motion calling for wider access with respect for privacy. The Minister explained three access routes, said the Public Prosecution Service now applies the revised guidelines more generously while protecting third-party privacy, and agreed to discuss the matter with the OM.
It is therefore not necessary for next-of-kin to start an article 12 complaint procedure in order to enforce access to the investigation file.
Het is dus niet nodig dat nabestaanden een artikel 12 klachtprocedure starten om toegang tot het onderzoeksdossier af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Vrouwen zoeken vaker én eerder hulp na verkrachting’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Bergkamp asked whether forensic evidence collection at Centres for Sexual Violence costs victims their own-risk payment, and how to exempt such care from it. The government answered that forensic costs are borne by the justice chain, medical care falls under the deductible, and it is piloting a one-year temporary scheme to reimburse the deductible for acute-phase victims while pointing victims to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven.

We are working towards a temporary one-year arrangement under which victims of sexual violence seeking help at the CSG in the acute phase receive reimbursement of the costs incurred for the deductible.

Zo zetten wij erop in om een tijdelijke voorziening voor één jaar in te richten waarbij slachtoffers van seksueel geweld die in de acute fase hulp zoeken bij het CSG, een vergoeding krijgen van de gemaakte kosten voor het eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over incassobonussen van deurwaarders voor grote klanten

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about bonus arrangements between bailiffs and large creditors such as insurers and energy companies, and whether these threaten bailiff independence. The minister acknowledges the risk, notes the financial supervisor BFT is investigating, points to a forthcoming KBvG regulation limiting tariff models and the Oskam committee report, and describes the CJIB's upcoming tender and the Rijksincassovisie.
This earnings model may pose a risk to the independence of the bailiff.
Dit verdienmodel is mogelijk een risico voor de onafhankelijkheid van de gerechtsdeurwaarder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het sluiten van een contract voor een pilot met rechtshulppakketten

The SP MP Van Nispen asked whether a first contract for a legal aid package pilot had been signed, including with an insurer subsidiary for 1200 social security cases, and why parliament and current legal aid providers were not informed or consulted. The minister referred to a letter of 6 February 2019 and answered yes to the request for answers before the debate.
For the answer to these questions I refer to my letter dated 6 February 2019 on the legal aid pilot.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief d.d. 6 februari 2019 over de pilot rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Veel gedetineerden gaan in de cel door met drugshandel, smokkel of afpersing’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that prisoners continue drug trafficking, smuggling and extortion from prison, questioning the failure to act on GRIP reports, the lack of registration of crimes committed by prisoners, and whether more staff and extra-secure capacity should be provided. The Minister acknowledges the problem, describes an intensified chain approach with DJI, OM and police, promises talks and a response to the DSP-groep study, and states that current EBI capacity suffices.
Continuing criminal activities in and from detention is unacceptable.
Het voortzetten van criminele activiteiten in en vanuit detentie is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht dat het kinderspel is om bedrijven lam te leggen met beslag

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that conservatory seizures can cripple businesses, requesting case figures, the balance of burdens between creditor and debtor, and whether debtors should be heard earlier. The minister gave court statistics, explained the existing safeguards (judge's assessment, opposition procedure, damages), said the courts do not keep the requested data, and said a bill to bar seizure as a mere pressure tool is pending before the Council of State.
There are no figures known on the number of cases in which the seizure was lifted in summary proceedings.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal gevallen waarin het beslag is opgeheven in kortgeding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de mogelijk negatieve effecten van de e-privacyrichtlijn op het werk van het Expertise Centrum Online Kindermisbruik

MP Van Nispen asked whether the ePrivacy Directive would prevent the EOKM and private parties from scanning uploads for child sexual abuse material without user consent, and whether the EOKM could keep using its hash database. The State Secretary answered that uploads are not preventively scanned, that ePrivacy rules stop applying once content reaches the host's server so hash-based removal remains possible, and that national exceptions for crime prevention may be explored.
Regarding the approach to child pornographic content, I am considering together with the Minister of Justice and Security to explore this option if the number of reports does not decline.
Voor wat betreft de aanpak van kinderpornografische inhoud overweeg ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid deze optie te verkennen wanneer het aantal meldingen niet daalt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de bruikbaarheid van de cijfers van het World Justice Project bij het vergelijken van rechtsstelsels

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice ministers how the World Justice Project Rule of Law Index is compiled, who funds and conducts the Dutch survey, how representative it is, and whether it justifies firm comparative conclusions. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the index is one of several indicators, that YouGov conducts the Dutch survey of about a thousand respondents in three cities, that the ministry does not fund it, and that the index is sufficiently reliable alongside other studies.
The World Justice Project is funded by, among others, foundations, governments, companies, individuals and national Bars of Lawyers.
Het World Justice Project wordt gefinancierd door onder andere stichtingen, overheden, bedrijven, individuen en nationale Ordes van Advocaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Wantrouwen: het verkeerde uitgangspunt’

Two VVD MPs asked why patients must give separate consent forms before treating doctors can share medical records, and whether opt-out or broader one-time consent is possible. The minister replied that the GDPR requires explicit consent, ruling out opt-out and blanket consent, and that the GTS programme is exploring a registered-consent scenario, to be discussed with parliament.

The medical professional confidentiality (laid down in the WGBO) guarantees that everyone can freely seek help from a healthcare provider and that patients can be fully open with their treating physician.
Het medisch beroepsgeheim (vastgelegd in de WGBO) garandeert dat iedereen vrijelijk voor hulp bij een zorgverlener kan aankloppen en dat patiënten volledig open naar hun behandelaar kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asked the government whether it bears responsibility for climate policy and how it responds to a series of statements by Greta Thunberg at COP24, including whether it disputes her criticisms and whether it will change policy and its own practices. The answer, given on behalf of several ministers, is not included in the text as provided, which is cut off after the question list.
Answer: The written questions from MP Akerboom (PvdD), question number 2018Z24293, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Akerboom (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24293 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten inzake Bekir A. de vermoedelijke moordenaar van een 16-jarig meisje

The MP Markuszower asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a suspect could approach a 16-year-old victim despite a no-contact order and probation supervision, why he had firearms, and whether the sentence was too lenient, and asked the Minister to instruct prosecutors against suspended sentences for repeat violent offenders. The Minister expressed sympathy, said he cannot comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, noted the victim's first report in May 2018 and that the Inspectorate will investigate the agencies' conduct, and stated that judges rule independently and that suspended sentences with strict conditions can be more effective.
I cannot enter into the judgment of the judge in individual criminal cases.
Ik kan niet in het oordeel van de rechter in individuele strafzaken treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de vervolgstappen omtrent bevallen onder pseudoniem

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about follow-up steps on anonymous births, including how confidential births are handled across agencies, costs of protected births, and whether anonymous birth should be legislated. The minister answered that confidential birth procedures are being improved with partners, a decision on de facto anonymous birth is expected before 1 March 2019, and no absolute protection can be guaranteed.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this before 1 March.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer daarover vóór 1 maart te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over eerdere signalen van misstanden bij interlandelijke adoptie

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection what signals the ministry received about misconduct in past intercountry adoptions and the Dutch state's role, why it took FOI requests to uncover involvement, and what this means for support to adoptees searching for origins. The minister reports various signals from five countries, admits earlier signals were not investigated in depth, announces an independent external commission, and promises to share information and develop a support plan with organisations.
That information is grounds for me to set up an external commission that will conduct independent research into intercountry adoptions that took place in the past.
Die informatie is voor mij aanleiding om een externe commissie in te stellen die onafhankelijk onderzoek gaat uitvoeren naar interlandelijke adopties die in het verleden hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de staat van het notariaat

A D66 MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about disciplinary sanctions against notaries, including the publication of reprimands and warnings, a decline in trust since 2005, rising severity of sanctions, accessibility and fees, and quality under market liberalisation. The minister answered that the legal system for publishing disciplinary rulings is adequate, that no clear trend in disciplinary cases or sanction severity exists, that trust has not measurably declined, and that the BFT supervision evaluation was largely positive.
Yes, I believe the legal system is adequate.
Ja, ik meen dat het wettelijk systeem toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onrechtmatig handelen door een voormalig rechter en de Raad voor de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Supreme Court rulings that a former judge and the Raad voor de rechtspraak acted unlawfully toward a lawyer, and about why the Council paid the procedural costs and whether those costs will be recovered. The Minister confirmed the rulings, said the Council bears costs only in exceptional cases, declined to detail the settlement or recovery given ongoing negotiations, and gave no concrete general safeguards beyond expecting the Council to have learned lessons.
In the interest of this procedure, I cannot go into this further.
In het belang van deze procedure kan ik hier niet verder op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het advies van het Zorginstituut Nederland omtrent financiering hoogtechnologisch draagmoederschap

An MP asked whether the Zorginstituut advice shows that covering high-tech surrogacy from the basic insurance is a political choice and why the advice request was only submitted on 24 August 2018, 156 days after it was announced. The government answered that the institute sees a precedent only where the intended parents have a medical indication, that coverage without one would conflict with the Zvw, and that the timing followed the wider Staatscommissie process, with a cabinet response to follow later.

As indicated in the answer to your earlier parliamentary questions of 3 December, a cabinet response to the Zorginstituut advice will follow together with the cabinet response to the entire advice of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.

Zoals aangegeven in de beantwoording van uw eerdere Kamervragen op 3 december 3 volgt een kabinetsreactie op het advies van het Zorginstituut samen met de kabinetsreactie op het gehele advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebruik van SyRI in Capelle aan den IJssel

An MP asked about the SyRI risk-profiling system in Capelle aan den IJssel, including how many cases were investigated, whether investigative powers were used against people without suspicion, and whether SyRI operations should be documented and reported annually. The state secretary said the 62 no-violation cases came from a separate collaboration rather than SyRI, that data were destroyed late, that risk reports are not proof, that SyRI methods will remain undisclosed, and that SyRI use is already documented with a possible mention in a semi-annual letter.
I maintain that the data files and analysis methods used by SyRI should not be made public.
Ik blijf van mening dat gebruikte databestanden en analysemethoden van SyRI niet openbaar moeten worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over straffen en belonen in de jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers whether a silent-sitting punishment and the withdrawal of earned privileges in youth care institutions are still used, whether extra oversight took place after a 2010 ruling, and what is done to protect youths and promote evidence-based methods. The minister answered that Pluryn reports the measure is no longer used, that the IGJ will make unannounced visits and will inspect all closed youth care institutions in early 2019, that advocates reported only minor concerns, and that a knowledge programme on effective methods starts in January 2019.
The IGJ will visit DHG unannounced to verify this as well.
De IGJ zal DHG onaangekondigd bezoeken om dit ook te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het inschrijven bij de gemeente Amsterdam

MPs Van Gent and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the refusal to register a child born abroad to two fathers in Amsterdam, whether Dutch law requires a mother on the birth certificate, and whether the Staatscommissie's review of parenthood addresses the issue. The minister explained that foreign birth certificates are refused recognition when they conflict with Dutch public order, that the mother-on-certificate principle is treated as fundamental, and that the government's response to the Staatscommissie's proposals and related studies will follow in early 2019.
A child must, where possible, be enabled through the birth certificate to know its maternal descent.
Een kind moet, indien mogelijk, aan de hand van de geboorteakte in staat worden gesteld zijn afstamming van moederszijde te kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de vader van een ontvoerd kind alimentatie moet betalen

SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the father of an abducted child had to pay maintenance, and whether the LBIO verifies foreign maintenance requests before enforcing them. The Minister answered that the LBIO will now include the paying parent's objections in court requests, check with the Dutch central authority for child abduction cases (subject to privacy limits), and develop a policy on refusing requests within the limited discretion the treaties allow, while stating that Ukraine's accession to the Hague Child Abduction Convention does not directly change the LBIO's assessment framework.
The LBIO has changed its working method in cases falling under the Hague Conventions of 1973 or 2007 or the New York Convention.
Het LBIO heeft de werkwijze veranderd in zaken die vallen onder de Haagse verdragen uit 1973 of 2007 of het Verdrag van New York.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over een boekhoudkundige truc om aan openbaarmaking van de jaarrekening te ontkomen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Blokker family evades annual accounts disclosure by periodically inserting a new parent company above HB Capital, and whether this should be closed off. The government answered that a subsidiary's publication duty only lapses if the parent publishes consolidated accounts and files a 403 declaration, that the transparency rules still apply, and that it sees no loophole requiring legislative change.
As appears from the answers above, I see no loophole in the law.
Zoals blijkt uit de bovenstaande antwoorden, zie ik geen maas in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het bericht ‘Tbs'er verdacht van verkrachting medewerkster’

MP Markuszower asked whether the government will publish the DJI incident monitor annually, whether assaults by tbs patients on clinic staff are registered, whether clinics always file reports, and whether every tbs patient committing a crime will be prosecuted. The minister answered that serious incidents are published anonymised on the DJI website, that clinics must report and file complaints, and that the OM assesses each complaint for prosecution, without committing to prosecute every offence.
The DJI incident monitor is an internal source used to evaluate these incidents within DJI and learn from them.
De DJI-incidentenmonitor is een interne bron, die wordt gebruikt om deze incidenten binnen DJI te evalueren en hiervan te leren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het mogelijk maken van hoogtechnologisch draagmoederschap voor paren van gelijke geslacht

An MP asked the government about allowing high-tech surrogacy for same-sex couples, citing clinic plans and a new professional guideline, and about the timing of a legal framework and Zorginstituut funding review. The minister answered that clinics may offer it within existing rules, that a legal framework awaits research due early 2019, and that the Zorginstituut was asked to assess funding.
The cabinet is considering a legal framework for surrogacy as part of its response to the advisory report of the State Committee on Parenthood.
Het kabinet beraadt zich over een juridische regeling voor draagmoederschap in het kader van de kabinetsreactie op het advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht de opening van nog een vondelingenkamer in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Legal Protection about the opening of another baby hatch (vondelingenkamer) in the Netherlands, its legality under the Children's Rights Convention and the Criminal Code, and the security of records kept by Stichting Beschermde Wieg. The minister answered that the government sees no reason for further research, will focus on prevention and cooperation, and will discuss with the foundation how to safeguard parentage records so children can access them later.
I will therefore discuss with Stichting Beschermde Wieg and the other involved bodies how parentage records can be properly managed and secured so they remain accessible.
Ik ga daarom met Stichting Beschermde Wieg en de andere betrokken instanties bespreken op welke wijze de afstammingsgegevens goed kunnen worden beheerd en geborgd kan worden

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema, De Graaf en Markuszower over de door een prediker gedane uitspraak in een online cursus van de As Soenah moskee te Den Haag, te weten: ‘Vrouwenbesnijdenis is niet verplicht

MPs Wilders, Agema, De Graaf and Markuszower asked about a preacher's statement that female genital cutting is recommended though not mandatory, and how many girls were cut, how many cases were prosecuted, and what subsidised organisations do. The minister answered that prevalence research is under way with results expected mid-2019, that cutting is prosecuted as assault, that cases are not registered separately, and that the government funds an integrated chain approach and will report on it in a progress letter.
It therefore cannot be retrieved from the registers how many court cases of genital mutilation there are.
Het is daarom niet uit de registers te halen om hoeveel rechtszaken van genitale verminking het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de coldcase kalender 2018

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the 2018 cold case calendar distributed in prisons, including why it targets detainees, the criteria for cold cases and for calendar inclusion, and why the Chris van de Werken murder was chosen. The minister confirmed the calendar's purpose and criteria in general terms but declined to discuss individual cases and offered only general information on new forensic techniques.
As your House is aware, I in principle do not comment on individual cases.
Ik ga, zoals uw Kamer bekend is, in beginsel niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Rechters te makkelijk gewraakt’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the public prosecution service and judges jointly pushed to restrict the right to challenge judges (wraking), and whether recent Supreme Court rulings and this push undermine judicial impartiality and require legislation. The Minister answered that the College and Raad had written to him about more flexibility in handling challenge requests, that the Supreme Court rulings fit current law and do not call for amendment, and that he will consider legal options later and inform the House once that is done.
The Supreme Court rules that challenging judges in criminal cases is not possible on the ground that they made unwelcome (interim) decisions.
De Hoge Raad oordeelt daarin dat wraking van rechters in strafzaken niet mogelijk is op de grond dat zij onwelgevallige (tussen)beslissingen hebben genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de gevarentoelage voor gevangenispersoneel mogelijk wordt afgeschaft

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether the hazard allowance for prison staff in the EBI, Terrorist and BPG wings is at risk, why cuts are considered, and how this fits with a TNO finding that the work remains heavy. The Minister says DJI is examining ways to reduce the burden, that there is no need to cut pay, and that results and the allowance will be reviewed at the end of 2019.
There is no need to cut the pay of staff in the EBI, TA and BPG wings.
Er is geen noodzaak om te bezuinigen op het loon van personeel van de EBI, de TA en de BPG-afdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de gehanteerde leeftijdsgrens voor aspirant-adoptieouders

Parliamentary questions from MP Bergkamp (D66) to the Minister for Legal Protection about the age limit of 42 (and 46) for prospective adoptive parents, asking about its basis, comparisons with other countries, pleegouders, embryo age limits and whether it should be raised. The minister answers that the limits are not absolute, rest on child-welfare grounds, have no known signals of problems, and that no increase is planned.
I see no reason to raise the age limits for prospective adoptive parents.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de leeftijdsgrenzen voor aspirant-adoptiefouders te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Den Boer over het bericht ‘DELA gebruikt vingerafdruk overledenen voor commerciële doeleinden’

MPs Van Dam and Den Boer asked whether funeral company DELA's use of deceased persons' fingerprints for commercial products was acceptable, and about legal protection of the dead and the remedies available to relatives. The minister answered that fingerprints taken with consent are a personal choice and part of business operations, that taking them without consent is unacceptable, and that relatives can complain to the company, the funeral complaints institute, the police or a civil court.
That a funeral organisation, such as DELA, sells products bearing the fingerprint of a deceased person for whom consent was given falls within the business operations of that organisation.

Dat een uitvaartorganisatie, zoals DELA, producten verkoopt met daarop de vingerafdruk van een overledene waarvoor toestemming is gegeven, behoort tot de bedrijfsvoering van de betreffende organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat bezorgde rechters de noodklok luiden over de financiering van de rechtspraak en de te hoge werkdruk

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about judges' open letter warning of underfunding, excessive workload and quality pressures in the judiciary. The minister acknowledged the concerns, rejected claims of shifted financial burdens and expanded Raad power, and pointed to ongoing talks on funding and workload studies without committing to new measures.
I take the concerns seriously and am discussing them with the Council for the Judiciary.
Ik neem de zorgen serieus en spreek daarover met de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verwijdering van het schilderij Regelrecht uit de rechtbank in Almelo

MP Bergkamp asked ministers about the removal of a nude-breasted painting from the Almelo court building, whether it undermines the court's independence, and whether the samenleving seeks to influence art more. The government answered that the court board is responsible for the building's interior, that the removal was weighed against a complaint from a sex-crime victim, and that artistic freedom remains the starting point, with no general policy on art in public buildings.

In this case it is therefore up to the court board of the Overijssel district court to assess to what extent the complaints received about the painting give cause to move it from the public to the non-public area of the Almelo courthouse.

Het is in dit geval dus aan het gerechtsbestuur van de rechtbank Overijssel om te beoordelen in hoeverre er in de ontvangen klachten over het schilderij een aanleiding moet worden gezien om het schilderij van de publieke naar de niet-publieke ruimte van het gerechtsgebouw in Almelo te verplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘drugsdumpingen in Zuid-Nederland’

An MP from D66 asked the Ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about the rise in drug waste dumpings and synthetic drug labs in the south of the Netherlands, including police data, investigative capacity, legal instruments and the ondermijningskamer. The Minister answered with regional counts, explained limits in ERISSP registration and LFO capacity, and said existing laws are adequate and that a strategic advisory report is expected by year end.
I cannot go into this specific incident, because it forms part of operational information.
Ik kan niet ingaan op dit specifieke incident, omdat dit onderdeel is van operationele informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over drugsfeest in Justitieel Complex Zaanstad

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about leaked footage of a drug party in JC Zaanstad prison, whether it was known in advance, and whether the planned closure of other prisons should be reconsidered. The Minister confirmed the footage, described searches and isolation of the seven inmates involved, and declined to reverse the closure decision, stating the prisons have a good detention climate.
This case was not previously known to me.
Dit geval was mij niet eerder bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Drugsfeest in gevangenis Zaanstad'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection how drugs and phones reached prisoners at JC Zaanstad after a leaked video showed a drug party, how supervision failed, and whether staff would be dismissed and prisoners punished more harshly. The Minister said the seven prisoners were identified and placed in isolation, searches were carried out, security measures are under review, no staff involvement was found, and a bill to criminalise smuggling of contraband was submitted.
There is no indication that staff are involved in the smuggling of contraband.
Er is geen aanwijzing dat personeel betrokken is bij de invoer van contrabande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over chaotische toestanden bij gevangenissen vanwege de op handen zijnde sluiting van vier inrichtingen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about chaos in prisons caused by the planned closure of four institutions, including staff and inmate transfers, safety equipment, working conditions and contraband in Zaanstad. The minister denied chaos, described a six-month phased transition plan with monitoring, and promised additional searches and reviews in Zaanstad.
The relocation of staff and detainees from the four locations to be closed, namely Almere, Zwaag, Zeist and Zoetermeer, is being carried out very carefully.
Het verplaatsen van de medewerkers en de gedetineerden uit de vier te sluiten locaties, te weten Almere, Zwaag, Zeist en Zoetermeer gebeurt zeer zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de politieverhoren en een mogelijke gerechtelijke dwaling in de Arnhemse Villamoord

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about police interrogation practices and possible miscarriage of justice in the Arnhem Villamoord case, including whether the novum-based review regime and interrogation rules need changing. The minister declined to judge the case pending the procurator-general's inquiry, pointed to ongoing professionalisation of interrogations and an upcoming evaluation and WODC monitor, and promised policy responses to the House.
It is still too early to conclude that this is the case here.
Het is nog te vroeg om de conclusie te trekken dat daarvan in deze zaak sprake is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over eerdere witwaspraktijken van ING

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about ING's earlier money-laundering practices, the settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, whether natural persons were shielded from prosecution, and the minister's role given former ING counsel Grapperhaus. The minister answered that the Dutch prosecutor was not involved in the 2012 US settlement, that no agreement shielded individuals and prosecution remains possible if new facts emerge, and that the transaction was approved by the minister after the Justice minister recused himself.
It does not befit me to comment on any integrity violations that may have come to light in another investigation, not conducted by the Dutch Public Prosecution Service.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over eventuele integriteitschendingen die in het kader van een ander onderzoek, dat niet is verricht door het Nederlandse OM, aan het licht zouden zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht over het verspreiden van een filmpje over een commerciële verzekeraar

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a promotional-looking video of her visit to a commercial legal-aid insurer (Stichting Achmea Rechtsbijstand) amounted to advertising, who conceived it, and whether it complied with the handbook for ministers on commercial activities. The minister answered that the visit was part of many fact-finding visits, the video was made by her communications directorate, further such visits and videos will be shared, and the handbook guidance was fully followed.
In my view these guidelines were fully complied with in shaping my working visit to Stichting Achmea Rechtsbijstand.
In mijn beleving zijn deze richtsnoeren volledig nageleefd bij de vormgeving van mijn werkbezoek aan de Stichting Achmea Rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Tbs’er verdacht van verkrachting medewerkster'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a TBS patient suspected of raping and assaulting a staff member at a day-care centre inside the clinic, asking about supervision, past incidents, staff protection, and abolition of TBS. The minister acknowledged the incident as serious but exceptional, described added security measures and staff protection programmes, provided incident figures without delict types, and defended TBS as aimed at preventing reoffending.
The type of offence is not registered, since at that point it is not yet clear under which criminal provision the violence against staff falls.
Het type delict wordt niet geregistreerd, aangezien op dat moment nog niet duidelijk is, onder welke strafbepaling het geweld tegen het personeel valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘bedrijven die DNA-materiaal van hun cliënten met anderen delen’

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether companies that obtain clients' DNA for ancestry research may share it with third parties such as pharmaceutical firms, and what remedies citizens have. The minister answered that such sharing requires explicit consent for a specific purpose, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority supervises compliance, and that existing information for citizens is sufficient, so no new measures are planned.
Only when a person gives explicit consent for the disclosure of their special (genetic) data to another company may that person's special personal data be shared.

Alleen wanneer een persoon uitdrukkelijke toestemming geeft voor het verstrekken van zijn of haar bijzondere (genetische) gegevens aan een ander bedrijf, mogen de bijzondere persoonsgegevens van deze persoon gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over vrijwilligerswerk met gedetineerden en ex-gedetineerden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the new subsidy system for volunteer work with detainees and ex-detainees, and about administrative burden raised by BONJO. The minister acknowledged the value of volunteer work, admitted possible extra administrative burden during transition, and committed to an implementation manager, an advisory committee and an evaluation of the new system.
I aim to keep these burdens to a minimum.
Ik streef ernaar deze lasten tot een minimum te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook telefoonnummers gebruikt voor advertentiedoeleinden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether Facebook uses phone numbers given for account security for advertising, whether this is lawful under the GDPR, and whether non-users can be targeted via uploaded contact data. The minister said he lacks data, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority decides whether to investigate and that Ireland's authority may be the lead regulator, and that using security-provided data for advertising without consent is not permitted under the GDPR.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), as independent supervisor, to possibly investigate and make a judgment on the lawfulness of Facebook's conduct.
Het is aan de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens (AP) om als onafhankelijke toezichthouder eventueel onderzoek te doen en een oordeel te vellen over de rechtmatigheid van het handelen van Facebook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Staat wil deal met Volkert van der Graaf'

An MP from the PVV asks why the Public Prosecution Service negotiates with Volkert van der Graaf, the convicted killer of Pim Fortuyn, and why he was released early and may leave the country, and whether he should be re-jailed or expelled. The minister answers that the court and prosecution agreed a new reporting arrangement without judicial intervention, that early release and conditions are for the judge to decide, that emigration would be subject to ordinary rules, and that re-arrest or expulsion will not be pursued.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to assess whether conditional release should be withheld.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling (v.i.) achterwege moet worden gelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat advocaten Dekker ‘klassenjustitie’ verwijt

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about lawyers' accusations of class justice over planned reforms to subsidised legal aid, and about the claim that the government ignores the legal-aid target group. The minister says the reform proposal is being finalised, describes the Wrb user population from the 2016 monitor, and acknowledges that the government is the opposing party in most subsidised cases and commits to preventing unnecessary government litigation.
I believe the government should set a good example and therefore wants to focus on preventing unnecessary proceedings and juridification within government.
Ik vind dat de overheid het goede voorbeeld moet geven en wil daarom inzetten op het voorkomen van onnodige procedures en juridisering bij de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de regeling van het openbaar ministerie met Volkert van der Graaf

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister for Legal Protection about costs of the Public Prosecution Service's deal with Volkert van der Graaf, any financial support including emigration or living costs abroad, and whether emigrating convicts receive such aid. The minister declined to give cost details or information on individual financial support, referred to the ongoing special (v.i.) regime running to May 2020, and said such support is not customary.
I will not go into the procedural costs incurred in an individual case.
Ik ga niet in op gemaakte proceskosten in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Den Boer over een mogelijk incorrect politie voorschrift en de schijnbare willekeur bij het handhaven van een omgangsregeling

MPs Bergkamp and Den Boer asked about an internal police instruction that wrongly stated a custodial parent withholding a child from court-ordered contact does not commit an offence under article 279 Penal Code, and about perceived arbitrariness in enforcement. The Minister acknowledged the instruction was incorrect, said it was removed and revised, and denied arbitrariness, noting police must establish an offence and consult the public prosecutor.
This is incorrect and not in line with article 279 of the Penal Code.
Dit is onjuist en niet in lijn met artikel 279 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Ronnes en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Opmars No Cure, No Pay bureaus bij WOZ-bezwaren’

MPs asked about the growing share of WOZ property-valuation objections filed by no-cure-no-pay agencies, including calls for independent research, consumer protection, association sponsorship practices, municipal valuation quality, and an OZB inspection counter under the Omgevingswet. The ministers say they will commission research into the volume of such objections and related cost reimbursements before deciding on solutions, but decline to intervene in agency-association arrangements and point to existing Waarderingskamer oversight and the WOZ waardeloket.
My colleagues and I will have the development of the number of objections by no cure no pay companies and the related cost reimbursements examined.
Mijn ambtgenoten en ik zullen de ontwikkeling van de aantallen bezwaren door no cure no pay bedrijven en de in verband daarmee toegekende kostenvergoedingen laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Drie jaar cel en tbs voor verkrachtende verlof-tbs’er’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how a tbs detainee who raped a girl came to be granted leave, whether such leave decisions are sound, and whether leave should be banned after violent or sexual offences committed on leave. The minister replies that leave is an essential, carefully assessed part of treatment reviewed by the clinic and the independent AVT, that incidents are evaluated and protocols adjusted where needed, and that existing rules already allow tbs to be extended, while declining to comment on sentencing.
That happens very carefully and in a step-by-step manner.
Dat gebeurt heel zorgvuldig en stapsgewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Woede over nieuwe kans voor enkelbandknipper’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a violent offender who had cut his ankle tag was given a new chance with an ankle tag and early release, and whether the law would be changed so such offenders stay in prison, given the victims' families' anger. The minister refused to change the law now, pointing to recidivism reduction and victims' interests, and said a bill limiting conditional release is expected this autumn.
The judge weighs all the interests involved, including those of the surviving relatives.
De rechter maakt daarbij een afweging van alle betrokken belangen, inclusief die van nabestaanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Wonen naast een tbs-kliniek: Hoe een verkrachting het dorpje Oostrum opschudde’

PVV MPs Helder and Markuszower asked about police questioning of a rape victim in Oostrum, police requests for secrecy about a tbs-detainee perpetrator, compensation, sentencing and tbs leave policy. Minister Grapperhaus defended police handling in general terms, declined to comment on the individual case, and said the leave system is a necessary part of tbs treatment with an Inspectorate study pending.
I cannot go into an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat 'de naam van de kerk boven het welzijn van de mens komt'

An MP asked the ministers whether the 'crimen sollicitationis' instruction still applies in the Dutch Catholic Church, how it relates to Dutch criminal procedure and human rights, and whether the church's secrecy could enable cover-ups, and asked for talks with the bishops. The minister answered that the instruction has not been in force since 2001, announced a WODC study on broadening the reporting duty (art. 160 Sv), said the church's procedures are subordinate to Dutch criminal law, and declined a new meeting with the bishops as unnecessary.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Ontsnapte tbs’er Patrick B. zit weer vast’

The MP asks how a tbs patient who had earlier escaped from leave was granted leave again, and whether patients who escaped or attempted escape will be denied leave. The Minister declines to discuss individual cases, explains the independent leave-assessment process (clinic committee and the AVT advisory college), notes that an escape ends leave and bars leave for at least a year, and states that no one who escaped in 2018 was transferred to another clinic.
It is not appropriate for me to address individual cases.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrief van rechters en officieren van Justitie

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection how she responds to the NVvR letter warning that the judiciary is under strain, including staff shortages, overload, ICT problems, budget uncertainty and reserve depletion, and whether the planned review of judicial operations will protect quality. The minister acknowledges the concerns, points to funding increases, ongoing digitalisation resets, governance measures and a review, but answers mostly by restating existing policy and deferring to the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Following the evaluation of the Judicial Map Revision Act and the digitalisation problems, I have indicated that the judiciary faces financial and governance problems.

Ik heb naar aanleiding van de evaluatie van de Wet herziening gerechtelijke kaart (HGK) en de problemen rond de digitalisering aangegeven dat de rechtspraak kampt met financiële en governance problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het filmpje op Twitter inzake Achmea Rechtsbijstand

Two MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Twitter video showing the minister endorsing Achmea legal insurance, asking about commercial interest, sponsorship, and the link to reform of subsidised legal aid. The minister denied any Achmea involvement or advertising, said the visit was to inform himself, and promised to inform parliament soon on the reform of legal aid.
As Minister for Legal Protection, I attach great importance to being broadly informed on various fields by different parties.
Als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming hecht ik groot belang aan het mij breed laten informeren op diverse terreinen door verschillende partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verspreiden van een filmpje over een commerciële verzekeraar

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why she had a film made of her visit to Achmea Rechtsbijstand, a commercial legal-aid insurer, and distributed it on Twitter, and whether she risked it looking like advertising for that insurer. The minister answered that the visits are a way to learn about practice and that sharing footage shows what the visits involve, denied the advertising risk, and said she visited many organisations including social-law firms.
By sharing footage I make clear what these working visits consist of.
Met het delen van beeldmateriaal maak ik inzichtelijk waaruit deze werkbezoeken bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hiddema over het aandeel van de asieladvocatuur binnen de gefinancierde rechtshulp

An FvD MP asked how much publicly funded legal aid goes to asylum and immigration procedures, what lawyers are paid in those cases, and whether lawyers in hopeless asylum cases could be denied legal-aid payment via court ruling. The minister answered that data for 2000-2001 are unavailable, pointed to a table for the budget figures, and declined to investigate court-based denial of lawyers' income, citing the ongoing asylum procedure review.
Figures for the years 2000 and 2001 are not available, because this was not separately registered in the Justice budget.
De cijfers voor de jaren 2000 en 2001 zijn niet beschikbaar, omdat dit niet apart geregistreerd werd in de Justitiebegroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een onderzoek van de Kinderombudsman naar vervangende jeugddetentie

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Children's Ombudsman's report on substitute youth detention for unpaid damages orders, including how often it is imposed and whether minors can pay. The minister answered that substitute detention is applied in under 1% of cases, that judges should weigh each minor's ability to pay, and that a new, more person-oriented payment arrangement policy since 2017 allows instalment plans, with a broader letter on youth criminal law promised.
At present it is being examined how, after substitute detention has been applied, further collection of the damages measure can still be achieved, for both minors and adults.

Op dit moment wordt onderzocht op welke wijze na de toepassing van vervangende detentie de verdere inning van de schadevergoedingsmaatregel nog bewerkstelligd kan worden, zowel bij minder- als meerderjarigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de leeftijdsopbouw van het nieuwe DJI personeel

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister for Legal Protection for the age breakdown of the 800 new DJI staff, how many applicants aged 50 and over were rejected and on what grounds, and for a faster reply. The minister gave a rough age split (60% under 30, 30% aged 30-50, 10% over 50) but said DJI does not record age in selection, so applicant-level age data and rejection grounds cannot be provided.
I therefore cannot state how many of the applicants for the 800 vacancies were 50 or older, how many of them were rejected, and on what grounds.
Ik kan dan ook niet aangeven hoeveel van de sollicitanten voor de 800 vacatures 50 jaar en ouder waren, hoeveel van hen werden afgewezen en op welke gronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Staat aansprakelijk voor uitlatingen bewindspersoon over downloaden uit illegale bron’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court ruling that the State acted unlawfully toward film producers by statements about downloading from illegal sources, asking about consequences, damages, and why the government long held downloading from illegal sources was not punishable and what enforcement followed. The Minister said the ruling is still being studied and appeal is possible, no damages have yet been claimed, and that since the 2014 CJEU ruling downloading from illegal sources was never permitted, with enforcement left largely to private collective action by Stichting Brein.
No statements can yet be made about the consequences of the judgment.
Over de gevolgen van het vonnis kunnen nog geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de volmacht en de Participatiewet

Two SP MPs asked whether a son holding a power of attorney for his incapacitated mother can lose his Participatiewet benefit merely by being deemed able to dispose of her assets, and what options exist to prevent this. The Secretary of State replied that a power of attorney does not affect benefit entitlement if the funds are used solely for the principal, that the benefit must be stopped only if the duty to disclose is breached, and that municipalities have been informed via a Gemeentenieuws notice.
A power of attorney and being reasonably able to dispose of funds has no effect on the right to benefits, provided the funds are used exclusively for the benefit of the authorised person.
Een volmacht en het redelijkerwijs over middelen kunnen beschikken heeft geen invloed op het recht op bijstand, mits de middelen uitsluitend ten behoeve van de gemachtigde worden aangewend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van Ojik en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Waarom help Nederland zijn meisjes niet’

MPs Özütok, Van Ojik and Buitenweg asked the Foreign Affairs and Legal Protection ministers why the Netherlands helps so few women and girls who are victims of forced marriage or abandonment abroad, why the ticket fund is little used, and how Norway compares. The minister's answer describes 38 reports in 2017, the handling of cases, the limited use of the ticket fund, and commits to reporting results of the forced marriage unit soon.
There is no national registration of victims of forced marriage and abandonment.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van slachtoffers van huwelijksdwang en achterlating.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat honderden advocaten de afgelopen jaren zijn gestopt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why hundreds of social lawyers have stopped, citing high workload and low fees, and asked whether the minister will provide a reasonable fee. The minister says the number of legal aid providers fell only 2% and is not alarming, and commits to reforming legal aid within existing budgets, starting with family law, while promising to inform parliament soon.
I feel the urgency to bring about changes in the short term.
Ik voel de urgentie om op korte termijn veranderingen tot stand te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht ‘Wetgeving rond internationale faillissementen is verouderd’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether Dutch rules on recognising non-EU insolvencies are outdated, how often such cases arise, and whether the Bankruptcy Act should change. The Minister says such cases are probably a few dozen per year, that courts currently decide case by case, and that he will discuss modernisation with the bankruptcy advisory group and inform parliament.
I do not have access to the precise number of bankruptcies outside the European Union that have a connection with the Netherlands
Ik heb geen beschikking over de precieze hoeveelheid faillissementen buiten de Europese Unie die een relatie hebben met Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Woede over nieuwe kans voor enkelbandknipper’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a convicted offender who had previously cut his ankle monitor could be released again under conditional release with a new ankle monitor rather than serving longer in prison. The minister explained that the court revoked 120 days of conditional release as punishment and, rejecting the prosecution's request to drop the new conditional release, imposed conditions including monitoring via an ankle band.
By judgment of 12 July 2018 the Zeeland-West-Brabant district court ruled there were insufficient grounds to forgo the conditional release entirely.
Bij uitspraak van 12 juli 2018 oordeelde de rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant dat er onvoldoende grond is de v.i. geheel achterwege te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wiersma over het bericht van RTL Nieuws dat tientallen criminelen een uitkering ontvangen ondanks een openstaande celstraf

Two MPs asked why convicts evading an open prison sentence still receive benefits, and whether the state can recover them and tighten the law. The minister says the practice is unjustifiable, describes a CJIB-UWV data-matching process and a pilot letter scheme to meet Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings, and sees no need for a law change.
For this small remaining group, I am therefore, together with my colleague at SZW, taking an additional step to stop the benefit.
Voor deze kleine resterende groep zet ik daarom samen met mijn ambtsgenoot van SZW nog een extra stap om de uitkering stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht 'Tientallen criminelen krijgen uitkering ondanks openstaande celstraf'

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice why convicted criminals with outstanding prison sentences still receive benefits, how much this costs, and what will be done to stop and recover payments. The minister answers that benefits are terminated under a 2011 scheme, 837 benefits were withdrawn in 2016-2017, courts have in some cases ruled withdrawal unlawful, and a CJIB-UWV pilot with letters to offenders will continue.

To withdraw or refuse benefits of convicted persons with an outstanding prison sentence, benefit agencies match CJIB files of fugitives from the investigation register against files of benefit recipients.
