Om de uitkeringen van veroordeelden met een openstaande vrijheidsstraf in te trekken of te weigeren, matchen uitkeringsinstanties CJIB-bestanden van voortvluchtigen uit het opsporingsregister met de bestanden van uitkeringsgerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat gevangenispersoneel alarm slaat over een plan om gevangenen veel meer zelf te laten regelen via tablets

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about staff concerns over a pilot giving prisoners self-service tablets (ZBJ), including fears of less human contact, unsafe situations, and the replacement of libraries. The minister answered that the pilot is in its test phase in three locations, staff and works councils were involved, the tablets are designed to increase human contact and coaching, and no physical library will be replaced during the pilot.
Thus the COR will take part in the pilot's steering committee.
Zo zal de COR deelnemen aan de begeleidingscommissie van de pilot.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Toorenburg over onnodig confronterende vragen op evaluatieformulieren voor ouders van kinderen met zeer ernstige verstandelijke en meervoudige beperkingen (ZEVMB)

Two MPs asked whether evaluation forms that ask parents who are curators of children with severe multiple disabilities (ZEVMB) about their children's self-reliance are unnecessarily confronting, and whether the forms can be changed. The minister acknowledges the questions can be painful, reports that the form has been revised so parents can skip questions with a medical statement, and says the issue will be discussed with stakeholders and the Werkgroep Wij zien je Wel.
At the second periodic evaluation, answering the questions can be much shorter via a specific ZEVMB-targeted route.
Bij de tweede periodieke evaluatie kan de beantwoording van de vragen veel korter zijn via een «afslag», die specifiek is gericht op ZEVMB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Toenemende agressie tegen gevangenispersoneel’

MPs Buitenweg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising aggression against prison staff, workload, and staffing norms in prisons. The minister acknowledged the reports, said staff stability and workload scores are unchanged, noted a fragile balance in staffing, and saw no need for additional measures given existing convenant-based investments.
In view of this, I currently see no need to take additional measures.
Gelet hierop zie ik op dit moment geen noodzaak aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de sterke rechtspositie van banken in het geval van insolventie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Ministers of Justice and Finance about banks' strong legal position as secured creditors in insolvency, the disadvantage to other creditors, and whether the balance is still desirable. The Minister answered that the government will discuss the balance with insolvency practitioners within the ongoing faillissementsrecht reform, while defending the current pledge rules and noting that other creditors have their own protections.

Whether the above is still sufficient to keep the positions of the various parties in a bankruptcy in balance, I will discuss with practitioners within the reorganisation pillar of the bankruptcy law revision programme.

Of het voorgaande nog steeds voldoende is om de positie van de verschillende betrokkenen in een faillissement in evenwicht te houden, zal ik in het kader van het laatste wetsvoorstel in de reorganisatiepijler van het wetgevingsprogramma herijking faillissementsrecht bespreken met vertegenwoordigers uit de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het tekortschietende toezicht op deurwaarders

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the four-person Bureau Financieel Toezicht can adequately supervise all bailiffs, and why investigations fell while bailiff offices under heightened supervision doubled. The minister replied that there is currently no enforcement shortfall, agreed to a 335,000 euro budget deficit for 2018, and will discuss funding for 2019 with the BFT and professional bodies in October.
I have agreed to a budget deficit for 2018 so that the BFT can carry out the proposed supervisory activities regarding bailiffs.
Ik heb ingestemd met een tekort op de begroting voor 2018 opdat het BFT uitvoering kan geven aan de voorgestelde toezichtactiviteiten ten aanzien van de gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Roon en Agema over het beleid van Jeugdbescherming Rijnmond inzake reisadviezen naar Israël

PVV MPs asked whether the Rotterdam youth protection agency JRR gives children under supervision a negative travel advice for Israel, why it differs from Turkey or Morocco, and whether it should allow travel to such areas when accompanied by an adult. The minister answered that the certified institution assesses each trip case by case for every destination, that the ministry's advice is only one factor, and that it will not restrict the institution's power to refuse travel when child development is at risk.
There is no general negative travel advice for any country.
Er is daarbij geen sprake van een algemeen negatief reisadvies voor welk land dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de regulering van rechtsbijstandverzekeringen

Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the quality of legal aid provided by insurers' in-house jurists, self-regulation via the Verbond van Verzekeraars, the status of a motion on supervision of procedural legal advisers, and the free choice of lawyer after the Massar/DAS ruling. The minister answered that insurer quality is judged by the same civil standard as for lawyers, that a WODC evaluation found insurer-provided help rated best, that a study on supervision is being followed up, and that cost caps on external lawyers are for courts to assess.
Incidentally, the Verbond van Verzekeraars has no known signals that the stated cost maximum would be insufficient.
Bij het Verbond van Verzekeraars zijn overigens geen signalen bekend dat het gestelde kostenmaximum onvoldoende zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Het no cure no pay-verbod binnen de advocatuur moet worden opgeheven’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a report calling for lifting the ban on no-cure-no-pay arrangements in the legal profession, and about the effects and future of the ongoing pilot in injury and fatal-damage cases. The minister answered that the pilot aims to widen access to justice, that the Dutch Bar (NOvA) is evaluating it and will decide before year-end on continuation, and that other countries and other legal fields are not yet assessed.
I do not have an overview of other European countries without a ban on no cure no pay, nor of the effects in those countries on the costs of the legal profession and access to justice.
Ik heb geen overzicht van andere Europese landen die geen verbod op «no cure no pay» hebben, noch van de effecten in die landen op de kosten van de advocatuur en de toegang tot het recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Buitenweg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over seksueel misbruik binnen de gemeenschap van Jehova’s Getuigen

Four MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether at least five victims had filed reports of sexual abuse within the Jehovah's Witnesses, whether these reports warrant further investigation, how police and prosecutors handle them, whether Jehovah's Witnesses can invoke the clergy testimony privilege, and whether internal instructions to store abuse allegations in sealed envelopes comply with the GDPR. The minister confirmed the reports, said an ongoing criminal investigation prevents further comment, stated the prosecution has nationwide oversight, said the testimony privilege belongs to individuals not organisations and will be considered in the review of extending the reporting duty, and referred the GDPR question to the independent Data Protection Authority.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation, which may result in prosecution and trial.
Er is sprake van lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat kan resulteren in vervolging en berechting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mogelijk gebruik van Chroom-6 in de PI Ter Apel

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about possible Chromium-6 exposure from treated wood handled by staff and detainees at PI Ter Apel, including health complaints, reported internal risk assessments, and storage practices. The Minister answered that no Chromium-6 health complaints were known for Ter Apel, that the 2014 and 2016 risk assessments and a RIVM study will be pursued, and that suppliers were ordered to stop delivering chromium-treated wood.
I have therefore asked the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) to examine whether, and if so how, more clarity can be provided on this.
Ik heb daarom het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) verzocht na te gaan of, en zo ja hoe, hier meer duidelijkheid over kan worden verschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hiddema en Baudet over het bericht 'extreemlinkse activisten blijven meestal onbestraft'

Two MPs from FvD asked the Justice Minister whether left-wing extremist activists enjoy de facto impunity, as suggested by a WODC report, and what the government will do about it. The minister disagreed with that conclusion, citing difficulties of proof and that in three of seven cases the suspect was convicted, and said extremism of any kind is prosecuted case by case.
Where extremist conduct constitutes a criminal offence, the Public Prosecution Service will investigate as far as possible and assess whether to prosecute.

Wanneer er sprake is van extremistische gedragingen die een strafbaar feit opleveren, zal het OM voor zover mogelijk onderzoek instellen en beoordelen of tot strafrechtelijke vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan huurders van boerenschuren screenen’

MPs Van Oosten and Rutte asked whether the government supports municipalities screening tenants of farm barns for criminal records to prevent drug labs or cannabis grow sites, and about reviving the 'stoplight model' for police advice to private landlords. The minister welcomed local initiatives against undermining crime, said the stoplight model lacked a legal basis and was stopped, and that the government is studying the problem.
Data protection law provides no room to restart the implementation of the stoplight model.
Het gegevensbeschermingsrecht biedt geen ruimte om een doorstart te maken met de uitvoering van het stoplichtmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verstrekken van een kopie van het onderzoeksdossier aan nabestaanden

An SP MP asked the Minister whether relatives of deceased persons still cannot obtain copies of criminal investigation files, and how the promised talks and motion on access were being followed up. The government replied that the Public Prosecution Service has amended its guidelines so relatives in principle get access to the file, with privacy weighed case by case, and that it will meet an experienced lawyer in August and report to parliament.
This means that under the amended Guidelines, relatives in principle always get access to the file.
Dit betekent dat op grond van de aangepaste Aanwijzingen nabestaanden in beginsel altijd inzage krijgen in het dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onverenigbaarheid van het ambt van rechter en het Kamerlidmaatschap

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the judicial office should be declared incompatible with a seat in the Senate or House of Representatives, and whether other posts such as civil servant should also be incompatible with it. The minister said a position will be drafted with the Interior Minister and information sent to parliament after the summer recess, while stating that ancillary positions are generally considered a useful addition to the judicial office and existing guidelines suffice.
I have received the advice of the judiciary and am now preparing a position in consultation with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik heb het advies van de rechtspraak ontvangen en bereid nu in overleg met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties een standpunt voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de inning van auteursrechten door collectieve beheersorganisaties

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about rising fees collected by collective rights organisations from small businesses for copyright use, the lack of clear justification, limited information for entrepreneurs, and whether oversight should be tightened. The minister acknowledged a single joint invoice has not yet been agreed, called on the organisations to act quickly, pointed to existing information channels, and said a bill strengthening the oversight body's powers is being prepared for submission in early 2019.
The cabinet aims for effective and efficient supervision of collective rights organisations.
Het kabinet streeft naar slagvaardig en doelmatig toezicht op cbo's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Koopmans over het bericht ‘Mkb kan uitzondering op nieuwe strenge privacywet wel vergeten’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about SME compliance costs and vague AVG rules, including the register obligation and data storage scope, and about the Data Protection Authority's enforcement approach. The government estimated compliance costs, pointed to existing guidance and brochures, said the register duty largely replaces the earlier notification duty, and described the AP's independent focus on education and proportionate enforcement.
The AP is an independent supervisor that makes its own supervisory choices.
De AP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf haar toezichtskeuzes maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat twee derde van 150 populaire websites de privacywet overtreedt

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a report that two-thirds of 150 popular websites breach privacy law, and about the regulators' priorities, the Tax Administration's delay in complying with the GDPR, and whether government bodies should lead by example. The minister said regulators set their own priorities, that the Data Protection Authority is adequately resourced, that the Tax Administration has reached a basic compliance level with a plan to finish, and that government bodies must comply like any other organisation.
It is therefore not for me to pass judgment on the Data Protection Authority's priority setting.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over de prioriteitstelling van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er veiligheidsproblemen zouden zijn in de penitentiaire inrichting te Alphen aan de Rijn

SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of high sick leave and security problems at the Alphen aan den Rijn prison, including temporary staff use, delays in transferring convicted prisoners, medication errors and staffing. The minister acknowledged the signals, gave sick-leave and staffing figures, denied the medication-error allegation, and pointed to ongoing recruitment and measures to reduce absence.
I take the signals from staff seriously.
Ik neem de signalen van het personeel serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat FNV nu snel extra geld eist voor veiligheid cipiers

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about union demands for quick extra money for prison guard safety, the feeling of insecurity among guards due to understaffing, the status of the DJI convenant, tensions between permanent and temporary staff, and when improvements will be felt. The minister said recruitment is ongoing with 757 new executive staff hired, €100 million is earmarked for the convenant, and the convenant talks are continuing.
There are no financial obstacles to hiring the necessary prison security officers and penitentiary workers.
Er zijn geen financiële belemmeringen voor het aannemen van de benodigde inrichtingsbeveiligers en penitentiair inrichtingswerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over matchfixing in het tennis

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether a Belgian match-fixing investigation in tennis involves Dutch suspects, whether Dutch and Belgian authorities are in contact, and whether the Kansspelautoriteit or prosecutors will investigate Dutch parties. The minister confirmed contact with Belgian authorities via the Public Prosecution Service, said he cannot comment on foreign investigations, and explained that the Ksa only supervises detection and reporting of suspicious bets, with signals assessed for criminal investigation without confirming any ongoing investigations.
Each signal is also examined, as usual, for possible leads for criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
Elk signaal wordt daarnaast – zoals gebruikelijk – onderzocht op mogelijke aanknopingspunten voor strafrechtelijk onderzoek door het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Koopmans over gebruik informatie uit het Handelsregister voor facebook-targeting

Two VVD MPs asked how Chamber of Commerce register data could be used for Facebook targeting, whether that is permitted, and whether the privacy of sole traders is affected. The Secretary of State said the register is public under the Handelsregisterwet, the KvK does not offer data for advertising purposes, privacy may be at stake, and talks with the Data Protection Authority are ongoing and confidential.
The talks between the KvK, the Data Protection Authority and EZK are still ongoing and take place in a confidential atmosphere.
De gesprekken tussen de KvK, de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens en EZK zijn nog gaande en vinden plaats in een vertrouwelijke sfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er toch medische dossiers zoek zijn geweest in het gevangenisziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that medical records, specifically medication administration lists, were lost in a prison hospital and why earlier answers did not mention this. The minister acknowledged the omission, attributed the loss most likely to human error, and declined further investigation, noting the Inspectorate's routine oversight already covers record-keeping.
I see no reason to order additional investigation and I have confidence in the level of care provided at the JCvSZ.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek te laten doen en heb vertrouwen in het niveau van zorgverlening in het JCvSZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Oosten en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de vader van een ontvoerd kind alimentatie moet betalen

MPs Van Nispen, Van Oosten and Van Toorenburg asked whether the Dutch collection agency LBIO may enforce foreign alimony orders against a parent whose child was abducted abroad. The minister acknowledged the harshness, said the treaties offer limited grounds to refuse, and announced practical improvements such as LBIO summarising the left-behind parent's objections and checking for abduction cases in court requests.

As also promised during the General Consultation on Personal and Family Law on 16 May, I have engaged with the LBIO to examine how current practice can be improved, within the limited possibilities the treaties allow.

Zoals ook toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Personen- en familierecht van 16 mei jongstleden ben ik met het LBIO in gesprek gegaan om te bekijken op welke wijze de huidige praktijk verbeterd kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over het bericht dat informatie van de Kamer van Koophandel gebruikt wordt voor reclamedoeleinden

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked why the Chamber of Commerce (KvK) sells business register data that companies are obliged to provide, which is then used for targeted advertising, and what protections businesses have. The State Secretary answered that the register's public nature requires disclosure, that recipients bear their own privacy-law responsibility, and pointed to the Non Mailing Indicator, the Bel-me-niet register and ongoing exploration of extending protections, but committed only to continued contact with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
The KvK is currently investigating the possibilities to extend the NMI to email and telephone.
De KvK onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden om de NMI uit te breiden naar e-mail en telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over schuldenaars onder schrikbewind

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen (SP) asked about abuses by professional debt administrators (bewindvoerders), the lack of oversight, municipalities' ability to refer or assess them, liability for damages, and the market-law constraints on municipalities acting as administrators. The minister responded that existing court supervision, the ongoing evaluation of the 2013 reform, and the Wet markt en overheid apply, promising results of the evaluation around summer and largely pointing to the courts and the evaluation for answers.
I am awaiting the outcomes. These are expected around the summer and will be sent to your House as promised.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten af. Deze zijn rond de zomer te verwachten en worden zoals toegezegd aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Zus vermoorde Nadia terug bij af na tbs-draai’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why transmural leave was approved for a violent tbs detainee, whether victims are being further harmed, and whether the decision files and a list of leave grants can be shared. The minister explained that leave is based on independent advice from the AVT and treatment progress, that victims are informed of leave conditions, and declined to share individual advice or a list of detainees.
I see no reason to send advice on individual tbs detainees underlying a leave authorisation to your House.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om adviezen over individuele tbs-gestelden, die aan een verlofmachtiging ten grondslag liggen, aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van EenVandaag 'Meer homogeweld en veel zaken komen niet bij Openbaar Ministerie terecht'

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked the Justice Minister about an EenVandaag report on rising anti-gay violence and low prosecution of such cases, requesting report and prosecution figures for 2016 and 2017. The minister answered with police, ADV, CRM and OM figures, rejected the claim of an increase in anti-gay violence, but acknowledged low reporting willingness and committed to contributing to an action plan against violence towards LHBTI people.
From the police and Public Prosecution Service reports on discrimination, it cannot be concluded that there is an increase in anti-gay violence, as EenVandaag claims.
Uit de rapportages van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over discriminatie kan niet worden afgeleid dat er sprake is van een toename van homogeweld, zoals EenVandaag stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Toorenburg over de uitzending ‘Donny pleegde zelfmoord door gokschulden’

MPs Van der Graaf and Van Toorenburg asked why Unibet can operate illegally in the Netherlands, why payments to it remain possible despite the payment-provider convenant, and why unlicensed operators are not listed unless sanctioned. The minister answered that enforcement is difficult given the scale of illegal gambling, that the Remote Gambling Bill would add powers such as binding instructions to block payments, and that the Council of State ruled facilitation via payments was not clearly prohibited, while pointing payment providers to their own responsibility.
The Remote Gambling Bill clearly states that facilitating illegal games of chance, including offering payment services, is also prohibited.
Het wetsvoorstel Kansspelen op afstand bepaalt duidelijk dat ook het faciliteren van illegale kansspelen (waaronder het aanbieden van betaaldiensten) verboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de behandeling van klokkenluider Roelie Post door de Europese Commissie

Two MPs from the SP asked the ministers whether the government would intervene in the case of whistleblower Roelie Post, who alleges retaliation and threats from the European Commission after exposing adoption corruption in Romania. The minister replied that the government considers threats against officials unacceptable, points to EU whistleblower guidelines, states it lacks details of the dispute, and sees no role for itself in mediation, though it would welcome a mutually acceptable solution.
For this reason, the government sees no obvious role for mediation.
Voor het kabinet ligt er om deze reden geen bemiddelende rol voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Proefverlof ophanden voor vader die zijn zes kinderen de dood injoeg’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a father who murdered his six children could receive trial leave (proefverlof) from TBS detention, and whether minimum sentences and blocking the leave were considered. The minister replied that trial leave is a carefully assessed step in resocialisation with independent review and victim input, that he sees no basis for minimum sentences, and declined to comment on the specific case.
I will not go further into the decision-making and the details of this specific case.
Ik ga hier niet verder in op de besluitvorming en de details van deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het  bericht ‘Gedetineerde ontsnapt tijdens vervoer naar andere gevangenis in Grave’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice why a detainee escaped during transport and why he was not handcuffed, and whether the costs of recapturing him could be recovered from him. The minister said the case is under investigation, that handcuffing is a discretionary power based on individual risk rather than a standard requirement, and that recapture costs are borne by the state rather than the escapee.
This concerns an individual case that is still under investigation. I cannot comment on it.
Dit betreft een individuele casus die nog in onderzoek is. Ik kan hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Buitenweg over het horen van slachtoffers / getuigen in de strafzaak rond de Groningse gaswinning

MPs Van Tongeren and Buitenweg asked whether the investigating judge would hear witnesses and victims at their homes, in the presence of NAM's lawyers, in the criminal case on Groningen gas extraction, and how secondary victimisation could be avoided. The Minister answered that the suspect's counsel have a statutory right to attend, that the home-hearing request came from the witnesses themselves, that the Public Prosecution Service opposed it, and that the investigating judge had not yet authorised it, with each witness supported by a lawyer during questioning.
The Public Prosecution Service opposed hearing the witnesses on location.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft zich verzet tegen het horen van de getuigen op locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over late betalingen door en marktmacht van Nederlandse supermarkten

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked the government about late payments by Dutch supermarkets to suppliers, bank-financed payment schemes, and whether rising market power and concentration threaten competition. The State Secretary answered that existing payment-term rules apply to supermarkets, a Commission proposal on unfair trading practices is being assessed, a ban on assignment clauses is planned, and that the ACM already polices abuse of dominance case by case, while declining to speculate on causes or commission a broad market-power study.
It is not for me to speculate on the underlying reason for supermarkets' conduct.
Het is niet aan mij om te speculeren over wat de achterliggende reden van het handelen van supermarkten is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Jouw medicijnen worden straks misschien wel door een drone gebracht’

MPs Koopmans and Remco Dijkstra asked the ministers about news that drones may deliver medicines, and about drone innovation, timing of an integrated vision, privacy and airspace safety, miniaturised or camouflaged drones and drone swarms in private hands. The government answered that it keeps its drone policy course, that general privacy rules and EU safety regulation apply, that small camouflaged drones filming covertly may be criminal, and that swarm flights will need to meet safety requirements under forthcoming EU rules.
This cabinet maintains the course set earlier, as stated in the most recent progress letter on drone policy of 28 May 2018.
Dit kabinet houdt vast aan de eerder ingezette koers zoals verwoord in de meest recente voortgangsbrief dronebeleid van 28 mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het contrast tussen de torenhoge toegewezen declaratie van een politie-advocaat en de bezuinigingen op de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the contrast between a very high declared fee awarded to a police officer's lawyer and cuts to subsidised legal aid, including why the hourly rate cannot be disclosed and whether ministry-appointed lawyers lack tariff agreements. The minister declined to disclose the rate as it falls under a private agreement, said no ministry tariff ceiling exists for such cases, and promised a directional perspective on reforming subsidised legal aid after the summer recess.
The hourly rate is part of this agreement, to which I am not a party.
Het uurtarief maakt onderdeel uit van deze overeenkomst, waarin ik geen partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Populaire games overtreden gokregels’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether loot boxes in popular games breach gambling rules, and about youth gaming and gambling addiction risks. The government answered that non-tradable loot box items fall outside the Wok, that the Ksa will act against tradable ones, and pointed to awareness campaigns and data on addiction care.
It is not known how many other games use loot boxes.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel andere spellen gebruikmaken van loot boxes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het manifest van de Vereniging Sociale Advocatuur Nederland en het verlaten van het rechtshulpoverleg

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the VSAN manifesto on legal aid and why VSAN and NVJSA left the consultation on reforming subsidised legal aid, and whether the budget-neutral starting point should be abandoned. The minister welcomed the manifesto's ideas for the programme, said the reform is bound by the coalition agreement and existing budgets, regretted their withdrawal, and promised a letter after the summer.

The framework for my approach is set by the coalition agreement: the new system will be designed along the lines of the Wolfsen and Van der Meer committee reports and within the existing budgetary space.

Het kader voor mijn aanpak is gegeven door het regeerakkoord: het nieuwe stelsel wordt ontworpen langs de lijnen van de rapporten van de commissies-Wolfsen en -Van der Meer en binnen de bestaande budgettaire ruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Privacywet of niet, Kadaster deelt privégegevens’

The MP asks about reports that the Kadaster discloses private personal data, whether this risks identity fraud, and how privacy can be better protected. The minister says the risk of identity fraud from Kadaster data is very limited and defers the substantive questions on balancing legal certainty and privacy, access restrictions and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens advice to a cabinet response promised before the summer recess.
I expect to be able to send the cabinet response on this to the House of Representatives before the summer recess.
Ik verwacht voor het zomerreces de kabinetsreactie hierop toe te kunnen zenden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over de berichten "Aanrander nog hier" en "Doodsbang voor het monster uit Hoorn."

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why a convicted rapist, Mohammed M., was still in the Netherlands after his unconditional sentence ended, and why the victim was not actively informed and was left in fear. The State Secretary answered that he was placed in immigration detention, could not be deported due to a subsequent asylum application rejected through the courts, and was deported to Mogadishu on 25 May 2018, while denying that the prosecution had promised the victim deportation.
The prosecutor's office informed the victim about the convicted person's release on 22 February 2018 once he had served the unconditional part of his sentence.
De zaaksofficier van justitie heeft het slachtoffer geïnformeerd over de invrijheidsstelling van de veroordeelde op 22 februari 2018
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht 'Gegevens miljoenen Facebook-gebruikers gestolen voor politieke reclame'

MP Koopmans asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Facebook/Cambridge Analytica data harvesting, including whether Dutch citizens were affected, how victims can check and be compensated, rules on data reuse by researchers and journalists, and government trust in Facebook for communication. The minister answered that at most about 89,000 Dutch profiles may be affected, pointed to pending collective damages legislation and the Dutch DPA's cooperation with the UK regulator, explained the GDPR conditions for scientific and journalistic reuse, and said he sees no reason to change government use of Facebook.
I will talk with Facebook and other providers to again point out their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over privacyschendingen door Facebook

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether they would confront Facebook over reported privacy breaches, where citizens can complain, whether the Dutch data protection authority is investigating, and whether stricter oversight is warranted. The minister answered that Facebook must comply with privacy law, that the AP handles complaints and has wider powers from 25 May 2018, that an AP investigation concerns another matter while it is in contact with the UK regulator, and that the EU working party has made social media a key priority, and committed to discussing responsibility with Facebook and other providers.
I will engage with Facebook and other providers to remind them once again of their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de sterke rechtspositie van banken in het geval van insolventie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and of Finance whether banks enjoy a privileged position in insolvency, whether this disadvantages other creditors, and whether enforcement practices such as collective pledge deeds and irrevocable powers of attorney should be curbed. The government answered that secured creditors' rights are a necessary condition for cheap credit, that other creditors also hold privileges, that no misuse of irrevocable powers of attorney is found, and that the insolvency law reform programme will revisit the position of pledge and mortgage holders with the advisory group.
This subject was already discussed in June 2017 with the group of representatives from the insolvency practice.
Dit onderwerp is in juni 2017 al eens besproken met de groep vertegenwoordigers uit de faillissementspraktijk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over privacyschendingen door Facebook

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government would contact Facebook after reports that data of about 89,000 Dutch users reached Cambridge Analytica, how affected users could trace their data, and whether government should inform the public about privacy risks. The minister answered that the Dutch DPA and EU regulators supervise Facebook under the GDPR, that the minister will talk with Facebook about its responsibility, explained the access and erasure rights, and said that the GDPR information duties and government guidance cover the risks.
I will engage in discussion with Facebook and other providers to point them once again to their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over gebrekkige veiligheid in gevangenissen door bezuinigingen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about unsafe prisons caused by budget cuts, including calls from the FNV union for structural safety agreements, action after the Inspectorate's 'Uit Balans' report, and whether staff sick-leave and workload were addressed. The Minister answered that a covenant with the DJI board, works council and unions set aside EUR 100 million over four years, that additional measures are underway, and that the staffing shortage was not caused by budget cuts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de ondersteuning van nabestaanden van vliegramp MH17 bij de afwikkeling van schade

An MP asked the government how it can support relatives of MH17 victims in pursuing civil damages claims, given confusing advice and competing lawyers, and whether 'no cure no pay' fees suit the case. The minister acknowledged the uncertainty, said the government cannot yet give unambiguous advice, referred emotional support to Slachtofferhulp Nederland, and said the deken supervises no-cure-no-pay arrangements.
Given the existing uncertainties, it is currently not possible to provide next of kin with unambiguous advice and assistance.
Gelet op de bestaande onduidelijkheden en onzekerheden is het echter op dit moment niet goed mogelijk om nabestaanden met eenduidige raad en daad terzijde te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de versoberde detentieomgeving een succesvolle resocialisatie in de weg staat

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the austere detention regime undermines resocialisation and raises recidivism risk, citing a Nederlands Juristenblad article. The minister rejected the claim that the regime is sober, pointed to the activating DBT and plusprogramma with activities and reintegration options, and declined to commission additional research.

I am of the opinion that sufficient information from research is available to arrive at a balanced daily programme in which the principles of retribution and of general and special prevention are reflected.
Ik ben van mening dat voldoende informatie uit onderzoek voorhanden is om te komen tot een afgewogen dagprogramma waarin de principes van vergelding én van generale en speciale preventie terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het investeren van afgepakt crimineel geld in wijken

The MP asked whether confiscated criminal assets should be returned to neighbourhoods, as suggested by the Rotterdam mayor, and whether data sharing rules should be widened to fight undermining crime. The minister rejects earmarking confiscated assets for neighbourhoods, citing selective enforcement and budget-process concerns, while pointing to a new 100 million euro undermining fund and planned legislation on information sharing.
Confiscated criminal assets should, in the first instance and where possible, be returned to the victims.
Afgepakt crimineel vermogen dient in eerste instantie, indien mogelijk, terug te worden gegeven aan de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Waarom de strijd tegen het UWV je kapot kan maken - en hoe het anders kan’

SP MPs asked why UWV rarely uses mediation in objection cases, whether objection procedures can be made independent, and what will be done for a woman in a euthanasia procedure judged fit for work. The State Secretary answered that mediation is offered at objection stage but used only when both parties agree, that UWV's objection directorate is organisationally separate and independent, that an independent commission is unnecessary, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
I cannot go into an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het verslag schriftelijk overleg inzake het rapport Werkgroep liberalisering naamrecht

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the state of naming-law reform, whether the default surname rule for children (father's name for married parents, mother's name for unmarried parents) is compatible with equality and CEDAW, and whether to allow written name declarations, double surnames, and inclusion of the working group's recommendations. The Minister defended the current fallback rule as balanced, rejected mandatory explicit naming choices and double surnames for lack of societal consensus, and said the naming-conflict question will be included in advice on multiparenthood.
I am aware of the view of the UN Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW) on the current fallback rule.
Ik ben bekend met de opvatting van de Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women van de Verenigde Naties (CEDAW) over de huidige vangnetnorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Een database om miljardenfraudes te voorkomen: in het VK kan ’t wél’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the UK fraud register (Cifas), the Dutch FraudeInfodesk and whether the Data Protection Authority blocks it. The government says it cannot direct the independent AP, that cross-sector data sharing remains possible under the GDPR subject to an AP permit, and that it will await experience with the permit application before considering new legislation.
It is not for the Minister of Justice and Security or for me to direct the AP on how it grants permits under Article 33(4)(c) and (5) of the UAVG after the implementing act takes effect.

Het is niet aan de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid of aan mij om de AP sturing te geven op de wijze waarop zij na de inwerkingtreding van de Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (UAVG) krachtens artikel 33, vierde lid, aanhef en onderdeel c, en vijfde lid van die wet vergunningen verleent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de tv-uitzending van Kassa waaruit bleek dat ex-gedetineerden moeilijk een schadeverzekering af kunnen sluiten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether insurers may refuse ex-prisoners cover merely because of a criminal record, and whether the minister would address insurers' social responsibility for resocialisation. The minister answered that refusing ex-prisoners categorically would be undesirable, that Kassa's examples did not show systematic refusal, pointed to the Vereende as a fallback insurer, and said he would raise the issue with the Verbond van Verzekeraars.
In this light, I will bring to the attention of the Verbond van Verzekeraars the importance for people with a criminal record of being able to take out insurance.
In dit licht zal ik het Verbond van Verzekeraars het belang van mensen met een strafblad om verzekeringen te kunnen afsluiten onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Aanhoudingsverzoeken, wraking, neerleggen verdediging - recht op een eerlijk proces versus misbruik van procesrecht’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that wraking requests and withdrawal of defence counsel in criminal cases are increasingly used to delay trials, and whether rules against abuse of procedure are needed. The minister reported stable wraking figures, said withdrawal of defence is hard to sanction, and pointed to existing sanctions for abusive wraking requests, faster handling measures, and consultation on the new Code of Criminal Procedure.
Figures from the Council for the Judiciary show that the number of wraking requests filed each year is fairly stable.
Uit cijfers van de Raad voor de Rechtspraak blijkt dat het aantal wrakingsverzoeken dat jaarlijks wordt gedaan redelijk stabiel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over initiatieven voor laagdrempelige rechtspraak in de buurt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about low-threshold 'neighbourhood judge' initiatives, including a Belgian justice-of-the-peace model, the discontinuation of the Spreekuurrechter pilot at the Noord-Nederland court, and the SP's Huizen van het recht proposal. The minister answered that experiments are being prepared and evaluated, that the pilot is not yet ready for regular use, that existing low-cost routes remain available, and that the proposal will be considered alongside legal aid reform.
The concept is therefore not yet ready to be included in the regular offering of the courts.
Het concept is op dit moment dan ook nog niet rijp om op te nemen in het reguliere aanbod van de rechtbanken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Spreekuurrechter stopt, ondanks succes’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the news that the Noord-Nederland court's spreekuurrechter pilot is ending despite success, whether it will be evaluated, how its results feed into coalition plans for experimental simple procedures, and what options the court has to continue. The Minister confirmed the pilot is being evaluated, said the evaluation should be awaited given positive experience and lessons learned, and pointed to a new experiment law in consultation as a possible vehicle.
It is important to await that evaluation now.
Het is belangrijk die evaluatie nu af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de positie van kwetsbare verdachten in het strafproces

An SP MP asks the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about protecting vulnerable suspects in criminal proceedings, including a dissertation on mentally ill defendants, the choice between prosecution and compulsory psychiatric admission, false confessions, screening at first interrogation, and audiovisual recording of interrogations. Minister Dekker answers that the new Sv Book 6 draft addresses most recommendations, that case-by-case judgement applies, that existing safeguards exist, and that screening of all suspects is not straightforward; recording is required only for specified serious offences and is still being expanded.
Efforts are aimed at expanding these facilities.
Er wordt naar gestreefd deze faciliteiten uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Veroordeelde knipt enkelband door en vlucht’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a suspect could cut off his ankle tag and flee, why a violent offender was released from pre-trial detention, and when suspects of violent crimes will be required to remain in custody and attend hearings. The minister said the tags are hard but not impossible to remove, a stronger band is being introduced, the court decided the release, and a bill requiring detained suspects of serious sex or violent offences to attend hearings will go to consultation before summer.
I aim to put this proposal out for consultation before the summer.
Ik streef ernaar dit voorstel voor de zomer in consultatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een crimineel op proefverlof zijn enkelband doorknipt en zware misdrijven kon begaan

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a case in which a person on conditional release cut off his ankle monitor and committed serious crimes, and about how many wearers cut their bands, whether conditional release rules should be tightened, and how sabotage is followed up. The minister answered that the monitor is a control tool, that the judge decides on revocation, that the monitor is not meant to replace detention, and described the follow-up protocol, while declining to speculate on the judge's decision and not centrally recording how many wearers reoffend.
It is not centrally recorded how often suspects and convicted persons who have been ordered to wear an ankle monitor commit an offence.
Er wordt niet centraal geregistreerd hoe vaak verdachten en veroordeelden aan wie het dragen van een enkelband is opgelegd een misdrijf plegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het tekortschietende toezicht op malafide bewindvoerders

SP MPs asked why supervision of malafide court-appointed financial administrators (bewindvoerders) is weak, whether the 2014 quality requirements and centralised quality control work, how information is shared among judges, and about municipalities taking over administration and a white list. The Minister answered that supervision applies to all professional administrators, that a broader evaluation is underway with results expected around summer 2018, that information sharing among judges is informal but feedback-based, and that he has reservations about an online blacklist while favouring cooperation among courts, municipalities and administrators.
Around the summer I will inform the House by letter about the evaluation.
Rond de zomer informeer ik uw Kamer bij brief over de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verstrekken van het onderzoeksdossier aan nabestaanden bij twijfel over de doodsoorzaak

The SP MP Van Nispen asked whether relatives who doubt a death's cause should get copies of police/prosecution case files and whether access for their own investigation could be widened, as adopted in a motion. The Minister answered that prosecutors decide case by case, weighing confidentiality, third-party privacy and risks to future prosecution, and pointed to an earlier letter for the motion response.
Providing a file for the purpose of one's own investigation deserves a separate assessment, which the handling public prosecutor must make case by case.
Het verstrekken van een dossier ten behoeve van eigen onderzoek verdient een heel eigen afweging, die de behandelend officier van justitie per zaak moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat “de beveiliging in tbs-kliniek Van der Hoeven te wensen overlaat”

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports of drugs, alcohol, child pornography and a computer found in the Van der Hoeven tbs clinic, and why these problems were not visible in earlier inspection reports, plus questions on drug controls, staff turnover and administrative burden. The minister disputes the clinic's depiction, says the Inspectorate will consider further investigation, points to an earlier inspection report and an action plan, and says broader findings on safety and staffing will be awaited and reported to parliament.
Both DJI and the Van der Hoeven clinic have stated that they do not recognise the picture described in the article.
Zowel DJI als de Van der Hoevenkliniek hebben aangegeven zich niet in het beeld zoals beschreven in het artikel te herkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht “Makkelijk om aan drugs en kinderporno te komen”

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that drugs and child pornography are easily obtained in a forensic psychiatric clinic, including sanctions for contraband, lax checks after leave, and staff tolerance. The minister replied that contraband is prohibited with consequences, describes existing controls and an ongoing safety investigation, and says the clinic reports no safety problems while the Inspectorate may investigate further.
I can indicate that an investigation into safety in forensic care is currently under way.
Wel kan ik aangeven dat er momenteel een onderzoek loopt naar de veiligheid in de forensische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over E-Court

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about e-Court, a private digital arbitration body used for debt collection, including its procedures, consumer protection, judicial review of its awards, and debt-collector fees. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the Hoge Raad will be asked prejudicial questions via an upcoming test case, and announced a review of debt collection procedures, but largely deferred on specifics and did not commit to changing the rules.
It is important that clarity is provided on the scope of judicial review of e-Court's decisions by the court.
Het is van belang dat er uitsluitsel komt over de vraag naar de reikwijdte van de toetsing van uitspraken van e-Court door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Robotrechter e-Court is een groot en niet-transparant zwart gat?’

MPs Groothuizen and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked about the private digital arbitration firm e-Court, its opaque caseload, algorithm use, publication of awards and arbiter lists, and insurers' arbitration clauses. The minister answered that e-Court's caseload data is confidential, that the courts' review of its awards is pending a Supreme Court referral, that arbitral transparency is not legally required, and that a rights-of-appeal exists for consumers.
This is commercially sensitive information which e-Court therefore did not wish to provide.
Dit is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie die e-Court om die reden niet heeft willen verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de uitvoering van de Wet beëdigde tolken en vertalers

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the implementation of the Wet beëdigde tolken en vertalers, including quality of interpreters, use of non-registered interpreters and the reform based on the ABDTOPConsult report. The Minister answered that quality and price are being balanced, that about half of roughly 475,000 interpreting services in 2016 used a registered interpreter, and that the reform programme is ongoing with rollout expected in 2019.
Annex 1 provides an overview of interpreting services by these so-called obligated organisations, broken down by language, for 2016.
In bijlage 1 is een overzicht gegeven van tolkdiensten van deze zogenoemde afnameplichtige organisaties uitgesplitst per taal over 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de herziening van het stelsel voor gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the ministry's redesign of the subsidised legal aid system, including the use of three commission reports, the reliance on stakeholder input, and why the redesign is constrained to existing budgets despite findings that more money is needed. The minister replies that the redesign follows the coalition agreement within existing budget limits, that a programme team and stakeholder sessions are underway, and that the Van der Meer findings are for policymakers to act on, rejecting the premise that more money is required.
The programme cannot carry out its mandate without the knowledge, expertise and experience of the professionals involved.
Het programma kan haar opdracht niet uitvoeren zonder de kennis, expertise en ervaring van betrokken professionals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het bericht dat de Noorse gevangenen verdwijnen uit Veenhuizen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection what the government will do to keep Norgerhaven prison open after Norway stopped leasing it, and how job security and the regional prison policy in the regulation will be handled. The Minister answered that the decision is still being weighed against total detention capacity, that a vision on prisons will be sent before the summer recess, and that a personnel convenant on job security was signed.
Although I want to dispel this uncertainty as quickly as possible, I cannot yet provide clarity on the precise consequences of this decision for the capacity of Norgerhaven.
Hoewel ik deze onrust zo snel mogelijk wil wegnemen, kan ik op dit moment nog geen duidelijkheid verschaffen over de precieze gevolgen van deze beslissing voor de capaciteit van Norgerhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Veluwe staat model bij aanpak criminelen’

Opposition MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the municipality of Putten's administrative sanction method (last onder dwangsom against criminals) relates to criminal procedure under Article 6 ECHR, whether municipalities bypass prosecutors and judges and consider personal circumstances, and how many municipalities use it and whether fines are collected. The Minister answered that the instrument is a restorative administrative sanction not generally covered by Article 6, that it is subject to Awb proportionality limits and appeal, that the municipality works with police and prosecutors, and that in 90-95% of cases no new violation follows, with the remainder collected effectively, though the Minister lacks data on other municipalities.
I am not aware of how many municipalities use this instrument or what the results are.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten gebruik maken van dit instrumentarium en wat de resultaten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het contrast tussen de torenhoge toegewezen declaratie van een politie-advocaat en de bezuinigingen op de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked why a police-officer defendant's lawyer was awarded a very high fee of about 144,000 euro in a relatively simple assault case, while legal aid fees are being cut, and what the government will do about it. The Minister said the court's decision is not for him to comment on, that the right to choose a lawyer applies and that courts decide what is a reasonable fee, and that the lawyer's hourly rate is unknown to him; he noted the police-officer compensation arrangement and that the state bears the cost via the court ruling, but committed to no concrete action.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on the Court of Appeal's decision.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op de beslissing van het Gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over seksueel misbruik tijdens de tantramassage

An MP asked whether the Inspectorate for Healthcare had received reports of sexual abuse by tantra masseurs, what rules apply to the profession, whether police refused around thirty complaints, and whether the government would engage with the Tantra Misbruik reporting point. The ministers answered that the Inspectorate concluded these activities fall outside the Wkkgz and thus outside its supervision, that victims were advised to file police reports, and that they do not comment on individual cases, describing the police reporting process instead.
As I have previously informed the House, I do not go into individual cases and complaints.
Antwoord 4, 5 Zoals ik uw kamer eerder heb geïnformeerd 2 ga ik niet in op individuele casus en aangiften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de uitzending over homo-ontmoetingsplaatsen van ‘Undercover in Nederland’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about crimes at gay meeting places shown in a SBS6 documentary, including the lack of statistics, victims' reluctance to report, preventive measures, and whether municipalities are inconsistent or drive gay men away. The minister condemned all such crimes, said no statistics exist because offences are often covered by other crimes and sites are not designated, expanded Slachtofferhulp Nederland's online services, and said local authorities are responsible for policy, supported by a Movisie handbook.
Local tailoring is appropriate here because conditions can differ from municipality to municipality.
Lokaal maatwerk is hier aangewezen omdat de omstandigheden per gemeente kunnen verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het gevangenisziekenhuis te Scheveningen zou knoeien met medicaties

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that the Scheveningen prison hospital tampered with inmates' medication, asking whether renewed intensified oversight is needed. The minister said medication handling follows protocols, incidents are evaluated by the MIP committee, the IGJ lifted intensified supervision in 2014 and has found no reason to restore it, and the IGJ can decide on intensified oversight based on its own findings.
I have no indications that the medication dispensing process at the JCvSZ is currently going badly.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat het proces van medicijnverstrekking in het JCvSZ op dit moment slecht verloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Koopmans over de berichtgeving over het proefschrift van Marlies van Eck van de Tilburg University

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a PhD thesis finding that citizens are insufficiently legally protected against computer-driven financial decisions by government, and whether computer instructions should be open to third parties or reviewed by an independent body. The State Secretary answered that existing law already requires correctable, well-reasoned decisions, that the Wet Openbaarheid van Bestuur allows third parties to request source code, that an algorithms study is under way, and that no independent review body is planned.
In line with this practice, I see no reason for now to establish an independent body to assess source codes.
In lijn met deze praktijk zie ik vooralsnog geen reden om een onafhankelijke instelling in het leven te roepen voor de beoordeling van broncodes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over arresten van de Hoge Raad in de Valkenburgse zedenzaak

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Supreme Court rulings allowing a one-day unconditional prison term alongside a community sentence for serious sex offences, and whether the law should be tightened. The minister declined to judge the individual sentence, noted the 2012 restriction on community sentences for serious sex and violent crimes, and said the evaluation's recommendation for changing the legal framework will be addressed in a policy response before summer 2018.
I aim to send my policy response to the report to the House of Representatives before the summer of 2018.
Ik streef ernaar mijn beleidsreactie op het rapport voor de zomer van 2018 aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Oosten over het artikel 'Opleggen van huisverbod moet vaker en sneller'

MPs Tielen and Van Oosten asked about a call by The Hague's mayor to impose household bans more often and faster, and about hulpverlening follow-up, extensions, and information sharing in domestic violence cases. The minister defends the household ban as an effective tool within a broader safety plan, acknowledges problems organising aid, says extensions are only legal when danger persists, and points to ongoing programmes and existing reporting code.
There are therefore no figures available on this.
Er zijn hierover daarom geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wörsdörfer over de verhaalspositie van het MKB bij onbetwiste geldvorderingen

MPs Van Oosten and Wörsdörfer asked whether Belgium's 2016 out-of-court debt collection procedure for undisputed claims between businesses should be introduced in the Netherlands to strengthen small and medium-sized firms' position. The minister answered that its added value is unclear, that rule-of-law safeguards and cost questions need study, and that a further exploration will follow once the Belgian law's effects are clearer.

The rule-of-law safeguard of out-of-court dispute resolution methods such as arbitration and binding advice lies, as a recently published report on this subject also showed, among other things in the fact that one must go to the judge for an enforceable title.

De rechtsstatelijke waarborging van buitengerechtelijke geschiloplossingsmethoden zoals arbitrage en bindend advies, is – zo bleek ook in een recentelijk gepubliceerd rapport over dit onderwerp – onder meer gelegen in het gegeven dat men voor een titel voor tenuitvoerlegging naar de rechter moet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over justitiële dwalingen

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection how she responds to Knoops's recommendations on reopening wrongful-conviction cases, including the novum test, single-instance assessment of new evidence, preservation of evidence, closer OM-advocacy cooperation, and evaluation of the Wet hervorming herziening ten voordele. The Minister replied that the novum criterion already applies, that evidence retention and the recommendations will be considered in the evaluation, and that the evaluation report is expected only by end 2018.
The study, which already subjects the statutory regime for further investigation of a possible novum to a general evaluation, has already been tendered and is under way.
Het onderzoek, waarin de wettelijke regeling van het nader onderzoek naar een mogelijk novum al aan een algemene evaluatie wordt onderworpen, is reeds aanbesteed en in uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een veroordeelde pedofiel die in detentie een boek over zijn slachtoffer kon schrijven

An MP asked the Justice Minister how a convicted child abuser could write a book about his victim while in detention and whether this should be prevented. The minister said the manuscript left prison improperly via a released inmate, that supervision measures were then imposed, and that no new legal ban is needed given existing civil and criminal remedies.
The manuscript should have been sent by the inmate through the institution's post.
Het manuscript had door de gedetineerde verzonden moeten worden met de post via de inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Bajesbewaker bedreigd'

The MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about an anonymous threat on 17 January 2018 to shoot staff with an automatic machine gun at the Alphen prison, and what measures would prevent recurrence and detect smuggling. The Minister answered that police and DJI responded adequately, staff safety was never at risk, all prisoners were locked in, and a study of new detection technology will be sent to parliament before summer 2018.
I will send this exploration to your House before summer 2018.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer 2018 deze verkenning doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over gestolen data van Übergebruikers

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the theft of data of 174,000 Dutch Über users, including whether companies must report breaches and whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens' investigation outcome will be shared. The minister answered that breach reporting duties under the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens apply, that the regulator can enforce them, and that the regulator will publish its findings on its own initiative.
The report is currently being investigated.
De melding wordt op dit moment onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de ontvoering van Insiya naar India

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the abduction of a child to India, the content and enforceability of an Indian family court ruling, what the Dutch government is doing to speed up the child's return, and the status of the criminal case against the father. The government answered that the Indian ruling is not public and concerns parental rights rather than the abduction, that the Foreign Ministry and embassy press for return and have raised the case at high level, and that the criminal case is pending before the court so it will not comment further.
From the start of the case, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has maintained close contact with Insiya's mother about the status of the case and the possible return of Insiya to the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt vanaf het begin van de zaak nauw contact met de moeder van Insiya over de stand van zaken en de mogelijke terugkeer van Insiya naar Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht 'Verdachte verpleeghuismoord had verklaring van goed gedrag'

MP Krol asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a suspect in the nursing-home insulin murders held a certificate of good conduct (VOG) despite a prior conviction, and for five-year VOG statistics and measures to make the VOG more reliable. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy and the ongoing judicial process, said the statistics are not available, and saw no reason for new measures, calling the VOG a momentary check that supports recidivism reduction.
The right to privacy means I am extremely reticent about information on individual cases.
Het recht op privacy maakt dat ik uiterst terughoudend ben met informatie over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Koopmans over "het artikel ‘gemeente Tilburg mag niet specifiek speuren naar Turkse bijstandfraudeurs’"

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Koopmans asked whether municipalities may screen welfare recipients by country of origin and pursue foreign assets after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling found Tilburg's targeting of Turkish benefit fraudsters discriminatory. The State Secretary answered that selecting on country of origin alone violates the non-discrimination rule, that municipalities should work with the IBF on cross-border fraud, and that he will promote IBF cooperation and guidance for municipalities.

The consequence of the CRvB ruling is that selecting on the basis of country of origin, as the sole factor, is contrary to the non-discrimination prohibition laid down in Article 14 ECHR and Article 1 of Protocol 12 to the ECHR.

De consequentie van de uitspraak van de CRvB is dat selecteren op basis van land van herkomst, als enkele feit, in strijd is met het discriminatieverbod zoals neergelegd in artikel 14 EVRM en artikel 1 van Protocol 12 bij het EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de strijd tegen seksuele uitbuiting van minderjarigen

Member Van Oosten (VVD) asked the Justice and Security ministers about combating sexual exploitation of minors, including boys, information sharing by youth care with police, the use of decoy operations by Terre des Hommes, and specialised victim care. The government answered that boys' victimisation is under-recognised, that an interdepartmental action plan is in preparation, that decoy use by private parties faces legal limits, and that the sexual offences law modernisation consultation is expected around summer 2018.
As announced in the answer to questions 2 and 4, an interdepartmental action plan is currently being developed.
Zoals aangekondigd in het antwoord op vraag 2 en 4, wordt er momenteel gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van een interdepartementaal plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het blokkeren van de laagdrempelige procedure bij de Spreekuurrechter voor aardbevingsschadezaken

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked whether the Rechtbank Noord-Nederland blocked a Groningen earthquake damage case from the low-threshold Spreekuurrechter procedure after an internal intervention and contact with the NAM, and how access to justice for gas-damage victims will be ensured. The minister answers that the Spreekuurrechter pilot is for relatively simple disputes, the court itself judged the earthquake case unsuitable, the NAM was informed by letter and phone, and the new damage protocol and the EUR 200,000 fund for legal costs are being pursued.

For this deviating procedure a procedural regulation has been drawn up, which establishes that the Spreekuurrechter may decide that a case is not suitable for handling by the Spreekuurrechter, even if the parties would want it.

Voor deze afwijkende procedure is een procesreglement opgesteld en daarin is vastgelegd dat de Spreekuurrechter kan bepalen dat een zaak zich niet leent voor behandeling door de Spreekuurrechter, zelfs indien partijen dat wel zouden willen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over achterstanden bij de digitalisering van de rechtspraak

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about delays and extra costs in digitising the judiciary (KEI programme), their causes, and whether budget contributions must rise. The minister confirmed the delays (about one year for asylum and detention cases, further delays for other procedures), attributed them mainly to an over-optimistic 2014 estimate, and said extra costs would be covered from reserves for 2018 with the longer-term responsibility lying with the judiciary, to be clarified in spring.
I expect to be able to give a first assessment of the further shaping of digitisation in the spring.
Ik verwacht in het voorjaar een eerste oordeel te kunnen geven over de verdere vormgeving van de digitalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Henk Kuipers begint een eigen videorubriek’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kuiken asked whether a detained suspect starting his own video column, 'Vraag het Henk', was acceptable under the Penitentiary Principles Act and whether he had permission to contact the media. The Minister replied that contact with media requires the prison director's permission, that a request for an own video column is not likely to be granted, and that no such request had been received, so unauthorised contact could lead to restrictions.
For all contacts with the media, detainees must request permission from the director of the institution.
Voor alle contacten met de media geldt dat gedetineerden toestemming aan de directeur van de inrichting dienen te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Groothuizen over het verplichtgestelde pensioenfonds voor notarissen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Groothuizen asked whether there is sufficient support among notaries for the statutory obligation to join the notarial pension fund, given a survey showing the 60% representativeness norm is not met. The government answered that mandatory participation for notaries rests on the Wna itself, that the desirability of compulsory membership is a matter for the profession, and declined to comment on the survey figures.

Given this responsibility of the notaries themselves, I am of the view that the figures from the support survey, their interpretation and any conclusions drawn from them are a matter for the notaries themselves.

Gezien deze verantwoordelijkheid van de beroepsgenoten in het notariaat zelf, ben ik van mening dat de cijfers die uit het draagvlakonderzoek naar voren komen, de interpretatie daarvan alsmede eventuele conclusies naar aanleiding daarvan een zaak van de beroepsgenoten in het notariaat onderling is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de gevolgen van het mogelijke vertrek van de Noorse gevangenen uit Veenhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the possible early departure of Norwegian prisoners from Veenhuizen, the status of the Norwegian decision, whether the prison would stay open, and the timing and staff involvement. The minister noted the report, said a Norwegian extension is favoured but undecided, would assess consequences for capacity once clear, and said withdrawal could start from 1 September 2018 with staff involved under an existing agreement.

Once clarity exists on whether the lease of the Norgerhaven location to Norway is extended, it will be examined what the consequences of this decision are for the use of the total available detention capacity, including the capacity of Norgerhaven.

Zodra duidelijkheid bestaat over het al dan niet verlengen van de verhuur van de locatie Norgerhaven aan Noorwegen, wordt bezien wat de gevolgen van dit besluit zijn voor de bestemming van de totale beschikbare detentiecapaciteit, inclusief de capaciteit van Norgerhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het opleggen van bestuursverboden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a person repeatedly involved in bankruptcy fraud can keep founding new companies, how many civil and criminal director bans have been imposed, and whether bans are effective. The Minister said the current screening and civil ban regime is in place, that bans take time to become final, and that criminal bans were imposed in a limited number of cases, while declining to comment on the individual case.
In 2016 and 2017, a total of 256 civil cases on director liability were decided by the district courts.
In 2016 en 2017 zijn bij de rechtbanken in totaal 256 civiele zaken over bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid afgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Kinderlokker krijgt weer tbs en een celstraf’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a convicted child lurer could reoffend right after leaving TBS, whether supervision existed, and how often released TBS patients reoffend. The Minister said the release followed a court decision with a conditional BOPZ order and no probation supervision, defended TBS as effective, and gave WODC recidivism figures of about 21 to 23 percent within two years.
Because no criminal-law framework applies while a BOPZ order is in force, there is no probation supervision.
Omdat tijdens de toepassing van een BOPZ-machtiging geen sprake is van een strafrechtelijk kader, is er geen toezicht van de reclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Lage straf door trage rechtsgang'

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that sentences were reduced because criminal cases took too long, and what causes the delays and what will be done. The ministers acknowledged that reasonable-term breaches can reduce sentences, cited capacity shortages and reported measures such as ZSM, the Verkeerstoren and extra judges in the north, while stating that no registration of such overruns exists.
The court and the Public Prosecution Service do not keep records of exceedances of the reasonable time limit and the consequences attached to them.
De rechtbank en het OM houden geen registratie bij van overschrijdingen van de redelijke termijn en welke gevolgen daaraan zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Kwetsbaarheid voor omkoping een reëel risico’

MPs Van Oosten and Van den Bosch asked whether municipalities can adequately screen risk-sensitive officials for criminal antecedents, given reports of vulnerability to bribery and infiltration. The minister answered that VOG screening exists with a ten-year lookback for political office holders, that a study and a Netwerk Weerbaar Bestuur are underway, and that a bill extending VOG refusals to police data is in preparation, while the Bibob bureau's role would require further study.
