As known to your House, I am preparing a bill under which, for certain vulnerable functions in the security domain, a VOG can be refused not only on the basis of judicial documentation but also on the basis of police data.

Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, bereid ik een wetsvoorstel voor waarbij voor bepaalde kwetsbare functies binnen het veiligheidsdomein de VOG niet alleen kan worden geweigerd op basis van justitiële documentatie, maar ook op basis van politiegegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Komt Johan van Laarhoven in 2018 naar Nederland?’

MP Bergkamp asked whether the Thai appeal against Johan van Laarhoven's conviction allows preparation of a WOTS transfer, whether the government will press Thailand to withdraw the appeal, and what other transfer options exist. The minister answered that WOTS can only start once the judgment is final, that the government does not interfere in ongoing foreign criminal cases, and that the prosecution service decides on extradition and has no plans to request it.
Once the case is final, the WOTS request of Mr Van Laarhoven, as promised in my letter of 13 December 2017 to your House, will be processed expeditiously.
Zodra de zaak onherroepelijk is, zal het Wots-verzoek van de heer Van Laarhoven, zoals toegezegd in mijn brief van 13 december 2017 aan uw Kamer, voortvarend in behandeling worden genomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de uitzending van Zembla ‘Verdachte ouders’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about a Zembla broadcast on suspected Munchausen by proxy/PCF cases, including rising Veilig Thuis reports, support for doctors, the role of the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and the need for fact-finding. The ministers answered that professionals are supported through protocols, expert centres and joint guidance, that no Dutch research exists on prevalence, and that a fact-finding action plan will be sent to parliament in spring 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het boek over de herzieningszaak Baybasin

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Ton Derksen's book criticising the advocate-general's advice in the Baybasin revision case, the protests by former prison directors, and whether such scholarly work should play a role in the Supreme Court's revision decision. The minister declined to comment on the advice or the Supreme Court's role, noted that the court decides and may order further investigation, and said demonstrations are a matter for the public.
Given the independent position of an advocate-general, it is not for me as Minister for Legal Protection to reflect on the advice given in response to a revision application.

Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van een advocaat-generaal is het niet aan mij als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming om te reflecteren op de adviezen gegeven naar aanleiding van een herzieningsaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Advocaten ronselen in de bajes’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about lawyers advertising to prisoners via eMates-printed correspondence and about recruitment practices. The Minister replied that DJI has no formal agreement with eMates, that advertising is not prohibited but targeted recruitment breaches professional conduct rules handled by the bar deans, and that DJI will pass complaints to eMates.
DJI has no formal agreements with eMates or other parties regarding advertising on private correspondence of detainees.
DJI heeft geen formele afspraken met eMates of andere partijen ten aanzien van het adverteren op (privé)correspondentie van gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Incasso-oplichting blijft ongemoeid’

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked how debt collectors could wrongly charge debtors up to 500 euro in collection costs for years, and why the OM, curator and BFT had not acted. Minister Dekker answered that the BFT investigated, sought suspension and filed a disciplinary complaint, the chamber struck the bailiffs off in March 2017, and the OM is now handling a criminal complaint and will give extra attention to such cases in 2018.
The BFT did however intervene, as the answers below also show.
Het BFT heeft echter wel degelijk ingegrepen, zoals ook uit onderstaande antwoorden blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Groothuizen over de vrijspraak van Julio Poch

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Justice and Foreign Affairs about the acquittal of Julio Poch in Argentina, his long pre-trial detention, Dutch extradition and legal assistance, compensation, and consular support. The government answered that it sees no reason to revise earlier answers, that the duration of detention is for Argentine courts to decide, that Dutch legal assistance obligations were met, and that consular support was provided, while declining to comment on the unpublished judgment.
It is not appropriate for the government to judge the substance of foreign court rulings.
Het past de regering niet om inhoudelijk te oordelen over buitenlandse rechterlijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de zaak Julio Poch

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the acquittal of former pilot Julio Poch in Argentina after eight years of pretrial detention, including whether Dutch authorities' information-sharing contributed to his detention and what consular support and extradition options exist. The government declined to judge the foreign ruling, said Dutch information sharing was a legal duty under mutual legal assistance rules, described consular support, and confirmed Dutch law does not allow extradition of its own nationals to Argentina.
The provisions on providing legal assistance in the Code of Criminal Procedure and the Convention against Torture require that such assistance be provided as broadly as possible.

Uit de bepalingen omtrent het verlenen van rechtshulp in het Wetboek van Strafvordering en uit het Verdrag tegen Foltering volgt dat dergelijke rechtshulp in zo ruim mogelijk mate verleend moest worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Oosten over vrijspraak van de heer Poch in Argentinië

MPs Ten Broeke and Van Oosten asked the ministers about the Argentine acquittal of Mr Poch, the state's role in facilitating his prosecution, an anonymous prosecutor's remark, and the adequacy of consular assistance. The government answered that legal aid was given within the existing framework, that the state does not interfere in foreign criminal cases, that consular support was provided throughout detention, and that Mr Poch returned to the Netherlands on 7 December 2017.
The State refrains from substantive involvement in criminal cases that are before the (foreign) judge.
De Staat onthoudt zich van inhoudelijke bemoeienis met strafzaken die onder de (buitenlandse) rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de incidentmeldingen rond de verloven van criminelen

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of incidents and escapes during prison and tbs-clinic leave, the trend in incidents, how leave eligibility is assessed, and whether the whole leave system will be reviewed. The Minister disputes the picture of frequent escapes, reports stable or fluctuating numbers, describes the risk-assessment and advisory process, mentions past evaluation, and does not commit to a new review.
Nevertheless, I understand that such a message raises questions with your House as well as with citizens.
Desondanks begrijp ik dat een dergelijke boodschap vragen oproept bij uw Kamer alsook bij burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bedrijven ongevraagd klantgegevens delen met Facebook

MPs Hijink and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Consumentenbond report that companies share customer data with Facebook without consent, asking how many companies, sanctions imposed, and what steps will follow. The minister replied that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is independent and must assess lawfulness, that Facebook provided no figures, that customers can object or withdraw consent, and that no concrete new action is promised.
It is up to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens to assess whether Facebook Custom Audience targeting involves a legitimate interest on which the data processing can be based.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om te beoordelen of bij Facebook Custom Audience targeting sprake is van een gerechtvaardigd belang waarop de gegevensverwerking kan worden gebaseerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over de berichtgeving inzake een Brabantse islamgeleerde die geen straf krijgt voor het verkrachten van zijn stiefkind vanwege dementie

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a 74-year-old suspect could be declared demented to avoid prosecution for raping his stepchild, and called for life imprisonment, denaturalisation and expulsion. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, which is before the courts, and referred to a letter sent to parliament.
This concerns an individual case that is still before the courts.
Het gaat hier om een individuele zaak die nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de zorg voor kinderen van ouders in detentie

An MP asks the Justice Minister why children of detained parents still lack information, support and care despite earlier commitments, and who is responsible. The Minister acknowledges the problem, lists measures taken since 2012 (child check, digital post, extended visits, pilots), says responsibility is shared with the Health Ministry, and largely accepts the Children's Ombudsman's recommendations, while declining some and referring others to the relevant bodies.
I will therefore work on film and other information material specifically for children with a parent in detention, to give them a better picture of where their parents are and what to expect.
Ik zal dan ook inzetten op film en ander informatiemateriaal speciaal voor kinderen met een ouder in detentie, om hun een beter beeld te geven waar hun ouders verblijven en wat ze kunnen verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat cipiers ziek van angst zouden zijn door onveilige situaties in de gevangenissen

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that prison guards are sick from fear due to unsafe conditions, the shortage of staff, delayed supply deliveries, and whether two guards can supervise 50 prisoners. The minister answers that safety is paramount, outlines recruitment drives, a convenant with unions, temporary external staff, and says the structural staffing is sufficient once vacancies are filled, while acknowledging reduced operational flexibility.
Safety always takes priority at DJI.
De veiligheid staat bij DJI altijd voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mogelijke kansspelkarakter van zogenoemde ‘lootboxes’ in videospellen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether loot boxes in video games are gambling, whether children should be shielded from them, whether the Betting and Gaming Act still fits digital practice, and whether the Dutch regulator will act in the meantime. The minister said the Gaming Authority is investigating whether loot boxes are games of chance and that results are expected in early 2018, while declining to take further awareness steps beyond existing media actions.
The Gaming Authority (ksa) is currently investigating the possible relationship between problem gambling and video games and the harmful aspects of video games.
De kansspelautoriteit (ksa) doet momenteel onderzoek naar het vraagstuk van de mogelijke relatie tussen problematisch gokgedrag en videospellen en naar de schadelijke aspecten van videospellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over misstanden in het gevangenisziekenhuis te Scheveningen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reported abuses and complaints at the Scheveningen prison hospital, including whether oversight had weakened since 2014 and whether intensified supervision should be reinstated. The minister responded that complaints are handled through the prison complaints commission and appeal route, that the healthcare inspectorate will ask the prison director for a response, and that the inspectorate sees no reason to reintroduce intensified supervision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over hoe de leraar verplicht werd zich bij te scholen

MP Kwint asks how the teacher register's slogan 'by, for and of the teacher' fits with petitions against it and why it was imposed without support. The minister defends the register as developed with teacher organisations, saying ownership by the profession remains central and that voluntary uptake fell short of the 40% target.
The law was developed through intensive cooperation with the Onderwijscoöperatie, consisting of the largest representative teacher organisations.
De wet is tot stand gekomen op basis van een intensieve samenwerking met de Onderwijscoöperatie, bestaande uit de grootste vertegenwoordigende lerarenorganisaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de door leraren (LerarenAdviesRaad) voorgedragen kandidaat-voorzitter voor de Onderwijscoöperatie is afgewezen door het bestuur van de Onderwijscoöperatie

An SP MP asked whether the Onderwijscoöperatie board rejected the teacher-nominated chair candidate and, if so, for what reasons. The ministers declined to ask the board for its reasons, stating that appointment decisions belong to the independent organisation.
We do not consider it appropriate to ask about the reasons for appointing or not appointing a specific candidate.
Wij vinden het niet gepast om te vragen naar de beweegredenen om een specifieke kandidaat wel of niet te benoemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de samenloop tussen een internationale kinderontvoering en een lopende strafzaak

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a father who had been convicted of assaulting the mother, and was flagged for enforcement, could still have a child returned to Australia under the Hague Convention, and whether the prosecutor's cooperation protocol should be changed. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said the civil courts decided the return and the prosecutor has little discretion to refuse enforcement, and saw no reason to amend the protocol.
I currently see no reason to amend the existing cooperation protocol.
Ik zie momenteel dan ook geen aanleiding het bestaande samenwerkingsprotocol aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Paternotte over de radiouitzending 'Schimmige praktijken bij ZonMw' en de Kamerbrief van Minister Schippers van 3 oktober 2017 (Kamerstuk 30850-45)

Two D66 MPs asked the health and education ministers about a radio report on conflict-of-interest practices at ZonMw, including whether its 2016-2017 evaluation checked compliance with the Awb and codes of conduct, and whether exceptions to the conflict-of-interest code exist elsewhere. The minister replied that the evaluation did not cover these aspects, acknowledged a legal exception clause was removed after a 2015 appeal ruling, found a single NWO case of insufficiently strict application, announced a joint code evaluation that will delete the exception clause, and promised further measures and to send the answers to the Chamber.
Following that, the application of and supervision of compliance with the code of conduct has been tightened for all ZonMw committees.
Naar aanleiding daarvan is de toepassing van en het toezicht op naleving van de gedragscode voor alle ZonMw-commissies verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over mediation in het strafrecht

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the 81.2% success rate of criminal mediation is a success and whether mediation should be continued and expanded. The Minister called the results favourable but noted the small number of referrals and said no firm conclusions on recidivism or court burden can yet be drawn; he referred to budget answers on further funding.
Compared with the total inflow of criminal cases (non-canton) at the district courts, namely 106,250 cases, the number of referrals is very limited.
Vergeleken met de totale instroom aan strafzaken (niet-kanton) bij de rechtbanken, te weten 106.250 zaken, is het aantal verwijzingen zeer beperkt te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over beveiligde GGZ-zorg

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about shortages of secured mental health care (beveiligde GGZ), time-out beds and suitable housing, and why zorgverzekeraars may be holding back budget. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortages, pointed to agreements to raise purchasing of secured care, a sector norm due April 2018, and housing initiatives, while attributing part of the gap to insurers' contracting and providers not claiming care.

My predecessor informed you in her letter of 13 July 2017 that agreement was reached with the parties involved to immediately increase the purchasing of secured mental health care for patients who display aggressive or dangerous behaviour.

Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in haar brief van 13 juli 2017 u medegedeeld dat met betrokken partijen de afspraak is gemaakt de inkoop van beveiligde ggz-zorg voor patiënten, die agressief of gevaarlijk gedrag vertonen, onmiddellijk te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de achterstanden bij de rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked about delays and incomplete case files in appeals from the Zeeland-West-Brabant district court, including possible breaches of the reasonable-time right and sentence reductions. The Minister acknowledged the problems, said the 80 percent figure reflected an earlier snapshot, pointed to measures taken by the court and appeal court, and saw no need for further consultation or action now.
The Council for the Judiciary has indicated that such data cannot be derived from the systems.
Antwoord 2 De Raad voor de rechtspraak (Rvdr) heeft aangegeven dat dergelijke gegevens niet uit de systemen kunnen worden afgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het feit dat het NOS Jeugdjournaal een reportage heeft gerectificeerd, omdat er onvolledige en verkeerde informatie werd gegeven

An MP asked the State Secretary whether NOS Jeugdjournaal's rectified report on Gaza children, and the unrectified archived broadcast, meet rules on correction and online archiving. The minister answered that the NPO journalistic code requires prompt correction, that the NPO ombudsman handles complaints, and that she will not judge the editorial handling of corrections given broadcaster autonomy.
I do not express a view on substantive and editorial matters.
Ik spreek mij niet uit over inhoudelijke en redactionele kwesties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özdil over stigmatiserende lesmethodes

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary of Education whether a primary-school reading method that describes the 'ng' sound with a Chinese-stereotype gesture is stigmatising, whether similar methods exist, and whether the government will investigate or raise awareness. The minister agrees the gesture is stigmatising, says no similar methods are known, declines to start an investigation because schools and publishers are responsible for teaching materials, and says raising awareness is up to schools and publishers, not the government.
I do not intend to start an investigation into this.
Ik ben niet van plan hier een onderzoek naar te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over de aanhouding van een NRC-fotograaf

Opposition MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the arrest of an NRC photographer who refused to hand over photos of a fight involving a US soldier violates press freedom and proper handling of journalistic material. The minister confirmed the arrest, said apologies were offered, pointed to existing restraint rules on coercive measures against journalists, and committed to discussing the case within the prosecution service and police training.
The acting chief public prosecutor has offered apologies to both the photographer and the editor-in-chief of NRC.
De waarnemend hoofdofficier van justitie heeft zowel de fotograaf als de hoofdredacteur van de NRC excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Engelshoven en Groothuizen over het in de cel gooien van een Nederlandse journalist

MPs from D66 asked why an NRC photographer was detained and his equipment seized for refusing to hand over photos, and whether this was lawful. The Minister answered that the journalist was wrongly treated as a suspect, the seizure was wrong, the Public Prosecution Service apologised, and the case will be discussed within the OM.
The journalist was wrongly treated as a suspect.
De journalist is ten onrechte als verdachte aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over NPO Start

An MP asks the State Secretary about the NPO Start Plus paid on-demand service: expected subscribers, the basis for the 2.95 euro price, competition with commercial services, whether it should face a renewed new-services test, which programmes move behind the paywall, and why HD is paid-only. The government answers that the service was approved under a completed procedure, is cost-based, will be evaluated and reported on annually, and that HD upgrading carries costs of up to 10 million euro per year.
The NPO must evaluate the tariff after two years and report every year on developments regarding NPO Start Plus.
De NPO dient na twee jaar het tarief te evalueren en elk jaar te rapporteren over de ontwikkelingen ten aanzien van NPO Start Plus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het onderzoek van RTL nieuws dat ouders hun keuze voor een school zouden laten afhangen van de hoogte van de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about an RTL Nieuws investigation suggesting parents base school choice on the voluntary parental contribution, and whether schools communicate its voluntary nature and whether the Inspectorate intervenes. The State Secretary said the findings match existing monitoring, schools inform parents, the Inspectorate received 126 signals in five years without sanctions, and handling of voluntariness will be a thematic focus in 2018.
I do not have exact data on how many schools communicate insufficiently clearly or even incorrectly about the voluntary parental contribution.
Ik beschik niet over exacte gegevens hoeveel scholen onvoldoende helder of zelfs onjuist communiceren over de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over cursussen in het lerarenregister

MP Kwint asked the state secretary about commercial professionalisation events and courses validated for the teacher register, including early-bird discounts, prizes, a trampoline course and ticket raffles, and whether this undermines teachers' informed choices. The state secretary replied that validation is done by a teacher-only commission, declined to give a substantive view, said the law leaves course choice to teachers, and said she has no insight into providers or spending.
I have no insight into the individual providers in the register, nor into the budget that teachers or schools have spent on them.
Ik heb geen inzage in de individuele aanbieders in het register, noch in het budget dat leraren of scholen hieraan hebben besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het niet tijdig beschikbaar zijn van digitale leermiddelen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Education why schools cannot access digital learning materials at the start of the school year, what causes this, how it relates to privacy law, the market position of distributor Van Dijk, and the cost and market development of digital materials. The State Secretary answered that causes are varied and shared among distributors, publishers and schools, that problems have fallen from about 80 schools to about 10, that a pseudonym law and an independent study are expected to help, and that market competition remains limited.
I have no insight into how the costs of digital learning materials have developed compared with conventional learning materials.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe de kosten voor digitale leermiddelen zich hebben ontwikkeld ten opzichte van conventionele leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over het op straat belanden van gevoelige gegevens van 1800 kwetsbare leerlingen

MPs Becker and Wörsdörfer asked the State Secretary for Education and the Interior Minister about leaked personal data of 1,800 vulnerable pupils via unanonymised municipal school-transport tenders, and about municipal privacy compliance, other risky tenders, pseudonymisation law and digital security standards. The government answered that municipalities are responsible for compliance and accountable to their councils, pointed to PIANOo and school-sector awareness measures, and said pseudonymisation targets digital learning tools rather than municipal tenders.
The municipalities are accountable to the municipal council for this.
De gemeenten zijn daarover verantwoording verschuldigd aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat conciërge ‘Meester Appie’ graag wil werken, maar wat niet mogelijk is

An SP MP asked the state secretary why a school could not hire conciërge 'Meester Appie' despite structural funds for conciërges and classroom assistants, and asked about the number of such staff, vacancies and trained assistants. The government said it has no figures on schools unable to hire for lack of funds, that school boards decide how to spend the funds, and gave staff and vacancy numbers without committing to any new action.
That is not known. School boards make their own choices about how to spend their financial resources.
Dat is niet bekend. Schoolbesturen maken zelf keuzes in de besteding van hun financiële middelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over gebrekkig onderwijs t.a.v. sexting

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked why pupils report little sexting education and how schools' teaching on sexting, sexual diversity and media matches the 'Seks onder je 25ste' findings. The ministers pointed to Inspectorate reports showing schools address sexual education variably, to Mediawijzer.net and curriculum reform, and gave no new concrete commitments beyond ongoing efforts.
The full report 'Seks onder je 25ste' has not yet been made public; that will happen in the autumn.
Het volledige rapport «Seks onder je 25 ste » is nog niet openbaar gemaakt; dat gebeurt in het najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (onderwijsinspectie) die geen bevoegdheid zou hebben "om toe te zien op de inhoudelijke kwaliteit van examens"

An MP asked why the Inspectorate of Education limits its review of the Frans vwo exam signal to procedure and whether it should assess exam validity, given a parliamentary motion from 2014. The State Secretary replied that the inspectorate supervises the functioning of the CvTE but does not judge exam content, and that the CvTE and inspectorate are tightening the supervisory framework.
It is not a task of the inspectorate to pass judgment on the content and quality of the central exams.
Het is niet een taak van de inspectie om een oordeel te vellen over de inhoud en kwaliteit van de centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de zorg- en leerboerderij Lyts Tolsum in Tzum geen onderwijs meer mag geven vanaf schooljaar 2018/2019

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether it is desirable that a care and learning farm in Tzum can no longer provide education from 2018/2019, leaving pupils with no route to their diploma, and whether action will be taken. The state secretary said that schools, partnerships and municipalities are responsible for finding suitable alternatives, declined to comment on individual cases, will leave it to the inspectorate to monitor, and announced a joint exploration of funding and organisation problems at the education-care interface.
It is not for me to go into individual casework and privacy-sensitive pupil data in the House.
Het is niet aan mij om in de Kamer in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek en privacygevoelige gegevens van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over gendergelijkheid in vergoedingen en salarissen bij de publieke omroep

MPs Paternotte and Sjoerdsma asked whether men and women are paid equally for equal work at the Dutch public broadcasters, following reports on BBC pay gaps and DWDD guest fees, and what concrete action the government has taken. The State Secretary says equal pay is required, that no evidence of unjustified pay gaps was found, that the NPO will raise the issue with broadcasters, possibly with a voluntary quick scan, and that the Code of good governance may address it.
There is no indication that there is unjustified unequal pay between men and women at the public broadcasters.
Er is geen aanwijzing dat er sprake is van ongerechtvaardigde ongelijke beloning van mannen en vrouwen bij de publieke omroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over de gebrekkige beschikbaarheid van uitzendingen van NPO in het buitenland en op de BES-eilanden

MPs Paternotte and Diertens asked why NPO programmes are often unavailable abroad and on the Caribbean Netherlands islands, and whether residents there can watch NPO websites. The State Secretary answered that availability depends on broadcast rights, that geo-blocking has been relaxed for the BES islands where rights and technology allow, and that distribution agreements were made with providers there.
Geo-blocking of NPO websites based on the user's location is no longer applied to the BES islands, insofar as broadcast rights allow and it is technically possible.

Het blokkeren van toegang tot websites van de NPO op basis van de geografische locatie van de gebruiker wordt, voor zover uitzendrechten dat toestaan en het technisch mogelijk is, niet meer toegepast voor de BES-eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat bij een aspirant-omroep meerdere medewerkers boven de Balkenende-norm verdienen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether senior and presenter pay at aspiring broadcaster PowNed, above the WNT pay norm, is lawful and why presenters can be exempted, and what criteria apply. The State Secretary answers that the director's pay exceeds the norm under transitional rules, presenters fall under the separate BPPO norm with limited exceptions, and the NPO plans to stop granting exceptions.
If a broadcaster intends to pay a presenter above the current BPPO norm, that intention must be submitted to the NPO executive board.
Indien een omroep voornemens is een presentator te gaan belonen boven de huidige BPPO-norm, dan dient dat voornemen voorgelegd te worden aan de raad van bestuur van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Islamschool paait jongere met gratis laptop of elektrische fiets'

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic schools should be banned, whether existing ones should be closed, and whether schools should be barred from visiting mosques, following a report on an Islamic school offering pupils gifts. The State Secretary answered that education is free under Article 23 of the Constitution, that schools must meet legal quality requirements including on citizenship and he will act where they do not, and that refused closures and mosque bans, leaving school visits to schools and parents.
Where schools do not comply with statutory quality requirements, including on citizenship, I will of course intervene for that reason.
Waar scholen zich niet houden aan wettelijke kwaliteitseisen, waaronder ten aanzien van burgerschap, treed ik om die reden uiteraard wel op.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat een nieuwe islamitische school in Amsterdam bekostigd moet worden door het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

MPs De Graaf, Beertema and Wilders asked whether the Council of State's ruling obliging the Ministry to fund a new Islamic school in Amsterdam, despite concerns about IS sympathies, could be reconsidered and whether any Islamic education should be allowed. The Secretary of State answered that the ruling is respected and funding has started, that the Inspectorate will supervise the school and may enforce, and that a bill introducing a quality test for new schools is in preparation.
I have already prepared the bill Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen, which introduces a quality test for approval of a new publicly funded school.
Ik heb reeds het wetsvoorstel Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen in voorbereiding, waarmee ik een kwaliteitstoets introduceer voor de goedkeuring van een nieuwe bekostigde school.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van den Hul over ouders die zich blauw betalen aan slimme kinderen die extra lessen nodig hebben

An MP asked the state secretary about parents paying hundreds of euros monthly for external enrichment classes for gifted children because schools do not provide adequate support, and whether parents are afraid to complain. The state secretary answered that education must be free, that schools and special-education partnerships must provide needed support without parental payment, that the inspectorate will enforce this, and that the budgets are sufficient.
If the school does not comply with the regulations, the inspectorate will take enforcement action and can partially or fully suspend or withhold the school's funding.
Wanneer de school zich niet houdt aan de regelgeving zal de inspectie handhavend optreden en kan de inspectie de bekostiging van een school gedeeltelijk of geheel opschorten of inhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de gewijzigde Regeling bijzondere bekostiging bij fusie van 22 mei 2017

An SGP MP asks the state secretary for Education why the amended 2017 merger-compensation scheme applies a 50% pupil-transfer criterion retroactively to mergers already decided under the 2015 rules, and why schools face clawbacks over an unquantified 'substantial' criterion. The state secretary answers that the criterion merely clarifies the concept of merger, that enforcement targets cases where no pupils transferred at all, and that boards bear the risk of their own enrolment assumptions.
To provide clarity on this, the condition was subsequently operationalised in the amended scheme of 22 May 2017.
Om hier duidelijkheid over te verstrekken is die voorwaarde in de gewijzigde regeling van 22 mei 2017 alsnog nader geoperationaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over leraren die worden gekort op salaris voor deelname aan staking

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether a school foundation was docking teachers' pay for striking on 28 June 2017 and whether the school board would be held to account. The State Secretary answered that the employer and unions had talked and the strike days would be paid, and that the matter is for employers and employees.
Strikes and work stoppages are a matter for employers and employees.
Stakingen en werkonderbrekingen zijn een zaak van werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat juffen en meesters die staakten een uur minder loon krijgen

An MP from the SP asked the State Secretary whether a school board in Wijchen was right to deduct one hour of pay from teachers who joined a strike, and whether other school boards did the same. The State Secretary answered that the pay was in the end paid out after consultation with the unions, and that the PO-Raad reported no other school boards deducting pay.
It has now become clear that, after consultation between the Kans en Kleur foundation and the unions AOB and CNV, the salary will be paid out.
Inmiddels is duidelijk geworden dat na overleg tussen de stichting Kans en Kleur en de vakorganisaties AOB en CNV het loon wordt doorbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de uitzending van Brandpunt dat stress op middelbare scholen toeneemt

An MP asked the state secretary about a broadcast reporting rising school stress and burn-out among secondary pupils, including how many pupils are affected, the role of performance pressure, and measures taken. The government answered that such figures are not structurally tracked, cited OECD data showing relatively low school-related stress in the Netherlands, attributed stress mainly to family and societal factors, and pointed to the Gezonde School programme as the main measure.
Information on these specific topics is not structurally kept at the national level.
Over deze specifieke onderwerpen wordt landelijk niet structureel informatie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint inzake het bezwaarschrift van een ouder, wiens dochter na het behalen van het havodiploma niet wordt toegelaten tot de vwo-opleiding op de eigen school

An MP asks whether a Berlage Lyceum pupil with a havo diploma can be denied entry to vwo at her own school, and whether this conflicts with the minister's stated right to upward progression. The State Secretary replies that schools set their own admission rules for higher years, that a statutory havo entry right is planned, that no national overview of school admission criteria exists, and that the school's stated vwo criteria were not met by the pupil.
The governing body of a secondary school determines the admission requirements for its own school itself.
Het bevoegd gezag van een school voor voortgezet onderwijs bepaalt zelf de toelatingseisen tot de eigen school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat ‘steeds meer kinderen uitgesloten worden om de ouderbijdrage’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that primary schools exclude children over voluntary but high parental contributions, and asked about the status of a motion setting a limit on these contributions. The State Secretary replied that contributions are voluntary, that schools must inform parents, that children must be able to join compulsory activities regardless of payment, and that Regioplan research on a limit is expected by end 2017.
Schools cannot oblige parents to pay the parental contribution.
Scholen kunnen ouders niet verplichten de ouderbijdrage te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘zorg over toekomst van aangepaste leermiddelen voor leerlingen met dyslexie’

MP Bruins asked the state secretary whether the lack of a new tender for adapted learning materials for dyslexic pupils will make the supply unavailable and outdated, and why no tender has been issued. The state secretary answered that Dedicon will keep supplying adapted books, that the collection is not quickly outdated, and that no new tender has yet been issued because alternative, cheaper production methods are being explored, with more clarity expected in autumn.
No new tender procedure has yet been issued, because we are currently still in discussion with other parties in light of current technological developments.
Er is nog geen nieuwe aanbestedingsprocedure uitgeschreven, omdat wij op dit moment (in het licht van de huidige technologische ontwikkelingen) nog in gesprek zijn met andere partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de artikelen ‘Noodlijdende St. Maartenschool vindt geldschieter’ en ‘Geldschieter voor school: tijd gewonnen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about press reports that the St. Maartenschool, a special school, faces a two-million-euro cut and was rescued by an outside funder, and whether regular schools must arrange care before pupils transfer. The State Secretary declined to take a substantive position, pointed to earlier answers, said care is shared responsibility of schools, municipalities and insurers, and that no definitive plan had yet been submitted.

It is up to schools, boards and collaborative partnerships in the region to assess which pupils can be placed in (secondary) special education and which, possibly with extra educational support, can go to mainstream education.

Het is aan de scholen, besturen en samenwerkingsverbanden in de regio om te beoordelen welke leerlingen een plek in het (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs kunnen krijgen en welke leerlingen, eventueel met extra onderwijsondersteuning, naar het reguliere onderwijs kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Onderwijs aan ernstig meervoudig beperkte kinderen'

Van Meenen (D66) asked the State Secretary of Education about unequal age limits (16 or 20) for special-education placements of children with severe multiple disabilities across regional partnerships, and about funding and the role of partnerships versus schools. The government answered that the law allows enrolment up to age 20 without an absolute limit, that partnerships set their own criteria, and that a joint VWS-OCW effort is underway on care funding, while ruling out excluding these children from the Passend Onderwijs Act.
Excluding pupils with severe multiple disabilities from passend onderwijs is not something I consider desirable.
Het uitsluiten van leerlingen met ernstige, meervoudige beperkingen uit passend onderwijs acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de Gemeenteraad in Leiden in actie komt tegen de verschraling van de lokale journalistiek

An MP asked the Dutch government about the decline of local and regional journalism and whether municipalities or the national government should fund it, and how this affects local democratic oversight. The government answered that local media play an important role in oversight, pointed to financial pressure on local public broadcasters, mentioned a structural funding line, a guide for councillors and a forthcoming research outline, and said municipalities are responsible for funding local public media.
The importance of these roles only increases with the decentralisations in the social domain and the transfer of over €10 billion to the Municipal Fund.
Het belang van deze rollen neemt met de decentralisaties in het sociaal domein en de overheveling van ruim € 10 miljard naar het Gemeentefonds, alleen maar toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en van Nispen inzake het bericht dat scholen stoppen met schoolzwemmen

The SP MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked whether they are concerned that four Utrecht primary schools stopped offering school swimming after a child drowned, whether other schools have done so, and what concrete measures the government will take to keep schools offering swimming lessons and to improve supervision and responsibility-sharing with pools. State Secretary Dekker answered that the decision lies with schools, that the government does not track their reasons centrally, that it will reiterate the 2005 school swimming protocol and the national platform's plan due at the end of 2017.
Offering school swimming is a consideration that schools make themselves.
Het aanbieden van schoolzwemmen is een afweging die scholen zelf maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet inzake het bericht dat de NPO de zendtijd van Argos en Reporter wil halveren

MP Ellemeet asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the reported NPO plan to halve broadcast time for Argos and Reporter, and about targets, research on investigative journalism, and budget transparency. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, affirmed the importance of investigative journalism, explained that NPO evaluates programmes on a combination of factors, and said no specific budget for investigative journalism can be isolated from the broader news and opinion budget.

It is not really possible to state explicitly what the budget development for investigative journalism has been, because this budget is often part of an overall budget in which editorial departments largely decide for themselves how it is spent.
Het is niet goed mogelijk om expliciet voor onderzoeksjournalistiek aan te geven wat de budgetontwikkeling is geweest, omdat dit budget vaak onderdeel is van een totaalbudget
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de Sint Maartenschool in Ubbergen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Education about the Sint Maartenschool in Ubbergen, which may have to dismiss a third of its staff under passend onderwijs, and how education and care for pupils would be secured. The government answered that a plan of action with municipalities and regional bodies will set out how education and care are organised and funded from the new school year, with families informed before the summer.
Before the end of this school year, parents and staff will be informed about this.
Voor het einde van dit schooljaar worden de ouders en het personeel daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het lerarentekort in de Randstad leidt tot jacht op docent in spe

MP Kwint asked the minister about reports that teacher shortages in the Randstad lead to a rush for pabo students, whether this is undesirable, and what the government will do about the shortage and workload. The minister answers that unqualified pabo students being placed in classrooms is undesirable, that the inspectorate has been instructed to act, and refers to the teacher shortage plan and letters for further measures.
We find the situation in which students are already hired during their training as regular group teachers and stand in front of the class independently and without supervision undesirable.
Wij vinden de situatie waarin studenten al tijdens hun opleiding worden aangenomen als reguliere groepsleerkracht en zelfstandig en zonder begeleiding voor de klas staan niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de toekomstige beschikbaarheid van IC-prototypes voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en wetenschappelijk onderzoek

MP Bruins asked the minister whether the EU's decision not to continue funding Europractice, which provides chip prototyping services to universities and industry, would harm Dutch science and industry, and whether alternative, more continuous funding could be sought. The minister answered that Europractice-PLUS failed the minimum quality threshold in the EU evaluation, that the Netherlands has raised the issue with the Commission and other member states, and that a follow-up proposal may be submitted to a call expected in October 2017.
The Netherlands raised this issue at a meeting of this Committee on 18 May.
Nederland heeft deze kwestie tijdens een zitting van dit Committee aan de orde gesteld op 18 mei jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Van taalachterstand naar taalenthousiasme'

MP Bisschop asked the state secretary about a report on language policy, questioning whether the debate on spelling and grammar is one-sided and whether teachers master Dutch grammar, and asked for consultation with the Vereniging Hogescholen. The minister answered that the remarks show a need for balanced language use, that teacher training standards already apply, and that there is currently insufficient reason to consult the association further.
In view of the above, in my opinion there is currently insufficient reason to enter into further consultation with the Vereniging Hogescholen on this matter.
Gelet op bovenstaande is er naar mijn mening nu onvoldoende aanleiding met de Vereniging Hogescholen hierover verder in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht ‘dat schoolbesturen van basisscholen de gasrekening betalen uit de salarispot van leraren’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for education whether primary school boards using teacher salary funds for heating, cleaning and digital boards is acceptable, and whether earmarking personnel and material funding should be introduced. The state secretary replied that lump-sum funding gives boards freedom of allocation, that funding is sober but adequate, that the sector's finances are positive, and rejected earmarking and extra funds while acknowledging room to improve accountability.
I do see possibilities to improve the lump-sum system in the accountability of school boards and to make better use of existing information.
Ik zie wel mogelijkheden tot verbetering van de lumpsumsystematiek in de verantwoording van schoolbesturen en het beter benutten van de bestaande informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het programma Ontvoerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether the ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice cooperated with the RTL programme Ontvoerd on child abduction, and raised concerns about child harm, due process and media interests. The state secretary answered that the Central Authority gave only general information in three meetings in 2012–2013, that the ministries were not involved in producing the programme, and that broadcasting and participation decisions rest with the broadcaster and parents.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1, 10 and 11, three meetings took place in 2012 and 2013 between officials of the Central Authority and the editorial team of RTL-Ontvoerd.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in antwoord op de vragen 1, 10 en 11 hebben in 2012 en 2013 drie gesprekken plaatsgevonden tussen ambtenaren van de Centrale autoriteit en de redactie van RTL-Ontvoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgoz-Zegerius over het bericht dat in het concept Jaarplan TV 2018 door de NPO opgenomen is dat de berichtgeving rond Nederlanders van niet-westerse afkomst niet problematiserend mag zi

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the NPO's draft 2018 plan, which aims for positive portrayal of Dutch people of non-Western origin, abandons journalistic objectivity and whether the NPO should be asked to discuss this. The State Secretary confirmed the NPO's duty to give balanced, objective coverage, said the NPO was reminded of this, and noted that the NPO accounts for its programming annually in its Terugblik, leaving parliament to assess afterwards.
Following your questions, I have once again pointed this out to the public broadcaster.
Naar aanleiding van uw vragen heb ik de publieke omroep hier nogmaals op gewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘RK-scholen passen viering Pasen aan’

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether Dutch Christian and Catholic schools that adjusted their Easter celebrations to accommodate Muslim pupils were betraying Judeo-Christian culture, how many schools and pupils were affected, and whether school boards and Muslim parents should be summoned or told to assimilate or leave. The state secretary rejected the premise, said the central government does not track school Easter practices or pupil transfers, declined to summon school boards, and said integration rather than assimilation is policy.
The central government does not keep track of whether schools celebrate Easter or how they do so.
De rijksoverheid houdt niet bij of scholen het paasfeest vieren en op welke wijze zij dit doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Azmani over het bericht “Christelijke scholen zwakken paasviering af”

Two VVD MPs asked the education state secretary whether Christian schools that reportedly scaled back their Easter celebrations were self-censoring, and what the ministry will do to support teachers and promote civic education. The state secretary answered that the schools deny the media account, that he has no signs of self-censorship, that teachers should feel supported by their own boards, and that a legislative tightening of the civic education duty is being prepared.
I am now preparing this legislative amendment. I will submit it to your House as soon as possible.
Ik bereid deze wetswijziging nu voor. Ik leg deze zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Marijnissen over de geplande sluiting van Den Bongerd in Oss

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the planned closure of Den Bongerd in Oss is justified given the lack of support from staff, parents and pupils, whether co-determination should have binding consent rights, and whether the closure fits the goal of appropriate education for every child. The state secretary answered that the closure is a deliberate decision to move Den Bongerd's expertise into regular schools, that staff and parents were involved through co-determination bodies, that no statutory consent right is planned, and that he sees no reason to meet the board to prevent the closure.
As I explained earlier in the letter to parliament on the progress of the pupil decline measures of 28 October 2016, I see no reason to align the consent right when closing a school.

Zoals ik eerder heb toegelicht in de Kamerbrief over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de maatregelen leerlingendaling van 28 oktober 2016, zie ik geen aanleiding voor het gelijktrekken van het instemmingsrecht bij sluiting van een school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de weeffout in de Jeugdwet

An SP MP asks why municipalities pay for residential youth care for children from other areas, why some cities bear costs for children placed by others, whether municipalities refer children for financial reasons, and why the compensation scheme is slow and partial, plus a question on innovation in residential care. The State Secretary says the woonplaats principle will be changed for care without residence now and that a feasibility study is underway for residential care, that the compensation scheme for 2017–2019 will stay as is, and refers back to answers 3–5 for question 8.
For youth care without residence, the woonplaats principle will be adjusted and I am initiating a legislative amendment for this.
Voor jeugdhulp zonder verblijf zal het woonplaatsbeginsel worden aangepast en daarvoor zet ik een wetswijziging in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat het Nederlandse onderwijs nog teveel talenten van leerlingen en studenten onbenut laat

An MP asked the state secretary about the Inspectorate's finding that some schools get more from their pupils than others and whether schools rated 'voldoende' should be pushed to 'goed'. The secretary agreed that schools differ, said the inspectorate will be able to distinguish 'voldoende' from 'goed' under renewed supervision from August 2017, and said the inspectorate has a stimulating role but gave no new concrete commitment.
The renewed supervision enters into force on 1 August 2017.
Het vernieuwde toezicht treedt 1 augustus 2017 in werking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de werkdruk onder basisschoolleraren door "administratieve rompslomp"

MP Becker asked the state secretary about teacher workload caused by administrative burden in primary schools, citing an NOS survey, and asked about measures to reduce paperwork and clarify what is legally required. The state secretary confirmed the workload picture, described the Regeldrukagenda and Operatie Regels Ruimen, explained that much paperwork is self-imposed by schools rather than required by the inspectorate, and promised a overview of common misunderstandings by June.
Yes. To help schools take more control, an overview of the biggest misunderstandings about registrations in education will be available in June, with an explanation from the inspectorate.

Ja. Om scholen te helpen meer de regie te nemen, komt er in juni een overzicht voor scholen van de grootste misverstanden over registraties in het onderwijs, met hierbij een toelichting van de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over onbevoegde wiskundedocenten voor de klas

MP Kwint asks the State Secretary about the growing number of unqualified mathematics teachers in secondary schools, their effect on education quality, and whether the 2016 action plan is working. The State Secretary answers that the share of mathematics lessons taught by unqualified teachers rose only marginally, that schools are working on it, and that it is too early to judge the plan's results.
At this point it cannot yet be said how many teachers have obtained their qualification since February 2016, because these data are not yet available.
Het valt op dit moment nog niet te zeggen hoeveel leraren hun bevoegdheid gehaald hebben sinds februari 2016, omdat deze gegevens nog niet beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff inzake de brandbrief van gemeenten en scholen over het onderwijsachterstandenbeleid

An MP asks whether the new CBS definition of educational disadvantage captures more children than the old weighting scheme, and whether funding will be increased accordingly, along with questions on a planned 65 million euro cut. The Secretary of State disputes that the definitions are comparable, says the funding frame of the education budget is binding, and describes the reduction as a demographic forecast adjustment rather than a cut.
There is no question of a cut, but of a forecast adjustment due to the general decline in pupil numbers in primary education.
Er is geen sprake van een bezuiniging, maar van een ramingsbijstelling ten gevolge van de algemene leerlingendaling in het primair onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus over het starten van een Vrije School in Schin op Geul

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Education whether a Waldorf (Vrije School) can be opened in Schin op Geul, and whether current law allows such initiatives and transitional arrangements. The State Secretary answers that current law blocks new schools and dislocations in this case, but a bill (Meer Ruimte voor Nieuwe Scholen) is in preparation to ease this.
That is why I have a bill in preparation that will in the future offer more options to start a school based on actual interest and a quality test.
Daarom heb ik een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding dat in de toekomst meer mogelijkheden biedt om op basis van daadwerkelijke belangstelling en een toets op de kwaliteit, een school te kunnen starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het Edith Stein College dat op onwettelijke gronden leerlingen weigerde

MP Kwint asked the State Secretary for Education why the Edith Stein College unlawfully selected pupils based on Cito scores, why the rector and staff did not catch it, what will happen to pupils redirected to another school, and whether other schools use similar selection. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said it was corrected quickly, stated that referral to an alternative school is not compulsory, and declined further investigation, pointing to the Inspectorate and the forthcoming evaluation of the Primary Education Testing Act.
I therefore do not consider further investigation necessary.
Nader onderzoek acht ik dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht dat er problemen zijn met het vervoer voor leerlingen met een zorgvraag of beperking

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that school transport for pupils with care needs or disabilities is badly arranged, including how many use it, quality and punctuality data, and whether a general administrative order (AMvB) like the one for disability transport should be made. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for school transport, that the ministry has no quality picture or punctuality figures, that satisfaction surveys show high ratings, and that no AMvB is possible under current law, pointing to a handbook for municipalities instead.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport does not lie with the Ministry of OCW but with the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt niet bij het Ministerie van OCW maar bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht 'Sluiting dreigt voor snel groeiende school Het Dok'

An MP asked the education state secretary about a primary school at risk of closing because housing delays left it below the founding enrollment norm, and whether exceptions or extra transition time should apply. The answers say the school has options to continue (re-founding or a cooperation agreement) and that no general policy or discretionary exemption is needed, while the state secretary notes the lapse was largely outside the school's control.
The WPO contains no discretionary power and/or hardship clause for situations where a school does not meet the founding norm.
De WPO kent geen discretionaire bevoegdheid en/of hardheidsclausule voor situaties waarbij een school de stichtingsnorm niet haalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de nieuwe Partijwijzer voor jongeren van de NPO

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the NPO's youth voter guide omitted parties standing in the 2017 election, such as the Vrijzinnige Partij, and whether all qualifying parties should be included. The State Secretary said the NPO has since added the missing parties under the same criteria as the NOS debates, and declined to pressure the NPO because of media programming autonomy.
Based on the programmatic autonomy of the media, government interference in this does not fit.
Op basis van de programmatische autonomie van media past inmenging vanuit de overheid hierin niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Roemer over het bericht dat de Staatssecretaris de Sint Maartenschool in Ubbergen niet wilt bezoeken

An MP asks why the state secretary refuses to visit the Sint Maartenschool, which faces job losses due to funding cuts under inclusive education policy, and why a ministry official rather than the minister engages with stakeholders. The secretary answers that officials will consult regional parties, that the school remains open and must offer appropriate education, that a reorganisation and social plan with 53 fte reduction were agreed, and that ministries will help organise medical care.

During the general consultation with your House on 15 December 2016 on inclusive education, I committed that ministry officials would consult stakeholders in the region to hear what exactly is happening at the Sint Maartenschool.

Tijdens het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 15 december 2016 over passend onderwijs heb ik toegezegd dat ambtenaren van het ministerie in overleg gaan met betrokkenen in de regio om te horen wat er precies speelt rond de Sint Maartenschool.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Mei Li Vos over staatssteun voor Belgische mediabedrijven die Nederlandse krantenbedrijven willen overnemen

MPs Mohandis and Mei Li Vos asked about Belgian state support (postal distribution compensation to bpost and a 0% VAT rate on printed newspapers) enabling Belgian media firms to acquire Dutch newspapers, and whether this distorts the Dutch market. The Secretary of State answered that the EU Commission has found both measures compatible with EU rules, that no distortion was established, and that the future of the Dutch press is primarily the sector's responsibility, with a promised information letter on research into independent journalism before summer.
The European Commission concluded in its aforementioned decision that the Belgian DAEB press distribution complies with EU state aid rules.
De Europese Commissie heeft in haar voornoemd besluit geconcludeerd dat de Belgische DAEB persdistributie voldoet aan de EU staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake hoge werkdruk en het lage salaris van leraren

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education about high teacher workload, structural overtime, underfunding, and the failure to make teaching attractive, citing an AOb survey. The State Secretary disputes underfunding, points to ongoing measures to cut administrative burden and a planned letter on the motion about teaching hours, and argues workload is mainly a matter for teachers and their managers.
The solution to the experienced high workload is not simple and can only be limitedly influenced by national policy.
De oplossing voor de ervaren hoge werkdruk is niet eenvoudig en maar beperkt te beïnvloeden door landelijk beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘School lokt leerling met vliegreisje’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Education whether public education funds should be spent on marketing such as a school's flight trip to attract pupils, and what role the ministry could play in sharing good practice like the Breda agreements. The State Secretary answered that schools may use funding for name recognition and pupil information, that the accountant and inspectorate supervise proportionality, and that the ministry is not the party to approve local initiatives but welcomes them and shared best-practice resources.
In cases where the spending of funding has no relation to education, the inspectorate acts as supervisor.
In gevallen waar bij de besteding van de bekostiging de relatie met het onderwijs niet aanwezig is, treedt de inspectie als toezichthouder op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Veldman inzake het bericht Technieklokaal Winterswijk bang voor sluiting door te weinig geld

MPs Straus and Veldman asked whether the government would close the funding gap threatening the Winterswijk technology classroom, which faces closure without it. The state secretary said schools decide how to spend funds, that the classroom can continue under school choice through 2020, and that the national government does not give individual grants to support organisations.
The national government does not give individual contributions to supporting organisations; this runs via the schools themselves.
De rijksoverheid geeft geen individuele bijdragen aan ondersteunende organisaties, dit loopt via scholen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch inzake het bericht 'Kiezen voor Technologie'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about the reported drop in funding for the 'Kiezen voor Technologie' science and technology programme in primary schools, and the consequences for provision and the national budget. The government answers that the programme was a temporary stimulus, that about 2.2 million euro is available for regional networks in 2017 falling to 1.4 million by 2020, and that schools receive regular funding and a 65 million euro increase in the prestatiebox for science and technology.
Is it correct that the financial support for WTE falls from 6 million euro to 1.5 million euro in 2017?
Klopt het dat de financiële ondersteuning voor WTE in 2017 daalt van 6 miljoen euro naar 1,5 miljoen euro?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over afleiding van mobiele telefoons in de klas

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about pupils' phone use in class, citing research on learning losses and asking about schools' experiences, blocking tools and alternatives. The government answered that schools and parents are responsible for agreements on phone use, that jamming devices may conflict with the law, and that it will ask the national research body and Kennisnet to compile research for schools.
I consider the sensible use of smartphones in and around the classroom in primary education a responsibility of schools and parents.
Ik acht het verstandig gebruik van smartphones in en om het klaslokaal in de basis een verantwoordelijkheid van scholen en ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de rol die de achtergrond van kinderen speelt bij het schooladvies en de kansen in het onderwijs

MP Ypma asks the State Secretary of Education how socio-economic background affects school advice for children with similar Cito scores, and whether parents should be able to push advice upward. The State Secretary acknowledges a structural tendency for high-SES pupils to be advised above their test scores, rejects a legal right or duty for upward revision as counterproductive, and instead commits to inspectorate-led awareness measures and clarification of the review obligation.
I therefore work to ensure that the potential of pupils is fully reflected in the school advice.
Ik zet me er dan ook voor in dat het potentieel van leerlingen volledig wordt weerspiegeld in het schooladvies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake leerrechten van vluchtelingenkinderen en terugdringen van thuiszitters

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about the right to education of refugee children, how many asylum-seeker children are not in school, and why the target of zero long-term truants is set for 2020 rather than earlier. The state secretary answers that asylum-seeker children have the same schooling obligations and access within three months, that about 200 of 7,500 are not attending school, and that the 2020 target is realistic given how persistent truancy is.
As shown by the file comparison included in my letter of 14 July 2016, about 200 of the 7,500 school-age asylum-seeker children are known not to attend school.

Zoals uit de in mijn brief d.d. 14 juli 2016 opgenomen vergelijking van bestanden blijkt, is van de 7500 leer- en kwalificatieplichtige asielzoekerskinderen van ongeveer 200 bekend dat zij niet naar school gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het bericht 'Nieuwe opwinding over GIEL-salaris'

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked whether a reported salary of 560,000 euros for a public broadcaster's radio presenter is reasonable and whether non-top staff in the public sector should fall under the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT). The State Secretary called such a salary unreasonable and said the WNT-3 bill extending the pay norm to non-top staff, including presenters, is expected to go to the Council of State for advice soon.
The cabinet also wants the statutory pay norm to apply to non-top officials in the (semi-)public sector, including presenters, programme makers and radio DJs at the public broadcaster.
Het kabinet wil daarnaast dat de wettelijke bezoldigingsnorm ook op niet-topfunctionarissen in de (semi)publieke sector van toepassing wordt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over topsalarissen bij de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep

An MP asked whether a presenter's reported high salary at the public broadcaster was true and what the government would do about such pay funded by taxpayers. The state secretary said the salary exceeds the WNT disclosure norm, that the exact figure cannot be verified from disclosed data, that the NPO will revise its hiring and pay policy, and that the cabinet will extend the WNT pay cap to non-top staff via the WNT-3 bill going to the Raad van State.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me shortly of the concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding a more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het topinkomen van een radiomaker

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about reports that a public broadcasting radio presenter earns about 560,000 euro a year, and whether public-broadcaster staff should fall under the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) salary cap of 181,000 euro. The government says it cannot verify the reported salary from WNT disclosures, finds such pay undesirable, has demanded concrete follow-up from the broadcaster, and says a WNT-3 bill extending the cap to non-top officials is in preparation.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me shortly which concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding a more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de topsalarissen bij de publieke omroep

An MP asked the government about reported high salaries at public broadcasters, including a radio DJ allegedly earning about three times the WNT norm, and asked for greater transparency. The state secretary said such pay above the WNT norm is undesirable, that the NPO was ordered to announce concrete steps on hiring and pay policy, that the WNT is being extended to non-top officials via a draft bill, and that the broadcasters must provide information to the minister on request.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me in the short term of the concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Asante over het vertrek van een leerling van het Waterlant College

MPs Vermue and Asante asked about a pupil who left Waterlant College after reportedly being the only white pupil in his class and facing bullying, and about segregation and parental involvement in schools. The state secretary called the situation undesirable, said the Inspectorate has been in contact with the school and will discuss the case with the governing body, and pointed to existing anti-bullying duties and support tools without committing to a new investigation.
Following earlier contact with the school management, the inspectorate will discuss this case with the competent authority of Waterlant College in the short term.
In vervolg op het eerdere contact met de schoolleiding zal de inspectie deze zaak op korte termijn bespreken met het bevoegd gezag van het Waterlant College.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis, Jasper van Dijk en Verhoeven over geheime contracten en onzorgvuldige begeleiding van deelnemers bij RTL-programma's rond hulp-tv

MPs asked the state secretary about RTL reality-help programmes allegedly misleading vulnerable participants, binding them to secret contracts, and filming therapy under pressure, and whether the state has adequate legal tools and oversight. The state secretary said producers and broadcasters bear primary responsibility, the Mediawet 2008 contains no such rules and no new legislation is planned, RTL (under Luxembourg supervision) has promised to review its practices and media code, and medical questions were referred to the health minister.
I also see no reason to propose statutory rules for this.
Ik zie ook geen aanleiding om daar wettelijke regels voor te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het commerciële tv-programma "een nieuw begin"?

SP MPs asked the Health and Culture ministers about the commercial TV programme 'een nieuw begin', which allegedly pressed participants into unnecessary cosmetic and dental treatments, and whether clinics and the Inspectorate had acted. The minister called it a worrying signal, said patient consent and information duties apply, noted the Inspectorate had no complaints about the programme and was investigating CDC Tandzorg on unrelated complaints, and said RTL and producers bear responsibility and will be reviewed.
The Inspectorate cannot make any statements about the nature of the ongoing investigation.
Over de aard van het lopende onderzoek kan de Inspectie geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Bisschop inzake het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht niet in lijn handelt met de Leerplichtwet en het wettelijk vastgestelde model

MPs Bruins and Bisschop asked whether Utrecht's extra conditions on home-schooling exemptions under the Leerplichtwet, and its strict prosecution practice, conflict with the state secretary's 2016 letter to municipalities. The state secretary declined to judge the pending case, said all municipalities must act within the law, and noted that jurisprudence will clarify exemption requirements over time.
The case you refer to is before the court. It is not for me to judge this at this stage.
De zaak waar u naar verwijst is onder de rechter. Het is niet aan mij om daar in dit stadium over te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake het bericht ‘Praktijkscholen vrezen toeloop van ander soort leerlingen’

An MP asked the State Secretary about practical schools fearing an influx of pupils with severe behavioural problems if national admission criteria are dropped, and how this relates to an amendment on opting out. The State Secretary answered that regional special-needs partnerships will decide placements, that no restriction on cluster-4 inflow is planned, and that talks with the sector on a new funding system and the dropping of criteria will continue, with a proposal expected in spring 2017.
In spring 2017 a proposal will be worked out and a bill drafted, which the next cabinet can submit to the House of Representatives.
In het voorjaar van 2017 wordt een voorstel uitgewerkt en een wetsvoorstel opgesteld, dat door het volgende kabinet kan worden ingediend bij de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Straus over het artikel ‘Schoolbestuur, waar is uw jaarrekening?’

MPs Duisenberg and Straus asked about a press report finding that many school boards do not publish their annual reports, despite agreements in the Good Governance Code, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary confirms the problem, says the government will amend sector laws and the reporting regulation to require publication if the agreements are not kept, and refers to the Inspectorate's forthcoming report.

Afterwards, further instructions on publishing the full annual report, consisting of the board report, the financial statements and other relevant documents, will be given in the Regulation on Education Annual Reporting.

Daarna worden in de Regeling Jaarverslaggeving Onderwijs nadere aanwijzingen omtrent de openbaarmaking van het gehele jaarverslag, bestaand uit zowel het bestuursverslag, de jaarrekening en overige relevante stukken gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de aanmeldleeftijd in het onderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about legal doubts over school enrolment procedures in several municipalities, including whether these breach the Primary and Secondary Education Acts, and what the inspectorate and ministry are doing. The State Secretary answered that schools must adapt procedures themselves, the inspectorate acts on signals rather than routine checks, and schools are given time through the coming school year.
If the inspectorate receives a signal, it takes action where necessary.
Krijgt de inspectie een signaal binnen, dan onderneemt zij zo nodig actie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Leenders over de sluiting van de Rotterdamse vestiging van het Wellant College

MPs Vermue and Leenders asked why the Rotterdam vmbo-groen department of Wellant College must close, leaving 180 pupils to find new schools, and how this affects pupils with extra support needs and local green-sector prospects. The state secretary replied that closure is a board decision, that nearby alternatives exist, and that the school has a duty of care for pupils with support needs, while leaving substantive regional planning to local partners.
Whether or not to close a branch is a decision primarily taken by the school board.
