Het al dan niet sluiten van een vestiging is een beslissing die primair door het schoolbestuur wordt genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Klein over het bericht ‘Duizenden kinderen zitten onnodig thuis’

MPs Ypma and Klein asked the State Secretary of Education about reports that thousands of children stay home unnecessarily due to schools and municipalities failing to find suitable places, cost disputes between schools, municipalities and youth care, school refusals, and exemptions. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Thuiszitterspact and the appointed facilitator, committed to a school-inspectorate monitoring route, a study into rising exemptions, and to further dialogue on a development budget, without introducing new legal powers.
That is why I have agreed with the Inspectorate of Education that these signals can be reported there.
Daarom heb ik met de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) afgesproken dat deze signalen daar kunnen worden gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake aanmeldleeftijd in het onderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Hague convenant setting a single enrolment age and limiting parents to one school application complies with the WPO and WVO, and what can be done about it. The government answered that the convenant conflicts with the law, that it will be adjusted with the municipality and school boards, and that it will raise the issue with schools and examine any other cases that come to light.
For that reason the convenant must be adjusted in a way that fits within the framework of the WPO.
Daarom moet het convenant worden aangepast op een manier dat het binnen de kaders van de WPO past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over een propaganda-offensief van de publieke omroep

An MP asked the state secretary whether the public broadcaster NPO has a legal mandate to remove fear of the Arab world and whether it may try to change Dutch opinion, and whether its programmes amount to propaganda. The state secretary answered that the public media mandate is in Article 2.1 of the Mediawet, that broadcasters are programmatically autonomous, and that Middle East coverage is extensive and balanced, without committing to any action.
In any case, it always applies that only the broadcasters themselves are responsible for the form and content of their media output.
Overigens geldt altijd dat uitsluitend de omroepen zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor de vorm en inhoud van hun media-aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de zedenpolitie van AVROTROS

An MP asked the state secretary whether it was absurd that AVROTROS removed a homosexual sex scene from the series La Famiglia and asked for a talk with the broadcaster about this 'moral policing'. The government answered that the scene was dropped only for narrative placement reasons, that AVROTROS has no problem with gay sex scenes, that no Mediawet rule is breached, and that broadcasters are programmatically autonomous so no talk is needed.
From my answer to questions 1–3 it appears that there is no question of 'moral policing' by AVROTROS.
Uit mijn antwoord op de vragen 1–3 blijkt dat geen sprake is van «zedenpolitie» door AVROTROS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake de aandacht op de publieke tv-zenders voor de Paralympische Spelen

An MP asked the government about the limited TV airtime (about 35 hours) the public broadcasters gave the Paralympics compared with the Olympics, and whether the government would investigate a fairer split. The State Secretary declined to judge the airtime allocation, stressed that public broadcasters decide their own programming under the Mediawet, pointed to increased Paralympic coverage and online streams, and rejected a study as unnecessary and undesirable.
The Mediawet explicitly provides that the public media institutions themselves determine the form and content of their media offering and are themselves responsible for it.
In de Mediawet is nadrukkelijk bepaald dat de publieke media-instellingen zelf de vorm en inhoud van hun media-aanbod bepalen en daar ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de onmogelijkheid om in het Caribisch deel van Nederland de Nederlandse televisiezenders te ontvangen

An MP asked why Dutch TV channels were not receivable in Caribbean Netherlands and what the government would do about it. The government answered that the NPO adjusted geo-IP filtering so the islands can access its services, that sports rights are sold by geographic zone, and that commercial broadcasters set their own distribution policy.
For the distribution of media services by commercial broadcasters, this is not a matter for the Dutch government.
Voor de doorgifte van mediadiensten van commerciële omroepen geldt dat dit geen zaak is van de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over conciërges en klassenassistenten

An SP MP asked how many concierges and classroom assistants were hired since 2015 with the structural 50 million euro from the 2014 budget agreement, and requested yearly headcounts from 2010 to 2014. The State Secretary replied that the funds went into the lump sum so hiring cannot be traced, but DUO staff data show a rise in support staff from 2014 to 2015 and provides figures for 2010-2015.
As a result, it is not possible to state how many concierges and classroom assistants have been hired with this money.
Daardoor is het niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel conciërges en klassenassistenten met dit geld zijn aangesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat PowNed Onno Hoes een schadevergoeding moet betalen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about a court ruling ordering PowNed to pay damages to Onno Hoes, including whether public money would be used and whether PowNed's leadership should be held liable. The State Secretary declined to judge the court's ruling, noted that appeal and a damages procedure remain open, said PowNed is insured, and stated that liability of its directors is not his matter.
The court has ruled on the matter and I cannot and will not comment on or pass judgment on that ruling, especially since an appeal is still open against it.
De rechter heeft zich erover gebogen en ik kan en wil niet treden in zijn oordeel of dat oordeel van commentaar voorzien, temeer omdat tegen de uitspraak nog hoger beroep open staat.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Ypma en Vermue over het bericht 'Basisscholen moeten ouderbijdrage beperken'

MPs Ypma and Vermue asked the State Secretary of Education whether schools' voluntary parental contributions deter parents and exclude children from activities, and what measures will be taken. The State Secretary answered that contributions are voluntary, the Inspectorate monitors compliance with sanctions in principle though none have been applied, schools must let all children take part in compulsory lessons, and the government allocates extra funds for children's participation.
Schools cannot oblige parents to pay the parental contribution. The contribution is always voluntary.
Scholen kunnen ouders niet verplichten de ouderbijdrage te betalen. De bijdrage is altijd vrijwillig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat een 'Gülenschool' in Amsterdam wordt beveiligd

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked about extra security at Gülen-linked schools in Amsterdam, possible foreign funding of schools, and whether political conflicts should stay out of schools. The state secretary said extra security was temporary and local, that inspection found no sign of external funding, and that schools should not become a political arena, while supporting schools and municipalities.
I am aware that at various schools security was present at the beginning of this school year.
Het is mij bekend dat op verschillende scholen aan het begin van dit schooljaar beveiliging aanwezig was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Jasper van Dijk en Grashoff inzake de gevolgen van het Turkse conflict voor Nederlandse scholen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Education about school withdrawals and intimidation of Turkish-Dutch pupils linked to the Erdogan-Gulen conflict, and about the role of municipalities and the financial effects on schools. The answers report about 600 pupils switching schools, signals of pressure from within the community, extra police attention, support from the School and Safety foundation, and that funding follows enrolment counts monitored by the Inspectorate.
I am therefore pleased with the great involvement of municipalities.
Ik ben daarom blij met de grote betrokkenheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het bericht dat scholieren vaak ziek thuis zitten

An SP MP asked the education state secretary about reports that many pupils stay home sick, whether passend onderwijs has failed, and whether the M@ZL programme should be rolled out nationally. The state secretary said there is no national data on pupil sickness absence, that M@ZL halved absence in West Brabant, and that the NCJ is exploring wider rollout while regions decide themselves.
No, I cannot give you figures on this.
Nee, ik kan u hierover geen cijfers geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Bruins over zorgen om privacy in het onderwijs

MPs Van Meenen and Bruins asked the State Secretary for Education about psychologists' and pedagogues' concerns over careless handling of sensitive pupil data, and what has been done to improve it. The State Secretary acknowledged the signals, listed sector-wide privacy measures, planned a repeat monitor, and pointed to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie as supervisors while leaving much responsibility with schools.
I intend to have this monitor repeated still this calendar year and will inform your House of the results.
Ik ben voornemens deze monitor nog dit kalenderjaar te laten herhalen en zal uw Kamer over de resultaten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de positie van de landelijke ouderorganisatie Ouders & Onderwijs

An SP MP asked the education state secretary whether the state-funded parents' organisation Ouders & Onderwijs adequately represents parents, how its 1 million euro budget, director's spending and grant discretion are controlled, and whether its evaluation should be brought forward. The state secretary defended the organisation as fulfilling a parliamentary motion, pointed to an evaluation in 2017 covering governance and representation, detailed the 2015 expenditure, and declined to bring the evaluation forward.
I want to first give the organisation the opportunity to take shape before I evaluate.
Ik wil de organisatie eerst de kans geven vorm te krijgen, alvorens ik ga evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over examens in het speciaal onderwijs

MP Siderius asked whether students with autism in special secondary education must take the oral college exam, whether their test grades count toward the final exam grade, and whether the oral exam can be taken in writing. The State Secretary answered that schools choose among exam modalities; under the state exam the college exam (oral, possibly partly written, adaptable with CvTE approval) determines half the final grade, and schools with an exam licence can count test results while written alternatives are possible.
A written exam instead of an oral exam is among the possibilities.
Een schriftelijk examen in plaats van een mondeling examen behoort tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de wijze waarop leerlingen op het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs hun examen hebben moeten maken

An MP asked why students in special secondary education face different and burdensome exam arrangements (e.g. many oral exams in a few days, a staatsexamen with examiners unfamiliar with their needs) compared with regular secondary schools. The Secretary of State answered that exam modalities vary, that maatwerk and examiner training are provided, and that no review of the current system is planned.
I do not intend to conduct research into a way to make the current system more reasonable.
Dit maakt dat ik niet voornemens ben om onderzoek te doen naar een manier om de huidige systematiek meer redelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten over "over het ontbreken van het beroep ‘leraar basisonderwijs’ op de kansberoepenlijst van het UWV "

MPs Bruins and Schouten asked why primary-school teacher is not on UWV's list of opportunity occupations despite projected shortages from 2016 and 2020, and whether the government will consult stakeholders and answer quickly. The minister replied that current supply is sufficient (about 7,800 unemployed in primary education in 2015), so the occupation is excluded, that the list is updated twice yearly and could be revised, and that he will inform parliament in November.
I will inform your House in November about the latest state of affairs on the education labour market.
Ik zal uw Kamer in november informeren over de laatste stand van zaken op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Gedoe over onderzoek naar schoolkeuze ouders’

An SGP MP asked the education state secretary about a study of parental school choice motives, arguing the research should focus on satisfaction with the existing school offer rather than hypothetical scenarios. The state secretary explained the study uses vignettes to compare school characteristics and relates preferences to actual choices, and promised the results after the summer.

As stated in my letter to your House of 27 June 2016, the study into parental school choice motives in primary and secondary education is currently being carried out and the House will receive the research results after the summer.

Zoals vermeld in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 27 juni 2016, wordt het onderzoek naar schoolkeuzemotieven van ouders in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs momenteel uitgevoerd en ontvangt de Kamer de onderzoeksresultaten na de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de aanhoudende problemen met het leerlingenvervoer in De Fryske Marren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about data sharing with a research bureau, the poor rating of school transport stops, and the abolition of door-to-door pickup in De Fryske Marren. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible, that data should not have been shared and an apology was given, and that complaints can be lodged with the municipality, while declining to inspect stop conditions and committing to no new action.
School transport is a responsibility of the municipalities.
Het leerlingenvervoer is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het opheffen van de Groep in School (GIS) op basisschool de Torteltuin in Almere

An SP MP asked whether closing the Groep in School at de Torteltuin in Almere without an equivalent alternative, on financial grounds and without parental involvement, was acceptable under passend onderwijs. The State Secretary replied that school boards in the SWV are responsible for a dekkend aanbod, that alternatives were offered to all pupils, that parents were informed and consulted, and that no extra measures or investigation are needed.
As stated in the answer to question 1, it is the responsibility of the schools within a collaborative partnership to organise a comprehensive range of support provision.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 1 staat, is het de verantwoordelijkheid van de scholen binnen een samenwerkingsverband om een dekkend aanbod aan ondersteuningsvoorzieningen te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de werkwijze van het interventieteam Onderwijs en Zorg

An MP asked the state secretary about the criteria, procedures and powers of the Interventieteam Onderwijs en Zorg, which handles children who stay home long-term. The government answered that the team has no extra powers or override authority, works case by case with parental consent, and that remaining cases are still in progress.
The intervention team has no override authority.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Mohandis over de toegankelijkheid van grote sportevenementen op televisie

MPs Van Dijk and Mohandis asked whether major sporting events such as Formula 1 should be available on free-to-air television and whether the events list should be widened, after Formula 1 moved to subscription broadcaster Ziggo Sport. The Secretary of State agrees such events should be accessible on free-to-air television if of significant national importance, but declines to amend the events list now, citing legal certainty and recent 2015 changes, and points to digital options.
At this moment, however, I do not wish to amend the events list.
Op dit moment wil ik de evenementenlijst echter niet aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus, Aukje de Vries en Moors inzake vmbo-leerlingen die aangeven onvoldoende kennis van geldzaken te hebben

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Finance about a survey showing vmbo pupils feel insufficiently informed about money matters, and what schools, the curriculum and the Wijzer in Geldzaken programme do about it. The government answers that money management is embedded in existing curriculum goals and subjects, that monitoring of school practice is not done centrally, and that prevention is preferred to municipal debt write-offs.
However, it is not monitored nationally in what way and with what intensity schools pay attention to societal themes such as managing money, nor why they do so.
Er wordt echter niet landelijk gemonitord op welke wijze en met welke intensiteit scholen aandacht besteden aan maatschappelijke thema's zoals omgaan met geld, en ook niet waarom zij dat zo doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de invoering van de verevening voor leerwegondersteunend onderwijs en praktijkonderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education about regional disparities in the redistribution of lwoo and pro support funding and related pressures in Groningen. The State Secretary answered that lwoo and pro funds will not be equalised, that effects are not yet known, and that no additional measures are planned, while committing to consult schools and cooperation bodies on the distribution.
How the funds will be distributed across the cooperation bodies is not yet known.
Hoe de middelen wel verdeeld kunnen worden over de samenwerkingsverbanden is nu nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat stapeling van diploma’s in het MBO belemmerd worden door verplichte keuzedelen

An SP MP asked whether requiring three elective modules (keuzedelen) in one year for bbl students moving from MBO level 2 to level 3 obstructs diploma stacking, and whether exemptions or a per-year quota could be introduced. The minister answered that the rules apply equally to bbl and bol, that institutions can grant exemptions and set programme structure, that transitional arrangements give enough time, and that she could not yet give enrolment numbers.
I cannot do that at this moment. Not all enrolments for the 2016–2017 school year are known yet.
Dat kan ik op dit moment niet. Nog niet alle inschrijvingen voor het schooljaar 2016–2017 zijn bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat een leerling vanwege haar beperking niet mee op schoolkamp mocht

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether it is acceptable that a pupil with a disability was excluded from a school camp, and what the school and government will do about it. The State Secretary said exclusion is not desirable, declined to judge the individual case, contacted the school, which will look at better support for activities outside class, and pointed to existing anti-discrimination law and the UN disability convention.
Ik heb contact gelegd met de school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten over het ontbreken van het beroep ‘leraar basisonderwijs’ op de kansberoepenlijst van het UWV

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why the profession of primary school teacher is absent from UWV's list of opportunity occupations, despite expected shortages in 2017-2019. The minister answered that teacher shortages are expected mainly in the four big cities, that current job losses and available unemployed teachers mean enough qualified candidates exist, and that UWV will reassess the list twice yearly.
If it turns out that the profession of primary school teacher meets the criteria, it will be included on the list of opportunity occupations.
Indien daarbij blijkt dat het beroep «leraar basisonderwijs» aan de criteria voldoet, zal dit op de lijst met kansberoepen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over audiodescriptie bij film en televisie voor blinden, slechtzienden en meervoudig gehandicapten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about audio description for blind, visually impaired and multiply disabled viewers on public broadcasting and film, and why subtitles are mandatory but audio description is not. The State Secretary answered that the NPO runs a pilot and evaluation, Telefilms and Filmfonds-funded films will get audio description, a decision on further steps awaits the evaluation, and the EU merely encourages such accessibility.
I first want to investigate how this technology is experienced and used and also await the outcome of the NPO evaluation before taking further steps.
Ik wil eerst onderzoeken hoe die techniek ervaren en gebruikt wordt en ook de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van de NPO afwachten alvorens verdere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake het onderzoek '(W)elk kind heeft recht op onderwijs?’

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a study on the right to education for children who are home-schooled, truant or Roma, and about the government's plans for its recommendations. The state secretary answered that the government is intensifying its approach to truancy through a 2020 pact, reviewing exemptions and preparing stricter home-education rules, and will report further on child participation and a possible right to education in later progress reports.
I therefore first want to await the outcome of the study into a 'right to education' before forming a judgment on the usefulness and necessity of codifying such a right.
Ik wil daarom eerst de uitkomst van het onderzoek naar het «leerrecht» afwachten, alvorens ik een oordeel vorm over het nut en de noodzakelijkheid van het vastleggen van een leerrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake het bericht dat bij het inroosteren van examens in Groot-Brittannië rekening wordt gehouden met de Ramadan

An MP asked the state secretary about accommodating Ramadan in exam scheduling, citing UK and Flemish developments and a VU study showing lower exam results during Ramadan. The state secretary replied that the Dutch central exams did not overlap with Ramadan in the first session, that students may reschedule fasting or retake in the second session, and that no additional measures are needed.
In view of the answers to questions 4, 5 and 6, I do not consider additional measures necessary.
Gelet op de antwoorden bij de vragen 4, 5 en 6 acht ik geen aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de toegang van leerlingen met een beperking uit het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs tot de REA topklas in Leiden

An SP MP asked the minister whether it is desirable that vso graduates with vmbo-tl diplomas can no longer enter the REA topklas at ROC Leiden due to cuts, and about the consequences for their schooling, plus questions on passend onderwijs gaps in mbo. The minister answered that support is the responsibility of mbo institutions and regional partners, that no decision has yet been taken on the REA topklas, that no shortfall in funding is seen, and that monitoring of passend onderwijs will continue.
As I already indicated, I find it important that students receive appropriate support to successfully complete a mbo programme.
Zoals ik al aangaf vind ik het belangrijk dat studenten passende ondersteuning krijgen om succesvol een mbo-opleiding af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Volp over het bericht “Zorgen over toename seksueel misbruik op scholen”

MPs Ypma and Volp asked about reports of rising sexual abuse and intimidation in schools, the Inspectorate's handling of such reports, school codes of conduct, and sex education. The government answered that the report figures are not a sustained upward trend, pointed to the Wet veiligheid op school and the duty to report to police, and said the Inspectorate's thematic study on sexuality education will be sent to parliament this summer.
The inspectorate has no data on the number of reports of sexual intimidation made to the police or in how many cases the police started an investigation.
De inspectie heeft geen gegevens van het aantal meldingen van seksuele intimidatie bij de politie of in hoeveel gevallen de politie een onderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Jadnanansing inzake het bericht 'Ongelijkheid op Amsterdamse scholen groeit verder'

MPs Vermue and Jadnanansing asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that inequality and segregation in Amsterdam schools are growing, and whether categorical schooling undermines integration and opportunity. The State Secretary acknowledged the findings, said segregation is largely a societal problem, pointed to municipal agreements, a planned congress and an Onderwijsraad advisory request, and declined to commission new national research.
I see no added value in further research into segregation in education as a standalone phenomenon.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde in verder onderzoek naar segregatie in het onderwijs als een op zichzelf staand verschijnsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Vermue en Jadnanansing inzake het gebrek aan aandacht over seksuele diversiteit in het onderwijs

MPs Yücel, Vermue and Jadnanansing asked why only 25% of surveyed pupils had lessons on sexual diversity despite mandatory core objectives since 2012, and how inspectorate oversight and teacher training address this, also referring to a motion on citizenship education and a Stichting School en Veiligheid report on teacher colleges. The Minister and State Secretary answered that they await the Inspectorate's forthcoming thematic report before taking a position, that no enforcement against schools has occurred, and that the teacher-training competence profile and curriculum reviews are underway, while rejecting the claim that the training approach is merely voluntary.
We therefore first await the outcomes of this thematic study by the inspectorate, in order to then reach a considered position
Wij wachten daarom eerst de uitkomsten van dit themaonderzoek van de inspectie af, om vervolgens tot een afgewogen standpunt te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Lodders inzake de doorstroom van voortgezet speciaal onderwijs naar regulier voortgezet onderwijs

MPs Straus and Lodders asked the state secretary about a havo pupil whose examination results from special secondary education could not be carried over to regular secondary education, and how pupils transfer and are informed. The state secretary answered that results can be transferred if the receiving school has an exemption, that transfer need not cause delay, and that the specific case was resolved by granting such an exemption.
This has already happened. There was contact between the school and the Ministry of OCW to discuss this specific case.
Dit is reeds gebeurd. Er is contact geweest tussen de school en het Ministerie van OCW om deze specifieke casus te bespreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten over het bericht dat de GGD Hart voor Brabant de screening van spraak- en taalontwikkeling van 5-jarigen stop zet

MPs Siderius and Leijten asked whether the GGD Hart voor Brabant stopping logopedic screening of 5-year-olds weakens early detection of speech and language disorders, and what the government will do. The state secretary replied that the GGD has reorganised rather than abandoned the task, that youth health care (JGZ) is responsible under municipal law, and that no intervention or new investigation is planned.
I see no reason to call the GGD Hart voor Brabant and the associated municipalities to order.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de GGD Hart voor Brabant en de bijbehorende gemeenten tot de orde te roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermue over het luiden van de noodklok door scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about secondary schools in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen sounding the alarm over falling pupil numbers, distances and the funding system. The State Secretary answered that school boards are themselves responsible for provision, that the region is not unique, and pointed to existing support instruments and a call for more intensive cooperation, without committing to new funding.
The starting point remains that school boards in a region are themselves responsible for the educational offering and its coordination.
Uitgangspunt daarbij blijft dat schoolbesturen in een regio zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het onderwijsaanbod en de onderlinge afstemming daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de sluiting van het Expertisecentrum Onderwijs Noord-Kennemerland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about the closure of the Expertisecentrum Onderwijs in Noord-Kennemerland, which would move pupils with special needs to regular vmbo schools, and whether every region should keep an OPDC. The State Secretary answered that the samenwerkingsverband is competent to make this policy choice, that support and staff expertise will be secured through redeployment and the TOM rebound facility, and that there is no wave of OPDC closures.
The samenwerkingsverband is also competent to do so.
Het samenwerkingsverband is daartoe ook bevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Bosman inzake samenwerking tussen scholen in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen die worden geconfronteerd met leerlingendaling

Two VVD MPs asked the education state secretary about cooperation between secondary schools in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen facing declining pupil numbers, including whether a full range of school types should be maintained. The state secretary said schools' boards are primarily responsible for provision and coordination, that OCW supports cooperation through a regional process facilitator and earlier advisory support, and that the boards must intensify cooperation.
The starting point is that school boards in the region are themselves responsible for the educational provision and its mutual coordination.
Uitgangspunt daarbij is dat schoolbesturen in de regio zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het onderwijsaanbod en de onderlinge afstemming daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake technische vmbo-scholen die in de knel komen door verschuivingen in de bekostiging

An MP asked the State Secretary whether technical vmbo schools will lose funding as the new profiles and the simplified per-pupil funding are introduced, and whether schools may switch to cheaper programmes. The State Secretary acknowledged the higher costs of vocational education, said start-up costs vary by school and can be covered by reserves, and promised a sample survey of school choices and a consultation with the VO-raad, while leaving the funding design open.
A sample survey is currently being carried out, partly due to concerns from VNO/NCW, to gain more insight into the choices schools intend to make in their profile offerings.
Er wordt op dit moment vanwege de zorgen van onder andere VNO/NCW een steekproef uitgevoerd om meer zicht te krijgen op de keuzes die scholen voornemens zijn te maken in hun aanbod aan profielen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake de stigmatiserende video van Powned over inwoners van de Bijlmer

An MP asked the government whether a PowNed video portraying Bijlmer residents as stigmatised was acceptable, and whether public funding should be reconsidered. The state secretary answered that public broadcasters have editorial autonomy under the Mediawet, the government does not judge individual programmes, and complaints can go to anti-discrimination bodies or the courts, while an NPO-wide ombudsman is being pursued.
It is not for the government to pass judgement on the media offering of public media institutions.
Het is niet aan de overheid om een oordeel uit te spreken over het media-aanbod van de publieke media-instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de diagnose en behandeling van dyscalculie bij kinderen op de basisschool

An MP asked why dyslexia diagnosis and treatment for primary school children fall under the Youth Act while dyscalculia does not, and whether dyscalculia care should get the same status. The government answered that this was a deliberate choice, since only severe isolated dyslexia had been in the basic health insurance package based on a CVZ assessment, and no comparable justification exists for dyscalculia, while schools must provide support regardless of diagnosis.
Yes, this was a deliberate choice.
Ja, dit is een bewuste keuze geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins inzake het bericht 'Techniek in de knel door verandering binnen onderwijs'

MP Bruins asked the State Secretary whether the move to broader vmbo profiles and simplified funding would cut technical vmbo education, and whether schools can keep technical equipment up to date. The State Secretary answers that funding for technical education stays at the same level, that schools can use reserves for one-off costs, a sample survey is underway, and a consultation with school boards is planned, though full substantive answers on guaranteed funding and a higher per-pupil amount are deferred.

I am therefore organising a consultation round with school boards, in which I, in cooperation with the VO-raad, will discuss with boards and school leaders the questions that exist about the planned simplification.

Ik organiseer daarom een consultatieronde met besturen, waarin ik, in samenwerking met de VO-raad, in gesprek treed met besturen en schoolleiders over de vragen die bestaan over de voorgenomen vereenvoudiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake techniekopleidingen in het nieuwe vmbo

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether vocational (vmbo) schools will offer fewer specialised technical programmes because of higher costs, as VNO-NCW feared. The State Secretary replied that vmbo schools receive higher funding per student, that transition costs can be covered from reserves, that regional planning should preserve a broad offering, and that a sample survey of schools' profile choices would be carried out with results expected in May.
A sample survey is currently being carried out, partly due to concerns from VNO/NCW, to gain more insight into the choices schools intend to make in their offering of profiles.
Er wordt op dit moment vanwege de zorgen van onder andere VNO/NCW een steekproef uitgevoerd om meer zicht te krijgen op de keuzes die scholen voornemens zijn te maken in hun aanbod aan profielen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de problemen in de uitbesteding van leerlingen door scholen voor het voortgezet onderwijs (vo-scholen) aan het voortgezet algemeen volwassen onderwijs

MP Siderius asked the minister about vo schools refusing to outsource pupils to adult secondary education (vavo) based on grade thresholds or age, and about related problems with vmbo-havo transfer rules. The minister answered that outsourcing is not an enforceable right, that vo schools remain primarily responsible for minors, and that no statutory change to the transfer code is currently planned, with monitoring results to follow later.
Outsourcing a vo pupil to a vavo institution is not a right a pupil can invoke at all times.
Het uitbesteden van een vo-leerling aan een vavo-instelling is geen recht waarop een leerling zich te allen tijde kan beroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Leijten inzake ouders die zich door scholen onder druk gezet voelen om hun kind te medicaliseren tegen ADHD

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries whether schools pressure parents to medicate children for ADHD without diagnosis, and whether funding cuts, class sizes, waiting lists and costs drive medicalisation. The government answers that schools cannot prescribe medication, that a plan of action against medicalisation is underway with expert meetings planned for autumn 2016, that prescriptions fell in 2015, and that several questions are for further research or the next progress report.
Schools cannot prescribe medication; this is reserved for care professionals.
Scholen kunnen geen medicatie voorschrijven, dit is voorbehouden aan zorgprofessionals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de verplichte ouderbijdrage voor onderwijs aan hoogbegaafden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether mandatory parental contributions of about €1,145 to €1,200 for Leonardo education for gifted pupils are acceptable, and how this fits with inclusive education and the excellence programme. The State Secretary answered that education for gifted pupils should be free and accessible, that schools and support partnerships must provide suitable provision, and that the Plan van Aanpak Toptalenten requires no parental contribution, but did not address the number of schools or costs and gave no commitment to ban the contribution by law.
I am of the view that education for gifted pupils, like for other pupils, must be freely accessible and free of charge.
Ik ben van mening dat het onderwijs voor hoogbegaafde leerlingen net als voor andere leerlingen vrij toegankelijk en kosteloos moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de subsidie aan Ouders & Onderwijs en het salaris van de directeur

An MP asked the State Secretary about the EUR 1.15 million subsidy to Ouders & Onderwijs, the director's salary, unspent funds, reserves and the foundation's form, transparency and representation of parents. The State Secretary answered that the hourly rates and salary fall within rijksbrede norms and the WNT maximum, that financial reporting for 2015 is not yet received, and that the structure will be evaluated in 2017.
I am willing to do so. However, I have not yet received the financial accountability for the year 2015.
Daar ben ik toe bereid. De financiële verantwoording over het jaar 2015 heb ik echter nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Straus inzake scholen die ouders onder druk zetten om hun kind ADHD-medicatie te geven

Two VVD MPs asked whether schools pressure parents to medicate children with ADHD medication or be transferred to special education, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary says schools may not give medical advice, must meet their duty of care under the Passend Onderwijs law, and that no inspection investigation was opened due to few complaints, while a joint action plan on ADHD care is being pursued.
Parents may not be forced by schools to give medication to their child.
Ouders mogen door scholen niet gedwongen worden om medicatie aan hun kind te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake uitgaven door de KRO

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about KRO broadcaster spending of association funds on year-end projects, chocolates, cars, a project manager and a website. The State Secretary answered that the spending concerns association money rather than public media funds, that the Commissariaat voor de Media finds no reason to act, and that no further tightening of supervision is needed.
The Commissariaat judges that this has been the case here.
Het Commissariaat oordeelt dat zulks hier het geval is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Jadnanansing inzake examentraining die scholieren extern (moeten) inkopen

MPs Vermue and Jadnanansing asked whether schools should fund exam preparation themselves rather than having pupils buy external training, and whether a discount on exam training via the cultuurkaart encourages schools to outsource it. The State Secretary replied that schools are responsible for exam preparation from their own budget, pupils may freely buy extra external training, and no change is planned.
It is the responsibility of schools to properly prepare exam candidates for the examinations.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van scholen om eindexamenkandidaten goed voor te bereiden op de examens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake de aflevering 'Eindexamens' over het uitsluiten van leerlingen door wurgcontracten van De Monitor

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Education about schools forcing pupils to sign 'wurgcontracten' that exclude them from final exams, and whether repeat offenders would be sanctioned and pupils informed. The state secretary answered that no repeat offenders are known, that the inspectorate would impose sanctions if they occurred, and that information is provided via LAKS and the inspectorate, with no extra measures planned.
As soon as a report comes in to LAKS or the inspectorate of such a contract, LAKS or the inspectorate addresses the school concerned.
Zodra er een melding komt bij LAKS of bij de inspectie van een dergelijk contract, spreekt LAKS of de inspectie de betreffende school aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake het bericht 'Brandbrief met brede steun voor 't Klaverblad'

An MP asked the state secretary whether the discretionary power to keep small primary schools open could be used for OBS 't Klaverblad, a satellite branch whose pupil numbers are growing, and why the power does not apply to satellite branches. The state secretary answered that the discretionary power covers only independent schools, that satellite branches already have a three-year window under existing law, and that funding for the branch will end from 2016–2017 with pupils having to transfer.
A discretionary power does not exist for satellite branches.
Een discretionaire bevoegdheid bestaat niet voor nevenvestigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Vermue over het uitblijven van meervoudige schooladviezen

MPs Ypma and Vermue asked the State Secretary of Education about schools giving only single school recommendations instead of multiple ones, how many such placement guides exist, complaint numbers, and what will be done. The State Secretary answered that such practices are undesirable, that an evaluation will map placement guides and results come in May, that complaints were received, and that a letter will be sent to schools after the 2016 test results.
Placement guides that steer towards issuing only single recommendations are, in my view, undesirable.
Plaatsingswijzers die aansturen op het afgeven van alleen enkelvoudige adviezen, vind ik ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake het omruilen van christelijke voor islamitische feestdagen

MP Straus asked the State Secretary whether schools may swap Christian holidays for Islamic ones, and how schools should promote Dutch traditions, values and national holidays, including whether teachers are equipped to discuss sensitive topics. The State Secretary replied that only non-officially recognised days may be swapped, that civic education already covers national values and holidays, that teachers mostly feel equipped with support from School en Veiligheid, and that overlap with sector organisations PO-Raad and VO-raad already exists.
Swapping a generally recognised public holiday for an Islamic holiday is not at issue.
Het inruilen van een algemeen erkende feestdag voor een islamitische feestdag is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Volp over het onderzoek van de Rutgers Stichting dat kinderen te weinig les krijgen over verliefdheid, relaties en puberteit

MPs Ypma and Volp asked the State Secretary for Education about a Rutgers Foundation study finding that children receive too little lessons on crushes, relationships, sexual boundaries, diversity and puberty, and whether schools should be pressed to address these topics more. The State Secretary answered that parents play the main role, that these topics are already in the core objectives, and that he will await the Inspectorate's thematic report due this summer before taking a considered position on the matter.
I am therefore first awaiting the outcomes of this thematic study by the Inspectorate of Education, in order to then arrive at a considered position
Ik wacht daarom eerst de uitkomsten van dit themaonderzoek van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs af, om vervolgens tot een afgewogen standpunt te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ypma over het rapport ‘Wachten op je toekomst’ over asielkinderen in de noodopvang

MPs Kuiken and Ypma asked the state secretaries about the Children's Ombudsman report on asylum children in emergency shelters, including living conditions, forced relocations, access to mental health care, school continuity and support for schools. The government replied that conditions are acceptable given the high pressure on reception, that relocations cannot be fully avoided, that the IGZ is examining health care for foreigners, and that OCW will report later on school registration and school-attendance figures.
I believe the number of relocations of families with children and unaccompanied children should be kept as limited as possible.
Ik vind dat het aantal verhuisbewegingen van gezinnen met kinderen en alleenstaande kinderen zo beperkt mogelijk zou moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de prestatiedruk bij kleuters

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether pressure on kindergarten children and the use of prescribed kleutermethodes is harmful, and whether teachers' expertise is being undermined. The State Secretary answered that the signals do not warrant new action, that schools choose their own methods, and that the inspectorate's communication on the matter is being improved.
I see no reason to take measures on this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hier maatregelen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over prestatiedruk in het kleuteronderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary about performance pressure, mandatory methods and tests in kindergarten education, after a TV report on teachers quitting. The state secretary denied seeing excessive pressure on young children, stated schools are free to choose their methods, and described communication and regulatory-burden measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Martin Bosma en Helder over het weglaten van cruciale informatie in het programma Opsporing Verzocht

PVV MPs asked why the Opsporing Verzocht broadcast omitted that a robbery victim couple was attacked with antisemitic motives and that the victim named Moroccan perpetrators, and whether NPO coverage is driven by political correctness. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed, that the broadcast is an official investigative tool controlled by the prosecution service (OM) rather than the NPO, and that only verified information directly relevant to identifying suspects was included.
The criminal investigation covers all aspects of the offence. As this is an ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information on its content.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek richt zich op alle aspecten van het strafbare feit. Aangezien het een lopend onderzoek betreft kan ik over de inhoud van het onderzoek geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het inzetten van de subsidieregeling praktijkleren voor de meest kwetsbare leerlingen

An MP asks why the practical-learning subsidy scheme excludes pupils in vso and praktijkonderwijs, whether it should be extended to them, and why pro pupils are not automatically in the disability employment register. The Minister confirms the exclusion, says she is willing to examine extending the scheme to vso, pro and vmbo entry programmes, and explains that pro pupils generally have better job prospects so they are not automatically registered.
I am therefore willing to examine whether it is desirable to extend the scheme to other groups.
Ik ben daarom bereid te onderzoeken of het wenselijk is de regeling uit te breiden naar andere groepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het weigeren van leerlingen bij een mytylschool vanwege het passend onderwijs

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about a Haarlem special school refusing pupils due to bureaucracy under passend onderwijs, and about administrative burden at regional partnerships. The State Secretary answers that refusing pupils would breach the duty of care, that the Inspectorate found no refusals, and that a national form is not desired, while announcing measures to reduce bureaucracy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over extreem hoog percentage afwijzingen islamitische middelbare scholen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education why only two of thirty applications for Islamic secondary schools were approved, and whether the criteria allow discretion. The State Secretary replied that applications are assessed only against the objective statutory founding norm with no discretion, and announced a bill (Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen) to change the start procedure, with housing decisions left to municipalities.
I aim to submit the bill to the House of Representatives in early 2017, after completing all formal steps including advice from the Education Council and Council of State.
Ik streef ernaar om het wetsvoorstel, na het doorlopen van alle formele stappen, waaronder advisering door de Onderwijsraad en Raad van State, begin 2017 aan de Tweede Kamer te kunnen aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Jacobi over de handhaving van cao’s

MPs Yücel and Jacobi asked whether all childcare and early-education staff should be paid under the Peuterspeelzaalwerk collective agreement, whether the government monitors salary developments during municipal harmonisation, and what tools it has to enforce collective agreements. The minister answered that several collective agreements apply, that salary agreements are for social partners, and that the Inspectie SZW can investigate enforcement only at the request of social partners, with compliance being primarily their responsibility.
It is up to social partners to make agreements on salaries in the harmonisation of child care facilities.
Het is aan sociale partners om afspraken te maken over de salarissen bij de harmonisatie van de kindvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Wolbert inzake de gevolgen van de afschaffing van leerlinggebonden financiering en de positie van logopedisten in de eerste lijn

MPs Ypma and Wolbert asked whether speech therapy in primary care is only reimbursed for activities performed in the patient's presence, whether unpaid coordination work is a problem, and what insurers' role is. The Secretary of State answered that telespeech therapy can be billed under the NZa tariff, that contact with other professionals is covered by existing tariffs, that inequality cannot be concluded, and that insurers have a duty to purchase quality care without signals of non-compliance.
No, a care provider can also bill for a speech therapy treatment that takes place without the patient being directly present.
Nee, een zorgaanbieder kan een logopedische behandeling ook in rekening brengen wanneer deze plaatsvindt zonder directe aanwezigheid van de patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake fraude bij de tussentijdse Cito-toetsen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education about repeated cheating with Cito interim tests, including a school location director who had students redo wrong questions to inflate results, and about tests still sold on Marktplaats. The State Secretary condemns the cheating, notes the school suspended the director and the Inspectorate was informed, says Cito sends letters and pursues illegal copies, and states the government will monitor implementation through a multi-year evaluation.
I see it as the government's responsibility to closely monitor how the implementation of the renewed legislation proceeds.
Ik zie het als verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid om goed te volgen hoe uitvoering van de vernieuwde wetgeving loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Jasper van Dijk inzake de marketingactiviteiten van scholen

MPs Siderius and Jasper van Dijk asked whether schools should hire marketing agencies and compete for pupils, and how much education funding goes to such activities. The State Secretary answered that transparency about schools is welcome, that no national data on marketing spending exists and no investigation is planned, and that regular funding is sufficient for the core teaching process.
Such an overview cannot be provided because this kind of information is not available at national level.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven aangezien dit soort informatie niet op landelijk niveau voorhanden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake het laten herkansen van toetsen uit het leerlingvolgsysteem in het basisonderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a primary school leader let pupils retake LVS monitoring tests, and about the resulting perverse incentives in test culture. The State Secretary acknowledged the case, said no other signals exist and the inspectorate no longer attaches judgments to interim test results, so no further research is planned.
As indicated in question 1, the inspectorate no longer attaches a judgment to the interim results.
Zoals aangegeven in vraag 1 verbindt de inspectie nu geen oordeel meer aan de tussenresultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake een boete voor de Leidse 'plasticjager'

An MP asked whether the state secretary would allow more flexibility in the compulsory education law for children travelling abroad with parents, given a fine imposed on a Leiden 'plastic hunter' family. The state secretary answered that a bill will allow up to six months of distance learning per level under strict conditions, but that until then current rules apply and truancy officers cannot yet act in the spirit of the new flexibility.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Siderius en Gesthuizen inzake de problemen rond de huisvesting van de Internationale Schakelklas (ISK)

MPs Siderius and Gesthuizen asked the state secretaries about problems finding adequate school housing for asylum-seeker children in the International Transition Class, and about funding and a possible national contribution. The government answered that municipalities are responsible for school housing, acknowledged difficulties in some cases, said a national scheme for secondary education is being explored, and is in talks with affected municipalities and school boards.

For secondary education, the possibility is being examined of quickly designing a scheme, modelled on the OHBA scheme for primary education with standard amounts, that addresses school housing problems in municipalities.
Voor het voortgezet onderwijs wordt de mogelijkheid onderzocht om op korte termijn een regeling te ontwerpen, die naar analogie aan de OHBA-regeling voor het primair onderwijs met normbedragen werkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake scholen die geld oppotten

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the education minister and state secretary about schools hoarding funds from the National Education Accord and Autumn Agreement, including whether a 3,000 young teachers target was met, and about lump-sum funding, university property risks and related motions. The government answered that schools received 891 million euro extra, with 406 million spent in 2013-2014, that employment targets are being verified via data due in 2016, and that inspectorate reports on university property will follow.
School boards were not asked to account for how the extra funds under the National Education Accord were spent.
Schoolbesturen zijn niet gevraagd om zich te verantwoorden over de besteding van de extra middelen in het kader van het Nationaal Onderwijsakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake overgangscontracten in het voortgezet onderwijs en het uitsluiten van leerlingen van deelname aan het eindexamen

An MP asked the state secretary about school 'transition contracts' that exclude pupils from the final exam, and whether schools may impose conditions on advancement and exam participation. The state secretary answered that such conditional admission to the final year is forbidden, that LAKS and the inspectorate handled reported cases (most contracts withdrawn, excluded pupils readmitted), that a funding sanction is possible but has not been applied in these cases, and promised clarification in the school newsletter.
Schools are prohibited from promoting pupils conditionally to the examination year.
Het is scholen verboden om leerlingen voorwaardelijk over te laten gaan naar het examenjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de benoeming van de voorzitter van Raad van Toezicht van de NPO

MP Bruins asked whether the new NPO supervisory board chair's role as chair of the UWV executive board was considered and whether it complies with Mediawet incompatibility rules, and whether the appointment fits the profile. The State Secretary answered that the role was considered, that a statutory incompatibility does not apply to independent administrative bodies, and that the appointment follows the advisory committee's nominations and the profile.
I will shortly explore how the role of the Minister in this can be limited.
Ik ga op korte termijn verkennen hoe de rol van de Minister daarin kan worden beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Pieter Heerma, Verhoeven, Jasper van Dijk, Thieme en Kuzu over de behandeling van de Mediawet in de Eerste Kamer

MPs asked the State Secretary about appointments to the supervisory boards of the NOS and NTR and the NPO, including alleged political favouritism and whether a board chair's position at UWV made the appointment incompatible with the Mediawet. The State Secretary denied any legal incompatibility, said the NPO appointment followed an independent advisory committee, and refused to reverse it.
I regret the impression that has arisen and do not consider it consistent with the actual course of events.
Ik betreur het beeld dat is ontstaan en vind dat ook niet in overeenstemming met de feitelijke gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake functioneel analfabetisme op het vmbo

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about claims that 14 percent of vmbo pupils are functionally illiterate and whether the Dutch curriculum must be overhauled. The State Secretary answers that most vmbo pupils reach reference level 2F, that remaining gaps are addressed through targeted pathways and the Onderwijs2032 curriculum renewal, and that results will be reported annually.
In the Examenmonitor VO and the progress report on language and arithmetic, your House receives annual information on results for the Dutch subject in secondary, primary and vocational education.
In de Examenmonitor VO en de voortgangsrapportage taal en rekenen ontvangt uw Kamer jaarlijks informatie over de resultaten voor het vak Nederlands in het VO, respectievelijk PO, VO en MBO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht betreffende het aanbestedingscircus bij het leerlingenvervoer

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Education about the tendering of school transport, including price-versus-quality concerns, reduced travel times, cost trends, privacy breaches from publishing pupil data on TenderNed, and calls for a national base rate. The State Secretary replies that responsibility lies with municipalities within legal frameworks, admits the privacy publication was wrong and had the data removed, but rejects a national tariff and new measures.
I deeply regret this. Publishing such privacy-sensitive information is absolutely unacceptable.
Ik betreur dit ten zeerste. Het publiceren van dergelijke privacygevoelige informatie kan absoluut niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Kuiken over de berichten dat veel vluchtelingenkinderen nog steeds geen onderwijs ontvangen

MPs Ypma and Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that many refugee children still receive no schooling, including unclear demand data, trauma support, NT2 teacher shortages and communication on funding. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, explained the three-month reception norm, promised data linkage with the Justice ministry, and outlined measures such as accountmanagers, teacher retraining and a progress report before summer 2016.
I have committed to informing you by 1 April 2016 about the number of asylum-seeker youths in school in the Netherlands.
Ik heb u toegezegd om u voor 1 april 2016 te informeren over het aantal asielzoekersjongeren op school in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de 39 aanhoudingen tijdens een PEGIDA demonstratie

An MP asks the Justice Minister about 39 arrests at a PEGIDA demonstration in Rotterdam, including the alleged violent arrest and denial of medical help and delayed lawyer access of a journalist, and about press freedom. The minister declines to comment on the individual case while a police complaints investigation (BVIK) is ongoing, describes the standard procedure for lawyer access, and says other journalist cases are not known to him.
During this investigation I cannot make a statement on the content of this case.
Gedurende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitspraak doen over de inhoud van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake de penibele situatie waarin onderwijsinstelling Kikidio als aanbieder van onderwijs voor hoogbegaafde kinderen, verkeert

MP Ypma asked the State Secretary for Education about the financial distress of Kikidio, a small school for gifted children, and how this relates to a parliamentary motion on funding bespoke solutions. The State Secretary answered that Kikidio is a small initiative whose students meet compulsory schooling rules, that a legal change would be needed to fund such schools in exceptional cases, and that a meeting with regional school partnerships is planned.

In the letter on education at another location, I announced that I want to make it legally possible that, in extreme cases, when the partnership cannot itself provide a suitable offer, funding for an offer at small-scale initiatives is permitted.

In de brief over onderwijs op een andere locatie heb ik aangekondigd het wettelijk mogelijk te willen maken dat in uiterste gevallen, als het samenwerkingsverband niet zelf in een passend aanbod kan voorzien, de bekostiging van een aanbod op kleinschalige initiatieven toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius, Rog en Van Meenen inzake de sluiting van het doveninternaat in Haren

MPs Siderius, Rog and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about closing the boarding school for deaf pupils in Haren, arguing it would destroy capital and expertise and that clustered classes are not a realistic alternative. The state secretary replied that alternatives in regular education are being explored with the VO-raad and Siméa, that boarding costs were never structurally funded and will be phased out for new pupils from August 2017, and that the Guyotschool need not close.
The boarding school is not needed if appropriate education can be offered nearby for these pupils within regular or special secondary education.
Het internaat is niet nodig, als er thuisnabij ook voor deze leerlingen binnen het regulier of binnen het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs passend onderwijs kan worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake wijzigingen in de toegestane hulpmiddelen bij de centrale examens VO in 2016

An MP asks the State Secretary why spell-checker use was removed for pupils with dyslexia during the 2016 central exam year, and whether this is consistent with earlier guidance and equal treatment law. The State Secretary says the independent exam body CvTE made the decision for equal exam conditions, that he has asked CvTE to reconsider for pupils with spelling disabilities, but that he has no power to reverse the decision himself.
Since this concerns a statutory task of the CvTE as an independent administrative body, I cannot intervene in this decision.
Aangezien het hier een wettelijke taak van het CvTE als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan betreft kan ik niet in dit besluit treden.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Siderius inzake kleine klassen in het basisonderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary to provide the group-size charts from a letter on primary school class sizes in tabular form. The government answered yes and supplied tables for the average group size and the distributions of group sizes and schools.
Question 1: Can you send the graphs from the letter on group size in primary education (figures 1, 2 and 3) to the House in table form?
Vraag 1 Kunt u de grafieken uit de brief over groepsgrootte in het basisonderwijs (figuur 1, 2 en 3) in tabelvorm aan de Kamer doen toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over het online platform voor 'vluchtelingen' dat de publieke omroep wil beginnen

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about a proposed public broadcaster online platform for refugees, including its cost, legal basis under the Mediawet, whether it would give migrants tips to get through the asylum procedure, and whether the minister would stop it and guarantee no subsidies. The state secretary answered that the platform would be an experimental channel of about 320,000 euros per year, justified under article 2.1 of the Mediawet, that no tips were known to be planned, that no prior approval is needed but the broadcaster must explain its fit with the public mission, and that funding comes mainly from the participating broadcasters' own resources.
No prior permission is needed to start an experimental distribution channel, but the public broadcaster must explain how this channel fits within the public media mission.
Voor het starten van een experimenteel aanbodkanaal is geen toestemming vooraf nodig, maar moet de publieke omroep wel uitleggen hoe dit kanaal past binnen de publieke mediaopdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake de nieuwe eindtermen van het economieonderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about disagreement over macroeconomics specifications in the new economics exam syllabus, the progress of implementation, and whether the reform is necessary. The state secretary said the content dispute is not for the government to judge, that the domain H and I specifications are settled for the 2017 central exam, and that the CvTE is working on implementation.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on this type of substantive disagreement.
Het ligt niet in de rede dat ik me uitlaat over dit type inhoudelijke meningsverschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk inzake het bericht dat een presentatrice is gediscrimineerd bij RTL Nieuws

Deputies Kuzu and Öztürk asked about reports that a RTL Nieuws presenter was discriminated against, and about diversity and representativeness in Dutch media and the public broadcaster NPO. The Secretary of State said RTL denies discrimination, that media diversity is ultimately the responsibility of broadcasters, that data limits exist due to privacy rules, and that he will urge media organisations and the NPO to improve diversity without committing to binding action.
It is unacceptable if someone is treated differently on the basis of their skin colour than another person.
Het is onacceptabel als iemand op basis van zijn/haar huidskleur op een andere manier wordt behandeld dan een ander persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over een docent die structureel wordt overbelast door het schoolbestuur

MPs Van Dijk and Siderius asked the State Secretary of Education about a teacher allegedly overloaded by her school board, including whether the board blocked her email and placed her on non-active status for discussing workload with colleagues. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case because it is before the courts, and gave general answers on workload, the collective agreement and national policy.
For the answers to questions 3 to 5, 7 and 9, I cannot go into this individual case because it is before the courts.
Voor het antwoord op de vragen 3 tot en met 5 en 7 en 9 geldt dat ik niet kan ingaan op dit individuele geval, omdat deze zaak onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de hoge werkdruk in het basisonderwijs

An SP MP asks the state secretary for education about high workload in primary schools, teachers' burnout and 'survival mode', the effects of accountability and inspection, measurability of results, 'phantom rules', and the impact of passend onderwijs. The state secretary acknowledges the concern, points to the Nationaal Onderwijs Akkoord, a regeldruk agenda and a registration complaints desk, and rejects the claim that policy has fostered distrust, while stating that workload has multiple causes and needs school-level solutions.
High workload can lead to more sick leave, a greater chance of burn-out complaints and less job satisfaction.
Een hoge werkdruk kan leiden tot meer ziekteverzuim, een grotere kans op burn-out klachten en minder werkplezier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de bovenwettelijke ouderbijdragen van de Groningse Schoolvereniging

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about voluntary parental contributions at a Groningen school association, including whether schools may withhold information about parents' rights, whether the contribution can be split by use, and whether internationally oriented education can be charged extra. The State Secretary answered that schools must state the voluntary nature of contributions, that parental consent via the works council is required, that the Inspectorate can enforce, and that no separation of pupils by ability to pay is allowed.
The Inspectorate will examine the cited case further.
De inspectie zal de genoemde casus nader bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake arme scholen die online campagnes organiseren om geld in te zamelen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether it is acceptable that schools must raise money through crowdfunding for basics like playground renovation and tablets, and whether this creates inequality between schools. The State Secretary answered that regular government funding is sufficient for statutory tasks, that schools may seek extra funding such as crowdfunding under a sponsorship covenant, and that no inequality arises.
The government is responsible for the regular funding that enables schools to provide good quality education and meet their statutory obligations.
De overheid is verantwoordelijk voor de reguliere bekostiging waarmee scholen in staat worden om kwalitatief goed onderwijs te geven en aan hun wettelijke verplichtingen te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins inzake de benoeming van de voorzitter van de Raad van Toezicht van de NPO

An MP asked whether the newly appointed chair of the NPO supervisory board creates an appearance of political partisanship, and how the appointment procedure safeguarded independence. The Secretary of State defended the open, externally run procedure and independent advisory committee, but agreed the appearance of partisanship should be avoided and promised a review of appointment procedures across public media bodies.
I will carry out a serious review of the appointment procedures in the media sector in which the Minister is involved.
Ik zal daarvoor een serieuze verkenning doen naar de procedures voor benoemingen in de mediasector waarbij de Minister betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut inzake de sluiting van leerwerkbedrijven

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked why the Werkartaal social-firm training provider for vulnerable youth and others is closing, whether the Participatiewet cuts are harming vulnerable groups, and what the government will do to preserve such pathways. The minister answers that the closure stems from lack of participants and falling employer demand, that the government cannot support individual private work-learning companies, and that gemeenten and other providers can take over.
The Ministry of OCW therefore cannot take measures to support an individual work-learning company that is in financial distress.
Het Ministerie van OCW kan dan ook geen maatregelen nemen om een individueel leerwerkbedrijf dat in financiële nood verkeert te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma inzake NPO-voorzitter Hagoort en diens intentie de politiek te beïnvloeden

An MP asked whether NPO chair Hagoort's remarks about influencing public opinion and politics breach the Mediawet, and whether he should resign. The State Secretary replied that the remarks were about public opinion rather than politics, that the NPO must reflect diversity and balance, and that there is no state broadcaster with prescribed opinions; he rejected calls for Hagoort's removal.

It is the task of the public broadcaster to reflect the diversity of convictions, opinions and interests and to report on what is happening in the world in a balanced and journalistically responsible way.

Het is de taak van de publieke omroep om de diversiteit aan overtuigingen, meningen en interesses te weerspiegelen en op evenwichtige en journalistiek verantwoorde wijze te berichten over wat er speelt in de wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Straus inzake het niet verlenen van een ontheffing aan Nederlandse kinderen woonachtig in Duitsland die onderwijs in Nederland willen volgen

MP Straus asked whether Germany's North Rhine-Westphalia state refusing exemptions from compulsory schooling for Dutch-national children living in Germany who want to attend school in the Netherlands is contrary to EU free movement and whether other border regions are affected. The Secretary of State answered that the exemption was granted after all in one case, that the state government confirmed no policy change, that he will ask the German counterpart to address the local authority, and that the requested follow-up information took longer but the answers are sent.
I will ask my NRW counterpart to consult with the local authority concerned, to prevent recurrence.
Ik zal mijn collega van NRW vragen in overleg te treden met de betrokken lokale autoriteit, om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake docent die niet mag bidden op school

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about a teacher reportedly barred from praying during breaks at a Rijswijk school, and whether this breaches religious freedom and equal treatment law. The state secretary declines to judge the facts or the legal question, saying the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or a court should decide, and announces no new measures.
Giving a legal judgment on this matter is reserved for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or the court, not for the cabinet or the House of Representatives.
Het geven van een juridisch oordeel over deze zaak is voorbehouden aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens of de rechter, niet aan het kabinet of de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake tegenstrijdige berichten over de 'Class for the Gifted' van het Aloysius College

The MP Siderius asked the State Secretary of Education about contradictory reports on whether the Aloysius College's Class for the Gifted for grade 7 and 8 pupils would continue, and what measures would keep it. The State Secretary replied that Zandvliet College intended a programme but attracted too few pupils, that a new Zandvliet offer starting April 2016 is separate from the Aloysius programme, that a gap arose, and that the interim board committed to restoring an offer from January 2016.
Therefore he has promised me to do everything possible to have an offer again from January 2016 for the gifted pupils of grades 7 and 8 of primary education.
Daarom heeft hij mij toegezegd alles in het werk te stellen om vanaf januari 2016 weer een aanbod te hebben voor de hoogbegaafde leerlingen van groep 7 en 8 basisonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Mohandis over DaMu scholieren naar aanleiding van de uitzending "Alles voor je kind"

MPs Duisenberg and Mohandis asked the State Secretary about travel costs for DaMu dance and music pupils and whether existing schemes or funds could cover them. The State Secretary said no government scheme exists, estimated the cost of a student travel pass at about 600,000 euros, and announced from school year 2016/2017 an exceptional travel-cost contribution run by the Stichting DaMu.
After consultation with the Stichting DaMu, I have decided to provide, from school year 2016/2017 and in exceptional cases, a contribution towards travel costs for DaMu pupils.
Na overleg met de Stichting DaMu heb ik besloten om met ingang van schooljaar 2016/2017 in uitzonderlijke gevallen te voorzien in een tegemoetkoming van reiskosten voor DaMu-leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing inzake de brede brugklas en het uitstellen van selectie in het voortgezet onderwijs

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about a report finding that children of low-educated parents are steered to lower school tracks than peers with equal results, and about the value of broad first-year classes and delayed selection in secondary education. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, defended the shift to a later end-of-primary test with a school advice as the leading factor, and promised advisory research and measures to support broad first-year classes.
I will inform the House before 1 March 2016 about the measures I am taking.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor 1 maart 2016 informeren over de maatregelen die ik neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over het bericht dat coffeeshops in verzet komen tegen de komst van scholen in de buurt

Two MPs asked the Justice and Education ministers about coffeeshops opposing nearby schools, including Amsterdam's refusal of a school location due to a nearby coffeeshop and whether closures or hour limits should follow. The minister answered that distance criteria and school housing are local matters, no overlap with him occurred, and gave no commitment to new action.
Because the location of coffeeshops near schools are local matters, no consultation has taken place with me about the cases mentioned.
Omdat de vestiging van coffeeshops in de buurt van scholen lokale aangelegenheden zijn, heeft er geen overleg met mij plaatsgevonden over genoemde casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de problemen bij de overname van de afdeling Gifted Education van het Aloysius College door het Zandvliet College en het Rijswijks Lyceum
