An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about problems placing the gifted-education pupils of the closing Aloysius College in other Hague schools, including whether Zandvliet College can accommodate them and whether a transfer plan exists. The State Secretary answered that about 90 percent of pupils, including gifted pupils, were placed at their first-choice school, that schools must offer suitable education, and that he sees no need for extra funding for a new school.
I consider this a positive result.
Ik beschouw dit als een positief resultaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over het opzeggen van de FM-vergunning door Open Rotterdam

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked whether Open Rotterdam's decision to stop radio broadcasting, leaving the FM frequency unused, could be remedied before 2018 by letting another broadcaster use it. The minister confirmed that under the Mediawet only one local public broadcaster per municipality may be designated and that the frequency is reserved for Open Rotterdam, so reallocation to others is not possible, though a third party could broadcast on Open Rotterdam's frequency in agreement with it and the municipality.
An FM licence for local public broadcasting is only granted to the local public media institution designated by the Commissariaat voor de Media for that municipality.
Een FM-vergunning voor lokale publieke omroep wordt slechts verleend aan de lokale publieke media-instelling die door het Commissariaat voor de Media voor deze gemeente is aangewezen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma inzake de kritiek van de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid op de inhoud van het programma Pauw

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Media whether the Minister of Social Affairs may criticise the content of a talk show (Pauw) and whether this undermines cabinet unity, and accused the public broadcaster of left-wing bias. The state secretary answered that the minister's remark was within bounds because broadcasters have editorial autonomy under the Mediawet, and that the government will not judge editorial choices.

There can be no misunderstanding on that last point: the Mediawet explicitly provides that broadcasting organisations themselves determine the form and content of their media offering and are responsible for it.
Over dat laatste kan geen misverstand bestaan: de Mediawet bepaalt nadrukkelijk dat de omroepinstellingen zelf de vorm en inhoud van hun media-aanbod bepalen en daar verantwoordelijk voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Straus over de vervangersproblematiek

MPs Mulder and Straus asked whether the minister knew of a Catholic primary school foundation's letter to parents saying children might be sent home because substitute teachers can now only be engaged three times for a half-day under the new law, and what the government would do. The minister says sending children home is undesirable, notes the sector's cao runs until 1 July 2016 so current rules still apply, and says the substitute problem will be addressed in cao negotiations.
That is why collective labour agreement parties can make agreements deviating from the law, both for on-call contracts (zero-hours or min/max contracts) and for temporary contracts.
Daarom kunnen cao-partijen van de wet afwijkende afspraken maken, zowel als het gaat om oproepcontracten (nuluren- of min/max contracten) als om tijdelijke contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over problemen met de bekostiging van het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs aan leerlingen ouder dan 18 jaar

Siderius (SP) asked whether it is acceptable that severely learning-disabled pupils in special secondary education lose schooling after age 18 due to funding problems under passend onderwijs, and how the government will guarantee schooling until age 20 as the WEC allows. The State Secretary replied that schools remain funded for every enrolled pupil regardless of age, that the decision to stay or leave is individual and made with parents, and that the inspectorate can act against unlawful expulsions, though no specific study is planned and the motion Ypma guarantee is said to be already met by existing law.
If schools wrongly remove pupils after eighteen and thereby evade their duty of care, the inspectorate can act against this.
Indien scholen onterecht leerlingen na achttien jaar verwijderen en daardoor zich aan hun zorgplicht onttrekken kan de inspectie daar tegen optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake verplichte overblijfkosten op scholen met een continurooster

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether schools with a continuous timetable are transparent that lunch-supervision costs are voluntary, whether such costs may be made compulsory, and whether the voluntary parental contribution should be capped. The State Secretary answered that schools must state the voluntary nature of contributions in their school guides (94 percent reportedly do), that compulsory lunch costs are undesirable, and that no cap is planned because schools set activities individually.
Schools must at all times be clear about the voluntary nature of the parental contribution.
Scholen moeten te allen tijde duidelijk zijn over het vrijwillige karakter van de ouderbijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Verhoeven inzake het bericht dat Sesamstraat verdwijnt van NPO1.

MPs Van Dijk and Verhoeven asked whether the removal of Sesamstraat from NPO1 to a themed channel is acceptable, given its educational role and the audience reach lost. The Secretary of State answered that the decision lies with the NPO under programmatic and editorial autonomy, that the morning broadcast remains on NPO 3, and that declined to discuss the decision with the NPO.
That editorial autonomy is explicitly guaranteed in the Mediawet (Media Act).
Die redactionele autonomie staat nadrukkelijk gegarandeerd in de Mediawet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake de bevestiging van de VARA dat gasten in het tv-programma Pauw betaald worden voor hun bijdrage

An MP asked the state secretary whether the public broadcaster VARA confirmed that guests on the talk show Pauw are paid, and whether this affects transparency and journalistic integrity. The state secretary said fees are a matter for broadcasters and must not compromise independence, and promised to urge the NPO to issue internal guidelines and to report on a motion for transparency of genre-level costs by spring 2016.
The NPO does not currently have that information because it is the responsibility of individual broadcasters.
De NPO beschikt nu niet over die informatie omdat dat de verantwoordelijkheid is van individuele omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake de chaotische invoering van de rekentoets

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education why the rekentoets (maths test) rules for secondary schools were published late and chaotically, leaving schools, pupils and parents uncertain about whether the test counts toward diplomas. The State Secretary answered that retroactive transitional rules would be published, that schools were advised on the worst-case scenario, and that clarity was given by letter, but declined to remove the test from the pass/fail rule for this school year.
With the letter of 22 October 2015 it was made clear in which cases the rekentoets counts toward the diploma.
Met de brief van 22 oktober 2015 is duidelijk gemaakt in welk geval de rekentoets meetelt voor het diploma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Kooiman betreffende de problemen die kinderen ondervinden met het volgen van onderwijs na een plaatsing in een residentiële jeugdzorgvoorziening

MPs Siderius and Kooiman asked why pupils placed in residential youth care often cannot return to their home school, whether schools tied to nationally operating care institutions bear the school duty of care, and how onderwijs and care placements can be better aligned. The State Secretary says the receiving school has the duty of care, outlines transition rules and a Variawet exemption for short stays, rejects per-place funding, and promises a separate letter on education outside school premises.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Gesthuizen inzake onderwijs aan meerderjarige vreemdelingen

MPs Siderius and Gesthuizen asked whether the government's rules denying adult foreigners without a residence permit the ability to start or switch education are desirable, and whether they conflict with the European Convention on Human Rights. The minister answered that residence-permit applicants and those with lawful stay can enrol, that unlawfully staying adults may only finish courses already begun under the Koppelingswet's aims, and that no legislative change is planned.
The cabinet sees no need to take further measures.
Het kabinet ziet geen noodzaak om verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over een samenwerkingsverband dat weigert passende expertise op school in te zetten en ouders de benodigde expertise zelf laat betalen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education about a special education partnership (SPPOH) that refuses to use outside expertise for a pupil with epilepsy and requires parents to pay for external support themselves. The State Secretary answered that parents should not have to pay for school support, that the inspectorate will act if this happens, and that the partnership has the right to prioritise its own staff and to shorten the procedure, but did not disclose details of the individual case.
If that does happen, the inspectorate will hold those schools and partnerships to account and ask them to reverse it.
Als dat wel gebeurt, zal de inspectie die scholen en samenwerkingsverbanden daarop aanspreken en verzoeken dat terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over knelpunten in de inkomensvoorziening voor jongeren met opgeschorte Wajong-2015

MPs Siderius and Karabulut asked whether severely multiply disabled young people over 18 can continue learning and what support exists after the Wajong-2015 study allowance ended. The government replied that vso attendance is possible until age 20 with exemptions, that gemeenten may grant studietoeslag or bijzondere bijstand, and that it has no insight into how many municipalities provide bijzondere bijstand to this group.
I have no insight into the extent to which municipalities provide individual special assistance to severely multiply disabled young people aged 18 and over without labour market prospects.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de mate waarin gemeenten individuele bijzondere bijstand verstrekken aan meervoudig gehandicapte jongeren van 18 jaar en ouder zonder arbeidsmarktperspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de artikelen 'Rijk in de fout met licentie voor Wijnbergschool' en 'Patstelling op De Berg'

An MP asked the state secretary why a special-education licence was granted to De Wijnberg in 2012 on apparently incomplete grounds, and how it led to the closure of a partner school's location and dispute over pupils. The state secretary answered that the application contained a capacity forecast, that DUO's 2014 review found the licence was not wrongly granted, and that the responsibility for providing capacity figures lay with the applicant school.
I am aware that school de Velddijk (Onderwijsgroep Buitengewoon) closed its location on the grounds of the Mutsaersstichting.
Het is mij bekend dat school de Velddijk (Onderwijsgroep Buitengewoon) de locatie op het terrein van de Mutsaersstichting heeft gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat de islamitische basisschool «Al Andalus» in Venlo-Noord in één jaar tijd met 67 leerlingen is gegroeid

MPs Beertema and Wilders asked whether an Islamic primary school in Venlo growing by 67 pupils should be judged by its mission and social vision, and whether that vision fits local society. The State Secretary answered that all schools face the same legal criteria, that diversity of school provision is valued, and that the Inspectorate has found no breach of the rules on citizenship and social integration.
The Inspectorate of Education has no indications that Al Andalus violates the legal requirements imposed on a school, including the requirements on citizenship and social integration.

De Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft geen aanwijzingen dat Al Andalous de wettelijke eisen overtreedt die aan een school worden gesteld, inclusief de eisen betreffende burgerschap en sociale integratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sjoerdsma over de gevolgen van de bezuiniging op Nederlands onderwijs in het buitenland

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Education about the expected effects of ending direct subsidies to Dutch schools abroad, including school closures and falling quality, as predicted by an ITS study. The State Secretary maintained that parents are responsible for funding, pointed to temporary transitional funding and NOB support, and said effects will vary by school and that the government will keep working to minimise them.
The ITS study gives insight into schools' expectations of how they will act when the temporary subsidy to schools ends on 1 January 2017.
Het onderzoek door ITS geeft inzicht in de verwachtingen van scholen hoe zij zullen handelen wanneer de tijdelijke subsidie aan scholen op 1 januari 2017 eindigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de sluiting van een school voor speciaal onderwijs 'de Ambelt' door de invoering van het passend onderwijs.

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about the closure of special school De Ambelt due to passend onderwijs, questioning the loss of places, staff and expertise and the effects on pupils. The State Secretary answered that the closure is a regional decision driven by verevening and that pupils will get support elsewhere, while largely rejecting the claims and stating that passend onderwijs is not failing.
I distance myself from what is insinuated in the question.
Ik neem afstand van wat in de vraag wordt geïnsinueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over problemen met het passend onderwijs op het mbo

An SP MP asked the minister about problems with passend onderwijs in mbo, including a student removed after four weeks, budget dilution for students needing support, and exam flexibility. The minister said implementation is not causing major problems, that the budget is unchanged, and that individual cases should be resolved between institution and student, offering a study on exam flexibility.
This data is not known. Mbo institutions are themselves responsible for the support they provide within the framework of passend onderwijs.
Deze gegevens zijn niet bekend. Mbo-instellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de ondersteuning die ze bieden in het kader van passend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake de indexatie van personele bekostiging in het primair onderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether the 0.44% indexation of personnel funding in primary education leaves schools 0.8% short of actual employer costs, and how quality would be protected. The State Secretary confirmed the figure, explained that cao costs must be financed from the cabinet contribution and other sources and that the PO-Raad is responsible for keeping spending within those limits, and declined to change the lump-sum funding system to open-ended funding.
To avoid disrupting ongoing negotiations, the content of this letter is not discussed publicly.
Om lopende onderhandelingsprocessen niet te verstoren, wordt er niet in het openbaar ingegaan op de inhoud van deze brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake de opheffing van De Ambelt, school voor speciaal onderwijs.

An MP from the Labour party asked the state secretary for Education about the closure of De Ambelt, a special-education school with 2,100 pupils, and how pupils, parents and staff would be guaranteed suitable education, along with questions on class size and teacher expectations in inclusive education. The state secretary answered that all pupils will be placed at suitable schools from August 2017, that the regional partnership is responsible for coverage, and that the situation will be monitored, but declined separate research on class size.
I will keep a close eye on this.
Ik houd daarbij een vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Bisschop en Potters inzake vernomen onjuistheden in Nederlandse schoolboeken over Israël

MPs Voordewind, Bisschop and Potters asked the education state secretary about alleged factual errors and antisemitic wording in Dutch textbooks on Israel and the Middle East, and about schools avoiding Holocaust and Middle East lessons. The state secretary declined to intervene in individual textbook content, but reported forwarding a correction request to ThiemeMeulenhoff and committed to supporting teachers through School en Veiligheid.
It is not for me to pronounce on the content of individual teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om een uitspraak te doen over de inhoud van individuele lesmethodes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de entreetoets die steeds meer gebruikt wordt als basis voor schooladviezen

An SP MP asked whether using the group 7 entreetoets as an early basis for school advice is undesirable, whether Cito tests remain reliable, and what the government will do about test-driven advice. The State Secretary replied that schools own their advice and decide how test results are weighed, that no legal limits apply to the entreetoets' use, and that he sees no reason for new steps or measures.
It is up to their professional judgement to determine how test data are weighed in this.
Het is aan hun professionele oordeel om te bepalen hoe toetsgegevens hierin meewegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de zorgelijke situatie op school voor het speciaal onderwijs 'de Parachute’

An SP MP asks whether pupils who left special school 'de Parachute' and now receive partial schooling at a care farm are left at home because the regional partnership, inspectorate and municipality take no responsibility for a new placement, and criticises the inspectorate and truancy officer. The Secretary of State says children should not be left without schooling, that most pupils now have a solution, that the partnership and school must act, and that the school remains under intensified inspection with a review planned for January 2016.
The Inspectorate of Education will keep a close watch in the coming period to ensure that a suitable solution is found for all children as quickly as possible.
De inspectie houdt komende periode vinger aan de pols om ervoor te zorgen dat zo snel mogelijk voor alle kinderen een passende oplossing komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over het Koningslied dat een duur grapje blijkt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science why the Koningslied for the 2013 inauguration cost far more than first reported, despite the sober-celebration wish of the royals and claims that participants worked for free. The State Secretary confirmed total costs of €574,463 (€400,000 from the Nationaal Comité Inhuldiging, €174,463 from the NPO), itemised the spending, reported the proceeds to the Oranje Fonds, and acknowledged confusion over the earlier NPO figure while defending the NPO's role as within its public task.
Do you consider it within the NPO's public mandate to co-finance the production of the Koningslied?
Vindt u het onder de taakstelling van de NPO vallen om de productie van het Koningslied mee te financieren?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over promotie van het Koningslied

An MP asked whether the NPO and DWDD were paid to promote the Koningslied, how much the Nationaal Comité Inhuldiging paid the NPO, and whether this amounted to covert advertising in breach of media rules. The Staatssecretaris answered that no programme costs were paid to Radio 2 or DWDD, that the NPO received 1.8 million euro for media coverage of inauguration events under a contract safeguarding editorial independence, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media found no violation and no grounds for further investigation.
I asked the Commissariaat to assess the mediation agreement between the NPO and the Nationaal Comité Inhuldiging in relation to the Koningslied.
Ik heb het Commissariaat gevraagd de bemiddelingsovereenkomst tussen de NPO en het Nationaal Comité Inhuldiging in relatie tot het Koningslied te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over leerlingen die kleine vakken thuis volgen achter de computer

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked whether a Liemers College arrangement letting pupils follow small subjects such as philosophy online at home, due to school shrinkage, is acceptable and how quality and compulsory-education rules are safeguarded. The State Secretary said the school's own professionals and parents decide, that distance learning can count as lesson time under the Leerplichtwet if integrated and approved by the works council, and gave no new concrete commitments.
Distance learning can be regarded as instruction time and therefore as lesson time within the meaning of the Compulsory Education Act, if this benefits the quality or accessibility of education.
Afstandsonderwijs kan gezien worden als onderwijstijd en daarmee ook als lestijd in de zin van de Leerplichtwet, als dit de kwaliteit of toegankelijkheid van het onderwijs ten goede komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius inzake grote klassen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius asked the state secretary about reports that pupils' classes are too large, the claimed link to worse performance, and whether a national 'Actieplan Kleine Klassen' should be made. The state secretary said class size is not a simple measure of quality, that the evidence on class size and performance is mixed, and that he will not create a national plan, instead encouraging schools to use their new flexibility.

No. A national 'Actieplan Kleine Klassen' suggests that all these different timetables with many different classes, teaching methods and subjects could (or should) be arranged centrally from 'The Hague'.

Nee. Een landelijk «Actieplan Kleine Klassen» suggereert dat al die verschillende lesroosters met veel verschillende klassen, verschillende werkvormen en veel verschillende vakken centraal, vanuit «Den Haag», geregeld zouden (kunnen) worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake de lunchpauze van leraren in het basisonderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education about a CNV Onderwijs survey showing many teachers at schools with continuous timetables are dissatisfied with break arrangements and whether schools have enough funds for lunch supervision and teacher breaks. The State Secretary answered that break rules follow from the Arbeidstijdenwet and the cao, that school boards and works councils decide on arrangements and funding, and that teachers can raise concerns with their employer.
The personnel part of the works council has consent rights over the working and rest time arrangements at the school.
Het personeelsdeel van de medezeggenschapsraad heeft instemmingsrecht op de arbeids- en rusttijdenregeling op school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing inzake het verdwijnen van brede scholengemeenschappen in krimpregio's

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary whether the disappearance of broad secondary schools in shrinking regions, such as Maastricht, harms pupils' pathways, and what measures could keep such schools. The state secretary replied that broad schools need not be dissolved, that Maastricht's board chose to cluster education by level while keeping three broad schools, and that cooperation between schools plus policy measures (relaxed 50% rule, pilot, fusion compensation) are the way to keep a wide offer.
School boards themselves decide which forms of secondary education are offered.
Schoolbesturen bepalen zelf welke vormen van voortgezet onderwijs aangeboden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichtgeving van de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) over de gewichtenregeling

The MP Bisschop (SGP) asked the State Secretary about DUO's communication on the weighting scheme for disadvantaged pupils, including whether the new mandatory parental form changed criteria, why ethnicity is not reintroduced, and the decline in weighted pupils. The State Secretary answered that only a formal requirement changed, that ethnicity was rejected as stigmatising, that the decline reflects demographics, rising parental education and errors, and that SBB judges foreign education levels.
Using the mandatory parental form has been a formal requirement for determining a weight since 1 January 2015.
Het gebruik van het verplichte ouderformulier is met ingang van 1 januari 2015 een formeel vereiste voor de vaststelling van een gewicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake onvoldoende budget voor scholen in achterstandswijken om goed onderwijs te kunnen bieden

An MP asked the state secretary whether schools in disadvantaged neighbourhoods have enough budget for quality education, and about the criteria for disadvantage funding. The state secretary replied that the extra funding is sufficient, gave figures on pupil counts and the secretary declined to provide data on children of Central/Eastern European and asylum families, and said a reform based on individual pupil deficits was not pursued because of administrative burden.
For the Leerplusarrangement in secondary education, just over €48 million is being deployed this year.
Voor het Leerplusarrangement voortgezet onderwijs wordt dit jaar ruim € 48 miljoen ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema inzake het bericht dat middelbare scholen in achterstandsgebieden 'collectief liegen' over slechte kwaliteit onderwijs en baat hebben bij meer lesuren

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that secondary schools in deprived areas claim poor education quality and need more lesson hours, and whether the new hours framework and funding are adequate. The secretary answered that the new framework from 1 August 2015 gives schools more room for tailored teaching, that regular funding is sufficient with extra money for schools with disadvantaged pupils, and that no action against the schools is planned.
The regular funding is sufficient to deliver the regular programme.
De reguliere bekostiging is toereikend om het reguliere programma te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over ouders die steeds vaker financiële hulp nodig hebben om de kosten voor school en sport te dekken

An SP MP asked why 68,619 children depend on charity such as Stichting Leergeld to cover school and sport costs, and whether voluntary parental contributions should be capped or reported. The State Secretary answered that schools must offer free alternatives for compulsory activities, that voluntary contributions are the shared responsibility of schools and parents monitored by the inspectorate, and that no cap or national reporting is planned.
From school year 2012/2013 supervision of compliance with school costs and voluntary parental contributions has been included in the inspectorate's regular supervision.
Vanaf het schooljaar 2012/2013 is het toezicht op de naleving van de schoolkosten en vrijwillige ouderbijdrage in het reguliere toezicht van de inspectie opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de reddingsbrigade schoolzwemmen terug wil om te voorkomen dat er nog meer kinderen verdrinken

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the government will respond to the Reddingsbrigade's call to reinstate compulsory school swimming and to take action given rising drowning figures. The minister replied that parents are primarily responsible for children's swimming ability, supported by schools and municipalities, and that the government awaits a sector action plan before deciding on further school swimming initiatives.
Once this plan is in place, your chamber will receive a response, including whether talks with municipalities and schools about more school swimming initiatives are desirable.
Zodra dit plan er ligt, zal uw kamer een reactie ontvangen, inclusief het antwoord of gesprekken met gemeenten en scholen voor meer initiatieven voor schoolzwemmen wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het trage internet op basisscholen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education why slow internet at primary schools could deprive 900,000 pupils of modern education, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary says the Doorbraakproject Onderwijs en ICT and partners will ensure schools get adequate connections by 2017, with a broadband guide and purchasing support, but explicitly states the central government will not finance fast internet for all schools.
However, this does not mean that the central government will finance fast internet for all primary schools.
Dat betekent echter niet dat de rijksoverheid snel internet voor alle basisscholen gaat financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over trage internetverbindingen in het onderwijs en de ambities op het gebied van digitale leermiddelen en hoogwaardig onderwijs

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Economic Affairs about slow internet connections in schools and the government's ambitions for digital learning materials. The government says most schools can currently manage with available speeds, describes the Doorbraakproject support and a planned action plan, and says schools should contribute to local broadband initiatives while receiving extra funds.
As a first step, it will be mapped which schools experience problems and which solutions are effective.
Als eerste stap wordt in kaart gebracht welke scholen problemen ervaren en welke oplossingen effectief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het negeren van een uitspraak van de Reclame Code Commissie

An MP asked ministers why an erotic website's advertising, already ruled against by the Advertising Code Commission, could reappear on a beach banner and whether current enforcement tools are sufficient. The government answered that the Code applies to banners, that the firm complied with the earlier ruling (96% of advertisers comply), that a new complaint is being assessed, and that current instruments are adequate.
Given the high percentage of advertisers that follow a ruling (96%), I consider the current instruments sufficient.
Gelet op het hoge percentage adverteerders dat een uitspraak opvolgt (96%), acht ik de huidige instrumenten voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de mogelijkheid van leerlingenvervoer naar de buitenschoolse opvang

An SP MP asked whether municipalities should be made to provide adapted transport from special schools to after-school care for children with disabilities, since parents may be forced to stop working. The State Secretary answered that the arrangement covers home-school transport only, that after-school transport is the parents' responsibility, and that existing hardship clauses already allow flexibility without new legislation.
I am of the view that not every situation should be resolved through regulation.
Ik ben van mening dat niet elke situatie via regelgeving moet worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake scholen in het voortgezet onderwijs die enkelvoudige schooladviezen verplicht stellen

An SP MP asked why some secondary schools require single school advice from primary schools, whether this is a side effect of inspectorate accountability pressure, and what will be done to stop it. The State Secretary replied that the arrangements are voluntary agreements under the Friese Plaatsingswijzer, not unilateral requirements, that broad advice may be better for some pupils, that the Inspectorate has no signals of unilateral imposition, and that schools will be reminded via the VO-raad and newsletters to align admission policy with regulations.
There is therefore no question here of secondary schools imposing single advice on primary schools.
Er is hier dan ook geen sprake van een verplichtstelling van enkelvoudige adviezen door het voortgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het bericht dat middelbare scholen geen genoegen nemen met het schooladvies van de basisschool

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether secondary schools are ignoring the primary school advice for admission, citing a VOO survey showing requests for extra information, and whether the quick scan will examine this. The State Secretary says all secondary schools have been informed that the advice is binding, the quick scan is a small first indication and not representative, and a response on the motion regarding the onderwijskundig rapport will come in October 2015.
The primary school advice is, after all, binding for admission.
Het basisschooladvies is immers leidend voor de toelating.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het leerlingenvervoer in De Fryske Marren

An SP MP asked whether the municipality of De Fryske Marren may replace individual school transport for pupils with disabilities or behavioural problems with group pick-up points, and whether it treats parents' objections fairly. The Secretary of State answered that the municipality still provides adapted transport for those pupils as legally required, that objections were handled before the school year, and that no measures are needed.
For the pupils who are designated for this, adapted transport is still provided.
Voor de leerlingen die daarop zijn aangewezen wordt nog steeds aangepast vervoer toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake onvoldoende bekostiging om het onderwijs en de zorg voor leerlingen met een ernstige meervoudige beperking (cluster 3) te garanderen

The SP MP Siderius asked whether funding cuts by special-education partnerships were pushing students with severe multiple disabilities (cluster 3) into lower funding categories, leaving schools unable to secure nursing care, and whether a separate funding regime and a refusal to exempt these pupils from inclusive education were warranted. The State Secretary answered that partnerships set their own criteria, that the new special funding scheme and simplified procedure are meant to keep category 3 funding for these pupils, that schools' nursing care can come from care budgets, and that no change to inclusive education is planned.
It is therefore explicitly not the intention that partnerships lower the funding of emb pupils to category 2.
Het is dan ook nadrukkelijk niet de bedoeling dat samenwerkingsverbanden de bekostiging van emb-leerlingen verlagen naar categorie 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de bestuurlijke chaos bij Stichting Mozon

An MP from the SP asked the State Secretary of Education about governance chaos at Stichting Mozon, including the suspension of a school director, conflicts over the board and supervisory board, petition handling, and the case for works council consent rights. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate is investigating the Venlo school, defended the current board model with checks and balances, and pointed to the Wet Versterking bestuurskracht bill and a possible review of budget consent rights by summer 2016.
The quality investigation is currently in the hearing and counter-hearing phase.
Het kwaliteitsonderzoek bevindt zich momenteel in de fase van hoor en wederhoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de gemeente Kampen die weigert passend vervoer te regelen voor leerlingen met een beperking

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether the municipality of Kampen, by no longer providing adapted transport to special primary school pupils and paying only public transport fares, complies with its legal duty to provide suitable pupil transport. The State Secretary replies that Kampen applies its ordinance with an individual assessment per pupil, that compliance is ultimately for the courts to judge, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
Whether the municipality applies the law correctly, as answered at question 7, is a task for the judge.
Of de gemeente de wet goed toepast is, zoals beantwoord bij vraag 7, een taak van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de gemeente Heerhugowaard die stopt met het organiseren van aangepast vervoer voor leerlingen naar het speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary whether Heerhugowaard's refusal to organise adapted transport for special-education pupils, leaving only public-transport allowances and parental escort duties, complies with the legal duty and whether ministerial action is planned. The secretary replied that the municipality has not been shown to refuse adapted transport, that case-by-case assessment is lawful, that no signals of the alleged harms were received, and that objections go through the normal appeal route, so no measures are planned.
I cannot infer from the information available to me that the municipality of Heerhugowaard refuses to organise appropriate adapted pupil transport for pupils of special primary education.
Ik kan uit de mij beschikbare informatie niet afleiden dat de gemeente Heerhugowaard weigert om passend aangepast leerlingenvervoer te organiseren voor leerlingen van het speciaal basisonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Graaf over hoe de KRO begrip wil creëren voor de islam

PVV MPs Bosma and De Graaf asked whether the public broadcaster KRO's programme 'Bekeerd', intended to create understanding for Islam, is a legitimate task for public broadcasting and whether the state broadcaster is being used to Islamize the Netherlands. The Secretary of State replied that the programme aims to give insight into the lives of young (converted) Muslims, fits the public broadcasters' mandate, and that under the Mediawet broadcasters themselves determine form and content, so it is not for the minister to judge.
It is therefore not for me to pass judgement on that.
Het is dus niet aan mij om daar een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Arabisch op Blerickse scholen'

PVV MPs asked whether Arabic lessons in Dutch primary schools should be stopped, arguing the language is irrelevant and linked to radicalisation. The minister rejected these claims and stated that schools may offer Arabic as an extracurricular activity, while within school hours only English, German and French (plus Dutch and Frisian) are legally permitted.
Within school hours, primary schools are legally permitted to offer only English, German and French, alongside Dutch (and Frisian in Friesland).
Binnen de onderwijstijd is het in het basisonderwijs wettelijk alleen toegestaan de talen Engels, Duits en Frans aan te bieden, naast het Nederlands (en het Fries in Friesland).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake het bericht dat de meerderheid van de VO-scholen alsnog toetsscores wil zien

An MP asks the State Secretary whether schools may base admission to secondary education on test scores rather than the primary school advice, and how teachers reconsider advice after eindtoets results. The State Secretary answers that the primary school advice is binding for admission, that the inspectorate found no signals of test-based admission, and that teacher reconsideration is a professional matter; empirical monitoring results are expected in 2017.
The primary school advice is after all binding for admission.
Het basisschooladvies is immers leidend voor de toelating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen inzake de rijkssubsidie die gaat verdwijnen voor het doveninternaat in Haren

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked about the planned withdrawal of OCW subsidy for the deaf boarding school in Haren. The Secretary of State explained the funding history, said the OCW subsidy would be phased out from 2016/2017 pending a visit to the school, and described how care needs are now assessed and what the consequences for pupils would be.
At Mr Van Meenen's request, I have committed to first visit the boarding school before taking a final decision on phasing out the subsidy.
Op verzoek van de heer Van Meenen heb ik toegezegd eerst op bezoek te gaan bij het internaat, voordat ik een definitief besluit neem over de afbouw van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake sponsoring van een school voor 3 ton door een commercieel bedrijf

An SP MP asks whether a Rotterdam secondary school accepting a 300,000 euro gift from a software company, amid budget cuts, is acceptable and whether this threatens the independence of education and creates inequality. The state secretary replies that schools have sufficient funding, that the gift is a donation without counter-performance covered by the sponsorship convenant, and that no overview of sponsorship is held.
I do not have an overview of sponsorship of schools in primary and secondary education in 2013 and 2014.
Ik ben niet in het bezit van een overzicht van de sponsoring van scholen in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs in 2013 en 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mohandis over de implementatie van het cookiebeleid op de websites van de Publieke Omroep

MPs Oosenbrug and Mohandis asked whether NPO websites respect users' cookie choices, whether settings are remembered, and what the government will do to make sites accessible without accepting privacy-sensitive cookies. The minister answered that the sites were reviewed, the NPO fixed a display error and a remembering problem, and enforcement rests with the ACM and CBP, which have already acted.
Whether the NPO complies with the legal requirements and continues to do so is of course for the ACM to assess.
Of de NPO aan de wettelijke eisen voldoet en blijft voldoen is uiteraard aan de ACM om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de werkloosheid onder jonge leerkrachten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about young teachers losing out on jobs and whether schools should be pushed to hire them with the 150 million euro NOA funds. The government said it sees no role in directing schools, opposes earmarking the funds, and will report on the labour market and the effects of the funds in the autumn.
I will inform the House in the autumn, via the labour market letter, further about the state of affairs on the education labour market.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het najaar via de arbeidsmarktbrief nader informeren over de stand van zaken op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de gevolgen van de sluiting van orthopedische didactische centra (opdc's) voor leerlingen met een zorgbehoefte

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of an orthopedic didactic centre (OPDC) and the refusal of a pupil by a vmbo school based solely on a school file, asking whether schools may refuse pupils on file alone and how the duty of care under inclusive education is enforced. The state secretary answered that schools must first examine whether they can provide the support themselves, that the inspectorate supervises compliance, that the case was resolved by the regional partnership, and that the state secretary is not directly responsible for finding places but monitors through the inspectorate.
A school must always first examine, for a pupil who needs extra support, whether it can offer that support itself.
Een school moet bij een leerling die extra ondersteuning nodig heeft altijd eerst bekijken of zij deze ondersteuning zelf kan bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de algemene voorwaarden van De Persgroep voor freelance journalisten

An MP asked ministers about De Persgroep's new terms for freelance journalists, including unilateral change with eight days' notice, competition clauses, broad exploitation rights and licence fees. The government answered that these are private civil-law contracts, that disputes are for the courts or the ACM, and that the new copyright contract law sets a 'fair remuneration' standard it cannot judge itself.
However, this concerns a civil-law contract between private parties to which the government is not a party.
Het betreft hier echter een civielrechtelijke overeenkomst tussen private partijen waarbij de overheid geen partij is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Teeven over problemen bij de inschrijving voor de Marechaussee opleiding

MPs Straus and Teeven asked the State Secretary of Education and the Minister of Defence about raised entry requirements for a one-year mbo level 2 security course that feeds into the Royal Marechaussee training, which excluded vmbo basic-track pupils without prior communication. The minister acknowledged the requirement was not in line with law, said the ROCs failed to inform the KMar, promised the pupils would be admitted via the usual selection, and committed to requiring ROCs to restore the legal entry requirement and rename the course.
The ROCs concerned will have to bring the entry requirement back to the statutory entry requirement for vmbo-bb.
De betrokken ROC's zullen de instroomeis terug moeten brengen naar de wettelijke instroomeis vmbo-bb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake onbehoorlijk bestuur binnen de Stichting Roobol en het niet publiek maken van een onderzoeksrapport

The SP MP Siderius asked the state secretary about governance failures at Stichting Roobol, including the non-publication of an independent investigation report and the composition of its supervisory board. The secretary answered that procedural errors were made but no structural problem found, that the report is kept confidential by the supervisory board, and that the government will strengthen medezeggenschap (works council) rights through a bill.
The supervisory board chooses to keep the Van den Hoek report confidential because it contains sensitive personal information about the former chair of the executive board.
De raad van toezicht kiest ervoor het rapport Van den Hoek vertrouwelijk te houden omdat het gevoelige persoonlijke informatie bevat over de afgetreden voorzitter van het college van bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over een directeur die twee schoolbesturen leidt en voor 66 uur per week wordt uitbetaald

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a school director leading two separate primary school boards and paid for 66 hours a week (1.65 fte), questioning legality, pay norms, employee protection, works council rights and whether such dual roles exist elsewhere. The state secretary called this undesirable, said the parties are seeking a solution and that the case will be monitored, noted the cao caps the contract at 100 percent of a norm position, said pay falls within the WNT norm, explained the works council dispute mechanisms, and could not say how many such dual directors exist because the data does not allow it.

I do not consider it desirable that a full-time school board member, regardless of the number of hours he works, leads two independent school boards, partly because a board member must be alert to conflicting interests.

Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat een fulltime schoolbestuurder, ongeacht het aantal uren dat hij werkt, leiding geeft aan twee zelfstandige schoolbesturen, mede omdat een bestuurder alert moet zijn op conflicterende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte inzake het bericht "Aanpassingen afspraken sportcontracten horen bij onafhankelijke en transparante publieke omroep"

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a secret arrangement between the NOS and Eredivisie Media Marketing that included free Ster airtime, and about transparency of public broadcasting contracts. The Secretary of State said the matter concerns the NPO and NOS and is for the Commissariaat voor de Media to judge, that the parties have revised the arrangement, and that transparency in future tender procedures is essential, while stating that the existing contract cannot be altered.
The content of the contract between NOS and Eredivisie Media Marketing (EMM) is not public.
De inhoud van het contract tussen NOS en de Eredivisie Media Marketing (EMM) is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake het bericht dat het toelatingsbeleid in Amsterdam scholen weer zwart maakt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether Amsterdam's primary school admission policy, reported to re-segregate schools, is acceptable and what he would do about it. The State Secretary answered that the policy aims at neighbourhood schooling and transparency, early placement data show no clear segregation effect yet, and the municipality and school boards are responsible for any adjustment after a full-year evaluation.
If the policy nonetheless increases segregation, it is up to the municipality and the school boards to discuss this and possibly adjust the policy.
Wanneer door het beleid de segregatie toch zal toenemen, is het aan de gemeente en de schoolbesturen dit te bespreken en eventueel het beleid bij te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat het toelatingsbeleid in Amsterdam scholen weer zwart maakt

Two SP MPs asked how the government responds to reports that Amsterdam admission policy is re-segregating schools, and about funding for parent initiatives to mix schools. The State Secretary answered that schools' quality matters, that existing disadvantage measures apply, that school mixing by ethnicity is not desired at national level, and that the only role for municipalities is the statutory annual consultation on segregation.
I see no further role for the national government.
Ik zie geen verdere taak weggelegd voor de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het fysiek ingrijpen en fixeren van leerlingen op de school voor speciaal onderwijs De Parachute in Zoetermeer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education about the physical restraint of pupils at special school De Parachute in Zoetermeer, its very weak inspection rating, and pupils being placed at a farm receiving only half an hour of education daily. The State Secretary confirmed the school is under intensified inspection supervision, said the farm arrangement does not meet legal education requirements and must end by 1 August 2015, and described the inspectorate's follow-up monitoring while declining to discuss individual cases.
It is not for me to go into individual cases and privacy-sensitive information about pupils in the House.
Het is niet aan mij om in de Kamer in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek en privacygevoelige gegevens van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het meetellen van spelling en schrijfvaardigheid bij het examen Nederlands

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Education why spelling and writing no longer count in the Dutch centraal examen for havo and vwo after the reading-comprehension test was changed. The State Secretary acknowledged that the change had an unintended effect, said spelling should be assessed, and asked CvTE to reinstate spelling-based deductions for the 2016 exams, while stating that spelling is still assessed in the schoolexamen.
I want to emphasise that every pupil this year must still demonstrate that he or she has a good command of Dutch spelling.
Ik wil benadrukken dat elke leerling ook dit jaar wel degelijk moet bewijzen dat hij of zij de Nederlandse spelling goed beheerst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake het niet toestaan van bekostiging

MP Ypma asked the State Secretary for Education about an Inspectorate letter stating that school funds may not pay for tailored education for pupils enrolled at private schools, which she argued conflicts with her motion, and about whether children are left without funded education. The State Secretary answered that the rule follows existing law, that schools can still receive funding for tailored arrangements where the pupil is enrolled at the funded school, and that an inventory of options outside the regular school will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
I will inform you of the results before the summer recess.
Over de resultaten daarvan informeer ik u voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de klachten bij de vmbo-examens

An MP asked the State Secretary whether abolishing the second correction round for digital vmbo exams removes external quality control, and whether this affects validity, fraud risk and the end-of-April schedule. The State Secretary denied that external control is absent, pointing to a najaarscorrectie by exam correctors with inspectorate follow-up, and defended the flexible scheduling as serving pupils' interests.
There is indeed external quality control of the marked work for digital central exams.
Er is wel degelijk sprake van een externe kwaliteitscontrole op het nagekeken werk bij digitale centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake eerder onderzoek op taal- en spraakproblemen bij kinderen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the decline of GGD logopedic screening in primary schools, its effects on children with speech problems, and the cost-benefit of speech therapy. The government answered that screening is not mandatory for all pupils under the basic youth health care package, that schools and parents refer when needed, that no data exist on the number of affected pupils, and that a new guideline is being developed.
There is no data known on the number of pupils with speech problems in regular primary education.
Er zijn geen gegevens bekend over het aantal leerlingen met spraakproblemen in het reguliere basisonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Leerling naar huis door invallerlimiet’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why school boards still resist replacing teachers despite the Wwz flexibility options, and whether the Wwz's entry into force in primary education should be delayed if the PO-Raad and unions fail to agree by 1 July 2015. The minister answers that board reactions stem from unfamiliarity with Wwz options, that the current CO primary education cao continues until 1 July 2016 under transitional law, and that boards may keep existing temporary-contract and min/max arrangements until then.
Reports from the PO-Raad and the unions of 1 May show that the parties have agreed not to conclude a new primary education collective agreement at this time.
Uit de berichtgeving van de PO-Raad en de bonden van 1 mei jl. blijkt dat partijen hebben afgesproken om op dit moment geen nieuwe cao voor het primair onderwijs af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over thuiszittende, autistische kinderen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about autistic children staying at home because regular schools cannot meet their needs and special school waiting lists are long, and asked for waiting-list figures and budget details. The state secretary said that schools and partnerships are responsible for providing suitable provision and that the Inspectorate supervises them, but that waiting-list and budget data are not kept nationally and only partly answered the questions.
Data on possible waiting lists are not kept nationally.
Gegevens over eventuele wachtlijsten worden niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over verwaarloosde kinderen op school

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretaries of health and education whether they knew of reports that hundreds of children arrive at school hungry and neglected, and what is being done about it. The government answers that municipalities and Veilig Thuis are responsible for responding, that schools should report signals, and that it is promoting integrated cooperation between schools and neighbourhood teams.
Municipalities also have an important role in tackling poverty, one of the possible underlying causes.
Gemeenten hebben ook een belangrijke rol bij het tegengaan van armoedeproblematiek, één van de mogelijk achterliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Bisschop inzake trage internetverbindingen in het onderwijs en de ambities op het gebied van digitale leermiddelen en kwalitatief hoogwaardig onderwijs

MPs Voordewind and Bisschop asked about slow internet connections in schools, whether all schools can meet digital learning targets, and how to fund fast connections in rural areas. The State Secretary answered that most schools have adequate bandwidth via cable, that an 8 Mbps connection is too slow, and that a joint approach with school associations and the Ministry of Economic Affairs is being explored.
I want to examine together with the PO-Raad, the VO-raad and the Ministry of Economic Affairs whether a joint approach can be created that provides all schools with fast internet
Ik wil samen met de PO-Raad, de VO-raad en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken bekijken of er een gezamenlijke aanpak te creëren is die alle scholen van snel internet kan voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het voortbestaan van het speciaal basisonderwijs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether passend onderwijs threatens the survival of speciaal basisonderwijs (sbo), and what the government will do about it, including the lack of expertise and funding in regular schools. The State Secretary replied that the regions decide placements, the sbo decline predates passend onderwijs, no sbo schools have closed since its introduction, and no extra measures are planned, citing existing funding.
I therefore will not take any additional measures regarding the sbo.
Ik ga dan ook geen extra maatregelen nemen ten aanzien van het sbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het Adelbert College dat een moeder heeft laten aanhouden door de politie vanwege onenigheid over passend onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a school that had a mother of a chronically ill pupil arrested by police over a dispute on special education, and about suspension, the school's duty of care, parental involvement and the availability of kort geding data. The state secretary said police intervention was undesirable but understandable in escalated conflicts, that the school met procedural requirements, and that the individual case and the placement decision are for the school, the partnership and the complaints committee; data on kort geding cases was not available and the answer was late.
It is not for me to assess the substance of a decision to suspend or remove a pupil.
Het is niet aan mij om een besluit tot schorsing of verwijdering inhoudelijk te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over de onheuse bejegening van Israël in de geschiedenismethode ''Geschiedeniswerkplaats vmbo-kgt 4 examenboek'' van Noordhoff Uitgevers

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister and State Secretary of Education whether a Dutch vmbo history textbook presents Israel unfairly and fuels anti-Semitism. The State Secretary declined to judge the specific textbook, stating that publishers and teachers are responsible for balanced content, while noting that objections from Israel exist and that the Israeli education minister had raised concerns.
Nevertheless, it is not for me to assess a teaching method on its substance, and I will therefore neither approve nor disapprove of it.
Desalniettemin is het niet aan mij om een lesmethode inhoudelijk te beoordelen en ik ga deze dan ook niet goed- of afkeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘verwaarloosde kinderen op basisscholen’

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the state secretaries about a report that around 1,100 children arrive at school daily without basic necessities, and that many schools feed and clothe pupils themselves, asking about detection, referral to youth care and Veilig Thuis, and coordination with the VNG and PO-Raad. The government acknowledges the problem, points to municipal responsibility, the poverty-fighting funds and the verbindingsagenda, and says it will discuss the issue with partners without committing to new legal or institutional change.
Municipalities, as stated, have the means to provide the necessary support.
Gemeenten hebben zoals gezegd mogelijkheden om de benodigde ondersteuning te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake de plannen van de NPO

Dutch MP Verhoeven (D66) asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether the NPO's plans to remove underperforming programmes and favour popular ones, cut debate programmes and emphasise ratings conflict with the government's aim of a more distinctive public broadcaster, and whether the NPO's commercial aims are subordinating content. The State Secretary answered that public value must come first, that programmes should be judged on more than ratings, that the NPO is editorially independent but must make sharp choices, and that the NPO has been asked to include a quality assessment framework in its concession plan.
The NPO has an important role in realising this.
De NPO heeft een belangrijke rol in de realisatie hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma inzake vroege schoolselectie

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Education about early school selection at age twelve, the decline in transfers from vmbo to havo and havo to vwo, and whether selection criteria are reasonable. The State Secretary rejected the concern that early selection prevents pupils reaching their potential, pointed to the Onderwijsraad's advice and to measures promoting flexibility, and promised to report back after the summer recess.
I will inform you about this after the summer recess.
Ik informeer u hierover na het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ypma over de positie van leerlingen in het praktijkonderwijs in de Participatiewet

Two MPs asked whether pupils in practical secondary education (praktijkonderwijs) risk falling through the cracks under the Participatiewet, and whether they can be automatically listed in the target-group register for guaranteed jobs. The government answered that pupils will stay in view through handover of Wajong networks to municipalities, information campaigns, and a UWV procedure allowing direct applications for target-group assessment, with financing centralized at UWV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de kanttekeningen die docenten lichamelijke opvoeding plaatsen bij het ‘Plan van aanpak bewegingsonderwijs’

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Education why teacher organisation KVLO was not more prominently involved in the movement-education plan and whether generalist teachers should be trained to give PE, questioning the displacement of specialist PE teachers and how the two-hour target will be monitored. The State Secretary defended the partners chosen, stated that generalist teachers can be qualified for PE, announced a funding scheme and a vacancy inventory, and said monitoring will run through Vensters PO and the Inspectorate's survey.
It is important that every movement-education lesson is given by a qualified teacher, which is why I am focusing on qualifying group teachers.
Het is van belang dat iedere les bewegingsonderwijs gegeven wordt door een bevoegde leerkracht, vandaar dat ik inzet op het bevoegd maken van groepsleerkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Van Laar over het stoppen van de financiering van het doveninternaat in Haren

MPs Ypma and Van Laar asked the State Secretary of Education about ending state funding for new pupils at the deaf boarding school in Haren, and the consequences for bilingual secondary education for deaf pupils. The State Secretary confirmed that boarding subsidy for new pupils will be phased out since passend onderwijs was introduced, argued that a havo diploma is achievable without boarding, admitted no specific study was done on effects, and committed to further talks with Kentalis, Fodok and Dovenschap.
Question 3: What research was done into the effects of closing the boarding school and the available alternatives?
Vraag 3 Wat voor onderzoek is gedaan naar de effecten van de sluiting van het internaat en de beschikbare alternatieven?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake emotionele schade die kinderen oplopen omdat zij te laat worden doorverwezen naar het speciaal onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about children suffering emotional harm from late referral to special education under passend onderwijs, including financial incentives, crisis-situation placements, costs to schools, regional equalisation and enrolment figures. The state secretary answered that referral decisions rest on the needs of the child and on appeal rights, denied a rise in crisis placements, and provided cost tables and enrolment data while stating no new grounds to revise equalisation.

If the collaborative partnership does not issue an admission declaration and parents and/or the regular school believe special education is the best solution, they can object to the partnership's decision.

Geeft het samenwerkingsverband geen toelaatbaarheidsverklaring af en zijn ouders en/of de reguliere school van mening dat speciaal onderwijs de beste oplossing is, dan kunnen zij tegen het besluit van het samenwerkingsverband bezwaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol inzake het bericht "Teveel oude kijkers? Programma weg"

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about reports that the NPO may adapt or cancel programmes that attract many older viewers, and whether older viewers are being served proportionately. The State Secretary answered that the public broadcaster serves all ages, that the NPO may adjust programming when targets are missed, and that he sees no need to consult the NPO now.
Following the cited NRC Handelsblad article, I see no need to consult with the NPO at this time.
Naar aanleiding van het aangehaalde artikel in het NRC Handelsblad zie ik geen noodzaak om nu met de NPO in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Wie mag er naar een witte school’

MP Bisschop asked whether restricting parent choice to the eight nearest schools in Amsterdam undermines freedom of education and whether schools truly participate voluntarily in the central allocation system. The Secretary of State replied that all programmes remain available, that oversubscription forces schools to select objectively, that schools are free to opt out, and that he trusts participation is voluntary.
I have every confidence that primary schools participate voluntarily.
Ik heb er het volste vertrouwen in dat de basisscholen vrijwillig deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over calamiteitenzender NPO1

An MP from 50PLUS asked why the government website once named NPO1 and Radio 1 as national disaster broadcasters, and why the wording was later changed to refer to regional broadcasters. The minister replied that the Minister-President may requisition broadcast time in extraordinary circumstances, that the website wording was too narrow and has been corrected, and that the change is a clarification rather than a policy shift, while acknowledging the need for interdepartmental coordination on the answer's timing.
The sentence on the website, "In the event of a national disaster the disaster broadcaster is Nederland 1 or Radio 1", was an overly narrow formulation.
De zin «Bij een nationale ramp is de rampenzender Nederland 1 of radio 1» op de website betrof een te beperkte formulering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de aanhoudende onzekerheid voor kinderen met een meervoudige beperking en de intensieve zorg in de klas

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Education and of Health about persistent uncertainty for children with multiple disabilities who need intensive care in class, including funding of medical care at school, whether Wlz-funded care should be earmarked, and the reported letters from schools to parents. The government replied that funding and care rights are adequate, that earmarking is neither necessary nor desirable, that a national application procedure and a joint working agenda are being pursued, and that it will keep monitoring implementation.
As State Secretary Van Rijn indicated in the general consultation on 25 March, earmarking part of the Wlz indication for possible participation in education is neither necessary nor desirable.

Zoals de Staatssecretaris Van Rijn in het algemeen overleg op 25 maart heeft aangegeven, is het oormerken van een deel van de Wlz-indicatie voor een mogelijke deelname aan onderwijs niet nodig en niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk inzake het opheffen van NPO Radio 6

An SP MP asked the Secretary of State for Education, Culture and Science why the NPO plans to close NPO Radio 6 on 1 January 2016, challenging the efficiency rationale, audience figures, programming changes, and whether soul and jazz would be lost. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO decides programming and budget, that the decision awaits the concession policy plan due 15 June, and declined to intervene now.
It is up to the NPO to make programmatic considerations.
Het is aan de NPO om programmatische afwegingen te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Kritiek op aanpak radicalisering”

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government how it responds to criticism of its approach to radicalisation, the role of schools, the causes of radicalisation including discrimination, and whether schools can get specialist social workers. The government answered that schools play preventive, curative and repressive roles, describes existing support such as a hotline, training and the Stichting School en Veiligheid, rejects a dedicated social worker in every school as a matter of tailored support, and notes that research on causes is ongoing.
We have taken note of the criticism.
Wij hebben kennis genomen van de kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de kritiek vanuit het onderwijsveld op de huidige aanpak op het voorkomen van radicalisering onder jongeren

An MP asked the Minister of Education about education-sector criticism that children of immigrant background feel alienated, that deep-rooted injustice may fuel radicalisation, and whether schools should be relied on to counter radicalisation. The minister acknowledges the concern, says the causes are complex and points to ongoing research and the civic education approach, without introducing new powers or oversight.
We recognise that there are groups of pupils who do not feel recognised and acknowledged in this society.
Wij herkennen dat er groepen leerlingen zijn die zich niet herkend en erkend voelen in deze samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Karabulut over de toekomst van leerlingen die het praktijkonderwijs succesvol hebben doorlopen

MPs Siderius and Karabulut (SP) asked about the prospects of praktijkonderwijs (practical education) leavers, including barriers from language and maths requirements, the Participatiewet, sheltered work and dagbesteding, and whether the government will monitor and support school-leavers. The State Secretary answers that most leavers find work or continue training, that municipalities are now responsible for support, and that additional measures and monitoring are planned, without accepting parliamentary demands for extended follow-up or compensation for reduced ESF funds.
The cabinet does not expect a negative effect of the Participatiewet on the successful outflow of praktijkonderwijs pupils.
Het kabinet verwacht geen negatief effect van de Participatiewet op de succesvolle uitstroom van leerlingen uit het pro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg inzake de vastgelopen cao-onderhandelingen in het voortgezet onderwijs

MPs Van Meenen and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary for Education about stalled collective bargaining in secondary education, including the wage adjustment budget, whether lower ABP pension premiums created room for scholarships, and whether employers should pass the premium cut on to employees. The State Secretary answered that collective bargaining is decentralised, that employers decide how the cabinet contribution is used, and that he is not a party to the negotiations, declining to press employers and only promising to monitor developments.
That means it is up to the employers to decide how the cabinet contribution is used for the terms of employment.
Dat betekent dat het aan de werkgevers is om te bepalen op welke wijze de kabinetsbijdrage wordt ingezet voor de arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de mogelijkheid tot het geven van dubbele schooladviezen bij het doorstromen van het primair onderwijs naar het voortgezet onderwijs

MP Siderius asked whether it is desirable that a regional school consultation body in four municipalities requires primary schools to give only single school recommendations, ruling out combined advice, and what the government will do about it. The Staatssecretaris said he does not find this desirable, but that schools have room under current rules to make such agreements, so the arrangement is not directly unlawful; the inspectorate will raise the point with the regional body.
However, I have to establish that such agreements are not directly in conflict with the laws and regulations.
Ik moet echter vaststellen dat dergelijke afspraken niet direct strijdig zijn met de wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de handhaving van bevoegdheidseisen voor onderwijspersoneel in het voortgezet onderwijs

An MP asked how the government supervises whether secondary school teachers are qualified for the subjects they teach, where teachers can complain about unqualified colleagues, and whether the entry right incentivises schools to hire unqualified teachers. The Secretary of State answered that the Inspectorate and yearly national checks monitor qualifications, that school boards are the first point of contact for complaints, and that no link to the entry right was found, while promising further steps such as a registry pre-portal and an October progress report.
That is why I have every year all schools in secondary education investigated for all subjects whether the teachers who teach those subjects are also qualified.
Daarom laat ik jaarlijks op alle scholen in het voortgezet onderwijs voor alle vakken onderzoeken of de docenten die deze vakken geven ook bevoegd zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over leerlingen met ernstige vormen van dyslexie, die mogelijk geen gebruik kunnen maken van digitale woordenboeken tijdens het Centraal Schriftelijk Examen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius asked why the College voor Toetsen en Examens refuses digital dictionaries for pupils with severe dyslexia in the central written exam, despite a non-binding ruling by the Human Rights Institute, and whether the pupil Iris can use one. The State Secretary defends the refusal: a digital dictionary lowers the vocabulary requirement, alternatives such as oral support are adequate, and no guarantee can be given for Iris.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over passend onderwijs voor leerlingen met diabetes

An SP MP asked the state secretary for education what became of promised early-2015 measures on diabetes care in schools: a factsheet, an improved medical-procedures protocol and good-practice examples. The state secretary replied that the factsheet will soon be published digitally, the protocol revision is still underway with sector and patient organisations, and a legal exploration will be reported in the next progress report before the summer recess.
The factsheet on diabetes care in primary education will soon be made available digitally.
De factsheet diabeteszorg in het basisonderwijs wordt binnenkort digitaal beschikbaar gesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over zijn voorgenomen besluit gebruik te maken van zijn aanwijzingsbevoegdheid om het bestuur van de Stichting Scholengemeenschap Bonaire tot aftreden te dwingen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether funds meant for education at the Stichting Scholengemeenschap Bonaire were spent on non-education items and whether the Inspectorate had found signals of this. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate found no concrete indications of unlawful spending, that the accountant will still review lawfulness, and that he would recover any unlawfully spent euro if it later emerged.
There are currently no concrete indications of unlawful spending. Should this later prove to be the case, it is my policy to recover every unlawfully spent euro from the board concerned.

Er zijn op dit moment geen concrete aanwijzingen dat sprake is van onrechtmatige bestedingen. Mocht dit later blijken, dan is het mijn beleid om iedere onrechtmatig bestede euro terug te vorderen van het bestuur in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over gebrekkige sociale en maatschappelijke vorming op scholen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about schools' weak, unplanned approach to social and civic education, which the Inspectorate says is at minimum level with little development. The State Secretary agreed it is concerning, pointed to planned measures, the #Onderwijs2032 curriculum process, SLO support and Inspectorate thematic research, but declined to target the weakest schools specifically.
I have asked the Inspectorate to examine, in a thematic study, how schools fulfil their civic education task.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd om in een themaonderzoek te bekijken op welke manier scholen hun burgerschapstaak invullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de autistische Rebecca, die graag naar school wil, maar al 18 maanden thuis zit

An MP asked the state secretaries about a 15-year-old autistic girl kept at home for 18 months, the lack of a joined-up school and youth-care system, and related waiting lists and gaps in responsibility. The government says a suitable school placement has recently been found, cites privacy limits on details, and points to municipal responsibility and existing cooperation support without committing to new national measures.
I cannot go into all the details of this matter, because this concerns privacy-sensitive information.
Ik kan niet op alle details van deze kwestie ingaan, omdat dit privacygevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Rog over de bezorging van de centrale examens vo in mei 2015

Two MPs asked whether the Ministry's notice telling schools that closure on the exam-delivery day counts as not wishing to administer central exams was fair, and whether schools could receive redelivery. The State Secretary agreed with the substance to avoid theft risk, admitted the wording could have been clearer, but refused to guarantee redelivery except in cases of force majeure.
I regret that the notice on www.examenblad.nl led to irritation.
Ik betreur het dat de melding op www.examenblad.nl heeft geleid tot irritaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake het niet beschikbaar zijn van de website van de NOS tijdens de stroomstoring op 27 maart 2015
