An MP asked whether the NOS website was offline for an hour during a 27 March 2015 power outage and how the public broadcaster's emergency back-up and role as disaster broadcaster are arranged. The government replied the outage lasted about 20 minutes, that crisis.nl serves as the online equivalent, and that the back-up is partly realised with the cause of the failed generator at the data centre under investigation.
Yes, I have asked the NPO about this.
Ja, ik heb dit bij de NPO nagevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de toelaatbaarheidsverklaringen voor het speciaal onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about special education admission certificates (toelaatbaarheidsverklaringen): whether schools should decide without knowing pupils, whether a uniform form and earlier applications were appropriate, and whether the vso should fall under the secondary-education collective agreement. The state secretary defended the current division of responsibilities, said the uniform form applies only to severely multiply disabled pupils, rejected national admission criteria, and announced a planned unbundling of special and vso with a progress report before the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de sluiting van speciale school 't Nyrees in Almelo

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about the planned closure of the special school 't Nyrees in Almelo, its effects on pupils and staff, and the lack of a social plan. The State Secretary answered that the decision belongs to the samenwerkingsverband (school board consortium), which is currently considering a successor arrangement, and that the parents' council has consent rights over the support plan.
It is the responsibility of the samenwerkingsverband and the schools where these pupils are enrolled to ensure an appropriate offer.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het samenwerkingsverband en de scholen waar deze leerlingen ingeschreven zijn om te zorgen voor een passend aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op leraren

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about a report that most secondary schools employ fewer teachers than funded while growing non-teaching staff, and whether funds are misallocated away from teaching. The state secretary acknowledged the growth in support staff, rejected a causal link to workload, and rejected a fixed 80/20 teacher-support ratio as a blueprint, leaving the allocation to schools.
No. The ratio within the funding functions as a calculation model and not as a blueprint for how the funds are spent.
Nee. De verhouding binnen de bekostiging functioneert als rekenmodel en niet als blauwdruk voor de besteding van de middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op lerarenScholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op leraren

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary whether secondary schools deliberately underspend on teachers relative to funding, whether the lump-sum system allows misuse of funds, and whether schools should spend 80% on the classroom. The State Secretary answered that staffing ratios have been stable, that the 2012 surplus was small and in line with the Court of Audit's view, that the lump-sum system will be kept for its flexibility, and that the ratio is a calculation model rather than a mandated spending rule.
It is up to the schools, together with the staff representatives of the works council, to determine an appropriate ratio here.
Het is aan de scholen om, samen met de (personeelsgeleding van de) medezeggenschap, hier een passende verhouding in te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op leraren

An SP MP asked the state secretary to respond to a BON study claiming schools underspend on teachers under the lump-sum funding system, and to explain rising support staff shares and the use of 150 and 650 million euro akkoord funds for teacher hiring. The state secretary rejects that lump-sum causes fewer teachers, says schools have autonomy and monitoring runs through sector agreements and the inspectorate, and declines to measure the effect of specific funds on teacher numbers.
It is not possible to indicate which euro was spent on what, or whether schools would have made different choices had they not received this money.
Het is niet mogelijk aan te geven welke euro precies waaraan is besteed en of scholen andere keuzes gemaakt hadden als ze dit geld niet ontvangen hadden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht dat de administratieve lasten voor Jeugdzorginstellingen zijn toegenomen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether youth care administrative burdens have risen despite the reform's aim to cut bureaucracy, and whether standardised administrative processes and good examples exist. The State Secretary acknowledged that burdens have shifted and may rise during transition, pointed to a standard declaration and digital tools, cited Capelle aan den IJssel as an example, and said he is in consultation with municipalities and providers on reducing burdens.
I am in consultation with municipalities and institutions about reducing administrative burdens.
Ik ben in overleg met gemeenten en instellingen over het verminderen van administratieve lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake het aanstellen van conciërges en klassenassistenten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education how many concierges and classroom assistants had been hired since 1 January 2015 with the structural 50 million euro, how staffing changed in 2010-2014, and how many extra hours teachers gained. The State Secretary answered that the funds only became available early 2015, no staffing targets were agreed with sector organisations, staffing figures for 2015 come only in 2016, historical figures show a decline due to falling pupil numbers, and the extra teaching hours cannot be stated.
I can provide you with figures on the total number of education support staff and support and management staff (OOP/OBP) hired.
Ik kan u wel cijfers verstrekken over het totaal aangesteld onderwijsondersteunend personeel en ondersteunend en beheerspersoneel (OOP/OBP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Voordewind over het bericht 'Rotterdam fnuikt thuisonderwijs'.

MPs Bisschop and Voordewind asked whether Rotterdam's approach to home-schooling exemptions under the Leerplichtwet complies with the law, whether parents are properly informed, and whether pressure on parents is being exerted. The State Secretary answered that Rotterdam acts within the law, that exemptions are ultimately decided by courts, that parents can complain to the municipal ombudsman, and that he intends to remove the exemption ground from the law but no amendment takes effect for 2015–2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over rechterlijke uitspraken met betrekking tot de Wmo 2015

An MP asks the State Secretary how court rulings on Wmo 2015 home-help cuts (Montferland, Utrecht, Franekeradeel, Harlingen) should be interpreted, including whether co-payments and individual assessment are adequate and whether municipalities will be held to account. The State Secretary replies that courts stress individual, careful investigation and affordability, that municipalities remain responsible for their own policy, that no central register exists, and that intervention is possible only if municipalities persistently deviate from the law.
I therefore do not keep a list of municipalities that have reduced or ended home help.
Ik houd dan ook geen lijst bij van gemeenten die de huishoudelijke verzorging hebben versoberd of hebben beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius inzake de gewichtenregeling in het basisonderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether children whose parents only completed MBO level 1 receive no weighting in the primary-school weighting scheme and whether this is fair compared with vmbo. The State Secretary confirmed the rules, said no data exist on how many parents report MBO-1, and promised to report on possible revision of the scheme later in the year.
Schools administer the parents' education data for implementing the weighting scheme. OCW has no insight into this data.
Scholen administreren voor de uitvoering van de gewichtenregeling de opleidingsgegevens van de ouders. OCW heeft geen inzicht in deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma inzake mogelijke vooroordelen bij leerkrachten bij het geven van het schooladvies

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked whether teachers' school advice systematically underrates pupils of non-Dutch background, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate finds little evidence of ethnic bias in advice, that the CITO-to-advice gap disappears after correction, and that existing mechanisms for switching school levels are sufficient, so no further measures are needed.
In the report 'The quality of primary school advice' (2014), the Inspectorate of Education concludes there is little evidence that ethnicity influences the level of advice.
In het rapport « De kwaliteit van het basisschooladvies» (2014) concludeert de Inspectie van het Onderwijs dat er weinig evidentie is dat etniciteit van invloed is op de hoogte van de advisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Anne Mulder over de gevolgen van de nieuwe Wet werk en zekerheid (Wwz) voor het onderwijs

MPs Straus and Anne Mulder asked whether the new Wwz limit of three flexible contracts would cause problems replacing teachers and substitutes in primary and secondary education, and whether a sector exception to the chain rule was needed. The minister answered that substitution remains feasible through internal flexibility, substitute pools, on-call and min/max contracts, and cao deviations, so no sector exception is needed, though he will provide information and help find solutions.
An exception for education is therefore not necessary.
Een uitzondering voor het onderwijs is daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het bod van de NOS op de eredivisiesamenvattingen

An MP asked the State Secretary about the NOS bid for Eredivisie highlights, the confidential deal with FOX Sports, the reported EUR 75 million cost, STER-time arrangements and the timing of the Commissariaat voor de Media investigation. The State Secretary said the financial details and STER arrangements remain confidential under the agreement, that the Commissariaat has published a decision and will widen its investigation, and that transparency in future contracts is being discussed with the NPO and NOS.
Because of the confidentiality agreed between the NOS and EMM, I have so far been unable to make public any information on the financial details of the contract, and I cannot do so now.
Vanwege de geheimhouding die de NOS en EMM zijn overeengekomen heb ik tot op heden geen informatie over de financiële details van de overeenkomst openbaar kunnen maken en kan ik dat ook nu niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias inzake STER-afspraken in het NOS-contract voor de eredivisiesamenvattingen

An MP asked the State Secretary about STER advertising arrangements in the NOS contract for Eredivisie highlights, including free spots for Fox and whether these lower STER payments to the media budget. The government answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is responsible for assessing Mediawet compliance, is investigating and has extended its inquiry to STER, and that it will await the outcome without commenting on legality itself.
The Commissariaat announced on 19 January 2015 that it is continuing and widening its investigation into the purchase of Eredivisie highlights rights to other parties, including the Ster.

Het Commissariaat heeft op 19 januari 2015 aangekondigd dat het zijn onderzoek naar de aankoop van de rechten op de Eredivisiesamenvattingen vervolgt en verbreedt naar andere partijen, waaronder de Ster.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over afspraken tussen FOX en NOS

MP Verhoeven asks the state secretary about the NOS-EMM deal giving Fox free spots, possible Mediawet violations, NPO knowledge of the deal, responsibility, and Ster revenue impact. The secretary answers that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating and extending its inquiry, that the NPO was informed at mandate level, that the NOS is responsible for its contracts, and that confidentiality limits disclosure of figures and contract terms.

On 19 January 2015 the Commissariaat voor de Media announced that it is continuing and widening its investigation into the purchase of the Eredivisie summary rights to other parties, including the Ster.

Het Commissariaat heeft op 19 januari 2015 aangekondigd dat het zijn onderzoek naar de aankoop van de rechten op de Eredivisiesamenvattingen vervolgt en verbreedt naar andere partijen, waaronder de Ster.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de verplichte herbestedingsregels voor de ambulante begeleiding binnen het zogenaamde passend onderwijs

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether unclear rules on mandatory reallocation of ambulatory support budgets from special schools to regional cooperation bodies are causing confusion, whether agreements are being kept, and about the financial and staffing consequences. The State Secretary answered that information is provided via letters, factsheets and an advisory committee, that the agreements are in law and the Inspectorate can intervene if they are not kept, and that some cooperation bodies are opting out while exact amounts for some budgets cannot be given.
If signals show that this is not happening, that is reason for the Inspectorate of Education to start a conversation about it.
Indien uit signalen blijkt dat dit niet gebeurt, is dat reden voor de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) om daarover het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias inzake de nieuwe ledenwervingsactie van Omroep Max

An MP asked the state secretary about Omroep Max's membership campaign offering a free book worth more than the membership fee, whether this breaches the Mediawet ban on benefits, the status of the Commissariaat's fine, and the regulator's sanction options. The state secretary agreed the offer is undesirable, confirmed the ban on monetary benefits took effect on 1 January 2015, reported a fine of 180,000 euros imposed on Omroep Max, and listed the regulator's available instruments.
The Commissariaat will shortly carry out a sample check to see whether the ban is being complied with.
Het Commissariaat zal binnenkort een steekproef houden om te zien of het verbod goed wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over de bestedingen van de overheid aan onderzoek en innovatie

MP Van Veen asked the government whether public spending on research and innovation is falling, what figures the Rathenau Institute relies on, which definition of innovation applies, and whether a total overview of such spending can be included in the budget. The State Secretary acknowledged a decline in public investment mainly due to earlier cuts but said levels remain relatively high, listed planned increases to NWO and Horizon 2020 matching, and declined to put the overview in the budget, pointing to the independent Rathenau publication instead.
The cabinet attaches importance to the independent institute Rathenau producing an overview that gives insight into the level of public funds of the central government for research and innovation.
Het kabinet hecht eraan dat het onafhankelijk instituut Rathenau een overzicht maakt dat inzicht biedt in de hoogte van de publieke middelen van het Rijk voor onderzoek en innovatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Oosenbrug over de slechte ontvangst van TV West en TV Utrecht

MPs Mohandis and Oosenbrug asked whether the government is aware of poor reception of TV West and TV Utrecht after the channels were re-tuned, and whether this is undesirable given their emergency-broadcasting role; they also asked about frequency choice and when Ziggo will resolve it. The Secretary of State confirmed awareness, noted that the regional radio stations (not TV) are formal emergency broadcasters, said frequency management is Ziggo's responsibility, and reported that Ziggo promised to fix complaints via a free cable and technician visit, with all complaints so far resolved.
The emergency broadcaster status applies only to radio, not to television and online media.
De status van calamiteitenzender geldt alleen voor de radio, niet voor televisie en online media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over de ontvangst van de regionale publieke omroep via Ziggo

MP Pieter Heerma (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about poor reception of regional public broadcasters via Ziggo after the UPC network merger, including hundreds of complaints, the role of regional broadcasters as calamity channels, and interference from 4G and DVB-T. The State Secretary confirmed the complaints, explained the must-carry obligations and interference causes, and said Ziggo would send free cables and dispatch technicians where needed.
Ziggo has promised me to take all complaints received very seriously and first sends viewers experiencing interference a free coax cable.
Ziggo heeft mij beloofd alle ontvangen klachten zeer serieus te nemen en stuurt de kijkers die storingen ervaren eerst een gratis coaxkabel op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Otwin van Dijk over onduidelijkheid scheiding onderwijs- en zorgbudget voor ernstig gehandicapte kinderen

MPs Ypma and Otwin van Dijk asked how care and education budgets for severely disabled children during school hours are divided, and what happens when schools, municipalities and insurers cannot agree on funding. The state secretary answered that the boundary is individual, care can be agreed in the child's Wlz care plan, a consultation guide and support are offered, and a regulation will redirect about EUR 6-8 million of previously compensated funds to special schools from 2015-2016.
I am aware that there are signals of unclarity about the provision of care and support during school hours for children with severe multiple disabilities.
Het is mij bekend dat er signalen zijn over onduidelijkheden rondom de invulling van zorg en ondersteuning tijdens schooltijd voor kinderen met een ernstige meervoudige beperking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Mohandis over de aanpak van radicalisering en de handelingsverlegenheid van scholen om de actualiteit naar aanleiding van de gebeurtenissen in Parijs bespreekbaar te maken in d

MPs Marcouch and Mohandis asked how the government addresses radicalisation and why schools struggle to discuss the Paris attacks in class, including training, teaching materials and teacher education. The minister answers that schools are expected to act on their civic mandate, that training and portals exist, that a Jihadism intervention team is being discussed with municipalities, and that further studies and reports will follow.
We will return to this in the spring when we report on progress on citizenship education.
Wij zullen hier nader op ingaan als we in het voorjaar rapporteren over de voortgang op burgerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Straus over het bericht ‘Schrik na drie steekpartijen op school in week’

MPs Tellegen and Straus asked the state secretary and justice minister about school stabbings and rising reported weapon possession among pupils, including its causes, the types of weapons, and measures to curb it. The government answered that it is addressing weapon possession through school safety policy, checklists and the Convenant Veilige School, but that the monitor cannot confirm an objective rise in weapon possession, which may reflect stricter reporting and zero-tolerance policy.
I will also have the checklist for introducing weapon possession controls at schools updated.
Ook laat ik de «checklist invoering controle op wapenbezit scholen» actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Jadnanansing over de ‘Global Teacher Prize 2015’

MPs Duisenberg and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about the 2015 Global Teacher Prize, the nomination of a Dutch history teacher, and whether online platforms could share the stories of the nominees. The secretary answered that the government supports the prize's aims, that learning from abroad matters, and that the ministry has started exploring online dissemination via its social media and a teachers' website.
We have started this exploration and it turns out that the Global Teacher Prize organisation is already very active on social media
Wij zijn deze verkenning gestart en het blijkt dat de organisatie van de Global Teacher Prize zelf al zeer actief is op social media
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Halaleten voor elke scholier'

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Education whether a Christian school imposing halal food on all pupils, including non-Muslims, on a school trip is unacceptable and whether the proposal will be withdrawn. The State Secretary answered that schools are free to make such choices within the law, parents can raise concerns with school leadership and through the works council, and the national government has no role in meal decisions.
Schools are free to make their own choices, within the limits of laws and regulations.
Scholen zijn vrij om, binnen de grenzen van de wet- en regelgeving, hun eigen keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht dat scholen blijven werken met afgekeurde antipestmethoden

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the state secretary whether a report on rejected anti-bullying programmes exists, why it was not shared with parliament, and whether schools were being misled. The state secretary answered that no such report exists beyond the published assessment, that individual feedback to programme owners is confidential as business-sensitive, and that rejection does not mean a programme is harmful.
Regarding the individual feedback, the committee of the Dutch Youth Institute agreed with the programme owners that it would remain confidential.
Over de individuele feedback heeft de commissie van het Nederlands Jeugdinstituut met de programmaeigenaren afgesproken dat dit vertrouwelijk zou blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het in stand houden van regulier onderwijs met specifieke locaties voor zorgleerlingen in het passend onderwijs

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about the threatened continuation of special-needs locations within regular schools, including the Jorisschool in Nijmegen and a Rotterdam closure, the wider impact of passend onderwijs on funding, bureaucracy, care procurement and cluster 3 financing. The State Secretary replied that closure of the Jorisschool is not currently on the table, that responsibility for a covering support structure lies with the samenwerkingsverband and school boards, and that no national measures to sustain such facilities or change funding by location are planned.
Incidentally, responsibility for a comprehensive support structure lies with the samenwerkingsverband passend onderwijs.
Overigens ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor een dekkende ondersteuningsstructuur bij het samenwerkingsverband passend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over passend onderwijs voor chronisch zieke leerlingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether the Passend Onderwijs system adequately serves chronically ill pupils who cannot follow full-time programmes, and what measures will be taken. The State Secretary rejected the premise, pointing to existing options such as leave from school attendance, spread examinations and case-by-case support by schools, the inspectorate and truancy officers, and announced no new measures.
There is no overview of the number of chronically ill pupils who cannot follow a full-time education programme.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal chronisch zieke leerlingen dat geen fulltime onderwijsprogramma kan volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elias en Straus over het functioneren van L1 als rampenzender tijdens de asbest-situatie in Roermond

Two VVD MPs asked whether regional broadcaster L1 should function as a disaster broadcaster during the Roermond asbestos fire, how quickly it reported compared with national media, and whether the government will improve regional disaster reporting. The minister replied that L1 was not formally activated as calamity broadcaster, that the safety region chose other channels, and that an evaluation with the province, safety regions and L1 will follow.
For the timeline of journalistic coverage of the incident on the various platforms of broadcaster L1 and other media, I refer you to the broadcasters concerned.
Voor de tijdlijn van de journalistieke verslaggeving van het incident op de verschillende platforms van omroep L1 en andere media, verwijs ik u naar de betreffende omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de effectiviteit van Voor- en vroegschoolse educatie (vve)

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about claims by Prof. Fukkink that VVE early-childhood programmes are ineffective, and about the evidence on their effectiveness and suggested improvements. The Secretary rejects the claim, cites international and CPB evidence and the ongoing Pre-COOL study, and says the views of researchers will be considered in the government's policy response.
In January 2015 OCW is inviting Prof. Fukkink and other scientists to discuss the evaluation results of the Oke Act.
OCW nodigt in januari 2015 prof.dr. Fukkink en andere wetenschappers uit om te praten over de evaluatieresultaten van de wet Oke.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het bericht “Burgemeester 'geeft' Omroep West-baas bonus”

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about reports that a mayor approved a 13,844 euro bonus for the director of regional broadcaster Omroep West, which may breach the WNT pay-cap law, and about related questions on the L1 case, oversight and subsidy conditions. The minister says the Commissariaat voor de Media found the bonus was paid, that a fuller WNT compliance investigation is underway with results expected within six weeks, that bonuses are generally barred under the WNT, and that proactive checks at other regional broadcasters will follow.
It is expected that the entire investigation can be completed within six weeks.
Naar verwachting kan het hele onderzoek binnen zes weken worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat scholieren in Amsterdam zijn mishandeld, afgeperst en met de dood bedreigd

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about reports that pupils in Amsterdam were extorted, assaulted and threatened, and whether this is widespread in schools. The government answered that schools bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate monitors the situation and has found limited signals at three schools, and that it will keep watching and support schools via the School and Safety centre.
The inspectorate remains alert to the situation and will explicitly hold schools to account for adequately safeguarding pupils' safety where necessary.
De inspectie blijft alert op de situatie en spreekt scholen zo nodig nadrukkelijk aan op adequate borging van de veiligheid van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Ypma over de gevaren van sociale media voor minder begaafde jongeren

MPs Rebel and Ypma asked about risks social media poses to young people with intellectual disabilities, including data on cyberbullying and abuse, available teaching materials, and whether a dedicated reporting point is needed. The government acknowledges the heightened vulnerability, says data on prevalence for this group cannot be provided, points to a Rutgers/CED project and ongoing talks on filling material gaps, and states that meldknop.nl is the place for reports for everyone.
However, we cannot give you insight into the extent of the problem.
Wij kunnen u echter geen inzicht geven in de omvang van de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over ‘de kritiek op de rekentoets van een wiskundedocent in het Onderwijsblad’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about a mathematics teacher's criticism of the rekentoets (arithmetic test), including calls to scrap it and doubts about teacher support. The State Secretary rejects the characterization of the test as an intelligence or eye test, cites teacher involvement and broad support, says the test is improved and that the union position is not a direct consultation partner, and notes a temporary adjustment of its role in the pass/fail rule is under review.
I therefore disagree with the remark that the arithmetic test does not test the arithmetic skills of young people.
Ik ben het dan ook oneens met de opmerking dat de rekentoets de rekenvaardigheden van jongeren niet toetst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de afspraken tussen het voorgezetonderwijs en het basisonderwijs over verkapte toelatingstoetsen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether an IQ test used by the Waterland primary-secondary transition protocol functions as a disguised admission test that replaces the mandatory national final test, and what sanctions apply. The State Secretary answered that the IQ test is only one data source supporting the primary school advice, that the advice remains decisive for admission, that the protocol was clarified, and that the inspectorate will monitor compliance with a proactive approach.
The department, together with the inspectorate, will enter into direct consultation with the parties involved in a number of these cases in early 2015.
Het departement zal samen met de inspectie begin 2015 in een aantal van deze gevallen direct in overleg treden met betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de brief van het College voor Toetsen en Examens over de centrale eindtoets

An MP asks whether a November letter from the College voor Toetsen en Examens to school directors, carrying the government logo, wrongly suggests only the central end-of-primary test is allowed, and whether alternative test providers can get equal communication. The State Secretary denies any misleading impression, explains that the ministry informs schools about all permitted tests and subsidises alternative providers to communicate with schools.
The letter clearly stated that, besides the central end-of-primary test, other permitted end-of-primary tests may also be chosen.
In de brief is duidelijk aangegeven dat naast de centrale eindtoets, ook kan worden gekozen voor andere toegelaten eindtoetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het sectorplan primair onderwijs

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why the Jong en Oud subsidy in the primary education sector plan excludes young teachers who had a regular paid job in the previous six months, and whether this conflicts with teacher shortage goals. The minister answered that the condition is intended to target labour-market-vulnerable youth, that uptake so far is lagging (25.3 fte applications), and that changing the rules retroactively is undesirable.

An amendment of the Regulation as proposed is not desirable to me, because the measures for hiring vulnerable workers are specifically intended to offer opportunities to people at a distance from the labour market.

Een aanpassing van de Regeling zoals voorgesteld acht ik niet gewenst omdat de maatregelen voor indienstneming van kwetsbare werknemers, bij uitstek zijn bedoeld om personen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt kansen te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Scholen spelen privégegevens leerlingen door naar uitgevers”

MPs Rog, Voordewind and Van Dijk asked whether schools pass non-anonymised pupil data to publishers without parental consent, and why a 2014 privacy audit was not sent to parliament. The state secretary answered that consent is not required under the school's task-based legal ground, that pseudonymisation is being developed, and that the audit was withheld as a limited, policy-confirming exploration later published online.
The report was therefore not sent to your House.
Het rapport is daarom niet aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de voorgenomen sluiting van de St. Suitbertusschool in de gemeente Montferland (Stokkum)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education about the planned closure of St. Suitbertusschool in Stokkum (Montferland), its merger with a nearby school, the effect on village liveability, and whether small schools could be kept open. The State Secretary answered that closure is the responsibility of the school board, that the merger is carefully prepared due to falling pupil numbers, that he has no means to keep the school open, and that he will propose a law easing the rules on cooperative schools.
It is not for me to give a judgment on a decision to close or merge a school.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over een besluit tot sluiting of fusie van een school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over problemen met ontvangst van Omroep Zeeland via Digitenne

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about poor reception of regional broadcaster Omroep Zeeland via Digitenne and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the public broadcaster meets its licence conditions of at least rooftop reception, that improvement is for Digitenne and NPO to pursue, and that alternatives such as cable, DSL, fibre and streaming exist, leaving the assessment of their adequacy to Omroep Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat NPO televisietoestellen gaat afluisteren

An MP asked whether the NPO app's new feature, which recognises audio watermarks to synchronise second-screen content and enrich commercials, breaches privacy and fits the public broadcaster's remit. The State Secretary answered that the feature is consent-based, user-switchable, does not store viewing data, fits the NPO's innovation mandate, and cost EUR 20,000 in development plus EUR 110,000 in annual licence fees.
I do not share the view that this feature infringes people's privacy at the NPO.
Ik deel de mening niet dat er met deze functie door de NPO inbreuk gemaakt wordt op de privacy van mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat beginnende leraren veel stress ervaren

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about research showing beginning teachers in urban schools experience high stress and whether the problem is broader and growing. The State Secretary acknowledged the research, pointed to ongoing measures in the Lerarenagenda and sector agreements to improve induction and reduce workload, and noted the promising Meesterschap programme.
The Lerarenagenda therefore includes a number of measures to improve the guidance of all beginning teachers.
In de Lerarenagenda is daarom een aantal maatregelen opgenomen om de begeleiding van alle beginnende leraren te verbeteren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over het EO-programma ‘Rot Op Naar Je Eigen Land’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether the EO broadcaster would make equivalent programmes confronting PvdA, GroenLinks and D66 voters, and how the EO programme 'Rot Op Naar Je Eigen Land' fits the Mediawet's balance and quality requirements. The state secretary replied that no such programmes are in preparation, that the programme follows an Australian format, and that compliance with the Mediawet will only become clear after broadcast, with the EO responsible for content since the Constitution bars prior supervision.
Whether the programme complies with the various provisions of the Mediawet will become apparent in due course upon broadcast (start in January 2015).
Of het programma voldoet aan de diverse bepalingen van de Mediawet, zal te zijner tijd blijken bij uitzending (start in januari 2015).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de hoogte van de kosten van schoolexcursies op middelbare scholen

The MP asks whether extremely expensive school excursions in secondary education push parents into financial trouble, lead to segregation, and exclude pupils, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answers that excursions are paid from the voluntary parental contribution, that schools are free to set their profile, that parents' representatives must monitor affordability, and that the inspectorate supervises school cost policy, promising to discuss the issue with the VO-raad.
A task of the parents' representatives is to ensure that the total costs for parents remain manageable.
Een taak van de oudergeleding is om erop toe te zien dat de totale kosten voor ouders beheersbaar blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Mohandis en Segers over het bericht “Bonus directeur regionale omroep L1 onder de loep”

MPs Kerstens, Mohandis and Segers asked whether regional broadcaster L1 paid a director a bonus of over 26,000 euro, whether bonuses fall under WNT transitional law, and how unlawful bonuses are recovered and sanctioned. The Minister answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating, that bonuses agreed after 6 December 2011 are unlawful and must be recovered via a set procedure with penalty orders, and that he will consult VNG and IPO on model subsidy rules.
The Commissariaat voor de Media is currently investigating this.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media onderzoekt dit momenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over scholen die ouders verplichten tot aanschaf van een iPad

SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Education whether schools may require parents to buy iPads, which can cost up to 1,000 euro, and how the 'free' versus 'cost-free' distinction and school financing are handled. The State Secretary replied that schools may not compel purchase of tablets or laptops, that voluntary parental contributions are allowed with cost-free alternatives, and that the Inspectorate has received a stable number of complaints and ordered corrections at 17 schools.
I asked the Inspectorate whether it has received signals about schools where questions have arisen about parental contributions and school costs.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd of zij signalen hebben ontvangen over scholen waar vragen zijn gerezen over de ouderbijdrage en schoolkosten voor ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Rog over het bericht dat een docente de Tweede Kamer niet op de hoogte mocht stellen van fouten in rekentoetsen van het Cito

MPs Van Meenen and Rog asked whether teachers may be prevented from reporting alleged errors in Cito arithmetic tests to parliament, and whether the Wob refusal to disclose test items is justified. The Secretary of State answered that teachers may discuss errors but must not publish items online to protect reuse, that complaints go to the Examenloket, and that disclosure would harm the CvTE's statutory tasks; a fuller policy letter on access rights is promised for December.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen met betrekking tot onderwijs voor ernstig meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen, kinderen met forse gedragsproblematiek en kinderen met een (zware) verstandelijke beperki

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked how education for severely disabled children is funded from 1 January 2015, whether their right to passend onderwijs is guaranteed, and whether there is handling difficulty among providers and municipalities. The Secretary of State gave figures, explained the shift of care funding to the Jeugdwet, Zvw and Wlz, and said the government will monitor developments, without committing to new research.
I do not recognise the handling difficulty regarding referral to (v)so schools, but I will keep following developments.
Ik herken de handelingsverlegenheid ten aanzien van het doorverwijzen naar scholen voor het (v)so dan ook niet, maar ik zal de ontwikkelingen blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Siderius over “verwarring en onjuistheden in de investeringsbrief van OCW”

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Siderius (SP) asked the Education Minister about alleged errors and confusion in the OCW investment letter, including the claimed 500-euro professionalisation budget, the 1.2 billion investment figure, the effect of the wage freeze, and where Herfstakkoord money went. The Minister and State Secretary largely reject the criticism, state that the budget is at school level rather than personal, that the money is partly reallocated existing funds, and that school boards are monitored; they acknowledge the wording could have been clearer.
The wording about the personal budget in the letter could have better matched the wording in the collective agreement.
De formulering rondom het persoonlijk budget in de brief had beter kunnen aansluiten op de formulering in de cao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Fritsma over het bericht dat scholen de toestroom van asielkinderen nauwelijks aan kunnen

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Education how schools will cope with asylum-seeker children, including the extra costs for Den Helder and nationwide up to 2017, and whether the open-borders policy is disrupting education. The state secretary answered with cost estimates (about 630,000 euro for Den Helder; 22, 38 and 41 million euro nationally across three school years), said the schools are capable of providing education, and rejected closing the borders as a means to improve quality.
I do not share this view.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Schouw over de financiële problemen van scholen in het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs die te maken hebben met een grote toestroom aan asielkinderen

D66 MPs asked whether schools receiving large numbers of asylum-seeker children face financing problems linked to the funding system's limited enrolment measurement dates, and what action will be taken. The State Secretary says existing facilities are sufficient, will amend an application deadline for procedure-reception locations, is examining specific bottlenecks with the PO-raad, and is discussing intensified support with schools.
To make it possible for schools to use these facilities directly even after 1 July, I will amend this scheme so that schools can also submit an application at a later point in time.

Om het voor scholen mogelijk te maken ook na 1 juli direct van deze faciliteiten gebruik te kunnen maken, zal ik deze regeling aanpassen, zodat scholen ook op een later moment een aanvraag kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Maij over het onderwijs aan asielkinderen

MPs Ypma and Maij asked the state secretary about schools being overwhelmed by asylum-seeker children and whether education for them is adequate. The state secretary replied that no school signals were received, that the inspectorate found one weak location which improved, and that talks with support bodies on intensifying help are ongoing.

I am in discussion with the national working group on education support for asylum seekers and newcomers (Lowan), which supports schools in making education possible at the new locations, and with the PO-raad to consider how the support can be intensified.

Ik ben in gesprek met de landelijke werkgroep onderwijsondersteuning asielzoekers en nieuwkomers (Lowan) die ondersteuning levert aan scholen om het onderwijs op de nieuwe locaties mogelijk te maken, en met de PO-raad om te bezien op welke manier de ondersteuning kan worden geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdiensten voor bijbanen in publieke dienst

An MP asked the government about reports that former minister Uri Rosenthal received raised fees for his advisory council chairmanship and how much he earns from public-sector side jobs, and whether officials should earn no more than a minister. The government replied that the report was wrong, that the fee was actually lowered, that a calculation error in the published decision was corrected, and that the Remuneration Decree already caps combined fees at a minister's salary.
The internal checks on decisions sent to the Staatscourant have been tightened.
De interne controles op besluiten die naar de Staatscourant gaan, zijn verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de mogelijk abusievelijke verdubbeling van de vergoeding van de voorzitter van de Adviesraad voor Wetenschap en Techniek

An MP asked whether the chair of the Advisory Council for Science and Technology (AWT) received a salary increase after appointment and again in September 2014, and why a decision was published with an erroneous fee. The State Secretary answered that a temporary 0.1 FTE increase in 2013 was requested by the chair, that an erroneous calculation in an October 2014 Staatscourant publication was corrected, and that internal checks have been tightened.
Internal checks on decisions sent to the Staatscourant have now been tightened.
De interne controles op besluiten die naar de Staatscourant gaan, zijn inmiddels verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de problemen die het speciaal onderwijs ondervindt bij de bekostiging van medische zorg voor leerlingen

An MP asked whether special schools face insufficient budgets for care (supervision, personal care, nursing) for pupils with severe multiple disabilities after the AWBZ reform and the introduction of passend onderwijs, and about funding, bureaucracy and possible grouping of these pupils. The state secretary answered that care remains secured under the Jeugdwet, Zvw and Wlz, that continuity is provided through transitional rules, that the government is monitoring the situation and working on handreikingen, that a bureaucracy study is underway, and that a separate financing group for these pupils is not desirable.
It is a worrying signal that there are schools for (secondary) special education that indicate at this stage that they have insufficient (visibility of) budgets.
Het is een zorgelijk signaal dat er scholen voor (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs (het (v)so) zijn die in deze fase aangeven onvoldoende (zicht op) budgetten te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de belabberde kwaliteit van het leerlingenvervoer voor kinderen met een beperking

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about poor quality of school transport for disabled children, alleged price-driven European tenders, bankruptcies, the Gorinchem and Utrecht incidents, tariffs and parental escort duties. The State Secretary replied that quality and price are weighed in tenders, the 2009 handbook was updated in 2013, European tendering should not be banned, and municipalities are responsible for implementation and tariffs.
Responsibility for implementing school transport lies with the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Omtzigt inzake naheffingen bij scholengemeenschappen

MPs Rog and Omtzigt asked about Tax Authority back-tax assessments on school communities for lunch-supervision volunteer allowances, including whether they reach back five years and whether they fit the participation policy. The state secretary defended the volunteer exemption rules, said the Tax Authority can correct up to five years and may impose fines, and declined to intervene or ask for reduced penalties.
I cannot make further statements about individual cases in the context of these questions.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik in het kader van deze vragen geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de cijfers over het aantal thuiszitters in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary for an overview of compulsory-education children not attending school (thuiszitters) for 2010-2014, broken down by age and school type. The secretary provided figures for 2009-2012 only, noting 2013 and 2014 data are not yet available, that age breakdowns are unavailable, and that counting definitions vary across municipalities so the true number of stay-at-home children is probably lower than reported.
No data are available on the age of absolute truants and stay-at-home children.
Over de leeftijd van de absoluut verzuimers en de thuiszitters zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen c.s. over het bericht dat er zeer suggestieve vragen staan in de ‘Blikopener’-methode voor maatschappijleer op het VMBO

MPs asked whether the Blikopener social studies method for VMBO contains leading questions about Moroccan youth, headscarves and Islam, and reinforces gender stereotypes, and whether the method should be revised. The State Secretary answered that schools and teachers choose their own methods, that the content of methods is not for the government to judge, that there is no central quality control on methods beyond inspectorate oversight of coverage of attainment targets, and that the questions were not substantively addressed beyond referring back to the same general position.
It is not for me to assess the content of teaching methods or schools' choice of teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om de inhoud van lesmethodes of de keuze van scholen voor lesmethodes te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over het gebruik van cookies bij de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO)

An MP asked the minister whether the NPO's repeated use of tracking cookies without prior consent, flagged by the Dutch data protection authority, would be addressed and whether the CBP report would be sent to parliament. The minister declined to judge an independent regulator's individual decision, noted NPO has taken measures, and said websites must comply with the law without committing to concrete government action.
It is not for the cabinet to give a judgement on a decision of an independent supervisor in an individual case.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over een besluit van een onafhankelijke toezichthouder in een individueel geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de afspraken tussen het voorgezet onderwijs en het basisonderwijs over verkapte toelatingstoetsen

Ypma (PvdA) asks whether the 'Waterlandse overstap' protocol, under which secondary schools fund an intelligence test used by primary schools for school advice, amounts to a disguised admission test in breach of the new central final test law. Secretary Dekker answers that the protocol is not in conflict with the law, that the school advice remains leading, and that the protocol will be adjusted and monitored.
The school advice was already leading in this protocol and will remain so.
Het schooladvies was in dit protocol al leidend en zal dat blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Siderius en Van Gerven over sluikreclame op scholen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether food companies' so-called educational visits to schools (such as Ronald McDonald Shows and Blue Band lesson packs) amount to disguised advertising and should be banned. The Secretary of State answered that the Reclamecode voor Voedingsmiddelen permits such campaigns only with approval from a recognised authority, promised tightened rules by end 2014 and a letter in spring 2015, but rejected a statutory ban.
I expect the intended tightening to be in place by the end of this year. In spring 2015 I will inform you about this and give you my response.
Ik verwacht dat de beoogde aanscherpingen uiterlijk aan het einde van dit jaar tot stand zijn gekomen. In het voorjaar van 2015 zal ik u hierover informeren en u mijn reactie hierop geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over scholen die ouders onder druk zetten om schoolkosten te betalen die helemaal niet verplicht zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether schools pressure parents into paying non-mandatory school costs, including a vmbo tool kit of €200 required for a course. The State Secretary answered that complaints to the Inspectorate stayed stable (95 and 97), that toelating may never depend on parental contributions, schools must communicate transparent cost policies, and the Inspectorate supervises compliance and acts if violations occur, but will not name individual schools.
The works council also has an important role.
Ook de medezeggenschapsraad heeft een belangrijke rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht «Luchtkwaliteit scholen onvoldoende» van BNR Nieuwsradio

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a BNR report that school air quality is insufficient, including whether investments improved it, whether measurements are needed, and whether all primary schools have received a free CO2 meter. The state secretary answered that funds were largely spent, that schools bear responsibility for indoor climate with a stimulating role for government, that additional measurements are not necessary, and that CO2 meters have been or will be delivered to all schools that requested one.
It is expected that the meters will be delivered at the start of the new heating season (September–October).
Naar verwachting zullen bij de aanvang van het nieuwe stookseizoen (september–oktober) de meters worden uitgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Reddingsbrigade een ongekend drukke tijd heeft

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about declining swimming ability among children, whether compulsory swimming lessons were abolished as a cause, whether the Zwem-ABC should be required, the decline of school swimming, and whether a new safety-net scheme should be reinstated. The minister answered that 94% of children still obtain at least one swimming diploma, that swimming skill is mainly parents' responsibility, that no evidence links the abolition to declining skills, and that no new safety-net scheme is planned.
I see no reason to do so.
Ik zie hier geen aanleiding toe.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake het feit dat aanbieders van een alternatieve eindtoets PO hun verantwoording voor 1 augustus 2014 moesten inleveren bij het ministerie om een goedkeuring te kunnen krijgen

An MP asked why providers of alternative primary-school final tests had to submit their documentation by 1 August 2014, the timing of the Toetswijzer, the independence of COTAN assessors and whether schools will really have a choice of tests. The Secretary of State answered that both applications are still incomplete, that the Expert Group will advise by 1 December, that a transitional arrangement and subsidy are in place, and that the central test will be checked by the CvTE, but gave no firm guarantee of choice.
Both test providers have been asked to supplement their application.
Beide toetsaanbieders is gevraagd hun aanvraag aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de onzinnigheid van voorschoolse extra taallessen voor allochtonen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about a study reporting no proven effect of pre-school language programmes for children of immigrant background, the cost of roughly 400 million euro per year, and whether parents should bear the costs. The State Secretary disputed that the study shows no effect, cited ongoing quality issues and a forthcoming longitudinal study, gave the annual budget figures, and rejected full cost recovery from parents because education is a child's right.
The pre-cool study does meet the conditions for (quasi-)experimental research, so that reliable conclusions become possible.
Met het «pre-cool» onderzoek wordt wel voldaan aan de voorwaarden voor (quasi) experimenteel onderzoek zodat betrouwbare uitspraken mogelijk worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Straus over de effecten van Voor- en vroegschoolse educatie (VVE)

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Education about a Radboud University study finding little effect of early childhood education (VVE), its relation to the Inspectorate's critical 2013 report, whether quality will improve, and measurability and segregation issues. The state secretary disputes the study's conclusion as not supported (no baseline or control group, quality still lagging 2007-2011), promises a progress report in November and a 'pre-cool' cohort study in 2015, and declines to tighten effectiveness scrutiny.
The conclusion that VVE has hardly any effect cannot be drawn on the basis of the report mentioned.
De conclusie dat vve nauwelijks effect heeft kan op basis van het genoemde rapport niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over berichten dat ouders zelf moeten betalen voor het vervoer van hun gehandicapte kind

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Education whether municipalities may make parents of disabled children pay for school transport, and how municipalities decide whether a child can travel independently. The State Secretary answered that children who cannot travel independently are entitled to free transport, that municipal assessments rest on expert advice with appeal to the courts available, and that he has received no signals of parents being charged.
It is up to the municipalities to incorporate these changes into their school transport regulations.
Het is aan de gemeenten om deze wijzigingen te verwerken in hun regeling leerlingenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en De Graaf over het bericht dat op de Amsterdamse islamitische basisscholen El Amien I en II een angstcultuur heerst

PVV MPs asked whether a press report of a climate of fear, misused education funds and suspiciously high Cito scores at Amsterdam Islamic primary schools El Amien I and II justifies action, and whether the minister now has the powers to intervene such as closure. The minister answered that the inspectorate found improper spending that will be recovered, found no evidence of breaches of democratic values, that governance is inadequate so the board was ordered to improve, and that a follow-up inspection in Q4 2014 will determine whether to intervene further.
The inspectorate is preparing the recovery of unlawfully spent amounts and will continue to closely monitor the situation.
De inspectie bereidt de terugvordering van onrechtmatig bestede bedragen voor en blijft nauwlettend toezien op de situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat er geen banen zijn voor jongeren met een laag IQ

MPs Karabulut and Siderius asked the State Secretaries about warnings that closing sheltered workplaces and the Participatiewet will leave practical-education pupils without jobs, and about the cost-effectiveness of job coaches. The government answered that practical-education pupils are being steered to work through regional school-municipality networks and ESF funding, that the Participatiewet creates new instruments such as sheltered work, and that the job coach pilot was found to be expensive with limited effect on transitions to regular work.
The central government does not close sheltered workplaces (sw-bedrijven).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Helder over het bericht dat de bewoners uit de Tarwewijk, Rotterdam-Zuid angstig zijn voor de vrijlaten van de 15-jarige Rotterdamse jongen die woensdag is aangehouden voor mis

MPs Beertema and Helder asked the education state secretary about a 15-year-old Rotterdam boy released after assaulting a bullied girl, the fear in the neighbourhood, the school's failure under its anti-bullying protocol, and the need to punish bullies quickly given social media. The state secretary said an inquiry by the Rotterdam youth consul is underway, outlined planned legislation making school safety and bullying prevention enforceable by the inspectorate, and stated bullying figures have not risen though cyberbullying has.
With the announced legislation, it will become possible for the inspectorate to effectively supervise the social safety of pupils at school.
Met de aangekondigde wetgeving wordt het voor de inspectie mogelijk om effectief toezicht te houden op de sociale veiligheid van de leerlingen op school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Elias over wie de baas is van 'de rode knop' op de afstandsbediening

MPs De Liefde and Elias (VVD) asked whether the government intends to resolve the dispute over who controls the 'red button' on TV remotes between broadcasters and cable/telecom providers, and how the legal rules differ between cable, IP-TV and over-the-top services. The State Secretary answered that the rules on must-carry obligations are technology-neutral since 1 January 2014, that the legislator cannot impose carriage obligations on specific techniques such as HbbTV, that the relevant rules will be reviewed and modernised later this year, and that carriage negotiations between providers and broadcasters are free commercial negotiations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het bericht dat de NOS de samenvattingsrechten van het eredivisievoetbal voor de komende drie jaar heeft verworven

An MP asked the Education, Culture and Science State Secretary about the NOS acquiring highlights rights to Eredivisie football and whether the bidding was distorted or the amounts kept secret. The State Secretary answered that the Commissariat for the Media is investigating, that the NOS is bound by a non-disclosure agreement and the amounts remain undisclosed, that he finds this unsatisfactory and will push for transparency and tighten rules on efficiency, and offered confidential briefing to media spokespersons.
The NOS appears bound by the contractual agreements made with Eredivisie Media&Marketing (EMM) on this matter.
De NOS blijkt gehouden aan de contractuele afspraken die hierover zijn gemaakt met Eredivisie Media&Marketing (EMM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over de uitspraken van de heer K. (bestuurslid van de Stichting Islamitisch Onderwijs (SIO) Amsterdam en Omstreken)

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked whether a board member of the Islamic education foundation SIO Amsterdam, who publicly expressed support for ISIS, should be a reason to reconsider the approved Islamic secondary school and whether the foundation can be blocked from operating a school. The State Secretary answered that the school's approval was mandatory under the law and cannot be revised, that the inspectorate will be asked to examine the board's suitability before any funding begins, and that the government will act to prevent the school opening if it fails the civic-education requirements.
As soon as I receive notification that the school can actually become eligible for funding once housing becomes available, I will call in the inspectorate.
Zodra ik de melding ontvang dat de school door het beschikbaar komen van huisvesting daadwerkelijk in aanmerking kan komen voor bekostiging, zal ik de inspectie inschakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over segregatie in het onderwijs

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Karabulut asked the government about falling school segregation, the end of the twelve city pilots, the lack of structural municipality-school consultation, and parents' initiatives for mixed schools. The Secretary of State answered that segregation is declining, the pilots' effects were modest so they will not be continued (municipalities may continue on their own), and that the matter is a decentralised municipal responsibility, so the outcome was passed to the VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de verkoop van knowhow door Cito BV welke deels is ontwikkeld binnen de Stichting Cito

An MP asked the State Secretary whether software and knowhow for the digital exam tool Facet, partly funded by taxpayers, is being commercially sold by Cito BV and Trifork. The State Secretary answered that Facet was built under open source licence with the College voor Examens as co-owner, that a Swiss partnership involves Cito-funded software, and that Stichting Cito did not develop the sold products.
The CvE is co-owner and can carry out further development of Facet without problems.
Het CvE is mede-eigenaar en kan de doorontwikkeling van Facet zonder problemen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over Netflix, Trouw en de Kijkwijzer

An MP asked whether the government is satisfied with Kijkwijzer uptake and whether it will press Netflix, foreign-licensed channels, and newspapers like Trouw to show Kijkwijzer age ratings and icons, and whether it will legally oblige them. The Secretary of State says uptake is good, Netflix has committed to Kijkwijzer for most of its catalogue by end 2014, but declines legal obligations or appeals to newspapers, citing EU law and editorial independence.
The Netherlands cannot, under European law, impose rules on broadcasters with a foreign licence.
Nederland kan op grond van het Europese recht geen regels stellen voor zenders met een buitenlandse licentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jadnanansing over de instructietaal in het onderwijs op Sint Eustatius

MPs Van Laar and Jadnanansing asked about a reported plan to replace Dutch with English as the language of instruction on Sint Eustatius, the feasibility study behind it, who decides the language, and the next steps after the island council's motion. The Secretary of State referred to a letter and attached reports, said the statutory language regime is set by legislation, and noted the council motion did not disrupt the ministry's decision-making, though the ministry said it would follow up with the council.
The legislator therefore ultimately determines what the language of instruction in education on this island is.
De wetgever bepaalt dus uiteindelijk wat de instructietaal in het onderwijs op dit eiland is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het opheffen van ICIN (Netherlands Heart Institute) door de Koninklijke Nederlandse Akademie van Wetenschappen (KNAW)

An MP asks how cardiovascular research would continue after ICIN is dissolved by the KNAW, and whether the dissolution followed due process (Awb consultation, works council advice, financial analysis, a transitional arrangement). The minister says research continues within the UMCs with some added coordination burden, deems long-term damage limited, and declines substantive answers on procedure and legality because the matter is before the courts.
Because the matter is before the court, we are very reticent in answering these questions.
Omdat de zaak onder de rechter is zijn wij zeer terughoudend in de beantwoording van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over leerlingen in het vmbo en praktijkonderwijs die geen stage mogen lopen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why students without a permanent residence permit can only do compulsory internships in BOL vocational courses and not in vmbo, praktijkonderwijs or hbo. The minister acknowledged the exemption was an omission, said he would extend the exemption to praktijkonderwijs, vmbo maatwerk routes and similar tracks, but not to hbo.
This is an omission. Besides mbo, there are other secondary education routes specifically aimed at acquiring work-placement experience, so that an internship is an essential part of the course.

Dit is een omissie. Naast het mbo zijn er andere onderwijsroutes in het voortgezet onderwijs die specifiek gericht zijn op het opdoen van beroepspraktijkvorming waardoor stage een essentieel onderdeel van de opleiding vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de positie van cluster 1 en 2 leerlingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education about worries that visually, hearing and communication-impaired pupils will lose support in regular schools from August 2014, including the independence and uniformity of assessment committees, parents' remedies, and funding. The State Secretary answered that cluster 1 and 2 institutions take on a statutory support duty with full budgets, that committees are legally composed, that the government will not impose uniform admission conditions but will monitor referrals, and that parents can object or use the national dispute committee.
In the coming years the number of referrals to cluster 1 and 2 institutions and the support arrangements in regular education will be monitored.
De komende jaren zal het aantal verwijzingen naar de instellingen cluster 1 en 2 en de ondersteuningsarrangementen in het regulier onderwijs worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een verdubbeling van het aantal zwakke opleidingen op middelbare scholen in Amsterdam

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education why the number of weak secondary schools in Amsterdam doubled, what could be done, whether municipalities should get a bigger role, and what could be learned from Amsterdam having no very weak primary schools. The State Secretary answered that weak ratings are relative and rotate each year, that Amsterdam performs better than other large cities, that schools have support options, and that no strengthening of municipal roles is warranted.
Although the municipality has a role in local education policy, there are no reasons to strengthen that role.
Hoewel de gemeente een rol heeft in het lokale onderwijsbeleid, zijn er geen redenen voor een versterking van die rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat scholen niet klaar zijn voor passend onderwijs

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a teachers' union survey showing schools are not ready for inclusive education (passend onderwijs), raising concerns about teacher information, class sizes, professionalisation funding and whether implementation should be postponed. The government answered that teachers need better information, that samenwerkingsverbanden are phasing in the reform, that special education remains, that professionalisation spending is controlled through school boards and works councils, and that there is no reason to postpone the 1 August start.
That is why I, together with the education organisations, have called on school board members and school leaders to enter into discussion with teachers and parents before 1 May.
Daarom heb ik samen met de onderwijsorganisaties schoolbestuurders en schoolleiders opgeroepen om voor 1 mei met leraren en ouders in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Taalbarrière stremt Sabaanse Studenten’

MPs Van Laar and Jadnanansing asked about reports that Saban students struggle with language barriers in Dutch higher education and about barriers to studying in the United States. The minister said the data do not show most Saban students failing in the Netherlands, acknowledged language and cultural difficulties, pointed to extra Dutch lessons, a preparatory programme and an inventory of study options due to be completed in August 2014.
From the DUO data above it cannot be concluded that the majority of Saban students run into problems when studying in the Netherlands.
Uit de hierboven weergegeven gegevens van de DUO kan niet worden opgemaakt dat het merendeel van de Sabaanse studenten bij studie in Nederland in de problemen komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het ICIN

An MP asked the minister whether the KNAW's decision to close the ICIN Netherlands Heart Institute, as a way to meet a budget cut, was consistent with the ministry's earlier letter and whether the ministry would intervene by suspending the decision or funding a bridge amount. The minister answered that the KNAW is an autonomous body free to allocate its funds, that no suspension is warranted, and that the cardiology research continues in the academic hospitals.
The KNAW is however an autonomous organisation and the KNAW is in principle free to allocate the funds it receives from OCW, other than the specific subsidies, as it sees fit.
De KNAW is echter een autonome organisatie en het staat de KNAW in principe vrij de middelen die zij van OCW ontvangt, anders dan de specifieke subsidies, naar eigen inzicht te alloceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Rekentoets niet meetellen’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the mandatory arithmetic test for secondary school pupils risks creating a culture of accountability, whether teachers are adequately prepared, and whether pupils may be harmed in motivation or diploma chances. The State Secretary rejected these concerns, pointed to extra funding and teacher training, and said the timeline (test counting from 2015–2016) will stand, with monitoring of outcomes.
I am of the view that schools have sufficient time, with an implementation period of nearly six years, to adjust and optimise arithmetic education.
Ik ben van mening dat de scholen met de implementatieperiode van bijna zes jaar voldoende tijd hebben om het rekenonderwijs bij te sturen en te optimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over het bericht ‘Schoolrendement belangrijker dan leerling’

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the minister whether school selection hurdles that deny pupils from lower socio-economic backgrounds a fair chance are acceptable, and whether additional entrance tests at secondary schools are unlawful given a prior motion. The minister acknowledged that selection mechanisms must not be misused, promised a fuller policy response to the Onderwijsraad advice before summer, and deferred the question on additional tests to earlier answers.
A detailed description of our policy on easing transitions and access to the various types of education will be sent to you before the summer as a policy response to the Onderwijsraad advice.

Een uitvoerige beschrijving van ons beleid op de versoepeling van overgangen en toegankelijkheid van en naar de diverse onderwijssoorten, zullen wij u voor de zomer aanbieden als beleidsreactie op het advies van de Onderwijsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de brandbrief van Drentse scholen over CITO-scores als afrekenlijstje

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary whether school boards' concerns that CITO test scores are used as an inspectorate accountability tool and disadvantage schools with many pupils needing extra support are justified. The state secretary denied that scores are used to penalise schools, said the inspectorate corrects for pupil population, refused to lower the weight of scores now, but promised a broader quality framework under differentiated supervision and a written reply to Prisma Drenthe.
I see no reason to change the inspectorate's assessment of final outcomes in the short term, because in my view it already sufficiently takes the pupil population into account.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op korte termijn de beoordeling van de eindopbrengsten door de inspectie aan te passen, omdat deze naar mijn inzicht al voldoende rekening houdt met de leerlingpopulatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het bericht dat de luistercijfers van het publieke radiostation FunX niet openbaar zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary why FunX radio listening figures were not public, and whether a commitment to inform parliament about the Commissariaat voor de Media's view on the NPO's FunX arrangement had been kept. The State Secretary answered that the NPO and the NLO excluded FunX from the standard listening survey for representativeness reasons, that a separate survey has been commissioned and its results will be published this year, and that the commitment was met in the 2013 budget letter.
Listening figures for FunX will therefore be made public this year.
Er zullen dit jaar dus luistercijfers over FunX openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “NPO vanaf dinsdag ‘uitgekleed’ in Belgische tijdschriften”

An MP asked the State Secretaries about a reported sharp rise in the fees Belgian magazines must pay the NPO for Dutch broadcast programme data, and whether this matches the intent of the Mediawet. The government answered that the statutory tariffs were never meant to apply to foreign users, that this will be clarified in the next amendment to the Mediawet, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media will report before the summer recess.
Because this currently does not sufficiently appear from the Mediawet 2008, this will be corrected in the next bill amending the Mediawet 2008.
Omdat dit momenteel onvoldoende uit de Mediawet 2008 blijkt, zal dit worden hersteld in het eerstvolgende wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Mediawet 2008.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de wens vanuit het voortgezet onderwijs (vo) om een toelatingstoets in te voeren ter omzeiling van het schooladvies

An MP asked the state secretary whether secondary schools may use entrance tests to override the primary school recommendation, and how the Ypma motion banning such tests will be implemented and enforced. The state secretary answered that rules are being amended so the recommendation is leading and the eindtoets is the only permitted second opinion, with inspectorate monitoring from next year.
I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to include this in its supervision of compliance with laws and regulations from next year.
Ik zal de Inspectie van het Onderwijs vragen om dit vanaf volgend jaar mee te nemen in haar toezicht op de naleving van de wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Grote examenfraude ROC Amsterdam’

MP Jadnanansing asked the minister about exam fraud at ROC Amsterdam, how it compares to Ibn Ghaldoun, whether the Inspectorate is involved, and how school exams were leaked. The minister responded that investigations are ongoing, the Inspectorate is monitoring the case, and that schools are themselves responsible for exam security procedures.
The Inspectorate of Education closely monitors the measures taken by ROC Amsterdam.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs volgt de door het ROC van Amsterdam ingezette maatregelen nauwgezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat er op het Ibn Ghaldoun sprake was van een losgeslagen cultuur, een incompetent bestuur en het mede schuldig zijn van ouders en docenten

MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Education about reports of a lax culture, incompetent governance and complicit staff at Ibn Ghaldoun school, including how a teacher who was intimidated was handled, why no criminal complaint was filed, and whether the school was rescued despite known problems. The State Secretary answered that personnel matters belong to the school board, that criminal acts must be reported, that funding was ended after the inspectorate found no trust in the board, and that the inspectorate monitors the new school.
The inspectorate is keeping a close eye on this.
De inspectie houdt daarbij de vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de afwijzing van coöperatie-scholen

MP Ypma asked the State Secretary for Education why a cooperative of small schools was rejected, and why the cooperative is not seen as a useful form of cooperation for keeping village schools open in shrinking areas.
