The State Secretary answered that parts of the plan are welcome and can proceed under current rules or through his own projects, but he cannot support placing schools in a cooperative to evade closure norms, reopening a closed school, or moving schools away from their boards, and he sent his letter to the initiators.
I hereby send you the letter that I sent to Mr S. H.
Ik stuur u hierbij de brief die ik aan de heer S. H. heb verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de cao voor bestuurders in het voortgezet onderwijs

Rog (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Education why a separate collective agreement for secondary-education board members was created, whether their pay rises despite the zero-wage line for teachers, and whether supervisors can raise pay or exceed the topincome norm. The State Secretary answered that the agreement was requested to regulate executive pay, that salaries stay unchanged with a zero-indexation line, and that supervisors cannot raise pay above the sectoral ceiling of 184,549 euros.
The request from a former OCW minister to regulate the remuneration of board members.
Het verzoek van voormalige bewindspersoon van OCW om de beloningen van bestuurders te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over het bericht “Scholen niet blij met vergelijkingssite”

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the State Secretary for Education about criticism that the new school comparison website scholenopdekaart.nl is a confusing mass of data, the cost of Vensters PO compared with MBO Transparant, and whether data is openly available and SchoolInfo falls outside Wob and SLOA. The State Secretary rejected the criticism, explained the costs and the public nature of the data, confirmed SchoolInfo is outside Wob and SLOA, and promised a separate letter on transparency in spring.
In a separate letter to the House, which I will send you this spring, I will set out my vision on transparency and thereby also on Vensters voor Verantwoording PO and VO.
In een aparte brief aan uw Kamer, die ik u dit voorjaar toezend, zal ik mijn visie op transparantie en daarmee ook op Vensters voor Verantwoording PO en VO uiteen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over de website scholenopdekaart.nl

An MP asked why the scholenopdekaart.nl school-comparison website went online with much information missing, how it can serve parents' school choice, and what the development cost. The Secretary of State answered that the site is a phased rollout with information added by schools over time, that the project completes in 2015, and that the PO-Raad budgeted over 7 million euros for 2012-2015 across more than 7,000 schools, with a fuller letter on transparency promised.
Moreover, I will set out my vision on transparency, and thereby on Vensters voor Verantwoording PO and VO, in a separate letter to your House this spring.
Overigens zal ik in een aparte brief aan uw Kamer, die ik u dit voorjaar toezend, mijn visie op transparantie en daarmee ook op Vensters voor Verantwoording PO en VO uiteen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het falend onderwijstoezicht op Ibn Ghaldoun

An MP asked the state secretary why the education inspectorate failed to act on Ibn Ghaldoun earlier, given repeated signals, and how it will address fragmented oversight of weak schools. The state secretary acknowledged fragmented, insufficiently integrated oversight, promised that from August 2014 the inspectorate will judge at board level and consider prior supervision history, and declined to give a firm answer on a hypothetical 'what if' scenario.
From August 2014 the inspectorate will assess at board level where there are risks in quality (in departments), finances or signals.
Met ingang van augustus 2014 zal de inspectie op bestuursniveau oordelen, als er sprake is van risico's het gebied van kwaliteit (bij afdelingen), financiën of bij signalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de gebrekkige kennis van Nederlanders over de universele mensenrechten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about Dutch citizens' limited knowledge of universal human rights, the claimed lack of systematic human rights education in schools, the share of youth aware of children's rights, and whether the government will structurally embed human rights in citizenship education. The State Secretary disagreed that human rights education is not guaranteed, cited curriculum goals and a forthcoming letter on citizenship education, and committed to supporting schools and reviewing core goals.
I do not agree with that.
Ik ben het daar niet mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over belangenverstrengeling hoogleraren financiële sector

An MP asks the government about conflicts of interest arising from professors in the financial sector holding outside positions, including on the Commission Structuure Nederlandse Banken, and about transparency and funding of chairs. The minister says transparency agreements with universities are being upheld, that outside positions do not disqualify advisers, and that existing codes suffice, promising no new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het bericht dat scholen steeds minder vaak schoolzwemmen aanbieden

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the government about reports that municipalities are cutting funding for school swimming and that swimming diploma rates among children are falling. The state secretary answered that swimming skills are primarily the parents' responsibility, supported by schools and municipalities, that 94% of children obtain a diploma, and that no change to the division of responsibilities is warranted.
I see no reason to change the current division of responsibilities.
Zie ik geen aanleiding om de huidige verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de zogenaamd vrijwillige ouderbijdrage in het onderwijs

An MP asks whether voluntary parental contributions at Dutch primary schools, some very high, are being used for essential teaching and pressure parents, and whether limits should apply. The state secretary answers that contributions must be voluntary, are set with parent consent in the MR, that the inspectorate enforces the rules, and that no maximum will be introduced.
To obtain a picture of the current height of parental contributions, the education inspectorate will carry out such a study again in primary education.
Om een beeld te verkrijgen van de hoogte van de huidige ouderbijdragen, zal de inspectie van het onderwijs een dergelijk onderzoek in het primair onderwijs opnieuw uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het oneigenlijk gebruik van de fusiecompensatieregeling

An MP asked the state secretary whether schools abuse the merger compensation scheme by merging with a small village school and then closing it, and what measures would prevent this. The state secretary denied knowledge of such signals, said closure by merger is not itself abuse, did not know how many of the 95 merged schools closed a site, and promised to act and reclaim funds if misuse is found.
If it turns out that misuse or improper use of the merger compensation scheme occurs, I will take appropriate measures and reclaim unlawfully obtained funding.
Als blijkt dat zich misbruik of oneigenlijk gebruik van de fusiecompensatieregeling voordoet, zal ik treffende maatregelen nemen en onrechtmatig verkregen bekostiging terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht dat scholen niet klaar zijn voor passend onderwijs

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Education whether schools and samenwerkingsverbanden are ready for inclusive 'passend onderwijs', citing a Nieuwsuur report and an ECPO call, and how parents and children will be protected from falling between the cracks. The State Secretary acknowledged that many teachers and parents do not yet know what to expect, pointed to the responsibility of the samenwerkingsverbanden, and announced an extra implementation impulse together with education organisations, with more detail in a letter on the third progress report.
I am giving an extra impulse to the passend onderwijs implementation programme in cooperation with the education organisations.
Ik geef een extra impuls aan het invoeringsprogramma passend onderwijs in samenwerking met de onderwijsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over ontoelaatbare kindermarketing via het Nationaal Schoolontbijt

An MP asked whether the Nationaal Schoolontbijt, sponsored by food companies, is allowed to distribute products that are too sweet, salty or fatty and whether industry self-regulation on child-directed advertising under age 12 is working. The state secretary defended the initiative as private responsibility, noted the Voedingscentrum advises on products, and said industry has agreed to stop advertising to children under 12 except for products meeting nutritional criteria from 2014.
I support it when private parties take their social responsibility to promote a healthy lifestyle for young people.
Ik ondersteun het wanneer private partijen hun maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid nemen om in te zetten op een gezonde leefstijl voor de jeugd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over het feit dat scholen en gemeenten niet gezamenlijk kunnen investeren in nieuwe schoolgebouwen

An MP asks whether schools and municipalities can jointly invest in new school buildings, given the transfer of 256 million euro from the municipal fund to school lump sums and the ban on school boards investing in construction. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are autonomous in spending, that school boards may not spend lump-sum funds on construction, and that he is willing to explore conditional exceptions if the PO-Raad and VNG reach agreement.
If the PO-Raad and the VNG can reach agreements on these matters, I am willing to explore the possibilities of giving school boards room to deploy funds.
Als de PO-Raad en de VNG over deze zaken tot afspraken kunnen komen, ben ik bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om schoolbesturen de ruimte te geven om middelen in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over grote klassen

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education about large class sizes, citing a survey showing many secondary pupils find their classes too big, and asked who decides class size, whether budget cuts force larger classes, and whether the government will help make classes smaller. The secretary answered that class size is a school-level decision, that per-pupil funding has risen, that schools must weigh competing priorities, and that the government will not take over this responsibility, though good practices may be shared.
I am not inclined to place this responsibility with the national government.
Ik voel er niets voor deze verantwoordelijkheid bij de rijksoverheid te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Mei Li Vos over de perverse prikkels in de wetenschap

MPs Van Meenen and Mei Li Vos asked the state secretary about the Science in Transition pamphlet on perverse incentives in academia, including publication pressure, business-science entanglement, and proposed reforms. The government acknowledged the concerns, defended quality and international rankings, said it will consider stakeholder involvement and await the IBO Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek before deciding on funding changes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat NPO met een eigen betaaldienst komt

MP Verhoeven (D66) asked the state secretary about the NPO's plan for a paid on-demand service (NPO Plus) that would place publicly funded productions behind a paywall, and whether it distorts the market and what conditions apply. The secretary answered that the service is a financing and rights matter, that free Uitzending Gemist will remain, that the service is part of a joint platform with commercial broadcasters, and that a pilot with a formal approval procedure with public consultation and appeal rights will precede any permanent approval.
I believe the public broadcaster can and should move into the digital domain precisely to bind the audience.
Ik vind dat de publieke omroep zich in het digitale domein kan en moet begeven, juist om het publiek te binden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de financiële problemen van lokale omroepen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about financial problems at local broadcasters, including municipal underfunding below the guideline amount, falling advertising revenue, and possible spillover into regional and national media. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for funding, that the national government sets only framework conditions, and that professionalisation and cooperation are being pursued through the OLON and an additional 287,000 euro grant, while declining to expand the future media review or revisit the regional broadcasting cut.
Responsibility for the funding lies with the municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de financiering ligt bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘de Superschool’

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the state secretary of Education about the proposed 'Superschool' for pupils aged 2 to 18, the admission rules for new schools, the handling of expelled pupils, the share of master-qualified teachers, and school management overhead. The state secretary welcomes the initiative's aims but says a judgement needs a project plan, that no new school is currently being founded, that existing expulsion provisions and teacher-qualification ambitions are in place, and that management overhead is low and capped by the WNT.
I can only form a judgement on the plan on the basis of a project plan and a closer study of it.
Een oordeel over het plan kan ik pas vellen op basis van een projectplan en nadere bestudering daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Hijum over de Oranjeschool in Zalk

MPs Rog and Van Hijum asked whether the Oranjeschool in Zalk faces closure because Kampen did not split its municipal territory for the closing-norm, whether the 5 km rule and discretionary powers can help, and whether the rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that the municipality decided in 2001 not to split, retroactive splitting is not permitted, the 5 km exception cannot be waived, the discretionary power does not apply, and the school board should explore cooperation or merger options.
The Primary Education Act does not provide the possibility to permit a split with retroactive effect.
De Wet op het primair onderwijs biedt niet de mogelijkheid om met terugwerkende kracht een splitsing toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over seks in Schooltv Weekjournaal

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries whether teachers knew in advance about the 'Dr. Corrie' sex-education item in Schooltv Weekjournaal, why this format was chosen, and whether schools retain freedom over methods. The government answered that schools and broadcasters decide content and methods, that the state has no prior control over broadcasts under article 7 of the Constitution, and declined to discuss the presentation with the broadcaster.
The government has no prior supervision of or influence over the content or form of a television broadcast (art. 7 of the Constitution).
De overheid heeft geen voorafgaand toezicht of invloed op de inhoud of vorm van een televisie-uitzending (art. 7 van de Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over steeds grotere klassen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education about an AOb/ITS survey showing classes of over 28 pupils becoming more common, and pressed on class size, passend onderwijs and the Swedish research on smaller classes. The State Secretary answered that official representative data show only a slight rise in average group size, that large schools mostly form groups of 21-30 pupils, and that quality teachers and school-level judgement matter more than a fixed class-size cap, so no stepwise plan to smaller classes is planned.
Therefore I see no reason for a step-by-step plan towards smaller classes.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor een stappenplan naar kleinere klassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de gebrekkige informatievoorziening bij de slaagregeling in het vmbo

An MP asked the state secretary for Education why many vmbo schools were unclear about the tightened pass/fail rule and whether information was poor, and whether pupils can be blamed for not knowing. The state secretary replied that schools were informed through letters, the examination website and information meetings, that no information gap was evident, that the rule is in the examination decree rather than the PTA, and listed improvement channels without new commitments.
The reactions from schools present showed no sign whatsoever that there was an information gap.
Uit de reacties van daar aanwezige scholen is geenszins gebleken dat sprake was van een informatieachterstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de besteding van achterstandsgelden in het onderwijs

An MP asked the state secretary about how education disadvantage funding is distributed, including the Education Council's call to base allocation on parental education and origin, and about transparency and effectiveness. The state secretary said funding continues, will be reviewed for a new allocation model by year end, schools will be encouraged to account more, and effectiveness research is ongoing.
I aim to use, in such a model, data collected outside the school.
Ik streef erna om in een dergelijk model gebruik te maken van gegevens die buiten de school om verzameld worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht “Oud hoogleraar Bax schuldig aan wetenschappelijk wangedrag”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the finding that former professor Bax committed scientific misconduct, including the consequences for supervised PhD students, why earlier warnings and checks did not detect it, whether sector measures would have caught it, what integrity steps were taken, and whether criminal complaint would be filed. The minister answered that the PhD students face no consequences, that the VU will have the report translated and notify journals and registries, that the VU is responsible for any criminal complaint, and that institutions have reformed integrity policy.
The Vrije Universiteit has decided to have the Baud committee report translated into English and sent to the journals in which the articles appeared.
De Vrije Universiteit heeft besloten het rapport van de commissie Baud in het Engels te vertalen en te doen toekomen aan de tijdschriften waarin deze zijn verschenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over persoonsgegevens bij digitale televisie en Netflix

An MP asked the state secretaries about personal data handling by Netflix and digital TV providers, including whether Dutch privacy law applies to Netflix operating from Luxembourg and whether viewing data can reveal sensitive information. The government answered that the Dutch Wbp does not apply to Netflix, which falls under Luxembourg law implementing the same EU directive, and described Ziggo's opt-in rules for sharing viewing data.
The Wbp does not apply because Netflix has no establishment in the Netherlands.
De Wbp is niet van toepassing aangezien Netflix geen vestiging in Nederland heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog inzake de berichten over de afbakening van publieke taken bij Stichting CITO in relatie tot de marktactiviteiten bij CITO BV

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that CITO's public foundation could cover losses of its commercial subsidiary CITO BV, and about the separation of public and commercial tasks and intellectual property. The state secretary denied that private losses can be shifted onto public tasks, sent an audit report and new governance agreements strengthening the separation, and said IP rights over statutory tasks will pass to the minister.
Stichting CITO makes products and research results produced with public funds available to CITO BV under the same conditions as to other test providers.
Stichting CITO met publieke middelen vervaardigde producten en onderzoeksresultaten onder dezelfde voorwaarden aan CITO BV ter beschikking als aan andere toetsaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat ontslag van leerkrachten dreigt op honderden basisscholen

MPs Smaling and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether a report that 80% of primary schools must dismiss teachers to stay solvent, with consequences for class sizes and individual attention, was accurate and whether budget cuts threaten education quality. The State Secretary replied that falling pupil numbers make fewer teachers necessary, that class sizes have not risen sharply, that the government is investing in teacher quality and that the Nationaal Onderwijsakkoord is being revived.
It cannot be determined in advance what the effect of fewer remedial teachers, gym teachers and music teachers will be on education quality.
Op voorhand kan niet worden bepaald wat het effect van minder «remedial teachers», gymleraren en muziekdocenten is op de kwaliteit van het onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucas over het artikel “Kabinet herijkt onderzoekgeld”

An MP asked about a planned interdepartmental policy review (IBO) of scientific research funding and how Parliament would be involved. The ministers answered that no formal assignment has been issued yet, the review will be budget-neutral, the final report and cabinet response will be sent to the House, and the assignments will accompany the Miljoenennota.
No formal assignment has yet been given for carrying out an IBO on scientific research.
Er is formeel nog geen opdracht gegeven voor de uitvoering van een IBO naar wetenschappelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Steve Jobsscholen

An MP asked the state secretary about the planned Steve Jobs schools, including whether minimum knowledge standards, teacher supervision and quality norms are met and whether the new model risks becoming a failed experiment. The state secretary answered that schools have pedagogical freedom within legal limits, that the inspectorate will apply extra supervision, that the schools must meet the same quality requirements, and that a possible AMvB on flexible instruction time is being explored.
The inspectorate will therefore carry out extra supervision of the Steve Jobs schools.
De inspectie zal dan ook extra toezicht houden op de Steve Jobsscholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Meenen en Berendsen inzake het profielwerkstuk “De Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag”

MPs from D66 asked the state secretaries of Education and Justice about young people's awareness of the Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and whether education could deter crime, citing a student survey. The government acknowledges the low awareness, notes that only 650 youth applications were refused in 2012 and that the lookback period for adolescents was shortened, and commits to an information newsletter, awareness work with the CSV, and further outreach.
We endorse the importance of tailored information for young people about the existence of the VOG and the consequences a refusal may have for future study, internship or employment.
Wij onderschrijven het belang van voorlichting op maat aan de jongeren over het bestaan van de VOG en de gevolgen die een weigering hiervan kan hebben voor een toekomstige studie, stage of baan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het experiment ‘summerschool’

An MP asked the state secretary of Education about the reported success of a summer school pilot that let 87% of participating pupils advance without repeating a year, and whether the pilot should be extended. The state secretary said the pilot is being evaluated, results are expected in December 2014, and no conclusions or decisions on extension will be drawn before then.
I am awaiting the evaluation of the experiment before making further statements on this.
Ik wacht de evaluatie van het experiment af alvorens ik hier nadere uitspraken over doe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Mohandis over opleidingen die studenten met autisme weigeren

MPs Ypma and Mohandis asked about vocational and higher education institutions refusing students with autism, and the government's support for students with disabilities. The minister said the inspectorate had received no reports from institutions, that Start Foundation had about 100 unverified reports, and that the Equal Treatment Commission had handled only four cases, all in vocational education.
For now it is not known whether higher education institutions have refused admission to autistic students.
Vooralsnog is niet bekend of ho-instellingen autistische studenten niet hebben toegelaten.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over het bericht dat de islamitische school Ibn Ghaldoun onder de christelijke paraplu zou vallen

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Education whether an Islamic school, Ibn Ghaldoun, could fall under a Protestant-Christian school umbrella, and whether the board should be ordered to drop the plan or lose its subsidy. The state secretary declined to speculate on the planned cooperation, pointed to ongoing police, prosecution and Inspectorate investigations, and promised to inform parliament after the summer recess.
I will await the outcomes of the investigations before drawing my conclusions.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken af voordat ik mijn conclusies trek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Ypma over problemen met de ouderbijdrage in het onderwijs

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) and Ypma (PvdA) asked the state secretary about a news report on schools charging high parental contributions that deter poorer families, and about segregation. The state secretary answered that the contribution must be voluntary and that the inspectorate enforces this, but declined to cap contributions or to set a fixed enrolment date, leaving segregation to local authorities.
Where the inspectorate finds that schools do not comply with this statutory requirement, the inspectorate acts to enforce it.
Daar waar de inspectie constateert dat scholen zich niet aan deze wettelijke vereiste houden, treedt de inspectie handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Anass (13) volgens OM niet aangezet tot zelfmoord”

MP Bergkamp asked the Education and Justice ministers about a case where the prosecutor found a 13-year-old was not incited to suicide by bullying, and what lessons follow, including whether the anti-bullying plan changes and when legislation comes. State Secretary Dekker answered that the case underlines the need for the existing anti-bullying plan, which will not be changed, that the Inspectorate will investigate the school after summer, and that a bill is planned for 2014 with a target of August 2015.
In this specific case, the Public Prosecution Service informed the Inspectorate of Education about the outcomes of the investigation.
In dit concrete geval heeft het Openbaar Ministerie de Inspectie van het Onderwijs geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over de administratie van instellingen in het onderwijs

Two MPs asked the state secretary for Education about irregularities in the school registry (BRIN) and whether schools can reclassify branches to avoid the regional planning procedure, plus the validity of diplomas issued under a different school name. The state secretary denied that the registry is generally unreliable, said schools must report changes and that main branches can be reclassified only through the regional plan or merger rules, and declined to invalidate diplomas, while promising to address a legal gap and to remind schools of diploma rules.
In my policy response to the evaluation of facilities planning I announce that I will repair this omission in the law, namely 'what happens when the main branch is closed and the branch is not'.

In mijn beleidsreactie op de evaluatie voorzieningenplanning kondig ik aan deze omissie in de wet, namelijk «wat gebeurt er als de hoofdvestiging gesloten wordt en de nevenvestiging niet», te repareren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘VO-raad jokt: promotie van leraren kan wel’

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a report that secondary school employers' body VO-raad claimed promotion of teachers to higher pay scales could be paused, and about union claims that the functiemix policy had yielded funds for schools. The state secretary said the agreed goals of the functiemix will be upheld within available funds, that talks with VO-raad and unions are ongoing, and that schools will be reminded of their commitments to promote teachers.

Based on the goals of the Leerkracht covenant and the outcomes of the consultation, I will, together with the social partners, inform the schools and hold them to account on the importance of fulfilling the covenant's agreements to promote teachers to higher positions.

Aan de hand van de doelstellingen uit het convenant Leerkracht en de uitkomsten van het overleg zal ik samen met de sociale partners de scholen informeren en hen aanspreken over het belang van het nakomen van de afspraken uit het convenant om leerkrachten te bevorderen naar hogere functies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over thuisonderwijs via geheime constructies

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Smaling asked the state secretary about children receiving home schooling under secret arrangements, including whether contracts with parents impose confidentiality and whether the inspectorate approves them. The state secretary denied the secret-arrangement framing, said the individual handling plans are lawful maatwerk signed by the inspectorate, and pointed to a planned committee debate on truancy.
Agreements made are tailored work and not a blueprint for other pupils.
Gemaakte afspraken zijn maatwerk en geen blauwdruk voor andere leerlingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Straus en Neppérus over het verschil in btw voor naschoolse programma’s in het primair onderwijs

MPs Straus and Neppérus asked why some after-school educational programmes in primary education are VAT-exempt and others are not, and whether technology programmes should be exempt too. The State Secretary explained that only programmes derived from the publicly funded regular curriculum or tied to primary education are exempt, that CRKBO registration does not apply to primary-school programmes, and that no separate technology exemption is planned.
No separate statutory VAT exemption is provided for teaching programmes focused on technology.
Er is niet voorzien in een aparte wettelijke vrijstelling van btw voor lesprogramma's die zijn gericht op techniek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over het persbericht 'School-tv voor voortgezet onderwijs geschrapt'

MP Heerma (CDA) asked whether cuts to public broadcasting would end School-tv for secondary education and whether the broadcaster can still reach youth. The state secretary answered that core educational programmes remain, only secondary-school-specific content is dropped while archived material stays available, and that the NPO and broadcasters decide on the allocation of cuts without ministerial interference.
It is up to the NPO and the broadcasters, given their statutory tasks and the performance agreement, to give shape to the cuts in this concession period.
Het is aan de NPO en de omroepen om, gelet op de wettelijke taken en de afspraken in de prestatieovereenkomst, invulling te geven aan de bezuinigingen in deze concessieperiode.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over het bericht dat allochtone leerlingen vaak niet welkom zijn op een 'witte school'

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked whether primary schools refuse ethnic minority pupils and what the government will do about it and about school segregation. The state secretary said the small study does not support the conclusion, that OCW has no data showing ethnic background plays a role in admissions, that further research and dialogue with school boards are not needed, and that segregation is tackled locally with quality measures.
No such conclusion can be drawn from the small-scale study.
Uit het kleinschalige onderzoek kan deze conclusie niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut inzake scholen die allochtone leerlingen weigeren

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked about reports that schools refuse pupils of immigrant origin, and about a Forum study on admission barriers faced by migrant parents. The state secretary answered that the small-scale study cannot establish a clear pattern, that refusing pupils on ethnic grounds is unacceptable, and that desegregation is tackled locally, without a large-scale study.
Het tegengaan van segregatie is lokaal belegd.
Antwoord vragen leden Rog en Van Meenen over het belang van Nederlandse taal- en cultuurscholen in het buitenland

MPs Rog and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about the closure of state subsidy for Dutch language and culture schools abroad, and whether this threatens access and creates later language gaps for returning children. The state secretary replied that parents and employers should bear the cost, that the subsidy cut will be absorbed by school boards and parents, and that he will talk to employers and consider a role for the Inspectorate.
The cabinet chose, in filling the spending target, to spare education at schools as much as possible.
Het kabinet heeft er bij de invulling van de taakstelling voor gekozen het onderwijs op scholen zoveel mogelijk te ontzien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Straus over het advies van de KNAW: Digitale geletterdheid in het voortgezet onderwijs. Vaardigheden en attitudes voor de 21ste eeuw

Rep. Straus (VVD) asked the state secretary for Education about the KNAW advice on digital literacy in secondary education, including whether informatics is in dire straits, whether uptake of the subject (5.3%) should be raised, and how US initiative Code.org fits. The state secretary disputed the 'dire' characterisation and the 5.3% figure (11.2% of havo and 11.9% of vwo students chose it), said he will commission SLO research on effective measures, and promised a broader reaction before summer.
I will instruct the Netherlands Institute for Curriculum Development (SLO) to carry out research into the most effective actions.
Ik zal de Stichting voor de Leerplanontwikkeling (SLO) opdracht geven om een onderzoek uit te voeren naar de meest effectieve acties.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over de radio-uitzending ‘Trauma’s in de schoolbank’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Education about a radio report on traumatised asylum-seeker children in AZC schools, asking whether they need extra support, smaller classes, structural funding for therapists and social workers, and cluster 4 special-needs funding. The state secretary said extra costs are being inventoried with a possible financial solution to be implemented from the new school year, pointed to existing weighting and special funding that schools can use, and rejected cluster 4 funding because these are regular primary schools.
An inventory is currently being made of the costs that the pupil population of an AZC school linked to a family reception location entails.
Er wordt momenteel geïnventariseerd welke kosten de leerlingpopulatie van een AZC-school die is verbonden aan een Gezinsopvang locatie met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het initiatief Second love

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether the government finds it undesirable that the Second love initiative, which advertises in media, undermines relationships, including via public broadcasting, and what it will do to promote relationship support. The State Secretary answered that relationships are a private matter that cannot be imposed by government, that municipalities and Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin are responsible for relationship support (with a handreiking), and that government does not judge advertisements, which are assessed by the Reclame Code Commissie.
The government has no substantive involvement in, nor any judgement on, advertising.
De overheid heeft geen inhoudelijke bemoeienis met en ook geen oordeel over reclame-uitingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Wachtlijsten op de voorschool groeien’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports that waiting lists for pre-school education for children at risk of language delay are growing, and about how many such children are affected and what will be done. The government calls the growing waiting lists worrying, says it cannot determine how many target-group children are waiting, estimates about 45,000 target children, and places the duty to provide places on municipalities, with the Inspectorate of Education supervising, promising a joint letter before summer.
It is up to the municipalities to organise this; they also hold the instruments to resolve this at local level.
Het is aan de gemeenten om dit te organiseren; zij hebben ook de instrumenten in handen om dit op lokaal niveau op te lossen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing inzake het adviesrapport van de Kinderombudsman Van leerplicht naar leerrecht

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary for Education how to tackle thousands of truant children, including the Children's Ombudsman's view that the system is too rigid, that passend onderwijs does not solve the problem, and whether a jeugdregisseur with binding authority is needed. The state secretary agreed flexible solutions are needed, pointed to existing leerplicht exemptions and the coming zorgplicht under passend onderwijs, and rejected statutory binding authority for a regisseur in favour of local cooperation.
Statutorily regulated binding authority does not, in my view, fit a system that offers room for local tailoring.
Een wettelijk geregelde doorzettingsmacht vind ik niet passen in een systeem waarin ruimte voor lokaal maatwerk wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen Jadnanansing over het uitgelekte vwo-examen Frans

An MP asked the state secretary about the leaked VWO French exam, the risk of further leaks, and measures to protect exams and provide replacements. The state secretary confirmed being informed, described the continuity plan and a one-day delay, said no further exams were known stolen, and promised an evaluation and investigation into the theft.
The investigation into the precise circumstances of the theft is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de precieze toedracht van de diefstal is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing over de uitspraak van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens over het gebruik van de formulekaart bij dyscalculie

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary of Education about the College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that a dyscalculia student should be allowed a formula card at the wiskunde exam, which the College voor Examens had refused. The secretary answers that a formula card is acceptable only if it does not replace required understanding or exam requirements, that the CvE will advise schools at the start of next year, and that a limited card was arranged for the student.
The CvE will advise schools at the start of the next course year on the use of a formula card and the rules that apply to it at the central exams.
Het CvE zal scholen aan het begin van het volgende cursusjaar adviseren over het gebruik van een formulekaart en de regels die daartoe gelden bij de centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen Jasper van Dijk over scholen die steeds vaker bureaus inhuren voor examentrainingen

An SP MP asked whether it is problematic that about 160 Dutch secondary schools hire private agencies for exam training, which he sees as a sign that the state is failing in its responsibility for education. The state secretary replied that schools are responsible for exam preparation, that such extra training is their own decision, that the inspectorate does not supervise these agencies, and that no new measures are planned.
I am not in principle opposed to exam training as an extra supplement to standard practice at schools.
Ik ben op zich niet tegen examentrainingen als extra aanvulling op de staande praktijk bij de scholen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Geurts over de inhoud van het examen Nederlands voor havo

MPs Rog and Geurts asked why an opinion piece by professor Roos Vonk, reprimanded for improper conduct and linked to fabricated research, was used in the havo Dutch exam, and whether a note or the College voor Examens should have been consulted. The state secretary replied that the text was chosen for reading and argumentation skills, that it is an opinion piece without cited research, that no source note is required for opinion texts, and that he sees no need to discuss the choice with the College voor Examens.
The piece contains the personal opinion of Ms Vonk on a publicly known theme, but no references to research by Ms Vonk or Mr Stapel.

Het Centraal Eindexamen Nederlands ... Het stuk bevat de persoonlijke mening van mevrouw Vonk op een maatschappelijk bekend thema, maar geen verwijzingen naar onderzoek van mevrouw Vonk of de heer Stapel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp inzake de bekendheid onder docenten met het pestprotocol

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the state secretary of Education whether many teachers are unaware of their school's anti-bullying protocol and what will be done to raise awareness. The state secretary cited monitor data showing most schools have behaviour rules, pointed to a joint anti-bullying plan with the Children's Ombudsman, and committed to teacher-training modules and a mandatory school-wide anti-bullying approach including a protocol.
The action plan states that a school-wide and structural anti-bullying approach will become mandatory.
In het plan van aanpak staat dat een schoolbrede en structurele pestaanpak verplicht gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de positie van het openbaar onderwijs binnen samenwerkingsscholen

An MP asked the state secretary about the position of public (openbaar) education within cooperative schools, including how many have formed and whether public education is adequately protected. The state secretary answered that the law guarantees public education's equal position, reported that only a few cooperative schools exist and some public schools have merged or closed, and promised to address barriers to cooperation in a forthcoming letter on pupil decline.
The legislation guarantees the equal position between the public and the special-education parts within the cooperative school.
De wetgeving borgt de gelijkwaardige positie tussen het openbare deel en het bijzondere deel binnen de samenwerkingsschool.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de staking van leerlingen in Maastricht n.a.v. gedwongen ontslag personeel Sint-Maartenscollege

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about student strikes at the Sint-Maartenscollege in Maastricht over staff cuts and possible forced dismissals linked to financial problems. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate found no major financial problems, that no forced dismissals occur (staff will be redeployed to other locations due to falling pupil numbers), and that he is already discussing options with the governing body.
Inquiry with the competent authority of LVO shows that there is no question of forced dismissals.
Navraag bij het bevoegd gezag van LVO leert dat er geen sprake is van gedwongen ontslagen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Straus over het huiswerkblad van Maandtaak

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Maandtaak primary-school homework sheet on modern farming (on the farm, chicken, calf, pig) gives a one-sided picture, who is responsible for the content, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that the content of educational materials is not for the government to assess, that schools choose their own methods and sources, and that the government does not steer method choice, so no action is committed.
It is not for the (national) government to assess the content of educational materials.
Het is niet aan de (rijks) overheid om de inhoud van educatieve materialen te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (WOB)

An SGP MP asks the state secretary why she does not use the WOB exception in article 10(2)(g) to refuse disclosure of school test results, which she treats as a call for administrative disobedience, and whether the exception is hopeless. The state secretary answers that disclosure is the starting point, she is reconsidering her decision on objections from school boards, and she will not disclose without judicial intervention while affected parties wish to pursue it.
As long as affected parties wish for that for compelling reasons, disclosure will therefore not take place without judicial intervention.
Zolang belanghebbenden dat om moverende redenen wensen, zal dus niet zonder rechterlijke tussenkomst tot openbaarmaking worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht "Meer scholen met geldproblemen".

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about reports of more schools with financial problems and the risk to education quality, the causes, how insolvent schools will be handled, and a concrete recovery plan. The state secretary said quality is monitored by the inspectorate, cited falling pupil numbers and late cost adjustment as main causes, stated boards are primarily responsible, and announced support projects and intensified financial oversight of all boards within three years.
The inspectorate will actively approach and question all boards where it detects points of concern in financial management about the measures those boards have taken or must take.

De inspectie zal alle besturen waar zij aandachtspunten in de financiële huishouding bespeurt actief benaderen en bevragen op de maatregelen die besturen daarvoor hebben getroffen dan wel moeten treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de plannen voor kleine scholen

An MP asked the state secretary of Education about reported plans to abolish the small-schools allowance in favour of a cooperation bonus, and about the uncertainty this creates for staff and parents. The state secretary said measures would be set out in a letter to parliament in May, that the outcome depends on conditions not yet decided, and that a debate would follow.
In the last week of May I will send your House a letter clarifying what my measures entail.
In de laatste week van mei stuur ik uw Kamer een brief waarin ik duidelijk maak wat mijn maatregelen inhouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Huizing over het bericht “NPO 1 wordt nieuwe naam voor Nederland 1”

MP Huizing (VVD) asked the state secretary about reports that Nederland 1 would be renamed NPO 1, the premature timing given pending media law and the public broadcaster's future, a reported one-million-euro payment for the npo1.nl domain, and whether the marketing budget would be frozen. The state secretary confirmed the renaming is the broadcaster's own decision, said politics does not govern brand names for independence reasons, referred back to the earlier answer on the domain and noted a 2013 marketing budget of about 6.4 million euro subject to Commissariaat oversight, and declined to commit to freezing marketing spending.
It concerns the independence of the public broadcaster; it is not desirable for politics to have influence over this.
Het gaat hier om de onafhankelijkheid van de publieke omroep; het is niet wenselijk dat de politiek hier invloed op heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Rog over de verplichte taaltoets voor hbo-ers

MPs Heerma and Rog asked why higher-vocational (hbo) graduates must also pass the Dutch language test for pre- and early-school education (VVE) and whether municipalities may dismiss staff who refuse it. The state secretary answered that the test covers all VVE staff in the G37 cities regardless of qualification, that the test is needed to assess actual language levels, and that municipalities set subsidy conditions while employers decide on dismissal.
For all these reasons, it was chosen to test all pedagogical staff regardless of their prior education.
Om al die redenen is ervoor gekozen om alle pedagogisch medewerkers te toetsen ongeacht de vooropleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Hilkens over de uitzending van 1Vandaag over de drug GHB

Two MPs from CDA and PvdA asked the state secretaries about a 1Vandaag broadcast on GHB, covering prevention, addiction treatment waiting lists, hospital care, enforcement, and the GBL precursor. The government answered that prevention and local tailored approaches are underway, that treatment capacity is limited and some regions have waiting lists, and that it will commission a quick scan on GBL and consider policy adjustments.
I will instruct the Coordination Committee for Assessment and Monitoring of New Drugs to carry out a quick scan on the use of GBL.
Ik zal de Coördinatiecommissie Assessment en Monitoring nieuwe drugs opdragen een quick scan uit te voeren met betrekking tot het gebruik van GBL
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht betreffende het voornemen om binnenkort een WOB-verzoek van RTL Nieuws inzake eindtoetsgegevens in te willigen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether the ministry would grant an FOI request from RTL Nieuws for end-of-primary test data, why the ministry rather than the Inspectorate handles it, and about privacy, school protections and consultation. The State Secretary answered that individual pupil scores will not be released while school averages (raw and inspectorate-corrected where available) will be, with schools given two weeks to object, and that the Wob principle of open disclosure applies.
That is why I will not provide the score per pupil.
Daarom zal ik de score per leerling niet verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Lanterfanten is gezond’

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that Amsterdam schools test kindergarteners, whether municipalities can mandate such tests, and about publishing CITO test results. The secretary replies that the tests are voluntary local agreements compatible with play-based learning, that the national test-result publication is a Wob-based decision, and promises a letter on early childhood policy by end of April.
I will send a letter to the House of Representatives at the end of April addressing the state of affairs regarding early childhood education.
Ik kom eind april met een brief aan de TK waarin ik inga op de stand van zaken rondom VVE.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Smits en Paulus Jansen inzake het bericht dat het aantal lesuren techniek op 40% van de scholen daalt

MPs Smits and Paulus Jansen (SP) asked the state secretary for Education whether the reported decline in technology lesson hours at 40% of schools is confirmed, and what causes and actions follow. The state secretary said the department has no data on technology lesson hours, that schools have freedom in timetabling, and pointed to the Techniekpact, primary-school initiatives and new vmbo programmes, rejecting making technology a mandatory subject.
So I do not know whether the number of technology lesson hours is actually declining.
Ik weet dus niet of het aantal lesuren techniek daadwerkelijk daalt.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de stijgende regionale vervoertarieven voor scholieren vanaf het schooljaar 2013-2014

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked about sharp regional public transport fare increases for pupils from 2013-2014, the lack of clarity for schools and parents, and whether alternative subscriptions or harmonisation were agreed. The state secretary said fare decisions are regional, acknowledged the criticism, pointed to a compensation scheme in Zuid-Holland and to a planned permanent structure for harmonising discount products, but declined to take formal action or set a maximum increase.
From my current role, however, I have no formal powers to act against this.
Vanuit mijn huidige rol heb ik echter geen formele bevoegdheden om hier tegen op te treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma inzake Europese regulering van de media (ingezon

MPs Heerma asked the state secretary whether she endorses the Vike-Freiberga group's recommendations on EU competence over media freedom, supervisory powers to sanction journalists, and centralised EU oversight, and how the Heerma motion on strengthening journalistic self-regulation is being implemented. The state secretary answered that member states remain responsible, that the report reflects personal views rather than Commission policy, that she rejects powers to fine or strip journalists' status and centralised EU oversight, and that she is consulting the Raad voor de Journalistiek on supporting self-regulation.
It follows that I see nothing in European centralised supervision of national policy on pluralism and press freedom.
Hieruit volgt, dat ik niets zie in Europees gecentraliseerd toezicht op nationaal beleid rond pluriformiteit en persvrijheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Smits over de plotselinge sluiting en fusie van een groot aantal basisscholen in Sittard-Geleen en omgeving door schoolbestuur Kindante

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education whether the sudden closure and merger of many primary schools by school board Kindante in Sittard-Geleen, against the wishes of parents and the municipal council, is acceptable, and whether parents and councils have enough influence. The State Secretary answers that school boards and municipalities are responsible, that parents' consent and the dispute commission provide safeguards, and that he will not intervene in this case.
It is not for me to interfere in that.
Het is niet aan mij om me daarin te mengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosma inzake het weigeren van een journalist van de publieke omroep

An MP asked the education, culture and science state secretary whether he condemns Almere mayor Jorritsma barring a public broadcaster journalist from a town hall event open to other press, and whether he will talk to her. The state secretary answered that Almere governs its own press access, that openness to media is generally desirable, and that he will not intervene since it is a municipal matter accountable to the Almere council.
This is and remains a matter for the municipality of Almere, on which public accountability can if necessary be rendered in the Almere municipal council.
Dit is en blijft een zaak van de gemeente Almere, waarover desnoods in de gemeenteraad van Almere publieke verantwoording kan worden afgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het leerlingenvervoer

An SGP MP asked the state secretary of Education about Gaasterlân-Sleat's pupil transport costs, its tendering of transport, cost-cutting options and travel times for denominational pupils. The state secretary answered that the figures were provided by the municipality, described the legal options municipalities have to limit transport costs, and agreed to answer for the committee debate.
According to information from the municipality, the costs of pupil transport to the Eben-Haezerschool in Emmeloord, after deduction of parents' own contribution, amount to €38,712.
Volgens informatie van de gemeente bedragen de kosten van het leerlingenvervoer naar de Eben-Haezerschool te Emmeloord na aftrek van de eigen bijdrage van de ouders € 38.712.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over het blowverbod op scholen in Amsterdam

MPs Oskam and Rog asked whether the government supports a legal basis for a cannabis-smoking ban around schools in Amsterdam, how it squares with the Council of State ruling on municipal bans, and what enforcement tools municipalities have. The minister answered that the government is exploring stricter school rules, that municipalities can set coffee shop distances and local bans through the Opium Act enforcement guideline, and that court cases on the Amsterdam ban are pending.
The ministries involved are cooperating to strengthen a healthy school environment and are exploring the possibilities to tighten the rules.
De betrokken ministeries trekken samen op om een gezonde schoolomgeving te versterken en verkennen de mogelijkheden om de regels aan te scherpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog over het uitlekken van opgaven uit de Citotoets

An MP asked the state secretary about exam questions from the Cito test being offered for sale online, and what responsibility the ministry bears for preventing leaks. The state secretary answered that the government is not currently a party, that Cito considers the test may proceed, and that responsibility for security would shift to the state if the bill on a central final test is passed.
In that case, the organisation surrounding the administration of the central final test, including security and administration conditions, becomes a task of the central government.
In dat geval wordt de organisatie rondom de afname van de centrale eindtoets, waaronder de beveiliging en de afnamecondities, een taak van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het uitlekken en te koop aanbieden van de Cito-opgaven

An MP asks the state secretary for Education how original Cito test items came to be leaked and offered for sale online, whether past leaks occurred, and what will be done to guarantee fair testing and what happens to the leaked test. The government says it is unaware of how the leak happened, that Cito is investigating and has filed a complaint, that no past leaks have been observed, and that it favours a central public final test, but that the government is not a party in the current situation and Cito will proceed with the test.
In the current situation the government is not a party.
In de huidige situatie is de overheid geen partij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat de Cito-toets 2013 te koop is via Marktplaats

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the 2013 Cito test was being sold on Marktplaats and whether its questions had leaked, how this happened, and what steps would be taken. The state secretary confirmed the leak, said the cause was unknown and under investigation by Cito, and said the government is not a party in the current arrangement, so responsibility lies with Cito; security would become a government task only if the pending bill on a central final test is passed.
In the current situation the government is not a party.
In de huidige situatie is de overheid geen partij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog betreffende leraren die amper over gedragsproblemen leren

An MP asked the state secretary of Education about teacher training that gives little attention to behavioural problems, the use of a generic knowledge base for teacher training, the limited powers of education consultants in placing truant pupils, and the lack of an absence-reduction ambition in the coalition agreement. The state secretary denied that teacher training ignores learning and behaviour problems, pointed to accreditation and planned regional action plans, argued consultants' role is advisory and that the new appeals committee will handle impasses, and said the ambition on truancy will be set regionally after better absence registration.
I believe teacher training colleges and regional schools should make better agreements with each other on training teachers as well as possible in line with schools' needs.
Ik vind dat lerarenopleidingen en scholen in de regio met elkaar betere afspraken moeten maken over het zo goed mogelijk opleiden van leraren in aansluiting op de behoeften van scholen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Smits over het bericht dat leerlingen na hun eindexamen nog naar school moeten om de urennorm te halen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about a report that pupils at a special secondary school (Kentalis Kompas) must return after their final exams to meet the instruction-hours norm, and whether this is rigid and will be relaxed. The State Secretary explains that the norm for this school year is 1000 hours, that the inspectorate will be lenient in 2012/2013, that the norms will be harmonised from August 2013, and that the instruction-time norm will be modernised.

I have therefore agreed with the inspectorate that in school year 2012/2013 the inspectorate will apply the hours norm leniently when supervising compliance for pupils in special secondary education who sit exams.

Ik heb daarom met de inspectie afgesproken dat de inspectie in het schooljaar 2012/2013 bij het toezicht op de naleving van de urennorm bij leerlingen in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs die examen doen, coulant zal omgaan met die urennorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smits over het weigeren van politietoezicht door het Huygens College in Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the Huygens College in Amsterdam refusing a police-supported school safety team, the hiring of a media specialist, and whether municipalities can force police supervision on schools. The state secretary replied that a permanent safety team was agreed with police and the municipality, that schools decide their own support needs, and that the mayor already has power to deploy police in proven unsafe situations.
The mayor already has this power.
De burgermeester heeft deze bevoegdheid al.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de internationale school Eerde in Ommen

An MP asked the state secretary about alleged management abuses, gagging contracts, teacher pay and diploma validity at the international school Eerde, and whether the Inspectorate can intervene. The state secretary said the Inspectorate has only limited supervision of such schools, that Landstede's board has changed governance, and that the minister will raise the gagging contracts and any negative balance with the board and the accreditation body if needed.
I consider this an undesirable situation that does not fit normal labour relations in an educational institution, and I will hold the Landstede board to account for it.
Ik acht dit een ongewenste situatie die niet past bij normale arbeidsverhoudingen in een onderwijsinstelling en ik zal het bestuur van de Landstede hierop aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over het bericht “Meer vroegtijdig schooluitval op vmbo-scholen”

An MP asked the state secretary about a report finding higher early school leaving at schools offering only vmbo, and about labour-market prospects, parental involvement and intensive coaching. The government replied that the link exists but concerns a small group, that the Aanval op Schooluitval programme and the ouders en school samen programme address it, and that further CPB research is planned.
We will inform the ROCs about the positive effects of intensive guidance on early school leaving in this pilot.
Wij zullen de ROC’s wel informeren over de positieve effecten van intensieve begeleiding op vsv in deze pilot.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over speelnatuur en groene schoolpleinen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the health and education ministers about the benefits of green school playgrounds and whether the government supports their spread. The minister replied that municipalities and school boards are responsible, that the government welcomes such initiatives, and that VWS will stimulate healthy school playgrounds from 2013 using extra anti-obesity funds.
The national government has no direct responsibility for the design of school playgrounds and natural play areas.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen directe verantwoordelijkheid ten aanzien van de inrichting van schoolpleinen en speelnatuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuzu en Jadnanansing over de aandacht van scholen voor het omgaan met geld door jongeren

MPs Kuzu and Jadnanansing asked whether young people lack financial self-reliance and how schools and government address responsible money management. The State Secretary answered that core objectives in primary and secondary education cover consumer self-reliance and budgeting, leaving school-level implementation to schools and declining to direct schools to use specific Nibud lesson packages.
It is not for the government to encourage schools to use certain lesson packages.
Het is niet aan de overheid scholen te stimuleren bepaalde lespakketten te gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ypma over de gemeentelijke bijdrage aan vervoer van “signatuurleerlingen”

An MP asked the state secretary of Education whether municipalities should stop paying school transport for pupils attending faith-based schools elsewhere, and whether the rules should change so parents bear those costs. The government answered that the travel burden is a parental choice, that the regulation is being reconsidered in the context of the Onderwijsraad advice on article 23 of the Constitution, and committed to look at possible amendments.
I am willing to look into the possibilities of amending the regulations.
Ik ben bereid te kijken naar de mogelijkheden om de regelgeving aan te passen.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over zwendelkruiden

An MP asked the state secretary and minister whether herb mixes containing very little actual herb, and high salt and sugar, amount to consumer deception and what steps will be taken. The minister replied that the labels comply with EU food information rules, that producers should be transparent, that a review of enforceable product-improvement agreements is underway, and that the Warenwet adequately protects consumer perception.
I am currently having an official exploration carried out into options to make agreements on product improvement legally enforceable, should this be desirable in the future.
Ook laat ik momenteel een ambtelijke verkenning uitvoeren naar opties om afspraken over productverbetering ook juridisch afdwingbaar te maken, mocht dit in de toekomst wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over zwemles

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked about long swimming lesson waiting lists caused by COVID-19 restrictions, the classification of swimming lessons, child safety, and the COVID pass requirement at swimming schools. The minister answered at length, estimating 69,000 to 92,000 children lost lesson time and stating the lessons are now possible again, but declined to give exact figures and did not commit to re-seeking OMT advice.
It is difficult to say how many children have not obtained a diploma as a result of the restrictions.
Het is moeilijk te zeggen hoeveel kinderen nu geen diploma gehaald hebben als gevolg van de beperkingen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de Molukse KNIL-militairen die begin jaren ’50 naar Nederland zijn gehaald

Paulusma (D66) asked about the Moluccan KNIL soldiers brought to the Netherlands in 1951, including how many are still alive, where the deceased are buried, grave-right extensions, veterans' cemetery status, and the living conditions and child deaths in the 'woonoorden'. The government answered that no complete overview exists, that grave maintenance is largely not a central government matter, that research on the housing camps is possible via existing subsidy schemes, and that commemoration is left largely to society.
The central government does not have an overview of where the people brought to the Netherlands in 1951 and already deceased are buried.
Het is niet in beeld bij de rijksoverheid waar de mensen die in 1951 naar Nederland zijn gehaald en reeds zijn overleden, begraven liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de toekomst van de sportsector

An MP asked the minister about the state of the sports sector's financial recovery, falling sports participation among young people, comparisons with other countries, health effects and consultation with sports bodies. The minister answered that talks with sports federations and NOC*NSF are ongoing, the damage inventory is not finished, and a long-term strategy will follow, but gave no firm dates on several points and declined to compare with other countries.
This inventory has not yet been completed.
Deze inventarisatie is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Sahla over het gescheiden plaatsen van broers en zussen na een uithuisplaatsing

An MP asks the government about the separate placement of siblings after out-of-home placement, citing a Nieuwsuur broadcast, and asks about effects, registration, WODC research, pleeggezin shortages, legal anchoring and the position of foster parents. The minister answers that about 28% of sibling groups in the sample were placed separately, that this is not registered, that a report and a policy response by 1 April 2022 are promised, and that the legal anchoring question is being explored.
By 1 April 2022 the House will receive a letter in which I, on behalf of the State Secretary for VWS, will inform the House how we will follow up on the recommendations of the research report.

Uiterlijk 1 april 2022 ontvangt uw Kamer een brief waarin ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS), de Kamer zal informeren over de wijze waarop we opvolging gaan geven aan de aanbevelingen van het onderzoeksrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van den Hil over de weigering van gemeenten om onderzoek te doen naar roofhandel Joods vastgoed

MPs Ellian and Van den Hil asked the State Secretary about reports that 35 municipalities refuse to investigate the looting of Jewish property in WWII and whether they should be pressed to do so. The State Secretary said municipalities played no role in the centrally directed confiscations, encouraged voluntary research, and will consult the Ministry of BZK and VNG on encouraging municipalities.
I will check with the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) and the VNG what is possible in this regard.
Ik zal met het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) en de VNG nagaan wat daarin mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdere afname van het schoolzwemmen

An SP MP asked the government about the continued decline of school swimming lessons (from 31% to 26% of schools) and whether national action is needed. The minister answered that school swimming is not a statutory task and is a local matter, pointed to existing subsidy and a national swimming safety plan, and committed to consulting education and municipal stakeholders and to a catch-up support for COVID-related swimming delays.
School swimming is not a statutory task for education.
Schoolzwemmen is geen wettelijke taak voor het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Paulusma en Sneller over medicinale cannabis en ontoereikend beleid op maatschappelijk behoefte

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the minister about medicinal cannabis access, limited varieties for patients with severe symptoms, the lack of information and policy, and the ban on home cultivation. The minister answered that BMC has expanded varieties, a European tender is underway, research is funded, an evaluation is pending, and home cultivation remains prohibited with no individual exemption.
Your House will be informed further before the summer about the next steps following this evaluation.
Uw Kamer wordt voor de zomer nader geïnformeerd over de vervolgstappen naar aanleiding van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paternotte en Van der Laan over sporters van teamNL, die met corona besmet zijn geraakt

MPs Omtzigt, Paternotte and Van der Laan asked whether lessons were drawn after TeamNL athletes caught COVID-19 on the Tokyo flight, what measures China imposes, and whether flying on a single pre-departure test is safe. The minister replied that NOC*NSF evaluated the trip and adopted adjusted travel measures for Beijing, that no approach can reach zero risk, and that the cabinet considers a single test sufficiently safe while leaving the operational responsibility with NOC*NSF.
It is up to NOC*NSF to ensure that the TeamNL delegation can be sent to the Games in a safe manner.
Het is aan NOC*NSF om ervoor te zorgen dat de TeamNL-delegatie op een veilige manier kan worden uitgezonden naar de Spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de beslissing in de bezwaarprocedure met betrekking tot het subsidieverzoek voor de organisatie van de World Gymnaestrada 2023

An MP asked the State Secretary to explain the rejection of the subsidy application for the World Gymnaestrada 2023, its impact, and why the positive advice of the Dutch Sports Council was not followed. The minister answered that the application failed to demonstrate subsidy need, the side events were aimed at participants rather than broader social impact, and the policy conditions were not met, while offering to think along with organisers.
Moreover, the advice of the Dutch Sports Council is not the only deciding factor in reaching a subsidy grant.
Daarnaast is niet enkel het advies van de Nederlandse Sportraad bepalend om tot een subsidieverlening te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Smals over de berichtgeving in de media t.a.v. het tekort aan behandelaren waardoor er lange wachtlijsten zijn in de GGZ en instellingen zich genoodzaakt voelen tot een pati

Two VVD MPs asked about media reports of a shortage of GGZ practitioners causing long waiting lists and patient intake stops, and about the 2020 use of unfilled clinical psychologist training places to train extra GZ-psychologists. The State Secretary answered that the Capacity Body's projections should remain the guideline, that the shifted funding was a political choice rather than freed-up money, that master-psychologists already work in care, and that waiting lists are only loosely linked to the vacancy rate used in projections.

I would like to invite the parties to have investigated and substantiated how the clinical psychologist training can be made more attractive and how inflow into the KP training places can best be stimulated.

Ik zou de partijen willen uitnodigen om te laten onderzoeken en onderbouwen hoe de opleiding tot KP aantrekkelijker gemaakt kan worden en hoe de instroom in de KP opleidingsplaatsen het beste kan worden gestimuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Onverzekerdenkwestie lijkt veel op toeslagenaffaire’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that the uninsured-care scheme resembles the childcare benefits scandal, including bureaucratic burdens for providers, numbers of people whose insurance was cancelled after leaving the BRP, and compensation for uninsured people. The State Secretary defends the existing schemes as working well, denies the administrative burden is excessive, states the number of cancelled insurance cases is unknown, and rejects compensation because care was provided.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld van de ontoegankelijkheid van het openbaar vervoer voor mensen met een beperking.

MPs Bouchallikh and Westerveld asked about inaccessible public transport for people with disabilities, including broken lifts at small stations, assistance by train staff, rolling-stock seating and the involvement of disability experts. The State Secretary answered that stations are being made accessible by 2030, that platforms on the Maaslijn will follow by 2024, and that staff assistance at all times is not feasible, while promising a transport accessibility agreement and monitoring of lifts.
I share the view that public transport in principle must be accessible to all people with disabilities.
Ik deel de mening dat het OV in beginsel toegankelijk moet zijn voor alle mensen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Paternotte over de diplomatermijn in combinatie met topsport

Two D66 MPs asked how the ten-year diploma deadline for student finance is extended for elite athletes, including the criteria, definition of top sport, the role of DUO and NOC*NSF, and COVID effects. The minister explained that extensions depend on special circumstances, top sport is narrowly defined as international competition, and DUO will explore broadening the definition, but she gave no data on past extensions and did not answer by the requested deadline.
The reason for granting the extension of the diploma deadline is not registered in DUO's systems.
De reden van de toekenning voor de verlenging van de diplomatermijn wordt niet in de systemen van DUO geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over mondkapjeszwendel

An MP asks why the investigation into the face-mask deal with Van Lienden is delayed, whether the leak affects the timeline, and whether the minister will request a criminal investigation or act as shareholder against misuse of KLM's name. The minister says the research is delayed by complex data and privacy rules, the leak is not expected to affect delivery dates, the OM will assess the complaint itself, and the state as shareholder is not responsible for KLM's claims.
That is why I am having an independent investigation carried out into the agreement with RGA.
Daarom laat ik onafhankelijk onderzoek doen naar de overeenkomst met RGA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht dat veel mensen die langjarig medicijnen gebruiken geen tussentijdse beoordelingen aangeboden krijgen

The MP asks the State Secretary about a Radar survey showing many long-term medication users get no interim checks, and about antidepressant duration and pharmacy fees. The State Secretary replies that care is tailored to patients, that pharmacists and GPs monitor medication, and that an annual check for all long-term users is not necessary.
An annual check for all patients using medication long-term is therefore not necessary for everyone.
Een jaarlijkse controle bij alle patiënten die langdurig medicijnen gebruiken is daarom niet voor iedereen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een gezin € 300 per maand moet betalen voor de essentiële medicatie van hun dochter

MP Hijink asks the State Secretary why midodrine, which a family must pay for at €300 per month after insurer CZ stops covering it informally, is not reimbursed under the GVS, whether it is covered in Germany, and what short-term prospects patients have. The State Secretary answers that the Zorginstituut found insufficient evidence of effectiveness, that a re-assessment was refused for lack of new data, that reimbursement is a national matter, and that no short-term coverage can be guaranteed; he will ask the manufacturer whether a dossier is feasible.
In the short term I unfortunately cannot guarantee reimbursement.
Op korte termijn kan ik helaas geen vergoeding garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Tien jaar medicijnen slikken, zonder controle tussendoor: is het niet tijd voor een jaarlijkse medicatie-APK?’
