An MP asked the state secretary about a RADAR broadcast finding that many long-term medication users hear nothing from their pharmacist or doctor, and whether a yearly medication check should be introduced. The state secretary answered that tailored care is the responsibility of prescribers and pharmacists, that an annual check for all long-term users is not necessary and could weaken care for high-need patients, and that a broader study on medication safety is being tendered with results expected mid-2022.
An annual check for all patients who use medication long-term is therefore not necessary for everyone.
Een jaarlijkse controle bij alle patiënten die langdurig medicijnen gebruiken is daarom niet voor iedereen noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de recente misstanden bij gehandicaptenzorginstelling De Trans

The MP Hijink asked the State Secretary about serious problems at care institution De Trans, including staff alone with high-need groups, inspection criticism, and use of a budget calculation tool allocating fixed shares to overhead and returns, and whether staffing norms should exist. The State Secretary said the institution is responsible for its own allocation and staffing, declined to investigate other institutions or set staffing norms, and committed to talks with the sector on a vision for care for people with VG7 indications.
It is up to the care institution itself how it distributes the tariffs that belong to the care profiles.
Het is aan de zorginstelling zelf hoe zij de tarieven die horen bij de zorgprofielen verdeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de handhaving van het coronatoegangsbewijs en zwemles

An MP asked why swimming lessons require a coronavirus pass (CTB), leading to waiting lists, and how sports participation and disabled athletes are protected, and how clubs will enforce the CTB. The state secretary answered that the CTB applies to public indoor sports venues, that children whose parents cannot show a CTB may miss lessons but the effect on waiting lists is expected to be limited, and that clubs can get enforcement support via municipalities.
For the public indoor area of a sports facility (including the changing rooms) a CTB requirement applies to the public from age 18.
Voor de publieke binnenruimte van een locatie voor de beoefening van sport (waaronder ook de kleedkamers) geldt vanaf 18 jaar een CTB-plicht voor het publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Jeugdzorg faalt: jong kind soms niet meer terug naar ouders door onthechting'

An MP asked whether young children placed out of home are sometimes not returned to their biological parents because of attachment to foster families, and how often this happens. The minister answered that no figures exist on this specific issue, pointed to existing guidelines and the 'acceptable timeframe' criterion, acknowledged that gaps in help and fact-finding can delay returns, and referred to the reform agenda and a planned Inspectorate review of fact-finding quality.
There are currently no figures available on how often children cannot be returned to their parents due to attachment problems.
Er zijn op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar over hoe vaak het voorkomt dat kinderen (niet) kunnen worden teruggeplaatst bij hun ouders vanwege hechtingsproblemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Neef en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Juvent kan niet wegblijven uit Zeeuws-Vlaanderen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about Juvent's relocation of youth care from Zeeuws-Vlaanderen to Middelburg due to staffing shortages. The State Secretary said three youths stay at the Anker location, four moved to Middelburg with about 35 minutes' travel, and listed eleven contracted youth care providers in the region while pointing to municipalities' responsibility and broader reforms.
When children and parents need help, it is important that good help is available in a timely manner.
Wanneer kinderen en ouders hulp nodig hebben, is het van belang dat goede hulp tijdig beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de uitzending van Argos 'Diagnose bij kindermishandeling komt moeizaam tot stand'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Health about an Argos broadcast reporting that diagnosing child abuse is slow and that too little has changed in ten years, and raised questions on procedures, referrals, wait times, multidisciplinary cooperation and the closure of the MDCK centre. The government disputes that too little has been done, cites improved outcomes in a study, describes existing procedures and programmes, and promises further work, including a meeting with the LHV and integration of the GHNT programme into a new child and family protection scenario.
The government does not share the conclusion of the Argos researchers that too little has been done in the past 10 years to effectively combat child abuse.
De conclusie van de onderzoekers van Argos dat de afgelopen 10 jaar te weinig is gedaan om kindermishandeling effectief te bestrijden, delen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Belastingdienst gaf advies over omgaan met klagers in Jeugdzorg'

An MP asked whether youth care sought advice from the Tax Authority on handling parental complaints, and about the complaint routes for parents and the SKJ. The minister confirmed the Tax Authority was consulted in a 2019 round table following the Tielen/Peters motion, denied that the advice led to stricter complaint rules, and said parents' complaints must be taken seriously while noting the need to streamline complaint and disciplinary procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Markuszower over het bericht 'Alarm jeugdrechters om crisis jeugdzorg: gebrekkige dossiers en niet passende beslissingen'

MPs Maeijer and Markuszower asked the government about reports that juvenile judges warn of a youth care crisis, with poor case files and inappropriate decisions, and about waiting times, closed placements and the quality of factual investigation in child protection. The minister acknowledges pressure on child protection, reports regional gaps and an action programme, but gives no national figures on children waiting or unnecessarily detained, and points to other bodies and ongoing reviews.
No national figures are available on how many children are currently waiting for the child protection measure imposed by the juvenile judge.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen cijfers beschikbaar hoeveel kinderen op dit moment wachten op de door de kinderrechter opgelegde jeugdbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Dealen op scholen heel normaal, harddrugs vaker op gymnasiums’

An MP asks the Justice, Health and Education ministers about reports that drug dealing at schools is becoming normal, and about normalisation of drug use, youth addiction numbers, and prevention such as the Icelandic model. The government says there is no clear trend in dealing or drug use among pupils, points to €82 million for prevention, the planned revival of the LADIS addiction database in 2022, and the Helder op School programme, while declining to expand the Preventie Akkoord for now.
There is no precise data on the number of cases of dealing at school.
Over het aantal gevallen van dealen op school zijn geen precieze gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kwint over het weglekken van jeugdzorggelden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about profit-making and money flows in youth care, prompted by a Follow the Money investigation, and asked whether national oversight and data access should be strengthened. The State Secretary acknowledged high margins at some providers and pointed to municipalities' contracting and oversight powers, existing public financial reporting, planned data work in the Hervormingsagenda, a new notification requirement from 2022, and pending legislation (WIBZ) on profit distribution, while not committing to new national investigations.
Municipalities, as purchasing parties, can include conditions and hard criteria in their contracts and even in ordinances to limit profits.
Gemeenten kunnen als inkopende partij in hun contractering en zelfs in verordeningen randvoorwaarden en harde criteria opnemen om winsten te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Hulp aan duikslachtoffers in gevaar: behandelcentrum in Goes heeft geld nodig’

MPs Van den Hil and Aukje de Vries asked about a diving-victim treatment centre in Goes facing financial pressure and its role in navy and offshore work. The minister replied that the centre has no financial problems per the NZa, that a 24/7 funding question remains open between the centre and insurers, and that insurers bear the duty of care.
It is therefore not for me to form an opinion on the future of care for diving casualties or the position of the treatment centre in Goes.
Het is dus niet aan mij om een mening te vormen over de toekomst van de zorg voor duikslachtoffers of de positie van het behandelcentrum in Goes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over belemmeringen voor gezinshuizen en pleegouders

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport, about obstacles for foster-care and family-home (gezinshuis) providers, covering numbers of children and providers, regional differences, age profile, municipal requirements and tariffs, contract duration, placement moves, fiscal problems for foster parents, legal standing of family-home parents and COVID-related costs. The State Secretary answered at length with data from publications, mostly describing existing policy and pointing to municipalities and the IGJ for local matters, and committed to a study of financial problems for foster parents to be sent to the House in November 2021.
A broad study is currently underway examining which financial bottlenecks foster parents face.
Momenteel loopt een breed onderzoek waarin wordt nagegaan met welke financiële knelpunten pleegouders te maken hebben

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over berichtgeving in de media t.a.v. het tekort aan behandelaren waardoor er lange wachtlijsten zijn in de GGZ en instellingen zich genoodzaakt voelen tot een patiëntenstop

An MP asked the state secretary about media reports of a shortage of mental health treatment staff, long waiting lists and patient admission stops, and whether more GZ-psychologist training places should be funded. The state secretary said he follows the Capaciteitsorgaan's advice on training places, sees no reason to add places now, and that a decision on funding orthopedagogue training is for the next cabinet.
I therefore see no reason to make more training places available.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om meer opleidingsplaatsen beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het grote tekort aan zwemleraren en de risico’s voor de zwemveiligheid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a severe shortage of swimming instructors and lifeguards threatening swimming safety and pool services, its causes, consequences and remedies. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortage, said pool operation is a municipal task so the national role is facilitating, and listed national plan measures on training, retention and the image of the profession.
Since swimming is a public task assigned to the municipalities, I see the national government's role as mainly facilitating and supporting.
Aangezien zwemmen een publieke taak is die bij de gemeenten belegd is, zie ik voor de rijksoverheid vooral een faciliterende en ondersteunende rol weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over het besluit om coronatoegangsbewijzen verplicht te stellen voor ouders die hun kind naar zwemles komen brengen

Two MPs from the SP asked why the government extended the COVID certificate requirement to parents bringing children to swimming lessons, and whether exemptions could be made. The Minister defended the measure as an OMT-advised step to reduce transmission, noted parents can obtain a QR code by vaccination, recovery or testing, and refused to create an exemption.
I choose not to make an exception for this.
Ik kies ervoor om hier geen uitzondering voor te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Gemeenten hebben tekorten over zichzelf afgeroepen'

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a report that municipalities caused youth care shortages themselves, and about administrative burdens, dyslexia providers' profits, and tariff differentiation. The state secretary acknowledged the report, pointed to a convenant on reducing administrative burden, a forthcoming Hervormingsagenda, a study on transferring severe dyslexia to education, and joint measures with municipalities on tariff differentiation, without concrete new commitments.
I previously committed that I will, together with the Minister of BVOM, inform the House in 2022 about the outcomes of this study.
Eerder heb ik toegezegd dat ik, samen met de Minister van BVOM, uw Kamer in 2022 zal informeren over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat vergoeding van het medicijn Kaftrio tegen taaislijmziekte (CF) opnieuw is uitgesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary why reimbursement of the cystic fibrosis drug Kaftrio has been delayed again and why Dutch patients wait while other countries already reimburse it. The State Secretary answered that the Zorginstituut judged the price unjustifiably high, that price negotiations with the manufacturer are ongoing without agreement, and that he has asked the manufacturer to make the drug available during negotiations.
I am also, on condition, willing to take the costs of making the drug available into account in my negotiations with the manufacturer.
Ik ben, onder voorwaarde, ook bereid om de kosten voor de beschikbaarheidsstelling mee te wegen in mijn onderhandelingen met de fabrikant.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgwekkende fysieke ontwikkeling van kinderen en de nieuwe generatie sporters

An MP asked the State Secretary about declining motor skills and fitness among children and young athletes, citing a warning from coach Jac Orie, and asked whether government action is sufficient, including why a third weekly PE lesson has not been introduced. The government acknowledges the decline, points to the two-hour weekly PE requirement from 2023, the Nationaal Sportakkoord and the 'Nederland Vitaal en in beweging' advice, and defers further steps to a next cabinet.
It is up to a next cabinet to take further steps on this.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om hier vervolgstappen in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Jasper van Dijk over in Nederland geboren Molukkers die stateloos zijn

MPs Paulusma and Van Dijk asked about Dutch-born Moluccans who are stateless but hold Dutch travel documents under the Moluccans Position Act, including how many there are, how naturalisation works, and whether they should be actively informed about the option of Dutch nationality with voting rights. The state secretary answers that about 850 such people hold documents, at least 450 have obtained Dutch nationality over the years, and she is willing to discuss the matter with the Moluccan community while showing restraint in actively promoting nationality, since the Act was a deliberate choice.
I am of course willing to discuss this with representatives of the Moluccan community.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met vertegenwoordigers van de Molukse gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Van Ginneken, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Simons over het faillissement van de ggz-instelling voor transgenderzorg 'Stepwork'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and BIJ1 asked about the bankruptcy of Stepwork, a major transgender care mental health provider, its impact on waiting lists and continuity of care, and what government could have done earlier. The State Secretary answered that continuity of care is secured through takeover by Genderhealthcare, that the government had intervened repeatedly since 2019, and that a review of the psychological assessment requirement is being prepared via ZonMw.
The policy of the Ministry of VWS is aimed at continuity of care for patients and clients, not at continuity of individual institutions.
Het beleid van VWS is gericht op continuïteit van zorg voor patiënten en cliënten, en niet op continuïteit van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het onderzoek naar en het verdere verloop van de gang van zaken rond de zogenoemde mondkapjesdeals van Sywert van Lienden

An MP asked sixteen questions about the delayed independent investigation into the face-mask purchases involving Sywert van Lienden, including why data collection is slow, the role of the ministry in the RGA order, and when the reports and documents will be published. The State Secretary answered that results are expected by year-end at the earliest, attributed delays to data complexity and privacy rules, and deflected several questions to ongoing procedures or the investigators.

Should the results of the first part of the investigation, concerning the agreement with Hulptroepen Alliantie (HA) / Relief Goods Alliance B.V. (RGA), not be final by the first quarter of 2022, I will at the latest in that quarter share the status at that time.

Mochten de resultaten van het eerste deel van het onderzoek – de overeenkomst met Hulptroepen Alliantie (HA) / Relief Goods Alliance B.V. (RGA) nog niet in het eerste kwartaal van 2022 definitief zijn dan deel ik uiterlijk in dat kwartaal de stand van zaken van dat moment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over het bericht ‘Tekort aan behandelaren veroorzaakt naast wachtlijsten ook patiëntenstop in de ggz’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that staff shortages in mental health care cause waiting lists and intake stops, asking about shortages, training numbers, complexity, digital care, cross-regional allocation, ANW duties, sickness absence, external hiring costs and training capacity. The State Secretary answered at length with data and policy measures, but said some figures (shortages per profession, unemployed staff, costs of external hires, complexity trends) cannot be provided, and committed to informing parliament on regional allocation power and new waiting-time figures.
It is not possible to state how large the shortage of specific professional groups in mental health care is at present.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoe groot het tekort aan specifieke beroepsgroepen in de ggz op dit moment is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat Siriz verboden staatssteun heeft ontvangen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the continued grant to Siriz, which NRC reports was unlawful state aid, was defensible, and why advice from civil servants was disregarded. The State Secretary defended the grants as a transition to a new open-house funding model, rejected recovery of the aid, and said the subsidy ended in 2020 after the state-aid review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Ellemeet over de onrechtmatige staatssteun aan Siriz

MPs Jetten and Ellemeet asked the state secretary about Siriz's unlawful state aid, its subsidy history, contacts with the ministry, and the Court of Audit's findings. The state secretary acknowledged that the subsidy constituted unlawful state aid, gave a year-by-year payment table, but declined to make the 2019 state-aid assessments available and said recovery is not possible while no Commission or court ruling exists.
There are no documents containing full state-aid assessments that can be sent to your House.
Er zijn geen documenten met integrale staatssteuntoetsen die aan uw Kamer kunnen worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van der Laan over het WRR-rapport: Kiezen voor houdbare zorg

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the WRR report on sustainable healthcare, including quick wins, citizen forums, foreign care workers and prevention. The minister answered that hard political choices are needed but largely deferred concrete responses on the recommendations to a next cabinet, pointing to existing policy documents.
It is up to a next cabinet to make choices on this and to respond substantively to the WRR recommendations.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om daar keuzes in te maken en inhoudelijk te reageren op de aanbevelingen van de WRR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht dat Tilburgse kappers op blauwe plekken gaan letten in de aanpak tegen huiselijk geweld

An MP from the CDA asked whether Tilburg's plan to train hairdressers to report suspected domestic violence, and the wider idea of organised reporting points, is consistent with government policy on youth care and trust between citizens and professionals. The State Secretary answered that Veilig Thuis is the only reporting point, that reporting must follow the mandatory meldcode with care for trust, and that the government supports Tilburg's initiative to raise awareness without changing the meldcode.
Apart from Veilig Thuis there are no other organised reporting points for reporting domestic violence.
Naast Veilig Thuis zijn er geen andere georganiseerde meldpunten voor het melden van huiselijk geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Rotavaccin op de lange(re) baan geschoven: ‘Onbegrijpelijk. Dit kan duizenden opnames schelen’

An SP MP asked why the government postpones the decision to add rotavirus vaccination to the national vaccination programme despite a Health Council recommendation, and about costs and timing. The State Secretary says he is positive about the advice, but a decision must await the next cabinet and structural budget funding at the spring budget decision, with a RIVM implementation plan in preparation and an estimated cost of about 20 million euro per year.
However, given the caretaker status of the cabinet, it is up to the next cabinet to take a definitive decision following this advice.
Het is echter, gelet op de demissionaire status van het kabinet, aan het volgend kabinet om naar aanleiding van dit advies een definitief besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Kuiken over het niet opnemen van het rotavaccin in het rijksvaccinatieprogramma ondanks het positieve advies van de Gezondheidsraad

MPs Van der Laan and Kuiken asked why the rotavirus vaccine has not been added to the national vaccination programme despite positive Health Council advice, and why the decision is deferred to a new cabinet. The state secretary answered that a definitive decision awaits the next cabinet and budget cover, that the vaccine's cost-effectiveness depends on price, and that an implementation plan will be prepared.
In my letter of 20 September I informed the House that I am positive about the Health Council's advice, but that it is up to the next cabinet to take a definitive decision based on this advice.

In mijn brief van 20 september jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat ik positief sta tegenover het advies van de Gezondheidsraad, maar dat het aan het volgend kabinet is om naar aanleiding van dit advies een definitief besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Geen geld voor de tandarts: 'Mondzorg moet terug in het basispakket'’

MP Hijink (SP) asked the minister how he views reports that people skip dental care for financial reasons, whether this costs society more, and whether dental care should return to the basic insurance package. The minister acknowledges the problem but says data is limited, announces a long-term oral health monitor, and refuses to restore dental care to the basic package, pointing instead to municipal tailored support and local arrangements.
No. As previously stated, the basic principle is that adults have their own responsibility for caring for their teeth.
Nee. Zoals eerder aangegeven is de basis dat volwassenen een eigen verantwoordelijkheid hebben voor de verzorging van hun gebit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Peters over het artikel 'Mogelijk honderden kinderen uit gezinnen die de dupe waren van toeslagenaffaire, zijn uit huis geplaatst'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Peters (CDA) asked whether children were taken from home as a result of wrongly imposed childcare-benefit repayments, and what the state is doing to reunite families. The government says it does not yet know how many families are affected, that financial problems alone are no legal ground for removal, and that it is working on a recovery programme and a route via municipalities.
It is currently not known how many families of affected parents have had to deal with an out-of-home placement or reinstatement.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen van gedupeerde ouders te maken hebben (gehad) met een uithuisplaatsing of terugplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over kinderen in jeugdzorg vanwege de gevolgen van de toeslagaffaire

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about children placed in youth care as a consequence of the childcare benefits scandal, including how many families are affected, compensation, and how to prevent further out-of-home placements. The State Secretary acknowledged the signals, said the number is not yet known and is being mapped, pointed to financial compensation and the 'Leven op de rit' programme, and promised further information to parliament in November 2021 on a child and family protection scenario.
It is currently not known how many families of affected parents have had or are having an out-of-home placement or return.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen van gedupeerde ouders te maken hebben (gehad) met een uithuisplaatsing of terugplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Gezondheidslobby casht jackpot in gokbranche'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about reports that health-sector organisations such as MIND promoted state-run lotteries, the role of the Nederlandse Loterij, gambling reclame rules, and monitoring of gambling addiction. The government answered most questions substantively, committing to talks with MIND and asking the Kansspelautoriteit to act, while noting data gaps (LADIS not operational) and that some questions fall under other ministries or are commercially confidential.
Regarding the budgeted financial returns of any participation, we do not share information because it may concern commercially sensitive and competition-sensitive business information.
Over begrote financiële opbrengsten van welke deelneming dan ook, delen wij geen informatie omdat dit mogelijk bedrijfs-commerciële en concurrentiegevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het niet voldoen aan internationale eisen voor antidopingbeleid en de mogelijke sancties voor de Nederlandse Sport

MPs Van der Laan, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands fails to meet WADA's revised anti-doping code, when the government and the anti-doping authority learned of the non-compliance, and what sanctions Dutch sport could face. Minister Blokhuis answered that the independence of the Doping Appeals Committee (BND) is the remaining compliance issue, that legislation is being prepared, and that sanctions would not apply retroactively and could be contested before CAS.
I have answered the questions separately.
Ik heb de vragen afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Laan over de capaciteit bij de GGD’en

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about GGD capacity, outbreak preparedness, staffing shortages, contact tracing gaps, and the public-private testing and appointment arrangements during the COVID-19 period. The minister responded that GGDs had been assessed as generally capable, that preparedness was coordinated via RIVM and existing programmes, and that capacity and scheduling were adequate, though he gave limited detail on some preparedness contacts and did not commit to new concrete steps.
The GGD appointment system functions adequately.
Het afsprakensysteem van de GGD'en functioneert adequaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de toename van drugsgebruik onder studenten

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Justice and Health about rising student drug use, cocaine in particular, and how the care system and monitoring respond. The State Secretary answered that no national student-specific data exist yet, pointed to a monitor due in autumn 2021, acknowledged missing addiction-care data due to a stalled LADIS database, and described prevention programmes and funding.
There are currently no national figures on drug use specifically among the student population.
Er zijn op dit moment geen landelijke cijfers over het middelengebruik onder specifiek de studentenpopulatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de afwezigheid van het kabinet en de aanwezigheid van de Koning en Koningin bij de ‘Dutch Grand Prix’ in Zandvoort

An MP asked why ministers and state secretaries should not attend the Dutch Grand Prix in Zandvoort while the King and Queen do, given the King's role as head of government. The government answered that the cabinet agreed on restraint at events during the corona period, with capacity limited to two-thirds, and that the King's attendance as head of state reinforces the event's international profile.
In that light, the cabinet did not find it appropriate to attend itself.
Het kabinet vond het in dat licht niet gepast om zelf wel aanwezig te zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van den Berg over het factsheet voor GGD-medewerkers van test- of vaccinatiestraten, van klantcontactcentra (KCC), van bron- en contactonderzoeken en van vaccinatiesessies t.b.v.

CDA MPs Peters and Van den Berg asked the State Secretary for Health about a GGD factsheet for staff at test, vaccination, contact-centre and contact-tracing sites on recognising and reporting child and domestic abuse, questioning under-reporting, the number of reports, and the burden of reports handled by Veilig Thuis. The State Secretary answered that no figures exist on reports from GGD sites, that the factsheet does not steer staff toward reporting, that Veilig Thuis triages most reports to local support, and that a more transparent child protection system is being developed.
There are no figures known on the number of reports made via GGD test or vaccination sites.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend van het aantal meldingen dat via GGD test- of vaccinatiestraten is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het stilgehouden rapport Woittiez over structurele en ernstige juridische fouten in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked why a 2018 exploratory document ('Incident of Patroon?') on structural legal failures in youth care was not shared with parliament, and how the government chooses the reform agenda and involves experiential experts. The minister answered that the document was a short exploration rather than a full report, judged not to need sharing because the problem was already known and being addressed, and outlined the reform agenda and consultation processes while leaving final decisions to a new cabinet.

Given the nature of the exploration and the fact that it showed the problem was already known and being addressed, there was then no reason seen to inform me about the exploration and therefore not to share it with your House.

Gezien de aard van de verkenning en gelet op het feit dat uit de verkenning bleek dat de problematiek reeds bekend was en werd opgepakt, is destijds geen aanleiding gezien om mij te informeren over de verkenning en daardoor ook niet om de verkenning met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Meldingen eergerelateerd geweld stijgen, opvang vol’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that honour-related violence notifications are rising while shelter places are full, including shelter capacity, perpetrator removal, early recognition and a multi-year action programme. The government answered that notifications rose only slightly in 2020, that shelter demand peaked and was temporarily solved, that criminal law tools exist, and that work on prevention and a follow-up exploration is ongoing.
Talks are now taking place between the VNG, municipalities and care providers on the availability, occupancy and financing of this specialised shelter, with the aim of reaching a structural solution.

Er vinden nu gesprekken plaats tussen VNG, gemeenten en betrokken zorgaanbieders over de beschikbaarheid, bezetting en financiering van deze specialistische vorm van opvang, met als doel om tot een structurele oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de eigen bijdrage in de ggz

An MP asked whether mental health patients must pay the deductible twice for treatment spanning a calendar year under the new care-performance model, and whether about 100,000 patients are affected. The State Secretary confirmed that a treatment crossing the calendar-year boundary can trigger the deductible in two years, estimating up to 9% (about 100,000) of patients pay more, while defending the new funding model and listing compensation measures.
For an estimated maximum of 9% of mental health clients there is an effect; this concerns roughly a group of 100,000 people.
Voor naar schatting maximaal 9% van de ggz-cliënten is er wel een gevolg; het gaat bij benadering om een groep van 100.000 mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Meerdere mensen overleden door zelfdoding-middel, verkoper uit Eindhoven (28) opgepakt’

An ChristenUnie MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about reports of deaths from a suicide agent (Middel X) sold via the Coöperatie Laatste Wil and an Eindhoven seller, and whether sale to individuals should be banned. The government answers that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that existing voluntary industry monitoring is kept, that a ban is not pursued because legal regulation is complicated and possibly counterproductive, and that the VWS ministry will consult the industry code parties again.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide any information on this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de documentaire 'Goede Moeders'

MP Westerveld asks the Ministers about the documentary 'Goede Moeders' on repeated child removals, including reporting of new pregnancies, Veilig Thuis and youth-care investigation procedures, inaccurate case files, and the status of a motion and action plan to reduce out-of-home placements. The government answers that reporting is governed by the Meldcode and sector frameworks without a legal reporting duty, describes fact-finding safeguards and complaint routes, and says the motion's plan is under study with a roundtable planned, though it provides no firm commitment on the plan.

I am aware that in practice parents and children sometimes believe that the organisations concerned, such as Veilig Thuis, the certified institutions or the Child Protection Board, have not conducted proper fact-finding and that incorrect information remains in files and petitions.

Het is mij bekend dat het in de praktijk voorkomt dat ouders en kinderen menen dat door de betreffende organisaties, zoals VT, de GI's of de RvdK, geen goed feitenonderzoek is gedaan en dat onjuiste informatie in dossiers en verzoekschriften blijft staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Westerveld over het bericht 'Jeugdzorg sluit kinderen nog steeds op in isoleercel: belofte ermee te stoppen niet nagekomen'

MPs Simons and Westerveld asked why youth-care JeugdzorgPlus institutions still isolate children despite promises to stop, and what is being done about it. The minister explains the project results, the causes of persistent isolation, and plans such as a new bill (Wet rechtspositie gesloten jeugdhulp) with a 'nee, tenzij' rule and limits on isolation, though not a total ban.
I do not intend to ban forced isolation entirely.
Ik ben niet voornemens om gedwongen afzonderen geheel te verbieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het artikel Twee medewerkers Haagse ggz-instelling ernstig gewond bij geweldsincident, verdachte dood gevonden

An MP asked the state secretary about a shooting incident that began at a Parnassia mental health clinic in The Hague, and about weapons checks, prior incident reports, protections for staff and the handling of aggressive patients. The state secretary answered that no weapons checks are done at such low-threshold clinics, that no prior reports were known to the IGJ, and listed existing protocols, training, a sector-wide approach to aggression and a subsidy route, while stating that investigation of the incident is still ongoing.
A shooting incident took place in the Parnassia premises on Leggelostraat in The Hague. I cannot say more about this at the moment, because the investigation into this incident is still ongoing.

Er heeft een schietincident plaatsgevonden in het pand van Parnassia aan de Leggelostraat in Den Haag. Meer kan ik daar op dit moment nog niet over zeggen, omdat het onderzoek naar dit incident nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kathmann en Kuiken over het schietincident bij de ggz-locatie Parnassia

Two MPs asked the Justice and Security and Health ministers about a shooting at a mental health facility, whether the perpetrator's firearm permit had been revoked, whether such persons should be monitored, and how to protect mental health staff from violence. The government answered that the permit was withdrawn and weapons seized, that revoked-permit holders are not specifically monitored under the Firearms Act though past compulsory-care records are weighed in new applications, that no reliable violence statistics exist, and that it will work with sector partners on reporting and a police-mental health cooperation protocol.
Violence against care workers is not subject to a reporting obligation and is not recorded in a uniform way in police systems.
Geweld tegen hulpverleners is niet meldingsplichtig en wordt niet op een eenduidige manier vastgelegd in de politiesystemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over de artikelen ‘Inzet UHR-screening kan jaarlijks 1.800 psychoses voorkomen’ en ‘The Clinical High Risk for Psychosis (CHR-P) Model Is Flawed’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about articles claiming UHR screening could prevent 1,800 psychoses yearly and that the CHR-P model is flawed, asking about its origin, age limits, costs, effects and who decides and pays. The State Secretary answered that the Psychose care standard dates from 2017, explained the age range and cost-saving evidence, and argued that the critical article does not oppose screening within the UHR group, with care reimbursed under the basic insurance where it follows the standard.
The Psychose care standard is not a new care standard.
De zorgstandaard Psychose is geen nieuwe zorgstandaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht dat er jaarlijks tientallen meldingen binnenkomen over financiële uitbuiting van ouderen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of financial exploitation of older people, the outcome of a consultation with municipalities, the role of volunteer networks and local alliances, whether municipalities should be obliged to address elder abuse, and the awareness campaign. The state secretary answered that an expert pool for municipalities is planned for October, that municipalities are responsible under the Wmo and no detailed national requirements will be imposed, and that a reporting on the approach will follow in the progress report at the end of the year.
I do not have a precise picture of how many municipalities have or do not have an approach to elder abuse, and specifically financial abuse.
Ik heb niet precies in beeld hoeveel gemeenten wel of geen aanpak hebben op het gebied van ouderenmishandeling, en specifiek financieel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het overlijden van een 28-jarige vrouw door het dodelijke poeder van de Coöperatie Laatste Wil

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health and justice ministers about the death of a 28-year-old woman who took a lethal powder recommended by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about the cooperative's activities, data on deaths, criminal liability and possible prohibition. The minister answered that a criminal investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, that the NVIC data are only partially shared on advice, and that existing chemical-sale measures and a 2019 monitoring code remain in place, while noting that providing mere general information is not necessarily punishable.
Regarding this criminal investigation, I cannot make any further statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de uitzending van het TV-programma Pointer van 7 juni 2021

An MP asked the state secretary about a Pointer broadcast on ggz patients with complex needs who are refused by providers, including whether such patients can be counted, whether enough treatment exists, whether an acceptance obligation should be investigated, and how to improve identification and provision. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, stated that these patients cannot currently be registered, pointed to regional tables and new funding mechanisms, but rejected an acceptance obligation.
I am not in favour of an acceptance obligation in mental health care.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een acceptatieplicht in de ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over fouten in de jeugdzorg stilgehouden’

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Rechtsbescherming about a 2018 internal exploration 'Incident of patroon?' that allegedly showed systematic errors in youth-care files and was withheld from the ministers and the father in a case. The minister answered that it was an exploration rather than a report, that the claim of hundreds of cases per year is not substantiated, that the ministers were not informed, and that the actionplan on fact-finding is in progress with evaluation in 2022.
I am of the view that the method chosen for this exploration is not the right way to answer a broader systemic question.
Ik ben van mening dat de methode, zoals die in deze verkenning is gekozen, niet de juiste manier is om tot beantwoording van een bredere stelselvraag te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Van den Hil over "het bericht dat uitkeringen van psychiatrische patiënten zijn stopgezet na een gedwongen opname"

MPs De Kort and Van den Hil asked whether social assistance benefits of psychiatric patients are stopped entirely after a compulsory admission, and how many cases and which municipalities are involved. The minister answers that the right to general assistance is not wholly lost, that the data on cases is not registered, and that an amendment restoring general assistance after compulsory admission is being prepared for entry into force by 1 January 2022.
It is not known in which municipalities benefits under general assistance are stopped upon compulsory admission.
Het is ook niet bekend in welke gemeenten uitkeringen op grond van algemene bijstand bij een gedwongen opname worden stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de leefstijlcampagne ‘Fit op jouw manier’ en het aanpakken van de grondoorzaken van ongezond leven

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary of Health about the 'Fit op jouw manier' lifestyle campaign, its cost, its adequacy for low-income and polluted-area residents, and structural causes of unhealthy living. The State Secretary answers that the campaign budget is EUR 3.44 million, that it complements structural measures such as the Prevention Agreement and food-environment policy, and commits to further reports and a RIVM study.
I acknowledge that further steps are needed and have therefore asked the RIVM to investigate which additional measures could be deployed.
Ik erken dat er verdere stappen nodig zijn en heb daarom het RIVM gevraagd om te onderzoeken welke extra maatregelen ingezet kunnen worden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuiken over het zonder opleiding, met een strafblad en onder valse titel verlenen van zorg

An MP asks how a youth-care director with a criminal record, no training and a misused psychotherapist title could obtain a certificate of conduct (VOG) and keep working, and what oversight failed. The government answers that the VOG was issued after a screening-profile error that is being corrected, that the inspectorate warned the director over the title, and that governance and declaration-fraud investigations are ongoing, with the inspectorate pursuing a new inspection visit.
Because the requested function combined unusually with the indicated screening profile, Justis requested the job description.
Doordat er sprake was van een ongebruikelijke combinatie van de beoogde functie en het aangegeven screeningsprofiel is de functieomschrijving door Justis opgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht van een “veroordeelde stalker, neptherapeut, fraudeur en toch jeugdzorgdirecteur”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that a convicted stalker and fraudster heads a youth care company that bills for care allegedly not delivered, and about how inspectorates, municipalities and insurers failed to detect this. The government answered at length that it cannot comment on individual criminal cases or VOG decisions, described the IGJ's 2018-2020 inspections and signals, the pending Wbsrz data-sharing bill, and the ongoing investigation with further inspection visits.
Due to the confidentiality of the information and the privacy of the person concerned, no statements can be made about individual criminal cases.
Omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid van de informatie en de privacy van betrokkene kunnen er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de website ‘Fit op jouw manier’

An MP from the FvD asks the State Secretary for Health about the 'Fit op jouw manier' lifestyle campaign website, including its cost, visitor numbers, and an overview of government information campaigns of the past three years. The State Secretary gives the campaign budget and media spend, the visitor count, and refers to the government's website and annual reports for campaign evaluations, without listing all campaigns.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de schaderegeling voor slachtoffers in de jeugdzorg

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the minister about the compensation scheme for youth-care victims, covering rejected applications, aftercare, the asset test, debt-rescheduling claw-back and ZMOK-school placements. The minister answered in detail, explaining rejection grounds, referral to support lines, the Belastingdienst form process, Wsnp rules and why voluntary placements are excluded, while committing to no new action.
Placement via a ZMOK school does not fall under forced placement within the meaning of the scheme.
Plaatsing via een ZMOK-school valt niet onder gedwongen plaatsing in de zin van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Özütok en Westerveld over de blijvende tekorten voor jeugdzorg bij gemeenten

MPs Kuiken, Özütok and Westerveld asked whether the government should have resolved the chronic youth care funding shortfall at municipalities earlier, and why no extra money was provided now. The State Secretary replied that the government granted temporary funds (over EUR 1 billion for 2021 and EUR 1.314 billion for 2022), agreed savings with municipalities, committed to a reform agenda, and that a new cabinet must decide on structural funding taking the Commission of Wise Men's ruling as a weighty input.
The cabinet makes available an additional EUR 1.314 billion to municipalities in 2022 for the youth care shortfalls.
Het kabinet stelt in 2022 € 1,314 miljard extra beschikbaar aan gemeenten voor de tekorten vanwege de jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Plannen voor daklozenwoningen belanden te vaak in ijskast’

MPs Van den Hil and Koerhuis asked whether homelessness housing plans are stalling, how many of the 10,000 supported housing places have been realised, and whether temporary housing, prioritisation and municipal data are adequate. The State Secretary answered that municipalities report about 2,200 places realised by end 2020 (on track by their own measure), with overlapping figures from housing associations and the BZK fund, acknowledged delays due to COVID, and deferred further prioritisation and additional measures to a future cabinet.
It is up to a future cabinet to determine how the follow-up is shaped.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om te bepalen hoe het vervolg vorm wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht 'Kind in nood wacht gemiddeld tien maanden op hulp'

The MP Maeijer asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that children in need wait on average 44 weeks for youth care, and how waiting lists would be curbed given expected COVID-related rises in youth mental health problems. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to €613 million in extra funds, a regulation for €50 million and a first waiting-time report due in November, and said municipalities are responsible for youth care provision.
I see the urgency and share the concerns. It is my intention to take appropriate measures as quickly as possible.
Ik zie de urgentie en deel de zorgen. Het is mijn intentie om zo snel mogelijk passende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de hoge werkdruk van jeugdbeschermers

An MP from the CDA asked the government about reports of high workloads, staff turnover and waiting lists among youth protection workers, and about the risks of market mechanisms revealed by the Intervence and Briedis cases. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to multiple causes, and listed legislative and short-term measures while promising a report on the financial position of providers this autumn.
I endorse the importance of sufficient financial resilience.
Ik onderschrijf het belang van voldoende weerstandsvermogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Markuszower over kinderrechters die de noodklok luiden over de situatie van de jeugdzorg in Zeeland

PVV MPs asked whether judges' warnings that no youth care provider in Zeeland can take on court-ordered child protection cases, causing long waits, mean children are left without help, and what the government will do. The minister answers that new measures can still be assigned, but some children wait for a fixed case manager, with interim safety arrangements; a taskforce and a takeover of Intervence are underway, and the government says it will not take over regie.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for implementing youth protection and youth probation.
Gemeenten zijn conform de Jeugdwet verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van jeugdbescherming en -reclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over de Verwijsindex Risicojongeren

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (youth risk referral index), including whether the promised review covers parents' and children's perspectives, how misuse and stigmatisation are prevented, who checks correct use, and how families can see their registration. The State Secretary answered that the in-depth review is ongoing, will include youth and parent organisations, will report after the summer, and that municipalities and the Inspectie are responsible for oversight, with families informed of registrations and able to object.
After the summer I will inform the House of the outcomes of the in-depth study and my policy response to it.
Na de zomer zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het verdiepend onderzoek en mijn beleidsreactie hierop geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat artsen alarm slaan over lachgas

MP Kuik (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Health about doctors' warnings on nitrous oxide (lachgas) abuse, including cardiovascular and neurological harm, why it is seen as harmless, and why a national recreational-use ban on the Opiumwet list has not taken effect. The State Secretary reported rising incident figures, prevention plans, and that the ban was delayed by lack of police enforcement funding and is now left to a new cabinet, with no regulation expected before spring 2022.
I share the view that it is important to take national measures against the supply of nitrous oxide for recreational use as quickly as possible.
Ik deel de mening dat het belangrijk is om zo snel mogelijk landelijke maatregelen tegen het aanbod van lachgas voor recreatief gebruik te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de uitstel van de invoering van het verbod op lachgas en designerdrugs en het bericht ‘Woede om uitstel drugswet: ‘Echt grote onzin’’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Health ministers why enforcement of a ban on nitrous oxide and designer drugs such as 3-MMC was postponed, and why such substances remain easily available. The government answered that the delay stems from a lack of financing for police, prosecution and forensic enforcement costs, so the decision is left to a new cabinet, while it is preparing a separate 3-MMC ban and prevention measures.
The decision on both initiatives is therefore left to a new cabinet, as stated in the letter of 31 March on this subject.
Het besluit over beide initiatieven wordt dus overgelaten aan een nieuw kabinet, zoals vermeld in de brief van 31 maart jl. over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de sluiting van de noodopvang voor ‘niet- rechthebbende’ dak- en thuislozen

An MP from BIJ1 asked why emergency shelter for homeless people without residence rights was closed, whether they can isolate or get vaccinated, and whether housing for everyone is possible. The State Secretary replied that the shelter wind-down was tied to step 2 of the reopening plan, that GGD and shelter organisations have quarantine and vaccination arrangements, and that structural housing and a pilot for unlawfully staying migrants are being pursued.
The wind-down period lasts until 2 June.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Paternotte over de berichtgeving dat arbeidsmigranten niet allemaal een vaccin krijgen en de maatschappelijke opvang voor ongedocumenteerden wordt afgebouwd

Opposition MPs Paulusma and Paternotte asked why migrant workers and undocumented people not registered in the BRP may not receive vaccination invitations and why emergency shelter is being wound down. Minister De Jonge answered that unregistered groups are being reached via GGD regional plans and outreach, and that the shelter wind-down timing remains appropriate.

The Ministry of VWS asked the GGD regions, together with regional partners such as municipalities, shelter organisations and street doctors, to draw up a regional implementation plan for vaccinating homeless people, people in women's shelters and undocumented people.

Het Ministerie van VWS heeft GGD-en verzocht – in samenwerking met regionale partners zoals gemeenten, opvanginstellingen en straatdokters – een regionaal uitvoeringsplan te maken voor de vaccinatie van dakloze mensen, mensen die verblijven in de vrouwenopvang en ongedocumenteerde mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de wachtlijstproblematiek in de jeugdpsychiatrie naar aanleiding van de mondelinge vraag van het lid Westerveld

An FvD MP asked whether youth psychiatric care use has risen over ten years and whether research should be commissioned into why. The State Secretary reported that youth care use grew about 3.2% a year but fell in 2020, that youth mental health care is not tracked separately, and that further research on outpatient youth care will be reported before summer, without a new study now.
Because the Youth Act aims to provide integrated help, no separate data is kept on youth mental health care.
Omdat de Jeugdwet beoogt integraal hulp te bieden, wordt er geen afzonderlijke data bijgehouden over de jeugd-ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over de NOS-berichten inzake matchfixing

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked the government about rising gambling addiction during the COVID crisis, the expected effects of opening the online gambling market, and matchfixing risks. The Minister answered that addiction trends cannot be verified because the LADIS database is not operational, that the market opening on 1 October 2021 will proceed with stricter prevention rules, and outlined existing matchfixing cooperation and reporting arrangements.
Unfortunately it is not possible to determine whether the number of people with a gambling addiction seeking help has increased.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om in beeld te brengen of het aantal mensen met een gokverslaving dat zich heeft gemeld bij hulpverlening is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld en Hijink over het bericht 'Durfinvesteerders zien brood in tieners met lichte psychische klachten, zwaardere patiënten belanden op wachtlijst'

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld and Hijink asked about reports that venture investors target teenagers with mild mental health complaints while severe patients face waiting lists, and about profit limits, foreign investment and the treatment of suicidal youth. The state secretary said gemeenten can set profit caps and tariffs, pointed to the planned Wibz and Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid zorg voor jeugdigen, and reported that only a few investment firms are active in youth care.
I do not have an overview of the owners of institutions in youth mental health care.
Ik heb geen overzicht van eigenaren van instellingen in de jeugd-ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht dat de jeugd-ggz een lucratieve markt blijkt te zijn voor durfinvesteerders

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health how he responds to private equity investors treating youth mental health care as a lucrative market, whether he can list such institutions, and what financial incentives leave complex cases unserved. The State Secretary answers that no exhaustive overview of owners exists, estimates five to seven investment firms invest in two to four youth care providers, points to the Wibz bill on profit distribution limits, the youth care availability bill and regional cooperation, and says cost-based reasonable pricing will be set by AMvB.
No; I do not have an exhaustive overview of the owners of institutions in youth mental health care.
Nee; ik heb geen uitputtend overzicht van de eigenaren van instellingen in de jeugd-ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de 43 zorgmedewerkers die door Nederland naar Curaçao zijn gestuurd

An MP asked whether healthcare in the Netherlands is short-staffed and overburdened, and why 43 Dutch healthcare workers were sent to Curaçao instead of being deployed at home. The Secretary of State said the Curaçao situation is very serious, that the staff volunteered via Extra Handen voor de Zorg, and that the deployment has no significant effect on Dutch care, while declining to say how the NVZ views it.
I would like to point out that the Netherlands does not 'send' people, but facilitates this deployment.
Ik hecht eraan op te merken dat Nederland geen mensen «stuurt», maar deze inzet faciliteert.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over de berichten ‘Bevrijdingsdefilé in Wageningen dreigt voorgoed te verdwijnen’ en ‘Geen tweede kans voor 75 jaar vrijheid: opnieuw streep door defilé in Wageningen, ook in Groes

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport, jointly with the Minister of Defence, about reports that the Wageningen liberation parade may disappear, and about commemoration of 4 and 5 May for veterans unable to attend. The government denied that Defence refused cooperation outright, said Defence will review its support given operational capacity limits, and described online and alternative commemorations for 2021.
In response to the concerns about the future of the parade, the agreements are being reviewed.
Naar aanleiding van de zorgen die zijn ontstaan over de toekomst van het defilé worden de afspraken herbezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Laan-Geselschap over 'Nog steeds geen onderzoek Sarah'

MPs Regterschot and Laan-Geselschap asked whether national inspectorates should have investigated the fatal 2018 stabbing of Sarah Papenheim and whether such incidents can be independently investigated at case level. The minister replied that no Wmo calamity investigation was legally possible because the victim was not a client, that inspectorates cooperate in specific cases, and that municipalities can commission independent case investigations.

In this event the victim was not a client. Therefore the Wmo Supervision Rotterdam-Rijnmond and TSD concluded that in this case there is no legal basis for Wmo supervision to start a calamity investigation.

In deze gebeurtenis was het slachtoffer geen cliënt. Daarom hebben het Toezicht Wmo Rotterdam-Rijnmond en TSD geconcludeerd dat in deze casus voor het Wmo-toezicht geen wettelijke basis is een calamiteitenonderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over mogelijke dubbele financiering van zorg vanwege samenloop Jeugdzorg en Wlz

An MP asked whether municipalities can check for a Wlz indication before providing youth care, to prevent double financing, and whether GDPR rules block such a check. The State Secretary answered that the Wlz register check cannot be used for youth care without a legal basis or parental consent, that double financing is undesirable but not known to be structural, and that no additional data exchange is deemed desirable.
I am aware of one incident in which there was double financing.
Er is mij één incident bekend, waarbij sprake is geweest van dubbele financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de uitvoering van toezeggingen en moties van het notaoverleg 'In Nederland beslis je over je eigen leven'

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers about implementation of motions and commitments on honour-related violence, forced marriage protection, female genital mutilation registration and the possible criminalisation of hymen restoration. The State Secretary replied that the government is following up on these motions through action programmes, investigations and working groups, with most results promised in later progress letters.
I informed your House on 18 March 2021 about the progress of the action agenda on harmful practices.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 18 maart 2021 geïnformeerd over de voortgang van de actieagenda schadelijke praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht 'Tientallen jongeren de dupe van sluiting De Hoenderloo Groep, beloofde 'passende vervolgplek' is er niet gekomen'

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld and Kwint asked why dozens of youths from the closed Hoenderloo Groep lack a lasting placement after its closure, and whether the promised 'suitable follow-up placement' was broken. The Staatssecretaris answers that all youths had a placement on closure day, that some later placements proved unsuitable and are being addressed by Pluryn, municipalities and the inspectorate, and that the government is strengthening continuity-of-care rules.
I do not share the view of the questioners that Pluryn has broken the promise that every youth would receive a follow-up placement.
Ik deel het oordeel van de vragenstellers niet dat Pluryn de belofte heeft geschonden dat elke jongere een vervolgplek krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht “ondernemingsraad Intervence: stem medewerker niet meegenomen in plan”

An MP from the Labour party asked the state secretary whether it is wise that the works council's voice was left out of the bankrupt youth-care provider Intervence's transition plan, and how staff will be involved. The minister answered that staff involvement is important, that the Zeeland municipalities and Intervence's board are responsible for informing staff, and that the takeover scenario will be reviewed by the inspectorates and the Youth Authority.
The board of Intervence is primarily responsible for timely informing and involving staff in the takeover scenario.
De bestuurder van Intervence is primair verantwoordelijk voor het tijdig informeren en betrekken van medewerkers bij het overnamescenario.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de lange wachttijden in de ggz in Groningen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health why mental health waiting times in Groningen exceed the 14-week norm, what has been done over four years, and what new steps will be taken. The State Secretary confirmed the specialised mental health waits exceed the norm, described measures such as regional taskforces, transfer mechanisms and a regional enforcement power, and said the problem is too complex for a quick fix.
I am in discussions with regions where the problem is greatest.
Ik ben in gesprek met regio's waar de problematiek het grootst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over paardencoachbedrijven als nieuwe melkkoe van de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the State Secretary about the rapid growth in revenue of horse-coaching and care-farm organisations funded through youth care, the lack of evidence for their effectiveness, executive pay, cost-reporting rules and municipal steering options. The State Secretary confirmed the revenue growth, explained it by decentralisation and demand, noted that municipalities and inspectorates have instruments to steer and supervise, and pointed to a forthcoming quality framework and planned bill provisions on transparent business operations.
Municipalities must ensure they make good use of their instruments.
Gemeenten moeten zorgen dat zij goed gebruik maken van hun instrumentarium.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en El Yassini over het artikel ‘Utrecht krijgt daklozenopvang voor LHBT’ers: ‘Ik ben zó blij dat er nu een veilige plek is voor deze groep’, van RTV Utrecht

MPs Regterschot and El Yassini asked the State Secretary about a Utrecht shelter for homeless LGBTI people, the government's follow-up to a motion, the restriction of shelter access to self-reliant people, and how safety and information for LGBTI youth are ensured. The State Secretary answered that the initiative fits recommendations, listed action lines such as shelter renewal with single and double rooms and LGBTIQ-sensitive training, and promised to follow the pilot with evaluation in August 2021 and a decision in 2022.
I follow this initiative with interest to share knowledge about it and to work together on further developing approaches that work in practice.
Ik volg dit initiatief met belangstelling om kennis erover te delen en samen te werken aan het doorontwikkelen van in de praktijk werkende aanpakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de brandbrief van de bewoners van het asielzoekerscentrum in Apeldoorn

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a residents' letter complaining of cold, stuffy and dirty conditions at the Apeldoorn asylum centre on Christiaan Geurtsweg, which was meant to be temporary but keeps being extended. The State Secretary answers that the site meets the programme of requirements, that the COA is addressing hygiene and safety with residents and making concrete adjustments, and that the new location is expected in early 2022.
The situation at the Apeldoorn asylum centre has attention and the COA is consulting with residents about which changes can be made to make their stay more pleasant.
De situatie in het azc Apeldoorn heeft de aandacht en het COA is dan ook in overleg met de bewoners van het azc om samen met hen te bekijken welke veranderingen ingezet kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Kerstens en Kuiken over zorgcowboys die gemeenten op kosten jagen

MPs Nijboer, Kerstens and Kuiken asked about 'zorgcowboys' moving clients across the country to the detriment of municipalities, municipal financial strain in youth care, benefits and shelter, and whether this causes social rental housing construction problems and gatekeeping of care. Minister De Jonge answered that no signals of such practices were received, pointed to COVID compensation, extra youth-care funds and the planned residence-principle reforms, and largely deferred the structural funding question to a future cabinet.
Decision-making on a structural solution in terms of adjusting the system from 2022 and the required budget will be left to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming over een structurele oplossing in termen van aanpassing in het stelsel vanaf 2022 en benodigd budget, zal aan een volgend kabinet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Gerven over het rapport ‘The Sobering Truth: Incentivizing Alcohol Death and Disability’

MPs Alkaya and Van Gerven asked whether Dutch subsidies to development projects involving alcohol producers such as Heineken, which allegedly worsen alcohol harm and conflict with SDG 3.5, should be stopped. The minister replied that the projects support farmers' food and income security, that EUR 300,000 was added in 2018 with no new subsidies since, that additionality was met, and that the government will not exclude such partnerships.
Question 7: Are you willing to stop providing support to projects in developing countries involving Dutch alcohol producers and instead invest in projects reducing alcohol problems?
Vraag 7 Bent u bereid voortaan geen steun meer te verlenen aan projecten in ontwikkelingslanden waar Nederlandse alcoholproducenten bij betrokken zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over het bericht 'vertraging ggz-indicaties in de Wlz door hoge aantal aanvragen'

MPs Slootweg and Peters asked why GGZ Wlz indication requests far exceeded the expected 9,500, how long applicants will wait, what the dedicated CIZ team and transitional arrangements involve, and what the shift means for Wmo funding and care hours. The state secretary answered that the initial estimate was too low because ambulant clients and providers were initially hesitant, that over 16,000 clients are expected to receive Wlz GGZ indications, that a noodplan with extra staff is in place, that Wmo decisions were extended to 1 July 2021, and that the Wmo-to-Wlz transfer will be recalculated budget-neutrally for municipalities.
At the end of 2020 I made agreements with the CIZ on an emergency plan containing various measures to clear the backlog of applications as quickly and carefully as possible.
Eind 2020 heb ik met het CIZ afspraken gemaakt over een noodplan, waarin verschillende maatregelen zijn opgenomen om het stuwmeer aan aanvragen zo snel en zorgvuldig mogelijk weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de toename van seksueel geweld tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked ministers whether reported rises in sexual violence during the coronavirus crisis, based on a Rutgers study, are alarming and how they relate to domestic violence, police and prosecution data, and youth sexual health. The government answered that the Rutgers study does not show an increase in sexual violence, that police and prosecution data show fewer reports in 2020, and it pointed to existing campaigns and prevention programmes for youth.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Gemeentegrens wordt gesloten voor ongewenste zorgvragers'

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary about reports that municipalities shift care recipients to each other and that 40% of municipalities are stricter in granting care to outsiders, and about the consequences of the 2015 decentralisation. The State Secretary answered that the 40% figure comes from a survey of 151 municipalities that the ministry cannot verify as representative, committed to a new residence principle for youth care (2022) and for sheltered housing (2023), and deferred a structural budget solution to the next cabinet.
The Ministry of VWS has no insight into whether the 151 respondents form a representative cross-section of the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen inzicht of de 151 respondenten een juiste afspiegeling vormen van heel Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over mensen die hun woning moeten verlaten respectievelijk kwijtraken als ze hun zorgindicatie verliezen of worden opgenomen in een GGZ-instelling

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about people losing their homes when care indications end or when they are admitted to mental health institutions, and about the gaps in housing and support, the reduction of support hours, the household-sharing norm, and municipal responsibilities. The state secretary answered that no central figures exist on homelessness caused by expiring care indications, pointed to municipal responsibility, planned expert support and the Wvggz/Participatiewet frameworks, and said action is being taken through working agreements and a new plan.
At central level there is no insight into the amount of support that municipalities provide under the Wmo 2015.
Op centraal niveau bestaat geen inzicht in de omvang van de begeleiding die gemeenten op basis van de Wmo 2015 verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over signalen over problematiek samenhangend met de overgang van statushouders van een AZC naar de gemeente

VVD MPs asked how status holders are transferred from asylum reception centres to municipalities, what factors guide placement, what funding and information municipalities receive, and whether their care needs and municipal difficulties are being addressed. The State Secretary explained the COA-to-municipality matching and information-sharing process, noted some information gaps and a review underway, and stated that funding and care needs are handled under the same criteria as other residents, with an Ombudsman investigation into unaccompanied minors pending.
Your House will be informed about this shortly.
Uw Kamer wordt hierover op korte termijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Eijs over de pilot Speaksee

MPs from D66 asked whether the positive UWV pilot of the speech-to-text tool SpeakSee could be reimbursed for deaf and hard-of-hearing workers, since it is classed as a hearing aid and falls to health insurers rather than UWV. The minister agreed the tool is valuable, said the Zorginstituut indicated speech-recognition software may fall under the Zorgverzekeringswet, and promised to monitor and discuss access with representatives of people with disabilities.

As part of the one-counter approach from the cabinet response on POC KOT, I will discuss with VWS and representatives of people with disabilities whether they encounter obstacles when applying for these provisions.

Ik zal in het kader van de een loket gedachte uit de kabinetsreactie POC KOT, samen met VWS, met (vertegenwoordigers van) mensen met een beperking bespreken of zij bij het aanvragen van deze voorzieningen tegen belemmeringen aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over microplastics in placenta’s van ongeboren baby’s

An MP asked several ministers about reports that microplastics were found in unborn babies' placentas, and about the health risks, product bans and parental information. The government acknowledges the concern, says there is insufficient evidence on health effects, and points to ZonMw research, a knowledge agenda, and planned EU-level and environmental measures without committing to bans or consumer warnings.
There is currently insufficient knowledge to conclude whether microplastic particles pose a danger to the development of unborn babies.
Er is op dit moment onvoldoende kennis om de conclusie te kunnen trekken of microplasticdeeltjes een gevaar vormen voor de ontwikkeling van ongeboren baby's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van den Berge over de vaccinatiestrategie

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Health how homeless people, undocumented residents, unmanaged-budget recipients, informal carers and children of undocumented parents will be reached, informed, registered and vaccinated under the COVID-19 vaccination strategy. The Minister answered all 13 questions one by one, giving timing based on expected supply and Health Council risk groups, outlining outreach through organisations like the Leger des Heils, and stating that children under 18 are not yet being vaccinated.
We will soon discuss with the organisations where these groups are known (including the Salvation Army) how this harder-to-reach target group can best be informed.
We gaan binnenkort met de organisaties waar deze groepen bekend zijn (o.a. het Leger des Heils) in gesprek over de vraag hoe deze moeilijker bereikbare doelgroep het beste geïnformeerd kan worden.
