Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van den Hul en Van der Graaf over emotionele verwaarlozing en huiselijk geweld als gevolg van de lockdown

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the government about a Leiden study showing more emotional neglect and domestic violence during the lockdown, why official reporting figures did not show the same rise, how professionals and schools can support vulnerable families, and how the findings should inform policy. The state secretary answered that the government is aware of the study, monitors reporting trends through CBS and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, points to helplines and support tools, and agrees the school closures' effects on vulnerable families must be weighed, while stating that secondary schools cannot reopen yet.
We therefore, together with these organisations, closely monitor the (numerical) developments currently and also in the coming period.
Wij houden daarom samen met deze organisaties de (cijfermatige) ontwikkelingen momenteel en ook de komende tijd nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van donderdagavond 10 december 2020 'Sterke stijging anorexiapatiënten tijdens coronacrisis'

CDA MPs asked the government about a Nieuwsuur report on a sharp rise in anorexia patients during the coronavirus crisis, rising waiting lists for complex psychiatric care, bed shortages for anorexia treatment, interim care, regional high-complexity care tables, and the Court of Audit's view that long waits worsen conditions. The State Secretary acknowledged the mental health impact, described measures such as a consultation line, transparency rules and an evaluation of high-complexity care, but gave averages rather than specific anorexia waiting-list figures and did not provide case counts.
I will send you this evaluation.
Ik zal u deze evaluatie doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de crisisopvang jeugdpsychiatrie overbelast is

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that youth psychiatric crisis care is overloaded, rising crisis referrals, and measures to keep care accessible during lockdown. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to coordination between municipalities and providers, a pending survey of capacity, and a 58.5 million euro youth package, while stating there is no national picture of cancelled treatments.
There is no national picture of the number of treatments that did not go ahead.
Er is geen landelijk beeld op het aantal behandelingen dat niet is doorgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Renkema over de forse stijging van jongeren die kampen met suïcidaliteit en eetstoornissen

MPs Westerveld and Renkema asked the State Secretary for Health about the sharp rise in young people with suicidal thoughts and eating disorders, including waiting lists, crisis capacity, lockdown effects and whether crisis beds were cut. The State Secretary answered that a coordination meeting and a survey of capacity by region are under way, that Jeugdautoriteit and the support team are available, that responsibility lies largely with municipalities and that a regional-visions bill is planned, but gave no national capacity data.
Because youth care is organised in a decentralised way, there is no national picture of the number of crisis reports and requests for help in youth care since the lockdown.
Vanwege de decentrale organisatie van de jeugdhulp is er is geen landelijk beeld van het aantal crisismeldingen en het aantal hulpvragen in de jeugdhulp over de periode sinds de lockdown.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de schaderegeling voor slachtoffers in de jeugdzorg

Westerveld asked why the Schadefonds website still said it was unknown whether the compensation affects benefits, why it should be listed in tax returns, how many claims were filed, how elderly victims can apply, how victims are informed, and for an update on funding a memorial. The minister answered that the compensation does not count as income or assets for benefits and allowances, claims stood at about 1,900, the fund supports applications by proxy and by post, victims are actively informed, and up to 160,000 euros will be subsidised for the memorial.
Victims can ask the Tax Administration/Allowances to disregard this compensation of 5,000 euros for the assets test.
Slachtoffers kunnen bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen verzoeken deze tegemoetkoming van € 5.000,- buiten beschouwing te laten voor de vermogenstoets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Wijngaarden over het pleidooi voor effectieve preventie van seksueel geweld

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Wijngaarden asked the state secretary whether he is aware of Rutgers' plea for effective prevention of sexual violence, whether the promised letter on additional prevention steps will still come in January, and whether that letter will respond to the plea. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said Parliament will be informed in February about the interdepartmental approach including prevention, and that Rutgers will receive a separate written reply and an official-level meeting.
Your House will be informed in writing in February about the interdepartmental approach to sexual violence, including prevention of sexual violence.
Uw Kamer wordt in februari schriftelijk geïnformeerd over de interdepartementale aanpak van seksueel geweld, inclusief preventie van seksueel geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het Verwey-Jonker Instituut onderzoek 'Kwestie van lange adem: kan huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling echt stoppen?'

An MP asked the state secretary about a Verwey-Jonker study finding that violence often continues after reports to Veilig Thuis, and about related questions on the approach to domestic violence and child abuse. The secretary answered that reports should not be dismissed in advance, that violence stopped in 29% of families after 18 months, and that the government is working on gender sensitivity, professional training and youth care, but gave mostly policy-continuation answers.
I am of the view that a report should never be taken with a grain of salt in advance.
Ik ben van mening dat een melding nooit op voorhand met een korreltje zout genomen moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Toorenburg over kinderen die onterecht uit huis worden geplaatst door slecht feitenonderzoek

MPs Peters and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether children are wrongly removed from their homes due to poor fact-finding by youth care workers and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, and what measures will prevent this. The minister replied that the statutory duty to report facts fully and truthfully applies, that an Action Plan to improve fact-finding is under way through 2021, and that existing checks (RvdK independence, judicial review, appeal) are sufficient, so no new measures are needed.
Based on the above, I am of the view that the current system already contains sufficient safeguards to address the problem you describe.
Op basis van het bovenstaande ben ik van mening dat het huidige systeem reeds voldoende waarborgen bevat om het door u geschetste probleem te ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van den Berg over het bericht dat alle landen om ons heen al vaccineren tegen het rotavirus

Two CDA MPs asked whether rotavirus vaccination for all infants should be introduced or reconsidered early to relieve hospital pressure during the COVID crisis. The State Secretary answered that the Health Council will advise on rotavirus vaccination this year, that a temporary extra vaccination needs the same thorough assessment, and that COVID-related measures and a healthy lifestyle campaign are the current prevention focus.
The advice on rotavirus vaccination will be taken up by the Health Council later this year.
Het advies rondom rotavirusvaccinatie zal in de loop van dit jaar worden opgepakt door de Gezondheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Joe Biden kan 5 miljoen Amerikaanse rokers laten stoppen'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the possibility of nicotine reduction in cigarettes, the RIVM findings on its technical feasibility, public support, and whether the Netherlands can legally impose it under EU rules. The State Secretary called the idea promising, said EU Tobacco Products Directive limits make a national nicotine cap impossible, and offered to raise the point with the Commission later.
Under European legislation, producers may not be made unable to reach a maximum emission value of 1 mg per cigarette.
Het mag producenten op basis van de Europese wetgeving niet onmogelijk gemaakt worden om aan een maximale emissiewaarde van 1 mg per sigaret te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Onzekerheid over vaccinatiedatum BES en CAS'

An MP asked the state secretaries about preparations for COVID-19 vaccination on the Caribbean Dutch islands and Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten, including logistics, staffing, cold chain and undocumented residents. The government answered that plans and cold-chain equipment are in place, vaccination of healthcare staff and over-60s is intended from mid-February subject to RIVM approval, and it referred to earlier letters for quantities and timelines.
My intention is therefore to start vaccinating this group in mid-February.
Mijn voornemen is dan ook om half februari te starten met het vaccineren van deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het wetgevingsoverleg Jeugd van 23 november 2020

An MP asks whether COVID-19 is being used to frustrate custody visitation arrangements between parents and children, and what parents can do if access is restricted. The state secretary says visitation should continue except where someone has symptoms, points to NJi guidance and existing civil and criminal remedies, and says he will investigate reported signals with stakeholders.
The starting point is and remains that contact between child and parent, including during the coronavirus measures, continues.
Het uitgangspunt is en blijft dat omgang tussen kind en ouder, ook ten tijde van de coronamaatregelen, doorgang vindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'NZa legt Emergis verplichting op voor aanmerkelijke marktmacht'

An MP asks the State Secretary about the NZa's imposition of obligations on mental health provider Emergis due to significant market power, its regional impact, the sector's reaction, and how insurers account for regional circumstances and tariffs. The State Secretary confirms the decision, affirms regional accessibility, declines substantive comment on the decision given the regulator's independence and possible appeal, and explains insurers' duty of care and that tariffs played no role in this case.
Given the independent position of the NZa and the fact that it is for the administrative court to review this decision, I do not give a substantive response to this specific NZa decision.
Gelet op onafhankelijke positie van de NZa en gelet op het feit dat het aan de bestuursrechter is om dit besluit te toetsen, geef ik geen inhoudelijke reactie op dit specifieke besluit van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Scouting en jeugd- en jongerenwerk bestolen'

MPs Peters and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked whether 7.3 million euros earmarked for youth organisations and playgrounds during COVID-19 is being spent as intended, after reports that municipalities were not using it for that purpose. The state secretary confirmed the funds were made available, said the signals had not reached him before, and will raise the issue with the VNG and report back to the House.
If it turns out that the funds are indeed not yet being used for the intended purpose, it is good that the VNG again brings this to the attention of municipalities.
Als blijkt dat de middelen inderdaad nog niet ingezet worden voor het beoogde doel, is het goed dat de VNG dit nogmaals onder de aandacht brengt van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over de relatie tussen besmetting met de parasiet Toxoplasma gondii en het risico op ongevallen en geestelijke aandoeningen

MPs Diertsen and De Groot asked whether Toxoplasma gondii infection is linked to traffic accidents and mental disorders, what is known about infection rates and prevention in the Netherlands, and whether prevention is proportionate. The minister answered that the associations are not causal, that the Dutch evidence finds no link to depression or anxiety, and that current prevention and consumer advice are the best feasible approach, with a committed cost-benefit review and a meat-safety project underway.
It therefore cannot be concluded that toxoplasmosis increases the chance of being involved in a traffic accident.
Er kan dus niet worden geconcludeerd dat toxoplasmose de kans vergroot om betrokken te raken bij een verkeersongeval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over het bericht ‘Nog maar eens per drie jaar preventief onderzoek naar borstkanker’

An MP asked the state secretary about extending the breast cancer screening interval to up to three years, including the risk of late diagnosis, the regional differences and monitoring of stage at detection. The secretary acknowledged the difficult decision, said it was unavoidable due to staffing shortages after the spring suspension, and promised to restore the two-year interval as soon as capacity allows, with a letter to parliament before 1 March.
I will inform your House, in line with the Ploumen motion, before 1 March about the steps I am taking.
Ik zal uw Kamer, conform de motie Ploumen, voor 1 maart nader informeren over de stappen die ik zet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de verder verslechterde financiële positie van jeugdzorginstelling Elker

Kuiken and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the state secretary about Elker's deteriorating finances, possible dismissals amid high sickness absence, and whether the ministry would intervene to prevent bankruptcy. The secretary answered that providers and municipalities are responsible, that continuity of care is paramount, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and municipalities are in talks, with emergency liquidity support available only under strict conditions.
In extreme cases, youth care providers can apply for temporary liquidity support under the subsidy scheme 'Continuity of crucial youth care'.
In uiterste gevallen kunnen jeugdzorgaanbieders een aanvraag indienen voor tijdelijke liquiditeitssteun op basis van de subsidieregeling «Continuïteit cruciale jeugdzorg».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over sluiten van jeugdzorginstelling Intervence

An MP asks the State Secretary and Minister whether they accept the closure of youth care provider Intervence in Zeeland, whether the timeline is feasible, what happens to children and staff, and what the government will do about financial mismanagement and its own role. The government answers that municipalities chose to split Intervence's youth protection work among three other providers, that care continues until transfers are complete, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and inspectorates must approve a transition plan before any irreversible steps, with the government promising interbestuurlijk toezicht if continuity is not assured.

If, according to the JA and the inspectorates, the continuity and quality of care are not secured, we will hold the municipalities to account and, where necessary, take measures within the framework of interadministrative supervision.

Als de continuïteit en kwaliteit van zorg volgens de JA en de inspecties niet geborgd is, zullen wij de gemeenten daarop aanspreken en zo nodig maatregelen treffen in het kader van het interbestuurlijk toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over het bericht 'Ernstige zorgen over het verdwijnen van ‘de Zeeuwse IC op het gebied van jeugdzorg’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the Zeeland child-protection provider Intervence is being closed by 1 January 2021, whether children and families can be safely transferred, and whether the government is responsible. The government answers that municipalities chose the scenario, that no irreversible steps will be taken until an inspectorate-approved transition plan exists, and that tariff and personnel issues are being addressed.
The proposed decision by the municipalities has a far-reaching impact on the children and their relatives, the Intervence staff and all parties involved in Zeeland.
Het voorgenomen besluit van gemeenten is ingrijpend voor de kinderen en hun naasten, de medewerkers van Intervence en alle betrokken partijen in Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht 'Onderwijsminister Slob: Pluryn in de fout bij overdragen leerlingen Hoenderloo College'

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked why parliament was only informed in November that some pupils of the Hoenderloo College had no school place after closure, despite earlier assurances. The minister answered that Pluryn wrongly reported places were found, that the Inspectorate issued repair orders and intensive monitoring, and that all pupils were placed by 16 October 2020.
The board has taken its responsibility. This led to the last young person receiving a follow-up education place on 16 October 2020.
Het bestuur heeft zijn verantwoordelijkheid genomen. Dit heeft ertoe geleid dat op 16 oktober 2020 de laatste jongere een vervolg onderwijsplek heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bolkestein over het bericht 'Nieuwe drug 3-MMC duikt op in Zeeland'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about the new drug 3-MMC, its users, legal status, precursors, production, and government response. The minister answered that use data are limited but rising, 3-MMC is still legal and sold online, a NPS bill will ban it, and the CAM will review evidence and consider next steps.
Once the cathinones fall under the Opium Act, production of and trade in 3-MMC will be illegal.
Zodra de cathinonen onder de Opiumwet vallen zal productie van en handel in 3-MMC illegaal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over schadelijke behandelingen tegen autisme

Ploumen asks whether the state secretary will act against harmful homeopathic CEASE therapy for autism and when parliament will be informed about steps to ban it. Blokhuis answers that a ban is not legally possible given the lack of proven individual harm, but that supervision and enforcement will be tightened, independent research commissioned, and guidelines reviewed, with a fuller update promised early next year.
A ban on CEASE therapy is not possible given the regulations on alternative care and the lack of evidence of harm caused by this therapy.
Een verbod op CEASE-therapie is niet mogelijk gezien de regelgeving rondom alternatieve zorg en het gebrek aan bewijs van schade door deze therapie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het seksueel misbruik van jongeren in de gehandicaptenzorg

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked about sexual abuse of young people in disability care, citing reports that it is barely addressed, and asked about prevention measures, incident counts, reporting levels, and whether staff dismissed for abuse can move to other care jobs. The minister outlined prevention materials, the mandatory reporting duty to the inspectorate (90 reports in 2019), screening tools like VOG and the Waarschuwingsregister, and said she sees no clear sign of low reporting but will act if it exists.
Unfortunately we can never fully rule out that a situation arises in which someone moves on to work elsewhere in care after abuse has taken place.
Helaas kunnen we nooit helemaal uitsluiten dat zich een situatie voordoet waarin iemand elders in de zorg aan de slag gaat, nadat er misbruik heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Machteloze agent waker in gevecht met verwarde mensen’ en ‘Verwarde mensen drijven de agent tot wanhoop’

Mr Helder (PVV) asks why police are still left with transporting and handling confused people despite the Wvggz taking effect in January 2020, and what concrete steps will be taken. The ministers reply that the Wvggz protects patients' rights rather than reducing reports, point to an integrated approach with five national priorities, improved police training, a mobile care quality framework for transport, and promise further action in autumn.
It is not an aim of the Wvggz to reduce the number of reports about people with confused behaviour.
Het is geen doel van de Wvggz om te zorgen voor een afname van het aantal meldingen over personen met verward gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het tekort aan griepprikken

Two CDA MPs asked why there is a shortage of flu vaccines, whether healthcare workers can be prioritised, and how supply will be secured next year. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that extra vaccines were purchased and additional stock may arrive, that the state is not directly responsible for healthcare employers' vaccination offers, and that preparations for 2021 are being brought forward.
Vaccination of healthcare staff helps to prevent this transmission.
Vaccinatie van zorgpersoneel helpt om deze overdacht te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over kostenoverschrijdingen in de jeugdzorg door wagenwijd openstaande deuren bij gemeenten

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Health about youth care cost overruns caused by gemeenten (municipalities) opening youth care access too broadly, and whether municipalities should limit youth care scope, contract fewer providers, and receive more funds. The State Secretary largely answers that the Youth Act leaves municipalities room to make choices, announces investigations and a spring 2021 study on municipal approaches, and says extra funds will be weighed in the coming cabinet formation.
Following a commitment by the Minister of VWS, I have commissioned research into the approach of municipalities that indicate they have (more) grip on their youth care.
Naar aanleiding van een toezegging van de Minister van VWS heb ik onderzoek uitgezet naar de aanpak van gemeenten die aangeven (meer) grip op hun jeugdhulp te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de artikelen van Follow the Money en het Brabants Dagblad waaruit blijkt dat miljoenen niet naar jeugdzorg gaan

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that millions in youth care funding were not reaching care, including profit margins, executive pay above the WNT norm, opaque company structures and transparency of municipal oversight. The government acknowledged profit concerns and pointed to planned measures (Wibz, Wtza, youth care bill) but said it would not prevent profits outright, did not know municipal deficits, and deferred some points to later letters.
We must respect that transitional arrangement, even though I would prefer all salaries to already be below the maximum remuneration.
Dat overgangsrecht moeten we respecteren, ook al zou ik liever zien dat alle bezoldigingen nu al onder het bezoldigingsmaximum liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het uitblijven van een covid-19-bonus voor zorgprofessionals in Caribisch Nederland

An MP asked why healthcare workers in Caribbean Netherlands were excluded from the covid-19 bonus paid in European Netherlands and whether they would be given it. The state secretary said the bonus scheme does not apply there, but a $1,000 net bonus for March to December 2020 is being arranged, with the payment mechanism still to be worked out.
Therefore, work is currently underway on a method to make a care bonus of $1,000 net for healthcare professionals in Caribbean Netherlands possible.
Daarom wordt er op dit moment gewerkt aan een werkwijze om een zorgbonus van $ 1.000 netto voor zorgprofessionals in Caribisch Nederland mogelijk te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over antwoorden op vragen inzake de berichten ‘Tekorten aan jeugdzorgers steeds nijpender’ en ‘Sterke daling nieuwe werknemers in de jeugdzorg: ‘Zo gaat het kapot’

Two MPs (Wörsdörfer, VVD, and Westerveld, GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Health about staff shortages in youth care, the role of the national government, the Arbeidsmarktagenda, tariffs, professional participation, the convenant on stopping time-writing, and simplification of product codes. The State Secretary answered at length, describing ongoing joint programmes and a planned AMvB on reasonable tariffs, but gave mostly general commitments and set a 2022 target for the simplified product codes.
It is not possible to break down the data collected under the Labour Market Care and Welfare research programme by sub-sector.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gegevens die in het kader van het onderzoeksprogramma Arbeidsmarkt Zorg en Welzijn (AZW) worden verzameld uit te splitsen naar subbranches.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Hijink en en Wörsdörfer over wederom een datalek in de jeugdzorg

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health whether a new data leak at a youth care provider (Kenter/Jeugdriagg) could have been prevented given an earlier 2019 leak, and what steps have been taken on the earlier motions about securing youth care data, Z-CERT affiliation, penetration tests and ethical hacking rules. The State Secretary acknowledged the leak resulted from an old unclosed domain name, described the steps taken with branch organisations and Deloitte-run penetration tests, and said Z-CERT affiliation could start in early 2021 while stressing providers bear primary responsibility.
Through Z-CERT's risk-driven approach we will again examine the possibilities for affiliation.
Door de risico gestuurde aanpak van Z-CERT gaan we opnieuw de mogelijkheden voor aansluiting onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Forse stijging aantal slachtoffers van kindermishandeling en seksueel geweld op chat tijdens corona'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security and the State Secretary for Health about a reported sharp rise in child abuse and sexual violence reports via chat during the coronavirus crisis, and how this relates to other data showing no increase. The State Secretary answered that the increase is mainly in advice requests and chat contacts, that it cannot be confirmed that abuse actually rose, and listed measures, research and lessons learned, but could not answer all questions in time for the committee meeting.
It is not known whether child abuse and sexual violence actually increased during the coronavirus measures this spring.
Het is niet bekend of kindermishandeling en seksueel geweld daadwerkelijk is toegenomen tijdens de corona-maatregelen dit voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Wildgroei aan «beunhaas-behandelaars» bij populaire traumatherapie EMDR'

An MP asked the state secretary whether anyone can call themselves an EMDR therapist, whether the Netherlands has the most EMDR therapists per capita, and how consumers can verify training, among other questions about psychology registers and training places. The state secretary answered that individual treatment methods are not regulated under the Wet BIG, that quality is safeguarded through the Wkkgz and the IGJ, and that registers and training capacity are being discussed with professional bodies.
It does not fit within the Wet BIG to regulate individual treatment methods.
Het past niet binnen de Wet BIG om individuele behandelmethoden te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer naar aanleiding van het bericht dat broertjes en zusjes vaak niet samenblijven bij een uithuisplaatsing

An MP asked whether siblings are often separated in child protection placements and what the government will do about it. The minister answers that WODC research on separated placements is under way for completion in autumn 2021, that a broader Erasmus study on intervention effectiveness is expected in 2022/2023, and that the existing guideline already favours placing siblings together.
The WODC will conduct research this autumn into separated placements of brothers and sisters during out-of-home placement.
Het WODC gaat dit najaar onderzoek doen naar gescheiden plaatsingen van broers en zussen bij een uithuisplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Hijink naar aanleiding van het bericht dat broertjes en zusjes vaak niet samenblijven bij een uithuisplaatsing

MPs Westerveld and Hijink asked about reports that siblings are often not placed together when children are taken into care, and about the causes, data, reimbursement of travel costs and pleegouder numbers. The government answered that a WODC study on separated placements will report by autumn 2021, that CBS data is unavailable, that siblings are placed together where possible under existing guidelines, and that travel costs can be reimbursed, while legislation is not planned for now.
The WODC is going to carry out research this autumn into separated placements of siblings in out-of-home placements.
Het WODC gaat dit najaar onderzoek doen naar gescheiden plaatsingen van broers en zussen bij een uithuisplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Gerven over de aanhoudende klachten rond laagfrequent geluid bij windturbines

SP MPs asked why, despite RIVM findings on low-frequency wind turbine noise, no additional noise or distance norms exist, and whether health studies and a community-inclusive knowledge platform will follow. The government answered that current Dutch noise norms are adequate, that no distance norm or separate low-frequency norm is needed, that a health study will be explored with RIVM, and that existing platforms already represent residents.
Yes, the current norm assumes a serious nuisance rate of about 9% at the maximum permissible noise load.
Ja, de huidige normering gaat uit van een percentage ernstige hinder van ongeveer 9% bij de maximaal toelaatbare geluidbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bonussen aan personeel op het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

MPs Hijink asked whether ministry staff at VWS are dissatisfied with a 500 euro bonus, whether some received up to 5,000 euro, and how many received bonuses and how much. The minister answered that dissatisfaction is not known, that incidental rewards are standard practice across ministries under Rijk-wide frameworks, and that corona-related one-off rewards were agreed with unions, without giving the individual figures requested.
Incidentally, there is no question of a generic reward here.
Van een generieke beloning is hierbij overigens geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgsectoren bakkeleien over opleidingsplaatsen gz-psychologen

The MP asked why the government will not provide more structural training places for gz-psychologists despite rising demand, and why the allocation system favours larger training institutions. The state secretary replied that places follow the Capacity Organ's advice and budget room, that the 787 places for 2021 match the maximum advice, that the allocation system is the responsibility of the TOP foundation, and that the government will not change the system but will inform parliament after a November interim forecast.
I am awaiting the interim forecast of mid-November and do not want to anticipate it.
Ik wacht de tussentijdse raming van medio november af en wil daar niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Helvert over het bericht 'emoties lopen hoog op bij huisuitzetting: meerdere politiepatrouilles rukken uit'

MPs Peters and Van Helvert asked about a reported eviction in Geleen over rent arrears, in which several police patrols were deployed, and whether evictions for debt could be prevented. The government confirmed the case, declined to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons, and described measures such as early warning of rent arrears, the amended Municipal Debt Assistance Act from 1 January 2021, and the plan 'Een (t)huis, een toekomst' to prevent evictions.
To protect the privacy of those involved, I cannot go into individual cases.
Om de privacy van de betrokkenen te beschermen, kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het centraal inkopen van griepvaccins voor zorgverleners

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether flu vaccine supply for healthcare workers is adequate during COVID-19, why central purchasing was moved away from the RIVM, and whether central purchasing should be restored. The state secretary says shortages were unforeseen, that employers are responsible for purchasing, and rejects central purchasing for now while exploring one-off redistribution of leftover vaccines late in the season.
I will keep your House informed of the exploration.
Ik houd uw Kamer op de hoogte van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de invoering van een suikertaks

MP Ploumen asks the State Secretary for Health why a sugar tax was dropped from the National Prevention Agreement and whether industry lobbying influenced that decision. The State Secretary says a sugar tax remains a possible instrument but was not chosen because the agreement sets other sugar-reduction targets, denies yielding to industry, and promises further monitoring and a RIVM study of additional measures.
I am not choosing this measure at this time because in the National Prevention Agreement I have made other agreements on sugar reduction.
Ik kies op dit moment niet voor deze maatregel omdat ik in het Nationaal Preventieakkoord andere afspraken heb gemaakt over suikerreductie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘'Terrorbuurman' slaat opnieuw toe, Kees D. zorgt dagelijks voor angst en overlast’

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked about a neighbour causing fear and nuisance, reportedly ignoring a court-ordered outpatient care order and a contact ban, and asked what action can be taken. The state secretary declined to comment on the individual case, explained the probation and prosecution route for breaches of conditions, the Wvggz and Wfz coercive-care options, and a new national reporting line, without committing to a specific new action.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de aanpassing van de Drank- en Horecawet

Van Haga asked the State Secretary for Health whether the planned 1 January 2021 start of the amended Drank- en Horecawet is too early given the lead time needed for discount campaigns, and why the NVWA would publish its enforcement policy only one month before entry into force. The State Secretary answered that he will consult retailers and producers on a reasonable transition period and that the NVWA publishes enforcement policy at latest one month ahead, since enforcement details should not affect campaign preparation.
I will continue the discussion with them over what such a period could be in the coming month.
Ik zal het gesprek met hen over wat een dergelijke termijn zou kunnen zijn, daarom in de komende maand voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over rookvrije ruimte om op te groeien

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary for health about smoke-free playgrounds, farms and sports fields for children, citing support polls and the Prevention Agreement targets for 2020. The state secretary answers that most targets are delayed by COVID-19, with smoke-free farms expected by Q1 2021 and playgrounds and sports clubs supported by sector bodies.
The expectation is that all farms for children will be smoke-free in the first quarter of 2021.
De verwachting is dat alle kinderboerderijen in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 rookvrij zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Bromet en Ellemeet over G4 EA H1N1-virus en het bericht ‘RIVM houdt ontwikkeling van Chinees varkensvirus goed in de gaten’

MPs Klaver, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the ministers why RIVM is not preparing for the G4 EA H1N1 swine flu virus despite its pandemic potential, how vaccines could be produced, and what sources RIVM monitors. The ministers answered that human-to-human transmission has not been observed, vaccine production takes 4-6 months via WHO-coordinated surveillance, and that no link exists with African swine fever.
It is currently not known how Chinese employees and pig farmers were infected. That is a Chinese matter and we have no information about it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend op welke manier Chinese medewerkers en varkensboeren zijn besmet. Dat is een Chinese aangelegenheid en we hebben daarover geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Goedkope sigaretten nog volop verkrijgbaar'

MP Van Gerven asked why cheap cigarettes remained available after a 1 euro excise increase, why retailers could sell old-price stock, and why no minimum price exists. The state secretary answered that EU excise rules let manufacturers set retail prices and forbid minimum prices, that wholesalers may supply old-price stock only for two months, and that a further increase toward 10 euros by 2023 is planned after a cross-border evaluation.
Within the National Prevention Agreement, the cabinet has taken various measures to discourage tobacco use.
Het kabinet heeft in het kader van het Nationaal Preventieakkoord verschillende maatregelen op het terrein van tabaksontmoediging genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg en Von Martels over berichten dat mensen met overgewicht meer risico lopen bij het coronavirus

Three CDA MPs asked the state secretary for Health about links between overweight and severe COVID-19, and about strengthening healthy-lifestyle policy, including UK measures and coordination of local prevention and sport agreements. The state secretary agreed the link is plausible, pointed to existing prevention agreements, promised to monitor UK measures, and announced a RIVM evaluation and further steps on children's marketing and local funding.
By preventively countering overweight, a great deal of disease burden can be prevented.
Met het preventief tegengaan van overgewicht kan veel ziektelast worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ‘Jezelf van ziek naar gezond eten met een plantaardig dieet. Soms kan het echt’

An MP asked the state secretary whether plant-based diets help patients with conditions such as rheumatism, type 2 diabetes and atherosclerosis, which insurers reimburse lifestyle programmes, and how doctors are trained in nutrition. The state secretary replied that evidence of effectiveness is still needed before insurers reimburse such programmes, pointed to pending Health Council advice and ZonMw research funding, and said training is the responsibility of the profession.
For lifestyle programmes it is important that they are proven effective and can indeed bring about a behavioural change.
Voor leefstijlprogramma's is het belangrijk dat ze bewezen effectief zijn en inderdaad een gedragsverandering kunnen bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over de continuïteit van jeugdhulp en geestelijke gezondheidszorg

GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about continuity of youth care and mental health care during the coronavirus crisis, including treatment and visiting rules, liquidity risks, shortages of protective equipment, the size of postponed care demand, and whether insurers should proactively inventory support. The minister answered that visiting rules are being balanced against RIVM guidance, that continuity payments and compensation schemes are in place, and that the NZa monitors postponed care while insurers retain their duty of care.
A general visitor stop is therefore not desirable.
Een algehele bezoekersstop is daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van den Hul over het bericht dat dak- en thuisloze LHBTI-jongeren driedubbel kwetsbaar zijn

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary how the government will respond to calls for safe crisis shelter for homeless LHBTI youth, whose vulnerability was documented by Movisie research. The State Secretary replied that the broad homelessness approach prioritises own housing and short shelter stays, that shelter quality on sexual and gender diversity needs improvement through training and smaller units, and that concrete steps include a national platform and further talks with stakeholders.
I am in further discussion with Valente, VNG and interest organisations to determine what should be organised at regional level for this.
Ik ben met Valente, VNG en belangenorganisaties nader in gesprek om te bepalen wat hiervoor op regionaal niveau georganiseerd dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de btw-verlaging op o.a. groente en fruit in Duitsland

An MP asks whether the temporary German VAT cut on vegetables and fruit and other goods will harm Dutch border-region businesses, and whether the Netherlands should cut VAT or reverse the 2019 rise on fruit and vegetables to boost healthy eating. The government says effects on the Dutch economy are expected to be limited, rejects a temporary Dutch VAT cut for now, and points to existing prevention programmes without committing to reversing the VAT rise.
Currently the cabinet does not intend to temporarily lower VAT rates in the Netherlands.
Momenteel is het kabinet niet voornemens de btw-tarieven in Nederland tijdelijk te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over ontwikkelingen op het gebied van seksuele gezondheid

An SGP MP asked the minister about sexual health education: the review of lesson methods, the budget and its distribution for schools, the level playing field for providers, state-aid consequences for Rutgers, continuity of counselling contracts, and abortion counselling and aftercare. The minister answered that the Kwink study and a letter would follow, detailed a 7.1 million euro annual budget, said no further measures were needed on abortion clinic cooperation, and gave a substantive but partly general account.
This study will be submitted by Kwink Groep in June, and the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport will then inform you about it.
Dit onderzoek wordt in juni aangeboden door Kwink Groep en de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal u vervolgens daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Met boeven vangt men boeven, Big Tobacco leert de douane het smokkelvak’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Customs training by a tobacco manufacturer breaches the WHO FCTC and whether the industry actively smuggles tobacco. The government replied that such contact falls within Article 5.3 limits, that seized cigarettes are mostly illicit whites or counterfeits, and that the training was given by Japan Tobacco International, with no documents shared.
The information shared during the meeting was in the form of a presentation. The tobacco manufacturer did not share this information as a document or in any other form.
De informatie die is gedeeld tijdens de bijeenkomst is gedaan in de vorm van een presentatie. De tabaksfabrikant heeft deze informatie niet gedeeld in de vorm van een document of in een andere vorm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Renkema en Kuiken over jeugdzorg en de (jeugd-)GGZ

MPs Westerveld, Renkema and Kuiken asked the health minister about youth care and mental health services disrupted by COVID-19, including remote care, crisis beds, support for children in unsafe homes, financial stability of providers and shortages of protective equipment. The minister answered that the ministry monitors signals via crisis-structure consultations, supports digital care, reports crisis-bed capacity as sufficient, lists measures for children at risk, and describes agreements with VNG and the Jeugdautoriteit on continued funding.
When signals arrive repeatedly, we place them on the agenda of one of the consultations we set up within the corona crisis structure for mental health care and youth care.
Als signalen herhaaldelijk binnenkomen, agenderen we deze in één van de overleggen die we hebben opgezet in het kader van de corona-crisisstructuur voor de GGZ en voor de jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Volop onbegrip tussen politie en ggz'

MPs Van Dam and Van den Berg asked about reported failures by the police control room and the GGZ-police handover in a fatal Wageningen incident involving a person with confused behaviour. The minister answered that an internal evaluation was published, the handbook was reissued, a new protocol and training were introduced, and a national non-urgent reporting number is due around July 2020.
The police had an initial factual investigation carried out immediately after the incident.
De politie heeft direct na het incident een oriënterend feitenonderzoek laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kuik over zelfmoordpreventie ten tijde van corona

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about suicide prevention during the coronavirus crisis, including whether research into the impact on suicides is under way, whether the crisis could increase suicides, whether 113 Zelfmoordpreventie has enough resources, and the status of the national suicide prevention agenda. The government answered that monitoring is ongoing via a weekly commission, several studies are underway coordinated by ZonMw, contact with 113 is active with an update promised before the 8 June debate, and a new national agenda will be sent by October 2020.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of my contact with 113 Suicide Prevention in the letter I will send to the House ahead of the consultation meeting on 8 June.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van mijn contact met 113 Zelfmoordpreventie in de brief die ik voor het notaoverleg op 8 juni aanstaande naar de Kamer zal sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sazias over het advies van de Gezondheidsraad over COVID-19 en vaccinatie tegen pneumokokken

MP Sazias asked why the stock of pneumococcal vaccines is insufficient to vaccinate the whole target group advised in 2018, what measures will ensure enough vaccines for 60-plussers this autumn, when supply will be sufficient, and whether the programme will start given contact-minimisation policy, and asked for research on effectiveness in over-80s. The State Secretary answered that stock was bought per the 2018 advice for a five-year rollout with expected uptake of about 70%, that not all 60-plussers can be vaccinated this autumn so 70-79-year-olds get priority, that talks are underway to buy extra vaccines beyond 550,000 already available, that the programme will start this autumn with an alternative organisation prepared, and that RIVM European research on immune response in over-65s including over-80s is ongoing.
Currently talks are being held with the supplier about purchasing extra vaccines in 2020, on top of the 550,000 vaccines already available.
Momenteel wordt gesproken met de leverancier over het inkopen van extra vaccins in 2020, boven op de reeds beschikbare 550.000 vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de onderzoeksresultaten van het Trimbos-instituut over psychische hulp tijdens coronacrisis

A D66 MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Trimbos survey finding that three-quarters of mental-health panel members had no face-to-face contact with a care provider during the coronavirus crisis, and about falling mental-health care use despite rising demand. The State Secretary answered that care was largely continued remotely or face-to-face where needed, that declaration data cannot show reduced treatment minutes, that the NZa monitor shows waiting times rising then slightly falling, and that a GP-referral factsheet and a crisis structure are being used to restore care.
On the basis of (declaration) data from health insurers it cannot be said whether individual patients have received fewer treatment minutes during the coronavirus crisis.
Het is op basis van (declaratie)data van zorgverzekeraars niet te zeggen of individuele patiënten tijdens de corona-crisis minder behandelminuten hebben gekregen/krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een toename van geweld door verwarde personen

An MP asked whether violence by people with psychological problems has increased during the coronavirus crisis, its causes, and the status of a Trimbos Institute study. The government answered that no increase in violence by this group can be established, though police reports of disturbances involving confused persons have risen, and it promised to share forthcoming research results with parliament.
As soon as the results of these studies are available, I will share them with the House.
Zodra de opbrengsten van deze onderzoeken beschikbaar zijn zal ik deze met Uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Kuik en Kuiken over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs asked the government about the consequences of the COVID-19 crisis for people in prostitution, including unregistered workers without income support, bed-bath-bread shelter, exit programmes, police raids, and online advertising for physical services. The minister answered that sex workers can access existing support schemes and municipal shelters, that a ban on prostitution applies under the emergency ordinance, that exit demand has not yet grown substantially, and that the ordinance may be amended to address online advertising.
Such possibilities are currently being examined.
Op dit moment worden zulke mogelijkheden onderzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Ellemeet en Renkema over de berichten ‘Expertisecentrum kreeg vorig jaar recordaantal euthanasieverzoeken’ en ‘Jongeren die in 2017 zelfmoord pleegden vaak verstrikt in web van

MPs Westerveld, Ellemeet and Renkema asked the Health Minister about reports on record euthanasia requests at the Expertise Centre and on young people who died by suicide after being caught in the care system, asking about youth euthanasia rules, unrecorded self-harm and suicide prevention policy. The minister answered that most youth requests reflect a need for help rather than a death wish, provided statistics on youth requests and rejections, and said the government will present a new national suicide prevention agenda this year.
The Expertise Centre does not keep data on this.
Hier houdt het Expertisecentrum geen gegevens over bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over ‘sluip’marketing van de tabaksindustrie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about tobacco industry 'sneak' marketing: payments to retailers and festivals for prominent or exclusive product display, influencer videos featuring a tobacco brand, NVWA capacity and fines. The State Secretary answered that such payments violate the advertising ban, that the NVWA enforces case by case and has fined festivals, that capacity is being expanded by 6.5 then 7.5 FTE, and that the fine regime is adequate.
In the letter of 11 May I indicated that I consider supervision of the new rules of the National Prevention Agreement important for achieving the agreement's goals.
479 ) aan uw Kamer heb ik aangegeven dat ik het toezicht op de nieuwe regels van het Nationaal Preventieakkoord van belang acht voor het behalen van de doelen uit het akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verbijstering van politici over de totstandkoming van Windpark Spui in Piershil/Nieuw-Beijerland

MPs asked about the impact of the Windpark Spui wind farm on local residents, including noise nuisance, compensation, health effects, minimum distance norms and foreign ownership of subsidised turbines. The minister replied that provincial authorities are competent, that noise norms are met, that no scientific basis exists for 'turbine syndrome', and that further research on low-frequency noise is awaited, without committing to new national measures.
Because the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority for wind farm Spui, I am not directly involved in this wind farm.
Omdat de provincie Zuid-Holland bevoegd gezag is voor windpark Spui, ben ik niet direct betrokken bij dit windpark.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Regterschot over het bericht ‘Leren actievoeren kan ook als maatschappelijke dienst’

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a youth project under the Maatschappelijke Diensttijd (MDT) scheme that trains young people in activism, including a trip to London, and its cost of about 350,000 euros. The state secretary defended the project as meeting MDT goals, explained the cost per participant, and promised to address the objective framework and project information in a June progress letter.
In the MDT research, the objective framework consists of the values of the indicators for the group of young people who did not follow MDT.
In het onderzoek bij MDT bestaat het objectieve kader uit de waarden van de indicatoren van de groep jongeren die geen MDT gevolgd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht ‘Wereldwijde toename huiselijk geweld door coronavirus’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports of rising domestic violence during the coronavirus crisis, including an Italian police app, the Fier chat function, a national 24/7 chat, BES islands provision, and safe shelter availability. The minister answered by reference to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277) rather than answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MPs Bergkamp and Diertens (both D66) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) and State Secretary Blokhuis (Health, Welfare and Sport) (2020Z06384) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 277).

De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens (beiden D66) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) en Staatssecretaris Blokhuis (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) ( 2020Z06384 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Eerste uitkeringen slachtoffers en nabestaanden NS-transporten’ en over het bericht ‘NS komt overlevenden en nabestaanden Holocaust financieel tegemoet’

An MP asked the state secretary about NS's compensation scheme for WWII deportation victims, including whether the state as shareholder was consulted and whether resistance fighters and reprisal victims are covered. The government answered that NS decided independently on the commission and scheme, that the shareholder imposed no restrictions, and that NS will involve other victim groups in a collective recognition, with a decision expected around summer.
Determining the scope of the scheme NS has put in place, however, is not for the cabinet but for NS.
Het bepalen van de reikwijdte van de regeling die NS heeft getroffen is echter niet aan het kabinet, maar aan NS
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about the effects of the coronavirus crisis on sex workers, including exit programmes, income support, closure rules, online advertising, and shelter. The government answered that exit demand is being monitored, that municipalities bear responsibility for shelter and most support, and that it advises against forcing websites to block physical-service advertising.
In parallel, I have asked the RUPS organisations about the requests for help they have received since the start of the coronavirus crisis and the nature of these requests.
Parallel daaraan heb ik bij de Rups-organisaties een uitvraag gedaan naar de hulpvragen die zij sinds het begin van de coronacrisis ontvangen en wat de aard is van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over een plantaardige voedingsaanbod in ziekenhuizen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether plant-based meals are available in Dutch hospitals and whether the 2025 target of the National Prevention Agreement for healthy hospital food is ambitious enough. The State Secretary answered that healthy food should be available in hospitals, that availability is likely but not verified nationwide, and that the target has been set at 2030 with the Alliance Food in Care working toward it.
The goal is healthy food offerings in all hospitals by 2030.
Het doel is gezond voedingsaanbod in alle ziekenhuizen in 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over homeopathische behandelingen van Covid-19 en het coronavirus

An MP asked the minister about claims that homeopathic prophylaxis protects against the coronavirus, asking what powers exist to act against such claims and the role of the IGJ. The minister agreed such claims are unacceptable, said unfounded medical claims are not permitted, noted the IGJ can investigate providers who are reported, and brought the matter to the IGJ's attention.
I have brought the matter to the attention of the IGJ.
Ik heb een en ander onder de aandacht van de IGJ gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de risico’s voor en van nieuwe asielzoekers

An MP from the PvdA asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether new asylum seekers, during the COVID-19 measures, receive no help at all from IND or COA, whether some may have fled dangerous conditions, and how their health risks and need for basic humanitarian aid are weighed. The State Secretary confirms that new asylum applications are suspended, that only registration and security checks take place, and that an emergency shelter is being set up while existing COA reception continues until 6 April.
At the same time, work is under way to set up an emergency shelter location where people who cannot currently enter the asylum process can find accommodation and basic facilities.
Tegelijk wordt gewerkt aan de inrichting van een noodonderdaklocatie waar mensen, die nu niet kunnen instromen in het asielproces, onderdak en basale voorzieningen kunnen vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Voordewind over de kabinetsbrief Vervolgmaatregelen aanpak coronavirus

MPs Groothuizen and Voordewind asked whether suspending new asylum applications until 6 April removes access to reception and where arrivals will stay, plus questions on the IND, deportation talks, and COVID measures in asylum centres. The State Secretary confirmed new asylum procedures are suspended with only essential registration, that emergency shelter is being arranged, and that centre protocols and GGD cooperation are in place, though much remains uncertain.
The decision taken is that for asylum seekers who newly register, the asylum procedure is suspended.
Het besluit dat is genomen is dat voor asielzoekers die zich nieuw aanmelden de asielprocedure wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Reporter Radio kritisch over rookstophulp’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Reporter Radio report criticising smoking-cessation help, including coach quality, prescribing of medication without seeing patients, and the Kwaliteitsregister. The State Secretary largely acknowledges the problems, says a quality register improvement and a visiegroep review of coach criteria are underway, and calls prescribing without a doctor unacceptable, but defers insurer pricing questions to ongoing negotiations.
I find it unacceptable that medicines are prescribed without a doctor ever having seen the person.
Ik vind het onacceptabel dat medicijnen worden voorgeschreven zonder dat een arts de persoon ooit heeft gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over de televisie-uitzending van Rambam ‘Heel Holland coacht’

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Health and Social Affairs about a rise in self-described coaches, the lack of self-regulation and a possible national quality register for coaches, citing professional concern about a 'wildgroei'. The government replied that coaching is not a protected profession or part of mental health care, so it declines to judge the sector or take on a regulatory role, pointing responsibility to the profession and clients.
Coach is not a protected profession and not a function within (mental) health care.
Coach is geen beschermd beroep en geen functie binnen de (geestelijke) gezondheidszorg.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Regterschot over het bericht ‘Boosheid in Heerlen om ‘ over de schutting gooien’ Haagse daklozen naar krimpgebieden’

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that The Hague is relocating homeless people to shrinking regions such as Heerlen, and whether this shifts a social problem to other municipalities, what conditions and aftercare apply, and whether other municipalities use this approach. The state secretary replies that the pilot is voluntary for people with limited means, that The Hague assigns a case manager for warm handover, that aftercare is arranged case by case, and that no comparable pilots are known, with the wider housing issue to be addressed in a plan to be sent to parliament.
I have made inquiries with the VNG and Valente and they are not aware of other examples of a similar pilot.
Ik heb navraag gedaan bij VNG en Valente en zij kennen geen andere voorbeelden van een soortgelijke pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over maximale 'veilige' geluidsniveaus bij concerten die alleen met oordoppen veilig blijken te zijn

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Health about the 103 dB concert noise norm, which is only safe with earplugs, the adequacy of the earplug awareness campaign, the convention on hearing damage prevention, enforcement and monitoring, and the follow-up to a motion on statutory noise limits. The State Secretary acknowledges the concerns, defends the campaign and convention, says legislation options will be reported by year-end, and promises a progress report and stakeholder analysis in April.
I will therefore continue to facilitate the I Love My Ears campaign and the implementation of the Convenant Preventie Gehoorschade.
Ik zal daarom de I Love My Ears campagne en de uitvoering van het Convenant Preventie Gehoorschade blijven faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Ploumen over de actie van een verkoper van blenders waarbij moeders worden opgeroepen hun kind niet te vaccineren

MPs Diertens and Ploumen asked the state secretary about a seller's campaign offering a free blender to mothers who refrain from vaccinating their children against whooping cough. The state secretary answered that the Advertising Code Commission rebuked the campaign, that no legal sanctions apply because no statutory rules were broken, that the IGJ contacted the company and the campaign was stopped, but that contacting parents directly is not possible under privacy law.
No, we do not have data for this and we (or the IGJ) cannot request it from the website owner because of privacy legislation.
Nee, we beschikken niet over gegevens hiervoor en wij (of de IGJ) kunnen die ook niet opvragen bij de eigenaar van de website vanwege de privacywetgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Buitenweg over het interview ‘Politiechef Anja Schouten: Er moet een eerste hulp bij onbegrepen gedrag komen’ en het opinieartikel ‘Laat de politiegeen zorgtaken uitvoeren’

GroenLinks MPs Renkema and Buitenweg asked the state secretary for Health and the Justice minister about police chief Schouten's call for a first-aid response to 'confused behaviour' (E33 reports) and an op-ed against police doing care tasks. The government answered that the problem is multi-faceted and needs regional, personalised solutions, reported E33 incident counts for 2011–2019, and declined to adopt a national model or a mandatory crisis-point in every region.
A single national approach would also not do justice to the complexity of the problem and would leave insufficient room for local customisation.
Eén landelijke aanpak zou ook geen recht doen aan de complexiteit van de problematiek en onvoldoende ruimte bieden voor lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Vileine truc om verbod op mentholsigaretten te omzeilen: menthol-inlegkaarten’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether menthol insert cards that turn tobacco minty can circumvent the upcoming menthol ban, and whether such products fall under the Tobacco Act and NVWA supervision. The State Secretary agreed it looks like an attempt to circumvent the ban, said the products fall outside current law, and committed to an inventory of such accessories with a view to banning them.
I intend to have an inventory carried out of the nature and scale of such accessories.
Ik ben voornemens een inventarisatie te laten uitvoeren naar de aard en de omvang van dergelijke «accessoires».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het toevoegen van klimaatlessen aan het onderwijscurriculum in Nieuw-Zeeland

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government will adopt New Zealand's climate-education curriculum and related lessons on climate crisis, activism and eco-anxiety, and asked about the psychological effects of climate change. The ministers answered that sustainability is already part of the Dutch curriculum, that New Zealand's materials are freely available to schools, that Dutch education policy is a national responsibility, and that they do not see a need to copy the Italian or New Zealand models.
The Netherlands therefore does not need to follow the example of Italy and New Zealand, since themes such as sustainability, climate and liveability are already embedded in Dutch education.
Nederland behoeft het voorbeeld van Italië en Nieuw-Zeeland dan ook niet te volgen, aangezien thema's als duurzaamheid, klimaat en leefbaarheid ook nu al ingebed zijn in het Nederlandse onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Regterschot over het artikel ‘Opvang nieuwe slachtoffers huiselijk geweld niet geregeld’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a news report that women's shelter care in Noord- and Midden-Limburg was not arranged from 1 January 2020 due to a procurement dispute, and about information to municipal councils and the handling of Wmo procurement. The minister replied that interim agreements ensure continuity of shelter, that no other municipalities are known to lack shelter care, that municipal councils' information is a college responsibility, and that shelter triage is not part of mental health care.
Informing municipal councils about local Wmo care is a responsibility of the mayor and aldermen of the municipality concerned.
Het informeren van de gemeenteraden over de lokale Wmo-zorg is een verantwoordelijkheid van het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de betreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht 'Altrecht schrapt therapie voor zware psychiatrische aandoening: Charlotte (26) moet nu wéér wachten'

MP Renkema asks the State Secretary about Altrecht closing its trauma centre and dissociative disorder therapy due to staff shortages, leaving patients on waiting lists, and about accessibility of specialist mental health care and market effects. The State Secretary answers that Altrecht lacks expertise to continue the therapy, that patients received continuity plans, that a shortage of mental health staff exists, and that insurers and providers must submit a plan within four weeks to secure high-specialist capacity.
I have agreed with the health insurers and care providers that they will deliver their plan within four weeks.
Ik heb met de zorgverzekeraars en de zorgaanbieders afgesproken dat zij binnen vier weken hun plan opleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Renkema over het manifest van Lijm de Zorg

MPs Regterschot and Renkema asked the state secretary about the Lijm de Zorg manifesto on mental health care gaps, number of stranded patients, the Arkin deregulation experiment, a central reporting number and the evaluation of the Wvggz. The state secretary answered that a plan for complex-care capacity is due by 4 March, outlined steps including national rollout of simplified activity codes, a central number by 1 July 2020, and an evaluation of the Wvggz within two years, while admitting no precise count of stranded persons is kept.
I have asked health insurers and care providers to come up with a plan to secure care provision for the highly complex target group.
Ik heb zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders gevraagd met een plan te komen om het zorgaanbod voor de hoogcomplexe doelgroep te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het AO 'Vliegen over Conflictgebieden'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked who decides on suspending flights to China, whether it is right that airlines make that call commercially, what information airlines use, the roles of the UK and German governments, when the Dutch state could suspend flights, whether KLM cut mainly unsold flights, and whether arriving passengers can be medically screened. The Minister answered that airlines decide under advice from RIVM, WHO, EU and ICAO and the foreign ministry travel advice, that the Minister of Medical Care could impose targeted emergency measures under the Public Health Act but no flight-ban is warranted now, and that entry screening is not effective.
Transport permits that airlines hold under aviation treaties can only be withdrawn when operators do not comply with national rules on the admission, stay and departure of passengers and cargo.

Vervoerstoestemmingen die luchtvaartmaatschappijen op grond van de luchtvaartverdragen hebben, kunnen alleen worden ingetrokken wanneer exploitanten de nationale voorschriften voor de toelating, verblijf en vertrek van passagiers en vracht niet opvolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het artikel ‘Animo voor test baarmoederhalskanker stagneert’

An MP asked the state secretary about falling participation in the cervical cancer screening programme, its causes, information campaigns and whether the self-test request via DigiD is a barrier. The state secretary reported participation figures, a target-group study on barriers, and said the government will examine how to remove barriers without setting a high-uptake goal as such.
I consider a decline in participation worrying when it is caused by unnecessary barriers to participation.
Ik vind een daling in de deelname zorgelijk wanneer die veroorzaakt wordt door onnodige belemmeringen om deel te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het artikel '14 doden per dag: 'Verlaag leeftijd oproep darmkankeronderzoek naar 50 jaar''

An MP asked the state secretary whether an EU recommendation requires bowel cancer screening from age 50 and why the Netherlands starts at 55, and what the pros and cons of lowering the age are. The state secretary answered that the EU guidance sets a 50-74 band as a benchmark, that the Dutch age limit follows a 2009 Health Council advice, and that he is open to lowering it after a 2021 evaluation and a Health Council opinion.
Based on the evaluation of the programme, I will ask the Health Council to give an opinion on this.
Op basis van de evaluatie van het programma zal ik de Gezondheidsraad vragen hier een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Kuik over het Coronavirus

MPs Van den Berg and Kuik asked the government about the new coronavirus, including its mortality compared with Ebola, WHO coordination, Dutch preparedness, travel advice and European measures. The minister answered that mortality is about 2%, that the WHO declared a PHEIC, that Dutch hospitals are prepared with at least 250 isolation ICU beds, and that travel advice and monitoring are being adjusted in line with WHO and ECDC advice.
The Netherlands is well prepared and follows the advice of the WHO and the ECDC.
Nederland is goed voorbereid en volgt hierbij de adviezen van de WHO en het ECDC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘GEZOCHT: 100 aanstaande MOEDERS voor nieuw GREEN VACCIN!’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about a blog offering a free juicer to parents who choose not to vaccinate their children, whether it was misleading, what would be done against it, and whether financial rewards for not vaccinating are permitted. The state secretary called the action irresponsible and misleading, said the IGJ had contacted the blog owner and that the Reclame Code Commissie would rule on the advertising, but gave no new binding measures.
The IGJ asked the owner of the blog «Miss Natural Lifestyle» to adjust the call and invited her for a conversation.
De IGJ heeft de eigenaar van de blog «Miss Natural Lifestyle» gevraagd om de oproep aan te passen en haar uitgenodigd voor een gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Ploumen over de actie van een verkoper van blenders waarbij moeders worden opgeroepen hun kind niet te vaccineren

MPs Diertens and Ploumen asked whether the state secretary knew of a blender seller's campaign urging mothers not to vaccinate their children, and what could be done against commercial parties exploiting parental fears. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care had been notified, contacted the blog owner, and mentioned strengthening citizens' media literacy.
The Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care (IGJ) received a report from the RIVM.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) heeft een melding van het RIVM gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Verdachte steekpartij Den Haag 'gevaar voor zichzelf en omgeving', maar werd niet opgepakt'

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about a stabbing in The Hague by a man previously flagged as dangerous who was not detained, asking how oversight failed and whether mental health care cuts were to blame. The government answered that several investigations are ongoing, that the IGJ has ordered an independent inquiry at Parnassia and the Wmo supervisor is also investigating, and it declined to discuss specifics because of the criminal case.
Because of the ongoing investigations, I cannot currently go into specific aspects of this case.
Vanwege de lopende onderzoeken kan ik op dit moment niet ingaan op specifieke aspecten van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Verdachte steekpartij Den Haag gevaar voor zichzelf en omgeving, maar werd niet opgepakt’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that a stabbing suspect, already ordered into forced psychiatric care, was not picked up after failing to appear, and about the chronology of care and police contacts. The government declined to give the detailed chronology, citing ongoing criminal investigation and a parallel IGJ inspection, and only committed to informing the House of relevant findings later.
Since a criminal investigation is ongoing in the case and the trial against the suspect has yet to take place, no statement can be made about the precise sequence of events.
Nu in de zaak strafrechtelijk onderzoek wordt gedaan en het proces tegen de verdachte nog moet worden gevoerd, kan over de precieze gang van zaken geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Regterschot over het artikel ‘GGZ Nederland vraagt NZa in te grijpen bij zorgverzekeraars’

MP Regterschot asked the state secretary whether GGZ Nederland's request that the NZa enforce against insurers' acute mental health contracting for 2020 was justified, whether negotiations had stalled, and how such disputes could be avoided. The state secretary answered that GGZ Nederland withdrew its enforcement request on 13 December 2019 after a meeting with the insurers, that the NZa therefore issued no decision, and that an independent evaluation of the contracting process would start in February 2020.
After the enforcement request was withdrawn, the NZa's handling of the request was ended.
Na intrekking van het handhavingsverzoek is de behandeling van het verzoek door de NZa beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de mogelijke gevolgen van de richtlijn nevenbevindingen bij het bevolkingsonderzoek borstkanker

MP Ploumen asks why enlarged lymph nodes, calcifications, leaking breast implants and loose pacemaker wires seen on breast cancer screening mammograms are not reported to women and their GPs, and whether the guidance will change. The State Secretary defends the policy of reporting only exceptional findings on medical grounds, says the implant-leak section of the guidance will be amended in spring 2020, and undertakes to make the RIVM website more explicit about this.
The implementation framework will be amended in the new edition of March/April 2020 in the section on incidental findings.
Het uitvoeringskader zal in de nieuwe uitgave van maart/april 2020 op het onderdeel nevenbevindingen worden aangepast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Rudmer Heerema over de berichten ‘Neergeschoten vrouw in Alkmaar teisterde buurt al jaren: “Tweehonderd meldingen gemaakt”’ en ‘Door politie doodgeschoten vrouw (48) liep in

MPs Regterschot and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary about news reports that a 48-year-old woman with confused behaviour, shot dead by police in Alkmaar, had generated many prior reports to housing, police and mental health services, and whether earlier intervention was possible. The government answered that the figure of hundreds of reports was not recognised, that agencies acted per national guidelines, that the incident was complex and not preventable, that a stronger person-centred approach and triage are planned, and that a local rather than national approach is preferred.
It is not customary to go into detail on an individual case such as this one.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om gedetailleerd in te gaan op een individuele casus, zoals deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot doorverwijzing bij het bellen van het nummer 1-1-3 naar het nummer 0900–0113

Rep. Wörsdörfer asked whether calling 1-1-3 with a recorded redirect to the suicide prevention line 0900-0113 could cause fatal delay, whether a direct connection is preferable, and about waiting times on 0900-0113.
