The State Secretary answered that 1-1-2 is the emergency number, that telecom providers implemented an audible redirect since November 2019 with a structural solution in progress, and that no concrete waiting-time signals were received, with a new monitoring system planned.

Following the General Consultation on suicide prevention of 17 October 2019, the telecom sector was asked without delay to implement an audible message with redirection to the number 0900-0113 in their networks.

In vervolg op het Algemeen Overleg suïcidepreventie van 17 oktober 2019, is de telecomsector per ommegaande verzocht om een auditieve melding met doorverwijzing naar het nummer 0900–0113 in hun netwerken te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over vorderingen voor het overschrijden van het budgetplafond

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about insurers' retroactive claims over mental health budget caps that threaten provider bankruptcies, and about how caps are set and whether they are fair. The State Secretary says insurers and providers are private parties with contractual freedom, points to arbitration and courts, and describes planned improvements to the contracting and add-on contracting process, including a new mental health funding model.
I am not a party to cases concerning retroactive claims by health insurers, because they concern contractual agreements between care providers and insurers and their implementation.
Ik ben geen partij bij casussen met betrekking tot navorderingen door zorgverzekeraars, omdat het gaat om contractafspraken tussen zorgaanbieders en verzekeraars en de uitvoering ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Drenthe dwingt Cosis kwetsbare cliënten op straat te zetten’

MP Kerstens asked the state secretary about a report that a dispute between Drenthe municipalities and care provider Cosis could leave vulnerable clients on the street, and whether other such cases are known. The state secretary said clients should not suffer from such disputes, cited a court-extended transition period in Assen, and pointed to national housing investments and a broad homelessness approach while acknowledging no national overview of shortages exists.
I do not have a national overview of possible bottlenecks regarding available housing for sheltered living.
Ik heb geen landelijk overzicht van mogelijke knelpunten op het gebied van beschikbare woonruimte voor beschermd wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Boete voor uitdelen tabaksbonus aan winkeliers’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the state secretary for health about NVWA findings that tobacco manufacturers pay sales bonuses to specialist tobacco shops, and whether the NVWA should be able to compel cooperation and act against such deals, including with supermarkets. The state secretary called the bonuses unlawful under the advertising ban, said a pending bill would give administrative bodies power to impose orders under penalty, and committed to further NVWA investigations in 2020 with results to be reported.
It is of great importance that cooperation is given to investigations by the NVWA.
Het is van groot belang dat medewerking wordt verleend aan onderzoeken van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'NZa draait patiëntenstop Parnassia terug'.

The SP MP Hijink asks the State Secretary for Health about the NZa's intervention in the Parnassia-VGZ contracting dispute, waiting lists in mental health care, VGZ's contracting limits, marketing by Parnassia, and related issues. The State Secretary says the NZa acted rightly to protect continuity of care, sets out waiting-time data and the NZa's oversight findings, and points to existing commitments on contracting and workforce, while declining to comment on private contract talks and having no insight into marketing budgets.
I stand behind the NZa's approach and I am pleased with the outcome.
Ik sta achter de handelwijze van de NZa en ik ben blij met de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Internationale deskundigen in Nederland bij elkaar over sjoemelsigaretten’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health for the full list of participants, agenda, findings and minutes of an expert meeting at RIVM on filter-ventilated cigarettes. The state secretary declined to name experts, withheld the agenda as a meeting-confidentiality matter, and deferred substance to a report due before the FCTC COP9 conference.
Names of experts are not released so that these people can do their work without interference from the tobacco industry.
Namen van experts worden niet vrijgegeven om deze mensen zonder inmenging van de tabaksindustrie hun werk te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Regterschot over de artikelen ‘Ouders Thijs H.: wij smeekten ggz om hulp’ en ‘Ouders Thijs H. smeekten GGZ om hulp, maar opname was ‘onnodig’’

An MP (Regterschot, VVD) asked the state secretary about press reports that the parents of Thijs H. repeatedly asked mental health services for admission before a violent incident, and whether recommendations of the Hoekstra commission were ignored, plus questions on family involvement, staffing, medication side effects and transparency. The state secretary disputed non-implementation, listed actions taken, pointed to the new Wvggz family-involvement rules, declined to comment on the individual case and cited medical confidentiality and ongoing investigations, while promising a letter on learning culture in mental health care.
I cannot go into this question because it concerns an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze vraag omdat het om een individuele casus gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Regterschot en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de artikelen ‘Doe iets, anders is het wachten op de volgende dode’ en ‘We laten verwarde personen te lang vrijlopen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about newspaper reports on dangerous incidents involving confused persons, the lessons drawn, implementation of the person-centred approach, information sharing, a 24/7 hotline, mayors' emergency powers, rising incident numbers, police workload and whether a national approach is possible. The government answered that the approach is being implemented regionally, that the Wvggz and new privacy guidance improve information sharing, that a national hotline is expected in spring 2020, and that local tailoring rather than a single national approach is preferred.
The national reporting number is expected to be ready in spring 2020.
7 , zal het landelijk meldnummer naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2020 gereed zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Lesmethodes seksuele voorlichting onder de loep’

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether the supply of recognised sexual health lesson interventions is broad enough, how subsidies to Rutgers and others are kept to sexual health, and whether Rutgers' role in recognising lesson methods creates a conflict of interest. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that about 36 recognised interventions exist, that subsidies continue with partial phase-out for state-aid reasons, that grant accountability will shift to measuring reach, and that a Gezonde School coordinator is a mandatory component, while defending Rutgers' expert role as not creating conflict of interest.
However, I cannot yet make announcements about the exact outcomes, because the organisations concerned must first be informed.
Ik kan echter nog geen mededelingen doen over de exacte uitkomsten ervan, omdat eerst de betreffende organisaties op de hoogte gebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Patiëntenstops bij GGNet voor verzekerden Zilveren Kruis, Interpolis en FBTO'

An MP asks the State Secretary how a patient admission stop at GGNet for insured persons of Zilveren Kruis fits the statutory duty of care, what the insurer is doing to restore care, whether it must contract additional capacity, and whether the NZa monitors and can enforce that duty. The State Secretary answers that the insurer's duty of care is met through referral and extra contracting, that the NZa oversees it and has used only dialogue so far, and that existing enforcement tools are adequate.
Yes, I am of the view that the NZa is adequately equipped.
Ja, ik ben van mening dat de NZa voldoende is toegerust.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Toorenburg en Van der Graaf over de impact van gokelementen in games op jongeren

MPs from the CDA and ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries about rising problematic gaming among young people, the spread of gambling-like loot boxes, the slow enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit against game developers, and age classification. The government answered that the rise may not be confirmed by current data pending a legal basis for LADIS, rejected a national ban as ineffective, said enforcement is complex and partly confidential, and pointed to prevention, industry dialogue and PEGI self-regulation.
Not everything happens in public. It is a careful process that must also be able to withstand scrutiny in court.
Niet alles gebeurt in de openbaarheid. Het is een zorgvuldig proces dat ook bij de rechter moet kunnen standhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de toename van het aantal kinderen dat in een crisisopvang woont

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked the government about the rising number of children living in crisis shelters, including whether gezinnen should get priority for housing and whether the issue will be addressed in an upcoming homelessness action plan. The minister answered that children should not grow up in shelters, that no recent data exists so a study will be commissioned, that housing allocation is a municipal responsibility, and that a homelessness action plan is being prepared.
There are no recent substantiated figures on the number of children currently living in women's or social shelters.
Er zijn geen recente onderbouwde cijfers bekend over het aantal kinderen dat momenteel in de vrouwen- of maatschappelijke opvang woont.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over het bericht dat sommige jongeren niet kunnen studeren omdat zij dakloos zijn

GroenLinks MPs asked whether homeless young people are excluded from education, how many cannot study or lack a startkwalificatie, where they can get help, and about schuldsanering and student loan barriers. The government replied that lack of a registered address is no bar to enrolment, that no national figures exist on homeless youth without qualifications, that municipalities coordinate support, and pointed to existing action programmes and schuldhulp measures.
DUO does not register who has no fixed residential or residence address.
DUO registreert niet wie er geen vaste woon- of verblijfsplaats heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Rog over de geplande opschaling van Respect Education Foundation

MPs Peters and Rog asked the government about the planned scaling-up of the Respect Education Foundation and what it had done on the earlier motion to support the RespectPact. The minister answered that the departments saw no financial room, that the foundation has not yet sent a proposal for immaterial support, and that the cabinet is willing to offer immaterial support once that proposal arrives.
The cabinet is willing to provide immaterial support for the REF's work, but is awaiting a proposal from the REF.
Het kabinet is bereid tot immateriële ondersteuning van het werk van het REF, maar is in afwachting van een voorstel van het REF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Ellemeet over de ingezonden brandbrief in het NRC van 67 zorgprofessionals ‘Laten we de duurste ziekte aanpakken – dementie’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about a open letter from 67 care professionals urging greater focus on preventing dementia, including claims about lifestyle-related risk and possible savings. The minister acknowledged the letter, said prevention is part of existing programmes and the Nationaal Preventieakkoord, and declined to make a sugar tax a priority while offering to talk with the initiators.
We are, however, willing to enter into discussion with the initiators.
Wel zijn wij bereid met de initiatiefnemers het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Gijs van Dijk en Kerstens over de verdubbeling van het aantal daklozen

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about the reported doubling of the number of homeless people in the Netherlands, including the state's duty to provide housing, the causes, the adequacy of social assistance, shelter capacity and broader societal effects. The state secretary answered that housing and health are constitutional social rights shared with municipalities and housing corporations, that the government will present an additional plan this autumn, and that CBS research on the rise is pending.
That is why the Cabinet, together with other (local) parties, will come this autumn with an additional plan to significantly reduce the number of homeless people in the coming years.
Daarom komt het Kabinet dit najaar samen met andere (lokale) partijen met een aanvullend plan om het aantal dak- en thuislozen de komende jaren fors terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kwantificering van zorgkosten

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify health and care costs attributable to (non-Western) immigrants, premium arrears, and targeted programmes. The minister answered that no breakdown by migration background is available for most items, gave an estimate of about 2.2 million euros for medically necessary care to uninsured non-Western-background residents, and pointed to other sources for cost differences.
We have no insight into what share of care costs is spent on Dutch residents with a migration background.
We hebben geen inzicht in welk deel van de kosten van zorg wordt aangewend voor Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht ‘Familiedrama in Winschoten: 'Ze belde 113, maar dat nummer bestaat helemaal niet'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary whether the confusing 113 suicide-prevention number, which cannot be reached by dialling 1-1-3, contributed to a family tragedy in Winschoten and why 0900-0113 was chosen. The state secretary answered that the organisation is in talks with the ministry on a short-term fix such as redirecting callers, explained the historical reasons for the number, and promised a further letter to parliament.
I am now in discussion with the Ministry of EZK to take action on this and to adjust the message for now into a clear referral or redirection to the correct number.
Ik ben inmiddels met het Ministerie van EZK in gesprek om hier actie op te ondernemen en de melding vooralsnog aan te passen in een duidelijke verwijzing of doorschakeling naar het juiste nummer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de bereikbaarheid van 113 Zelfmoordpreventie

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the 113 suicide prevention line could be made directly reachable via the 113 number, since the 0900 number is less known and costly, after a family tragedy where a caller dialled a non-existent 113 number. The State Secretary answered that a 0800 number now removes cost barriers, that the 1-1-3 number could potentially be made available subject to a number-plan change by the ACM, a process of at least three months with conditions and misdialling risks still being studied, and committed to further investigation with the Minister of Justice.
Together with the Minister of Justice we will investigate the possibilities, risks and appropriate conditions for making this number available.
Samen met de Minister van JenV zullen wij onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden, de risico’s en passende voorwaarden zijn bij het beschikbaar maken van dit nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de zelfmoordpreventielijn

An MP from the CDA asked why the suicide prevention line widely known as 113 cannot be reached on that number and whether the 0900-0113 number is free of charge. The Secretary of State acknowledged that callers to 1-1-3 receive a message that the number does not exist, said the 113 name caused confusion, and committed to adjusting the referral message in the short term and to a letter to parliament.
I am now in discussion with the Ministry of EZK to take action on this and to adjust the message into a clear referral or redirection to the correct number.
Ik ben inmiddels met het Ministerie van EZK in gesprek om hier actie op te ondernemen en de melding aan te passen in een duidelijke verwijzing of doorschakeling naar het juiste nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een meisje zelfmoord pleegde na het niet-bestaande telefoonnummer ‘113’ te bellen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Winschoten case in which a girl who called the non-existent number 113 for suicide help took her own life, asking about sympathy, the misleading 113 name, the timeline of talks on reassigning the number, the 144 comparison, and free access to the helpline. The State Secretary expressed sympathy, explained the history and reasoning behind the number issue, and deferred the detailed answers to a same-day letter to parliament, while outlining that 1-1-3 could be made available subject to conditions and a three-month process.
Together with the Minister of Justice and Security we will investigate the possibilities, risks and appropriate conditions for making this number available.
Samen met de Minister van JenV zullen wij onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden, de risico's en passende voorwaarden zijn bij het beschikbaar maken van dit nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een kwart van de ggz-instellingen 2018 afsloten met rode cijfers

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a quarter of mental health (ggz) institutions closed 2018 in the red, and whether unpaid care, labour shortages and cost-driven incentives threaten access to care. The state secretary answered that contracting disputes can go to court or the complaints committee, that the NZa monitors insurers' duty of care, and that the Hoofdlijnenakkoord addresses the issues, expressing hope that early 2019 results are improving.
Should a conflict arise in contracting between a care provider and an insurer or municipality, the parties can submit it to the court.
Mocht er bij de contractering overigens een conflict ontstaan tussen een zorgaanbieder en een verzekeraar of gemeente, dan kunnen partijen dat aan de rechter voorleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Familiedrama in Winschoten: ze belde 113 maar dat nummer bestaat helemaal niet’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Winschoten family tragedy in which a caller dialled 113, a suicide-prevention number that does not exist as a usable number, and about whether the 113 Zelfmoordpreventie line should be given 1-1-3. The State Secretary expressed sympathy, said the number usage is not tracked, explained that the number is reserved in the numbering plan under the responsibility of the EZK Secretary and the ACM, and said that he and the Justice Minister will examine options and conditions for making 1-1-3 available.
Together with the Minister of Justice and Security we will examine the possibilities, risks and suitable conditions for making this number available.
Samen met de Minister van JenV zullen wij onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden, de risico’s en passende voorwaarden zijn bij het beschikbaar maken van dit nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Familiedrama in Winschoten: ‘Ze belde 113, maar dat nummer bestaat helemaal niet’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the 113 suicide prevention number confusion after a tragedy in Winschoten, and whether the number could be made available quickly. The State Secretary expressed sympathy, acknowledged the confusion, and explained the numbering-plan constraints and ongoing talks with EZK, promising a short-term fix and an exploration of making 1-1-3 available.
I am now in discussion with the Ministry of EZK to take action on this and to adapt the message into a clear referral or forwarding to the correct number
Ik ben inmiddels met het Ministerie van EZK in gesprek om hier actie op te ondernemen en de melding aan te passen in een duidelijke verwijzing of doorschakeling naar het juiste nummer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Familiedrama in Winschoten: 'Ze belde 113, maar dat nummer bestaat helemaal niet'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health why suicide-prevention callers cannot reach the helpline via 113 or must dial a longer 0900 number, and whether the line could be free and linked to 113. The State Secretary said 113 could be made available for suicide prevention in principle, but that this requires coordination with the Economic Affairs ministry (which controls number allocation), a plan of at least three months, and conditions over misdialling risks to emergency number 112.
As stated in today's letter to the House, the State Secretary for Economic Affairs has indicated willingness to make the number 1-1-3 available for help in the context of suicide prevention.
Zoals in de Kamerbrief van heden is opgenomen heeft de Staatssecretaris van EZK aangegeven bereid te zijn het nummer 1-1-3 beschikbaar te stellen voor hulp in het kader van suïcidepreventie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'De elektrische wegwerppeuk: nieuw gevaar voor longen en milieu'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about disposable e-cigarettes: whether flavour bans are possible, whether these products are legal and properly registered, where they must be disposed of as e-waste, and whether online sellers check age. The State Secretary answers that disposable e-cigarettes are permitted under the Tobacco Act, that flavour bans are possible under the EU directive but only Hungary has used this, that waste must go to collection points, and that enforcement of online age checks is complex and a test-purchase method is being developed.
Enforcement of age verification by sellers is complex, because a test purchase must be carried out to establish a violation.
Het toezicht op de naleving van de leeftijdsverificatie door verkopers is complex, omdat voor het constateren van een overtreding er een testkoop uitgevoerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het recht op huurtoeslag van cliënten in een beschermde woonvorm

An MP asked whether residents of supported housing cannot claim rent allowance when their building is owned by a commercial landlord, and whether this worsens the shortage of housing from non-profit landlords. The minister confirmed the rule, said local authorities and housing corporations are responsible for housing supply, and pointed to recent government plans without committing to amend the rule.
I share your concern about realising sufficiently affordable housing with appropriate support for this group of vulnerable citizens.
Ik deel uw zorg om voldoende betaalbare huisvesting met passende ondersteuning te realiseren voor deze groep kwetsbare burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de sluiting van een Pro Persona-locatie in Ede

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the reported closure of a Pro Persona mental health location in Ede, its effects on patients, waiting lists, and other locations. The State Secretary replied that the provider is responsible for its finances, that a phased reduction of beds in Ede (over one to two years) is being explored rather than an immediate closure, that care continuity is assured, and that regulators (NZa, IGJ) monitor the situation, while declining to answer questions about other providers.
I cannot answer this question. It is the responsibility of care providers themselves to take timely measures to address financial problems.
Ik kan deze vraag niet beantwoorden. Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf om tijdig maatregelen te nemen om financiële problemen aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het faillissement van GGZ-instelling Vincere Groep

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of addiction and mental health provider Vincere Groep, including effects on patients, staff, waiting lists and causes. The State Secretary answered that the curator handles care transfer and causes, that IGJ and NZa supervise continuity of care, and that the provider was responsible for its own finances, while committing to no concrete new action beyond monitoring.
It is up to the curator of Vincere Groep to investigate the causes of the bankruptcy.
Het is aan de curator van de Vincere Groep om onderzoek te doen naar de oorzaken van het faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de zorggroep Aventura

MP Kerstens (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about care provider Aventura, including large management fees possibly circumventing the Wet normering topinkomens, the reasonableness of a monthly rate per client, corporate structures, misuse of institutional logos, and supervision of sheltered-housing providers by municipalities. The State Secretary answered that the CIBG is investigating the fees, that maximum tariffs would conflict with the Wmo 2015 aim of tailored support, that municipalities are responsible for Wmo supervision and that more focus and support for supervision is planned, but declined to commit to a new action plan or to extend the Wtza to Wmo providers.
The CIBG, the care sector supervisor for compliance with the Wnt, has very recently launched an investigation into Aventura.
Het CIBG, de toezichthouder in de zorg op de naleving van de Wet normering topinkomens (Wnt), heeft Aventura zeer recent in onderzoek genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Peters en Van den Berg over het gebruik van melatonine als slaapmiddel

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about calls by about 500 scientists to make melatonin prescription-only, its sale and youth use, the rules under which it is sold, and whether labelling and enforcement are adequate. The Minister answered that melatonin products of 0.3 mg or more are treated as medicines by the IGJ, that jet-lag products sold without prescription are not approved for children, that enforcement is being intensified, but that he does not support making all melatonin prescription-only.
From September the IGJ is intensifying enforcement against unregistered medicines containing melatonin, based on a previously drawn-up enforcement plan that has recently been completed.
De IGJ intensiveert vanaf september de handhaving van niet-geregistreerde geneesmiddelen met melatonine, op basis van een eerder opgesteld handhavingsplan dat recent is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de toename van het gebruik van lachgas in het verkeer.

An MP asked the state secretary about the sharp rise in nitrous oxide (laughing gas) incidents in traffic and whether measures would be taken to raise awareness among young people and reduce sales. The government called the rise worrying, pointed to a Trimbos handbook, a planned youth campaign and a pending risk assessment, and said municipal consultations would follow, but answered the questions late.
In the autumn I will, together with the Ministry of Justice and Security, inform your House further on this.
In het najaar zal ik samen met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid uw Kamer hierover nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de gevolgen van lachgas in het verkeer

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about rising nitrous oxide (lachgas) use among drivers, its effects, casualty figures, enforcement options and whether recreational use should be banned. The state secretary answered that casualty data are not available, that existing criminal and CBR administrative tools can already be used, that a risk assessment is pending, and that a youth awareness campaign is planned, but did not fully answer the deadline request.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de noodsituatie in de psychiatrische zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports from GGNet staff of a crisis in psychiatric care, including shortages of beds, long intake waits, insurers' duty of care and government action. The State Secretary answered that there is no shortage of acute treatment beds at GGNet, that intake waits exceed the four-week norm in most diagnosis groups, that insurers bear the duty of care supervised by the NZa, and that the sector works through the existing mental health agreement without announcing new measures.
I am currently not aware that the number of treatment beds for acute situations would be insufficient.
Er is mij op dit moment niet bekend dat het aantal «behandelbedden» voor acute situaties onvoldoende zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de rookcultuur bij Defensie

An MP from the SP asked the State Secretaries of Defence and of Health about reports of a smoking culture within the armed forces, including smoking rates, the exclusion of tobacco prevention from the 'Duurzaam Gezond Inzetbaar' policy, the closure of the smoking-cessation clinic, and very cheap cigarettes at the Brunssum NATO base. The government replied that smoking in vehicles and workplaces is banned, that smoking behaviour is a personal choice so no study is planned, that cessation support has been moved to Defence health centres, and that the low Brunssum prices follow from NATO status-of-forces rules, with illegal resale to be addressed by the Royal Marechaussee if signals arise.
Research into the smoking behaviour of military personnel is therefore not something I consider necessary.
Onderzoek naar het rookgedrag van militairen vind ik daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het lager vaststellen van de maximumprijzen voor ggz-zorg door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether the NZa's lower 2020 maximum mental health tariffs will reduce income, pressure quality and staffing, and ignore staffing norms and temporary staff costs. The State Secretary answers that the tariffs rest on thorough cost research, that most providers can keep their 2018 revenue, that the NZa's approach to staffing is sound, and that the NZa only opposes blanket discounts by insurers.
I am of the opinion that the maximum tariffs set for 2020 are based on a carefully conducted cost study.
Ik ben van mening dat de vastgestelde maximumtarieven voor 2020 zijn gebaseerd op een zorgvuldig uitgevoerd kostenonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Anti-vaccinatiecampagne aangevoerd door homeopaten'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of an anti-vaccination campaign led by homeopaths, the progress of the vaccination alliance's work against misinformation, and why a mandatory warning text on homeopathic products cannot be added. The government describes voluntary actions by an alliance counter-misinformation group, a website visibility improvement, and says Dutch law cannot unilaterally require such text because EU medicines directive rules are binding.
The Netherlands cannot unilaterally deviate from the directive.
Nederland kan niet eenzijdig van de richtlijn afwijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de opkomst van zorgbeveiligers en het hardnekkige fenomeen separatie in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about the rise of security guards in mental health care, the persistence of seclusion, the lack of data on their use and costs, and whether the Dolhuys manifesto goal of seclusion-free care for 2020 is met. The State Secretary says data on security guards and costs are unavailable, that seclusion is ultimum remedium and will be reduced via the Wvggz from 2020, and that transparency on coercive measures will be built into regulations, while leaving staffing, quality and bed capacity largely to providers and insurers.
To make data on the use of coercive measures per mental health institution public, it is necessary that this data be collected, processed and exchanged in a uniform and systematic way.

Om de gegevens over de toepassing van dwangmaatregelen per GGZ-instelling openbaar te kunnen maken, is het nodig dat deze gegevens op uniforme en systematische wijze worden verzameld, bewerkt en uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het bericht 'Daklozenopvang in nood: opnamestop bij Leger des Heils'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a reported reception stop at Leger des Heils in Amsterdam, rising homelessness, and whether shelter capacity and ambulant care are adequate. The state secretary confirmed the stop was temporary and lifted by the Amsterdam council, cited existing reports, and described ongoing work with municipalities and national programmes without committing to a new national intervention.
I consider this an adequate solution to the situation that had arisen.
Ik vind dit een adequate oplossing voor de situatie die was ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de opnamestop bij de daklozenopvang van het Leger de Heils in Amsterdam

An MP asked whether Amsterdam's cut in subsidy caused the admission stop at the Leger des Heils homeless shelter and what the consequences for neighbouring cities are. The state secretary replied that Amsterdam's budget actually rose and that Amsterdam's own taskforce, not the national government, is responsible for fixing the situation, so no national action was committed.
Amsterdam's executive board has taken its responsibility by freeing up funds to lift the admission stop and by setting up a taskforce.
Het college van B&W van de gemeente Amsterdam heeft zijn verantwoordelijkheid genomen door middelen vrij te maken om de instroomstop op te heffen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Dam over de gevolgen van de problemen bij het Sehos-ziekenhuis in Willemstad

MPs Van den Berg and Van Dam asked about the consequences of the Sehos hospital problems in Curaçao for Bonaire patients, including referrals, waiting lists, costs and the hospital's finances. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao is responsible for hospital care, that few Bonaire patients go to Sehos for non-urgent surgery, that reimbursement of travel costs applies, and that the financial supervisor monitors the situation.
Curaçao, as an autonomous country, is itself responsible for (hospital) care.
Curaçao is als autonoom land zelf verantwoordelijk voor de (ziekenhuis)zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Inspectie: Lentis-kliniek voldoet niet aan voorwaarden voor goede zorg’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an Inspectorate finding that the Lentis clinic failed to meet conditions for good care due to staff shortages, and about how risks to care continuity and safety are guaranteed and monitored. The State Secretary replied that providers are responsible for safe care, that the Inspectorate monitors this and will report on calamities linked to staff shortages in early 2020.
This year the IGJ will, for each closed calamity report in mental health care, examine whether staff shortages played a role in the patient's residential situation at the time of the calamity.

De IGJ zal dit jaar per afgesloten melding van een calamiteit in de ggz inventariseren of personeelstekorten een rol hebben gespeeld in de verblijfssituatie van de patiënt ten tijde van de calamiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over de gevolgen van lachgasgebruik voor het Klimaat

PvdA MPs asked whether recreational nitrous oxide use and its climate impact are known to users and how much it adds to emissions. The government answered that users are not aware of the climate effects, estimated the emissions as small relative to national totals, and said a risk assessment due in November will guide any health measures, while no specific climate policy is planned.
Pending the advice, the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport is examining various policy options so that appropriate national measures can be taken quickly once the assessment is final.

In afwachting van het advies worden door het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport diverse beleidsopties bekeken zodat wanneer de beoordeling definitief is, snel passende landelijke maatregelen kunnen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over miljoenentekorten bij de grootste zorginstelling van Nederland

An SP MP asked the state secretary about multi-million deficits at the Parnassia Groep, its high sick-leave rate, planned staff cuts and training limits, the high salary of its board chair, and its BV structure. The state secretary answered that the organisation is financially sound and that the IGJ and NZa monitor quality and finances, that the WNT salary exceeds the norm only under transitional rules and the CIBG is checking this, and that no governance investigation of the BV structure is warranted.
I have asked the CIBG, the independent supervisor of the WNT in the care sector, to investigate whether the transitional law at Parnassia has been applied correctly.
Ik heb het CIBG, de onafhankelijk toezichthouder op de WNT in de zorgsector, gevraagd te onderzoeken of het overgangsrecht bij Parnassia juist is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Overheid treedt niet op tegen illegale nicotinebom Juul'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that the Juul e-cigarette, which exceeds Dutch nicotine limits and is marketed to young people, is sold in the Netherlands without enforcement, and what would improve supervision. The State Secretary said such sales are unacceptable, that the NVWA is enforcing, several fines were issued and some shops stopped selling, and that supervision will continue.
The NVWA supervises and takes action against companies offering products on the Dutch market that do not meet the requirements.
De NVWA houdt toezicht en treedt op tegen de bedrijven die producten die niet aan de eisen voldoen, aanbieden op de Nederlandse markt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘RIVM: vaccinatiegraad gestabiliseerd, maar nog niet terug op ‘veilige’ 95 procent’

An MP asked the state secretary about falling childhood vaccination coverage, regional gaps, cross-border vaccination records, municipal measures, and a timeline to return to 95 percent. The secretary answered that it is too early to evaluate the measures, outlined municipal initiatives and a Nivel study, and said he aims for 95 percent as soon as possible without giving a firm date.
Besides the measures I have already taken, I want to clarify whether other options are possible and necessary, so that I can intensify them if needed.
Naast de maatregelen die ik al heb ingezet, wil ik helder krijgen of er nog andere opties mogelijk en noodzakelijk zijn, zodat ik zo nodig kan intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Graus over het bericht dat een zeer gevaarlijke reuzenteek aangetroffen is nabij Nederland

PVV MPs Agema and Graus asked the state secretary and ministers about reports of the dangerous Hyalomma tick near the Dutch border, its Crimean-Congo virus risk, public information, monitoring and vaccines. The minister answered at length that the risk to Nederland is currently very low, that monitoring and public information are being expanded, and that a separate tick hotline is of limited added value.
Because of the recent findings in Germany, the RIVM and the CMV will expand monitoring together with partners.
Vanwege de recente bevindingen in Duitsland gaan het RIVM en het CMV met partijen de monitoring uitbreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over mannen die vluchten voor huiselijk geweld en daardoor het contact met hun kinderen kwijtraken

An MP asked whether men fleeing domestic violence lose contact with their children because mothers decide on access, and about shelter numbers and the share of parents bringing children. The minister confirmed the reports, gave 2018 shelter figures without parent-child breakdown, said no data confirm a general pattern disadvantaging men, and promised to bring the issue to a new expert team.
I do not have information that can unconditionally confirm the picture described in the question.
Ik beschik niet over informatie die het beeld zoals verwoord in de vraag zonder meer kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Nieuwbouw bij De Boerderij in Reek van de baan, GGZ verplaatst autismezorg naar Huize Padua 'Dit is een ramp voor de bewoners’

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary about GGZ Oost-Brabant's decision to relocate autism care residents from De Boerderij in Reek to Huize Padua, questioning consultation, alternatives and the reasons for the move. The State Secretary acknowledged the impact, said the move is a considered decision by the care provider not expected soon, that the provider consulted residents and alternatives, and that he cannot intervene in such a decision.
Do you consider it acceptable that the residents of De Boerderij must move to Huize Padua, with all the consequences, purely for real estate reasons?
Vindt u het acceptabel dat de bewoners van De Boerderij moeten verhuizen naar Huize Padua, met alle gevolgen van dien, puur en alleen vanwege vastgoedoverwegingen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Kinder- en Jeugdartsen: Onbegrijpelijk dat ‘nepnieuws’ over homeopathische vaccinatie niet wordt aangepakt’

An MP asked why the health inspectorate (IGJ) is not acting against homeopathic alternatives to vaccination, about the limits of its enforcement powers, whether mandatory warning text on such products will be introduced, and the status of an expert task force. The State Secretary answers that the IGJ will act on misleading medical claims by providers and manufacturers, has limited powers against private individuals, rejects a mandatory warning text under current law, and reports that the expert group met in April with another meeting planned.
The IGJ will meet the Dutch Association for Paediatrics in July about its concerns regarding homeopathic prophylaxis as an alternative to vaccinations.
De IGJ gaat in juli in gesprek met de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Kindergeneeskunde over haar zorgen ten aanzien van homeopathische profylaxe als alternatief voor vaccinaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Özdil over het bericht ‘RIVM en CBS: psychische gezondheid jongeren achteruit in afgelopen tien jaar’

MPs Bruins and Özdil asked the ministers about a RIVM/CBS report showing declining mental health among young people, and about student stress, the leenstelsel link, waiting times for student psychologists and prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, announced a large-scale RIVM follow-up study expected by late 2020, and said the ministries will coordinate, while several questions on causes, waiting times and the leenstelsel link were answered only in outline.
I am aware of the results of the research.
Ik ben bekend met de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over het tegengaan van het gebruik van lachgas

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the state secretary about municipalities and festivals banning recreational nitrous oxide, its health and environmental harm, and whether national measures are needed after voluntary retailer agreements. The state secretary said he will consult VNG and municipalities, commissioned a new CAM risk assessment due late November, and will report on it, while stating he lacks data on how many municipalities have banned use.
I do not have such data.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van den Berg over de stijging van het aantal oxycodonverslaafden

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about the rising number of oxycodone addicts, the lack of a clear treatment approach, prescribing practices, and patient information. The Minister acknowledged the trend, cited rising NVIC overdose notifications, and described a task force working on a national approach, prescribing guidance and patient information, with a progress letter promised for the second half of 2019.
Unfortunately I cannot give you national figures on the number of users in addiction care because these are not available.
Landelijke cijfers van het aantal gebruikers in de verslavingszorg kan ik u helaas niet geven omdat deze niet voorhanden zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘De behandeldirecteur van de PI Vught die zwaar blunderde bij de overplaatsing van Michael P. is nu bestuurder van Fivoor’

Two CDA MPs asked whether it is acceptable that the prison treatment director criticised for errors in the transfer of Michael P. now leads the clinic Fivoor, and whether the government will act given local residents' distrust of the clinic in Den Dolder. The minister replied that the government does not steer individual appointments at private institutions but on quality and performance, that a broader culture change is being pursued, and that interim measures were agreed with residents, with the inspectorate monitoring the clinic.
Where these performances fall below standard, intervention is possible.
Daar waar deze prestaties onder de maat zijn kan worden ingegrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Helvert en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘RIVM scherpt vaccinatieadvies mazelen aan’

MPs Raemakers, Van Helvert and Sjoerdsma asked about RIVM's measles vaccination advice for infants travelling to high-risk countries and whether the Foreign Ministry should adjust its travel advice accordingly. The minister answered that the advice is updated annually based on WHO data, and that the Foreign Ministry defers health information to the national travel health centre (LCR) by linking to it rather than copying the measles guidance, while examining automatic integration.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel App.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Sjoerdsma over het aanpassen van reisadviezen naar aanleiding van de uitbraak van mazelen in een Haagse kinderopvang

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Affairs Minister why travel advice does not specifically warn of measles risk in Europe and whether it should be updated, as the GGD does. The minister replied that travel advice links directly to the LCR's current health information, which covers measles, and that the ministry is not the health authority and will not copy changing health advice into its advice.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel app.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het doorbreken van het medisch beroepsgeheim bij verdenking van een misdaad

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked whether staff at the Mondriaan clinic should have breached medical confidentiality when they suspected a patient was involved in a double murder, and for examples of when a breach is permitted. Staatssecretaris Blokhuis answered that breaching confidentiality requires a careful case-by-case weighing under the conflict-of-duties rules, declined to judge the case while the investigation is ongoing, and gave general examples.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Overheid hanteert te ruime gifnormen voor sigaretten, extra risico volksgezondheid'

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Health why the government's tobacco emission limits seem loosely applied, with lab tests suggesting about 40% of brands exceed limits, and questioned the ISO standards, their paywalled cost, and tobacco industry influence. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA must apply the prescribed ISO methods and tolerances, that only one violation has been found and fined, and that he is pursuing an alternative test method at EU level.
I am focusing on persuading other Member States and the European Commission to amend the prescribed measurement methods in the TPD.
Ik richt mij op het overtuigen van andere Lidstaten en de Europese Commissie om zo de voorgeschreven meetmethoden in de TPD aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het bericht dat er op basisschool de Stelaertshoeve in Tilburg door de GGD voorlichting wordt gegeven over de ramadan

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about GGD health education on Ramadan given at a Tilburg primary school, including its purpose, whether it is GGD policy, how widespread it is, and whether other religious practices get similar attention. The State Secretary answered that the GGD advises schools on request within the Healthy School approach, that the Ramadan advice was tailored to exam or CITO test periods and given to a school and some parents, and that no other religious-holiday requests have been received.
For the whole of the Netherlands this question cannot be answered. No registration takes place.
Voor geheel Nederland kan deze vraag niet beantwoord worden. Er vindt geen registratie plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het samengaan van VBOK en Siriz

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the State Secretary whether the merger of VBOK into Siriz, a counselling provider, would undermine the neutral and non-directive character of abortion choice counselling and whether funding should be reviewed. The State Secretary replied that the open house quality criteria, central training and independent expert review, together with IGJ supervision, adequately safeguard quality, and that he will monitor any new structure.
As I informed you earlier, the independent experts I will appoint will assess whether this has indeed happened as I have now agreed with the parties.
Zoals ik u eerder informeerde, zullen de onafhankelijk deskundigen die ik zal aanstellen gaan beoordelen of dit ook werkelijk is gebeurd zoals ik nu met partijen heb afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over gevaren van het gebruik van lachgas

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports of people falling ill from recreational nitrous oxide use, rising poisoning reports, frostbite risk, and whether the NVWA should enforce and national policy should be introduced. The state secretary acknowledged the rise in reports, requested a new risk assessment, said frostbite is caused by careless consumer use rather than the product so NVWA enforcement is not its role, and promised to consult municipalities and VNG on further measures.
Therefore I asked the Coordination Point for Assessment and Monitoring of New Drugs (CAM) last month to carry out a new risk assessment of nitrous oxide.
Daarom heb ik het Coördinatiepunt Assessment en Monitoring Nieuwe Drugs (CAM) eind vorige maand gevraagd een nieuwe risicobeoordeling van lachgas uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Bergkamp en Raemakers over het niet van de grond komen van projecten die over schotten heen werken

MPs Diertens, Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about the Nova Me care initiative that collapsed over funding divides between care domains, and about budgets and the Wlz experiment article. The minister answered that no funding is earmarked for the experiment article, that VGZ found the care not suitable, and declined to convene a dedicated meeting on lessons learned.
I have no insight into the amount of money that parties in daily practice invest in realising appropriate cross-domain care for clients.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid geld die er in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt geïnvesteerd door partijen om passend aanbod over domeinen heen voor cliënten te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over het bericht dat vaginaal douchen schade oplevert bij vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Moorlag asked whether vaginal douching products that claim health benefits, and that can cause harm, should be acted upon and whether more public information is needed. The minister says existing guidance already advises against douching, that the IGJ and NVWA have received almost no complaints, and that no further measures are currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to take further measures.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat het ministerie van VWS de grootste stijging aan communicatiemedewerkers van alle ministeries heeft

An MP asked the Minister of VWS about the growth in communications staff at the ministry, its costs, campaigns on healthcare, and whether staff are used for party-political election activities. The government answered that staff work on policy communication, the growth was driven by public engagement needs, and election-campaign use is ruled out, while providing figures and campaign overviews.
No. The communications staff of VWS work on communication about policy, not on election activities.
Antwoord 18 De communicatiemedewerkers van VWS werken aan communicatie over beleid, niet aan verkiezingsactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over een keurmerk voor voedsel

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether the government would adopt the Nutriscore food labelling system, citing a Consumentenbond survey of snacks. The Secretary of State said the government is still comparing European logos and running consumer research, will decide after summer and no later than end 2019, and gave no commitment to Nutriscore.
I expect to inform you after the summer, but no later than the end of 2019, about the outcomes of the studies and my decision on the new food choice logo.
Ik verwacht u na de zomer, maar uiterlijk eind 2019 te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken en mijn beslissing over het nieuwe voedselkeuzelogo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Antirookclub zet longartsen buiten de deur’

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the state secretary for Health about the reported split between the Alliantie Nederland Rookvrij and the Stichting Rookpreventie Jeugd, including subsidy questions and the rejected proposals for a smoking addiction fund and licensing system. The state secretary declined to comment on the internal decisions of the organisations and KWF, said the proposals were discussed in the National Prevention Agreement but lacked sufficient support, and did not answer the questions in substance.
I am not responsible for the subsidy policy of KWF Kankerbestrijding.
Ik ga niet over het subsidiebeleid van KWF Kankerbestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het rapport ‘Psychiaters in GGZ-instellingen: Arbeidsmarktonderzoek NVvP-LAD’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Health about a labour market report on psychiatrists in mental health institutions, concerning the attractiveness of employment versus self-employment, rising workload for employed psychiatrists, and government action. The State Secretary answered that employee and self-employed numbers are both rising, that self-employment is not inherently undesirable, that the government will work through the Hoofdlijnenakkoord ggz with partners and include the report's recommendations.
I will include the recommendations from this report in the elaboration of these agreements.
Ik zal de aanbevelingen uit dit rapport meenemen in de uitwerking van deze afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over eetstoornissen en social media

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether Instagram's promotion of eating disorders, as shown by a BBC investigation, also applies to Dutch youth, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary acknowledged the risk, described existing platform and government measures such as blocked hashtags and help pop-ups, said no specific agreements with Instagram exist beyond EU codes, and said the UK measures will be monitored.
I do not have specific figures for young people with an eating disorder.
Over specifieke cijfers voor jongeren met een eetstoornis beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Incidenten verwarde mensen heftiger’

MPs De Lange and Laan-Geselschap (VVD) asked the Justice and Health ministers about a report that incidents involving people with confused behaviour were becoming more severe and that police registrations had doubled. The minister answered that E33 registrations are not diagnoses, that the rise cannot yet be explained, and pointed to a person-centred approach, regional support teams, and planned information-sharing legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Ritalin is populair op het schoolplein. Kan dat kwaad?’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Education whether non-medical use of Ritalin among pupils and students is problematic, how such use is obtained and combated, and whether more research on effects on school performance is needed. The minister answered that non-medical use is illegal and unacceptable, that enforcement and public information efforts exist, that research on school-performance effects is limited, and that the government will examine further research needs.
I will examine in the coming period whether, and if so what, further scientific knowledge is needed.
Ik zal in de komende periode onderzoeken of en zo ja, aan welke wetenschappelijke kennis er nog meer behoefte is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het faillissement van PTSS-kliniek Psytrec

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of PTSD clinic Psytrec, its effect on waiting times and treatment continuity, and what steps would protect patients. The State Secretary reported that a takeover (doorstart) was possible, that staff would largely be offered contracts, and that the IGJ and NZa were monitoring care and patient information.
In the case of Psytrec, it has since become known that a takeover (doorstart) can take place.
In het geval van Psytrec is inmiddels bekend geworden dat er een doorstart kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat sigaretten kopen onder de achttien te makkelijk blijft

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about press reports that minors can still easily buy cigarettes, with a university study finding 49% compliance and asking whether independent compliance research should be commissioned. The state secretary acknowledged compliance should be 100%, cited NVWA enforcement data showing improvement on risk locations, and declined to commission additional independent tobacco compliance research because NVWA data is available.
Because I have access to the NVWA enforcement figures, I do not intend to commission additional compliance research on tobacco.
Omdat ik beschik over de handhavingscijfers van de NVWA ben ik niet voornemens extra nalevingsonderzoek op tabak in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber, Agnes Mulder, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Stress door gasellende in bevingsgebied neemt toe’

MPs asked the minister about reports that gas-extraction stress in the Groningen earthquake area is rising, the need for psychological care funding, and NAM liability for immaterial damage. The minister acknowledged the mental health problem, pointed to ending gas extraction, independent damage and reinforcement processes, regional support programmes, and said he will await the outcome of pending court proceedings on immaterial damage.
I am awaiting the outcome of the court proceedings.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van de gerechtelijke procedures af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het steeds ouder worden van mensen met een drugsverslaving en het toerusten van zorginstellingen hierop

Two D66 MPs asked the Health Minister about rising drug addiction among older people and whether municipalities, Wlz care institutions and prevention are adequately equipped. The minister gave prevalence figures showing rises among older users, said municipalities are responsible for quality, found no signals of insufficient expertise in elderly care, argued late-life prevention is largely ineffective, and offered to send an overview of research but saw no reason for special action.
We are willing to do so. At present, however, we see no reason to take special action on this.
Daartoe zijn wij bereid. Op dit moment zien wij echter geen aanleiding hierop bijzondere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Raan en Van Gerven over het bericht dat EU-voorzitter Roemenië zich laat sponsoren door Coca-Cola

MPs from PvdD and SP asked whether Coca-Cola's sponsorship of the Romanian EU presidency, and similar Dutch presidency sponsorships, create conflicts of interest and undermine the EU's health and sugar policy. The minister answered that sponsorship is a logistical matter for each presidency, that Coca-Cola's sponsorship is separate from EU negotiations on food rules, that no intervention was planned, and that the Dutch sponsorship policy will be considered for the 2029 presidency.
Sponsorships are a way to facilitate an EU presidency logistically.
Sponsorschappen zijn een manier om een EU-voorzitterschap logistiek te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het overmatig gebruik van cafeïnepillen

An MP from the CDA asked the government about excessive use of caffeine pills after a broadcast, including rising poisoning cases, cheap bulk sales without warnings, varying actual caffeine content, and whether limits and warnings should apply. The minister answered that caffeine pills are sold as food supplements under existing labelling rules, that the NVWA lacks data on actual content per pill, and that caffeine will be proposed for inclusion in the EU annex to Regulation 1925/2006 to allow EU-level limits.

Given the possible health risks of using caffeine pills, I want to have caffeine included in the annex to Regulation (EC) No 1925/2006, so that limits such as a maximum quantity of caffeine pills can be set at EU level.
Gezien de mogelijke gezondheidsrisico´s van het gebruik van cafeïnepillen wil ik cafeïne in de bijlage van de Verordening (EG) Nr. 1925/2006 op laten nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het testen van pillen op festivals levens redt

Ms Bergkamp (D66) asked whether a UK study showing drug testing at festivals saves lives should lead to festival testing in the Netherlands. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that the Netherlands already has the DIMS monitoring and testing network with about 30 locations, that festival testing raises legal, practical, technical and financial problems and would send the wrong signal under the zero-tolerance policy, and that more test locations are expected.
In the Netherlands drugs can be tested, namely through the Drugs Information and Monitoring System (DIMS).
In Nederland kunnen drugs wel getest worden, namelijk via het Drugs Informatie en Monitoring Systeem (DIMS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over gebrekkige toegang tot ggz

MP Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Health about long mental health waiting times, misleading information on the Kiezen in de ggz website, crisis-care admissions caused by delayed treatment, and patients being referred back and forth, and whether the shortage of supply explains the 88,500 people on waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that the website reflects retrospective waits and that the NZa monitors providers, that crisis admissions cannot be attributed to delayed care, that patients can contact insurers and the NZa, and that a workforce and waiting-time action plan with progress reports to parliament is in progress.
I have no insight into the percentage that ends up there because they did not receive the right care in time.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het percentage dat daar terecht komt doordat zij niet tijdig de juiste zorg hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Dimence werkt met Skype-psychiater in India: geniaal of gek?’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about Dimence using a psychiatrist in India to treat Dutch patients via Skype, questioning its safety, quality and whether it is a substitute for in-person care. The State Secretary said e-health can help reduce waiting times, that providers are responsible for quality under the Wkkgz, that patients should have choice, and that the Inspectorate and regulations (including the rule on in-person contact before prescribing) govern such care, without committing to a new concrete step.
Ultimately the care provider is responsible for the quality of care, and the provider is also best placed to determine whether video calling is in certain cases a suitable or even better alternative.
Uiteindelijk is de zorgaanbieder verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de zorg, de aanbieder kan ook het beste bepalen of beeldbellen in bepaalde gevallen een passend of zelfs beter alternatief is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Overheid stimuleert roken: ondernemers kunnen sigaretten aftrekken van belasting’

An SP MP asked whether business owners being able to deduct tobacco costs from tax, and the government's preventive stance on smoking, are consistent, and about the economic case for a smoke-free society. The government answered that tax law is in principle value-neutral, that tobacco costs for owners are non-deductible or limited as mixed costs, that no data exist on how often tobacco deductions are claimed, and that the existing tax rules can coexist with prevention policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Jacques werd 2 jaar lang opgesloten om te 'genezen' van zijn homoseksualiteit’

MP Bergkamp asked whether exposing people to conversion therapy to remove homosexual feelings violates current law, whether the IGJ can supervise such providers, and whether a ban for minors is advisable. Minister Bruins answered that homosexuality is not an illness so healthcare cannot aim at curing it, that IGJ does not supervise non-medical therapies but can refer abuse to the Public Prosecution Service, and that he has no data on the scale of the practice.
IGJ therefore does not exercise supervision in situations of this kind.
IGJ houdt op dit soort situaties dan ook geen toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Gat in wet GGZ zorg Grensgangers’

An SP MP asks whether children of cross-border workers, who since decentralisation cannot receive Dutch youth mental health care, have a workable alternative given language barriers in Germany. The minister acknowledges the parents' concern but states that living abroad is a free choice and that compensating its disadvantages through new legislation is undesirable.
Compensating all these disadvantages by the Dutch State through new legislation is undesirable.
Het compenseren van al deze nadelen door de Nederlandse Staat in nieuwe wetgeving is onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Renkema over het rapport ‘Last Gasp: The coal companies making Europe sick’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about a report attributing 231 premature deaths in Europe to emissions from Dutch coal plants, and asked whether the two oldest plants should close by 2020, whether the Clean Air Accord covers this, whether Germany's RWE should be pressed, and whether RIVM should study health effects further. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to a planned legal ban on coal for electricity by 2029 (2024 for the oldest plants), said the Clean Air Accord considers power-sector emissions, reported intensified dialogue with Germany, and declined extra RIVM research.
The cabinet aims for a permanent improvement of air quality, so as to reduce health risks from air pollution.
Het kabinet streeft naar een permanente verbetering van de luchtkwaliteit, om zo te komen tot een vermindering van gezondheidsrisico's door luchtverontreiniging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het nieuwsbericht ‘Herstel van gebroken been is te meten, maar geldt dat ook voor een depressie?’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a news report on measuring outcomes in mental health care, the drop in clinics supplying quality data (230 to 75), and how the Akwa quality alliance will restore data sharing. The State Secretary said quality data sharing is voluntary, that Akwa expects an indicator set in autumn, and that he will encourage providers to share data while the Dutch Data Protection Authority's position is pending.
I think it is important that the mental health sector works on making quality transparent.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de ggz-sector werkt aan het inzichtelijk maken van kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Herstel van gebroken been is te meten, maar geldt dat ook voor een depressie?’

An MP asked the state secretary for health about a Nieuwsuur report on mental health care quality measurement, including the Data Protection Authority's delayed ruling on a complaint about a GGZ benchmark database and Menzis's ROM-based pilot with Volante. The state secretary said the AP must give its own judgment and he cannot set a deadline, that patient consent should be obtained in the meantime, and that quality measurement method choice is for the sector, supporting the AKWA approach.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) to give a considered judgment.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) om een gewogen oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over het bericht dat alleen een radicaal ander dieet in 2050 alle monden kan voeden

D66 MPs asked whether the EAT-Lancet report on a radically different diet for 2050 warrants changes to health and food policy, how it compares with the Preventieakkoord and the Schijf van Vijf, and how it fits agriculture and climate goals. The government replies that the report supports current healthy-eating policy, that the Schijf van Vijf broadly matches EAT-Lancet, and that it will rely on existing climate and circular-agriculture plans without new binding measures.
No, this report supports the policy on healthy nutrition, and the impetus indicated together with the National Prevention Agreement.
Nee, dit rapport ondersteunt het beleid op het gebied van gezonde voeding, en de impuls die daar mede met het Nationaal Preventieakkoord aangegeven wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Undercover in de wereld van het nieuwe roken’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a report on Philip Morris staff promoting the IQOS heated-tobacco device in tobacco shops, whether this promotion is illegal, and when the amended Tobacco Act with health warnings will be sent to parliament. The State Secretary said explaining tobacco products is not prohibited, that advertising will be restricted from 2021 under the prevention agreement, and that the bill will be introduced as soon as possible.
Explaining a (tobacco) product is not prohibited.
Het uitleg geven over een (tabaks)product is niet verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het eigen voedselkeuzelogo van Coca-Cola

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health why Coca-Cola is introducing its own food-choice logo on Dutch products and how this fits the planned government-backed, independently researched logo. The State Secretary regrets the company-specific logo, says a single shared logo under the Prevention Accord is needed, and promises a meeting with Coca-Cola.
I will shortly meet with Coca-Cola to share my position, as set out in this reply, with them.
Ik ga binnenkort in gesprek met Coca-Cola om mijn standpunt zoals ook in deze beantwoording verwoord met hen te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de presentatie van het RIVM over het Rijksvaccinatieprogramma van de toekomst

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a RIVM presentation on the future National Vaccination Programme, including whether parents can refuse consent for sharing vaccination data with RIVM and whether strict GDPR application would reduce insight into vaccination coverage. The State Secretary confirmed that consent is required, that data is needed to calculate coverage, and that the government will explain the value of central registration and monitor refusal rates.
RIVM will monitor what proportion of parents do not consent to sharing vaccination data.
Het RIVM zal monitoren welk deel van de ouders geen toestemming geeft voor het delen van de vaccinatiegegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht Moordenaar Romy (14) twee keer eerder verdachte: 'Haar dood kon voorkomen worden'

An MP from the CDA asked whether treating clinicians should have informed the school about a 14-year-old who was later convicted of killing a girl, and whether an independent body rather than the institution itself should investigate. The minister replied that the inspectorates found no shortcomings, that the clinicians' confidentiality duty was properly applied on the information available at the time, and that the institutions and inspectorates investigated the case, with the inspectorates judging that self-investigation is preferable except in closed-setting deaths.
The inspectorates are of the opinion that the professional considerations made were in line with the applicable standards and traceable.
De inspecties zijn van oordeel dat de professionele afwegingen die zijn gemaakt, conform de geldende standaarden waren en navolgbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de verwoestende effecten van GHB-gebruik

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about GHB addiction, relapse rates, waiting lists and driving under the influence. The state secretary acknowledged serious harms but said evidence on hidden scale was lacking, promised a fuller overview to parliament in early 2019, and pointed to a pilot in Twenterand with a guidance document expected in 2019.
I will ask the addiction care institutions to make the waiting list data at substance level transparent.
Ik zal de verslavingszorginstellingen verzoeken de wachtlijstgegevens op middelniveau inzichtelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Ellemeet over de problematiek rondom (chronische) Lyme

MPs Renkema and Ellemeet asked the minister about Lyme disease: patient concerns, prevention, recognition and diagnosis, co-infections, treatment of chronic patients, and whether the Health Council should be asked for new advice. The minister answers that research and patient involvement are ongoing, that prevention and GP training exist, and that a new Health Council advice will await results of the NLe research expected in a few years.
On the basis of the outcomes I want to formulate a new request for advice.
Op basis van de uitkomsten wil ik een nieuwe adviesvraag formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Rog over de maatschappelijke diensttijd en de status van het diplomasupplement na het vervullen hiervan

CDA MPs Slootweg and Rog asked the State Secretary for Health about the preference a diploma supplement might give youths who completed the civic service in government hiring, the use of certificates, and the involvement of education and defence in pilots. The State Secretary answered that the award form is still being designed, that diversity must be preserved, and that a certificate and a more compulsory variant will be explored in pilots.
I consider it too early at this time to indicate how this recognition can be given a good form by the government from an employer's perspective.
Ik vind het op dit moment te vroeg om aan te geven hoe deze waardering een goede invulling kan krijgen door de overheid vanuit het werkgeversperspectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Nederlandse wachtlijst geestelijke hulp telt in totaal 88.500 mensen’

MP De Lange asked the State Secretary for Health about a report that 88,500 people are on mental health waiting lists, the rising waiting times, and why many GGZ providers have not delivered waiting-time data to Vektis. The State Secretary answered that the figure is indicative, that waiting times remain a priority, that the NZa is pursuing enforcement and reminders, and that no provider names were published, while declining to set a new deadline for meeting the Treek norms.
I am not in favour of setting a new deadline, because it is difficult to set a deadline that is both motivating and sufficiently realistic.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het stellen van een nieuwe deadline, omdat het lastig is een deadline te bepalen die zowel stimulerend als voldoende realistisch is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘GGZ Nederland: nieuwe bekostiging acute ggz in 2020’

An MP asked why the new funding model for acute mental health care was postponed to 2020 and what interpretation differences caused this, and what the consequences would be. The State Secretary regretted the delay, explained that the generic module's ambiguities surfaced during contract negotiations, and said the parties agreed on extra capacity and on assessing personnel and budget impacts by 1 June 2019.
After all, it has been agreed that contracting will take place in the spirit of the generic module.
Afgesproken is immers dat in de geest van de generieke module zal worden gecontracteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Zorgen om homeopathisch alternatief voor vaccineren’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports of homeopathic practitioners promoting homeopathy as a vaccination alternative, the Advertising Code Committee's complaints, and whether the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) can enforce against misleading claims. The State Secretary said such claims are unacceptable, outlined the IGJ's existing enforcement powers (fines, orders, penalty payments), and announced a expert team to rebut misleading vaccine information and talks with the IGJ on whether it needs more tools.
As I indicated in my letter of 19 November 2018, I will talk with the IGJ to see whether it needs more tools to address incorrect information about vaccination.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 19 november 2018 heb aangegeven ga ik met de IGJ in gesprek om te bezien of zij meer handvatten nodig hebben om onjuiste informatie over vaccineren aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over de berichtgeving waarin kinderartsen oproepen op te treden tegen een homeopathisch alternatief voor vaccineren

An MP asked the state secretary about media reports of paediatricians urging action against homeopathic alternatives to vaccination, the reliance on misinformation from sites like NVKP, labelling rules, and whether the IGJ has enough enforcement tools.
