The state secretary said he shares the concern, pointed to new RIVM information, JGZ consultation time, an expert team to rebut misconceptions, labelling rules already banning unproven claims, and that he will consult the IGJ on whether it needs more tools.
As I indicated in my letter of 19 November 2018, I will consult with the IGJ on whether it needs more tools to address incorrect information about vaccination.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 19 november 2018 heb aangegeven ga ik met de IGJ overleggen of zij meer handvatten nodig heeft om onjuiste informatie over vaccineren aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat volgens experts een halvering van het aantal tabaksdoden mogelijk is

An MP asked the state secretary for health about reports that halving tobacco deaths may be possible via e-cigarettes, and whether e-cigarettes are less harmful and should be accessible to smokers. The state secretary answered that e-cigarettes are less unhealthy for individuals only if smokers fully switch, that long-term effects and population-level effects are unknown, and that proven quit-smoking methods (coaching plus nicotine replacement) are the most effective, with e-cigarettes not the first choice but not to be discouraged in specific cases.
Whether the e-cigarette leads to a net decline in the number of smokers at population level is unknown.
Of de e-sigaret op populatieniveau leidt tot een netto-daling van het aantal rokers is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verkoop van alcohol aan minderjarigen

MP Van Gerven asks how online alcohol sales to minors by bol.com, Albert Heijn and Gall&Gall can be controlled, who is responsible, what penalties apply, and how the NVWA supervises online sales. The state secretary answers that enforcement lies with municipalities, that suppliers are responsible under the DHW with fines up to €2,720, that enforcement is practically hard, and that a legal amendment is being explored.
I am therefore exploring an amendment to the DHW to improve compliance with the age limit for sales via home-delivery channels and to make effective supervision possible.

Daarom ben ik bezig met het verkennen van een wetswijziging van de DHW om de naleving van de leeftijdsgrens bij verkoop via thuisbezorgkanalen te verbeteren en effectief toezicht hierop mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over de uitzending van Radar over online kindermarketing

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about online child marketing of unhealthy food shown on Radar, including influencer reach, YouTube disclosure rules and the Jongeren Op Gezond Gewicht programme. The government acknowledged the concern, said it will annually monitor compliance with the food advertising code including social media, and will discuss the results with industry and the Alliantie Stop Kindermarketing.
I will conduct annual research into compliance with these agreements and will explicitly include the influence of social media in it.
Ik zal jaarlijks onderzoek doen naar de naleving van deze afspraken en zal de invloed van sociale media hierin nadrukkelijk meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Kuik over handhaving van het rookbeleid op festivals door de NVWA

MPs Bruins Slot and Kuik asked the State Secretary about NVWA enforcement of the smoking ban at festivals, including fines for big versus small volunteer-run events and whether volunteers should be expected to remove smokers. The State Secretary reported 60 fines and 2 warnings from 111 controls, said the organiser bears the duty to enforce the ban, and announced a meeting with festival organisers to share experiences and consider support.
The NVWA cannot distinguish small from large festivals in its analysis of the data from all inspected festivals.
De NVWA kan in de analyse van de data van alle gecontroleerde festivals geen onderscheid maken in kleine en grote festivals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Rijk wist in 2016 al van meningokok-gevaar'

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government knew of a rising meningococcal W threat as early as 2016, why vaccination decisions came only a year later, what risk analyses and decision frameworks apply, and whether enough vaccine supply is secured. The state secretary answered that the rise was initially small and unpredictable, that measures followed in 2017 as the increase continued, that advice from RIVM was consistent, and that vaccine supply is contracted for the planned campaign.
On 25 September 2017 the House was informed about the increase in meningococcal W and the measures taken.
Op 25 september 2017 is de Kamer geïnformeerd over de toename van meningokokken W en de maatregelen die zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de snelheid van reageren op een levensgevaarlijke uitbraak van een infectieziekte

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health why the government reacted slowly to a possible meningococcal W outbreak, including the RIVM's handling of manufacturer signals, the advisory timelines and the procurement rules for vaccines. The State Secretary answered each question in substance, describing RIVM procedures, the OMT/BAO crisis route, the Health Council's standing advice timetable and the limits of the procurement shortcut, while stating that the Health Council is independent.
On 19 December 2017 I requested advice from the Health Council on meningococcal vaccination.
Ik heb op 19 december 2017 advies gevraagd aan de Gezondheidsraad over meningokokkenvaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de berichtgeving dat de overheid in 2016 al wist van mogelijke uitbraak meningokokkenziekte

MP Van Gerven asked why the government waited a year after signs in autumn 2016 to purchase meningococcal vaccines, and about deaths, costs, supplier dependence, RIVM independence and lessons learned. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that a combination of epidemiological trends, severity of the disease and limited vaccine supply drove the decision, that the Mexican flu evaluation did not change the process, and that the vaccination programme is still ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de berichtgeving dat de gezondheid van modellen in de mode-industrie ondanks beloftes nog steeds ver onder de maat is

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Health about reports that models in the fashion industry remain pressured to be unhealthily thin despite pledges, and about evaluation of the 2016 convenant. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to The Model's Health Pledge with 55 signatories as the chosen approach, and said he will evaluate it at the end of 2019 rather than pursue French-style legislation for now.
I intend to evaluate this approach at the end of 2019 and on that basis assess, where possible, whether it offers sufficient protection to models.
Ik ben voornemens deze aanpak eind 2019 te evalueren en op basis daarvan zo mogelijk te beoordelen of deze voldoende bescherming biedt aan modellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht dat de pro-life beweging Siriz geen objectieve informatie geeft aan zwangere vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked whether the government shares concerns that counselling organisation Siriz, funded for unwanted-pregnancy support, steered women with leading chat questions and whether subsidies should change. The State Secretary answered that new quality criteria and an open-house funding model will apply from 2019, that organisations may hold their values but must not steer the woman's choice, and that the matter will be discussed with the parties.
For me it is important that all choice-support conversations must meet the same quality standards.
Voor mij is het daarbij belangrijk dat alle keuzehulpgesprekken moeten voldoen aan dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over informatiereizen in de zorg

An SP MP asked why the ministry commissioned a handbook on 'information journeys' in healthcare using personas, questioning whether it insults care workers and why it uses jargon like 'klant'. The minister answered that it aims to keep information provision patient-centred, that the wording is not objectionable, and that the handbook cost EUR 7,529.
Het realiseren van de handreiking heeft € 7.529 euro gekost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Gerven over het bericht dat een school een blaastest invoert voor dronken leerlingen

Two SP MPs asked the government about a school introducing voluntary breath tests for intoxicated pupils and about alcohol use among minors at school and local events. The state secretary said the school's voluntary test is its own choice, enforcement of the age limit lies with municipalities, and prevention and a national prevention accord are being pursued.
Supervision and enforcement of the 18-year age limit for alcohol sales is assigned to municipalities.
Het toezicht en de handhaving van de leeftijdsgrens van 18 jaar bij de verkoop van alcohol is belegd bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het tragische verhaal van S.Z.

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health whether the Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth (IGJ) would investigate the death of a young woman, S.Z., and the role of GGZ Altrecht, and what lessons could be drawn. The state secretary replied that two investigations are underway, with IGJ reviewing both and possibly launching further inquiry, but declined to discuss individual cases in parliament.
At the same time, I want to be careful about discussing individual cases in your House.
Tegelijkertijd wil ik er voor waken om individuele casuïstiek in uw Kamer te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het Health Behaviour in School-aged Children-onderzoek; het rapport over het welzijn en de gezondheid van Nederlandse jongeren (11-16 jaar)

An MP asked the state secretary about the decline in condom use among young people and the HBSC report on youth health, including falling sexual health knowledge and the end of the Vrij Veilig campaigns. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to schools, a seven-point plan and a planned campaign on contraceptive use, but did not commit to reinstating the Vrij Veilig campaign.
Furthermore, I want to inform various target groups through a campaign about conscious contraceptive use.
Daarnaast wil ik door middel van een campagne diverse doelgroepen gaan informeren over bewust anticonceptiegebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Bij ggz-patiënten klopt de diagnose vaak niet (meer)’

An MP asks the state secretary for health about reports that many psychiatric patients may have wrong diagnoses, following GGNet's re-diagnosis practice, and whether re-diagnosis should be standard and included in agreements. The state secretary welcomes GGNet's initiative, says no national figures exist, notes responsibility for diagnosis lies with providers, and promises the topic will be raised in a working group on triage and diagnostics.
I believe that re-diagnosing people with long-term psychological problems should be included in that, and I will also discuss this with the parties.
Ik vind dat het opnieuw diagnosticeren van mensen met langdurige psychische problematiek daarin moet worden meegenomen, en zal dit ook met de partijen bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de gemeente Bergen op Zoom intensieve contacten onderhoudt met tabaksfabrikant Philip Morris

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health whether the municipality of Bergen op Zoom's contacts with Philip Morris (lobbying, job-finding for vacant premises, alleged covert advertising) conflict with the government's WHO Framework Convention guidance on tobacco industry contacts, and who checks municipal compliance. The state secretary answered that the guidance still applies, that the municipality explained its contacts as job-retention efforts, that it published contact documents, and that municipalities are responsible for their own compliance, with a new letter to municipalities planned.
The municipal council can check how the mayor and aldermen handle this.
De Gemeenteraad kan controleren hoe het College van burgemeester en wethouders hiermee omgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Renkema over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar Menzis de behandeling van depressies voortaan vergoedt op basis van de resultaten

MPs Ellemeet and Renkema asked whether Menzis paying for depression treatment partly on outcomes risks undertreatment, patient selection and administrative burden, and whether the government would discourage it. The state secretary supports outcome-based payment in principle, says the patient group is limited to milder cases with no 'no cure, no pay', and rejects discouraging the contracts, while noting ROM measurement debates and promising monitoring with patient organisations.
I therefore do not intend to discourage this type of agreement.
Ik ben daarom niet van plan om dit type afspraken te ontmoedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij de stijging van het aantal zelfmoorden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the sharp rise in youth suicides, possible causes, suicide powders, school prevention, and the Netflix series 13 Reasons Why. The government said it has no explanation yet, is convening stakeholders, will receive a CBS microdata analysis in September, and is exploring regulation of substances used for suicide.
Based on the currently available information, I have no explanation for this increase.
Ik heb op basis van de huidige informatie die beschikbaar is, geen verklaring voor deze toename.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat tabaksfabrikanten festivaljongeren voor zich blijven winnen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the food and consumer authority NVWA, aware of alleged tobacco sponsorship breaches at festivals, would enforce, and whether sales of cigarettes at youth-oriented festivals should be banned. The State Secretary replied that NVWA is investigating festival sponsorship and will prioritise enforcement, that a sales ban is not on the table but voluntary abstention by the sector will be explored, and that event sponsorship is already prohibited under the Tobacco Act.
At present the NVWA is investigating advertising and sponsorship at festivals.
Op dit moment doet de NVWA onderzoek naar reclame en sponsoring op festivals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over het bericht dat organisaties en artsen vinden dat de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) de sjoemelsigaret uit de handel moet nemen

An MP asked the state secretary whether the NVWA should remove the so-called 'sjoemelsigaret' (cigarettes with understated TNCO values) from the market, and asked about consumer information, labelling, enforcement and compensation for NGOs. The state secretary answered that the EU Tobacco Products Directive governs ingredient disclosure via the RIVM database, that the NVWA supervises TNCO limits with few violations found, and that no additional enforcement or compensation is planned.
It is up to the NVWA to assess whether a violation is being committed regarding the TNCO maximum values in the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act.
Het is aan de NVWA om te beoordelen of een overtreding wordt begaan met betrekking tot de maximumwaarden voor TNCO in de Tabaks- en rookwarenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het teruglopend aantal vrouwen dat deelneemt aan het bevolkingsonderzoek baarmoederhalskanker

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary why participation in the cervical cancer screening programme has fallen and which subgroups are missed. The state secretary answered that participation is monitored, an evaluation is planned for 2019, and lessons from other countries are limited.
In 2019 an evaluation will be carried out focusing in particular on participation by the different groups.
In 2019 wordt een evaluatie uitgevoerd die zich met name gaat richten op de deelname door de verschillende groepen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de dalende deelname van vrouwen aan baarmoederhalskankerscreening

The SP MP Van Gerven asks the state secretary about falling participation in cervical cancer screening, the estimated lives saved by full participation, and whether the RIVM's neutral information is appropriate. The state secretary attributes the drop partly to rollout effects, stresses women's free informed choice, promises a 2019 evaluation and study into barriers, and declines to extend the deductible waiver.
However, I consider it paramount that women make a well-considered choice about whether to participate in the population screening based on good information.
Ik vind echter voorop staan dat vrouwen op basis van goede informatie een weloverwogen keuze maken over het al dan niet deelnemen aan het bevolkingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘De innige samenwerking tussen douane en tabaksindustrie’

An MP asked whether contacts between Customs and the tobacco industry, including joint discussion of smuggling detection methods, minutes kept by industry representatives, and possible hospitality at multi-day 'intelligence days', were acceptable, and why a 2011 memorandum and press release were removed from the government website. The State Secretary answered that contacts are limited to implementation matters under the 2015 protocol, that minutes will now be kept and published by Customs, that no signs of hospitality have been found, and that the removal followed the government's two-year archiving rule with the material still available in the web archive.
I have asked Customs to also always take responsibility for keeping minutes in future and to actively make them public.
Ik heb de Douane gevraagd om in de toekomst ook altijd zelf zorg te dragen voor verslaglegging en dat actief openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht 'Nergens in Europa wordt meer xtc geslikt dan in Nederland'

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Health about EMCDDA figures showing the Netherlands has the highest ecstasy and amphetamine use in Europe, and about related drug lab, drug death and health-effects reports. The State Secretary acknowledges concern, cites Trimbos explanations and prevention measures, and says some questions are still under study.
I will continue to step up prevention efforts.
Ik zal doorgaan met het extra inzetten op preventie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de overlast ten gevolge van lachgas

Labour MP Ploumen asked the ministers about nitrous oxide (lachgas) nuisance, including the status of voluntary sales restrictions, prevention materials, possible repressive measures, municipal powers and reported nuisance. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that voluntary measures are being agreed with retailers, Trimbos is developing prevention materials, monitoring continues and further measures will be considered if voluntary steps fail.
If it turns out that the voluntary restrictive measures and additional prevention efforts do not have the desired effect, I will consider possible additional measures.
Wanneer blijkt dat de vrijwillige beperkende maatregelen en extra inzet op preventie niet het gewenste effect heeft, zal ik mij beraden op mogelijke extra maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Minder gevallen baarmoederhalskanker voorkomen door afname vaccinaties’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that falling vaccination rates, including HPV vaccination, will prevent fewer cases of cervical cancer, and asked what measures are planned. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, opposed mandatory vaccination, pointed to existing measures and a forthcoming plan of action, and promised further information in autumn.
As I have already promised, I will inform the House in the autumn about my plan of action regarding the declining vaccination rate.
Zoals ik reeds heb toegezegd, zal ik de Tweede Kamer in het najaar informeren over mijn plan van aanpak ten aanzien van de dalende vaccinatiegraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over regeldruk voor kleine evenementen en festivals zoals de Lauwersland Fietsvierdaagse

CDA MPs asked the government about red tape for small events and festivals, including the Lauwersland Fietsvierdaagse needing municipal permits, cost burdens, temporary structure rules, event classification and safety handbooks. The minister answered that the rules are municipal, that the cycling event goes ahead in 2018, and that the government and VNG will keep monitoring, without committing to new national rules.
I endorse the social importance of volunteer organisations and associations, such as Oranje, scouting, carnival, sports and other associations.
Ik onderschrijf het maatschappelijk belang van vrijwilligersorganisaties en verenigingen, zoals Oranje-, scouting-, carnavals-, sport- en andere verenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Maak vaccineren verplicht’

MPs asked whether mandatory childhood vaccination should apply in daycare centres, how other EU countries handle it, and whether parents can learn daycare vaccination rates. The government opposes mandatory vaccination in daycare (limited effect, constitutional objections) and says a rate-disclosure obligation has little benefit and lacks support, promising a plan of action in autumn.
I am not in favour of making vaccination mandatory for children at daycare centres.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het verplicht stellen van vaccinatie voor kinderen op kinderdagverblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de snel oprukkende dodelijke bacterie Meningokokken W

The MP Kuik asked the State Secretary for Health about the rise of the deadly meningococcal W bacterium, the vaccine shortage, the timing of the vaccination programme and whether the advisory process is fast enough. The State Secretary answered that the rise is not clearly explained, that the government followed expert advice to vaccinate infants and 14-year-olds, and that vaccine supply and advisory timelines constrain faster action.
I have asked the Health Council whether vaccination against other meningococcal types should also be given and whether other age groups may also be eligible.
Aan de Gezondheidsraad heb ik gevraagd of ook tegen andere typen meningokokken gevaccineerd moet worden en of wellicht ook andere leeftijdsgroepen daarvoor in aanmerking komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Dodelijke bacterie rukt op in Nederland’

MPs Diertens and Pia Dijkstra asked about the meningococcal vaccine shortage after the national programme was changed, the later vaccination of 14-year-olds, and why scarce vaccines were kept for travellers. The state secretary explained the tender shortfall, said the risk remains very small, and that free-market travel vaccines are outside government control.
Therefore, from 1 May 2018 children aged 14 months will be vaccinated, and teenagers born between 1 May 2004 and 31 December 2004 from 1 October 2018.
Daarom worden vanaf 1 mei 2018 kinderen van 14 maanden gevaccineerd en tieners geboren tussen 1 mei 2004 en 31 december 2004 vanaf 1 oktober 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en De Lange over veiligheidshuizen en het delen van informatie tussen de ketenpartners

Two VVD MPs asked whether safety houses (veiligheidshuizen) lack a legal basis to share information needed for decisions on compulsory care, whether they will create one, and how medical confidentiality and the GDPR affect information sharing. The minister and state secretary answered that partners rely on their own legal bases, the Wvggz from 2020 provides sharing grounds, a bill on joint data processing is coming, and existing guidance and conflict-of-duties rules apply.
Soon the bill on data processing by cooperative partnerships will go into consultation.
Binnenkort gaat het wetsvoorstel gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden in consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat er ernstige fouten zijn gemaakt bij darmkankeronderzoeken

MP Ploumen asked the state secretary about reports that serious errors occurred in the bowel cancer screening, where 604 participants never received results. The state secretary acknowledged the failure, said affected people were contacted personally, and said the IT system has been fixed and other screening programmes checked.
I regret that due to this combination of circumstances this group of 604 participants received no feedback.
Ik betreur het dat door deze samenloop van omstandigheden deze groep van 604 deelnemers geen terugkoppeling heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Populaire games overtreden gokregels’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether loot boxes in popular games breach gambling rules, and about youth gaming and gambling addiction risks. The government answered that non-tradable loot box items fall outside the Wok, that the Ksa will act against tradable ones, and pointed to awareness campaigns and data on addiction care.
It is not known how many other games use loot boxes.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel andere spellen gebruikmaken van loot boxes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moorlag over ongezonde voedingsproducten

MP Moorlag asked the State Secretary whether it is harmful that less than a third of large food companies' products are healthy by the Access to Nutrition Index standards, and whether the government will push companies to speed up healthier product ranges. The State Secretary agreed the situation is regrettable, said companies share responsibility, and promised more attention to better food supply in the upcoming prevention accord, with further information in autumn.
Yes, see answer to question 3. All parties, including the food industry, will have to put their shoulders to the wheel to improve the food supply.
Ja, zie antwoord op vraag 3. Alle partijen, ook de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, zullen er de schouders onder moeten zetten om het voedingsaanbod te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat er geen extra geld beschikbaar is voor de ambulantisering van de ggz

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether insurers misused a 300 million euro mental health budget surplus, why community mental health care is underfunded, and how oversight of insurers can be improved. The State Secretary denied that funds were transferred to 2018, explained that insurers may lower premiums through efficiency, and announced NZa checks while committing to further talks with stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Statement Transvisie: Zorg voor transgender kinderen komt veel te laat'

An MP asked the Minister whether waiting times of up to 62 weeks in transgender care, especially for children and adolescents, are acceptable, and what action will be taken to reduce them. The Minister acknowledged the waits are too long, pointed to a quality standard due this year, expert-centre expansion talks, and stated that municipalities and insurers are responsible for their own provision, while the Minister does not hold data on municipal caps.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Help verstandelijk gehandicapten gezonder te leven’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a blog reporting worse health and substance use among people with intellectual disabilities, and about prevention efforts and the role of the VGN in the National Prevention Agreement. The State Secretary answered that data are scarce but risk of problematic use is higher, pointed to existing programmes such as Open en Alert and ZonMw research, and explained the VGN's current role in the agreement process.
According to Van der Nagel there are no hard figures on alcohol and drug use among people with mild intellectual disabilities, and the estimates vary widely.
Volgens Van der Nagel zijn er geen harde cijfers over alcohol- en drugsgebruik bij mensen met LVB en de schattingen lopen zeer uiteen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de komst van een zelfmoordmachine naar de uitvaartbeurs in Amsterdam

Three MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a suicide machine (euthanasia demonstration) was shown at an open funeral fair in Amsterdam, and what the government would do about it and about suicide prevention investment. The Staatssecretaris called such a demonstration highly undesirable, said the government has no legal power to ban it, and promised to inform the House this spring on suicide prevention funding.
I have no legal powers to prohibit such demonstrations, the aim of which is to stimulate discussion.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om te verbieden dat dergelijke demonstraties plaatsvinden, waarvan het doel is de discussie aan te jagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat ggz instelling Parnassia Groep ROM gegevens deelt met Stichting Benchmark GGZ.

An MP asked the State Secretary about Parnassia Group sharing routine outcome monitoring (ROM) data with Stichting Benchmark GGZ without patient consent, and whether this required action against the provider, other providers, or insurers. The State Secretary answered that it is unclear whether ROM data are personal data under the Dutch data protection law pending the Data Protection Authority's ruling, that consent is being used as a precaution, that the AP rather than the minister supervises the provider, and that patients are informed and can opt out.
It is not for me to call Parnassia to order. The AP is the supervisory authority in this area.
Het is niet aan mij om Parnassia tot de orde te roepen. De AP is toezichthouder op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het schenden van oorlogsgraven in de Waddenzee en de Noordzee

An MP asked the Defence and Culture ministers about looting of WWI-era war wrecks (British submarines E3 and E5, German cruiser SMS Mainz) in the Wadden Sea and North Sea and how these war graves are registered and protected. The government answered that protection is hard to guarantee at sea, described the stricter Heritage Act rules and a planned UNESCO convention, and promised to restate existing agreements to divers and deepen cooperation.
For war wrecks of foreign warships found in Dutch waters, including HMS E3 and HMS E5, the Netherlands does not structurally search for relatives of the crew members who died on those ships.

Ten aanzien van in Nederlandse wateren aangetroffen oorlogswrakken van buitenlandse oorlogsschepen, waaronder ook HMS E3 en HMS E5, wordt niet structureel vanuit Nederland gezocht naar nabestaanden van op die schepen omgekomen bemanningsleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht van Radar ‘Waar rook is: de macht van de tabaksindustrie’

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about a Radar broadcast on tobacco industry influence, covering smoking prevalence, cigarette measurement methods, illegal trade, industry-dominated standards committees and industry-funded research. The State Secretary answered most questions in substance, pointing to EU rules that prevent unilateral changes to cigarette measurement methods and promising further steps and reports.
The Netherlands is obliged to use the maximum permitted values and the testing method prescribed by the European Tobacco Products Directive.
Nederland is verplicht de maximum toegestane waarden en de onderzoeksmethode te gebruiken die wordt voorgeschreven door de Europese Tabaksproductenrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Dam over onnodige regeldruk voor vrijwillige verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dam asked about burdensome rules for volunteer traffic controllers, including the annual e-learning requirement and rising costs for events. The minister answered that eligibility was simplified from October 2017, that annual refresher training is kept for quality reasons, and that the matter of extra professional controllers is for municipalities to decide.
The trade-off has certainly been considered to extend this period, but insufficient justification was found for it.
De afweging is zeker gemaakt om deze periode op te rekken, maar daar is onvoldoende onderbouwing voor gevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Zevende rechtszaak van Stichting GGZ Momentum tegen verzekeraar om vrije artsenkeuze: Achmea schendt artikel 13 Zorgverzekeringswet'

MPs Voortman and Ellemeet asked the minister about GGZ Momentum's lawsuits against insurer Achmea over low reimbursement for non-contracted mental health care, which may breach the free choice of provider under article 13 Zvw and shift costs to patients. The minister answered that the 75-80% reimbursement benchmark has held up in court, that NZa supervises article 13 and is investigating insurers' reimbursement, and that the government will examine contracting issues and report to parliament.
Health insurers have their own responsibility when it comes to following case law on care procurement.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een eigen verantwoordelijkheid waar het gaat om het volgen van jurisprudentie met betrekking tot de zorginkoop.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht dat ministeries niet open zijn over de contacten met de tabaksindustrie

An MP asked the state secretary whether ministries are withholding their contacts with the tobacco industry from the transparency register and when disclosure will happen. The government acknowledged some contacts were not yet published, said the relevant documents have now been published or will be within a month, and committed to reminding local governments and ministries of their publication obligation.
I acknowledge that some of the contacts between ministries and the tobacco industry had not yet been disclosed.
Ik erken dat een deel van de contacten tussen ministeries en de tabaksindustrie nog niet was geopenbaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘Ministeries verzwijgen nog altijd gevoelige contacten met de tabaksindustrie’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health why ministries still withheld sensitive contacts with the tobacco industry, why some documents carried earlier publication dates, why Finance reported only one meeting a year when the register showed about 70 contacts, and whether the transparency register was incomplete and open to manipulation. The government admitted some contacts had not been published, said the missing documents were now posted or would be updated, explained the publication-date and contact-count discrepancies as technical and definitional, and committed to publishing the remaining documents.
I acknowledge that part of the contacts between ministries and the tobacco industry had not yet been disclosed.
Ik erken dat een deel van de contacten tussen ministeries en de tabaksindustrie nog niet was geopenbaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat ggz-instelling Parnassia ondanks kritiek nog groter mag worden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether he supports the proposed merger of mental health provider Parnassia with Virenze, whether it serves patients, and how fusion oversight by the NZa and ACM works, among other questions. The State Secretary answered that he takes no position on mergers, that the independent regulators NZa and ACM assess them, and that he sees no reason to commission research on mental health merger price effects.
It is not for me but for the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), as independent regulators, to assess merger proposals under the statutory frameworks.

Het is niet aan mij maar aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om, als onafhankelijk toezichthouders, fusievoornemens te beoordelen op grond van de wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Lange over het bericht ‘Helft ggz-aanbieders biedt inzicht in wachttijden’

An MP asked the state secretary why 45% of mental health providers had not yet supplied waiting-time data despite the mandatory NZa requirement, and about the timing of a patient choice website and waiting-list mediation. The state secretary answered that about 70% now deliver data, attributed delays to technical and administrative problems, committed to stepped-up enforcement and an NZa progress report in April, and said the website is expected in Q4 2018.
The NZa has indicated to me that it expects most technical problems to be resolved by the end of March, and that from that point measures will become progressively more individual and more binding.
De NZa heeft mij aangegeven dat zij verwacht dat eind maart de (meeste) technische problemen zijn opgelost en dat vanaf dat moment maatregelen stapsgewijs individueler en dwingender zullen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en De Lange over het onderzoek van Reporter Radio op radio 1 zondag 18 februari 2018 jl.

Two MPs asked the state secretary for health about a radio investigation showing that many mental health providers exceed the waiting time norms, and about regional differences, autism and personality disorder waiting lists, and the 1 July 2018 target. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described the regional taskforce approach and the NZa monitoring, and committed to sending an updated NZa report to parliament in April.
I have no insight into what percentage of the total number of people on waiting lists these specific groups make up.
Ik heb geen inzicht in welk percentage de hierboven genoemde specifieke groepen vormen van het totaal aantal wachtenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Zorg over groei geweld door verwarde mensen in Rotterdam’

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising incidents involving confused persons in Rotterdam and the police's role, training and the Schakelteam approach. The minister confirmed rising registered incidents (12% in 2017), said data cannot show unique persons or offences, and pointed to prevention, police training and Rotterdam's existing programmes without committing to new steps.
The police registration does not show the number of persons who committed or are suspected of a criminal offence while in a confused state.
Bij de politie is uit de registratie niet het aantal personen af te leiden dat in verwarde toestand een strafbaar feit heeft gepleegd of daarvan wordt verdacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitzending ‘2Doc: liever dood dan vermist’

MP Van Haga asks ministers about a documentary on unrecovered WWII aircraft wrecks, including the municipal discretion over salvage, cost sharing, and calls for harmonisation. The government acknowledges the emotional concerns, defends municipal discretion on safety and public order grounds, notes a 70% Rijk contribution and a working group on a decision framework, but does not change the rules.
The national government is willing to contribute to harmonising municipal policy.
Het Rijk is bereid een bijdrage te leveren aan het harmoniseren van het gemeentelijk beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Waar zijn de miljoenen voor de gezonde Veenkoloniën gebleven?’

MPs Dijksma and Nijboer asked the state secretary where the ten million euros for health measures in the Veenkoloniën went, whether bureaucracy hindered spending, and what health goals were set. The state secretary replied that EUR 3.5 million of the EUR 10 million has been spent on regional projects under the Kans voor de Veenkoloniën programme, that no signals of bureaucratic obstruction were received, and that results are too early to assess.
Currently EUR 3.5 million of the reserved EUR 10 million has been spent.
Er is momenteel € 3,5 miljoen van de gereserveerde € 10 miljoen besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Hermans en De Lange over het bericht 'Wachttijden onacceptabel'

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the causes of waiting times across healthcare sectors, whether insurers and providers have agreed to reduce them, and what the NZa can enforce. The minister answered that the NZa has an action plan, that insurers can be sanctioned under their duty of care, and that concrete follow-up such as reports to the House is planned.
Health insurers must make efforts to ensure that their insured persons receive good quality, accessible and timely care.
Zorgverzekeraars moeten zich inspannen om ervoor te zorgen dat hun verzekerden kwalitatief goede, bereikbare en tijdige zorg ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving dat resten van zeehelden op de vuilnisbelt liggen

An MP asked the Defence, Foreign Affairs and Health ministers about reports that human remains of Dutch naval war dead lie at dump sites near the Java Sea, and whether the government will recover and rebury them. The government confirmed contact with Indonesia and other flag states, offered help and requested on-site investigation, and said it will inform the families and parliament once there is clarity, though it cannot yet give a timeline.
Once there is clarity about the on-site investigation, we will inform you of this.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over het onderzoek ter plaatse, zullen wij u hierover berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het onderzoek “Economische’ daklozen vallen tussen wal en schip; Zelfredzaam zonder dak’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about a report on 'self-reliant' homeless people who fall between care systems, including how many exist and how the coalition agreement's call for better-aligned care applies. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said such people are not counted, attributed implementation problems to professionals' limited discretion, and promised a multi-year agenda and an update before summer 2018.
It is up to municipalities to provide shelter to all residents of the Netherlands who need it, regardless of the specific problems involved.
Het is aan gemeenten om aan alle ingezetenen van Nederland opvang te verlenen indien zij dat nodig hebben, ongeacht de specifieke problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de normalisering van gebruik van lachgas voor recreatieve doeleinden

MP Kuik (CDA) asks the government about the normalisation of recreational nitrous oxide use among young people, its benign image, online and retail sales, and enforcement against hospitality businesses supplying it. Minister Bruins answers that a Trimbos study shows concentrated but mostly incidental use, that Trimbos will add prevention on nitrous oxide, and that talks with retailers on voluntary restrictions are ongoing, with stronger measures to be considered if these fail.
I have asked the Trimbos Institute to include nitrous oxide as a specific theme in their current prevention offer to schools, parents and nightlife visitors.
Ik heb het Trimbos-instituut gevraagd lachgas als specifiek thema mee te nemen in hun huidige preventie-aanbod aan scholen, ouders en uitgaanders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat afhaalpunten voor pakketjes worden misbruikt door de tabaksbranche

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether tobacco shops used as parcel pick-up points expose customers to visible tobacco products, whether the display ban is consistent, and whether the tobacco industry's lobbying via trade groups will be investigated. The State Secretary answered that a planned display ban from 2022 will cover parcel pick-up shops, that no further investigation of indirect lobbying is deemed necessary, and that ministries and local bodies were informed of the WHO treaty's lobbying prohibition.
I am aware that the tobacco industry lobbies through other organisations. I do not consider it necessary to investigate this further.
Ik ben op de hoogte dat de tabakindustrie via andere organisaties lobbyt. Ik acht het niet noodzakelijk dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma over kindermisbruik op Aruba

MPs Kuiken and Dijksma asked why a 2015 motion calling for a joint Kingdom approach to child abuse on Aruba has not yet produced one, and whether a delay is acceptable. The state secretary cited Aruba's own responsibility, the postponed Kingdom working conference to March 2018, and ongoing interisland child-rights initiatives, but made no new binding commitment.
For Aruba, the approach to domestic violence and child abuse is a responsibility of the country itself.
Voor Aruba geldt dat de aanpak van huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling een verantwoordelijkheid is van het land zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Diertens over het onderzoek “Geweld tegen hulpverleners in de psychiatrie”

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about a study on violence against psychiatric care workers, including whether existing agreements give enough clarity on filing police reports, how the medical confidentiality rules relate to reporting, what prevention measures exist, and whether the government will engage with researchers on barriers victims face. The state secretary agreed safety is important, pointed to GGZ Nederland's initiative to consult police and prosecutors, and committed to asking GGZ Nederland to publicize the existing handreiking on reporting and confidentiality, while describing ongoing prevention efforts mostly as existing sector practice.
I will ask GGZ Nederland to give more publicity among its members to the O&O fund's handreiking.
Ik zal GGZ Nederland vragen onder haar leden meer bekendheid te geven aan de handreiking van het O&O fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de Tussentijdse rapportage Schakelteam voor personen met verward gedrag

An MP asks the state secretary about the interim report of the Schakelteam on persons with confused behaviour, covering transport gaps, response times, funding, police cell use, and crisis shelter provision. The state secretary acknowledges shortcomings, outlines regional transport meetings through December 2017 and a pilot-based funding approach, and commits to informing parliament on results and on structural funding in early 2018.
On the desirability and necessity of a specific arrangement for transport with psychiatric care and its structural funding, I will inform you in early 2018.
Over de wenselijkheid en noodzaak van een specifieke regeling voor vervoer met psychiatrische hulpverlening en de structurele bekostiging ervan zal ik u begin 2018 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het promoten van onbeperkt zonnen

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary about a sunbed chain offering unlimited monthly tanning without staff or age checks, in light of the SCHEER report on UV and skin cancer. The minister acknowledged the health risks, said the NVWA would visit the provider to check compliance, and judged additional information measures unnecessary while awaiting EU action.
I have asked the NVWA to visit the Dutch branch of the Danish sunbed provider to check whether the operator complies with the statutory rules for safe use of sunbeds.

Ik heb de NVWA gevraagd om een bezoek te brengen aan de Nederlandse vestiging van de Deense aanbieder van zonnebanken om na te gaan of de ondernemer zich houdt aan de wettelijke voorschriften voor het veilig gebruik van zonnebanken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Schotland voert minimumprijs voor alcohol in’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the Netherlands will follow Scotland in introducing a national minimum unit price for alcohol, and whether EU law blocks such a measure. The State Secretary confirmed EU law does not prevent minimum prices if proven more effective than tax increases, but declined to commit to a bill until the Scottish effects are observed.
I therefore want to first see what the possible effects of this measure in Scotland may be and will closely follow this step.
Ik wil daarom eerst zien wat de mogelijke effecten van deze maatregel in Schotland kunnen zijn en zal deze stap dan ook nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over beveiligde GGZ-zorg

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about shortages of secured mental health care (beveiligde GGZ), time-out beds and suitable housing, and why zorgverzekeraars may be holding back budget. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortages, pointed to agreements to raise purchasing of secured care, a sector norm due April 2018, and housing initiatives, while attributing part of the gap to insurers' contracting and providers not claiming care.

My predecessor informed you in her letter of 13 July 2017 that agreement was reached with the parties involved to immediately increase the purchasing of secured mental health care for patients who display aggressive or dangerous behaviour.

Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in haar brief van 13 juli 2017 u medegedeeld dat met betrokken partijen de afspraak is gemaakt de inkoop van beveiligde ggz-zorg voor patiënten, die agressief of gevaarlijk gedrag vertonen, onmiddellijk te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Voortman over zwerfjongeren

MPs Westerveld and Voortman asked about the rising number of young homeless people (zwerfjongeren), including estimates, possible causes such as the kostendelersnorm and the youth-to-adult care transition, and plans to prevent further growth. The government state secretary disputes the cited figure (citing CBS's 12,400 for 2016), says it is studying the trends, sees no need to change the kostendelersnorm or conduct new research now, and points to ongoing trajectories with results due in early 2018.
This study will be completed at the beginning of 2018.
Dit onderzoek zal begin 2018 worden afgerond.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Struijs over het bericht 'Ouderenmishandeling veel te weinig gemeld. Het komt misschien wel vaker voor dan kindermishandeling'

An MP asks whether elder abuse is under-reported and whether it is as common as child abuse, and what the government will do about detection, reporting, expertise centres, Veilig Thuis powers and funding. The state secretary answers that reporting figures are stable at about 2,000–2,500 per year, that new Maastricht research is expected in mid-2026, and that existing alliances make a new expertise centre unnecessary, while promising awareness campaigns, a signalling page and further monitoring.
I do not therefore simply share the conclusion that elder abuse occurs much more often than the prevailing estimate.
Ik deel daarmee niet zondermeer de conclusie dat ouderenmishandeling veel vaker voorkomt dan de gangbare schatting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Struijs over het artikel 'Schrijnend beeld: gepensioneerden zien inkomen al jaren achterblijven ten opzichte van anderen'

Members Van Brenk and Struijs (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an article showing pensioners' income lagging behind workers, the self-employed and benefit recipients, and about indexation of pensions compared with other EU countries. The minister confirmed the CBS figures but argued the article overstates the gap, attributed the lag mainly to limited indexation of supplementary pensions under the old system, rejected the age-discrimination claim, and promised a balanced purchasing-power outlook.
It is not possible to provide the requested information on the basis of publicly accessible data.
Het is niet mogelijk om op basis van publiek toegankelijke data de gevraagde informatie te verstrekken.
